description:
Implement the acyclic, schema-typed Runner V2 identity graph. This leaf owns semantic invocation, logical run, idempotent retry, replay-lineage, and nonsemantic process-attempt separation; consumes the sealed RunnerSpec root and base nominal wrappers; and mints no lifecycle, durability, scientific, or admission authority.

## Acceptance Criteria

The dedicated Acceptance Criteria field is the canonical close gate and includes exhaustive identity-schema, boundary, property, mutation, retry/replay, API/compile-fail, no-mock integration, and deterministic logging proof for this identity slice.
design:
Every runner-owned root uses fs_blake3::identity canonical schemas and nominal-role machinery, never ad hoc concatenation or an exposed generic ContentHash. RunnerSpecRootV2 is owned by 24.1.1.3. InvocationRootV2 is a distinct SemanticId schema with exact domain org.frankensim.fs-evidence-runner.invocation.v1. RunIdV2 is a distinct EntityId schema with exact domain org.frankensim.fs-evidence-runner.run.v1. Both use API generation 2, first wire version 1, explicit no predecessor, exact ordered FieldSpec lists, bounded CanonicalLimits, and checked constructors returning IdentityReceipt. Parsed identities are presented references only.

InvocationBasisV2 binds exactly: RunnerSpecRootV2; canonical RunnerCommandV2; canonical post-parse semantic argument tokens; family namespace and version; registered family mode; optional RunProfileV2 according to the frozen command table; immutable ordered CaseManifestRootV2; SourceIdentityRootV2; BuildIdentityRootV2; ToolchainIdentityRootV2; target triple; canonical feature set; RunnerBudgetsV2; tightened RunnerLimitsV2; ordered duplicate-rejected RootCapabilityPolicyRootV2 values sorted by embedded RootClassV2; optional PublicationSelectionV2 according to ArtifactDispositionV2; canonical logical input-object bindings with the output logical target present only inside PublicationSelectionV2; and optional ReplayLineageRootV2 present exactly for Replay. It does not duplicate MigrationExecutionBasisRootV2 outside the lineage. It excludes RunIdV2, ProcessAttemptIdV2, raw caller argv ordering, PID, attempt ordinal, scheduler or wall-clock data, output bytes or roots, lifecycle roots, diagnostics, and terminal state.

The CLI parser supplies identity tokens only after successful semantic parsing. Tokens use one frozen field order and normalized nominal values, so permutations of independent named options yield identical InvocationRootV2. Genuinely order-sensitive positional operands and the ordered case manifest retain their order. Duplicate or conflicting options refuse before identity construction. Raw OS-string bytes and presentation spelling are retained only in bounded nonsemantic diagnostics and never enter the identity.

RunIdV2 has one and only one typed child field, InvocationRootV2. It is computed through CanonicalEncoder and cannot include itself. An idempotent retry reuses the same InvocationBasisV2, InvocationRootV2, and RunIdV2. ProcessAttemptIdV2 is a private-field diagnostic token with no StrongIdentity implementation, canonical schema field, From or TryFrom relation, digest trait, or conversion to RunIdV2.

ReplayLineageV2 binds exactly, in order, the presented source BundleManifestRootV2, source SealRootV2, source PublishedBundleReceiptRootV2, source RunIdV2, source ReplaySupportBindingRootV2 when the source is itself a replay, MigrationExecutionBasisRootV2 for this replay, and checked u16 lineage_depth. The nominal wrapper types and domains exist in 24.1.1.1; their semantic constructors remain with the manifest and durable-publication owners. A replay request uses command Replay, the source immutable manifest selection, current source/build/toolchain/target/features/budgets, and this lineage. It receives a new InvocationRootV2 and RunIdV2 while retaining the exact source RunIdV2. Repeating the identical replay request is idempotent; it never reuses the source run identity.

Root-capability policy and path bindings stay nominal. Input and output artifact roots are distinct constructor parameters even when their digest bytes match. RootClassV2 Other accepts only a u16 policy ID already validated against the sealed 24.1.1.3 registry; this leaf does not register policy. Canonical feature sets reject duplicates before sorting. Exact-set registries are canonicalized only where their owner marks order nonsemantic.

Canonical AdmissionCandidateRefV1 has one owner: rjoq.7.2.1 in fs-govern::admission_interface. This leaf declares or imports none of it. In 24.5.1 the Runner seam validates BundleManifestRootV2 role/domain, then passes the registered Runner ProducerSchemaIdV1 plus exact digest bytes to the owner registered-manifest association API. The owner preserves bytes and returns ProducerManifestRootV1 without importing the Runner crate, rehashing, or exposing a generic conversion.

This leaf owns identity.rs, retry and replay identity support, focused tests, required module exports, and identity/no-authority contract sections. It does not own candidate.rs, comparison/effect evaluation, family sealing, artifact inventory, lifecycle, byte codecs, filesystem publication, process execution, resolver behavior, rjoq trait coherence, or any admission receipt.

PublicationSelectionV2 is semantic for every durable command and absent for List/Check/SelfTest. It binds explicit protocol, profile-tagged logical target, and destination admission mode parsed from canonical options and validated during preflight before InvocationRoot construction. The tagged CLI capability-slot spelling and acquired descriptor/handle/capability are nonsemantic; changing only those while resolving the same selection leaves identity stable. Changing protocol/profile/mode/logical target moves InvocationRootV2 and RunIdV2.

Replay lineage depth is derived, never caller-selected. A non-replay source manifest has retained depth 0; its first replay has depth 1; a nested replay has `checked_add(source_lineage_depth, 1)`. ReplayLineageV2 forbids zero, missing retained source depth, disagreement with the source ReplaySupportBinding, and u16 overflow. Overflow maps through the frozen migration/replay refusal table to Refused(MigrationRefused), base diagnostic `runner.refused`, RetryabilityV2::AfterInputChange, and a ranked repair to start from a shallower retained source; no identity or output is constructed.

MigrationExecutionBasisRootV2 is present exactly once inside ReplayLineageV2 for Replay and nowhere in non-Replay invocation identity. Current-wire replay binds the V1 no-adapter basis; migrated replay binds the exact verifier/target-schema/registry/selected-adapter/policy/capability/limits/budgets/authority basis. This identity is known before the lineage and InvocationRootV2 are frozen. A duplicated direct InvocationBasis field or any disagreement is a schema refusal. The later MigrationObservationRootV2 is an output retained through ReplaySupportBindingV2 and BundleManifestV2, never retroactively inserted into InvocationRootV2.

ReplayLineageV2 has the literal domain org.frankensim.fs-evidence-runner.replay-lineage.v1 and a private checked ReplayLineageRootV2 constructor owned here because this leaf owns its complete field list and depth derivation. MigrationExecutionBasisV2 and ReplaySupportBindingV2 are consumed unchanged from 24.1.1.5. ReplaySupportBindingRootV2 is required in the lineage only when the source manifest declares that its own command was Replay; fresh non-Replay source publications carry typed absence. The source manifest command and support-presence rule are checked before root construction.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Exact schema tests independently enumerate InvocationRootV2 and RunIdV2 domain, name, API generation, wire version, no-predecessor marker, context, role, field name, field order, wire type, presence, and typed child. An independent complete-frame oracle recomputes descriptors and roots.

2. Invocation identity tests vary every semantic field singly: spec, command, each canonical semantic argument and ordinal, family namespace/version/mode/profile, case manifest, source, build, toolchain, target, feature membership, budgets, every tightened limit, root capability policy, class, access, rights, and policy IDs, each logical input binding and the singular output target inside PublicationSelectionV2, and replay lineage. Every semantic change moves InvocationRootV2 and RunIdV2.

3. CLI canonicalization tests exhaust safe permutations of independent named options and prove identical post-parse tokens and roots. Duplicate, conflicting, missing, aliased, or inapplicable options refuse. Genuinely ordered operands and case order move the root.

4. Exclusion tests vary raw argv order and spelling, ProcessAttemptIdV2, PID-like data, attempt ordinal, scheduler order, wall-clock values, output bytes and roots, lifecycle roots, diagnostics, and terminal state while keeping InvocationBasisV2 fixed. Roots remain identical, and a schema-field audit proves exclusion rather than post-encode ignoring.

5. RunIdV2 tests prove the schema contains exactly one typed InvocationRootV2 child; independently recompute it; reject wrong root roles; prove no self field or cycle; preserve both roots across idempotent retry; and move RunIdV2 whenever InvocationRootV2 changes.

6. Replay tests cover a fresh source publication, exact manifest/seal/published-receipt/run joins, derived lineage depth one/exact-u16/overflow and explicit zero refusal, mutation of every lineage field, current environment identity changes, repeated identical replay, nested replay, and unrelated source substitution. A replay RunId differs from its source RunId and retains the source explicitly.

7. Feature, root, and path tests cover empty/one/exact/one-over sets, duplicates, stable sorting, Input versus Output swapping, Other policy present/missing/unregistered, relative-path validation, equal digest bytes under unequal roles, and maximum declarations without huge allocation.

8. Nominality compile-fail tests reject public identity literals, arbitrary bytes, root-role swaps, From/TryFrom/Deref/Borrow/AsRef erasure, generic digest containers, content-root-as-path behavior, ProcessAttemptId conversion, and any conversion into lifecycle, durability, Evidence, Certified, or admission authority. Positive tests use checked constructors and read-only getters.

9. All-zero and absence tests construct a present all-zero digest for each root role, prove it differs from typed absence, and reject sentinel omission. Lower-case canonical hex roundtrips; upper-case, whitespace, prefix, odd-length, and invalid-digit forms refuse.

10. Mutation/property tests cover every semantic field, descriptor field, role, domain, version, child relation, exclusion, retry relation, and replay relation. Each semantic mutant moves the expected root or refuses; nonsemantic mutants prove stability; minimized seeds and case names are retained.

11. A no-mock public-API fixture builds real base values, a sealed representative spec root, normal and replay InvocationBasisV2 values, retries, process attempts, every root class, and presented source publication roots through checked non-authoritative parsers. It exposes identity receipts only and has no candidate resolver, verifier, admission capability, scientific receipt, or authority receipt.

12. Candidate-ownership compile-fail and dependency tests prove fs-evidence-runner declares no AdmissionCandidateRefV1 or six authority field wrappers and has no accidental fs-govern admission dependency in this leaf. The test records the exact handoff owner and checked digest-preserving association contract for 24.5.1.

13. Deterministic logs retain schema/spec/source/build/toolchain/target/features roots, complete identity bases and exclusions, canonical argument tokens, retry/replay joins, expected and observed roots, owner/prerequisites/no-claim/repairs, minimized case, and relative fixture artifacts. They exclude absolute roots, handles, credentials, PIDs, wall-clock/scheduler data, raw candidate bytes, and secrets.

14. Focused unit, boundary, property/metamorphic, API/compile-fail, doctest, schema, mutation, retry/replay no-mock integration, and logging suites expose nonzero checked counts. Candidate construction and full runner-to-rjoq coherence remain 24.5.1.

15. Publication-selection identity tests exhaust required-versus-absent presence, all protocol/profile/mode/logical-target cells, preflight discovery, locator/descriptor/handle/capability metamorphism, destination-mode substitution, ContentStore logical key versus physical prefix, and canonical path bindings. Semantic selection changes move both roots; nonsemantic acquisition changes do not.

16. Replay-execution and depth tests independently derive fresh depth 1 and every nested `source + 1`, reject caller-provided/zero/missing/mismatched/overflow depth with the exact MigrationRefused diagnostic and repair, bind current-wire no-adapter versus registered adapter bases exactly once inside ReplayLineageV2, reject a duplicated direct InvocationBasis migration field or disagreement, vary every verifier/schema/registry/adapter/policy/capability/limits/budgets/authority root, and prove later MigrationObservation affects retained support/output roots but not the already frozen invocation identity.

17. ReplayLineageRootV2 tests independently enumerate its literal domain and ordered fields, recompute complete frames, and cover fresh non-Replay source typed absence versus nested-Replay required support. Source command/support disagreement, wrong support root, missing depth, wrong derived depth, and every full-frame mutation refuse or move the lineage, invocation, and run roots.

18. IMMUTABLE RELEASE-E2E CONTRIBUTIONS. This leaf freezes exact identity/replay contribution rows for `scripts/ci/e2e_evidence_runner_publication_v2.sh`, `e2e-evidence-verifier-v2-driver` through `scripts/ci/e2e_evidence_verifier_v2.sh`, consuming `scripts/ci/manifests/evidence_verifier_v2_cases.v1.json` (`.v1` is the case-manifest schema version; the public verifier route remains v2), `scripts/ci/canonical_evidence_runner_v2.sh`, and `scripts/ci/verify_runner_rjoq_handoff_v1.sh`, each bound to its sole downstream owner. Every row contains a stable ID, semantic fixture, independent expected identity/refusal/Unsupported oracle, explicit budgets, source/build/schema/oracle/log-schema roots, no-claim scope, and exact downstream owner/script. This leaf executes its identity constructors and replay-lineage models in process without mocks and returns context-bound in-process execution roots, but it neither executes nor reports success for a downstream release script. Result-free manifest roots, in-process execution roots, and later downstream release-result roots are distinct and non-substitutable.

19. Source-closure tests exact-set-bind every file and generated input owned or consumed by this leaf: implementation modules, CONTRACT/rustdoc, schema/domain/descriptor and constructor tables, independent oracles, unit/property/mutation fixtures, E2E contribution rows, log schemas, direct dependency/source/feature identities, and build configuration. One-at-a-time missing, extra, stale, reordered, ambient, unpinned, duplicate-owner, or mixed-snapshot inputs move the closure or refuse before proof; no retained binary/root can stand in for absent source. Source-closure accounting uses the final global close-manifest partitions. Workspace-relative source paths and downstream script mappings are typed mappings, not retained execution artifacts. Only an artifact actually produced by this leaf in-process run may be reported as retained leaf evidence.

20. The final GLOBAL REALITY-CHECK CLOSE-MANIFEST RECONCILIATION is the only leaf-wide green equation. This leaf adds identity, retry, and replay-specific positive, refusal, failure, mutation, Unsupported, inapplicable, logging/redaction, and source-closure cells without defining a second aggregate vocabulary.

21. GLOBAL REALITY-CHECK CLOSE-MANIFEST RECONCILIATION (CONTROLLING). Earlier `eligible`/`passed`/`failed` shorthand and any single collapsed `matched expected refusals` counter are compatibility-only and cannot close this leaf. The leaf must expose one result-free, source-authoritative, full-set-only close manifest that exact-sets every stable test and E2E cell into all nine preserved category groups: literal/unit/boundary; property/metamorphic; state/typestate/model/race; mutation/fuzz; API/compile-fail/trait; fault/resource/cancellation; release-built no-mock E2E or immutable E2E contribution; detailed deterministic logging/redaction; and source closure. Each applicable category and each applicable slash-separated facet has a separately nonzero corpus. A genuinely inapplicable facet requires a registered typed reason with stable code/name, exact owner, execution scope, prerequisite, and no-claim text; it cannot hide an eligible cell.

Result accounting retains distinct counters and exact ID sets for: eligible positives and matched positives; eligible expected refusals and matched expected refusals; eligible expected failures and matched expected failures; eligible mutations and matched mutations; typed Unsupported cells with exact matched reasons; typed inapplicable cells with exact matched registered reasons; unexpected mismatches; execution failures; and unexplained skips. It also reports checked aggregate adversarial totals as the sums of the three adversarial subpartitions without replacing them. Green requires each matched subpartition to equal its own eligible subpartition, every eligible stable ID exactly once in canonical order, nonzero applicable positive and adversarial corpora, exact Unsupported/inapplicable reason equality, and zero unexpected mismatches, execution failures, and unexplained skips. An expected failure is never an execution failure, a mutation is never relabeled as a refusal, and an empty/subset selection can never be green. Missing, extra, duplicate, reordered, stale, reclassified, wrong-reason, or wrong-scope manifest/result rows refuse structurally.

Where this leaf owns execution, comprehensive unit/integration/property/model/race/fault/mutation/API tests and the named E2E script run release-built with no mocks. Where execution belongs downstream, this leaf instead emits immutable stable rows binding independent literal expectations/oracles, semantic inputs, explicit time/memory/work/process/artifact/log budgets, schema and log-schema roots, source/build roots, exact downstream owner and script, and no-claim scope; it cannot report that downstream execution passed. E2E tests cover happy, boundary, expected-refusal, expected-failure, mutation, Unsupported, inapplicable, cancellation/drain, resource-return, and hidden-skip cases with deterministic stable IDs and exact first divergence.

Canonical bounded logs retain stable cell/category/facet IDs; semantic-input, source, build, schema, oracle, budget, manifest, and execution roots; ordered stage observations and terminal stage; expected/observed classification; first-divergence ID/root; resource and drain outcomes; exact result partitions; ranked non-executable repair manifest; no-claim scope; and safe relative retained-artifact references. They reject or type-redact secrets, credentials, environment values, live capabilities, raw resources/handles, absolute or physical paths, PIDs, wall clock, scheduler noise, and bulk payloads. Rejection diagnostics retain only a stable redacted data class and must not echo the sentinel through `observed`, Display, Debug, canonical bytes, logs, or reproduction text. Logging tests cover zero/one/exact/one-over limits, checked overflow, missing/extra/duplicate/reordered/truncated events, wrong roots/counts/reasons, redaction for every forbidden class, and deterministic replay.

Every user-visible Refused, Unsupported, divergent Negative, expected failure, and unexpected mismatch carries one bounded deterministic actionable diagnostic with registered code, precise redacted typed expected/observed values, owner, retryability, exact prerequisites, no-claim scope, and uniquely ranked declarative repairs. Repairs cannot contain or invoke commands, callbacks, scripts, credentials, raw capabilities/resources/handles/provider payloads, physical paths/locators, or automatic mutations. Source closure exact-sets all implementation, contract/rustdoc, schema/domain/owner tables, independent oracles, fixtures, E2E manifests/scripts or contribution rows, log schemas, dependencies/features, and build configuration on one compatible stable snapshot. Closeout reports focused proof, release-built E2E or contribution proof, source closure, DSR, and any downstream/scientific/authority proof separately and never promotes one into another.

FIVE EXPLICITS DECLARATION, RUNTIME-EVIDENCE, AND COMPLETE-LOG GATE (CONTROLLING). Every stable literal, unit, boundary, property, metamorphic, state, typestate, model, race, mutation, fuzz, API, fault, and E2E cell binds one declaration-side Five Explicits contract: typed units for every numeric input, numeric grant, and expected numeric observation; one canonical seed declaration plus generator/minimizer version, or a registered `SeedInapplicable` code with owner, scope, prerequisite, and no-claim; seven-axis hard and soft time, memory, logical-work, process, artifact, output, and log budgets with process shape declared separately; exact API, wire, schema, source, build, toolchain, target, profile, and feature version requirements; one exact required/permitted semantic capability contract; and the exact no-claim. Runtime actual numeric observations, resolved seed provenance, budget reconciliation, observed versions, and actual required, granted, observed, returned, and revoked capability sets exist only inside disposition-gated runtime evidence. `Observed` requires complete actuals; `NotObserved` may retain only safe typed partial evidence plus its exact reason and cannot substitute expected values; `Deferred` and `Inapplicable` contain no fabricated actuals. Changing any applicable declaration or actual explicit moves exactly the intended component, cell, evidence, log, reproduction, aggregate, and report roots. Bounded log writers reserve sufficient bytes for one canonical terminal event before admitting detail events. The first event that would exceed the remaining detail budget emits one complete deterministic `LogBudgetExceeded` terminal containing the rejected event class and ordinal, digest, omitted count, applicable budget, first-divergence stage, disposition, drain/resource outcome, diagnostic owner, repair-manifest root, and no-claim. Partial JSONL, silent truncation, overwriting prior events, missing terminal state, expected-as-actual substitution, fabricated observed-empty data, or treating overflow as success refuses. Minimized reproduction evidence retains every applicable declaration and safe actual explicit without exposing a forbidden value.

INVOCATION SEED IDENTITY (CONTROLLING). `InvocationBasisV2` gains exactly one `InvocationSeedSelectionRootV2` semantic child after the ordered case-manifest field and before source/build identity. Run binds the canonical parsed selection; List, Check, and SelfTest bind sealed `None`; Negative binds the sealed selection required by its selected case manifest; Replay preserves the exact source invocation seed selection and forbids override. Every exact field-order/count oracle, identity receipt, retry/idempotency test, mutation table, source closure, and replay-lineage test is revised explicitly. Changing applicable seed material moves InvocationRootV2 and RunIdV2; retry preserves them; process attempt, worker, scheduling, and wall-time data remain excluded.

READINESS OWNER CLARIFICATION (CONTROLLING). This leaf is blocked on `frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.1.1.3.2.3`, the sole RunnerSpec and executable-descriptor constructor owner, not the broader `.24.1.1.3` review rollup. The live blocking edge and precise owner are authoritative; all prior schema and proof requirements remain.

E2E ROUTE OBLIGATION MANIFEST GATE (CONTROLLING). Every leaf owns one exact ordered route-obligation manifest rather than a lossy leaf-wide binary. Each applicable obligation appears exactly once with `LeafCloseRouteObligationKindV1`: 1 `LocalInProcess`, 2 `ExecutionOwned`, 3 `ContributionOnly`, or 4 `Inapplicable`; zero and unknown refuse. A LocalInProcess row binds the real public in-process entry point, immutable cell oracle, budgets, expected partitions, detailed-log schema/root, source closure, and no-mock no-authority boundary. An ExecutionOwned row binds one literal release driver, POSIX wrapper where applicable, direct native-Windows driver or PowerShell wrapper as frozen by the owner contract, immutable case-manifest path/root, exact close argv, release-artifact identity, platform/provider matrix, declared capability profile, runtime evidence-envelope contract, retained relative artifacts, and complete detailed-log root. A ContributionOnly row binds one immutable result-free payload and Deferred envelope to exactly one downstream execution owner plus its literal driver, script/native route, manifest, observer contract, budgets, expected partitions, logging schema, source/build roots, and no-claim; it cannot report downstream execution passed. An Inapplicable row binds one registered reason, owner, scope, prerequisite, and no-claim. The derived leaf class is exactly `LocalOnly`, `ExecutionOnly`, `ContributionOnly`, or `Mixed`; multiple obligations and multiple contribution rows are legal and must remain distinct. Missing, extra, duplicate, reordered, generic, ambiguous, rollup-owned, stale, remapped, wrong-script, unconsumed, multiply consumed, debug, ambient/PATH-resolved/alternate/unregistered Cargo-run, hidden-skip, contribution-as-execution, or inferred leaf-class routes refuse. A specifically registered source-closed focused probe is legal only when its owner Bead names it and remains separately labeled non-closing evidence. Unit/exact-set, property/model, mutation, API/compile-fail, no-mock in-process or release-built E2E/contribution, deterministic detailed-log/redaction, structured-reproduction, resume/shard, overflow, and source-closure tests cover empty, one, maximum, mixed, duplicate, reorder, route substitution, owner remap, and every row-kind/derived-class transition. Focused/unit proof cannot substitute for a required release-built row or immutable contribution contract.

AC57 EVIDENCE-DISPOSITION CONSUMER GATE (CONTROLLING). This leaf consumes, and MUST NOT redefine, the exact evidence-kind, RuntimeObservationDispositionV1, reason-registry, completeness, safe-partial-evidence, resource-reconciliation, EvidenceEnvelopeV1, and FirstDivergentExplicitComponentV1 contracts governed by program gate `.24.1.1.1` and base contract owner `.24.1.1.1`. Every stable local cell and every exact route-obligation row maps to one and only one legal evidence-kind/disposition pair. OwnedHarnessExecution and InProcessProjectionExecution admit only Observed or NotObserved; ImmutableDownstreamContribution admits only Deferred; ApplicabilityDeclaration admits only Inapplicable. LocalInProcess and ExecutionOwned work may close Observed only after a completed attempt supplies every applicable actual numeric-observation, observed-seed-disposition, budget-reconciliation, observed-version, observed-capability-set, execution-completeness, attempt-identity, retained-state, and resource-reconciliation root. A matched refusal, expected failure, executed Unsupported outcome, or mutation survivor/kill remains Observed when observation is complete; semantic outcome never substitutes for observation disposition.

NotObserved is fail-closed and uses exactly one registered reason: 1 execution-failed-before-completeness, 2 observation-channel-failed-before-completeness, or 3 unexpected-unstarted-or-skipped. It preserves attempt and payload identity and may preserve only a separately rooted redacted safe-partial-evidence object; it never copies expected values into actual fields, encodes missing actuals as observed-empty, claims successful execution, or permits a green aggregate. Every ContributionOnly row emits exactly one result-free upstream payload plus a distinct Deferred envelope with reason 1 immutable-contribution-awaits-designated-release-owner and the designated owner/driver/native-or-script route/manifest/observer contract; the designated owner later emits a separate execution envelope and cannot overwrite, alias, or promote the upstream envelope. Inapplicable is legal only for a predeclared exact source-registered applicability descriptor and cannot be synthesized from runtime skip, infrastructure failure, unsupported provider discovery, or missing observation.

The leaf's result, report contribution, stage evidence, runtime aggregate, detailed cell event, log context, structured reproduction, normal terminal, overflow terminal, bounded prefix, final bounded log, route contribution, and source closure exact-join the applicable declaration components, runtime disposition, and envelope root. Actual component roots are present only for Observed; every non-Observed form carries exact typed absence plus its reason/descriptor and no-claim. Comparisons use the AC57 exact twenty-position FirstDivergentExplicitComponentV1 precedence and stop at the first unequal applicable component without logging rejected raw values. Unit and literal-oracle tests cover every owned legal row; zero/unknown code and complete/partial/absent boundaries; property/model/state/typestate laws; mutation and API/compile-fail barriers; no-mock in-process or release-built owner E2E, or immutable contribution plus owner-consumption E2E; execution/observation/grant/use/return/revoke/cancellation/resource faults; deterministic step-prefixed detailed logging, redaction, structured reproduction, overflow-before-divergence, shard/resume, and one-component root movement; exact coverage partitions; and source closure. Tests MUST reject every illegal kind/disposition/reason pair, expected-as-actual, observed-empty-as-complete, payload-as-envelope, upstream-as-owner envelope, contribution-as-execution, applicability-as-skip, duplicate/missing/reordered evidence, hidden skip, forbidden-value echo, and stale or mixed-snapshot root.

AC58 SCHEMA-IMPACT CONSUMER AND MIGRATION GATE (CONTROLLING). This leaf consumes, and MUST NOT redefine, the canonical-schema migration registry and independent literal schema oracle owned by base contract owner `.24.1.1.1` under program gate `.24.1.1.1`. Its exact source-authoritative SchemaImpactManifestV1 classifies every canonical frame, nominal root, registry, manifest, log event, terminal, report, projection, contribution, route envelope, and structured-reproduction schema that this leaf owns or consumes exactly once by stable schema ID and exact u16 disposition: 1 NewV1NoPredecessor, 2 UnchangedV1, 3 MigratedV1ToV2, 4 DecodeOnlyLegacyV1, 5 RetiredV1, or 6 InapplicableNoCanonicalFrame. Each row binds API generation, wire version and wire-predecessor policy, separate canonical-schema migration policy, exact domain, magic, ordered field descriptors, nominal root role, owner, source path, authoritative/compatibility status, allowed parent/child versions, no-claim, and compatible-source-snapshot root. Zero/unknown codes and missing, extra, duplicate, reordered, owner-inferred, route-inferred, stale, or mixed-snapshot rows refuse.

Wire compatibility and canonical-schema migration are non-interchangeable. API generation 2, wire version 1, and Runner wire predecessor NoPredecessor remain separate from canonical-schema policies NoSchemaPredecessor, V1DecodeOnlyCompatibilityEvidence, and V1Retired. A new component may begin at V1 only when it has no canonical predecessor. Every enclosing schema whose field order, field meaning, canonical payload, or authority semantics changes rotates coherently to a distinct V2 type, `.v2` domain, versioned magic, field table, and V2 nominal root on the same compatible source snapshot. An unchanged V1 child is legal inside a V2 parent only when the independent oracle explicitly records that unchanged component role and exact position. Decode-only or retired V1 bytes never alias, parse as, substitute for, or close an authoritative V2 path; partial migration, V2-parent/V1-child substitution outside an allowed unchanged slot, generic ContentHash bridging, transmute-like accessors, shared domains/magics, compatibility aliases, and caller-minted roots refuse.

Every literal/unit/boundary, property/metamorphic, state/model/race, mutation/fuzz, API/compile-fail, fault/resource/cancellation, no-mock E2E or immutable-contribution, deterministic detailed-log/redaction, structured-reproduction, coverage, and source-closure fixture owned by this leaf names the authoritative schema versions and compatible snapshot. Tests freeze every V1 compatibility byte fixture before migration; exhaust exact-empty, one, exact maximum, one-over, missing/extra/duplicate/reordered rows; mutate every domain, magic, version, policy, field descriptor, nominal role, source owner, parent/child version, and snapshot; prove exact root movement and typed inspectability; reject V1/V2 and cross-role substitution, old-root-as-new-root, stale literal counts, and partial or mixed-snapshot migration; and exercise the exact release-built route or immutable contribution plus designated-owner consumption with step-prefixed logs, first explicit divergence, structured reproduction, overflow/resume, retained-relative-artifact policy, and no forbidden-value echo. CONTRACT/rustdoc, public accessors, route manifests, detailed log schemas, reproduction descriptors, coverage manifests, source closure, and all literal ratchets MUST agree on the same authoritative version; focused, strict-remote, release-built E2E, DSR, downstream, durability, scientific, and authority results remain separate proof states.

EXACT CONTRIBUTION-ONLY ROUTE ROW runner-v2.route.24-1-1-2.to.phase1-contract.v1 (CONTROLLING). title: Runner V2 evaluator and case-conformance exact-set implementation rollup
description:
Exact-set proof-and-ownership rollup over four nonoverlapping evaluator implementation leaves: immutable evaluator schemas and bounded DAG arenas; presented-input admission and context preflight; deterministic comparison/effect evaluation and cross-lane conformance; and independent proof, release contributions, logging, and source closure.

The four-child union implements the complete original evaluator/raw-outcome/conformance contract without removing any schema, constructor, error, nested expectation, mutation, E2E, logging, source-closure, or no-authority requirement. This rollup owns no implementation, constructor, test cell, E2E execution, contribution row, or authority; it closes only by exact-set joining the four child close manifests on one compatible snapshot.

## Success Criteria

The dedicated Acceptance Criteria field is the authoritative exact-set rollup gate. Every direct child must close on one compatible source/build/proof snapshot with its complete test or contribution, release-built E2E, deterministic-log, result-partition, and source-closure roots; the rollup owns no implementation and cannot replace a missing child, proof class, or no-claim boundary with status, prose, or aggregate counts.
design:
CONTROLLING OWNERSHIP PROJECTION. Evaluator ownership is fixed: 24.1.1.3.1.1 owns vocabulary, schemas, nominal roots, registry view API, and bounded arenas; .3.1.2 owns presented-input admission, effect requirements, validated views, and context preflight; .3.1.3 owns deterministic comparison/effect evaluation, errors, mismatch details, raw outcomes, artifact projection semantics, expected-outcome conformance, and verdict construction; .3.1.4 owns independent proof, aggregate downstream contribution manifests, logging reconciliation, and the exact union of the four child source closures. Parent 24.1.1.3.1 owns only their exact-set join.

Children 24.1.1.3.1.1-.3 jointly own the immutable bounded evaluator wire/API algebra: .1 owns vocabulary, schemas, nominal roots, and arenas; .2 owns admission and preflight; .3 owns evaluation and conformance and no lifecycle or terminal constructors. Checked private arenas contain at most 256 unique nodes, 512 edges, depth 32, and 4096 memoized first visits. Builders reject dangling/cyclic handles, cap breaches, and empty `Any`; empty `All` is Match, `Not` has exactly one child, and `Any` has one or more children so every Mismatch has representable detail. Repeated handles are accepted immutable DAG sharing; unique nodes, every edge, longest depth, identity references, and first-visit preorder are counted separately.

`EvaluationLaneV2` is exact: 1 Comparison and 2 Effect. `ComparisonNodeV2` u16 discriminants and ordered fields are exact: 1 Exact { observation_key, expected_value }; 2 OrderedRange { observation_key, inclusive_lower, inclusive_upper }; 3 SetEqual { observation_key, expected_values }; 4 MultisetEqual { observation_key, expected_value_counts }; 5 SequenceEqual { observation_key, expected_values }; 6 RootEqual { observation_key, expected_nominal_root }; 7 DiagnosticEqual { observation_key, expected_diagnostic }; 8 All { ordered_child_handles }; 9 Any { nonempty ordered_child_handles }; 10 Not { child_handle }. OrderedRange refuses lower > upper and uses only the closed exact numeric compatibility table. Set inputs canonicalize after duplicate detection; multiset counts are nonzero u32; sequence and Boolean order remain semantic.

`EffectNodeV2` u16 discriminants and fields are exact: 1 RootTransitionEqual { named_root, expected_before_root, expected_after_root }; 2 NoAuthority { authority_scope_id }; 3 NoExternalMutation { ordered_root_class_set }; 4 ArtifactSetEqual { expected_artifact_set_root }; 5 ResourceDeltaEqual { resource_identity, expected_signed_rational_delta, unit }; 8 All { ordered_child_handles }; 9 Any { nonempty ordered_child_handles }; 10 Not { child_handle }. It uses the same arena, DAG, error, and mismatch rules and observes immutable before/after snapshots only.

`ObservationValueV2` u16 variants and ordered payloads are exact: 1 Scalar { TypedValueV2 }; 2 Sequence { ordered TypedValueV2 values }; 3 Set { canonical unique values }; 4 Multiset { canonical value, nonzero u32 count pairs }; 5 Diagnostic { complete ActionableDiagnosticV2 }; 6 NominalRoot { role, domain, digest }; 7 RootSet { canonical nominal roots }; 8 AuthorityScope { presented root, canonical u16 capability scopes }; 9 ExternalMutationSet { canonical external identity/generation/content-root tuples }; 10 ArtifactSet { ArtifactSetObservationV2 }; 11 Resource { ResourceObservationV2 }. `ObservationSetV2` is zero through 256 duplicate-rejected, fully namespaced keys sorted canonically.

`DiagnosticEqual` compares every canonical structured ActionableDiagnosticV2 field: code and namespace, retryability, expected/observed typed data, owner, ordered prerequisites, no_claim_scope, and every ranked RepairActionV2 field including display_hint. Only an external localized/rendered prose presentation that is not stored in the schema is excluded. The complete 8192-byte diagnostic cap is enforced before comparison.

The closed numeric table is exact. Exact requires the same TypedValueV2 variant and bytes, except Quantity additionally validates identical canonical unit. OrderedRange admits exact checked promotion across signed integers, unsigned integers, nonnegative signed-to-unsigned, Rational, Decimal, and Quantity after exact rational scale conversion with identical SI dimensions. F32Bits/F64Bits support Exact only and never cross width. Overflow is EvaluationErrorV2::ArithmeticOverflow, never rounding.

`EvaluationErrorV2` has ten exact u16 variants. Every actual frame begins with the common ordered prefix `lane, EvaluationContextRootV2`, followed only by its variant payload: 1 MissingObservation { key }; 2 UnexpectedObservation { key }; 3 DuplicateObservation { key, first_ordinal, second_ordinal }; 4 IncompatibleType { node_ordinal, key, expected_kind, observed_kind }; 5 UnitUnavailable { node_ordinal, key, unit_id }; 6 UnitDimensionMismatch { node_ordinal, key, expected_dimensions, observed_dimensions }; 7 ArithmeticOverflow { node_ordinal, operation }; 8 LimitExceeded { dimension, unit, limit, observed }; 9 UnknownRegistryId { namespace, id }; 10 MalformedEffectSnapshot { field, expected_shape, observed_shape }, legal only in the Effect lane. Frames are bounded and content-addressed as `EvaluationErrorRootV2`; missing or surplus fields refuse.

`MismatchDetailV2` has exact u16 variants: 1 ExactValue, 2 RangeBelow, 3 RangeAbove, 4 SetMissing, 5 SetExtra, 6 MultisetCount, 7 SequenceLength, 8 SequenceElement, 9 RootIdentity, 10 DiagnosticField, 11 BooleanInversion, 12 RootTransition, 13 AuthorityOrExternalMutation, 14 ArtifactSet, 15 ResourceDelta. Every actual frame begins with the common ordered prefix `lane, EvaluationContextRootV2, node_ordinal, first_occurrence_path, variant`; the path contains at most 32 u32 child ordinals. Only variants whose closed payload table requires an observation key contain one, and every variant admits only its required typed payload. Complete detail size is at most 8192 bytes and has `MismatchDetailRootV2`; missing or surplus fields refuse.

Each lane evaluates every unique reachable node once in canonical first-visit preorder. A lane never short-circuits away an error: its lowest-preorder error outranks any Match/Mismatch. Error-free All selects its first mismatching child, a fully mismatching nonempty Any selects its first child mismatch, and Not attributes inversion. Comparison and Effect lanes both always evaluate. `CaseRawOutcomeV2` stores comparison outcome then effect outcome, each as Match, Mismatch(detail/root), or EvaluationError(error/root). Cross-lane attribution order is Comparison before Effect only for selecting a single reported first divergence; it never suppresses or masks the other retained lane result.

Expected results are separate from raw outcomes and never contain actual manifest-bound evaluator values or roots. `ExpectedLaneOutcomeV2` is exact: 1 Match; 2 ExactMismatch { complete root-free `ExpectedMismatchFrameV2` }; 3 ExactEvaluationError { complete root-free `ExpectedEvaluationErrorFrameV2` }. `CaseDomainClaimModeV2` is 1 DomainConformance or 2 ExerciseOnlyNoDomainClaim. The final controlling acyclic contract below freezes the complete `CaseConformanceSpecV2` field order. Effects default to and normally require Match; a negative comparison expectation cannot mask an effect mismatch or error.

`CaseConformanceVerdictV2` is 1 Match or 2 Mismatch { `CaseConformanceMismatchV2` }. Match requires both actual lane outcomes to equal their complete expected nested frames after the actual contexts project to the sealed expectation precontexts. Mismatch binds the first divergent lane, the exact expected tagged nested frame, the exact observed tagged actual frame/root, and the retained other-lane actual frame/root. `ExerciseOnlyNoDomainClaim` still requires both exact expectations and yields the normal conformance verdict and downstream CaseTerminal basis, but explicitly asserts no domain or authority claim. There is no no-terminal executed case.

Raw evaluator outcomes, expected frames, and conformance verdicts are neutral and non-authoritative. 24.1.2 alone applies the command x claim-mode x conformance/raw-error mapping to ProofExit. No Match/Mismatch/error/observation/effect can directly construct a terminal, durability proof, scientific Evidence, Certified, or admission receipt.

The sealed manifest must carry the same `CaseEvaluationKeyV2`, expressions, requirements, conformance spec, and fixture policy established before manifest construction. Presented and validated input roots bind that key; actual contexts add the manifest root and must project exactly to any sealed expectation precontext. A raw outcome, mismatch detail, evaluator error, or conformance verdict from another key/manifest/spec/expression/input cannot be substituted even when its visible Match/Mismatch tags and digest bytes under another role happen to agree. Lifecycle consumes these roots unchanged and cannot rebind them.

## Diagnostic integration ownership clarification

MismatchDetailV2, lane ordering, the exact first-divergent-lane frame, and comparison/effect semantic contents are owned and proved here. 24.1.1.1 freezes only the stable diagnostic code/name and bounded non-authoritative detail-reference handoff. No other leaf may recreate the structured frame.

## Controlling reality-check reconciliation: input preflight, registry binding, and effect snapshots

Effect semantics are exact. RootTransitionEqual compares expected and observed before first, then after. NoAuthority requires the same authority-scope identity and an after capability-scope set that is equal to or a strict subset of before; widening, substitution, or an unregistered scope mismatches or errors. NoExternalMutation requires exact canonical identity, generation, and content-root tuple equality in each selected class; missing, extra, reordered-equivalent, and changed tuples are distinguished. ArtifactSetEqual compares the complete canonical after ArtifactSetRootV2. ResourceDeltaEqual resolves its exact EvaluationUnitRefV2, requires identical SI dimensions, performs checked rational conversion, and compares after minus before without rounding. Nominal-root tests cover all fourteen final base-declared evaluator/conformance wrappers plus ArtifactSetRootV2 and ExternalMutationSetRootV2, exact domains and Spec/Run/Policy roles, private semantic constructors, all-zero-present values, cross-role/domain/case/input/registry substitutions, and one-field complete-frame movement. The semantic constructor owner is exactly EvaluatorAndCaseConformance; no later leaf redeclares these types.

32. Artifact projection tests consume the base ArtifactCodecIdV2 and LogicalExtentV2 and freeze the paired integrity-layer entry order from the controlling design. They prove field-for-field parity with the 24.1.1.4 inventory schema, including all three length/root pairs, producer data, required flag, path antichain, extent ordering, registered axis/unit validation, and exact ArtifactSetRootV2 movement. Child 24.1.1.3.1.1 owns only the artifact-observation schema and child .3.1.3 owns only projection/comparison semantics; neither implements a codec relation, decoder, inventory, manifest, publication, or durability behavior.

33. Precedence and payload-table tests independently enumerate every EvaluationErrorV2 and MismatchDetailV2 required/forbidden field, structural-preflight precedence, lowest-first-visit node errors, set union ordering, multiset count ordering, sequence element-before-length, diagnostic field order, artifact path/field order, root before/after order, Boolean attribution, comparison-before-effect reporting, and retained other-lane outcome. Missing or surplus payload cells refuse, and every semantic one-field mutation moves the exact root.

34. Work-accounting tests independently count unique node entries, edges, lookups, registry probes, collection elements, diagnostic fields, artifact fields, and conversion steps; cover zero/one/exact-4096/4097 without large allocation; prove shared DAG nodes execute once while references still charge; and show early mismatch never skips chargeable error discovery. Counts and per-kind totals are emitted in closed deterministic logs and reconcile with aggregate coverage.

35. Corrected release E2E tests produce immutable result-free contribution manifests plus exact in-process execution roots for the three downstream journeys. They reject missing, extra, duplicate, stale, reordered, unmapped, or context-substituted consumption and report AC31 partitions, detailed logs, source closure, and typed absent-retained-artifact claims. Child 24.1.1.3.1.4 does not create, edit, execute, or claim release-built downstream scripts.

36. Final presented/validated vocabulary tests exact-set enumerate all fourteen evaluator/conformance roots and exclude `ObservationInputRootV2`, `EffectSnapshotInputRootV2`, and `CaseEvaluationRegistryRootV2`. Public-construction tests make all ten evaluator errors reachable through real bounded presented inputs while compile-fail tests prove arbitrary inputs cannot mint validated observation, snapshot, requirements, registry, context, error, detail, raw-outcome, or verdict roots. Zero/one/256/257/258 rows, per-cell size bounds, presentation ordinal derivation, valid permutation behavior, invalid-root absence, and exact context substitution are covered in both lanes.

37. Requirements, registry, context, and complete-payload tests independently derive the exact effect requirements from every effect arena; cover identical deduplication, conflicts, all five keys, every before/after shape, 256/257 requirements, and manifest disagreement; exact-set every registry category and family/version binding; mutate every EvaluationContextV2 field; and independently enumerate every required/forbidden field and atom of all ten errors and fifteen mismatch variants. Missing, surplus, open-ended, cross-lane, cross-case, cross-registry, cross-expression, cross-requirement, presented/validated-substituted, reordered, stale, and one-field-mutated frames refuse or move the proper root.

38. Final precedence and downstream-parity tests exhaust simultaneous limit, unknown-ID, duplicate, missing, unexpected, malformed-shape, incompatible-type, unit-unavailable, dimension-mismatch, arithmetic-overflow, mismatch, and Match conditions in both lanes under the frozen stage and tie order. Artifact observation uses the paired field order and has no compile dependency on 24.1.1.4; later inventory parity is a downstream projection. No-mock E2E contribution manifests, deterministic closed logs, coverage joins, and source closure retain presented and validated roots separately, registry/requirements/context roots, selected stage and ordinal/key/path, both lane results, validated-root absence reasons, exact AC31 outcome partitions, and typed absent-retained-artifact claims without editing or claiming execution of downstream scripts.

39. Registry-normalization and scoped-artifact tests cover codes 53 and 66-71 independently; normalized logical/evaluation unit conversions; same-number/different-typed-namespace acceptance; cross-type refusal; fixed-codec binding; and absence of free conversion/callback tables. Artifact tests exact-set filter by both case ID and manifest ordinal, covering empty/one/many entries, two-case isolation, right-ID/wrong-ordinal, wrong-ID/right-ordinal, cross-case leakage, canonical permutations, required-present metadata, missing/extra required expectations, and no-completeness-without-ArtifactSetEqual. Root tests independently encode registry/case/ordinal/entry frames and external view/class/tuple frames; every registry, scope, path, paired field, required bit, or tuple mutation moves the proper root or refuses. No-mock E2E, detailed logs, coverage joins, and source closure retain the exact scope and no-claim boundary.

40. Contribution identity tests independently enumerate the exact three journey rows, domains, owners, script mappings, stable IDs, semantic fixtures, and required root joins. Missing, extra, duplicate, reordered, stale, remapped, result-contaminated manifest, context-free execution, manifest/execution substitution, cross-journey row reuse, or fabricated retained artifact refuses. Each downstream owner exact-set consumes only its named row plus both aggregate roots; detailed logs and coverage reconcile all positive/expected-refusal/Unsupported cells with zero unexpected mismatches.

41. Acyclic expectation tests independently encode CaseEvaluationKey, EvaluationPrecontext, actual EvaluationContext, both expected nested frame types, CaseConformanceSpec, raw outcome, mismatch, and verdict. They topologically sort registry/view to expressions/requirements to fixtures/expected frames/spec to CaseManifest to actual contexts/outcomes/verdict, rejecting every reverse/self edge. Compile-fail and mutation tests forbid actual error/detail values or roots inside expectations, CaseManifest/context/outcome/lifecycle roots inside precontext/spec, wildcard expectations, generic digests, and every key/precontext/context substitution.

42. Fixture/command tests cover Run absent-fixture Match/Match, Negative required immutable fixtures with every exact Match/Mismatch/Error pair, designated SelfTest/Check policies, ExerciseOnly no-claim, current/nested replay preservation, zero/one/256/257/258 presented rows, validated-root presence by stage, and valid permutation canonicalization. Expected nested payloads are compared field-for-field with actual manifest-bound frames; same visible tags under a different key, manifest, registry, expression, requirements, presentation, or validated view diverge exactly.

43. DAG-aware no-mock E2E, contribution, detailed-log, coverage, and source-closure tests retain CaseEvaluationKey, fixture roots, precontexts, actual contexts, expected nested frames, both actual outcomes, raw/verdict roots, selected divergence, and no-claim scope separately. Independent oracles reconstruct every frame and root; missing, extra, duplicate, reordered, stale, cyclic, context-collapsed, or result-contaminated rows refuse. Green requires nonzero positive and expected-refusal/expected-failure/mutation corpora, typed Unsupported cells, every eligible ID once, and zero unexpected mismatches.

44. The final GLOBAL REALITY-CHECK CLOSE-MANIFEST RECONCILIATION exclusively defines the child-union categories and green requirements. The four mapped evaluator children contribute their scoped model, race, fault, mutation, API/trait, in-process E2E, detailed-log/redaction, and source-closure cells to that exact manifest.

45. GLOBAL REALITY-CHECK CLOSE-MANIFEST RECONCILIATION (CONTROLLING). Earlier `eligible`/`passed`/`failed` shorthand and any single collapsed `matched expected refusals` counter are compatibility-only and cannot close any mapped evaluator implementation child. Each mapped evaluator implementation child must expose one result-free, source-authoritative, full-set-only close manifest that exact-sets every stable test and E2E cell into all nine preserved category groups: literal/unit/boundary; property/metamorphic; state/typestate/model/race; mutation/fuzz; API/compile-fail/trait; fault/resource/cancellation; release-built no-mock E2E or immutable E2E contribution; detailed deterministic logging/redaction; and source closure. Each applicable category and each applicable slash-separated facet has a separately nonzero corpus. A genuinely inapplicable facet requires a registered typed reason with stable code/name, exact owner, execution scope, prerequisite, and no-claim text; it cannot hide an eligible cell.

Result accounting retains distinct counters and exact ID sets for: eligible positives and matched positives; eligible expected refusals and matched expected refusals; eligible expected failures and matched expected failures; eligible mutations and matched mutations; typed Unsupported cells with exact matched reasons; typed inapplicable cells with exact matched registered reasons; unexpected mismatches; execution failures; and unexplained skips. It also reports checked aggregate adversarial totals as the sums of the three adversarial subpartitions without replacing them. Green requires each matched subpartition to equal its own eligible subpartition, every eligible stable ID exactly once in canonical order, nonzero applicable positive and adversarial corpora, exact Unsupported/inapplicable reason equality, and zero unexpected mismatches, execution failures, and unexplained skips. An expected failure is never an execution failure, a mutation is never relabeled as a refusal, and an empty/subset selection can never be green. Missing, extra, duplicate, reordered, stale, reclassified, wrong-reason, or wrong-scope manifest/result rows refuse structurally.

Where the mapped evaluator implementation child owns execution, comprehensive unit/integration/property/model/race/fault/mutation/API tests and the named E2E script run release-built with no mocks. Where execution belongs downstream, that mapped evaluator implementation child instead emits immutable stable rows binding independent literal expectations/oracles, semantic inputs, explicit time/memory/work/process/artifact/log budgets, schema and log-schema roots, source/build roots, exact downstream owner and script, and no-claim scope; it cannot report that downstream execution passed. E2E tests cover happy, boundary, expected-refusal, expected-failure, mutation, Unsupported, inapplicable, cancellation/drain, resource-return, and hidden-skip cases with deterministic stable IDs and exact first divergence.

Canonical bounded logs retain stable cell/category/facet IDs; semantic-input, source, build, schema, oracle, budget, manifest, and execution roots; ordered stage observations and terminal stage; expected/observed classification; first-divergence ID/root; resource and drain outcomes; exact result partitions; ranked non-executable repair manifest; no-claim scope; and safe relative retained-artifact references. They reject or type-redact secrets, credentials, environment values, live capabilities, raw resources/handles, absolute or physical paths, PIDs, wall clock, scheduler noise, and bulk payloads. Rejection diagnostics retain only a stable redacted data class and must not echo the sentinel through `observed`, Display, Debug, canonical bytes, logs, or reproduction text. Logging tests cover zero/one/exact/one-over limits, checked overflow, missing/extra/duplicate/reordered/truncated events, wrong roots/counts/reasons, redaction for every forbidden class, and deterministic replay.

Every user-visible Refused, Unsupported, divergent Negative, expected failure, and unexpected mismatch carries one bounded deterministic actionable diagnostic with registered code, precise redacted typed expected/observed values, owner, retryability, exact prerequisites, no-claim scope, and uniquely ranked declarative repairs. Repairs cannot contain or invoke commands, callbacks, scripts, credentials, raw capabilities/resources/handles/provider payloads, physical paths/locators, or automatic mutations. Source closure exact-sets all implementation, contract/rustdoc, schema/domain/owner tables, independent oracles, fixtures, E2E manifests/scripts or contribution rows, log schemas, dependencies/features, and build configuration on one compatible stable snapshot. Closeout reports focused proof, release-built E2E or contribution proof, source closure, DSR, and any downstream/scientific/authority proof separately and never promotes one into another.

46. EXACT-SET CHILD ROLLUP (CONTROLLING). This Bead owns no implementation, test cell, E2E execution, or downstream contribution row directly. Its frozen ordered child set is exactly frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.1.1.3.1.1 evaluator schemas and arenas; .24.1.1.3.1.2 presented-input preflight; .24.1.1.3.1.3 deterministic evaluation and conformance; and .24.1.1.3.1.4 independent proof, contributions, logging, and source closure. Closure requires all four children closed on one compatible source, build, toolchain, target, and feature snapshot and exact-set joins their result-free test manifests, owned release-built no-mock E2E execution roots or immutable downstream contribution roots, deterministic redacted log roots, source-closure roots, and separately reported proof states. Every original feature and acceptance obligation maps to at least one stable child-owned cell, while every stable cell has exactly one primary child owner. Missing, extra, duplicate, reordered, stale, reclassified, cross-child-substituted, mixed-snapshot, or result-contaminated child rows refuse. The rollup independently checks the disjoint union of eligible positives and matched positives; eligible expected refusals and matched expected refusals; eligible expected failures and matched expected failures; and eligible mutations and matched mutations; exact Unsupported and inapplicable reasons; and zero unexpected mismatches, execution failures, and unexplained skips. All preexisting acceptance criteria remain controlling. Focused proof, release-built E2E or contribution proof, source closure, DSR, and downstream, scientific, certificate, or authority proof are reported separately.

47. EXACT CHILD OWNERSHIP MAP (CONTROLLING). Evaluator ownership is fixed: 24.1.1.3.1.1 owns vocabulary, schemas, nominal roots, registry view API, and bounded arenas; .3.1.2 owns presented-input admission, effect requirements, validated views, and context preflight; .3.1.3 owns deterministic comparison/effect evaluation, errors, mismatch details, raw outcomes, artifact projection semantics, expected-outcome conformance, and verdict construction; .3.1.4 owns independent proof, aggregate downstream contribution manifests, logging reconciliation, and the exact union of the four child source closures. Parent 24.1.1.3.1 owns only their exact-set join. Every preserved semantic/test requirement is projected to that exact child owner or child union; no inherited parent-ownership wording is authoritative. It never grants implementation, constructor, test-cell, E2E-execution, contribution-row, source-closure, native-resource, scientific, admission, or authority ownership to this rollup. The rollup closes only from the frozen exact child set and cannot substitute its status or prose for any child close manifest.

ROLLUP FIVE-EXPLICITS AND LOG-COMPLETENESS JOIN (CONTROLLING). This rollup exact-set joins every direct child Five-Explicits root and complete-log root on the same source/build snapshot. Missing, extra, duplicate, stale, mixed, unit-ambiguous, seedless-without-typed-reason, over-budget, capability-incomplete, partially logged, silently truncated, or terminal-less child evidence refuses. Aggregate counts or a parent budget cannot replace any child cell exact explicit values or complete terminal log.

SEMANTIC SEED PROPAGATION AND PROOF JOIN (CONTROLLING). This bead does not invent a second seed type or hidden default. Every owned schema, fixture, command, execution, artifact, replay, verifier, receipt, log, source-closure, E2E row, or rollup join that carries an invocation or case preserves the exact upstream `InvocationSeedSelectionRootV2`, `CaseSeedPolicyV2`, and applicable `CaseExecutionSeedRootV2` or registered `NoRandomness` absence through typed parent bindings. Unit/property/model/race/mutation/API/compile-fail/release-E2E-or-contribution/log/source-closure proof covers omission, substitution, wrong case/run, stale/mixed snapshot, override, ambient randomness, and count-only evidence. Test-harness seeds remain separately typed Five-Explicit data and cannot substitute for the semantic workload seed. Seed evidence establishes reproducibility only and never scientific, publication, verification, or admission authority.

ROLLUP E2E ROUTE RESOLUTION JOIN (CONTROLLING). This rollup exact-set joins every direct child execution/contribution classification and proves a one-to-one mapping from each contribution row to one literal downstream owner, driver, script/native route, and immutable manifest. Every execution owner exact-set consumes its rows once and retains release identity, complete logs, source closure, result partitions, and relative artifacts. Missing, ambiguous, duplicate, stale, remapped, wrong-owner/script, unexecuted, multiply executed, hidden-skip, contribution-only-Pass, or focused-proof substitution refuses.

BASE AC54 DECLARATION/OBSERVATION EXACT-JOIN (CONTROLLING). This rollup consumes the base leaf AC54 contract without redefining its types, weakening provenance, or collapsing component roots. Every direct-child close row that contains or semantically reconstructs Runner base coverage exact-joins declaration-side five_explicits_declaration_root, numeric_inputs_root, numeric_grants_root, expected_numeric_observations_root, seed_requirement_root, budget_set_root, version_requirements_root, and capability_contract_root on one source/build/schema snapshot. expected_numeric_observations_root is the declared expected-observation contract, not proof of a runtime observation. Only execution-owning evidence may add separately derived actual numeric observations, observed_versions_root, and observed_capability_sets_root; schema-only and contribution-only rows preserve typed nonpresence plus the exact downstream owner and no-claim instead of copying declarations, expectations, owners, budgets, or route facts into observed slots. FixedManifest seed provenance remains bound to the exact case-manifest identity; InvocationDerived provenance remains bound to invocation selection, case identity, registered derivation domain, generator version, and minimizer version; NoRandomness remains a registered inapplicability record. Source ordinal, expected record count, execution scope, category or facet, cell-derived hash, inferred soft budget, and total or parallel child caps cannot substitute for any semantic explicit. Every detailed log, complete LogBudgetExceeded terminal, minimized reproduction, aggregate, and report exact-joins the applicable component roots. Independent literal/unit/boundary, property/metamorphic, state/model, mutation, API/compile-fail, release-E2E-or-contribution, detailed-log/redaction, and source-closure tests reject missing, extra, duplicate, reordered, stale, cross-role, declaration-as-observation, wrong-seed-provenance, mixed-snapshot, and count-only joins. Focused proof, release-route proof, source closure, and DSR remain separate proof states.

AC58 DESCENDANT SCHEMA-IMPACT JOIN (CONTROLLING ROLLUP). This rollup owns no implementation schema and may mint no leaf evidence. It consumes the exact SchemaImpactManifestV1 from every recursively contained implementation leaf on one compatible source snapshot and constructs a deterministic descendant join ordered by stable leaf ID, then stable schema ID. The join records exact descendant and schema-row counts plus exact counts for NewV1NoPredecessor, UnchangedV1, MigratedV1ToV2, DecodeOnlyLegacyV1, RetiredV1, and InapplicableNoCanonicalFrame; every count is checked against the literal descendant inventory rather than inferred from status, labels, estimates, source ordinals, or child aggregate totals. It refuses a missing, extra, duplicate, reordered, stale, owner-remapped, cross-rollup, unknown-disposition, incompatible-snapshot, V1/V2-substituted, partial-migration, or multiply aggregated leaf/schema row, and refuses any authoritative V2 close claim while a required descendant is absent or still names an incompatible authoritative V1 parent.

Comprehensive rollup tests cover exact-empty where structurally legal, one descendant, the exact live maximum, one-over injected input, all six dispositions, nested-rollup associativity without double counting, order/shard/schedule/resume invariance, every missing/extra/duplicate/reorder and mixed-snapshot mutation, first explicit divergence, bounded deterministic step-prefixed logging and redaction, structured reproduction, overflow terminal, coverage counters, and exact source closure. A source-closed release-built E2E join consumes only already produced leaf evidence and proves aggregation fidelity; it does not execute descendants, replace their unit/property/model/mutation/API/fault/E2E/log/source-closure gates, or promote focused, DSR, downstream, durability, scientific, or authority proof. CONTRACT/rustdoc and the final rollup report list every descendant schema-impact manifest and all separate proof states.

DECOMPOSED BASE DEPENDENCY RECONCILIATION 2026-07-29 (CONTROLLING). This schema/framing consumer blocks on exact checked-values/catalogs/limits work package .24.1.1.1.1, not the full integrated .24.1.1.1 route/proof parent. It still consumes common types under the .24.1.1.1 program authority and must exact-bind the child source/schema root. This narrowing permits independent implementation without waiving any later parent integration or release close gate; stale/wrong child, incomplete parent presented as closed, or transitive owner inference refuses.

LIVE ROLLUP TOPOLOGY, SCHEDULING, AND OPERABILITY 2026-07-29 (FINAL CONTROLLING). This issue is a `runner-v2-rollup` epic. Its exact direct hierarchy children are: `frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.1.1.3.1.1`, `frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.1.1.3.1.2`, `frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.1.1.3.1.3`, `frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.1.1.3.1.4`. Its current recursive subtree contains exactly 5 Beads: 4 implementation tasks totaling 2,400 minutes and 1 rollup epics totaling 120 minutes, for 2,520 minutes. The 4 internal `parent-child` relations are closure hierarchy only; no reciprocal parent-depends-on-child `blocks` edge is permitted. This rollup's own 120-minute estimate covers only its explicitly named aggregate, integration, join, driver, rerun, source-closure, or close-review work and is not duplicated in child estimates. Functional implementation order remains solely in explicit `blocks` edges among owning tasks. While `br epic status` reports `eligible_for_close=false`, this rollup MUST have status `blocked`, never `open` or `in_progress`; when eligibility becomes true, transition it to `open` or `in_progress` only for its scoped closeout, then close it. The canonical executable-work query is `br ready --epic frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24 --type task`. `bv` robot output is diagnostic only; any surfaced rollup is not executable implementation work. Close this rollup only after every exact child-root, integration, test/E2E, detailed-log/redaction, reproduction, source-closure, proof-state, authority, and no-claim gate in this Bead passes. This clause supersedes every earlier numeric node/estimate/subtotal claim and every earlier phrase treating hierarchy children as reciprocal `blocks` dependencies or this epic as an implementation task. It removes no scope, feature, functionality, test, E2E script/contribution, logging, reproduction, source, route, capability, durability, scientific, admission, authority, or no-claim obligation.

ROLLUP CLOSEOUT DISCOVERABILITY AND MANUAL-EVIDENCE GATE 2026-07-29 (FINAL CONTROLLING). `br ready --epic frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24 --type task --json --limit 0` is the canonical implementation-task query; `bv` robot output is dependency/impact diagnosis, not executable status. When `br epic status --eligible-only --json` first reports this epic eligible because all direct children are closed, the epic is not automatically complete. Its deterministic closeout view MUST expose any remaining integration/route/join/rerun/review work; exact route ID where applicable; immutable command/driver/manifest descriptor; compatible source/build/schema roots; unresolved stable cells and proof states; expected result partitions; retained relative artifact root; retryability; no-claim scope; and uniquely ranked non-executable repairs. A route-owning or integration-owning epic must be claimed and its own acceptance evidence completed before explicit close; task-only queries must not make that work disappear, and automatic bulk epic closure cannot substitute for it.

The transition from blocked -> eligible closeout -> in-progress closeout -> explicitly closed is deterministic and logged. Literal/unit, state/model/race, mutation, API/compile-fail, fault/cancellation, integrated E2E or child-evidence replay, detailed logging/redaction, reproduction, exact coverage, and source-closure tests cover premature surfacing, hidden remaining route work, missing/extra/duplicate child roots, stale eligibility, already-complete reruns, failed closeout and safe retry, mixed snapshots, bulk-close substitution, and exact final proof-state separation. Pure review rollups use a typed no-route closeout; no epic may invent or infer an unnamed route merely to become discoverable.
notes:
Scheduling truth: children 540 + 540 + 720 + 600 minutes plus this 120-minute rollup = the original 2,520 minutes exactly. Schema/arena and admission work serialize only where type ownership requires it; deterministic evaluation follows admission; independent proof and downstream contribution reconciliation consumes the complete child union. The sibling rollup 24.1.1.3.2 exact-set joins children .3.2.1-.4; those children retain singular registry, case, spec/catalog, and proof ownership. Every former aggregate requirement remains mapped to one stable child owner, and focused/E2E/contribution/source/DSR/scientific/authority statuses remain separate.

FINAL LIVE RECONCILIATION 2026-07-29. The authoritative acceptance clause records 5 subtree Beads, 4 implementation tasks at 2,400 minutes, 1 rollup epics at 120 minutes, and 2,520 total minutes, with the exact direct hierarchy-child set and blocked-until-eligible rollup status rule. Earlier accounting, task/rollup classification, reciprocal child-block wording, and zero-minute integration claims are superseded; all functional, test/E2E, logging, reproduction, source-closure, route, authority, and no-claim obligations remain intact.
