title: Runner V2 evaluator schemas, nominal roots, registry view, and immutable bounded DAG arenas
description:
Own the final evaluator vocabulary, private checked constructors, exact root/domain/role tables, comparison and effect node schemas, observation values, registry-view schema, immutable bounded DAG arenas, and evaluator-owned artifact and external nominal roots. This child contains no lifecycle, terminal, process, publication, codec, callback, executable predicate, capability, or authority path.

## Acceptance Criteria

The dedicated Acceptance Criteria field is the authoritative close gate. Every numbered criterion must pass, including the controlling nine-facet literal/unit/boundary, property/metamorphic, state/model/race, mutation/fuzz, API/compile-fail/trait, fault/resource/cancellation, release-built no-mock E2E or immutable E2E-contribution, deterministic detailed-logging/redaction, and source-closure manifest; the four explicit eligible/matched result partitions; exact Unsupported/inapplicable reasons; and zero unexpected mismatches, execution failures, or unexplained skips on one compatible source/build/proof snapshot.
design: Preserve EvaluationLaneV2 and every final evaluator and conformance nominal wrapper while excluding superseded input and registry names. The immutable arenas allow at most 256 unique nodes, 512 edges, depth 32, and a separately checked 4,096-work-unit execution contract. Preserve empty All, forbidden empty Any, unary Not, ordered Boolean children, immutable DAG sharing, stable first-visit preorder, transactional refusal, and separate node, edge, depth, and work accounting. Freeze descriptors, domains, roles, field order, ownership, and safe read-only access. Construction order is nonsemantic only where explicitly declared; ordered child sequences remain semantic.
acceptance_criteria:
1. OWNERSHIP AND EXACT CONTRACT. Own the final evaluator vocabulary, private checked constructors, exact root/domain/role tables, comparison and effect node schemas, observation values, registry-view schema, immutable bounded DAG arenas, and evaluator-owned artifact and external nominal roots. This child contains no lifecycle, terminal, process, publication, codec, callback, executable predicate, capability, or authority path. The implementation and schema owner set is singular; missing, duplicate, shadow, stale, mixed-snapshot, reverse-edge, generic-root, or authority-widening ownership refuses. Primary ownership maps parent criteria 1–2, 15, 20–21, 23, 30–32 and the schema and vocabulary portions of criteria 36–37 and 41 to stable child-prefixed cells.

2. COMPREHENSIVE LITERAL, UNIT, AND BOUNDARY PROOF. Independent handwritten tables assert every discriminant, field order, field type, presence rule, root domain and role, registry category, constructor owner, and bound. Tests cover zero, one, exact, and one-over nodes, edges, depth, work, and representability; dangling and cyclic handles; shared diamonds; repeated siblings; duplicated subtrees; canonical freeze; checked overflow; construction-order equivalence where nonsemantic; root movement where order is semantic; and a release-built no-mock public-API journey that builds a real registry view and both expression arenas including shared DAG and exact boundary cells.

3. PROPERTY, MODEL, RACE, FAULT, AND MUTATION PROOF. Property and metamorphic tests cover every declared semantic invariance and root-movement rule. State and typestate models cover every legal transition and bounded relevant interleaving. Fault, resource, cancellation, and checked-overflow tests cover zero, one, exact, and one-over limits. Mutation and fuzz corpora change every owned discriminant, field, presence bit, ordinal, edge, bound, root, stage, owner, budget, log, diagnostic, repair, and no-claim value and require the exact first refusal or divergence. Genuine inapplicability uses a registered typed reason.

4. API AND COMPILE-FAIL PROOF. Public API, trait, doctest, dependency-DAG, and compile-fail tests reject public literals, Default or bypass construction, mutable thaw/reopen, callbacks or scripts, arbitrary code-bearing values, generic digest substitution, forbidden reverse dependencies, raw capability/resource data, result fabrication, and conversion to lifecycle, durability, scientific, certificate, admission, or other authority.

5. OWNED E2E OR IMMUTABLE CONTRIBUTION PROOF. Every locally owned path runs release-built through real public APIs with no mocks and exact retained execution roots. Physical or downstream behavior not owned here is represented only by immutable stable contribution rows binding exact owner and script, independent expectations and oracles, semantic inputs, explicit budgets, schema, log, source, and build roots, expected disposition, and no-claim scope. Contribution rows cannot claim downstream execution. Happy, boundary, expected-refusal, expected-failure, mutation, Unsupported, inapplicable, cancellation, drain, resource-return, and hidden-skip cells are explicit where applicable.

6. DETERMINISTIC LOGGING, REDACTION, AND REPAIRS. Bounded canonical logs retain stable cell, category, and facet IDs; semantic, schema, source, build, oracle, budget, manifest, and execution roots; ordered stages and terminal stage; expected and observed classifications; exact first divergence; drain and resource outcomes; exact partitions; no-claim scope; ranked non-executable repairs; and safe relative evidence references. Secrets, credentials, environment values, live capabilities, raw resources and handles, physical paths, PIDs, wall time, scheduler noise, and bulk payloads are rejected or type-redacted. Forbidden sentinels cannot echo through observed values, Display, Debug, canonical bytes, logs, diagnostics, or reproduction text.

7. SOURCE CLOSURE. Source closure exact-sets implementation, CONTRACT and rustdoc, schema, domain, and owner tables, independent oracles, fixtures, E2E targets or contribution rows, log and diagnostic schemas, dependencies and features, build configuration, toolchain, target, and direct source identities on one compatible snapshot. Missing, extra, duplicate, stale, ambient, unpinned, mixed-snapshot, result-contaminated, or source-path-as-artifact inputs move the root or refuse.

8. CHILD CLOSE-MANIFEST RECONCILIATION (CONTROLLING). One result-free source-authoritative full-set manifest exact-sets the nine category groups and every applicable slash-separated facet. It retains distinct exact ID sets and checked counts for eligible positives and matched positives; eligible expected refusals and matched expected refusals; eligible expected failures and matched expected failures; and eligible mutations and matched mutations; exact Unsupported and inapplicable reasons; unexpected mismatches; execution failures; and unexplained skips. Green requires every eligible stable ID exactly once, nonempty applicable positive and adversarial corpora, equality within every eligible and matched subpartition, exact reasons, and zero unexpected mismatches, execution failures, or unexplained skips. Its exact frame order is API generation 2; wire generation 1; ABI ID; argv representation windows-utf16-code-units-v1; direct-driver/no-shell/no-PATH policy; and no-claim native-windows-bootstrap-contract-proves-argv-shape-not-driver-presence-launch-exit-or-authority. A concrete driver ID, source/build artifact, target/provider binding, and execution remain owned by the designated execution owner and exact-join this common contract.

BaseCoverageCloseDeferredObservationContractV1 remains compatibility-only because its windows_route field is path-only. It is never reinterpreted for DirectDriver. BaseCoverageCloseDeferredObservationContractV2 replaces that field with NativeWindowsRouteV2 and has domain org.frankensim.fs-evidence-runner.close-deferred-observation-contract.v2 and magic ASCII FSCLOSEDEFERREDOBSERVER followed by byte 0x02. Its exact order is route ID; semantic consumer; execution owner; driver owner; POSIX wrapper owner; capability profile; driver ID; POSIX route; complete NativeWindowsRouteV2 bytes/root; case-manifest path; case-manifest contract root; Deferred-reason registry root; Deferred reason; and no-claim. Because BaseCoverageCloseDownstreamContributionV2 embeds the V1 observer, route declarations use additive BaseCoverageCloseDownstreamContributionV3 plus BaseCoverageCloseDeferredEvidenceEnvelopeV2; the V2 contribution and V1 envelope remain compatibility evidence and cannot enter the authoritative route manifest. No existing V1 bytes are silently reinterpreted.

ROUTE DECLARATION/RUNTIME DAG CLARIFICATION (CONTROLLING). A source-authoritative LocalInProcess route row binds attempt_identity_contract_root, detailed_log_schema_root, and structured_reproduction_schema_root. It MUST NOT bind a per-invocation attempt_identity_root, detailed_log_root, or structured_reproduction_root. LocalInProcessRunRequestV1 binds the actual AttemptIdentityV1 only after declaration admission. RuntimeObservationV1, EvidenceEnvelopeV1, PresentedResultV2, aggregate/report, StructuredReproductionV2, terminal, and final log bind actual invocation roots in that forward order. StructuredReproductionV2 is constructed only after the completed report or safe partial report; its actual root enters the terminal afterward. Any reverse edge, expected-as-actual substitution, or source manifest whose root changes per attempt refuses. Static route rows bind a case_manifest_contract_root derived from exact owner/driver/native/POSIX/path/schema literals; they do not claim a downstream-owned file exists, has been read, has a runtime content root, or has executed.

OWNER ROLE EQUALITY MATRIX (CONTROLLING). Every owner role remains a separately encoded typed field even when two fields contain the same Bead ID. source_owner is the leaf that emits the declaration. For each ContributionOnly row, semantic_consumer equals execution_owner and driver_owner equals execution_owner unless an exact row explicitly freezes another owner. posix_wrapper_owner equals execution_owner when a POSIX wrapper is declared. windows_wrapper_owner equals execution_owner only for PowerShellWrapper; DirectDriver has no wrapper owner and its driver_owner equals execution_owner. source_owner MUST differ from semantic_consumer and execution_owner. Equal values across declared role fields are legal and do not collapse, omit, or infer fields. Rows may share an owner, driver, platform routes, and case-manifest contract only when explicitly listed, while their route ID, payload root, contribution root, and Deferred-envelope root remain distinct.

DECLARATION VERSUS ACTUAL ARTIFACTS AND FAULTS (CONTROLLING). Contribution rows use OwnerEnvelopeRelativePathsOnly. Local rows use a distinct LocalExplicitAbsentOrRelativePathsOnly policy. Both are declaration policy only; RetainedArtifactStateV1 is runtime evidence and is present only under the legal runtime disposition. A pure in-process leaf with no asupersync/runtime dependency may test deterministic model-only observation-loss, cancellation, deadline, and resource faults through private sealed fixtures, but MUST label them model evidence and MUST NOT call them actual runtime cancellation/drain proof. Actual scoped cancellation, stop, drain, process, and resource-return evidence remains with the exact execution owner whose dependency/capability contract permits it. A Boolean callback or public test hook cannot stand in for either model proof or actual cancellation.

CANONICAL ROUTE SCHEMAS AND TEST GATE (CONTROLLING). New route body, row, manifest, local-entrypoint registry, native-route, native-bootstrap, V2 observer, V3 contribution, V2 Deferred-envelope, declaration-policy, and runtime-result schemas have exact API/wire versions, domains, magic bytes, ordered fields, nominal roots, migration rows, source owners, source paths, compatible snapshot, and no-claim. New nominal roles use source-frozen LeafExtension fragments and never append to the immutable 47-role FrozenBase registry. Independent handwritten tests cover exact codes/literals and every route row; empty, one, 64, 65, exact-set, missing, extra, duplicate, reorder, stale, unknown kind, all class transitions, and all-Inapplicable refusal; every-field/root mutation; owner/consumer singularity and equality; PowerShell/direct-driver substitution; V1/V2/V3 barriers; raw-hash and cross-kind compile failures with exact Rust error codes and positive counterparts; result-free contribution plus Deferred-envelope separation; no-mock local or release owner E2E; Observed, NotObserved, Deferred, and Inapplicable matrices; safe partials; model-only versus actual cancellation scope; reserve-before-detail log overflow; deterministic step order, redaction, no-echo, and post-report structured reproduction; shard/resume and mixed-snapshot refusal; exact partitions; and complete source closure. Every test and compile-fail addition updates its live inventory, class count, route ratchet, schema-impact manifest, log/reproduction schema, and source closure atomically. Focused, release-built, source-closure, constellation, DSR, downstream, platform, durability, scientific, admission, and authority proof states remain separate.

ROUTE-PLAN CONFLICT RECONCILIATION 2026-07-29 (CONTROLLING). The following clauses resolve only contradictory legacy wording. They preserve every route, field, schema, test, E2E journey, log, reproduction artifact, source-closure obligation, and no-claim boundary already required by this Bead; where older prose conflicts, these clauses supersede only the conflicting interpretation.

QUALIFIED EVIDENCE TYPE. Every pre-existing unqualified `EvidenceKindV1` token in this Bead's route criteria means the exact common enum `BaseCoverageCloseEvidenceKindV1`. Already-qualified names remain unchanged. Logging retains its own nominal evidence-kind type; no third generic enum exists. Independent literal-oracle, zero/unknown-code, cross-type compile-fail, and positive-construction tests freeze this rule.

STATIC DECLARATION VERSUS RUNTIME ROOTS. A source-authoritative static `LocalInProcess` route row binds only `attempt_identity_contract_root`, `detailed_log_schema_root`, and `structured_reproduction_schema_root`. It never binds a per-invocation `attempt_identity_root`, `detailed_log_root`, or `structured_reproduction_root`. Actual roots are constructed only after declaration admission and real execution yields a completed report or permitted safe partial; reproduction is post-report and the terminal/final log join it afterward. Unit, boundary, property/model, one-field mutation, no-mock in-process E2E, deterministic detailed-log/redaction, structured-reproduction, attempt-isolation, DAG-cycle, and source-closure tests prove static-root stability across attempts and runtime-root movement without expected-as-actual substitution.

ROLE IDENTITY AND VALUE EQUALITY. Statements that owners or consumers remain distinct mean that the role fields remain nominally typed and separately encoded, not that their token values must differ. For every contribution row, `semantic_consumer == execution_owner` and `driver_owner == execution_owner`. A wrapper owner equals the execution owner exactly when the selected wrapper variant exists; `DirectDriver` carries no wrapper owner or wrapper path. `source_owner` remains its separately designated declaration owner and is never inferred from those equalities. Unit/exact-set, property/model, wrong-equality mutation, presence-matrix, cross-role compile-fail, owner-consumption E2E, logging/reproduction, and source-closure tests reject missing, unequal, fabricated, or variant-inapplicable role values.

ROUTE-CARDINALITY CORRECTION 2026-07-29 (CONTROLLING). This Bead owns one LocalInProcess row and exactly four downstream ContributionOnly rows, not three: the three release journeys plus the Phase-1 contract contribution. The authoritative five-row ordered route summary and its counts remain unchanged. Unit exact-set, mutation, generated-registry, contribution-consumer, log, reproduction, and source-closure tests reject a three-contribution interpretation, a missing Phase-1 row, or double counting a release journey.

PROGRAM-WIDE ATTEMPT CORRELATION, STAGE TELEMETRY, SHARD/RESUME, AND COMPLETE-LOG CONSUMER GATE 2026-07-29 (FINAL CONTROLLING). This task exact-binds, and does not redefine, the common three-plane contracts owned by `.24.1.1.1.4` through `.24.1.1.1.6`. Every executable cell declaration binds the common attempt-identity contract root; the actual nominal `AttemptIdentityRootV1` exists only after admission. Every child/downstream execution records its stable route/suite/case/cell/shard IDs and causal ordinal, with an optional typed parent-attempt root only in attempt-specific evidence. Canonical invocation/command/event/report/reproduction/terminal/final-log payloads bind the attempt-invariant `CanonicalRuntimeObservationProjectionRootV1` and contain deterministic schema/version, logical event sequence, stage code/ordinal, event kind/severity, expected/observed classification, semantic/budget/capability/no-claim roots, first divergence, bounded actionable diagnostic, terminal completeness, and safe relative artifacts. They contain no attempt identity/scope, raw transcript, timing sample, wall clock, physical path, host/environment/PID/scheduler/load, secret, live capability/resource value, or bulk payload.

Applicable actual execution additionally requires a complete AC57 envelope and finalized `AttemptRetentionReceiptV1` that correlate the canonical root set with nominal attempt identity, safe retention scope, resource/capability reconciliation, raw-audit roots, atomic finalization, and `RunnerStageTelemetryV1`. The bounded telemetry sidecar records attempt/optional parent correlation, stable route/suite/case/cell/shard IDs, causal ordinal, stage code/ordinal, start/finish disposition, checked monotonic offset and stage delta with explicit units, clock descriptor/root, resolution and suspend policy, applicable environmental time budget, terminal disposition, safe relative artifact references, and explicit no-performance-claim scope. Timing is an operator observation only: it never feeds semantic/source/build/schema/oracle/expected-result/publication/receipt/admission/authority roots or a portable performance claim. A read-only operator view may join receipt, canonical log, and telemetry after finalization; it cannot feed execution or mutate any root.

A ContributionOnly or deferred-local declaration carries its immutable result-free payload plus typed Deferred envelope and fabricates no attempt, timing, execution, resource, or terminal actual. A genuinely pure/non-executable facet uses a source-registered Inapplicable reason naming exact owner, scope, prerequisite, and no-claim. Every manifest explicitly declares `Sharded` or `ShardInapplicable` and `Resumable` or `ResumeInapplicable`; omission, runtime-skip synthesis, or Unsupported-as-Inapplicable refuses. Applicable E2E owners retain exact attempt-scoped relative artifact/reproduction references; contribution tasks bind the exact downstream owner/driver/script/manifest that will produce them.

Comprehensive literal/unit/boundary, property/metamorphic, state/typestate/model/race, mutation/fuzz, API/compile-fail/trait, fault/resource/cancellation, no-mock local/release E2E or immutable contribution plus owner-consumption E2E, deterministic detailed logging/redaction/no-echo, structured reproduction, shard/resume, exact coverage, and source-closure tests cover missing/extra/duplicate/reordered stages/events/correlation rows, logical-sequence gaps/overflow, simultaneous same-cell attempts, causal-parent substitution, exact resume versus cross-attempt residue, shard gaps/duplicates/remaps, clock unavailable/regression/wrap/overflow, stage nesting and deadline reconciliation, observation loss, zero/one/exact/one-over log and telemetry budgets, reserve-before-detail terminal overflow, changing timing/attempt/raw noise without moving canonical roots, one-component movement in the correct outer plane, sentinel redaction across every output path, and missing terminal/correlation/artifact/reproduction evidence. Silent truncation, hidden skip, unbounded logging, fabricated actuals, or a green subset is forbidden.

title: Runner V2 family specification, case manifest, catalog, and feasibility exact-set rollup
description:
Exact-set proof-and-ownership rollup over four nonoverlapping family/specification implementation leaves: family registries and evaluator views; case keys, real fixture preflight, conformance specifications, and manifests; executable descriptors, FamilySpec, RunnerSpec, catalog, and feasibility sealing; and independent proof, release contributions, ownership audit, logging, and source closure.

The four-child union implements the complete original CaseManifestV2/RunnerCatalogV2/resolver-policy/registry/feasibility/RunnerSpecV2 contract without removing any schema field, constructor, fixture, test, E2E contribution, logging, source-closure, or no-authority boundary. This rollup owns no implementation, constructor, test cell, E2E execution, contribution row, or authority; it closes only by exact-set joining the four child close manifests on one compatible snapshot.

## Success Criteria

The dedicated Acceptance Criteria field is the authoritative exact-set rollup gate. Every direct child must close on one compatible source/build/proof snapshot with its complete test or contribution, release-built E2E, deterministic-log, result-partition, and source-closure roots; the rollup owns no implementation and cannot replace a missing child, proof class, or no-claim boundary with status, prose, or aggregate counts.
design:
CONTROLLING OWNERSHIP PROJECTION. Family/spec ownership is fixed: 24.1.1.3.2.1 owns family registries, root-policy/unit normalization, and evaluator-view population; .3.2.2 owns case keys, fixtures, preflight consumption, conformance specs, and CaseManifest sealing; .3.2.3 owns executable descriptors, FamilySpec, RunnerSpec, RunnerCatalog, structural feasibility, and their checked roots; .3.2.4 owns independent proof, aggregate downstream contributions, ownership audit, logging reconciliation, and the exact union of child source closures. Parent 24.1.1.3.2 owns only their exact-set join. Evaluator schemas come from evaluator children 24.1.1.3.1.1-.3 under rollup 24.1.1.3.1; admission/context from .3.1.2, and evaluation/conformance from .3.1.3.

Children 24.1.1.3.2.1-.3 are the singular implementation owners: .1 owns registries and evaluator-view population, .2 owns cases/fixtures/manifests, and .3 owns executable descriptors, FamilySpecV2, RunnerSpecV2, RunnerCatalogV2, feasibility, and sealing. It consumes base catalogs/limits/budgets/diagnostics from 24.1.1.1 and evaluator/conformance types from evaluator children 24.1.1.3.1.1-.3 under rollup 24.1.1.3.1. It owns no callable executable, lifecycle writer, byte codec, process spawn, artifact publication, scientific authority, or admission authority.

Family namespaces use `family.` followed by at least two StableTokenV2 segments. `runner.`, `proof.`, `rjoq.`, `frankensim.base.`, and `org.frankensim.fs-evidence-runner.` are reserved. Every family-owned mode/case/diagnostic/role/domain/policy/unit/schema/descriptor/decision-detail ID is fully namespaced, duplicate-rejected, and bounded by RunnerLimitsV2.

`ExecutableDescriptorV2` is descriptive semantic data with exact ordered fields: descriptor_id; family namespace/version; executable_schema_id; entrypoint_token; canonical supported target triples; executable_image_root; build_identity_root; source_closure_root; executable_resolver_policy_root; capability_root; argv_schema_root; environment_policy_root; input/output schema roots; declared budgets/limits roots; stop_barrier_schema_root; and no_claim_scope. It contains no path, ambient PATH name, handle, closure, callback, function pointer, or process-local token. `ExecutableResolverPolicyV2` freezes allowed resolver kind, image/build/source equality, signature/content checks when registered, capability scope, freshness/revocation, target/platform constraints, and read/execute-only access. Runtime affine resolution/binding belongs to 24.4.1.

`RunnerSpecV2` is the acyclic base-and-family contract and has exact ordered fields: API generation 2; wire version 1; no-predecessor marker; runner implementation schema ID; base catalog root; base limits root; base budget-schema root; base publication/capability schema-descriptor root; evaluator/conformance schema root; ordered FamilySpecV2 vector; command table root; diagnostic/repair schema root; family extension/executable-registry root; version-policy root; and global no-claim scope. It deliberately does not bind invocation/replay identity, migration/replay-support, artifact/manifest, lifecycle/result, byte/publication, verifier, adoption, or handoff descriptor roots: those schemas are frozen later and several contain RunnerSpecRootV2, so including them here would create a descriptor cycle. The complete generated phase-1 schema/owner inventory is a separate non-authoritative RunnerPhase1SchemaOwnershipRegistryV2 owned by 24.1.3.2; each downstream phase contributes its own separately rooted append-only ownership manifest, and later conformance receipts exact-set-join them without retroactively changing RunnerSpecV2 or making phase 1 depend on phase 2. Its domain is `org.frankensim.fs-evidence-runner.runner-spec.v1`; `RunnerSpecRootV2` and its only checked constructor are owned here.

`RunnerCatalogV2` is the canonical List result and has exact ordered fields: API/wire versions; RunnerSpecRootV2; command descriptors; profile descriptors; for each family in canonical namespace/version order its modes, ordered cases with command/profile availability and claim mode, diagnostics, artifact roles, publication policies, executable descriptor summaries, limits/budget ceilings, source/schema roots, and no-claim scope; plus catalog_count_summary. Its domain is `org.frankensim.fs-evidence-runner.runner-catalog.v1`; it is a bounded canonical document, not lifecycle output and not authority.

`FamilyDraftV2` validates all declared counts and nested diagnostic/record feasibility before proportional allocation; namespaces/versions; duplicates/collisions; exact-set references; numeric/effect type compatibility; expression and observation caps; executable descriptor completeness; image/build/source/policy/capability joins; required publication selection availability; case nonemptiness/contiguous ordinals; exact `3 + sum(2 + maximum_family_rows)` lifecycle feasibility; cap tightening; and authority scope. It freezes into private boxed slices/read-only views with no Default, thaw, reopen, mutable accessor, or widening route.

`SchemaRefusalV2` is typed and deterministic and uses the complete ActionableDiagnosticV2 schema plus ranked repairs. Families cannot add ProofExit states/refusal reasons, alter base record/diagnostic rules, define an alternate evaluator, weaken artifact disposition, use default Run mode, inject callbacks, trust producer verdicts, or mint authority.

Sealing also enforces complete-result feasibility from 24.1.1.1. For every allowed command, the declared lifecycle_encoded_bytes, command_result_stdout_bytes, catalog or receipt maximum, fixed six-field transport-header length, diagnostic frame, and resident staging grant must admit the exact semantic payload plus checked full transport frame without exceeding the 5 MiB command-result ceiling or allocating an unbudgeted duplicate lifecycle. RunnerCatalogV2 exposes these separate limits and budgets with units; it never labels LifecycleOnlyNoBundle as having no output.

The family root-policy registry is the sole population/sealing owner for freshness, revocation, and overlap-policy registrations consumed by RootCapabilityPolicyV2. It emits the bounded non-wire RootPolicyRegistryProjectionV2 defined by the base leaf. Overlap registrations use the closed RequireInputOutputDisjoint relation; an opaque ID, a distinct pair of IDs, or mere registration cannot claim that acquired resources are disjoint.

## Controlling reality-check reconciliation: registry population and acyclic case binding

Registered IDs are two-stage. Base catalog variants can syntactically retain a nonzero presented u16, but every semantic family, case, evaluator, artifact, log, or publication use must resolve it through the exact sealed projection. Unknown, cross-kind, owner-mismatched, unit-incompatible, stale, or unbound IDs refuse. Family registries are immutable data: no callback, trait object, executable function, decoder, conversion routine, physical capability, terminal table, or authority is permitted.

ArtifactCodecIdV2 and LogicalExtentV2 are consumed base declarations. Child 24.1.1.3.2.1 owns family role/axis/unit registries and child .3.2.3 seals them with structural feasibility into FamilySpecV2; 24.1.1.3.1.1 owns artifact-observation schemas and .3.1.3 owns projection semantics, 24.1.1.4 owns inventory and codec relation descriptors, and 24.2.1.2 owns artifact bytes/codecs.

## Final controlling family-registry and case-binding contract

This section supersedes every earlier `CaseEvaluationRegistryViewV2` or `CaseEvaluationRegistryRootV2` name. No alias is retained. Child 24.1.1.3.2.1 populates and seals the evaluator-owned `EvaluationRegistryViewV2` and binds `EvaluationRegistryViewRootV2`. It also consumes the evaluator-owned `EffectSnapshotRequirementsV2` derived during effect-expression freeze and binds `EffectSnapshotRequirementsRootV2`; it never accepts a caller-authored requirements map.

The exact acyclic sealing order is: (1) validate all root-free family registry definitions and tightened independent caps; (2) construct and freeze `EvaluationRegistryViewV2` through the checked 24.1.1.3.1 API; (3) allocate canonical family-local case IDs and contiguous manifest ordinals and construct each root-free `CaseEvaluationKeyV2`; (4) construct comparison and effect arenas against the borrowed view, with effect freeze mechanically producing `EffectSnapshotRequirementsV2`; (5) construct any command-policy-permitted presented fixtures bound to the key, run the real evaluator preflight to derive the optional validated roots, and freeze the exact lane `EvaluationPrecontextV2` values; (6) construct root-free expected nested frames and `CaseConformanceSpecV2`; (7) construct `CaseManifestV2`; (8) construct `FamilySpecV2`; and (9) construct `RunnerSpecV2`. Case keys, expressions, requirements, fixtures, precontexts, expected frames, and conformance specs never bind a case manifest, actual evaluation context, outcome, verdict, lifecycle root, or authority, so no reverse edge exists.

The controlling `CaseManifestV2` field order is: `CaseEvaluationKeyV2`; allowed commands; registered mode IDs; allowed profiles; `CaseConformanceSpecRootV2`; `ComparisonExprRootV2`; `EffectExpectationRootV2`; `EffectSnapshotRequirementsRootV2`; canonical declared observation-key set; canonical allowed artifact-role set; canonical required capability-root set; executable descriptor ID; maximum family rows; maximum diagnostics; and no-claim scope. The key absorbs family namespace/version, case ID, manifest ordinal, and evaluation-registry-view root exactly once. The conformance spec must bind the identical key, expression roots, and mechanically derived requirements root; its optional fixture roots and expected precontexts must also bind that key. The requirements root must equal an independent derivation from the exact bound effect arena. The declared observation set must resolve to the exact key/kind rows in the key's registry view. Any absent, extra, duplicate, wrong-family, wrong-ID/ordinal, stale, mixed-snapshot, cross-key, cross-fixture, or cross-root binding refuses before a case-manifest root.

The controlling `FamilySpecV2` field order is: family namespace; family version; ordered mode descriptors; observation-key/kind descriptors; authority-scope descriptors; external-root-class descriptors; registered artifact-role descriptors; registered logical-extent-axis descriptors with nonempty allowed-unit sets; registered logical-unit descriptors; evaluation-unit and exact conversion descriptors; registered digest-domain descriptors; resource-identity descriptors; registered diagnostic descriptors; decision-detail namespace descriptors; root-policy descriptors; extension-schema descriptors; executable descriptors; `EvaluationRegistryViewRootV2`; ordered `CaseManifestRootV2` values; tightened `RunnerLimitsV2`; family budget ceilings; publication-selection policy; and explicit no-scientific/no-admission scope. The view is independently reconstructed from exactly the evaluator-consumed subset of these definitions plus the base artifact-codec and diagnostic catalogs; source-definition and view roots must agree byte-for-byte before FamilySpec freeze.

Registry data is descriptive and root-free until the complete view is checked. Each descriptor has a nonzero typed ID where applicable, globally namespaced stable name, sole owner, schema/kind payload, and explicit no-claim scope. Evaluation-unit/conversion rows contain canonical `UnitV2` values and exact rational same-dimension relations only. Observation descriptors freeze one exact `ObservationValueV2` kind. Authority scopes, external classes, and resources are identities, not live providers. No registry entry may contain a callback, trait object, parser, codec implementation/relation, executable string, function, ambient lookup, handle, capability provider, terminal mapping, or authority.

The family seal exact-set proves every registered ID used by expressions, requirements, observations, effects, artifact extents, diagnostics, or cases resolves through the one bound view. Syntactically valid unknown IDs remain representable only in evaluator presented inputs so `UnknownRegistryId` is reachable; they cannot enter sealed FamilySpec data. Registered-but-case-undeclared observation/effect keys remain representable presented inputs so `UnexpectedObservation` is distinct. Base artifact codec IDs are bound through the base catalog projection only; callable codec relations remain 24.1.1.4/24.2.1.2 handoffs.

## Final controlling FamilySpec order and cap ownership

This section supersedes every earlier FamilySpec field order and any language that rejects the same numeric ID merely because it appears in different typed registries. The exact dependency-first `FamilySpecV2` order is: namespace; family version; ordered mode descriptors; tightened `RunnerLimitsV2`; family budget ceilings; publication-selection policy; root-policy registry projection; registered artifact roles; registered logical units; registered logical-extent axes with canonical unit and exact scale-to-canonical rows; registered evaluation units mapping typed IDs directly to canonical `UnitV2`; registered digest domains; registered resource identities; registered authority scopes; registered external root classes; decision-detail namespaces; registered diagnostics; observation-key/kind descriptors; extension schemas; executable descriptors; `EvaluationRegistryViewRootV2`; ordered `CaseManifestRootV2` values; and explicit no-scientific/no-admission scope.

Exact cap ownership is: modes code 37; diagnostics code 38; artifact roles code 39; root-policy rows code 40 in aggregate across freshness/revocation/overlap categories; registered logical units code 41; digest domains code 42; extension schemas code 43; executable descriptors code 44; family decision-detail rows code 54; registered axes code 66; family observation-key union code 67 while each case uses code 53; authority scopes code 68; external root classes code 69; evaluation units code 70; and resource identities code 71. Fixed base rows are added separately with checked total and encoded-size arithmetic. Code 55 is not repurposed. Registry IDs are typed namespace-local u16 values, so the same numeric value in two categories is valid; duplicate IDs inside one category, ambiguous globally namespaced names, or cross-category substitutions refuse.

The exact sealing order is limits/budgets and root-policy aggregate feasibility; independent registry rows; cross-reference validation and normalized logical/evaluation conversions; `EvaluationRegistryViewV2`; canonical CaseEvaluationKey values; comparison/effect arenas and mechanically derived requirements; command-policy-permitted presented fixtures and real-preflight validated roots; expectation precontexts and root-free nested expected frames; conformance specs; case manifests; then FamilySpec. The view binds the fixed base artifact-codec catalog root but no family codec registration and no callable codec-relation catalog. Registered external-root-class descriptors are the semantic registry resolved by `RootClassV2::Other(id)`; root-policy registration alone cannot satisfy that lookup. Every category is exact-set reconstructed from the FamilySpec source rows, and no ambient/global registry participates.

## Case-scoped artifact expectation sealing

When a case effect arena contains `ArtifactSetEqual`, its expected `ArtifactSetRootV2` must bind the exact `CaseEvaluationKeyV2` that the draft CaseManifest will seal. This comparison is the sole required-artifact completeness declaration for that case. The entry `required` bit remains present-entry metadata; a case without ArtifactSetEqual makes no absence/completeness claim. Expected sets can be built before CaseManifestRoot because they bind the root-free key rather than the later manifest root; manifest sealing proves key equality and preserves the acyclic order.

## Final controlling case-fixture and command-policy sealing

`CaseConformanceSpecV2` is consumed exactly as defined by 24.1.1.3.1: CaseEvaluationKey; comparison expression root; effect expectation root; effect requirements root; optional presented-observation fixture root; optional presented-effect fixture root; comparison expected nested outcome; effect expected nested outcome; and claim mode. Child 24.1.1.3.2.2 does not redeclare evaluator types; it is the sole population owner that selects fixtures and expectation bytes, invokes checked evaluator builders, and places the resulting spec root in CaseManifestV2.

Fixture policy is explicit and closed per allowed command. A normal Run DomainConformance case has neither sealed fixture and requires Match/Match, because actual inputs arrive at execution. A Negative case has both immutable presented fixtures and exact complete nested expectations; real preflight determines whether each expected precontext contains a validated root. Designated SelfTest and Check cases use their declared sealed-fixture policy and may not silently fall back to Run or Negative semantics. Replay preserves the source CaseConformanceSpecRootV2 and fixture roots byte-for-byte for current and nested replay; migration can produce a distinct target spec only through the later migration contract.

Manifest sealing recomputes all transitive equalities rather than trusting producer claims: key equality across manifest/spec/fixtures/validated views/precontexts; registry equality across key/expressions/requirements; expression and requirements equality across spec/manifest; presentation ordinal and size bounds; validated-root presence exactly at the preflight stage; expected-frame lane and payload legality; and command/profile/mode compatibility. It rejects actual EvaluationErrorV2, MismatchDetailV2, EvaluationContextRootV2, CaseRawOutcomeRootV2, CaseConformanceVerdictRootV2, lifecycle roots, wildcard expectations, or generic digests inside expectations. Read-only accessors preserve direct user ergonomics for case ID, ordinal, family/version, registry view, expressions, requirements, fixtures, expected outcomes, and claim mode without duplicating identity fields in the wire frame.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Independent literal tests enumerate every CaseEvaluationKeyV2, CaseConformanceSpecV2 population rule, CaseManifestV2, ExecutableDescriptorV2, ExecutableResolverPolicyV2, FamilySpecV2, RunnerSpecV2, and RunnerCatalogV2 domain, root, field name/order/type/presence rule, u16 discriminant, bound, registry, and owner.

2. Case-manifest tests cover one/max cases, contiguous/noncontiguous ordinals, semantic order, globally unique namespaced IDs, every command/profile/mode availability cell, mandatory Run DomainConformance absent-fixture Match/Match cases, exact Negative and designated SelfTest/Check fixture policies, root-free nested mismatch/error expectations in both lanes, explicit effect expectation, ExerciseOnlyNoDomainClaim, row/diagnostic caps, and one-field key/spec/manifest root movement.

3. Cross-lane case tests reject a negative comparison expectation paired with an undeclared or violated effect, wrong key/precontext/lane/nested detail or error payload, actual evaluator roots inside expectations, arbitrary-outcome ExerciseOnly, Run non-Match expectation, and producer-supplied terminal. Exact sealed fixtures and root-free nested expectations roundtrip.

4. Executable descriptor tests assert every semantic field, stable target ordering, image/build/source/resolver-policy/capability equality, argv/environment/input/output schemas, budgets/stops, missing/extra/duplicate descriptors, wrong target, stale/revoked policy, and one-field identity movement.

Flattened duplicates, disagreement between key/spec/manifest fields, omitted spec root, wrong-key or wrong-case spec substitution, reverse actual-context/outcome edges, or a spec whose fixtures/expectations/claim mode are incompatible with manifest expressions and allowed commands refuse and move the proper roots.

21. IMMUTABLE SPEC/CATALOG RELEASE CONTRIBUTIONS. Child 24.1.1.3.2.4 freezes the exact aggregate family/spec/catalog/executable rows for the three named downstream journeys. Case-scoped artifact expectation tests cover absent/present ArtifactSetEqual, empty/one/many expected entries, exact CaseEvaluationKey agreement, wrong-ID/right-ordinal, right-ID/wrong-ordinal, wrong-view, cross-case set reuse, required-bit mutations, missing/extra expected paths, and no completeness claim without the effect node. 31. Real-fixture/preflight tests exhaust Run absent-fixture Match/Match, Negative paired fixtures, every designated SelfTest/Check policy, both claim modes, current and nested replay preservation, zero/one/256/257/258 presented rows, every deterministic preflight stage, optional validated-root presence and absence, Match/Mismatch/Error in both lanes, and every closed nested expected payload. 32. No-mock in-process E2E, property/mutation, compile-fail, deterministic detailed-log, coverage-join, and source-closure tests retain and independently reconstruct each CaseEvaluationKey, presented fixture root, optional validated root, EvaluationPrecontext, nested expected frame, conformance-spec root, manifest root, and command-policy decision. 33. The final GLOBAL REALITY-CHECK CLOSE-MANIFEST RECONCILIATION is the only child-union category and green gate. Children 24.1.1.3.2.1-.4 contribute their scoped sealing, catalog, fixture-policy, executable-descriptor, in-process E2E, detailed-log/redaction, and source-closure cells to it.

34. GLOBAL REALITY-CHECK CLOSE-MANIFEST RECONCILIATION (CONTROLLING). Earlier `eligible`/`passed`/`failed` shorthand and any single collapsed `matched expected refusals` counter are compatibility-only and cannot close any mapped family/spec implementation child. Each mapped family/spec implementation child must expose one result-free, source-authoritative, full-set-only close manifest that exact-sets every stable test and E2E cell into all nine preserved category groups: literal/unit/boundary; property/metamorphic; state/typestate/model/race; mutation/fuzz; API/compile-fail/trait; fault/resource/cancellation; release-built no-mock E2E or immutable E2E contribution; detailed deterministic logging/redaction; and source closure. Each applicable category and each applicable slash-separated facet has a separately nonzero corpus. A genuinely inapplicable facet requires a registered typed reason with stable code/name, exact owner, execution scope, prerequisite, and no-claim text; it cannot hide an eligible cell.

Result accounting retains distinct counters and exact ID sets for: eligible positives and matched positives; eligible expected refusals and matched expected refusals; eligible expected failures and matched expected failures; eligible mutations and matched mutations; typed Unsupported cells with exact matched reasons; typed inapplicable cells with exact matched registered reasons; unexpected mismatches; execution failures; and unexplained skips. An expected failure is never an execution failure, a mutation is never relabeled as a refusal, and an empty/subset selection can never be green. Where the mapped family/spec implementation child owns execution, comprehensive unit/integration/property/model/race/fault/mutation/API tests and the named E2E script run release-built with no mocks. Where execution belongs downstream, that mapped family/spec implementation child instead emits immutable stable rows binding independent literal expectations/oracles, semantic inputs, explicit time/memory/work/process/artifact/log budgets, schema and log-schema roots, source/build roots, exact downstream owner and script, and no-claim scope; it cannot report that downstream execution passed. E2E tests cover happy, boundary, expected-refusal, expected-failure, mutation, Unsupported, inapplicable, cancellation/drain, resource-return, and hidden-skip cases with deterministic stable IDs and exact first divergence.

Canonical bounded logs retain stable cell/category/facet IDs; semantic-input, source, build, schema, oracle, budget, manifest, and execution roots; ordered stage observations and terminal stage; expected/observed classification; first-divergence ID/root; resource and drain outcomes; exact result partitions; ranked non-executable repair manifest; no-claim scope; and safe relative retained-artifact references. Logging tests cover zero/one/exact/one-over limits, checked overflow, missing/extra/duplicate/reordered/truncated events, wrong roots/counts/reasons, redaction for every forbidden class, and deterministic replay.

Every user-visible Refused, Unsupported, divergent Negative, expected failure, and unexpected mismatch carries one bounded deterministic actionable diagnostic with registered code, precise redacted typed expected/observed values, owner, retryability, exact prerequisites, no-claim scope, and uniquely ranked declarative repairs. Repairs cannot contain or invoke commands, callbacks, scripts, credentials, raw capabilities/resources/handles/provider payloads, physical paths/locators, or automatic mutations. Source closure exact-sets all implementation, contract/rustdoc, schema/domain/owner tables, independent oracles, fixtures, E2E manifests/scripts or contribution rows, log schemas, dependencies/features, and build configuration on one compatible stable snapshot. Closeout reports focused proof, release-built E2E or contribution proof, source closure, DSR, and any downstream/scientific/authority proof separately and never promotes one into another.

35. EXACT-SET CHILD ROLLUP (CONTROLLING). This Bead owns no implementation, test cell, E2E execution, or downstream contribution row directly. Its frozen ordered child set is exactly frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.1.1.3.2.1 family registries and evaluator view; .24.1.1.3.2.2 cases, fixtures, conformance specs, and manifests; .24.1.1.3.2.3 executable descriptors, FamilySpec, RunnerSpec, catalog, and feasibility; and .24.1.1.3.2.4 independent proof, release contributions, ownership audit, logging, and source closure. Closure requires all four children closed on one compatible source, build, toolchain, target, and feature snapshot and exact-set joins their test manifests, owned release-built no-mock E2E execution roots or immutable contributions, deterministic redacted log roots, source closures, and proof states. Every original feature and acceptance obligation maps to one or more stable child cells and every stable cell has exactly one primary child owner. Missing, extra, duplicate, reordered, stale, reclassified, cross-child-substituted, mixed-snapshot, cyclic, or result-contaminated child rows refuse. The rollup checks the disjoint union of eligible positives and matched positives; eligible expected refusals and matched expected refusals; eligible expected failures and matched expected failures; and eligible mutations and matched mutations, exact Unsupported and inapplicable reasons, and zero unexpected mismatches, execution failures, and unexplained skips. All preexisting acceptance criteria remain controlling and proof scopes remain separate.

36. EXACT CHILD OWNERSHIP MAP (CONTROLLING). Family/spec ownership is fixed: 24.1.1.3.2.1 owns family registries, root-policy/unit normalization, and evaluator-view population; .3.2.2 owns case keys, fixtures, preflight consumption, conformance specs, and CaseManifest sealing; .3.2.3 owns executable descriptors, FamilySpec, RunnerSpec, RunnerCatalog, structural feasibility, and their checked roots; .3.2.4 owns independent proof, aggregate downstream contributions, ownership audit, logging reconciliation, and the exact union of child source closures. The rollup closes only from the frozen exact child set and cannot substitute its status or prose for any child close manifest.

ROLLUP FIVE-EXPLICITS AND LOG-COMPLETENESS JOIN (CONTROLLING). This rollup exact-set joins every direct child Five-Explicits root and complete-log root on the same source/build snapshot. Missing, extra, duplicate, stale, mixed, unit-ambiguous, seedless-without-typed-reason, over-budget, capability-incomplete, partially logged, silently truncated, or terminal-less child evidence refuses. SEMANTIC SEED PROPAGATION AND PROOF JOIN (CONTROLLING). This bead does not invent a second seed type or hidden default. Every owned schema, fixture, command, execution, artifact, replay, verifier, receipt, log, source-closure, E2E row, or rollup join that carries an invocation or case preserves the exact upstream `InvocationSeedSelectionRootV2`, `CaseSeedPolicyV2`, and applicable `CaseExecutionSeedRootV2` or registered `NoRandomness` absence through typed parent bindings. AC58 DESCENDANT SCHEMA-IMPACT JOIN (CONTROLLING ROLLUP). This rollup owns no implementation schema and may mint no leaf evidence. It consumes the exact SchemaImpactManifestV1 from every recursively contained implementation leaf on one compatible source snapshot and constructs a deterministic descendant join ordered by stable leaf ID, then stable schema ID. The join records exact descendant and schema-row counts plus exact counts for NewV1NoPredecessor, UnchangedV1, MigratedV1ToV2, DecodeOnlyLegacyV1, RetiredV1, and InapplicableNoCanonicalFrame; every count is checked against the literal descendant inventory rather than inferred from status, labels, estimates, source ordinals, or child aggregate totals. It refuses a missing, extra, duplicate, reordered, stale, owner-remapped, cross-rollup, unknown-disposition, incompatible-snapshot, V1/V2-substituted, partial-migration, or multiply aggregated leaf/schema row, and refuses any authoritative V2 close claim while a required descendant is absent or still names an incompatible authoritative V1 parent.

Comprehensive rollup tests cover exact-empty where structurally legal, one descendant, the exact live maximum, one-over injected input, all six dispositions, nested-rollup associativity without double counting, order/shard/schedule/resume invariance, every missing/extra/duplicate/reorder and mixed-snapshot mutation, first explicit divergence, bounded deterministic step-prefixed logging and redaction, structured reproduction, overflow terminal, coverage counters, and exact source closure. A source-closed release-built E2E join consumes only already produced leaf evidence and proves aggregation fidelity; it does not execute descendants, replace their unit/property/model/mutation/API/fault/E2E/log/source-closure gates, or promote focused, DSR, downstream, durability, scientific, or authority proof. CONTRACT/rustdoc and the final rollup report list every descendant schema-impact manifest and all separate proof states.

LIVE ROLLUP TOPOLOGY, SCHEDULING, AND OPERABILITY 2026-07-29 (FINAL CONTROLLING). This issue is a `runner-v2-rollup` epic. Its exact direct hierarchy children are: `frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.1.1.3.2.1`, `frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.1.1.3.2.2`, `frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.1.1.3.2.3`, `frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.1.1.3.2.4`. Its current recursive subtree contains exactly 5 Beads: 4 implementation tasks totaling 1,770 minutes and 1 rollup epics totaling 90 minutes, for 1,860 minutes. The 4 internal `parent-child` relations are closure hierarchy only; no reciprocal parent-depends-on-child `blocks` edge is permitted. This rollup's own 90-minute estimate covers only its explicitly named aggregate, integration, join, driver, rerun, source-closure, or close-review work and is not duplicated in child estimates. Functional implementation order remains solely in explicit `blocks` edges among owning tasks. While `br epic status` reports `eligible_for_close=false`, this rollup MUST have status `blocked`, never `open` or `in_progress`; when eligibility becomes true, transition it to `open` or `in_progress` only for its scoped closeout, then close it. The canonical executable-work query is `br ready --epic frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24 --type task`. `bv` robot output is diagnostic only; any surfaced rollup is not executable implementation work. Close this rollup only after every exact child-root, integration, test/E2E, detailed-log/redaction, reproduction, source-closure, proof-state, authority, and no-claim gate in this Bead passes. This clause supersedes every earlier numeric node/estimate/subtotal claim and every earlier phrase treating hierarchy children as reciprocal `blocks` dependencies or this epic as an implementation task. It removes no scope, feature, functionality, test, E2E script/contribution, logging, reproduction, source, route, capability, durability, scientific, admission, authority, or no-claim obligation.

ROLLUP CLOSEOUT DISCOVERABILITY AND MANUAL-EVIDENCE GATE 2026-07-29 (FINAL CONTROLLING). `br ready --epic frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24 --type task --json --limit 0` is the canonical implementation-task query; `bv` robot output is dependency/impact diagnosis, not executable status. A route-owning or integration-owning epic must be claimed and its own acceptance evidence completed before explicit close; task-only queries must not make that work disappear, and automatic bulk epic closure cannot substitute for it.

The transition from blocked -> eligible closeout -> in-progress closeout -> explicitly closed is deterministic and logged. title: Runner V2 family registries, root-policy projections, normalized units, and evaluator-view sealing
description:
Own root-free family registry drafts, exact cap ownership, root-policy aggregate projection, normalized logical and evaluation units, cross-reference checks, and population of the evaluator-owned EvaluationRegistryViewV2. This child owns no callback, parser, codec implementation, executable relation, provider, handle, terminal map, lifecycle, publication, or authority.

## Acceptance Criteria

The dedicated Acceptance Criteria field is the authoritative close gate. Every numbered criterion must pass, including the controlling nine-facet literal/unit/boundary, property/metamorphic, state/model/race, mutation/fuzz, API/compile-fail/trait, fault/resource/cancellation, release-built no-mock E2E or immutable E2E-contribution, deterministic detailed-logging/redaction, and source-closure manifest; the four explicit eligible/matched result partitions; exact Unsupported/inapplicable reasons; and zero unexpected mismatches, execution failures, or unexplained skips on one compatible source/build/proof snapshot.
design: Preserve exact cap codes 37 through 44, 54, and 66 through 71; typed namespace-local IDs; same numeric ID across different categories as valid; duplicates within one category as invalid; globally unambiguous names; exact owner and no-claim metadata; base-catalog joins; and no ambient registry. Root policies remain descriptive: RequireInputOutputDisjoint does not prove actual acquired-resource disjointness. Normalize units with checked exact conversions and explicit dimension rules. EvaluationRegistryViewV2 is populated from the frozen registry and independently reconstructible without reverse ownership.
acceptance_criteria:
1. OWNERSHIP AND EXACT CONTRACT. Own root-free family registry drafts, exact cap ownership, root-policy aggregate projection, normalized logical and evaluation units, cross-reference checks, and population of the evaluator-owned EvaluationRegistryViewV2. This child owns no callback, parser, codec implementation, executable relation, provider, handle, terminal map, lifecycle, publication, or authority. The owner set is singular and every inherited parent requirement maps to a stable child-prefixed cell. Missing, duplicate, shadow, stale, mixed-snapshot, reverse-edge, generic-root, or authority-widening ownership refuses. Primary ownership maps registry, cap, root-policy, unit, and evaluator-view portions of parent criteria 1, 6–8, and 23–28.

2. COMPREHENSIVE LITERAL, UNIT, AND BOUNDARY PROOF. A source-authoritative LocalInProcess route row binds attempt_identity_contract_root, detailed_log_schema_root, and structured_reproduction_schema_root. It MUST NOT bind a per-invocation attempt_identity_root, detailed_log_root, or structured_reproduction_root. Any reverse edge, expected-as-actual substitution, or source manifest whose root changes per attempt refuses. Static route rows bind a case_manifest_contract_root derived from exact owner/driver/native/POSIX/path/schema literals; they do not claim a downstream-owned file exists, has been read, has a runtime content root, or has executed.

OWNER ROLE EQUALITY MATRIX (CONTROLLING). Every owner role remains a separately encoded typed field even when two fields contain the same Bead ID. source_owner is the leaf that emits the declaration. For each ContributionOnly row, semantic_consumer equals execution_owner and driver_owner equals execution_owner unless an exact row explicitly freezes another owner. posix_wrapper_owner equals execution_owner when a POSIX wrapper is declared. windows_wrapper_owner equals execution_owner only for PowerShellWrapper; DirectDriver has no wrapper owner and its driver_owner equals execution_owner. source_owner MUST differ from semantic_consumer and execution_owner. Equal values across declared role fields are legal and do not collapse, omit, or infer fields. Rows may share an owner, driver, platform routes, and case-manifest contract only when explicitly listed, while their route ID, payload root, contribution root, and Deferred-envelope root remain distinct.

DECLARATION VERSUS ACTUAL ARTIFACTS AND FAULTS (CONTROLLING). Contribution rows use OwnerEnvelopeRelativePathsOnly. Local rows use a distinct LocalExplicitAbsentOrRelativePathsOnly policy. Both are declaration policy only; RetainedArtifactStateV1 is runtime evidence and is present only under the legal runtime disposition. A pure in-process leaf with no asupersync/runtime dependency may test deterministic model-only observation-loss, cancellation, deadline, and resource faults through private sealed fixtures, but MUST label them model evidence and MUST NOT call them actual runtime cancellation/drain proof. Actual scoped cancellation, stop, drain, process, and resource-return evidence remains with the exact execution owner whose dependency/capability contract permits it. A Boolean callback or public test hook cannot stand in for either model proof or actual cancellation.

CANONICAL ROUTE SCHEMAS AND TEST GATE (CONTROLLING). New route body, row, manifest, local-entrypoint registry, native-route, native-bootstrap, V2 observer, V3 contribution, V2 Deferred-envelope, declaration-policy, and runtime-result schemas have exact API/wire versions, domains, magic bytes, ordered fields, nominal roots, migration rows, source owners, source paths, compatible snapshot, and no-claim. New nominal roles use source-frozen LeafExtension fragments and never append to the immutable 47-role FrozenBase registry. Independent handwritten tests cover exact codes/literals and every route row; empty, one, 64, 65, exact-set, missing, extra, duplicate, reorder, stale, unknown kind, all class transitions, and all-Inapplicable refusal; every-field/root mutation; owner/consumer singularity and equality; PowerShell/direct-driver substitution; V1/V2/V3 barriers; raw-hash and cross-kind compile failures with exact Rust error codes and positive counterparts; result-free contribution plus Deferred-envelope separation; no-mock local or release owner E2E; Observed, NotObserved, Deferred, and Inapplicable matrices; safe partials; model-only versus actual cancellation scope; reserve-before-detail log overflow; deterministic step order, redaction, no-echo, and post-report structured reproduction; shard/resume and mixed-snapshot refusal; exact partitions; and complete source closure. Every test and compile-fail addition updates its live inventory, class count, route ratchet, schema-impact manifest, log/reproduction schema, and source closure atomically. Focused, release-built, source-closure, constellation, DSR, downstream, platform, durability, scientific, admission, and authority proof states remain separate.

ROUTE-PLAN CONFLICT RECONCILIATION 2026-07-29 (CONTROLLING). The following clauses resolve only contradictory legacy wording. They preserve every route, field, schema, test, E2E journey, log, reproduction artifact, source-closure obligation, and no-claim boundary already required by this Bead; where older prose conflicts, these clauses supersede only the conflicting interpretation.

QUALIFIED EVIDENCE TYPE. Every pre-existing unqualified `EvidenceKindV1` token in this Bead's route criteria means the exact common enum `BaseCoverageCloseEvidenceKindV1`. Already-qualified names remain unchanged. Logging retains its own nominal evidence-kind type; no third generic enum exists. Independent literal-oracle, zero/unknown-code, cross-type compile-fail, and positive-construction tests freeze this rule.

STATIC DECLARATION VERSUS RUNTIME ROOTS. A source-authoritative static `LocalInProcess` route row binds only `attempt_identity_contract_root`, `detailed_log_schema_root`, and `structured_reproduction_schema_root`. It never binds a per-invocation `attempt_identity_root`, `detailed_log_root`, or `structured_reproduction_root`. Actual roots are constructed only after declaration admission and real execution yields a completed report or permitted safe partial; reproduction is post-report and the terminal/final log join it afterward. Unit, boundary, property/model, one-field mutation, no-mock in-process E2E, deterministic detailed-log/redaction, structured-reproduction, attempt-isolation, DAG-cycle, and source-closure tests prove static-root stability across attempts and runtime-root movement without expected-as-actual substitution.

ROLE IDENTITY AND VALUE EQUALITY. Statements that owners or consumers remain distinct mean that the role fields remain nominally typed and separately encoded, not that their token values must differ. For every contribution row, `semantic_consumer == execution_owner` and `driver_owner == execution_owner`. A wrapper owner equals the execution owner exactly when the selected wrapper variant exists; `DirectDriver` carries no wrapper owner or wrapper path. `source_owner` remains its separately designated declaration owner and is never inferred from those equalities. Unit/exact-set, property/model, wrong-equality mutation, presence-matrix, cross-role compile-fail, owner-consumption E2E, logging/reproduction, and source-closure tests reject missing, unequal, fabricated, or variant-inapplicable role values.

ROUTE CARDINALITY (CONTROLLING). This Bead owns exactly five ordered rows: one `LocalInProcess` row and four `ContributionOnly` rows—the three release journeys plus the Phase-1 contract. Counts are LocalInProcess=1, ExecutionOwned=0, ContributionOnly=4, Inapplicable=0, and the class is `Mixed`. Tests reject a four-row total, a three-contribution interpretation, a missing Phase-1 row, a duplicate journey, or an inferred sixth row.

PROGRAM-WIDE ATTEMPT CORRELATION, STAGE TELEMETRY, SHARD/RESUME, AND COMPLETE-LOG CONSUMER GATE 2026-07-29 (FINAL CONTROLLING). This task exact-binds, and does not redefine, the common three-plane contracts owned by `.24.1.1.1.4` through `.24.1.1.1.6`. Every executable cell declaration binds the common attempt-identity contract root; the actual nominal `AttemptIdentityRootV1` exists only after admission. Every child/downstream execution records its stable route/suite/case/cell/shard IDs and causal ordinal, with an optional typed parent-attempt root only in attempt-specific evidence. Canonical invocation/command/event/report/reproduction/terminal/final-log payloads bind the attempt-invariant `CanonicalRuntimeObservationProjectionRootV1` and contain deterministic schema/version, logical event sequence, stage code/ordinal, event kind/severity, expected/observed classification, semantic/budget/capability/no-claim roots, first divergence, bounded actionable diagnostic, terminal completeness, and safe relative artifacts. They contain no attempt identity/scope, raw transcript, timing sample, wall clock, physical path, host/environment/PID/scheduler/load, secret, live capability/resource value, or bulk payload.

Applicable actual execution additionally requires a complete AC57 envelope and finalized `AttemptRetentionReceiptV1` that correlate the canonical root set with nominal attempt identity, safe retention scope, resource/capability reconciliation, raw-audit roots, atomic finalization, and `RunnerStageTelemetryV1`. The bounded telemetry sidecar records attempt/optional parent correlation, stable route/suite/case/cell/shard IDs, causal ordinal, stage code/ordinal, start/finish disposition, checked monotonic offset and stage delta with explicit units, clock descriptor/root, resolution and suspend policy, applicable environmental time budget, terminal disposition, safe relative artifact references, and explicit no-performance-claim scope. Timing is an operator observation only: it never feeds semantic/source/build/schema/oracle/expected-result/publication/receipt/admission/authority roots or a portable performance claim. A read-only operator view may join receipt, canonical log, and telemetry after finalization; it cannot feed execution or mutate any root.

A ContributionOnly or deferred-local declaration carries its immutable result-free payload plus typed Deferred envelope and fabricates no attempt, timing, execution, resource, or terminal actual. A genuinely pure/non-executable facet uses a source-registered Inapplicable reason naming exact owner, scope, prerequisite, and no-claim. Every manifest explicitly declares `Sharded` or `ShardInapplicable` and `Resumable` or `ResumeInapplicable`; omission, runtime-skip synthesis, or Unsupported-as-Inapplicable refuses. Comprehensive literal/unit/boundary, property/metamorphic, state/typestate/model/race, mutation/fuzz, API/compile-fail/trait, fault/resource/cancellation, no-mock local/release E2E or immutable contribution plus owner-consumption E2E, deterministic detailed logging/redaction/no-echo, structured reproduction, shard/resume, exact coverage, and source-closure tests cover missing/extra/duplicate/reordered stages/events/correlation rows, logical-sequence gaps/overflow, simultaneous same-cell attempts, causal-parent substitution, exact resume versus cross-attempt residue, shard gaps/duplicates/remaps, clock unavailable/regression/wrap/overflow, stage nesting and deadline reconciliation, observation loss, zero/one/exact/one-over log and telemetry budgets, reserve-before-detail terminal overflow, changing timing/attempt/raw noise without moving canonical roots, one-component movement in the correct outer plane, sentinel redaction across every output path, and missing terminal/correlation/artifact/reproduction evidence.
