title: Runner V2 artifact inventory, manifest/seal DAG, API conformance, and proof rollup
description:
Decomposed implementation-and-proof rollup for immutable artifact inventory and logical layout, the acyclic BundleManifestV2/Seal identity DAG, publication compatibility, and cross-module public-API conformance. Three atomic children own inventory/layout, manifest/seal DAG, and independent API/E2E/source-closure proof respectively; this epic exact-set joins their compatible roots. It implements no lifecycle production, byte codec, live publication effect, durability, science, admission, or authority.


## Success Criteria

The dedicated Acceptance Criteria field, including its final live rollup topology/accounting reconciliation, is the canonical success gate. Every exact direct child must close on compatible proof and source roots, every assigned aggregate/integration/route obligation must pass, and focused, release-E2E, DSR, durability, scientific, admission, authority, and no-claim statuses must remain separate.
design:
This leaf structurally validates presented length/root relations only. Identity requires equal encoded and expanded lengths and equal presented digest bytes under distinct nominal roles. ZstdFrameV1 permits different lengths and digest bytes and records DecodeRequired without claiming the relation was executed. Posix/Windows presented stored shape equals encoded shape; ContentStore presented stored shape includes the declared canonical envelope overhead. All roots are required as nominal references. Only 24.2.1.2 validates artifact bytes, computes the three roots, and classifies corruption; 24.2.2 later proves durability.

ArtifactInventoryDraftV2 validates counts and checked aggregate arithmetic before allocation; freezes zero through 256 entries; validates path, role/registry, codec, producer case, all three lengths and roots, required-present metadata, logical extents, and family axis/unit rules; rejects duplicate paths; sorts by canonical artifact-relative-path bytes; and computes ArtifactInventoryRootV2 with the exact domain org.frankensim.fs-evidence-runner.artifact-inventory.v1. It represents non-lifecycle artifacts only. Lifecycle logs, terminal bytes, inventory bytes, BundleManifestV2, SealV2, and publication receipts have no inventory-entry constructor.

PublicationProtocolV2, DestinationAdmissionModeV2, PublicationTargetV2, and PublicationSelectionV2 are nominal base schemas from 24.1.1.1. This leaf owns their manifest/inventory compatibility rules: Posix pairs only with PosixRelative, Windows only with WindowsRelative, and ContentStore only with ContentStoreLogicalKey; Absent and PreExistingEmpty are the only destination modes. ContentStore PreExistingEmpty is that same code-2 mode and is valid only when the separately bound DurableOutput RootCapabilityPolicyV2 has the exact Enumerate and AcquireExclusiveLease additions required by the base least-privilege matrix; there is no third leased-empty mode or selection variant. No cross-pair is legal. Input and output root policies must be profile-compatible with the selected publication; registered Other-root policies retain their own exact profile and rights and cannot widen or alias the output selection. This leaf performs pure compatibility, path-antichain, identity, and stored-shape validation only.

The seal wire schema is acyclic and its production constructor is deliberately later. SealBasisV2 binds exactly BundleManifestRootV2 and DurablePublicationIdentityV2, and SealRootV2 uses domain org.frankensim.fs-evidence-runner.seal.v1. DurablePublicationIdentityV2 identifies the already durable pre-seal payload transaction: lifecycle, terminal, inventory, artifact objects, manifest bytes, and BundleManifestRootV2. It does not include SealV2 or SealRootV2. This leaf owns the field/schema descriptor and independent root oracle but exposes no public constructor from a boolean, path, content root, or presented reference.

24.2.2 alone owns opaque ProvenDurablePreSealV2. Its production sealing API consumes that proof, constructs SealV2, durably writes and flushes the seal as a second commit step, then returns opaque PublishedBundleReceiptV2 and PublishedBundleReceiptRootV2. The final receipt binds pre-seal transaction identity, SealRootV2, final-store commit identity, and protocol. It is not embedded in SealV2, so no cycle exists. A schema fixture here may parse a checked presented DurablePublicationIdentityV2 nominal reference and independently recompute hypothetical SealBasisV2 bytes, but cannot construct ProvenDurablePreSealV2, production SealV2, or a published receipt.

Only SealV2 directly embeds BundleManifestRootV2 in the current output-bundle publication graph. ReplayLineageV2 separately references a source BundleManifestRootV2 and source SealRootV2, and the later rjoq candidate separately carries the digest-preserving ProducerManifestRootV1 association. Those are foreign-key references, not current-output self-inclusion. The valid dependency graph is spec/invocation plus lifecycle/inventory to manifest, pre-seal publication proof to seal, and final seal commit to published receipt.

Authority/no-claim scope is explicit and monotone. Inventory, manifest, schema-oracle seal root, neutral comparison, runner Pass, replay lineage, or published-byte receipt proves at most declared runner conformance and byte durability. None converts to scientific Evidence, Certified, or rjoq admission. Durability proves bytes and protocol effects, not artifact semantics.

The cross-module fixture uses real public constructors for a sealed representative family, normal/retry/replay identities, positive and negative comparison/effect observations, zero/one/many artifact inventories, a manifest basis, and typed schema descriptors. It independently exercises hypothetical seal-frame recomputation using a checked presented non-authoritative DurablePublicationIdentityV2 reference, then proves the production seal and published-receipt constructors are unavailable until 24.2.2. It does not construct AdmissionCandidateRefV1; the authority-owned type and real handoff remain 24.5.1.

This leaf owns artifact and manifest schema modules/tests, seal schema descriptors/oracles, crate-level compile-fail/no-mock/log coverage, and crate-local contract semantics. Workspace policy, schema registration, generated identities, documentation inventories, count ratchets, and DSR integration remain 24.1.3.

The stored-byte contract consumed by this leaf is protocol-aware and identity-bearing: RunnerBudgetsV2 carries artifact_encoded_bytes, artifact_stored_bytes, and artifact_expanded_bytes in that order. Encoded and expanded bundle ceilings are 64 MiB Smoke and 512 MiB Full. Each ContentStore object admits at most 4096 canonical envelope bytes beyond its encoded payload, so artifact-stored ceilings are 65 MiB Smoke and 513 MiB Full for at most 256 artifacts. Posix/Windows require stored == encoded; ContentStore requires stored == encoded + the exact non-payload envelope length. All sums are checked over complete stored objects before proportional allocation, publication, verification, replay, or handoff.

`LogicalAggregateMapV2` replaces any undefined scalar logical total. It is a canonical sorted vector keyed by `(LogicalExtentAxisV2, LogicalUnitV2)` with one checked u128 sum per exact key. Values with different axes or different units never add implicitly; a family may register an exact rational conversion only inside one axis, and the manifest records both the source-key totals and canonical converted target total. Duplicate keys, cross-axis conversion, absent conversion, or overflow refuse before root construction.

Artifact paths form a portable antichain. After canonical byte sorting, duplicate paths and any proper-prefix pair such as `a` and `a/b` refuse before ArtifactInventoryRootV2 construction. Locally decidable ASCII case aliases follow the sealed profile policy; non-ASCII Windows alias adjudication is typed Unsupported until the platform owner supplies registered proof.

BundleManifestV2 binds the complete observed `PublicationSelectionV2`, including DestinationAdmissionModeV2 and the canonical logical target value. Durable commands also bind that selection in InvocationBasisV2. Later DurablePublicationIdentityV2 and PublishedBundleReceiptV2 must repeat it byte-for-byte; mismatch is an identity refusal. Physical descriptors, handles, scoped prefixes, transaction locators, and generations remain outside manifest identity except for stable protocol-owned destination-generation roots in durability proofs.

BundleManifestV2 additionally binds ReplaySupportBindingRootV2 immediately after PublicationSelectionV2. Every current-wire bundle retains the explicit wire-V1 no-adapter support binding; a Replay bundle retains the exact source-support and current MigrationExecutionBasis relationship defined by 24.1.1.5. MigrationObservationRootV2 is not part of InvocationRootV2, but after execution it is required inside ReplaySupportBindingV2 and therefore moves the manifest. Missing, stale, unregistered, wrong-source, or wrong-target support cannot be treated as an output-only log detail.

The manifest separates actual artifact work from planned publication work without a self-length cycle. artifact_encoded_bytes, artifact_stored_bytes, and artifact_expanded_bytes are actual checked inventory aggregates. The complete RunnerBudgetsV2 supplies the singular artifact, system-publication, whole-publication, lifecycle, and command-result grants; no extracted grant is duplicated in the manifest. Before freezing, checked arithmetic proves the actual artifact stored total plus the system-publication grant fits the whole-publication grant and the 73 MiB/521 MiB profile ceiling. The final PublicationAccountingV1 and publisher receipt later bind actual stored bytes for exactly the six BundleLayoutV1 system objects and the actual whole publication. PublishedBundleReceiptV2 and DurableCommandResultV2 remain outer result data, while physical commit/recovery metadata remains nonsemantic. BundleManifestV2 never claims its own eventual encoded/stored length and never embeds final system roots, avoiding a fixed-point or receipt cycle.

The artifact_relative_path stored in every inventory entry is LogicalBundlePathV1. PublicationSelectionV2 owns the one bundle target prefix; inventory paths are relative beneath it and cannot repeat that prefix. ContentStoreObjectKeyV1 is derived later from the selected logical target plus reserved BundleLayoutV1 system namespace and one inventory path, never from a physical store prefix, transaction locator, generation, capability, or attempt. This leaf freezes the pure derivation schema and collision/antichain preconditions but performs no store access.

BundleLayoutV1 later derives the full logical object path as `artifacts/` plus artifact_relative_path; inventory never repeats that reserved prefix. System objects live under the separate `runner/` namespace. BundleManifest compatibility checks the selected bundle target plus every derived full object path against the 240-byte/32-segment profile cap and ContentStore key rules, so a maximum-length target and maximum-length artifact path cannot coexist silently. Duplicate and proper-prefix checks apply both to artifact-relative paths and to the final derived system/artifact object set.

## Final controlling shared-primitive, inventory, and evaluator-projection contract

This section supersedes the opening ownership and entry-order paragraphs. `ArtifactCodecIdV2` and `LogicalExtentV2` are shared declaration-only primitives owned by 24.1.1.1; this leaf consumes and never redeclares them. Family registration, axis/unit normalization, and `EvaluationRegistryViewV2` population are owned by 24.1.1.3.2.1; final `FamilySpecV2` sealing is owned by 24.1.1.3.2.3. This leaf owns artifact inventory, manifest, and pure relation schemas only. It does not own bytes or semantic constructors for `ArtifactEncodedRootV2`, `ArtifactContentRootV2`, or `StoredObjectRootV2`; those roots remain checked presented references here and are constructed only by 24.2.1.2 from validated bytes.

This leaf declares the data-only `ArtifactCodecRelationDescriptorV2` catalog and `ArtifactCodecRelationCatalogRootV2` under `org.frankensim.fs-evidence-runner.artifact-codec-relations.v1`. Its exact two rows consume base IDs 0 Identity and 1 ZstdFrameV1. Identity records `SameCanonicalBytes`, equal encoded/expanded lengths, and equal digest bytes under distinct nominal roles. ZstdFrameV1 records `DecodeRequired`, no encoded/expanded length-equality claim, and distinct encoded/content roots. Both rows state that stored-object relation is selected separately by publication protocol: direct encoded bytes for Posix/Windows or a complete canonical ContentStore envelope. The catalog contains no encoder, decoder, checksum, byte buffer, callback, function, parser, implementation object, capability, or authority. 24.2.1.2 exact-set consumes this catalog root and proves the byte meanings; unknown IDs refuse as Unsupported.

`ArtifactInventoryEntryV2` exact paired field order is: artifact-relative path; artifact role; codec ID; encoded length; encoded root; stored length; stored root; expanded length; content root; required flag; producing case ID; producing manifest ordinal; and canonical logical extents. `LogicalExtentV2` itself is consumed unchanged with axis, u128 value, and unit order. This paired order is identical to the `ArtifactSetObservationEntryV2` schema owned by 24.1.1.3.1.1 and its projection semantics owned by 24.1.1.3.1.3; the earlier all-lengths-before-all-roots order is forbidden.

The complete immutable inventory frame binds, in order, `RunnerSpecRootV2`, family namespace/version, `EvaluationRegistryViewRootV2`, `ArtifactCodecRelationCatalogRootV2`, and the canonical artifact-entry vector. `ArtifactInventoryDraftV2` resolves every registered role, logical axis, allowed unit, producing case ID, and manifest ordinal against the exact borrowed sealed family/case/view data; verifies that its reconstructed registry-view and codec-relation roots equal the bound roots; validates all path-antichain, count, byte, protocol, required, provenance, extent, and checked aggregate constraints before proportional allocation; and then computes `ArtifactInventoryRootV2`. A syntactically valid but unknown or cross-family ID cannot enter an inventory root.

The controlling `BundleManifestV2` fields retain every prior field and insert `EvaluationRegistryViewRootV2` immediately after family mode. That root must equal the inventory's bound view and the selected family/case view under `RunnerSpecRootV2`. The inventory root transitively binds the codec-relation catalog, so the manifest neither duplicates individual relation rows nor permits a mixed catalog. All replay-support, publication-selection, capability-policy, lifecycle, budget, accounting, acyclicity, seal, and no-claim fields and constraints remain intact.

Projection direction is downstream and acyclic. 24.1.1.3.1.1 owns the `ArtifactSetObservationEntryV2`, `ArtifactSetObservationV2`, and `ArtifactSetRootV2` schemas without importing this leaf; 24.1.1.3.1.3 owns their deterministic checked construction and comparison semantics. After an inventory is validated, this leaf accepts one complete sealed-family `CaseEvaluationKeyV2`, resolves it against the inventory's RunnerSpec/family/view context, filters by its case ID and manifest ordinal, and projects each selected inventory entry field-for-field in the exact paired order through the existing public evaluator API. It independently recomputes the evaluator artifact-set root and compares it with the API result. The two nominal aggregate roots remain domain-distinct: projection parity means identical semantic entry data and independently reproducible `ArtifactSetRootV2`, not equality with `ArtifactInventoryRootV2`. Any key, field, order, registry, codec relation, or provenance substitution moves the appropriate root or refuses.

## Candidate-seam entry identity closure

This leaf also declares and solely constructs `ArtifactInventoryEntryRootV2`, domain `org.frankensim.fs-evidence-runner.artifact-inventory-entry.v1`, with `DigestRoleV2::ArtifactInventory`. Its exact frame is contextual rather than a hash of unqualified entry bytes: `RunnerSpecRootV2`; family namespace; family version; `EvaluationRegistryViewRootV2`; `ArtifactCodecRelationCatalogRootV2`; then every `ArtifactInventoryEntryV2` field in the controlling paired order. The constructor is private to successful entry validation. The root identifies one validated entry under one exact schema/registry/codec context but does not by itself prove membership in a particular inventory, byte possession, publication, durability, candidate eligibility, science, or admission.

`ArtifactInventoryV2` exposes each canonical entry with its recomputable entry root and covers the complete ordered entry frames under the same context in `ArtifactInventoryRootV2`. The root DAG is entry context/data to entry root, then the complete ordered inventory to inventory root; an entry root never binds the inventory root, so there is no cycle. 24.5.1 consumes the pair of whole-inventory root and selected entry root and independently proves exactly-one membership before constructing its neutral candidate binding. No other leaf may synthesize an entry root from path/content alone or treat matching digest bytes under another context as membership.

## Final controlling artifact precision and complete manifest order

The codec relation root is exactly `ArtifactCodecRelationCatalogRootV2`, domain `org.frankensim.fs-evidence-runner.artifact-codec-relation-catalog.v1`, digest role Policy, semantic owner ArtifactSchema. The singular `relation-catalog` schema name and domain follow the standard generation rule. ZstdFrameV1 requires distinct nominal encoded/content root types and roles but makes no digest-byte inequality claim: equal 32-byte digests remain syntactically possible and do not prove equal underlying bytes. Identity's same-canonical-bytes relation permits equal digest bytes only under the two distinct nominal wrappers. Byte possession and relation proof remain 24.2.1.2.

`ArtifactInventoryEntryRootV2` has owner `ConstructorOwnerV1::ArtifactSchema` and remains a later phase-1 schema, so it does not change the base 43-wrapper inventory. `ArtifactSetObservationV2` binds the complete root-free `CaseEvaluationKeyV2` as declared by 24.1.1.3.1.1 and semantically checked by 24.1.1.3.1.3. This leaf exposes only `project_case_artifact_set(&CaseEvaluationKeyV2)`: it resolves the complete key through the bound sealed FamilySpec/CaseManifest data, filters entries whose producing case and ordinal both equal the key, preserves canonical path order, and constructs the evaluator-owned scoped set through its public checked API. Wrong namespace/version/view, unknown or mismatched ID/ordinal, and cross-case leakage refuse. No scalar-pair, whole-run, or ordinal-prefix projection is implicit; read-only convenience overloads may derive a key only from one already sealed CaseManifest view.

The `required` bit is identity-bearing metadata about a present entry. Inventory construction never infers a missing required artifact from an absent row. Completeness exists only where the sealed case's effect arena declares exact `ArtifactSetEqual` expectations for its scoped set; absent/extra artifacts then mismatch through that evaluator contract. Without that expectation, inventory and manifest make no completeness claim.

The one complete controlling `BundleManifestV2` field order is: API generation; wire schema; runner implementation identity; `RunnerSpecRootV2`; `InvocationRootV2`; `RunIdV2`; source identity; build identity; `RunnerCommandV2`; optional `RunProfileV2`; family namespace; family version; family mode; `EvaluationRegistryViewRootV2`; `LifecycleLogRootV2`; `RunTerminalRecordRootV2`; `ArtifactInventoryRootV2`; complete `RunnerLimitsV2`; complete `RunnerBudgetsV2`; actual artifact encoded bytes; actual artifact stored bytes; actual artifact expanded bytes; `LogicalAggregateMapV2`; ordered duplicate-rejected root-capability-policy roots; complete `PublicationSelectionV2`; `ReplaySupportBindingRootV2`; and authority/no-claim scope. This list supersedes every partial earlier exact list while preserving every named field and exclusion. The inventory transitively binds the codec-relation catalog; no row or root is duplicated.

Logical aggregate conversion consumes the normalized axis descriptors populated by 24.1.1.3.2.1 and bound into the sealed `FamilySpecV2` by 24.1.1.3.2.3: one canonical unit and exact scale-to-canonical per allowed unit. It retains exact source `(axis, unit)` totals and may additionally report a canonical converted total only by that sealed within-axis rational relation. Allowed-unit membership alone never implies a conversion; cross-axis, missing relation, noncanonical scale, or checked u128/rational overflow refuses. Quantity/resource evaluation units remain a separate typed namespace.

Portable path validation preserves the platform boundary. Exact-byte duplicate/proper-prefix checks and locally decidable ASCII case aliases refuse here. Non-ASCII Windows alias adjudication is typed Unsupported unless the later platform owner supplies the registered canonical alias proof; this leaf does not claim a universal Unicode/Windows collision oracle and does not silently narrow all paths to ASCII. ContentStore/Posix exact-byte cases remain deterministic. All codec/envelope/root fixtures in this leaf are explicitly structural and presented; they cannot be labeled byte-verified or no-mock codec evidence until 24.2.1.2 runs.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Independent literal tests enumerate every ArtifactCodecIdV2, inventory field/order, LogicalExtentV2 field/order, BundleManifestV2 field/order, SealBasisV2 field/order, PublicationProtocolV2, identity descriptor/domain, exclusion, authority/no-claim rule, and codec handoff. Expected tables are handwritten and assert exact set, order, uniqueness, stable u16 codes, versions, and unknown refusal.

2. Inventory tests cover zero/one/exact-256/257 entries and every encoded, stored, expanded, and logical zero/one/extreme. They cover checked aggregate overflow, both codec descriptor shapes, every base/registered role and axis, required/optional artifacts, producer cases, units, and maximum declarations without huge allocation.

3. Length/root relation tests exhaust Identity equality, Zstd encoded-versus-expanded differences, Posix/Windows stored-equals-encoded, ContentStore envelope differences, wrong length/root pairings, absent roots, same digest bytes under distinct nominal roles, and corruption classification at stored, encoded, and expanded layers.

4. `AdapterRegistryEntryV2` has exact ordered fields: source_schema_id RegisteredSchemaIdV1; target_schema_id RegisteredSchemaIdV1; adapter_id StableTokenV2; adapter_source_root SourceIdentityRootV2; adapter_contract_schema_id RegisteredSchemaIdV1; migration_policy_root; capability_root; limits_root; input_authority_scope_root; output_authority_scope_root; retain_original_required bool; and optional registered_bijection_proof_schema_id. title: Runner V2 CLI, lifecycle, stop/drain, and semantic-result exact-set implementation rollup
description:
Exact-set proof-and-ownership rollup over four nonoverlapping Runner CLI/lifecycle implementation leaves: abstract six-command grammar, CLI-to-InvocationBasisV2 projection and checked identity consumption, catalog UX, and capability presentation; deterministic stop/drain evidence, terminal windows, signals, and deadlines; lifecycle writing, evaluator-to-terminal mapping, continuation, and deterministic aggregation; and semantic command results, complete transport handoff, native process-exit model, and release proof.

The four-child union implements the complete original grammar, canonical rendering, lifecycle, terminal, conformance mapping, stop/drain, aggregation, diagnostics, staged semantic-result, transport-handoff, native-ingress, test/E2E, logging, source-closure, and no-authority contract. This rollup owns no parser, writer, arbiter, result constructor, transport, physical effect, E2E execution, or authority and closes only by exact-set joining the four child close manifests on one compatible snapshot.

## Success Criteria

The dedicated Acceptance Criteria field is the authoritative exact-set rollup gate. Every direct child must close on one compatible source/build/proof snapshot with its complete test or contribution, release-built E2E, deterministic-log, result-partition, and source-closure roots; the rollup owns no implementation and cannot replace a missing child, proof class, or no-claim boundary with status, prose, or aggregate counts.
design:
CONTROLLING OWNERSHIP PROJECTION. CLI/lifecycle ownership is fixed: 24.1.2.1 owns abstract grammar, canonical rendering, CLI-to-InvocationBasisV2 semantic projection, checked consumption of identity constructors solely owned by 24.1.1.2, catalog/help/version UX, typed capability presentation, and immutable native-ingress contributions; .1.2.2 owns stop/drain evidence, terminal windows, signal/deadline models, and related contributions; .1.2.3 owns lifecycle schemas/writer, evaluator-to-terminal mapping, continuation, aggregation, and lifecycle roots; .1.2.4 owns semantic command-result envelopes, complete transport handoff model, native exit mapping, release proof, and aggregate downstream contributions. Physical capability acquire/narrow/use/return/close remains 24.2.2.1. Parent 24.1.2 owns only the four-child exact-set join.

Children 24.1.2.1-.4 own the complete CLI/lifecycle scope: .1 owns abstract grammar, canonical rendering, CLI-to-InvocationBasisV2 projection and checked identity consumption, and UX; .2 owns stop/drain evidence and signal/deadline models; .3 owns lifecycle construction, case/run outcome derivation, continuation, and aggregation; .4 owns semantic command-result envelopes, transport handoff, exit mapping, and proof contributions. It does not own hostile byte decoding, filesystem/content-store publication, process execution, migration, scientific authority, or admission. All wire schemas are API generation 2 over first wire version 1 with private fields, checked builders, exact ordered encodings, literal domains, and no Default or public struct literals.

The canonical command grammar is exact. `--list` has no other options. `--check` and `--self-test` accept no caller family, mode, profile, budget, input, or publication selector. Durable forms are `--run smoke|full --family-mode MODE --seed SEED_SELECTION --publication-protocol PROTOCOL --destination-mode DESTINATION_MODE --artifact-root ROOT_CAPABILITY_REF --bundle-rel BUNDLE_REL`; `--negative CASE --publication-protocol PROTOCOL --destination-mode DESTINATION_MODE --artifact-root ROOT_CAPABILITY_REF --bundle-rel BUNDLE_REL`; and `--replay MANIFEST_REL --input-artifact-root INPUT_ROOT_CAPABILITY_REF --publication-protocol PROTOCOL --destination-mode DESTINATION_MODE --artifact-root ROOT_CAPABILITY_REF --bundle-rel BUNDLE_REL`. The command token is first. Independent options may appear in any order exactly once, but canonical rendering and InvocationRootV2 use the frozen order above after semantic parsing. Run has no default family mode. Negative and Replay derive family, mode, and profile from immutable manifests. Old `--artifact-dir`, generic `--mode`, generic `--profile`, aliases, duplicates, conflicts, and command-inapplicable options are Usage.

`ROOT_CAPABILITY_REF` is a nonsemantic presentation-only tagged union: `posix-fd:N`, `windows-handle-slot:N`, or `content-store-capability-slot:N`. Windows accepts an inherited handle-table slot rather than a raw handle value. ContentStore accepts a capability-table slot rather than a credential or locator. The presentation child 24.1.2.1 validates the typed profile/protocol and capability-policy request without effects and records only semantic policy data; physical resolve, acquire, affine narrow, disjointness proof, use, return, and close-once are owned solely by 24.2.2.1, and never logs the slot, descriptor, handle, token, credential, ambient path, or physical store prefix. Missing, invalid, aliased, overlapping, revoked, non-directory, non-container, or insufficient rights fail before family spawn with the exact typed diagnostic. Replay input is read-only and cannot alias or descend from output according to the backend-neutral root-separation proof.

ArtifactDispositionV2 code 1 is `LifecycleOnlyNoBundle`; code 2 remains `DurableBundleRequired`. List carries typed absence. Check runs one fixed built-in preflight manifest and SelfTest one fixed bounded internal manifest under LifecycleOnlyNoBundle. Run, Negative, and Replay require a complete PublicationSelectionV2 that matches protocol, destination mode, logical target, capability profile, and sealed family policy. No command silently infers or defaults a mode, protocol, destination mode, or family selector.

`LifecycleRecordHeaderV2` has exact ordered fields: wire_version=1 u16; record_kind LifecycleRecordKindV2; sequence_ordinal u32; invocation_root InvocationRootV2; run_id RunIdV2; and runner_spec_root RunnerSpecRootV2. Every record starts with this header. Sequence ordinals are contiguous from zero and no record can move between invocations or runs.

`RunStartRecordV2` payload fields are exact: command; optional profile; optional family_mode; budgets_root; optional PublicationSelectionV2; ordered_case_count u32; ordered_case_manifest_set_root; and artifact_disposition. `CaseStartRecordV2` fields are case_ordinal; case_id; CaseManifestRootV2; CaseConformanceSpecRootV2; executable_descriptor_id; and case_budget_root. `FamilyRowRecordV2` is the only extension envelope and has case_ordinal; case_id; row_ordinal; registered_family_row_schema_id; payload_length u64; FamilyRowPayloadRootV2; and canonical bounded payload bytes. Row ordinals are contiguous per case, schemas are exact-set registered, and payloads cannot carry terminals or authority.

`CaseTerminalRecordV2` ordered fields are case_ordinal; case_id; role ExecutedCaseTerminal or SuppressedCaseTerminal; state ProofExitV2; optional RefusedReasonV2; optional ActionableDiagnosticV2; terminal_basis CaseTerminalBasisV2. Executed cases bind evaluator completion only through CaseTerminalBasisV2. Suppressed cases forbid evaluator roots, require NotRun plus `runner.not_run`, and bind one exact NotRunCauseV2. Pass forbids diagnostics. Failed requires `case.conformance_mismatch`. Every other state requires its exact base diagnostic. Options are validated by a closed role/state/reason/diagnostic/basis table.

`StateCountVectorV2` stores one u32 count for every ProofExitV2 code in ascending code order and forbids Usage at run level. `RunSummaryRecordV2` fields are state_counts; executed_case_count; suppressed_case_count; RunOutcomeBasisRootV2; optional ArtifactInventoryRootV2 when a durable inventory exists; lifecycle_record_count; and lifecycle_encoded_bytes. Counts must equal the transcript and checked arithmetic must satisfy exact `3 + sum(2 + family_rows)` feasibility.

`RunTerminalRecordV2` fields are state; optional RefusedReasonV2; optional ActionableDiagnosticV2; RunOutcomeBasisRootV2; run_summary_root; transcript_prefix_root covering records through RunSummary; and artifact_disposition. It never includes BundleManifest, Seal, PublishedBundleReceipt, or a self-covering root and makes no durability claim. `LifecycleDocumentV2` contains exact record_count plus the exact ordered records and is the sole basis for LifecycleLogRootV2 after a successful final write/flush to the bounded staging sink.

Both comparison and effect lanes always evaluate and are retained in CaseRawOutcomeV2. Conformance is exact equality against both root-free nested `ExpectedLaneOutcomeV2` frames after each actual EvaluationContext projects to the sealed EvaluationPrecontext. The command by claim-mode by observed-outcome table is closed: Run DomainConformance manifests require absent fixtures and Match/Match; Negative and designated SelfTest/Check cases may seal exact nested mismatch or evaluation-error frames under their explicit fixture policy; Replay preserves the exact source durable command, CaseConformanceSpecRootV2, fixture roots, claim mode, and expected nested frames rather than forcing Match/Match; Check uses its sealed preflight expectations; ExerciseOnlyNoDomainClaim still yields a normal CaseTerminal but carries no domain or authority claim. Exact conformance, including an actual mismatch or error that exactly matches its nested expectation and precontext, produces Pass. A conformance divergence caused by a wrong Match or Mismatch/detail produces Failed with `case.conformance_mismatch`. A divergent actual EvaluationErrorV2 maps through the exact operational table instead of being disguised as Failed. A negative comparison expectation can never mask an effect mismatch or effect error. Failure before evaluator entry is always operational, never conformance Pass.

The divergent-actual `EvaluationErrorV2` mapping is exact: MissingObservation, UnexpectedObservation, IncompatibleType, UnitDimensionMismatch, and MalformedEffectSnapshot map to Refused/InvalidEvidence/`runner.refused`; DuplicateObservation to Refused/NonCanonicalEvidence/`runner.refused`; ArithmeticOverflow and LimitExceeded to Refused/LimitExceeded/`runner.refused`; UnitUnavailable and UnknownRegistryId to Unsupported/`runner.unsupported`. A complete actual error that exactly equals a sealed nested expected-error frame is conformance Match and therefore does not take this operational branch. The complete divergent actual error frame, context root, and lane remain causal diagnostic data. No wildcard, family override, Failed fallback, or InternalError shortcut exists.

Ordinary executed terminals including Refused, NoData, Stale, EnvironmentInvalid, Blocked, Unsupported, Failed, and Pass do not suppress later manifest slots. Only an accepted Cancelled or TimedOut stop, or a controlled drained InternalError, finalizes the active case and suppresses every later slot through the corresponding NotRunCauseV2. A cooperative stop before the first case suppresses all slots. Profile exclusions are absent rather than NotRun. Forced process death, unproved drain, failed staging write/flush, or non-clean EOF produces no authoritative LifecycleDocument or bundle.

`StopOriginV2` is exact: 1 CallerCancellation, 2 WallBudgetTimeout, 3 ControlledInternalFailure. `StopKeyV2` ordered fields are logical_checkpoint_ordinal u64; optional active_case_ordinal with None ordered before Some; within_case_checkpoint_ordinal u32; origin code; origin_ordinal u32; and typed cause_root. Keys compare lexicographically by those fields, never physical arrival time. Duplicate keys must carry identical causes or fail closed. The smallest accepted key wins.

`DrainEvidenceV2` fields are optional active_case_ordinal; descendant_identity_set_root; resource_lease_set_root; child_stdout_drained_bytes; child_stderr_drained_bytes; completed_finalizer_set_root; descendant_quiescence_root; and resource_return_root. `AcceptedStopEvidenceV2` fields are StopKeyV2; accepted state; observation_checkpoint; stop_window_generation; acceptance_basis_root; and DrainEvidenceRootV2. The option, slot, events, drop observations, and provider state are excluded from every semantic, replay, publication, receipt, conformance, and authority identity. Unit, boundary, property, mutation, API/compile-fail, generated-help, logging, and phase-1 public-constructor E2E cells prove absence/slow/failure cannot change semantic outputs.

37. Phase-1 release-built integration stops at the typed parser/provider/publication handoff and is labeled accordingly. A publication success/failure stub or fake capability may test schema mapping but cannot satisfy a no-mock or downstream publication cell. The mapped CLI/lifecycle implementation child or exact child union owns no scripts/ci file; it contributes immutable exact-set manifest rows and expected roots to the five sole downstream script owners. Missing, extra, duplicate, stale, remapped, or silently skipped contributions fail the final joins.

38. Public error-reachability and ownership tests exercise every one of the ten actual evaluator errors through the real CaseEvaluationKey-bound `PresentedObservationBatchV2` or `PresentedEffectSnapshotV2` admission/evaluation API and then through exact conformance or lifecycle mapping. Independent tables assert fixture/presented/validated root presence, expected-precontext to actual-context projection, requirements/key/registry/manifest/expression binding, both-lane retention, terminal state/reason/diagnostic/basis, and no wildcard. Compile-fail and mutation tests reject direct error/raw/verdict construction, actual error/detail roots inside expectations, lifecycle-subtree-owned evaluator constructors, partial lanes, hostile-byte-to-validated decoding, key/context/root substitution, missing/extra/reordered provenance, and divergent error-to-Failed or InternalError shortcuts. No-mock lifecycle E2E contributions, closed detailed logs, coverage joins, and source closure contain a nonzero row for every match and mapping and every expected refusal with zero unexpected mismatches, while downstream script execution remains owned only by its named script Beads.

39. Evaluator-handoff DAG tests independently reconstruct CaseEvaluationKey, both presented roots, both optional validated roots, both EvaluationPrecontexts, both actual EvaluationContexts, every nested expected frame, CaseConformanceSpecRootV2, CaseManifestRootV2, CaseRawOutcomeRootV2, verdict, and CaseTerminalBasisV2. They reject every reverse/self edge, duplicated registry identity outside the key, fixture/runtime substitution, actual-root expectation, stale or cross-manifest key, and one-field projection disagreement. No-mock E2E, mutation, compile-fail, deterministic detailed-log, coverage, and source-closure evidence exact-join every positive and expected-refusal ID once with typed Unsupported and zero unexpected mismatches.

40. NATIVE-ARGV CONTRIBUTION CONTRACT. The mapped CLI/lifecycle implementation child or exact child union freezes POSIX-byte and raw-Windows-UTF-16-code-unit stable cells, independent lexical expectations, exact argument ordinal/offset diagnostics, budgets, redaction/log schema, and source roots for parser owner frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.2.1.1 and release-harness owner frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.4.1.4. It does not launch a native process or decode hostile native bytes. Rows cover ASCII control tokens, canonical UTF-8 values, empty elements, every quote/backslash boundary, independent option permutations, embedded or hidden NUL where representable, non-UTF8 POSIX bytes, unpaired surrogates, locale/code-page variation, lossy-replacement mutants, argument ordinal/offset diagnostics, redaction, and zero effects on Usage.

41. SIGNAL-INGRESS MODEL AND CONTRIBUTION CONTRACT. In-process model tests cover logical first, duplicate, and escalated interrupt requests and stop-window effects. Immutable native rows consume neutral contracts from frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.4.1.2.1; native Linux, Windows, and macOS handler/provider cells are owned by frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.4.1.2.2-.4; controller resource-recovery and transport/publication semantics by frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.4.1.3; and canonical release execution and retry by frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.4.1.4; the mapped CLI/lifecycle implementation child or exact child union executes no handler or process. The model preserves the permitted atomic wake, exact Cancelled/18 boundary, no fabricated roots after escalation/forced death, close/recovery obligations, and detailed redacted logical logs.

42. Wall-deadline tests cover every registered monotonic provider/suspend policy, zero/one/exact/one-over grants and checked deadline arithmetic, clock resolution, observation-bound/overshoot cells, load and scheduling permutations, deadline versus logical-work races, restart/replay, and no raw timestamp logging. Model/property tests prove deterministic stop selection for an identical accepted request set while explicit no-claim tests forbid cross-run timeout-checkpoint/root bit-stability. Help, version, CONTRACT, E2E logs, coverage, and source closure direct reproducible users to logical-work limits.

43. COMPLETE-OR-DETECTABLY-TRUNCATED SEMANTIC MODEL AND CONTRIBUTION CONTRACT. The mapped CLI/lifecycle implementation child or exact child union independently reconstructs semantic result states and freezes short-write, truncation, retry, recovery, wrong-root/kind, trailing/concatenated-frame, and stderr expectations. Actual payload codecs, framing, stream writes, flush/close, broken-reader behavior, process exit, and process E2E belong to frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.2.1.3, frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.4.1.3, and frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.4.1.4. Unit, model, mutation, compile-fail, immutable release-built no-mock E2E contributions, deterministic detailed logs, exact coverage joins, and source closure retain semantic and transport states separately with nonzero applicable positive and adversarial corpora and zero unexpected mismatches, execution failures, or unexplained skips.

44. Launch-UX handoff tests generate help/completion/diagnostics from the exact bootstrap support table; cover direct POSIX descriptors, Windows handle slots, ContentStore slots, progress slots, missing/stale/wrong-kind table entries, launcher unavailable, target mismatch, and symbolic examples; and prove no slot/payload/handle/credential/locator enters semantic identity or logs. Compile/dependency tests keep the concrete launch ABI solely in 24.2.2.1 while the phase-1 public harness stops at the typed request.

45. CHILD-UNION RESULT-PARTITION CLOSE GATE. Every coverage manifest and owned or contributed E2E suite reports distinct exact ID sets and counts for eligible and matched positives; eligible and matched expected refusals; eligible and matched expected failures; eligible and matched mutations; typed Unsupported cells with exact matched reasons; typed inapplicable cells with exact matched registered reasons; unexpected mismatches; execution failures; and unexplained skips. Green requires every eligible stable ID exactly once, nonzero applicable positive and adversarial corpora, equality within each eligible/matched subpartition, exact reason equality, and zero unexpected mismatches, execution failures, and unexplained skips. Expected failures never count as positive implementation agreement, mutations never collapse into refusals, and contribution-only rows cannot claim the downstream owner executed them.

46. CHILD-UNION USER-FACING REPAIR SAFETY GATE. Every user-visible Refused or Unsupported outcome, every matched or divergent Negative path, and every unexpected divergence owned or contributed by the mapped CLI/lifecycle implementation child carries one bounded deterministic ActionableDiagnosticV2 with registered code, precise redacted typed expected/observed values, owning component, retryability, exact prerequisites, no-claim scope, and one or more uniquely ranked RepairActionV2 values. Repairs are declarative and non-executable: they cannot contain or invoke commands, callbacks, scripts, credentials, raw capability/resource/handle/provider payloads, physical paths/locators, or automatic mutations. Literal, unit, boundary, property/model, mutation, API/compile-fail, release-built no-mock E2E or immutable contribution, deterministic detailed-log/redaction, coverage, and source-closure tests exercise exact and one-over size/count/rank limits, stable tie-breaking, owner/prerequisite/no-claim accuracy, secret exclusion, and expected-Negative Pass semantics.

47. GLOBAL REALITY-CHECK CLOSE-MANIFEST RECONCILIATION (CONTROLLING). Earlier `eligible`/`passed`/`failed` shorthand and any single collapsed `matched expected refusals` counter are compatibility-only and cannot close any mapped CLI/lifecycle implementation child. Each mapped CLI/lifecycle implementation child must expose one result-free, source-authoritative, full-set-only close manifest that exact-sets every stable test and E2E cell into all nine preserved category groups: literal/unit/boundary; property/metamorphic; state/typestate/model/race; mutation/fuzz; API/compile-fail/trait; fault/resource/cancellation; release-built no-mock E2E or immutable E2E contribution; detailed deterministic logging/redaction; and source closure. Each applicable category and each applicable slash-separated facet has a separately nonzero corpus. A genuinely inapplicable facet requires a registered typed reason with stable code/name, exact owner, execution scope, prerequisite, and no-claim text; it cannot hide an eligible cell.

Result accounting retains distinct counters and exact ID sets for: eligible positives and matched positives; eligible expected refusals and matched expected refusals; eligible expected failures and matched expected failures; eligible mutations and matched mutations; typed Unsupported cells with exact matched reasons; typed inapplicable cells with exact matched registered reasons; unexpected mismatches; execution failures; and unexplained skips. It also reports checked aggregate adversarial totals as the sums of the three adversarial subpartitions without replacing them. Green requires each matched subpartition to equal its own eligible subpartition, every eligible stable ID exactly once in canonical order, nonzero applicable positive and adversarial corpora, exact Unsupported/inapplicable reason equality, and zero unexpected mismatches, execution failures, and unexplained skips. An expected failure is never an execution failure, a mutation is never relabeled as a refusal, and an empty/subset selection can never be green. Missing, extra, duplicate, reordered, stale, reclassified, wrong-reason, or wrong-scope manifest/result rows refuse structurally.

Where the mapped CLI/lifecycle implementation child owns execution, comprehensive unit/integration/property/model/race/fault/mutation/API tests and the named E2E script run release-built with no mocks. Where execution belongs downstream, that mapped CLI/lifecycle implementation child instead emits immutable stable rows binding independent literal expectations/oracles, semantic inputs, explicit time/memory/work/process/artifact/log budgets, schema and log-schema roots, source/build roots, exact downstream owner and script, and no-claim scope; it cannot report that downstream execution passed. E2E tests cover happy, boundary, expected-refusal, expected-failure, mutation, Unsupported, inapplicable, cancellation/drain, resource-return, and hidden-skip cases with deterministic stable IDs and exact first divergence.

Canonical bounded logs retain stable cell/category/facet IDs; semantic-input, source, build, schema, oracle, budget, manifest, and execution roots; ordered stage observations and terminal stage; expected/observed classification; first-divergence ID/root; resource and drain outcomes; exact result partitions; ranked non-executable repair manifest; no-claim scope; and safe relative retained-artifact references. They reject or type-redact secrets, credentials, environment values, live capabilities, raw resources/handles, absolute or physical paths, PIDs, wall clock, scheduler noise, and bulk payloads. Rejection diagnostics retain only a stable redacted data class and must not echo the sentinel through `observed`, Display, Debug, canonical bytes, logs, or reproduction text. Logging tests cover zero/one/exact/one-over limits, checked overflow, missing/extra/duplicate/reordered/truncated events, wrong roots/counts/reasons, redaction for every forbidden class, and deterministic replay.

Every user-visible Refused, Unsupported, divergent Negative, expected failure, and unexpected mismatch carries one bounded deterministic actionable diagnostic with registered code, precise redacted typed expected/observed values, owner, retryability, exact prerequisites, no-claim scope, and uniquely ranked declarative repairs. Repairs cannot contain or invoke commands, callbacks, scripts, credentials, raw capabilities/resources/handles/provider payloads, physical paths/locators, or automatic mutations. Source closure exact-sets all implementation, contract/rustdoc, schema/domain/owner tables, independent oracles, fixtures, E2E manifests/scripts or contribution rows, log schemas, dependencies/features, and build configuration on one compatible stable snapshot. Closeout reports focused proof, release-built E2E or contribution proof, source closure, DSR, and any downstream/scientific/authority proof separately and never promotes one into another.

48. DECOMPOSED CLI/LIFECYCLE ROLLUP GATE (CONTROLLING). The frozen ordered direct-child set is exactly frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.1.2.1 (abstract grammar, CLI-to-InvocationBasisV2 projection and checked identity consumption, catalog UX, and capability presentation), frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.1.2.2 (stop/drain evidence, terminal windows, interrupts, and deadlines), frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.1.2.3 (lifecycle writer, evaluator-terminal mapping, and deterministic aggregation), and frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.1.2.4 (semantic results, transport handoff, exit model, and release proof). All four must be closed on one compatible stable snapshot with exact terminal close-manifest, source/build/schema/owner/oracle/log roots, distinct result partitions, exact E2E execution or contribution scope, and safe relative evidence references. Missing, extra, duplicate, reordered, reopened, blocked, stale, mixed-snapshot, overlapping-owner, wrong-scope, or root-mismatched children refuse. The child union must preserve every original grammar, UX, lifecycle, terminal, stop/drain, aggregation, semantic-result, transport-handoff, logging/redaction, source-closure, native-ingress, and no-claim requirement exactly once. No child close, aggregate count, inherited parent prose, receipt, or proof root can substitute for another child. This rollup may claim only exact-set Runner CLI/lifecycle/result-interface conformance; publication durability, process containment, canonical controller execution, replay/migration, family science, admission, and authority remain separately owned and separately reported.

49. EXACT CHILD OWNERSHIP MAP (CONTROLLING). CLI/lifecycle ownership is fixed: 24.1.2.1 owns abstract grammar, canonical rendering, CLI-to-InvocationBasisV2 semantic projection, checked consumption of identity constructors solely owned by 24.1.1.2, catalog/help/version UX, typed capability presentation, and immutable native-ingress contributions; .1.2.2 owns stop/drain evidence, terminal windows, signal/deadline models, and related contributions; .1.2.3 owns lifecycle schemas/writer, evaluator-to-terminal mapping, continuation, aggregation, and lifecycle roots; .1.2.4 owns semantic command-result envelopes, complete transport handoff model, native exit mapping, release proof, and aggregate downstream contributions. Physical capability acquire/narrow/use/return/close remains 24.2.2.1. Parent 24.1.2 owns only the four-child exact-set join. Every preserved semantic/test requirement is projected to that exact child owner or child union; no inherited parent-ownership wording is authoritative. It never grants implementation, constructor, test-cell, E2E-execution, contribution-row, source-closure, native-resource, scientific, admission, or authority ownership to this rollup. The rollup closes only from the frozen exact child set and cannot substitute its status or prose for any child close manifest.

ROLLUP FIVE-EXPLICITS AND LOG-COMPLETENESS JOIN (CONTROLLING). This rollup exact-set joins every direct child Five-Explicits root and complete-log root on the same source/build snapshot. Missing, extra, duplicate, stale, mixed, unit-ambiguous, seedless-without-typed-reason, over-budget, capability-incomplete, partially logged, silently truncated, or terminal-less child evidence refuses. Aggregate counts or a parent budget cannot replace any child cell exact explicit values or complete terminal log.

SEMANTIC SEED PROPAGATION AND PROOF JOIN (CONTROLLING). This bead does not invent a second seed type or hidden default. Every owned schema, fixture, command, execution, artifact, replay, verifier, receipt, log, source-closure, E2E row, or rollup join that carries an invocation or case preserves the exact upstream `InvocationSeedSelectionRootV2`, `CaseSeedPolicyV2`, and applicable `CaseExecutionSeedRootV2` or registered `NoRandomness` absence through typed parent bindings. Unit/property/model/race/mutation/API/compile-fail/release-E2E-or-contribution/log/source-closure proof covers omission, substitution, wrong case/run, stale/mixed snapshot, override, ambient randomness, and count-only evidence. Test-harness seeds remain separately typed Five-Explicit data and cannot substitute for the semantic workload seed. Seed evidence establishes reproducibility only and never scientific, publication, verification, or admission authority.

CANONICAL RUN SEED OPERAND PROPAGATION (CONTROLLING). Every canonical Runner Run command form includes exactly one --seed operand using none or seed-256 followed by the canonical 32-byte lowercase-hex material form defined by .24.1.1.1; no default exists. List, Check, SelfTest, Negative, and Replay reject caller seed operands and bind their sealed or source-preserved selection. Help, completion, canonical argv, native parsing, Usage precedence, deterministic logs, reproduction records, release E2E, and source closure consume the exact .24.1.2.1 grammar. This requirement applies to the canonical Runner command only and does not add a seed operand to separate artifact-verifier driver commands.

ROLLUP E2E ROUTE RESOLUTION JOIN (CONTROLLING). This rollup exact-set joins every direct child execution/contribution classification and proves a one-to-one mapping from each contribution row to one literal downstream owner, driver, script/native route, and immutable manifest. Every execution owner exact-set consumes its rows once and retains release identity, complete logs, source closure, result partitions, and relative artifacts. Missing, ambiguous, duplicate, stale, remapped, wrong-owner/script, unexecuted, multiply executed, hidden-skip, contribution-only-Pass, or focused-proof substitution refuses.

AC58 DESCENDANT SCHEMA-IMPACT JOIN (CONTROLLING ROLLUP). This rollup owns no implementation schema and may mint no leaf evidence. It consumes the exact SchemaImpactManifestV1 from every recursively contained implementation leaf on one compatible source snapshot and constructs a deterministic descendant join ordered by stable leaf ID, then stable schema ID. The join records exact descendant and schema-row counts plus exact counts for NewV1NoPredecessor, UnchangedV1, MigratedV1ToV2, DecodeOnlyLegacyV1, RetiredV1, and InapplicableNoCanonicalFrame; every count is checked against the literal descendant inventory rather than inferred from status, labels, estimates, source ordinals, or child aggregate totals. It refuses a missing, extra, duplicate, reordered, stale, owner-remapped, cross-rollup, unknown-disposition, incompatible-snapshot, V1/V2-substituted, partial-migration, or multiply aggregated leaf/schema row, and refuses any authoritative V2 close claim while a required descendant is absent or still names an incompatible authoritative V1 parent.

Comprehensive rollup tests cover exact-empty where structurally legal, one descendant, the exact live maximum, one-over injected input, all six dispositions, nested-rollup associativity without double counting, order/shard/schedule/resume invariance, every missing/extra/duplicate/reorder and mixed-snapshot mutation, first explicit divergence, bounded deterministic step-prefixed logging and redaction, structured reproduction, overflow terminal, coverage counters, and exact source closure. A source-closed release-built E2E join consumes only already produced leaf evidence and proves aggregation fidelity; it does not execute descendants, replace their unit/property/model/mutation/API/fault/E2E/log/source-closure gates, or promote focused, DSR, downstream, durability, scientific, or authority proof. CONTRACT/rustdoc and the final rollup report list every descendant schema-impact manifest and all separate proof states.

LIVE ROLLUP TOPOLOGY, SCHEDULING, AND OPERABILITY 2026-07-29 (FINAL CONTROLLING). This issue is a `runner-v2-rollup` epic. Its exact direct hierarchy children are: `frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.1.2.1`, `frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.1.2.2`, `frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.1.2.3`, `frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.1.2.4`. Its current recursive subtree contains exactly 5 Beads: 4 implementation tasks totaling 2,280 minutes and 1 rollup epics totaling 120 minutes, for 2,400 minutes. The 4 internal `parent-child` relations are closure hierarchy only; no reciprocal parent-depends-on-child `blocks` edge is permitted. This rollup's own 120-minute estimate covers only its explicitly named aggregate, integration, join, driver, rerun, source-closure, or close-review work and is not duplicated in child estimates. Functional implementation order remains solely in explicit `blocks` edges among owning tasks. While `br epic status` reports `eligible_for_close=false`, this rollup MUST have status `blocked`, never `open` or `in_progress`; when eligibility becomes true, transition it to `open` or `in_progress` only for its scoped closeout, then close it. The canonical executable-work query is `br ready --epic frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24 --type task`. `bv` robot output is diagnostic only; any surfaced rollup is not executable implementation work. Close this rollup only after every exact child-root, integration, test/E2E, detailed-log/redaction, reproduction, source-closure, proof-state, authority, and no-claim gate in this Bead passes. This clause supersedes every earlier numeric node/estimate/subtotal claim and every earlier phrase treating hierarchy children as reciprocal `blocks` dependencies or this epic as an implementation task. It removes no scope, feature, functionality, test, E2E script/contribution, logging, reproduction, source, route, capability, durability, scientific, admission, authority, or no-claim obligation.

ROLLUP CLOSEOUT DISCOVERABILITY AND MANUAL-EVIDENCE GATE 2026-07-29 (FINAL CONTROLLING). `br ready --epic frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24 --type task --json --limit 0` is the canonical implementation-task query; `bv` robot output is dependency/impact diagnosis, not executable status. When `br epic status --eligible-only --json` first reports this epic eligible because all direct children are closed, the epic is not automatically complete. Its deterministic closeout view MUST expose any remaining integration/route/join/rerun/review work; exact route ID where applicable; immutable command/driver/manifest descriptor; compatible source/build/schema roots; unresolved stable cells and proof states; expected result partitions; retained relative artifact root; retryability; no-claim scope; and uniquely ranked non-executable repairs. A route-owning or integration-owning epic must be claimed and its own acceptance evidence completed before explicit close; task-only queries must not make that work disappear, and automatic bulk epic closure cannot substitute for it.

The transition from blocked -> eligible closeout -> in-progress closeout -> explicitly closed is deterministic and logged. Literal/unit, state/model/race, mutation, API/compile-fail, fault/cancellation, integrated E2E or child-evidence replay, detailed logging/redaction, reproduction, exact coverage, and source-closure tests cover premature surfacing, hidden remaining route work, missing/extra/duplicate child roots, stale eligibility, already-complete reruns, failed closeout and safe retry, mixed snapshots, bulk-close substitution, and exact final proof-state separation. Pure review rollups use a typed no-route closeout; no epic may invent or infer an unnamed route merely to become discoverable.

ACCESSIBLE OPERATOR-EXPERIENCE AND HUMAN/MACHINE E2E JOIN 2026-07-29 (FINAL CONTROLLING). This rollup exact-set joins the shell-independent grammar/presentation contribution from `.24.1.2.1`, generated Bash/Zsh/Fish/PowerShell completion/help artifacts and release-test contribution from `.24.1.3.2.2`, canonical release-built operator journey from `.24.4.1.4`, and final Runner-to-rjoq recovery/admission journey from `.24.5.3.2` as they become applicable in this phase. Static contribution, generated-artifact proof, canonical Runner execution, and final admission execution remain distinct statuses; a later result cannot repair a missing earlier contract, and a contribution cannot claim observed execution.

Closeout separately reports novice and expert machine journeys; POSIX and direct native-Windows coverage; TTY/non-TTY, `TERM=dumb`, `NO_COLOR`, optional color, zero/narrow/wide widths, C/UTF-8 locale, Unicode/combining/CJK/emoji/control handling, ASCII fallback, plain-text/screen-reader order, no mandatory animation/prompt, progress sink variants, broken pipe, cancellation, channel/exit behavior, attempt/telemetry correlation, bounded logs/reproduction, retained relative artifacts, and semantic-root invariance. Missing/extra/duplicate/remapped cells, color/glyph/timing-only status, human/machine channel contamination, presentation-driven semantics, hidden prompt/skip, inaccessible diagnostics, unsafe echo, silent truncation, or mixed source/build snapshot refuses. Rollup logs retain exact owner/proof-state/first-divergence and ranked non-executable repairs without duplicating child output.
notes:
Scheduling truth: children 540 + 480 + 720 + 540 minutes plus this 120-minute rollup = the original 2,400 minutes exactly. Grammar and stop/drain can proceed in parallel; lifecycle integration consumes both; semantic-result/transport handoff consumes the integrated lifecycle. Hostile byte decoding, capability/bootstrap acquisition, publication, process containment, migration/replay, science, admission, and authority remain with their named downstream owners. Every former aggregate criterion remains controlling through an exact child-owned cell.

FINAL LIVE RECONCILIATION 2026-07-29. The authoritative acceptance clause records 5 subtree Beads, 4 implementation tasks at 2,280 minutes, 1 rollup epics at 120 minutes, and 2,400 total minutes, with the exact direct hierarchy-child set and blocked-until-eligible rollup status rule. Earlier accounting, task/rollup classification, reciprocal child-block wording, and zero-minute integration claims are superseded; all functional, test/E2E, logging, reproduction, source-closure, route, authority, and no-claim obligations remain intact.

title: Runner V2 abstract CLI grammar, invocation-basis projection, catalog UX, and capability presentation
description:
Own the six-command abstract grammar, canonical rendering, protocol, destination, and mode tokens, typed capability-reference lexical forms, publication-selection requests, catalog UX, CLI-to-InvocationBasisV2 semantic projection, checked consumption of InvocationRootV2 and RunIdV2 constructors, identity-noninterference validation, List, help and version, optional nonsemantic progress requests, and launch-support presentation. Child frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.1.1.2 remains the sole schema, descriptor, and constructor owner for InvocationBasisV2, InvocationRootV2, and RunIdV2; this child neither redeclares nor mints those identities. This child owns no hostile native decoding, capability acquisition, resource effects, process, publication, transport, replay execution, or authority.

## Acceptance Criteria

The dedicated Acceptance Criteria field is the authoritative close gate. Every numbered criterion must pass, including the controlling nine-facet literal/unit/boundary, property/metamorphic, state/model/race, mutation/fuzz, API/compile-fail/trait, fault/resource/cancellation, release-built no-mock E2E or immutable E2E-contribution, deterministic detailed-logging/redaction, and source-closure manifest; the four explicit eligible/matched result partitions; exact Unsupported/inapplicable reasons; and zero unexpected mismatches, execution failures, or unexplained skips on one compatible source/build/proof snapshot.
design: Preserve the command-first rule, no defaults or aliases, canonical independent-option ordering, exact legacy-option refusals, Negative and Replay derived selections, complete five-explicit inputs, and exclusion of physical slot values from semantic identity. Help is generated from the grammar; RunnerVersionDocumentV1 has exactly fourteen ordered fields and bounded LF framing. Progress is observation-only and cannot change semantic roots. Capability tokens are lexical typed references only. Freeze immutable native-argv contribution rows for parser owner frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.2.1.1 and canonical harness owner frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.4.1.4.
acceptance_criteria:
1. OWNERSHIP AND EXACT CONTRACT. Own the six-command abstract grammar, canonical rendering, protocol, destination, and mode tokens, typed capability-reference lexical forms, publication-selection requests, catalog UX, CLI-to-InvocationBasisV2 semantic projection, checked consumption of InvocationRootV2 and RunIdV2 constructors, identity-noninterference validation, List, help and version, optional nonsemantic progress requests, and launch-support presentation. Child frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.1.1.2 remains the sole schema, descriptor, and constructor owner for InvocationBasisV2, InvocationRootV2, and RunIdV2; this child neither redeclares nor mints those identities. This child owns no hostile native decoding, capability acquisition, resource effects, process, publication, transport, replay execution, or authority. Ownership is singular and every inherited parent requirement maps to a stable child-prefixed cell. Missing, duplicate, shadow, stale, mixed-snapshot, reverse-edge, generic-root, physical-effect overclaim, or authority widening refuses. Primary ownership maps parent criteria 1–3, 18, 23, 32, 35–36, 40, and 44 plus grammar and presentation portions of criterion 34.

2. COMPREHENSIVE LITERAL, UNIT, AND BOUNDARY PROOF. Tests exhaust the complete grammar compatibility matrix, duplicates, conflicts, missing and extra values, every capability tag and numeric boundary, platform availability, canonical rendering and roundtrip, catalog drift, invocation identity under option permutations and slot substitution, fourteen version fields, generated help, progress noninterference, redaction, and a release-built no-mock public semantic-parser journey. Native contribution rows cover POSIX bytes, raw Windows UTF-16 code units, quotes and backslashes, empty arguments, hidden NUL, non-UTF8 bytes, unpaired surrogates, locale variation, exact offsets, and zero effects on Usage.

3. PROPERTY, MODEL, RACE, FAULT, AND MUTATION PROOF. Property and metamorphic tests cover every declared semantic invariance and root-movement rule. State and typestate models cover legal transitions and bounded relevant interleavings. Fault, resource, cancellation, size, count, and checked-overflow tests cover zero, one, exact, and one-over limits. Mutation and fuzz corpora alter every owned discriminant, field, presence bit, ordinal, edge, root, bound, owner, budget, stage, diagnostic, log, repair, and no-claim value and require the exact first refusal or divergence.

4. API AND COMPILE-FAIL PROOF. Public API, trait, doctest, dependency-DAG, and compile-fail tests reject public literals, Default or bypass construction, mutable thaw or reopen, callbacks or scripts, arbitrary code-bearing values, generic digest substitution, forbidden reverse dependencies, ambient parsing or lookup, raw capabilities and resources, physical process effects, result fabrication, and conversion to durability, scientific, certificate, admission, or authority.

5. OWNED E2E OR IMMUTABLE CONTRIBUTION PROOF. Every locally owned path runs release-built through real public APIs with no mocks and exact retained execution roots. Native, physical, publication, transport, or downstream script behavior not owned here appears only as immutable stable contribution rows binding exact owner and script, independent expectations and oracles, semantic inputs, explicit budgets, schema, log, source, and build roots, expected disposition, and no-claim scope. Contribution rows cannot claim downstream execution. Positive, boundary, expected-refusal, expected-failure, mutation, Unsupported, inapplicable, cancellation, drain, resource-return, and hidden-skip cells are explicit where applicable.

6. DETERMINISTIC LOGGING, REDACTION, AND REPAIRS. Bounded canonical logs retain stable IDs, semantic, schema, source, build, oracle, budget, manifest, and execution roots, ordered stages and terminal stage, expected and observed classifications, first divergence, exact partitions, drain and resource outcomes, no-claim scope, ranked non-executable repairs, and safe relative evidence references. Every owned schema, fixture, command, execution, artifact, replay, verifier, receipt, log, source-closure, E2E row, or rollup join that carries an invocation or case preserves the exact upstream `InvocationSeedSelectionRootV2`, `CaseSeedPolicyV2`, and applicable `CaseExecutionSeedRootV2` or registered `NoRandomness` absence through typed parent bindings. Unit/property/model/race/mutation/API/compile-fail/release-E2E-or-contribution/log/source-closure proof covers omission, substitution, wrong case/run, stale/mixed snapshot, override, ambient randomness, and count-only evidence. Test-harness seeds remain separately typed Five-Explicit data and cannot substitute for the semantic workload seed. Seed evidence establishes reproducibility only and never scientific, publication, verification, or admission authority.

PHASE-1 NAMED E2E PROOF JOIN (CONTROLLING). The rollup exact-set joins the governance route and Phase-1 contract route manifests, source/build roots, literal invocation records, complete log roots, retained relative artifacts, and distinct focused, constellation, DSR-quality, DSR-build, native-E2E, contribution, scientific, and authority statuses. Missing, duplicate, stale, mixed-build, unnamed, placeholder, filtered, debug, PATH-resolved, or fake-capability routes refuse.

ROLLUP E2E ROUTE RESOLUTION JOIN (CONTROLLING). This rollup exact-set joins every direct child execution/contribution classification and proves a one-to-one mapping from each contribution row to one literal downstream owner, driver, script/native route, and immutable manifest. Every execution owner exact-set consumes its rows once and retains release identity, complete logs, source closure, result partitions, and relative artifacts. Missing, ambiguous, duplicate, stale, remapped, wrong-owner/script, unexecuted, multiply executed, hidden-skip, contribution-only-Pass, or focused-proof substitution refuses.

AC58 DESCENDANT SCHEMA-IMPACT JOIN (CONTROLLING ROLLUP). This rollup owns no implementation schema and may mint no leaf evidence. It consumes the exact SchemaImpactManifestV1 from every recursively contained implementation leaf on one compatible source snapshot and constructs a deterministic descendant join ordered by stable leaf ID, then stable schema ID. The join records exact descendant and schema-row counts plus exact counts for NewV1NoPredecessor, UnchangedV1, MigratedV1ToV2, DecodeOnlyLegacyV1, RetiredV1, and InapplicableNoCanonicalFrame; every count is checked against the literal descendant inventory rather than inferred from status, labels, estimates, source ordinals, or child aggregate totals. It refuses a missing, extra, duplicate, reordered, stale, owner-remapped, cross-rollup, unknown-disposition, incompatible-snapshot, V1/V2-substituted, partial-migration, or multiply aggregated leaf/schema row, and refuses any authoritative V2 close claim while a required descendant is absent or still names an incompatible authoritative V1 parent.

Comprehensive rollup tests cover exact-empty where structurally legal, one descendant, the exact live maximum, one-over injected input, all six dispositions, nested-rollup associativity without double counting, order/shard/schedule/resume invariance, every missing/extra/duplicate/reorder and mixed-snapshot mutation, first explicit divergence, bounded deterministic step-prefixed logging and redaction, structured reproduction, overflow terminal, coverage counters, and exact source closure. A source-closed release-built E2E join consumes only already produced leaf evidence and proves aggregation fidelity; it does not execute descendants, replace their unit/property/model/mutation/API/fault/E2E/log/source-closure gates, or promote focused, DSR, downstream, durability, scientific, or authority proof. CONTRACT/rustdoc and the final rollup report list every descendant schema-impact manifest and all separate proof states.

LIVE ROLLUP TOPOLOGY, SCHEDULING, AND OPERABILITY 2026-07-29 (FINAL CONTROLLING). This issue is a `runner-v2-rollup` epic. Its exact direct hierarchy children are: `frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.1.3.1`, `frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.1.3.2`. Its current recursive subtree contains exactly 7 Beads: 5 implementation tasks totaling 2,580 minutes and 2 rollup epics totaling 210 minutes, for 2,790 minutes. The 6 internal `parent-child` relations are closure hierarchy only; no reciprocal parent-depends-on-child `blocks` edge is permitted. This rollup's own 90-minute estimate covers only its explicitly named aggregate, integration, join, driver, rerun, source-closure, or close-review work and is not duplicated in child estimates. Functional implementation order remains solely in explicit `blocks` edges among owning tasks. While `br epic status` reports `eligible_for_close=false`, this rollup MUST have status `blocked`, never `open` or `in_progress`; when eligibility becomes true, transition it to `open` or `in_progress` only for its scoped closeout, then close it. The canonical executable-work query is `br ready --epic frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24 --type task`. `bv` robot output is diagnostic only; any surfaced rollup is not executable implementation work. Close this rollup only after every exact child-root, integration, test/E2E, detailed-log/redaction, reproduction, source-closure, proof-state, authority, and no-claim gate in this Bead passes. This clause supersedes every earlier numeric node/estimate/subtotal claim and every earlier phrase treating hierarchy children as reciprocal `blocks` dependencies or this epic as an implementation task. It removes no scope, feature, functionality, test, E2E script/contribution, logging, reproduction, source, route, capability, durability, scientific, admission, authority, or no-claim obligation.

ROLLUP CLOSEOUT DISCOVERABILITY AND MANUAL-EVIDENCE GATE 2026-07-29 (FINAL CONTROLLING). `br ready --epic frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24 --type task --json --limit 0` is the canonical implementation-task query; `bv` robot output is dependency/impact diagnosis, not executable status.
