title: Runner V2 TOOL dependency policy, contracts, docs, and generated workspace gates
description:
Implement the early, parallelizable governance half of the Runner V2 TOOL integration: dependency/layer isolation, feature-route denial, contract/source/claims/docs coverage, live generated workspace counts, and repo-gate wiring. This leaf begins once the base publish-false crate scaffold exists and deliberately does not register later lifecycle or cross-module schema roots.

The dedicated Acceptance Criteria field is the canonical close gate. This leaf must retain comprehensive unit, boundary, property/metamorphic, mutation, compile-fail, dependency-route, release-built no-mock governance E2E, DSR-integration, and deterministic-logging evidence; a clean local Cargo check or an edited documentation count alone cannot close it.

## Acceptance Criteria

The dedicated Acceptance Criteria field is the canonical complete close gate. It preserves the domain-specific gate and the common nine-group unit/property/model/race/mutation/API/fault/E2E-or-contribution/logging/source-closure protocol; no description shorthand, checkpoint, parent status, aggregate count, or partial proof can replace it.
design:
This leaf governs `fs-evidence-runner` as a dedicated `publish = false` TOOL-layer crate. The minimal workspace-member and lock rows required for focused schema tests remain owned by 24.1.1.1; this leaf verifies those rows and owns the broader policy, contract, inventory, documentation, generated-count, and repo-gate consequences. It implements no runner schema type, lifecycle writer, parser, publisher, process controller, migration engine, verifier, family fixture, scientific checker, or admission service.

The dependency policy inspects normal, build, dev, target-specific, optional, renamed, feature-activated, proc-macro/build-helper, generated, and transitive routes. Product runtime/build reachability to the TOOL crate is forbidden. Explicit dev-only edges and out-of-process development-tool invocation are allowed. Empty discovery, unknown edge categories, target/feature ambiguity, generated metadata disagreement, or hidden transitive reachability fails closed with the complete route, owner, prerequisites, no-claim scope, and ranked repairs.

The crate contract freezes purpose/layer, safe-Rust boundary, dependency policy, deterministic behavior, cancellation applicability, public schema scope, API-generation-2/wire-V1 no-predecessor policy, feature policy, conformance-test classes, source/build closure, artifact/log retention, and explicit no-scientific/no-admission authority. Outbound direct normal dependencies have one closed eventual allowlist and owner table: `fs-blake3` for canonical hashing/nominal identity in phase 1; `asupersync` for explicit Cx, cancellation, drain, and contained-process runtime work added by phase 2; and `fsqlite` with exactly feature `async-api` for the persistent capability-scoped ContentStore provider added by phase 2. The final resolved graph must use the pinned constellation sources and one unified asupersync identity. A phase may import only its assigned dependency surface; an allowed package name is not blanket API authority. Inbound product runtime/build reachability remains forbidden. Promotion/admission imports, reexports, generic conversions, or authority constructors are forbidden.

The crate is included exactly once in contract coverage, source/SPDX inventory, claim/no-claim inventory, documentation truth, crate atlas, TOOL layer, workspace membership, Cargo.lock provenance, and every live-derived workspace/crate/layer/tool count. Generated facts come from registered sources and live workspace metadata, never hand-edited optimistic totals. Unrelated counts cannot be changed merely to accommodate this crate.

Repo-gate integration supplies focused dependency/layer/contract/source/claims/docs/count commands and the configured DSR quality lane. Cargo-independent constellation preflight runs before source blame when applicable. Focused proof, DSR-wide proof, constellation status, platform proof, and later schema/durability/admission proof remain separate statuses with exact command, result, log, and artifact paths.

Governance diagnostics and logs are bounded canonical data. They retain logical sequence, source/build/toolchain/constellation roots, discovered package/edge/feature inventories, generated input/output roots, exact set/count comparisons, policy stage, owner, prerequisites, no-claim, repairs, test class/count, and relative artifacts. They exclude absolute host paths, credentials, capability slots, PIDs, wall-clock values, scheduler noise, and secrets. Reproduction templates use symbolic workspace/source placeholders and exact semantic arguments, never live sensitive selectors.

Schema-policy and generated-fact validation are explicit responsibilities of this governance leaf. It verifies the API-generation-2/wire-V1/no-predecessor policy, validates owner/domain/source declarations supplied to the generated registry, and extends product-boundary scanning to `fs-evidence-runner` while preserving TOOL classification. It does not create, mutate, or exact-set register `RunnerPhase1SchemaOwnershipRegistryV2` rows; frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.1.3.2 is the sole registry and generator owner and consumes the policy constraints and governance root from this leaf.

## Live-source authority clarification

This leaf, not the pure base-schema crate, owns ambient repository discovery and derives the current source/build-input closure from the live tree, lockfile, constellation pins, toolchain/configuration, generated inputs, and dependency routes. It exact-joins external Cargo/doctest/compile-fail/scanner outputs by stable coverage ID and retains actual evidence/log paths. Base compile-time closure and caller-presented context roots are inputs to comparison only and can never be upgraded into live-tree proof.

## Final controlling schema-policy ratchets for evaluator and artifacts

Workspace schema policy exact-set registers the fourteen final evaluator/conformance nominal root descriptors and, inside the enclosing evaluator/conformance schema descriptor, the four root-free nested member schemas `CaseEvaluationKeyV2`, `EvaluationPrecontextV2`, `ExpectedMismatchFrameV2`, and `ExpectedEvaluationErrorFrameV2`. It rejects `ObservationInputRootV2`, `EffectSnapshotInputRootV2`, and `CaseEvaluationRegistryRootV2` as forbidden stale names and rejects fabricated nominal roots/domains/roles for any of the four root-free types. It enforces the 43-row base presented-wrapper table, ten constructor-owner classes, `EvaluatorAndCaseConformance` ownership for the fourteen roots plus ArtifactSet/ExternalMutationSet and the four nested members, and `CanonicalBytesAndCodec` ownership for ArtifactEncoded/ArtifactContent/StoredObject. ArtifactCodecIdV2 and LogicalExtentV2 remain base declarations; ArtifactSchema owns relation catalog, inventory, entry, and manifest schemas; inventory descriptors use the paired field order.

Generated policy and scanner tables contain exact RunnerLimitsV2 codes 1-71 and the typed category/cap map, normalized axis/evaluation-unit descriptors, namespace-local numeric IDs, root-policy aggregate rule, and no free conversion/callback registry. They exact-set register the later phase-1 `ArtifactInventoryEntryRootV2` and `ArtifactCodecRelationCatalogRootV2` with their standard domains/roles/owners without changing the base 43-row table.

Source/dependency/schema/owner scans distinguish nominal-root schemas, root-free nested members, semantic constructors, byte constructors, durability proof, and authority. They reject duplicate schemas/owners, fabricated roots for root-free members, actual EvaluationContext/error/detail/manifest/outcome/verdict/lifecycle/authority roots inside expectations, every reverse/self edge in the case-evaluation DAG, wildcard or generic-digest expectations, reverse evaluator-artifact dependencies, parser-minted validated roots, artifact-schema byte roots, generic digest conversion, stale field orders, and any source mapping mislabeled as retained execution evidence.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Dependency-policy unit/table tests enumerate every normal, build, generated-build, dev, target-specific, optional, renamed, feature-activated, proc/build-helper, and transitive route. Every production/build route to TOOL fails with the exact full path and repair; allowed dev-only and out-of-process routes pass.

2. Feature-matrix tests cover default/no-default/all-features, every optional feature, target partitions, aliases, build scripts, generated metadata, and transitive activation. Empty discovery, unknown edge type, unresolved target condition, or incomplete feature enumeration fails closed.

3. Compile-fail fixtures prove product code cannot import, link, generate, reexport, or acquire authority from `fs-evidence-runner` through runtime/build routes. Positive fixtures demonstrate only an explicit dev client and an out-of-process invocation.

4. Contract literal tests assert every required section and exact API/wire/no-predecessor, determinism, cancellation, safe-Rust, dependency, feature, source, conformance, retention, and no-authority fact. Missing, duplicate, contradictory, stale, or authority-widening text fails with an actionable diagnostic.

5. Source, SPDX, claims, docs, atlas, layer, member, and lock inventories require exactly one matching TOOL entry and exact source/build roots. Missing, duplicate, renamed, stale, untracked, or production-layer substitutions fail.

6. Generated-count tests derive all affected counts from live inputs; exercise zero/one/exact/one-over entries, nested workspace and untracked-member cases, before/after consistency, unrelated-count preservation, and checked arithmetic. A hand-edited count without matching inputs fails.

7. Property/metamorphic tests permute dependency declarations, target/feature partitions, registry input order, documentation order, and equivalent manifest encodings. Nonsemantic permutations preserve decisions/roots; any semantic edge, scope, source, claim, or count change moves the result.

8. Mutation tests remove, duplicate, rename, reclassify, feature-enable, build-route, stale, or authority-widen every edge, contract clause, inventory row, generated input, member row, lock row, and gate invocation. Each eligible mutant must execute and die; zero-denominator or expected-failure-only scores cannot close the leaf.

9. Repo-gate tests exercise focused commands, constellation refusal, DSR dry-run wiring, DSR quality success/failure result parsing, missing-tool fallback reporting, log/artifact capture, and strict separation of focused, DSR-wide, constellation, and platform proof states. This leaf does not claim a DSR pass until the named run actually passes.

10. A release-built no-mock governance E2E uses the real workspace metadata and public gate entry point to demonstrate one allowed dev route, every forbidden route class, contract/source/claims/docs/count generation, deterministic rerun, and a retained minimized failure for each stage. It does not execute a family, publisher, verifier, or authority service.

11. Logging tests assert exact event fields/order/caps, stable logical sequence, full route and generated-root evidence, first-error precedence with bounded secondary diagnostics, symbolic reproduction placeholders, and secret/host-noise exclusion. Malformed, missing, duplicate, truncated, reordered, or sensitive events fail.

12. Unit, boundary, property/metamorphic, mutation, compile-fail, dependency-route, contract, source/claims/docs/count, no-mock governance E2E, repo-gate, and logging classes each report a separately nonzero checked count and retained root. Focused, DSR, constellation, platform, schema-registry, durability, and authority statuses remain separate.

13. Outbound dependency-owner tests freeze the eventual direct normal set to fs-blake3, asupersync, and fsqlite with exactly async-api; assert phase-1 source imports only fs-blake3 and phase-2 owns the later rows; and prove the resolved sources/features unify with constellation.lock and the root crates-io patch. Missing, extra, renamed, optional, target-split, build/proc-macro, feature-expanded, duplicate-source, ambient-registry, wrong-phase, or authority-widening routes fail. Historical phase-1 focused evidence and current whole-package policy are reported separately without treating expected phase-2 additions as drift.

14. Source-closure tests exact-set-bind every file and generated input owned or consumed by this leaf: implementation modules, CONTRACT/rustdoc, schema/domain/descriptor and constructor tables, independent oracles, unit/property/mutation fixtures, E2E case-manifest rows, log schemas, direct dependency/source/feature identities, and build configuration. One-at-a-time missing, extra, stale, reordered, ambient, unpinned, duplicate-owner, or mixed-snapshot inputs move the closure or refuse before proof; no retained binary/root can stand in for absent source. The leaf coverage manifest reports distinct source-closure ID sets and checked counts for eligible positives and matched positives; eligible expected refusals and matched expected refusals; eligible expected failures and matched expected failures; and eligible mutations and matched mutations; exact Unsupported and inapplicable reasons; zero unexpected mismatches, execution failures, and unexplained skips; the exact source/build roots; and retained relative evidence paths.

15. Schema-policy integration verifies API generation 2, wire version 1, no predecessor, externally consumed schema declaration completeness, and product-boundary scanning. Missing, duplicate, stale, wrong-version, wrong-owner, migration, unscanned-source, or layer-substitution declarations fail. The generated ownership registry itself is constructed only by frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.1.3.2. This leaf changes no schema semantics and mints no Runner, scientific, admission, durability, or verification authority.

16. This leaf owns the live discovery and reconstruction engine and its proof schema. It discovers and exact-set verifies every owned or consumed Rust source, Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock row, CONTRACT/rustdoc input, `.cargo/config.toml`, rust-toolchain.toml, constellation.lock pin, generated schema/catalog/CLI input, test/compile-fail/E2E/log manifest, scanner rule, and direct/transitive dependency source identity. Every entry binds one owner, source route, pinned revision where applicable, one common repository snapshot, length, and content root. Missing, extra, stale, ambient, unpinned, duplicate-owner, mixed-snapshot, duplicate-source, or undeclared generated inputs refuse. frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.1.3.2 must rerun this engine after schema and lifecycle completion and bind the resulting current all-Phase-1 source/build roots; an earlier governance run, caller-presented root, or retained binary cannot substitute for the final compatible snapshot.

17. Source-closure and all other coverage reports use distinct exact ID sets for eligible positives and matched positives; eligible expected refusals and matched expected refusals; eligible expected failures and matched expected failures; and eligible mutations and matched mutations; typed Unsupported and inapplicable cells with exact matched reasons; unexpected mismatches; execution failures; and unexplained skips. Green requires nonzero applicable positive and adversarial corpora, exact ID/result joins, equality within each eligible/matched subpartition, exact reasons, and zero unexpected mismatches, execution failures, or unexplained skips. No passed/failed shorthand or collapsed counter is authoritative.

18. Retained evidence paths identify actual run manifests, canonical logs, scanner outputs, and proof receipts relative to the repository evidence root; source-file paths and future downstream script mappings are reported in separate typed fields and cannot masquerade as retained execution artifacts. The report binds source/build/toolchain/target/exact-feature roots, command, exit/result status, exact class and cell counts, first unexpected mismatch, and canonical log root with deterministic detailed logging. Focused proof, repo-wide proof, and downstream release-script proof remain separately labeled.

19. Generated policy tests independently enumerate all fourteen final evaluator nominal-root names/domains/roles, the four root-free nested member schemas with no domain/role/wrapper, three forbidden stale names, four forbidden fabricated-root names, 43 wrapper rows, ten owner classes, codes 1-71, every registry-cap category, normalized conversion shape, codec relation/entry/inventory paired descriptors, and all owner handoffs. Missing/extra/duplicate/reordered/stale/alias/fabricated-root/wrong-owner/wrong-domain/wrong-role/wrong-width or reverse-dependency mutants fail exact scanner and generated-source checks without changing the fourteen/43 counts.

20. Governance proof reports and closed logs separately retain declaration, constructor, byte, durability, source/dependency, schema, scanner, unit/compile-fail, E2E-contribution, and downstream-script status with exact source/build/toolchain/target/features roots, result IDs, expected/observed/effects, owner/no-claim, first mismatch, and genuine relative evidence paths. Applicable positive and adversarial partitions are nonzero; Unsupported and inapplicable reasons are exact. Unexpected mismatches, execution failures, and unexplained skips are always explicitly counted and must be zero for green. Focused/static results are never presented as DSR-wide or downstream release proof.

21. Evaluator-DAG governance tests source-independently walk view -> root-free CaseEvaluationKey -> expressions/requirements/fixtures/optional validated fixture roots -> root-free EvaluationPrecontext and expected nested frames -> CaseConformanceSpecRoot -> CaseManifestRoot -> actual EvaluationContextRoot -> actual error/detail -> raw outcome -> verdict. They reject every reverse/self edge, actual-root expectation, wildcard, generic digest, context collapse, parser-minted semantic value, and invented key/precontext/expected-frame root. Unit, property/mutation, compile-fail, no-mock integration, generated-policy E2E, deterministic detailed-log, coverage-join, and live-source-closure classes are separately nonzero and exact-joined with zero unexpected mismatches.

22. The final GLOBAL REALITY-CHECK CLOSE-MANIFEST RECONCILIATION exclusively defines the governance leaf comprehensive category, logging/redaction, source-closure, and green requirements.

23. GLOBAL REALITY-CHECK CLOSE-MANIFEST RECONCILIATION (CONTROLLING). Earlier `eligible`/`passed`/`failed` shorthand and any single collapsed `matched expected refusals` counter are compatibility-only and cannot close this leaf. The leaf must expose one result-free, source-authoritative, full-set-only close manifest that exact-sets every stable test and E2E cell into all nine preserved category groups: literal/unit/boundary; property/metamorphic; state/typestate/model/race; mutation/fuzz; API/compile-fail/trait; fault/resource/cancellation; release-built no-mock E2E or immutable E2E contribution; detailed deterministic logging/redaction; and source closure. Each applicable category and each applicable slash-separated facet has a separately nonzero corpus. A genuinely inapplicable facet requires a registered typed reason with stable code/name, exact owner, execution scope, prerequisite, and no-claim text; it cannot hide an eligible cell.

Result accounting retains distinct counters and exact ID sets for: eligible positives and matched positives; eligible expected refusals and matched expected refusals; eligible expected failures and matched expected failures; eligible mutations and matched mutations; typed Unsupported cells with exact matched reasons; typed inapplicable cells with exact matched registered reasons; unexpected mismatches; execution failures; and unexplained skips. It also reports checked aggregate adversarial totals as the sums of the three adversarial subpartitions without replacing them. Green requires each matched subpartition to equal its own eligible subpartition, every eligible stable ID exactly once in canonical order, nonzero applicable positive and adversarial corpora, exact Unsupported/inapplicable reason equality, and zero unexpected mismatches, execution failures, and unexplained skips. An expected failure is never an execution failure, a mutation is never relabeled as a refusal, and an empty/subset selection can never be green. Missing, extra, duplicate, reordered, stale, reclassified, wrong-reason, or wrong-scope manifest/result rows refuse structurally.

Where this leaf owns execution, comprehensive unit/integration/property/model/race/fault/mutation/API tests and the named E2E script run release-built with no mocks. Where execution belongs downstream, this leaf instead emits immutable stable rows binding independent literal expectations/oracles, semantic inputs, explicit time/memory/work/process/artifact/log budgets, schema and log-schema roots, source/build roots, exact downstream owner and script, and no-claim scope; it cannot report that downstream execution passed. E2E tests cover happy, boundary, expected-refusal, expected-failure, mutation, Unsupported, inapplicable, cancellation/drain, resource-return, and hidden-skip cases with deterministic stable IDs and exact first divergence.

Canonical bounded logs retain stable cell/category/facet IDs; semantic-input, source, build, schema, oracle, budget, manifest, and execution roots; ordered stage observations and terminal stage; expected/observed classification; first-divergence ID/root; resource and drain outcomes; exact result partitions; ranked non-executable repair manifest; no-claim scope; and safe relative retained-artifact references. They reject or type-redact secrets, credentials, environment values, live capabilities, raw resources/handles, absolute or physical paths, PIDs, wall clock, scheduler noise, and bulk payloads. Rejection diagnostics retain only a stable redacted data class and must not echo the sentinel through `observed`, Display, Debug, canonical bytes, logs, or reproduction text. Logging tests cover zero/one/exact/one-over limits, checked overflow, missing/extra/duplicate/reordered/truncated events, wrong roots/counts/reasons, redaction for every forbidden class, and deterministic replay.

Every user-visible Refused, Unsupported, divergent Negative, expected failure, and unexpected mismatch carries one bounded deterministic actionable diagnostic with registered code, precise redacted typed expected/observed values, owner, retryability, exact prerequisites, no-claim scope, and uniquely ranked declarative repairs. Repairs cannot contain or invoke commands, callbacks, scripts, credentials, raw capabilities/resources/handles/provider payloads, physical paths/locators, or automatic mutations. Source closure exact-sets all implementation, contract/rustdoc, schema/domain/owner tables, independent oracles, fixtures, E2E manifests/scripts or contribution rows, log schemas, dependencies/features, and build configuration on one compatible stable snapshot. Closeout reports focused proof, release-built E2E or contribution proof, source closure, DSR, and any downstream/scientific/authority proof separately and never promotes one into another.

FIVE EXPLICITS DECLARATION, RUNTIME-EVIDENCE, AND COMPLETE-LOG GATE (CONTROLLING). Every stable literal, unit, boundary, property, metamorphic, state, typestate, model, race, mutation, fuzz, API, fault, and E2E cell binds one declaration-side Five Explicits contract: typed units for every numeric input, numeric grant, and expected numeric observation; one canonical seed declaration plus generator/minimizer version, or a registered `SeedInapplicable` code with owner, scope, prerequisite, and no-claim; seven-axis hard and soft time, memory, logical-work, process, artifact, output, and log budgets with process shape declared separately; exact API, wire, schema, source, build, toolchain, target, profile, and feature version requirements; one exact required/permitted semantic capability contract; and the exact no-claim. Runtime actual numeric observations, resolved seed provenance, budget reconciliation, observed versions, and actual required, granted, observed, returned, and revoked capability sets exist only inside disposition-gated runtime evidence. `Observed` requires complete actuals; `NotObserved` may retain only safe typed partial evidence plus its exact reason and cannot substitute expected values; `Deferred` and `Inapplicable` contain no fabricated actuals. Changing any applicable declaration or actual explicit moves exactly the intended component, cell, evidence, log, reproduction, aggregate, and report roots. Bounded log writers reserve sufficient bytes for one canonical terminal event before admitting detail events. The first event that would exceed the remaining detail budget emits one complete deterministic `LogBudgetExceeded` terminal containing the rejected event class and ordinal, digest, omitted count, applicable budget, first-divergence stage, disposition, drain/resource outcome, diagnostic owner, repair-manifest root, and no-claim. Partial JSONL, silent truncation, overwriting prior events, missing terminal state, expected-as-actual substitution, fabricated observed-empty data, or treating overflow as success refuses. Minimized reproduction evidence retains every applicable declaration and safe actual explicit without exposing a forbidden value.

SEED GOVERNANCE AND SOURCE POLICY (CONTROLLING). Dependency, source, generated-doc, schema-owner, and no-bypass scans exact-set all semantic seed types, domains, constructors, policy rows, CLI facts, test-seed records, generator/minimizer versions, and source closures. Production code may use only the checked Runner seed APIs; ambient RNG, test-only RNG leakage, duplicate seed wrappers, unregistered derivation domains, and hidden defaults fail governance.

The consumer must bind the exact .7 proof/source root and later satisfy its own designated release route; child proof never substitutes for parent or downstream execution.

PROGRAM-WIDE ATTEMPT CORRELATION, STAGE TELEMETRY, SHARD/RESUME, AND COMPLETE-LOG CONSUMER GATE 2026-07-29 (FINAL CONTROLLING). This task exact-binds, and does not redefine, the common three-plane contracts owned by `.24.1.1.1.4` through `.24.1.1.1.6`. Every executable cell declaration binds the common attempt-identity contract root; the actual nominal `AttemptIdentityRootV1` exists only after admission. Every child/downstream execution records its stable route/suite/case/cell/shard IDs and causal ordinal, with an optional typed parent-attempt root only in attempt-specific evidence. Canonical invocation/command/event/report/reproduction/terminal/final-log payloads bind the attempt-invariant `CanonicalRuntimeObservationProjectionRootV1` and contain deterministic schema/version, logical event sequence, stage code/ordinal, event kind/severity, expected/observed classification, semantic/budget/capability/no-claim roots, first divergence, bounded actionable diagnostic, terminal completeness, and safe relative artifacts. They contain no attempt identity/scope, raw transcript, timing sample, wall clock, physical path, host/environment/PID/scheduler/load, secret, live capability/resource value, or bulk payload.

Applicable actual execution additionally requires a complete AC57 envelope and finalized `AttemptRetentionReceiptV1` that correlate the canonical root set with nominal attempt identity, safe retention scope, resource/capability reconciliation, raw-audit roots, atomic finalization, and `RunnerStageTelemetryV1`. The bounded telemetry sidecar records attempt/optional parent correlation, stable route/suite/case/cell/shard IDs, causal ordinal, stage code/ordinal, start/finish disposition, checked monotonic offset and stage delta with explicit units, clock descriptor/root, resolution and suspend policy, applicable environmental time budget, terminal disposition, safe relative artifact references, and explicit no-performance-claim scope. Timing is an operator observation only: it never feeds semantic/source/build/schema/oracle/expected-result/publication/receipt/admission/authority roots or a portable performance claim. A read-only operator view may join receipt, canonical log, and telemetry after finalization; it cannot feed execution or mutate any root.

A ContributionOnly or deferred-local declaration carries its immutable result-free payload plus typed Deferred envelope and fabricates no attempt, timing, execution, resource, or terminal actual. A genuinely pure/non-executable facet uses a source-registered Inapplicable reason naming exact owner, scope, prerequisite, and no-claim. Every manifest explicitly declares `Sharded` or `ShardInapplicable` and `Resumable` or `ResumeInapplicable`; omission, runtime-skip synthesis, or Unsupported-as-Inapplicable refuses. Applicable E2E owners retain exact attempt-scoped relative artifact/reproduction references; contribution tasks bind the exact downstream owner/driver/script/manifest that will produce them.

Comprehensive literal/unit/boundary, property/metamorphic, state/typestate/model/race, mutation/fuzz, API/compile-fail/trait, fault/resource/cancellation, no-mock local/release E2E or immutable contribution plus owner-consumption E2E, deterministic detailed logging/redaction/no-echo, structured reproduction, shard/resume, exact coverage, and source-closure tests cover missing/extra/duplicate/reordered stages/events/correlation rows, logical-sequence gaps/overflow, simultaneous same-cell attempts, causal-parent substitution, exact resume versus cross-attempt residue, shard gaps/duplicates/remaps, clock unavailable/regression/wrap/overflow, stage nesting and deadline reconciliation, observation loss, zero/one/exact/one-over log and telemetry budgets, reserve-before-detail terminal overflow, changing timing/attempt/raw noise without moving canonical roots, one-component movement in the correct outer plane, sentinel redaction across every output path, and missing terminal/correlation/artifact/reproduction evidence. Silent truncation, hidden skip, unbounded logging, fabricated actuals, or a green subset is forbidden.

title: Runner V2 Phase-1 registry and CLI generation, drift-ratchet, release-proof, and source-closure rollup
description:
Decomposed generation-and-proof rollup for the acyclic Phase-1 schema/identity ownership registry, generated CLI/catalog/help/completion/seed views, route/schema-impact/coverage/protocol drift ratchets, and release-built registry/CLI E2E plus source closure. Four atomic children own generator, presentation projections, coverage/ratchet, and final proof domains; this epic exact-set joins them after the source schemas and lifecycle/result contracts exist. Generated views remain descriptive and cannot feed authority back into RunnerSpecV2.


## Success Criteria

The dedicated Acceptance Criteria field, including its final live rollup topology/accounting reconciliation, is the canonical success gate. Every exact direct child must close on compatible proof and source roots, every assigned aggregate/integration/route obligation must pass, and focused, release-E2E, DSR, durability, scientific, admission, authority, and no-claim statuses must remain separate.
design:
This leaf consumes the twelve immutable-schema implementation manifests under 24.1.1, the evaluator and spec child-rollup manifests, the evaluator-spec join, and the final schema rollup; grammar/catalog roots from 24.1.2.1; stop/drain roots from 24.1.2.2; lifecycle/terminal roots from 24.1.2.3; semantic-result and transport-handoff contribution roots from 24.1.2.4; their exact-set rollup 24.1.2; and the TOOL-policy/docs/gate root from 24.1.3.1. It owns generated registry and coverage artifacts only and implements no data schema, semantic constructor, parser, publisher, executable, migration adapter, verifier, family fixture, scientific checker, or admission authority.

RunnerPhase1SchemaOwnershipRegistryV2 has exact domain `org.frankensim.fs-evidence-runner.phase1-schema-ownership-registry.v1` and exact ordered wire-field identifiers: `api_generation`; `wire_version`; `runner_spec_root` carrying RunnerSpecRootV2; `entries` carrying the ordered duplicate-rejected SchemaOwnershipEntryV2 values; `registry_source_closure_root`; `registry_build_identity_root`; and `no_claim_scope`. No alternate field identifier, structural alias, or type-name-as-field-name is accepted. It does not contain its own root. Its nominal root is computed only after the complete frame is frozen.

SchemaOwnershipEntryV2 has exact ordered fields: canonical_domain; schema_descriptor_root; nominal_digest_role; data_schema_owner; semantic_constructor_owner; optional parser_owner; optional verifier_owner; authority_owner_or_none; source_closure_root; and no_claim_scope. Owner IDs are stable namespaced tokens, not paths or callable references. The exact set covers every phase-1 base, evaluator/conformance, family/spec/catalog/executable, migration/replay-support, invocation/retry/replay, artifact/inventory/manifest, lifecycle/terminal/stop/drain, and outer-result schema and root exactly once.

RunnerSpecV2 remains the acyclic base/family contract. The ownership registry is rooted beside it and may refer to RunnerSpecRootV2; RunnerSpecV2 may not refer back to this registry or to any later schema descriptor. Later phases contribute separately rooted append-only ownership manifests. No downstream entry is smuggled into the phase-1 registry, and no later manifest can rewrite a phase-1 owner/domain/root.

The grammar registry is generated from the canonical grammar root owned by 24.1.2.1 and reconciled by 24.1.2. It includes exactly List, Check, SelfTest, Run, Negative, and Replay; explicit run profile/family mode; explicit publication protocol and destination mode; exact tagged root-capability reference forms/ranges; `--bundle-rel`; immutable Negative/Replay derivation; and independent-option canonicalization. It rejects `OutputlessLifecycle`, `--artifact-dir`, hidden aliases/defaults, duplicated selectors, raw paths/credentials, and stale help/completion/E2E rows.

Coverage joining consumes the exact ordered set of twelve immutable-schema implementation manifests—frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.1.1.1, frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.1.1.2, frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.1.1.3.1.1, frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.1.1.3.1.2, frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.1.1.3.1.3, frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.1.1.3.1.4, frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.1.1.3.2.1, frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.1.1.3.2.2, frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.1.1.3.2.3, frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.1.1.3.2.4, frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.1.1.4, and frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.1.1.5—plus the evaluator/spec nested join, the schema rollup, lifecycle manifest, and TOOL-policy manifest. Missing, extra, duplicate, or reordered implementation-manifest identities refuse structurally; a cardinality-only check cannot pass. Each implementation manifest reports exact source/build/schema roots and separately nonzero applicable literal, unit, boundary, property/model, API/compile-fail, mutation, public-API/no-mock E2E, and logging counts. Rollup counts are review evidence and are never miscounted as implementation tests.

Generated registry, grammar, help, contract facts, shell-completion fixtures, E2E command inventory, ownership table, and coverage counts derive from registered source inputs on one stable snapshot. Missing, duplicate, stale, mixed-root, hand-edited, later-phase, self-referential, or authority-widening data fails closed. Focused proof, registry generation, DSR-wide proof, constellation status, platform support, and downstream durability/authority proof remain distinct statuses.

Canonical logs retain logical sequence, source/build/toolchain/constellation roots, every registry entry and owner role, grammar row, exact coverage set/count/root, generation inputs/outputs, first failure, owner/prerequisites/no-claim/repairs, proof-state category, and relative artifacts. They exclude raw capability references, host paths, credentials, PIDs, wall clock, scheduler noise, secrets, and bulk payloads; reproduction templates use symbolic capability/root placeholders.

## Projection and coverage join clarification

This leaf owns the exact registry and checked-result join over the base leaves’ distinct journey manifests plus later downstream execution reports. It does not treat an aggregate root, count-only table, or future script path as proof. Coverage manifests are immutable inputs; execution results are exact-joined outputs under a closed logging schema.

## Generated UX gate

Help/version and progress syntax/events are generated from the frozen grammar and schemas while remaining explicitly outside the six-command semantic algebra and all authority identities. The generated source of truth includes the lossless POSIX-byte and raw-Windows-UTF-16-code-unit lexical tables, exact direct-POSIX versus bootstrap-required Windows/ContentStore/progress support matrix, all fourteen ordered `RunnerVersionDocumentV1` fields, complete-or-detectably-truncated transport prerequisites, handled-signal/exit mapping, and environmental wall-deadline no-claim wording. Help examples are symbolic and never embed ambient paths, handles, slots, credentials, locators, or a PATH-selected executable.

## Final controlling phase-1 ownership and contribution joins

`RunnerPhase1SchemaOwnershipRegistryV2` exact-set contains all fourteen final evaluator/conformance nominal root schemas under semantic owner `EvaluatorAndCaseConformance`, plus corrected ArtifactSetRootV2 and ExternalMutationSetRootV2 ownership. The enclosing evaluator/conformance descriptor separately exact-set contains the root-free nested members `CaseEvaluationKeyV2`, `EvaluationPrecontextV2`, `ExpectedMismatchFrameV2`, and `ExpectedEvaluationErrorFrameV2`, also under EvaluatorAndCaseConformance; they are not ownership-registry root entries and have no fabricated domains, roles, or wrappers. The generated non-wire nested-member inventory records enclosing descriptor, member type, data/semantic owner, source closure, and no-claim scope. The registry records the base 43-wrapper handoff separately from later phase-1 schemas, including ArtifactInventoryEntryRootV2 and ArtifactCodecRelationCatalogRootV2, and records `CanonicalBytesAndCodec` as the semantic byte-root owner without pretending those phase-2 constructors are implemented in phase 1. The three superseded evaluator root names and four fabricated nested-member root names are forbidden. Generated inventories include exact limit codes 1-71, registry category/cap ownership, normalized conversions, and paired inventory descriptors.

Coverage joins consume `RunnerV2EvaluatorE2eContributionManifestV1` and `RunnerV2EvaluatorE2eContributionExecutionV1` separately. The EvidenceVerifierV1 row is owned/consumed by 24.3.3.3.3, CanonicalRunnerV2 by 24.4.1.4, and VerifyRunnerRjoqHandoffV1 by 24.5.3.1. Each join requires the immutable row, aggregate manifest root, context-bound execution root, exact stable result IDs, source/build/toolchain/target/features roots, log root, and downstream owner. An in-process result cannot stand in for release-script execution, and a script mapping cannot stand in for retained evidence.

ROUTE-TYPE OWNERSHIP RECONCILIATION 2026-07-29 (CONTROLLING). This Bead consumes the common `LeafCloseRoute*` vocabulary and exact `LeafCloseRouteDerivedClassV1` spelling from `.24.1.1.1`. It owns only the Phase-1 generated registry rows, projections, coverage validation, CLI presentation, and related source closure. It does not define, encode, extend, or semantically reinterpret the common route kinds, route descriptor, summary, derived-class, evidence-disposition, or migration types.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Handwritten literal tests assert the exact registry and entry domains, API/wire/no-predecessor relation, ordered field names/types/presence, owner-role vocabulary, typed absence, caps, no-claim, and root-free frames independently of generated production tables.

2. Exact-set owner tests enumerate every phase-1 nominal wrapper, data schema, semantic constructor, parser, verifier, and authority owner exactly once. Missing, duplicate, role-swapped, stale, generic-digest, mixed-source, or implicit authority owners fail.

3. Dependency-DAG tests prove RunnerSpecV2 contains only base/family descriptors; the phase-1 registry may bind RunnerSpecRootV2 but RunnerSpec cannot bind the registry; no entry refers to a later-phase schema; no registry self root exists; and every root is computed only after its root-free frame. Every feedback-edge mutant fails.

4. Full-frame registry oracles cover zero/one/exact/max entries, key order, canonical token/domain rules, typed absence versus present all-zero roots, field deletion/duplication/reorder/extension, wrong width/version/role/domain, trailing bytes, and every one-field root mutation.

5. Source-closure tests prove every phase-1 schema/constructor/registry/generator source and relevant build input moves the appropriate leaf/registry root; unrelated workspace changes outside declared closures do not. Mixed source/build snapshots fail.

6. Grammar literal tests enumerate all six commands and exact command-specific option/presence tables, protocol and destination tokens, `--bundle-rel`, tagged capability reference grammar/ranges, immutable Negative/Replay derivation, and independent option canonicalization. Every missing/extra/duplicate/conflicting/inapplicable option and every old alias/default fails.

7. Generated help, catalog, contract, shell-completion, and release-E2E inventories must equal the grammar registry exactly. Missing, extra, stale, reordered-semantic, hidden alias, or handwritten optimistic row fails with the owner and repair.

8. Coverage-manifest tests require twelve distinct immutable-schema implementation roots plus the evaluator and spec child-rollup roots, evaluator-spec join, and final schema rollup, all four lifecycle implementation roots 24.1.2.1-.4, lifecycle rollup 24.1.2, and TOOL-policy manifest. They reject omission, duplication, relabeling, rollup-as-implementation counting, merged opaque totals, zero applicable category, root substitution, or stale snapshot.

9. Boundary/property tests exercise every entry/count/string/root cap at zero when legal, one, one-below/exact/one-over, checked arithmetic, equivalent nonsemantic input permutations, and semantic owner/domain/source changes. Equivalent inputs preserve roots; semantic changes move or refuse.

10. API/compile-fail tests reject public registry literals, mutable entries, post-freeze extension, generic owner strings, executable/callback owners, generic digest coercion, direct authority conversion, RunnerSpec feedback, phase-2 insertion, and product runtime/build dependency on generated registry code. Read-only accessors and descriptor lookup remain available.

11. Mutation tests alter every registry field/entry/owner/root/source/no-claim, grammar row/token/range, generated output, coverage root/count/category, and DAG exclusion. Every eligible mutant executes and dies in both registry generation and independent exact-set verification.

12. A release-built no-mock governance E2E generates the phase-1 registry, grammar/help/completion/E2E inventory, and coverage join from live registered inputs; independently decodes them; reruns deterministically; injects one minimized defect per stage; and uses no family producer, publisher, verifier, scientific checker, or admission service.

13. Repo-gate/DSR tests run the focused schema/identity/grammar/coverage checks and configured DSR lane, retain exact commands/results/log/artifact paths, exercise unavailable/failure reporting, and keep focused, DSR-wide, constellation, and platform status separate.

14. Logging tests assert exact event fields/order/caps, every owner and coverage principal, generation input/output roots, first-error precedence, bounded secondary diagnostics, symbolic reproduction placeholders, and sensitive/host-noise exclusion. Missing, duplicate, malformed, truncated, reordered, or sensitive events fail.

15. Every applicable category and slash-separated facet required by the final GLOBAL REALITY-CHECK CLOSE-MANIFEST RECONCILIATION exposes a separately nonzero exact count; every inapplicable facet uses a registered typed reason. Registry/CLI generation, source closure, owned release-built governance E2E, and downstream immutable contributions remain distinct evidence scopes. No registry receipt mints durability, scientific, promotion, or admission authority.

16. E2E-projection registry and source-closure tests bind the exact `RunnerV2BaseE2eProjectionV2` test-manifest schema, source root, five journey keys, and sole downstream owner map from 24.1.1.1 as non-wire test inputs. The projection manifest is not a RunnerSpec field or Phase-1 schema-registry entry. Missing, extra, duplicate, stale, remapped, script-owned, or authority-bearing projections fail; the final coverage join preserves the distinction between in-process base execution and later release-built script execution.

17. The projection registry consumes five distinct source-closed RunnerV2BaseE2eJourneyManifestV1 descriptors from 24.1.1.1, not five copies of an aggregate row list. It exact-set checks each public journey key, downstream owner/script mapping, semantic-cell root, compiled-source-closure root, closed log-schema root, API/wire/toolchain/target/exact-feature context, and scoped executor/reconstructor contract. Missing, extra, duplicate, stale, cross-journey, unmapped, ornamental, or authority-bearing cells fail. Each downstream owner must later present an exact checked result join for its projection before program closure.

18. Coverage generation separates immutable result-free manifests from checked execution reports. It exact-joins stable IDs for every owned unit, boundary, property/metamorphic, compile-fail/doctest, schema, mutation, in-process E2E, owned release-built E2E, downstream contribution, logging, source-closure, scanner, and repo-gate cell; counts alone or source-label placeholders cannot pass. Reports separately retain eligible positives and matched positives; eligible expected refusals and matched expected refusals; eligible expected failures and matched expected failures; and eligible mutations and matched mutations; typed Unsupported and inapplicable cells with exact reasons; unexpected mismatches; execution failures; and unexplained skips. Green requires exact ID/result joins, equality within every eligible/matched subpartition, exact reasons, and zero unexpected mismatches, execution failures, or unexplained skips. External results include command, snapshot/source/build/toolchain/target/exact-features, canonical log root, and retained evidence path.

19. Generated registry/CLI/E2E logs use closed field and event catalogs with required/forbidden matrices and reconcile start/summary/terminal events, exact cell/result sets, class totals, unsupported reasons, first-error precedence, and final roots. Downstream script mappings and source paths are distinct from retained artifacts. Any arbitrary field, omitted event, duplicate result, inconsistent count, unrooted feature set, or host-sensitive datum fails.

20. Generated grammar, deterministic help, exact version output, completion, catalog, contract facts, and E2E inventories include presentation-only --help/--version plus optional progress-capability-slot:N on Check, SelfTest, Run, Negative, and Replay. Independent literals enumerate all fourteen ordered RunnerVersionDocumentV1 fields, canonical LF framing, and every forbidden ambient field. Generated help distinguishes six semantic commands from meta-actions/options; lossless POSIX/Windows argv behavior; direct POSIX descriptors from bootstrap-required Windows/ContentStore/progress slots; semantic result from transport completion; handled signal/exit rows; and logical-work determinism from environmental wall deadlines. Drift, hidden alias/default, hand-edited row, slot/event/transport identity inclusion, missing redaction, PATH/debug fallback, or inconsistent CLI/API/wire/source/build/toolchain/target/features/profile fact fails. Literal, golden, property, mutation, compile-fail, release-process, redaction, source-closure, and checked-result counts are independently nonzero.

21. Ownership-registry tests independently enumerate all fourteen evaluator nominal-root rows, the four evaluator root-free nested members under their enclosing descriptor, all artifact/byte rows, 43-base versus later-phase membership, ten owner classes, three forbidden stale names, four forbidden fabricated-root names, exact domains/roles only where nominal, codes 1-71, and paired/normalized schema descriptors. Missing/extra/duplicate/reordered/stale/mixed-phase/wrong-owner/wrong-domain/fabricated-domain/alias or earlier-registry mutation fails full-frame reconstruction, generated CLI/docs, count ratchets, compile/dependency scans, coverage, and source closure without changing fourteen/43 counts.

22. CONTRIBUTION-UNION EXACTNESS. Coverage tests exact-set and distinguish: the five `RunnerV2BaseE2eJourneyManifestV1` manifests from frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.1.1.1; the three evaluator journeys originating from 24.1.1.3.1.4—EvidenceVerifierV1 consumed by frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.3.3.3.3, CanonicalRunnerV2 consumed by frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.4.1.4, and VerifyRunnerRjoqHandoffV1 consumed by frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.5.3.1; the spec/catalog journeys originating from 24.1.1.3.2.4; the lifecycle/result contribution union originating from 24.1.2.4; and every additional identity, artifact/manifest, and migration/replay contribution with its exact owner and script. Result-free manifests, context-bound in-process execution roots, and retained downstream release-result roots are separately joined and non-substitutable. Missing, extra, duplicate, reordered, stale, remapped, silently skipped, wrong-owner, wrong-script, result-contaminated, or fabricated-artifact rows refuse.

23. Nested-member ownership and DAG tests independently reconstruct the non-wire member inventory and walk view -> root-free CaseEvaluationKey -> expressions/requirements/fixtures/optional validated fixture roots -> root-free EvaluationPrecontext and expected nested frames -> CaseConformanceSpecRoot -> CaseManifestRoot -> actual EvaluationContextRoot -> actual error/detail -> raw outcome -> verdict. They reject invented nominal roots/digests, missing or duplicate members, actual-root expectations, wildcard/context collapse, every reverse/self edge, parser semantic construction, and owner/source-closure drift. Generated registry/help/docs, unit/property/mutation, compile-fail, no-mock release E2E contributions, deterministic detailed logs, exact coverage joins, and source closure retain root-free member frames as typed nested data plus their enclosing spec/descriptor roots, never fake artifact paths or nominal roots.

24. Generated native-presentation and transport UX tests exact-set POSIX byte classes, raw Windows UTF-16 code units/surrogate classes, quote/backslash process cases, bootstrap support cells, signal/exit rows, wall-deadline no-claim rows, version fields, progress rows, and CommandResultTransportFrameV1 handoff facts. They compare generated help/version/completion/CONTRACT/E2E inputs against independent handwritten tables and typed retained native observations from named parser, controller, and release-harness owners. This registry leaf validates and joins observations but does not launch a native process or claim a mapping row as execution evidence. Missing, extra, duplicate, reordered, stale, platform-collapsed, authority-widened, wrong-owner, or fabricated observations refuse.

25. LEAF RESULT-PARTITION CLOSE GATE. Every coverage manifest and owned or contributed E2E suite reports distinct exact ID sets and counts for eligible and matched positives; eligible and matched expected refusals; eligible and matched expected failures; eligible and matched mutations; typed Unsupported cells and exact matched reasons; typed inapplicable cells and exact matched registered reasons; unexpected mismatches; execution failures; and unexplained skips. Green requires every eligible stable ID exactly once, nonzero applicable positive and adversarial corpora, equality within each eligible/matched subpartition, exact reason equality, and zero unexpected mismatches, execution failures, and unexplained skips. Contribution-only rows cannot claim downstream execution.

26. LEAF USER-FACING REPAIR SAFETY GATE. Every user-visible Refused or Unsupported outcome, every matched or divergent Negative path, and every unexpected divergence owned or contributed by this leaf carries one bounded deterministic ActionableDiagnosticV2 with registered code, precise redacted typed expected/observed values, owning component, retryability, exact prerequisites, no-claim scope, and one or more uniquely ranked RepairActionV2 values. Repairs are declarative and non-executable: they cannot contain or invoke commands, callbacks, scripts, credentials, raw capability/resource/handle/provider payloads, physical paths/locators, or automatic mutations. Literal, unit, boundary, property/model, mutation, API/compile-fail, owned release-built registry/CLI-governance E2E and separately typed immutable downstream contributions, deterministic detailed-log/redaction, coverage, and source-closure tests exercise exact and one-over size/count/rank limits, stable tie-breaking, owner/prerequisite/no-claim accuracy, secret exclusion, and expected-Negative Pass semantics.

27. GLOBAL REALITY-CHECK CLOSE-MANIFEST RECONCILIATION (CONTROLLING). Earlier `eligible`/`passed`/`failed` shorthand and any single collapsed `matched expected refusals` counter are compatibility-only and cannot close this leaf. The leaf must expose one result-free, source-authoritative, full-set-only close manifest that exact-sets every stable test and E2E cell into all nine preserved category groups: literal/unit/boundary; property/metamorphic; state/typestate/model/race; mutation/fuzz; API/compile-fail/trait; fault/resource/cancellation; release-built no-mock E2E or immutable E2E contribution; detailed deterministic logging/redaction; and source closure. Each applicable category and each applicable slash-separated facet has a separately nonzero corpus. A genuinely inapplicable facet requires a registered typed reason with stable code/name, exact owner, execution scope, prerequisite, and no-claim text; it cannot hide an eligible cell.

Result accounting retains distinct counters and exact ID sets for: eligible positives and matched positives; eligible expected refusals and matched expected refusals; eligible expected failures and matched expected failures; eligible mutations and matched mutations; typed Unsupported cells with exact matched reasons; typed inapplicable cells with exact matched registered reasons; unexpected mismatches; execution failures; and unexplained skips. It also reports checked aggregate adversarial totals as the sums of the three adversarial subpartitions without replacing them. Green requires each matched subpartition to equal its own eligible subpartition, every eligible stable ID exactly once in canonical order, nonzero applicable positive and adversarial corpora, exact Unsupported/inapplicable reason equality, and zero unexpected mismatches, execution failures, and unexplained skips. An expected failure is never an execution failure, a mutation is never relabeled as a refusal, and an empty/subset selection can never be green. Missing, extra, duplicate, reordered, stale, reclassified, wrong-reason, or wrong-scope manifest/result rows refuse structurally.

Where this leaf owns execution, comprehensive unit/integration/property/model/race/fault/mutation/API tests and the named E2E script run release-built with no mocks. Where execution belongs downstream, this leaf instead emits immutable stable rows binding independent literal expectations/oracles, semantic inputs, explicit time/memory/work/process/artifact/log budgets, schema and log-schema roots, source/build roots, exact downstream owner and script, and no-claim scope; it cannot report that downstream execution passed. E2E tests cover happy, boundary, expected-refusal, expected-failure, mutation, Unsupported, inapplicable, cancellation/drain, resource-return, and hidden-skip cases with deterministic stable IDs and exact first divergence.

Canonical bounded logs retain stable cell/category/facet IDs; semantic-input, source, build, schema, oracle, budget, manifest, and execution roots; ordered stage observations and terminal stage; expected/observed classification; first-divergence ID/root; resource and drain outcomes; exact result partitions; ranked non-executable repair manifest; no-claim scope; and safe relative retained-artifact references. They reject or type-redact secrets, credentials, environment values, live capabilities, raw resources/handles, absolute or physical paths, PIDs, wall clock, scheduler noise, and bulk payloads. Rejection diagnostics retain only a stable redacted data class and must not echo the sentinel through `observed`, Display, Debug, canonical bytes, logs, or reproduction text. Logging tests cover zero/one/exact/one-over limits, checked overflow, missing/extra/duplicate/reordered/truncated events, wrong roots/counts/reasons, redaction for every forbidden class, and deterministic replay.

Every user-visible Refused, Unsupported, divergent Negative, expected failure, and unexpected mismatch carries one bounded deterministic actionable diagnostic with registered code, precise redacted typed expected/observed values, owner, retryability, exact prerequisites, no-claim scope, and uniquely ranked declarative repairs. Repairs cannot contain or invoke commands, callbacks, scripts, credentials, raw capabilities/resources/handles/provider payloads, physical paths/locators, or automatic mutations. Source closure exact-sets all implementation, contract/rustdoc, schema/domain/owner tables, independent oracles, fixtures, E2E manifests/scripts or contribution rows, log schemas, dependencies/features, and build configuration on one compatible stable snapshot. This phase rollup implements no parser, codec, filesystem operation, store operation, transport writer, publication adapter, or receipt constructor. The 38-node phase subtree totals 19,110 minutes.

24.2.1 owns a 60-minute exact cross-child canonical-byte integration join. Its 24.2.1.1 rollup owns native-byte/framing and hostile document/argv decoding plus evaluator projection and independent parser proof, while consuming—not redefining—the StableTokenV2 grammar/type/cap from 24.1.1.1.1. Backend-neutral logical layout and physical placement are distinct. ArtifactInventoryEntryV2 stores artifact_relative_path without artifacts/; BundleLayoutV1 derives artifacts/ plus that path exactly once and checks PublicationTargetV2 plus every full object path against joint path/key caps and the final antichain.
