1. The exact 38-node phase subtree closes: 28 implementation tasks and ten rollup epics including this phase gate, with the direct child rollups 24.2.1 and 24.2.2 and every recursively enumerated descendant exact-set from the live hierarchy. Every node closes on compatible schema/source/build/policy/ABI/provider-conformance/Cargo-manifest/lock/feature/transitive-closure/proof roots with the full nine-category test matrix, exact result partitions, release-built E2E or immutable contributions, deterministic detailed logging/redaction, safe reproduction, and source closure. Direct lists copied into prose never substitute for generated recursive membership.

2. Schema-DAG and exact-ownership proof keeps RunnerSpecV2 base/family-only; rejects every Phase-2 descriptor/registry/manifest or self-feedback field inside RunnerSpecV2; requires separately rooted append-only RunnerPhase2SchemaOwnershipManifestV2 with the exact 24.1.3.2 registry anchor and same owner-entry vocabulary; and proves 24.1.1.1 remains the singular owner for LogicalBundlePathV1, ContentStoreObjectKeyV1, PublicationTargetV2, PublicationSelectionV2, DestinationAdmissionModeV2, RootCapabilityPolicyV2, and RunnerBudgetsV2; 24.2.1.1 alone owns shared parser/presentation byte rows; 24.2.1.2 alone owns phase-2 BundleLayoutV1, ContentStoreEnvelopeV1, PublicationAccountingV1, DestinationResourceBindingV1/RootV1, PlannedPreIntentObjectSetRootV1, PublicationKeyV1, PublicationIntentV1, and PreSealObjectSetRoot bytes plus artifact byte-root/codecs; 24.2.1.3 alone owns byte codecs for upstream RunnerCatalogV2, LifecycleOnlyCommandResultV2, DurableCommandResultV2, and CommandResultTransportFrameV1; 24.1.1.3.2.3 remains the sole RunnerCatalogV2 schema/constructor owner; 24.1.2.4 remains the sole LifecycleOnlyCommandResultV2 and DurableCommandResultV2 schema/constructor owner; rollup 24.1.2 is their compatible exact-set gate; 24.2.2.1.1 constructs destination bindings and shared capability/event schemas; 24.2.2.1.2/.3/.4 own POSIX/Windows/ContentStore effects; 24.2.2.1.5 owns provider E2E schemas; 24.2.2.2 constructs publication typestates/receipts; 24.2.2.3.1 constructs only delivery observations/failure/projection policy; 24.2.2.3.2 owns RunnerPhase2SchemaOwnershipManifestV2; 24.2.2.3.3 owns focused E2E and canonical-harness contribution schemas; and no leaf may redefine an upstream wire schema.

3. Canonical byte proof covers every Runner document, typed numeric value, unknown-extension envelope, lifecycle frame, inventory, manifest, publication intent, seal, ContentStore envelope, Identity payload, and full ZstdFrameV1 block/table/checksum path under literal caps and bounded streaming allocation. StableTokenV2 tests accept exact 128-byte canonical tokens, refuse 129 bytes, preserve fully namespaced 90-byte identifiers, and never shorten or alias them.

4. Layout proof covers six reserved runner/ system objects; ArtifactInventoryEntryV2 artifact_relative_path without artifacts/; exact one-time derivation of artifacts/ plus relative path; PublicationTargetV2 plus full-path 240-byte/32-segment/key limits; duplicate/proper-prefix final-antichain conflicts; system/artifact collision; independent ContentStoreObjectKeyV1 rederivation; logical-versus-physical key separation; every one-field path mutation; and exact discovery from input capability plus manifest-relative selection.

5. Destination/publication-selection proof exact-set-checks rooted, self-root-free DestinationResourceBindingV1 fields RootClassV2, PlatformPathProfileV2, RootCapabilityPolicyRootV2, privacy-preserving stable ResourceIdentityRootV2, identity_provider_policy_root, freshness_observation_root, optional generation_observation_root, and no_claim_scope; proves same resource via new slots yields the same DestinationResourceBindingRootV1, different resources differ, unsupported providers refuse before mutation, raw resource identifiers are excluded/redacted, and InvocationRootV2/RunIdV2 do not move. It proves DestinationResourceBindingRootV1 binds PublicationKey, PublicationIntent, DurablePublicationIdentity, FinalCommitIdentity, PublishedBundleReceipt, and recovery. Publication-selection proof consumes the singular exact field order PlatformPathProfileV2, PublicationProtocolV2, DestinationAdmissionModeV2, PublicationTargetV2; exhausts its compatibility matrix and --bundle-rel mapping; proves lifecycle-only typed absence; separately verifies exact RunnerBudgetsV2 and ordered RootCapabilityPolicyRootV2 bindings in InvocationBasisV2/BundleManifestV2; rejects duplicated bundle-rel/budget/policy fields; and checks root movement for every semantic change.

6. Grant/accounting proof independently checks RunnerBudgetsV2 field positions and recomputes exactly nine PublicationAccountingV1 actuals: lifecycle encoded, artifact encoded/stored/expanded, exact six logical runner/ system-object stored including ContentStore envelopes, object counts, envelope overhead, separate command_result_stdout grant with no length/observation in accounting/receipt/identity, physical metadata exclusion, and whole-publication totals. POSIX/Windows and ContentStore equations, publication_stored = artifact_stored + system_publication_stored, exact 8 MiB system and 73/521 MiB whole caps, checked overflow, zero/one/256 artifacts, and one-below/exact/one-over grants are mandatory.

7. Capability proof covers posix-fd:N at 0/2147483647 and Windows/ContentStore slots at 0/4294967295 with canonical unsigned decimal spelling; rejects signs, separators, whitespace, leading zeros except 0, one-over/overflow, generic cap.<token>, untagged, path, locator, credential, and mismatched-profile forms; covers acquisition, private broker conversion, affine ownership, read/write scope, root identity/generation, revocation, freshness, alias/overlap, no ambient path reopening, deterministic close/drain; proves POSIX/Windows PreExistingEmpty has PopulateEmptyDestination but no AcquireExclusiveLease and ContentStore PreExistingEmpty alone has Enumerate+AcquireExclusiveLease; and redacts every presentation payload, resolved handle, path, credential, and physical transaction key.

8. Publication/recovery proof reconstructs PlannedPreIntentObjectSetRootV1 from lifecycle, terminal, inventory, manifest, and artifacts excluding intent/Seal; derives PublicationKeyV1 only from invocation/manifest/selection/DestinationResourceBindingRootV1/planned root; constructs PublicationIntentV1 without its own root; defines actual PreSealObjectSetRoot as planned objects plus intent and no Seal; admits ProvenDurablePreSealV2 only after that actual set is durable; and requires DurablePublicationIdentityV2 to bind DestinationResourceBindingRootV1 and both roots before Seal. Every intent/self/pre-seal/key/Seal/final feedback or destination-substitution mutation fails. It crashes at every planned-object, intent, actual-pre-seal, proof, Seal, rename/CAS, final sync/commit, result-encoding, flush, and return barrier. Exact already-published output reconstructs the same receipt; owned partial transactions resume without deletion; foreign or mixed content refuses as collision; ambiguous state never fabricates success.

9. Lifecycle/result-transport proof checks exact record_count/order, closed CaseTerminalBasisV2, CaseExecutionPhase/raw presence, shared RunOutcomeBasisRootV2, lifecycle exhaustion/finalized-writer state, forged clean_eof and missing/trailing-byte refusal, result self-root/redundant manifest/seal rejection, exact durable-result preflight and post-receipt re-encode equality, and the complete bounded CommandResultTransportFrameV1 six-field-header-plus-payload contract, with completion proved only by exhaustion and root/context equality. It covers zero, detectably truncated/uncertain, and complete physical outcomes; every compact prefix, the single-pass maximum-cutoff state machine, structural plus deterministic interior maximum-frame offsets, short write/EINTR/broken pipe/flush/return/process-death cases, fresh-channel byte-identical committed retry, and zero authority from a prefix. Delivery observations remain outside identity and the receipt never enters lifecycle.

10. Failure classification proof exercises the complete stage order and within-stage precedence for tamper, unsafe placement, collision, cap, stale generation, unsupported selection, blocked capability/lease, environment I/O/durability failure, cancellation, timeout, and controlled internal failure. DiagnosticCodeV2 code 1 is exactly case.conformance_mismatch and comparison.mismatch is rejected. StopKey arbitration and post-commit recovery are not conflated.

11. Replay plumbing tests cover immutable input, disjoint output, exact current-version acquisition, LifecycleOnlyNoBundle-reference refusal, unknown/future/legacy Unsupported classification, InvocationBasisV2 optional ReplayLineageRootV2 exactly for Replay, no direct duplicated MigrationExecutionBasisRootV2, and exactly one current basis inside ReplayLineageV2. They preserve the exact source durable command, CaseEvaluationKeyV2, expressions/requirements, presented fixtures and optional validated roots, EvaluationPrecontextV2 values, nested expected frames, CaseConformanceSpecRootV2, case-manifest roots, claim modes, actual contexts/outcomes where retained, and zero invocation of source, tracker, producer verdict, or migration adapter code. Only new Run cases force DomainConformance Match/Match; current, nested, migrated, and Negative Replay are never normalized. Successful replay/migration remains downstream.

12. Detailed canonical logs retain derived logical paths and target/key-cap equations; exact PublicationSelection, RunnerBudgets, and RootCapabilityPolicy bindings; nine-field accounting equations; result payload/header/checked-total/root/context preflight/reproduction, complete transport exhaustion, and delivery observations outside identities; artifact/system byte equations; redacted capability-policy and destination-binding roots; lifecycle basis/completion; complete replay key/spec/fixture/precontext/nested-expected/manifest/actual-context/outcome lineage; durability/recovery transitions; first failure, retry/drain/resources/native exit; full publication DAG roots; exact release/manifest/oracle/shard/source-closure roots; count partitions; authority/no-claim; safe reproduction templates; and relative artifacts. ROOT_CAPABILITY_REF payloads, handles/slots, credentials, locators, PIDs, timestamps, duration, and scheduler noise are excluded.

13. Phase closeout records focused proof, parser/codec proof, each backend proof, recovery proof, no-mock E2E, constellation preflight, and applicable DSR status separately. No one green lane erases a blocked platform/backend principal.

14. Estimate accounting is exact: 28 implementation tasks total 18,090 minutes; nine nested internal rollups total 960 minutes; this phase rollup is 60 minutes; and the 38-node phase subtree totals 19,110 minutes. Nested subtree totals are 8,400 for 24.2.1 and 10,650 for 24.2.2. Live hierarchy and `estimated_minutes` fields are authoritative; every decomposed integration estimate is checked separately so implementation, cross-child joins, release E2E, proof, logging, reproduction, and source closure are neither hidden nor double-counted.

15. StableTokenV2 proof is exact rather than Unicode-normalizing: valid lowercase-ASCII grammar is ^[a-z0-9]+([._-][a-z0-9]+)*$ with a 128-byte cap. Literal, unit, property, mutation, and applicable clean-process E2E cases cover constructions at 0/1/64/65/90/127/128/129 bytes with exact accept/refuse outcomes, including empty-token and empty-segment rejection, leading/trailing/repeated separators, uppercase, every non-ASCII input class, canonically equivalent Unicode normalization forms, confusable lookalikes, stale-64 implementations, and any truncation/shortening/alias behavior. Only grammar-valid nonempty values at or below 128 bytes are accepted.

16. Phase-2 rollup tests exact-join parser/codec, launch/bootstrap, capability, publication, recovery, ownership-manifest, transport, native E2E, and proof roots. They cover every bounded invalid Presented fixture, illegal validated-root or fabricated key/precontext-root mint, actual-context-in-expectation, context projection/substitution, both codecs and byte layers, paired inventory, relation-catalog mutations, 257/258 boundaries, resource faults, crash/recovery, native platform routes, and redacted detailed logs. Missing hostile/negative/E2E/source-closure classes, duplicate byte owners, semantic/byte/durability/transport conflation, or any unexpected mismatch blocks closure.

17. Launch/bootstrap proof locks public RunnerLaunchContextV1 and RunnerBootstrapTableV1 for standalone and hosted topologies, exact slot schemas/rights/lifetimes, one-shot child use, acknowledgement, revocation, provider behavior, parent/child races, pre-spawn refusal, async-safe signal notification boundary, and complete resource return. Unit, boundary, property/model, mutation, compile-fail, native-process E2E, detailed-log, and source-closure classes each report nonzero applicable counts.

18. Native portability proof runs each exact manifest and retained DSR release artifact through its source-closed Rust driver plus thin POSIX `.sh` route, and through the suite-owned native Windows route: `.ps1` for publication-state and direct companion driver for publication. It covers lossless POSIX-byte and raw-Windows-UTF-16-code-unit argv, quoting/backslashes/empty/NUL/non-UTF8/unpaired-surrogate cases, exact help/fourteen-field version, first/duplicate/escalated/forced interrupts, semantic-versus-native exits, progress observers, cleanup, and redaction. Cargo/debug/PATH/rebuild and Windows shell-emulation fallbacks fail.

19. Deadline proof binds environmental monotonic wall grants to the provider descriptor, suspend policy, resolution, checked deadline, bounded checkpoint observations, and explicit no-cross-run-bit-stability scope. It never compares host duration, overshoot, or timeout checkpoint as portable proof; logical-work tests remain replay-stable and combined limits do not widen authority.

20. Matrix-scheduling proof assigns each eligible stable cell ID one deterministic shard under the frozen derivation, explicit cell/shard budgets, exact release/manifest/oracle/shard-plan roots, and fail-closed resume state. Aggregation exact-set retains separate execution-started and execution-completed observations and accounts for every eligible stable ID exactly once. Its canonical partitions are: eligible positives and matched positives; eligible expected refusals and matched expected refusals; eligible expected failures and matched expected failures; eligible mutations and matched mutations; typed Unsupported and typed inapplicable cells with exact reasons; unexpected mismatches; execution failures; and unexplained skips. Green requires equality in all four eligible/matched pairs, exact typed reasons, and zero unexpected mismatches, execution failures, or unexplained skips. It retains per-cell, shard, aggregate, log, and source-closure roots with bounded detailed progress and safe reproduction templates.

21. GLOBAL ROLLUP EXACT-SET AND PROOF-STATE RECONCILIATION (CONTROLLING). This rollup owns review and proof aggregation only and cannot substitute parent prose, dependency presence, inherited status, aggregate counts, or a receipt root for direct-child completion. Its close manifest must bind the frozen exact ordered set of direct child IDs, each child status=closed, each child terminal close-manifest root, source-closure root, build/schema/owner/oracle roots, execution or contribution scope, retained relative artifact references, and focused, release-built E2E or contribution, source-closure, constellation, DSR, scientific, and authority proof statuses on one compatible stable snapshot. Missing, extra, duplicate, reordered, stale, reopened, blocked, mixed-snapshot, wrong-owner, wrong-scope, or root-mismatched children refuse; any intentional child-set change requires an explicit revision of this rollup rather than silent discovery. The join preserves separately the nine leaf categories: literal/unit/boundary; property/metamorphic; state/typestate/model/race; mutation/fuzz; API/compile-fail/trait; fault/resource/cancellation; release-built no-mock E2E or immutable E2E contribution; deterministic detailed logging/redaction; and source closure. It also preserves distinct exact ID sets and checked counters for eligible positives and matched positives; eligible expected refusals and matched expected refusals; eligible expected failures and matched expected failures; and eligible mutations and matched mutations; typed Unsupported and typed inapplicable cells with exact registered reasons; unexpected mismatches; execution failures; and unexplained skips. Aggregate totals are checked sums only and cannot replace a subpartition or make an empty/subset selection green. Every child-owned E2E contribution must resolve to exactly one named downstream execution owner/script and every owner must exact-set consume its contributed rows; the rollup cannot claim execution passed from contribution evidence. Child log roots must prove deterministic ordering, bounded retention, complete forbidden-class redaction and sentinel no-echo across observed values, Display, Debug, canonical bytes, logs, and reproduction text. Child source closures must exact-set implementation, contracts, schemas/owners, independent oracles, fixtures, E2E scripts or contribution rows, log schemas, dependencies/features, and build inputs. Closeout reports all proof statuses separately and never promotes focused proof, a child Pass, a no-authority conformance receipt, or a publication/admission result into scientific or authority evidence.

PHASE-2 PRODUCTION-CONTROLLER ROLLUP GATE (CONTROLLING). The rollup exact-set preserves the pure .24.2.2.3 policy/projection/manifest proof and every immutable canonical-harness contribution separately. It cannot convert a focused component Pass or contribution manifest into production process execution. Production controller and canonical process-harness results join only from frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.4.1.3 and frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.4.1.4 on compatible source/build/toolchain/target/exact-feature roots.

ROLLUP FIVE-EXPLICITS AND LOG-COMPLETENESS JOIN (CONTROLLING). This rollup exact-set joins every direct child Five-Explicits root and complete-log root on the same source/build snapshot. Missing, extra, duplicate, stale, mixed, unit-ambiguous, seedless-without-typed-reason, over-budget, capability-incomplete, partially logged, silently truncated, or terminal-less child evidence refuses. Aggregate counts or a parent budget cannot replace any child cell exact explicit values or complete terminal log.

SEMANTIC SEED PROPAGATION AND PROOF JOIN (CONTROLLING). This bead does not invent a second seed type or hidden default. Every owned schema, fixture, command, execution, artifact, replay, verifier, receipt, log, source-closure, E2E row, or rollup join that carries an invocation or case preserves the exact upstream `InvocationSeedSelectionRootV2`, `CaseSeedPolicyV2`, and applicable `CaseExecutionSeedRootV2` or registered `NoRandomness` absence through typed parent bindings. Unit/property/model/race/mutation/API/compile-fail/release-E2E-or-contribution/log/source-closure proof covers omission, substitution, wrong case/run, stale/mixed snapshot, override, ambient randomness, and count-only evidence. Test-harness seeds remain separately typed Five-Explicit data and cannot substitute for the semantic workload seed. Seed evidence establishes reproducibility only and never scientific, publication, verification, or admission authority.

ROLLUP E2E ROUTE RESOLUTION JOIN (CONTROLLING). This rollup exact-set joins every direct child execution/contribution classification and proves a one-to-one mapping from each contribution row to one literal downstream owner, driver, script/native route, and immutable manifest. Every execution owner exact-set consumes its rows once and retains release identity, complete logs, source closure, result partitions, and relative artifacts. Missing, ambiguous, duplicate, stale, remapped, wrong-owner/script, unexecuted, multiply executed, hidden-skip, contribution-only-Pass, or focused-proof substitution refuses.

AC58 DESCENDANT SCHEMA-IMPACT JOIN (CONTROLLING ROLLUP). This rollup owns no implementation schema and may mint no leaf evidence. It consumes the exact SchemaImpactManifestV1 from every recursively contained implementation leaf on one compatible source snapshot and constructs a deterministic descendant join ordered by stable leaf ID, then stable schema ID. The join records exact descendant and schema-row counts plus exact counts for NewV1NoPredecessor, UnchangedV1, MigratedV1ToV2, DecodeOnlyLegacyV1, RetiredV1, and InapplicableNoCanonicalFrame; every count is checked against the literal descendant inventory rather than inferred from status, labels, estimates, source ordinals, or child aggregate totals. It refuses a missing, extra, duplicate, reordered, stale, owner-remapped, cross-rollup, unknown-disposition, incompatible-snapshot, V1/V2-substituted, partial-migration, or multiply aggregated leaf/schema row, and refuses any authoritative V2 close claim while a required descendant is absent or still names an incompatible authoritative V1 parent.

Comprehensive rollup tests cover exact-empty where structurally legal, one descendant, the exact live maximum, one-over injected input, all six dispositions, nested-rollup associativity without double counting, order/shard/schedule/resume invariance, every missing/extra/duplicate/reorder and mixed-snapshot mutation, first explicit divergence, bounded deterministic step-prefixed logging and redaction, structured reproduction, overflow terminal, coverage counters, and exact source closure. A source-closed release-built E2E join consumes only already produced leaf evidence and proves aggregation fidelity; it does not execute descendants, replace their unit/property/model/mutation/API/fault/E2E/log/source-closure gates, or promote focused, DSR, downstream, durability, scientific, or authority proof. CONTRACT/rustdoc and the final rollup report list every descendant schema-impact manifest and all separate proof states.

LIVE ROLLUP TOPOLOGY, SCHEDULING, AND OPERABILITY 2026-07-29 (FINAL CONTROLLING). This issue is a `runner-v2-rollup` epic. Its exact direct hierarchy children are: `frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.2.1`, `frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.2.2`. Its current recursive subtree contains exactly 38 Beads: 28 implementation tasks totaling 18,090 minutes and 10 rollup epics totaling 1,020 minutes, for 19,110 minutes. The 37 internal `parent-child` relations are closure hierarchy only; no reciprocal parent-depends-on-child `blocks` edge is permitted. This rollup's own 60-minute estimate covers only its explicitly named aggregate, integration, join, driver, rerun, source-closure, or close-review work and is not duplicated in child estimates. Functional implementation order remains solely in explicit `blocks` edges among owning tasks. While `br epic status` reports `eligible_for_close=false`, this rollup MUST have status `blocked`, never `open` or `in_progress`; when eligibility becomes true, transition it to `open` or `in_progress` only for its scoped closeout, then close it. The canonical executable-work query is `br ready --epic frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24 --type task`. `bv` robot output is diagnostic only; any surfaced rollup is not executable implementation work. Close this rollup only after every exact child-root, integration, test/E2E, detailed-log/redaction, reproduction, source-closure, proof-state, authority, and no-claim gate in this Bead passes. This clause supersedes every earlier numeric node/estimate/subtotal claim and every earlier phrase treating hierarchy children as reciprocal `blocks` dependencies or this epic as an implementation task. It removes no scope, feature, functionality, test, E2E script/contribution, logging, reproduction, source, route, capability, durability, scientific, admission, authority, or no-claim obligation.

ATOMIC SOURCE OWNER VERSUS INTEGRATION CONTRACT OWNER 2026-07-29 (FINAL CONTROLLING). Every owned schema row separately encodes `implementation_source_owner` and `integration_contract_owner`; equal or different values are explicit and never inferred or collapsed. Atomic parser framing is sourced by `.24.2.1.1.1`, native argument conversion by `.24.2.1.1.2`, and evaluator/parser projection by `.24.2.1.1.3`. Artifact framing is sourced by `.24.2.1.2.1`; Zstd components by `.24.2.1.2.2.1` through `.24.2.1.2.2.4`; inventory by `.24.2.1.2.3`; layout/envelope by `.24.2.1.2.4`; accounting/binding codecs by `.24.2.1.2.5`; and publication-byte DAG/replay proof by `.24.2.1.2.6`. Backend-neutral publication typestate, actual-accounting construction, and receipt semantics are sourced by `.24.2.2.2.1`; POSIX, Windows, and ContentStore effects by `.24.2.2.2.2`, `.24.2.2.2.3`, and `.24.2.2.2.4`; cross-backend oracle by `.24.2.2.2.5.2`; and release projection by `.24.2.2.2.5.3`. Rollups may own only their explicitly frozen integration-contract and route rows. Schema-impact/source-closure literal, unit, property, model, mutation, API/compile-fail, E2E, logging, and source-closure tests reject a rollup listed as an atomic implementation source owner, a leaf listed as an implicit integration owner, or any collapsed, missing, stale, remapped, or mixed-snapshot owner role.

ROLLUP CLOSEOUT DISCOVERABILITY AND MANUAL-EVIDENCE GATE 2026-07-29 (FINAL CONTROLLING). `br ready --epic frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24 --type task --json --limit 0` is the canonical implementation-task query; `bv` robot output is dependency/impact diagnosis, not executable status. When `br epic status --eligible-only --json` first reports this epic eligible because all direct children are closed, the epic is not automatically complete. Its deterministic closeout view MUST expose any remaining integration/route/join/rerun/review work; exact route ID where applicable; immutable command/driver/manifest descriptor; compatible source/build/schema roots; unresolved stable cells and proof states; expected result partitions; retained relative artifact root; retryability; no-claim scope; and uniquely ranked non-executable repairs. A route-owning or integration-owning epic must be claimed and its own acceptance evidence completed before explicit close; task-only queries must not make that work disappear, and automatic bulk epic closure cannot substitute for it.

The transition from blocked -> eligible closeout -> in-progress closeout -> explicitly closed is deterministic and logged. Literal/unit, state/model/race, mutation, API/compile-fail, fault/cancellation, integrated E2E or child-evidence replay, detailed logging/redaction, reproduction, exact coverage, and source-closure tests cover premature surfacing, hidden remaining route work, missing/extra/duplicate child roots, stale eligibility, already-complete reruns, failed closeout and safe retry, mixed snapshots, bulk-close substitution, and exact final proof-state separation. Pure review rollups use a typed no-route closeout; no epic may invent or infer an unnamed route merely to become discoverable.
notes:
CURRENT PHASE-2 ACCOUNTING. The live 38-node subtree contains 28 implementation tasks totaling 18,090 minutes and ten rollup epics including this phase gate totaling 1,020 minutes, for 19,110 minutes. Canonical-byte subtree 24.2.1 is 8,400; capability-safe publication subtree 24.2.2 is 10,650. All parser, codec, launch/bootstrap, capability/provider, publication, recovery, complete-result transport, native-platform E2E, detailed-log/redaction, reproduction, ownership-manifest, replay-plumbing, and no-authority obligations remain intact. Live hierarchy and `estimated_minutes` fields are authoritative.

FINAL LIVE RECONCILIATION 2026-07-29. The authoritative acceptance clause records 38 subtree Beads, 28 implementation tasks at 18,090 minutes, 10 rollup epics at 1,020 minutes, and 19,110 total minutes, with the exact direct hierarchy-child set and blocked-until-eligible rollup status rule. Earlier accounting, task/rollup classification, reciprocal child-block wording, and zero-minute integration claims are superseded; all functional, test/E2E, logging, reproduction, source-closure, route, authority, and no-claim obligations remain intact.

title: Runner V2 canonical-byte, artifact-codec, and command-result transport exact-root rollup
description:
Closeout-only integration rollup for three bounded Phase-2 byte-contract scopes: canonical/native parsing rollup 24.2.1.1, artifact-codec/layout/accounting/publication-DAG rollup 24.2.1.2, and command-result payload/transport task 24.2.1.3. It exact-joins their recursively complete source, build, schema, owner, test, E2E-contribution, detailed-log/redaction, reproduction, coverage, and no-claim roots on one stable snapshot. It implements no parser, codec, root constructor, writer, effect, publication transition, migration, science, admission, or authority.

## Success Criteria

The dedicated Acceptance Criteria field is the canonical review and close gate. All three direct scopes and their 13 implementation tasks, singular ownership tables, exact source/build/schema/test/E2E/log/reproduction roots, no-feedback checks, and proof-state separations must agree on one stable snapshot; this rollup cannot manufacture a missing child result.
design:
The live byte contract is deliberately decomposed into 13 implementation tasks and three nested integration rollups beneath this 60-minute join without removing any feature. Parallelism follows explicit functional dependencies; hierarchy alone never makes a rollup executable.

24.2.1.1 owns bounded native-byte and canonical-document framing, hostile JSON/JSONL and typed-document parsing, lossless POSIX-byte and raw-Windows-UTF-16-code-unit argv decoding, presentation/evaluator projections, and independent parser proof. Base task 24.1.1.1.1 solely owns StableTokenV2 grammar, checked construction, and the 128-byte cap; 24.2.1.1 consumes that type and cannot redefine, widen, normalize, or bypass it. Parser output is checked presentation data only.

24.2.1.2 consumes that substrate and solely owns ArtifactEncodedRootV2, ArtifactContentRootV2, and StoredObjectRootV2 byte construction; Identity and complete bounded ZstdFrameV1; artifact inventory bytes; BundleLayoutV1; ContentStore keys/envelopes; exact nine-field PublicationAccountingV1; the acyclic planned/key/self-free-intent/pre-seal publication byte DAG; and legacy/current source artifact plumbing. It performs no live resource or durability effect.

24.2.1.3 consumes the shared framing substrate and solely owns RunnerCatalog/LifecycleOnly/Durable payload codecs, the exact six-field CommandResultTransportFrameV1, typed context projections, complete header-plus-payload budgeting, pure size preflight/post-receipt reproduction, full-input/root/context validation, and bounded raw reader/writer outcomes. It owns no semantic result or delivery-policy authority.

The branches may implement in parallel after 24.2.1.1 where their dependencies permit. This rollup owns only exact-set review: every schema/constructor/module/E2E-row/log/source path has one owner; shared interfaces have no duplicated implementation; cap dimensions and cancellation/error vocabularies agree; downstream owner-entry inputs are generated from the three closed child roots. A passing child cannot substitute for another or manufacture a missing root.

Existing top-level publication-state, publication, verifier, canonical-runner, and handoff suites remain solely owned downstream. Children contribute immutable rows/drivers/oracles and exact expected roots without editing duplicate scripts. Platform, focused, DSR-wide, constellation, and authority proof remain separate statuses.

No child or this rollup can turn parsed bytes, nominal artifact roots, or a complete transport frame into semantic evaluator/lifecycle/science, physical capability, publication durability, receipt, candidate, admission, Evidence, or Certified authority.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Children 24.2.1.1, 24.2.1.2, and 24.2.1.3 close on exact compatible source/build/toolchain/target/feature/schema/owner/test/log/coverage roots from one stable snapshot. Missing, stale, mixed, substituted, or prose-only proof blocks the rollup.

2. An independent exact owner-table join places every canonical document, parser, byte root, codec, layout, envelope, accounting frame, publication-DAG frame, payload codec, transport frame, context projection, constructor, module, E2E contribution row, log schema, and source path exactly once. Duplicate, missing, overlapping, or authority-widening ownership fails.

3. Shared parser closeout covers all canonical JSON/JSONL/typed values, limits, streaming/cancellation/error offsets, consumption of the base-owned StableTokenV2 checked type, lossless POSIX-byte/raw-Windows-UTF-16-code-unit argv, grammar/help/version/progress projections, evaluator presented inputs, replay/migration documents, hostile forms, redaction, ranked repairs, comprehensive tests, E2E contributions, detailed logs, reproduction, and source closure. title: Runner V2 canonical/native parsing, evaluator projection, contribution-proof, and source-closure rollup
description:
Decomposed parser-and-proof rollup for bounded canonical document framing, hostile POSIX/native-Windows argument ingestion, presentation-only CLI/meta-action parsing, evaluator document projection, independent malformed corpora, release-E2E contributions, deterministic diagnostics/logs, and source closure. Three atomic children own canonical framing, native argv conversion, and evaluator/proof integration; this epic exact-set joins their compatible roots. Parsing returns checked presentation/document values only and mints no semantic validation, durability, science, admission, or authority.


## Success Criteria

The dedicated Acceptance Criteria field, including its final live rollup topology/accounting reconciliation, is the canonical success gate. Every exact direct child must close on compatible proof and source roots, every assigned aggregate/integration/route obligation must pass, and focused, release-E2E, DSR, durability, scientific, admission, authority, and no-claim statuses must remain separate.
design:
This leaf is the sole owner of canonical framing primitives shared by non-artifact and non-command-result Runner documents: bounded JSON and JSONL, typed values, maps, sets, numbers, roots, logical paths, extension frames, and LF-only document framing. Readers and writers are streaming, preflight every declared allocation and count, poll cancellation at bounded chunk boundaries, preserve stable byte/field/token offsets, and classify the first error by one closed precedence table. Chunking, buffering, locale, scheduler order, and host formatting cannot alter accepted bytes or a typed refusal.

Base work package `.24.1.1.1.1` solely owns `StableTokenV2` grammar, checked nominal construction, and the exact 128-byte cap. This parser rollup and its children own hostile/native-byte acquisition, canonical framing, precise offsets, decoding, and conversion into that checked type; they cannot redefine, widen, normalize, or bypass its grammar, cap, or constructor. They also own non-artifact and non-outer-result document codecs; evaluator presented-input documents; lifecycle records/documents as bytes without lifecycle construction; migration semantic documents and replay-lineage fields without adapter execution; and the schema/descriptor tables required to decode those documents. They handle exact JSON number spelling, integer/rational/decimal widths, map order, duplicate and unknown members, retained extension bounds, nesting, counts, complete-input exhaustion, and truncation/concatenation/trailing-byte refusal.

Native argv acquisition is lossless. POSIX cells consume exact argument bytes. Windows cells consume exact raw UTF-16 code units after the registered standard-library command-line split. Grammar tokens are canonical ASCII; declared textual values must meet their own ASCII or Unicode-scalar contract before canonical UTF-8 encoding. Unpaired surrogates, hidden NUL, invalid UTF-8 where Unicode is required, locale/code-page conversion, lossy replacement, alternate quote parsing, platform normalization, aliases, duplicate/conflicting options, and ambient defaults refuse with bounded redacted diagnostics.

The presentation layer parses ROOT_CAPABILITY_REF and progress-capability-slot:N syntax, generated help/version requests, and the abstract six-command grammar, but it never resolves a slot or performs a capability/resource effect. Help/version use their separate bounded presentation-byte contracts; this leaf decodes or verifies those documents but does not conflate them with CommandResultTransportFrameV1. Evaluator rows at 0, 1, 256, 257, and 258 observations/effects preserve CaseEvaluationKeyV2 and presented roots while remaining unable to fabricate optional validated roots, evaluator errors, lifecycle outcomes, or authority.

This leaf does not own ArtifactEncodedRootV2, ArtifactContentRootV2, StoredObjectRootV2, ArtifactCodecIdV2 execution, BundleLayoutV1, ContentStoreEnvelopeV1, PublicationAccountingV1, the publication byte DAG, RunnerCatalog/result payload codecs, CommandResultTransportFrameV1, live capability brokers, semantic evaluator/lifecycle/result constructors, publisher transitions, receipts, migration execution, science, candidate, admission, or authority. It exports no generic validated-root, digest-role conversion, path-to-capability conversion, callback, or executable parser hook.

Its source-closed E2E contributions are immutable hostile-document, native-argv, help/version/progress, evaluator-wire, and parser-refusal rows consumed by the already designated canonical/publication/verifier/handoff suite owners. It owns no top-level scripts. Canonical bounded JSONL logs retain schema/document kind, byte offset, field/token/argument ordinal, parser stage, cap dimension, chunk plan, expected/observed class, first failure, source/build/toolchain/target/feature roots, ranked safe repair, no-claim, and relative evidence path; hostile raw bytes, capability payloads, secrets, physical paths, and bulk data are excluded.

EXACT CANONICAL-HARNESS CONTRIBUTION ROUTING (CONTROLLING). Every release-process contribution owned by this leaf names downstream owner frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.4.1.4, release driver `canonical-evidence-runner-v2-e2e-driver`, and script `scripts/ci/canonical_evidence_runner_v2.sh`. Each stable row binds its exact category/facet, independent expectation/oracle, semantic inputs, time/memory/work/process/artifact/output/log budgets, schema/log/source/build/toolchain/target/exact-feature roots, expected disposition, ranked repair/no-claim data, and result-free contribution root. The downstream owner must exact-set consume it; this leaf cannot claim production process execution.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Dependency and ownership gates require the exact compatible 24.1.2 schema/lifecycle/CLI root, the 24.1.3.2 generated registry/grammar/coverage root that is an actual blocking dependency, and parent 24.2.1 contract. This leaf owns every shared document-framing and hostile-presentation row exactly once and owns no artifact, transport, effect, semantic, durability, science, or authority constructor.

2. Independent literal tables freeze every owned domain, API/wire version, tag, field order, width, count, terminator, canonical spelling, and error-precedence row without importing production encoder constants. Missing, extra, duplicate, reordered, aliased, unknown, self-rooted, or trailing fields refuse at the exact earliest stage.

3. Canonical JSON/JSONL tests cover empty/minimal/maximal documents; member and map ordering; duplicate keys; unknown retained versus forbidden extensions; all whitespace/escape/UTF-8 forms; invalid encodings; alternate numeric spellings; truncation at every compact-fixture byte; concatenation; and full-input exhaustion.

4. Typed-number and bound tests cover every signed/unsigned width, u128, integer digit limit, rational numerator/denominator and reduction, decimal coefficient/scale, overflow, underflow, zero denominator, noncanonical zero/sign, and allocation-before-validation mutant.

5. Streaming reader/writer model and metamorphic tests vary one-byte/arbitrary chunks, buffering, cancellation position, declared versus actual size, nested count, map/set order, and scheduling. Accepted canonical bytes and roots remain invariant; refusal offset/class remains deterministic; no proportional allocation or output occurs before the relevant cap check.

6. StableTokenV2 tests accept only the exact lowercase-ASCII segmented grammar through 128 bytes and cover 0/1/64/65/90/127/128/129 bytes, leading/trailing/repeated separators, uppercase, non-ASCII, normalization variants, confusables, shortening, truncation, and alias mutants.

7. Lossless native-argv tests run release-built POSIX byte argv and native raw Windows UTF-16 code units argv. They cover empty arguments, all quote/backslash boundaries, hidden NUL where representable, non-UTF8 POSIX bytes, unpaired surrogates, valid Unicode scalars, locale/code-page changes, lossy replacement, option permutations, duplicates/conflicts, exact redacted argument ordinal/offset diagnostics, and zero resource effects on Usage.

8. Grammar/presentation tests exhaust all six semantic commands, help, version, progress-capability-slot, canonical protocol/destination/capability-reference tokens, missing selectors, retired aliases, duplicate/conflicting options, canonical rendering, and separate presentation-byte versus semantic-result transport contracts. Parsing never resolves or retains a live slot.

9. Evaluator-wire tests cover 0/1/256/257/258 presented observations/effects; every key/registry/expression/requirements/fixture/precontext/manifest-context projection; all ten publicly reachable EvaluationError paths; and every missing/duplicate/unexpected/type/unit/dimension/malformed/overflow/limit/registry mutation. No parser path constructs a validated root, raw outcome, verdict, terminal, or authority.

10. Replay/migration document tests preserve current and nested Replay lineage, exact source command, keys/specs/fixtures/precontexts/nested expectations, source depths, migration descriptors, unknown extensions, and no-predecessor/future-version refusal without selecting or executing an adapter.

11. API/compile-fail/dependency tests reject public struct literals, Default, unchecked constructors, arbitrary callbacks, generic digest wrappers or conversions, parser-to-semantic/validated roots, raw capability resolution, artifact-root constructors, frame constructors, publication effects, migration execution, and authority conversions.

12. Boundary/property/model/mutation/fuzz suites separately cover every owned schema, parser stage, count, depth, allocation, native argument, error class, cancellation checkpoint, redaction rule, and no-claim boundary. Independent expectations do not derive from the production parser tables.

13. Release-built no-mock contributions exercise hostile documents, native argv, generated help/version, progress syntax, evaluator presentation rows, clean/truncated input, and exact diagnostics through the designated downstream POSIX and native Windows routes. No Cargo-run, debug binary, PATH lookup, alternate rebuild, Bash-on-Windows substitute, mock, or silently skipped platform cell can close a row.

14. ActionableDiagnosticV2 tests require bounded precise expected/observed values, registered owner/code, retryability, prerequisites, no-claim, and uniquely ranked non-executable RepairActionV2 values. Commands, callbacks, credentials, raw slots, paths, handles, provider payloads, secrets, and automatic mutations are forbidden.

15. Canonical detailed-log tests freeze field order, event sequence, bounded sizes, exact first failure, roots/caps/counts, redaction, safe reproduction template, and relative artifacts. Missing, duplicate, reordered, truncated, secret-bearing, absolute-path, nondeterministic, or bulk-payload events fail.

16. Source closure exact-sets owned modules, consumed interfaces, CONTRACT/rustdoc, schema/domain/owner tables, independent oracles, unit/property/model/mutation/fuzz fixtures, E2E rows/drivers, log schemas, dependency/source/feature identities, and build/toolchain/target/profile inputs. Missing, extra, stale, ambient, unpinned, mixed-snapshot, or duplicate-owner input moves the root or refuses.

17. Exact result accounting records distinct ID sets and counts for eligible positives and matched positives; eligible expected refusals and matched expected refusals; eligible expected failures and matched expected failures; and eligible mutations and matched mutations; typed Unsupported and inapplicable cells with exact matched reasons; unexpected mismatches; execution failures; and unexplained skips. Green requires every stable ID once, nonzero applicable positive and adversarial corpora, equality within each eligible and matched subpartition, exact typed reasons, and zero unexpected mismatches, execution failures, or unexplained skips.

18. Closeout reports focused parser proof, POSIX argv proof, native Windows argv proof, evaluator-wire proof, downstream E2E contribution status, source closure, constellation preflight, and applicable DSR status separately. It makes no artifact-byte, transport, publication, migration-execution, durability, science, candidate, admission, or authority claim.

19. GLOBAL REALITY-CHECK CLOSE-MANIFEST RECONCILIATION (CONTROLLING). Earlier `eligible`/`passed`/`failed` shorthand and any single collapsed `matched expected refusals` counter are compatibility-only and cannot close this leaf. The leaf must expose one result-free, source-authoritative, full-set-only close manifest that exact-sets every stable test and E2E cell into all nine preserved category groups: literal/unit/boundary; property/metamorphic; state/typestate/model/race; mutation/fuzz; API/compile-fail/trait; fault/resource/cancellation; release-built no-mock E2E or immutable E2E contribution; detailed deterministic logging/redaction; and source closure. Each applicable category and each applicable slash-separated facet has a separately nonzero corpus. A genuinely inapplicable facet requires a registered typed reason with stable code/name, exact owner, execution scope, prerequisite, and no-claim text; it cannot hide an eligible cell.

Result accounting retains distinct counters and exact ID sets for: eligible positives and matched positives; eligible expected refusals and matched expected refusals; eligible expected failures and matched expected failures; eligible mutations and matched mutations; typed Unsupported cells with exact matched reasons; typed inapplicable cells with exact matched registered reasons; unexpected mismatches; execution failures; and unexplained skips. It also reports checked aggregate adversarial totals as the sums of the three adversarial subpartitions without replacing them. Green requires each matched subpartition to equal its own eligible subpartition, every eligible stable ID exactly once in canonical order, nonzero applicable positive and adversarial corpora, exact Unsupported/inapplicable reason equality, and zero unexpected mismatches, execution failures, and unexplained skips. An expected failure is never an execution failure, a mutation is never relabeled as a refusal, and an empty/subset selection can never be green. Missing, extra, duplicate, reordered, stale, reclassified, wrong-reason, or wrong-scope manifest/result rows refuse structurally.

Where this leaf owns execution, comprehensive unit/integration/property/model/race/fault/mutation/API tests and the named E2E script run release-built with no mocks. Where execution belongs downstream, this leaf instead emits immutable stable rows binding independent literal expectations/oracles, semantic inputs, explicit time/memory/work/process/artifact/log budgets, schema and log-schema roots, source/build roots, exact downstream owner and script, and no-claim scope; it cannot report that downstream execution passed. E2E tests cover happy, boundary, expected-refusal, expected-failure, mutation, Unsupported, inapplicable, cancellation/drain, resource-return, and hidden-skip cases with deterministic stable IDs and exact first divergence.

Canonical bounded logs retain stable cell/category/facet IDs; semantic-input, source, build, schema, oracle, budget, manifest, and execution roots; ordered stage observations and terminal stage; expected/observed classification; first-divergence ID/root; resource and drain outcomes; exact result partitions; ranked non-executable repair manifest; no-claim scope; and safe relative retained-artifact references. They reject or type-redact secrets, credentials, environment values, live capabilities, raw resources/handles, absolute or physical paths, PIDs, wall clock, scheduler noise, and bulk payloads. Rejection diagnostics retain only a stable redacted data class and must not echo the sentinel through `observed`, Display, Debug, canonical bytes, logs, or reproduction text. Logging tests cover zero/one/exact/one-over limits, checked overflow, missing/extra/duplicate/reordered/truncated events, wrong roots/counts/reasons, redaction for every forbidden class, and deterministic replay.

Every user-visible Refused, Unsupported, divergent Negative, expected failure, and unexpected mismatch carries one bounded deterministic actionable diagnostic with registered code, precise redacted typed expected/observed values, owner, retryability, exact prerequisites, no-claim scope, and uniquely ranked declarative repairs. Repairs cannot contain or invoke commands, callbacks, scripts, credentials, raw capabilities/resources/handles/provider payloads, physical paths/locators, or automatic mutations. Source closure exact-sets all implementation, contract/rustdoc, schema/domain/owner tables, independent oracles, fixtures, E2E manifests/scripts or contribution rows, log schemas, dependencies/features, and build configuration on one compatible stable snapshot. Closeout reports focused proof, release-built E2E or contribution proof, source closure, DSR, and any downstream/scientific/authority proof separately and never promotes one into another.

20. NATIVE ARGUMENT ABI AND DOWNSTREAM OWNERSHIP (CONTROLLING). POSIX argument identity is the exact byte sequence supplied by the registered OsString launch ABI; Windows argument identity is the exact raw UTF-16 code-unit sequence supplied by the registered host launch ABI. This parser MUST NOT rediscover or reinterpret a raw command line through CRT, CommandLineToArgvW, shell, locale, lossy Unicode, or ambient environment rules. Invalid Unicode remains representable and testable. This leaf owns only bounded framing, canonical document parsing, and hostile-input refusal. frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.4.1.3 is the sole production command controller, frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.4.1.4 is the sole canonical release-built process E2E harness, and frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.3.3.1 owns independent decoding. Contribution-only cases from this leaf MUST name the exact downstream script, category, facet, expected disposition, and source closure; they do not count as local process execution.

EXACT CANONICAL-HARNESS CONTRIBUTION GATE (CONTROLLING). Release-process contribution, source-closure, and deterministic-log tests exact-set the downstream owner, `canonical-evidence-runner-v2-e2e-driver`, `scripts/ci/canonical_evidence_runner_v2.sh`, stable cell IDs, all result partitions, and compatible source/build/toolchain/target/exact-feature roots frozen in Design. Missing, alternate, stale, duplicate, remapped, shell-only, debug/PATH, authority-bearing, or result-contaminated rows refuse.

FIVE EXPLICITS DECLARATION, RUNTIME-EVIDENCE, AND COMPLETE-LOG GATE (CONTROLLING). Every stable literal, unit, boundary, property, metamorphic, state, typestate, model, race, mutation, fuzz, API, fault, and E2E cell binds one declaration-side Five Explicits contract: typed units for every numeric input, numeric grant, and expected numeric observation; one canonical seed declaration plus generator/minimizer version, or a registered `SeedInapplicable` code with owner, scope, prerequisite, and no-claim; seven-axis hard and soft time, memory, logical-work, process, artifact, output, and log budgets with process shape declared separately; exact API, wire, schema, source, build, toolchain, target, profile, and feature version requirements; one exact required/permitted semantic capability contract; and the exact no-claim. title: Runner V2 command-result payload codecs, bounded transport framing, and delivery-byte state machine
description:
Implement canonical command-result payload codecs and the bounded six-field CommandResultTransportFrameV1 reader/writer state machine. This leaf proves exact transport of an independently valid semantic payload in its expected typed context; it owns no semantic result constructor, delivery-observation/failure policy, publication, receipt, lifecycle, admission, or authority.

## Acceptance Criteria

The dedicated Acceptance Criteria field is the canonical close gate. Every numbered criterion must pass on one compatible stable snapshot; prose, a count-only summary, or an inherited rollup status cannot substitute for the named roots and retained evidence.
design:
This leaf is the sole byte owner for RunnerCatalogV2, LifecycleOnlyCommandResultV2, and DurableCommandResultV2 payload codecs and for CommandResultTransportFrameV1 plus the typed CommandResultTransportContextV1 descriptor/root. It contributes exactly the new transport-frame and typed-context descriptor rows to RunnerPhase2SchemaOwnershipManifestV2. The Phase-1 payload schemas remain singularly owned upstream: RunnerCatalogV2 by 24.1.1.3.2.3; LifecycleOnlyCommandResultV2 and DurableCommandResultV2 by 24.1.2.4; and their generated ownership registry by 24.1.3.2. This Phase-2 contribution references those exact upstream owners and must not relist their data-schema rows. The exact header is API generation, wire version, closed frame kind, payload encoded length, frame-kind-selected nominal payload root, and typed CommandResultTransportContextRootV1, followed immediately by exactly that many canonical payload bytes. It has no completion field, frame self-root, or feedback into semantic identity.

CommandResultTransportContextRootV1 projections are exact and typed: Catalog binds List plus RunnerSpecRoot; Lifecycle binds command, InvocationRoot, RunId, and RunTerminalRecordRoot; Durable binds the lifecycle context plus PublishedBundleReceiptRoot. A consumer yields no payload/result until the complete header and payload parse, exact payload length, full-input/outer-stream exhaustion, independently recomputed nominal payload root, and independently recomputed typed context root all agree.

RunnerBudgetsV2.command_result_stdout_bytes caps the complete header-plus-payload frame. Pure fixed-shape preflight separately computes semantic payload length, fixed header length, and checked total before publication where possible. After receipt construction, durable encoding must reproduce identical payload bytes, payload length, and total before delivery. Header bytes never enter PublicationAccountingV1, receipt, payload identity, or another grant.

The bounded writer primitive reports raw write outcomes only: zero progress, arbitrary short writes, EINTR, EOF/broken reader, EPIPE/SIGPIPE-equivalent, Windows broken pipe, cancellation, timeout, flush failure, complete-write/return uncertainty, and local return. Physical outcomes are zero bytes, detectably truncated prefix, or one complete decodable frame. A prefix, exit code, or locally complete write alone carries no consumer authority. Fresh-channel retry may re-emit byte-identical committed output but never stitch prefixes.

Semantic result schemas, checked constructors, and nominal semantic roots remain owned by 24.1.2.4; 24.1.2 is their compatible exact-set gate. CommandResultDeliveryObservationV1, outer failure precedence, producer exit mapping, and controller policy remain 24.2.2.3. This leaf never constructs lifecycle, publication accounting, key/intent, durability, receipt, candidate, request, conformance, science, or authority and exposes no generic digest/root conversion.

Source-closed transport rows contribute complete/truncated/broken-pipe/flush/uncertain-return/retry cases to the designated publication, canonical-runner, verifier, and handoff suites; this leaf owns no top-level script. Detailed logs retain frame kind, declared/observed payload and total lengths, payload/context/root checks, byte/chunk offsets, attempted/written/flush/return/error/retry observations, exact grant, first refusal, source/build/schema/toolchain/target/feature roots, ranked repair, no-claim, and relative artifacts while excluding payload bodies, raw resources, capabilities, secrets, PIDs, time, and scheduler noise.

title: Runner V2 capability-safe atomic publication, idempotent recovery, and deterministic receipt reconstruction
description:
Closeout-only integration rollup for three bounded Phase-2 direct scopes: capability/bootstrap/provider rollup 24.2.2.1; publication-typestate/native-adapter/recovery/receipt rollup 24.2.2.2 with its nested cross-backend E2E/proof join; and delivery-policy/Phase-2 ownership/focused-proof rollup 24.2.2.3. Their 15 implementation tasks remain singular owners. This parent exact-set joins compatible roots and performs no capability parsing, physical effect, provider operation, publication transition, receipt construction, delivery, test cell, or authority action.

## Success Criteria

The dedicated Acceptance Criteria field is the canonical rollup gate. This Bead implements no capability parser, FFI primitive, provider operation, publisher state transition, receipt constructor, outer-result delivery, failure mapping, test case, or schema manifest entry.
design:
The former monolithic publication task is decomposed into an implementable dependency chain without removing any feature.

24.2.2.1 depends on 24.2.1.2 and owns the runtime authority/effect substrate: exact ROOT_CAPABILITY_REF brokers and affine capabilities; rooted self-root-free DestinationResourceBindingV1 with stable privacy-preserving ResourceIdentityRootV2; same-resource/new-slot stability and different-resource substitution defense; exact least-privilege rights; safe Franken/asupersync primitives where proved; narrowly audited raw POSIX/Windows FFI leaves only where necessary; a private sealed non-wire ContentStoreCapabilityV1; a versioned ContentStoreProviderConformanceRootV1; and a persistent publish-false FrankenSQLite reference provider with release-built restart/conformance E2E; and the only later fs-evidence-runner direct dependency rows, asupersync with no explicit feature and fsqlite with exact async-api, plus exact lock/feature/transitive/source closure.

24.2.2.2 depends on 24.2.2.1 and owns the publication/recovery typestate: singular selection with separate budgets/policies/destination binding; full logical layout and derived ContentStore keys; exact nine-field PublicationAccountingV1; PlannedPreIntentObjectSetRootV1; PublicationKeyV1 binding DestinationResourceBindingRootV1; self-root-free PublicationIntentV1; actual PreSealObjectSetRoot; ProvenDurablePreSealV2; DurablePublicationIdentityV2 binding destination plus both roots; backend-specific durability; Seal/final commit/PublishedBundleReceipt; deterministic owned-transaction resume; exact committed-output recovery; cancellation/drain; no deletion; and focused fault/tamper/log proof.

24.2.2.3 depends on 24.2.2.2 and the exact 24.1.3.2 Phase-1 registry root. It owns exact semantic-payload and full-frame budget preflight, upstream fully staged outer-result construction and bounded write/flush/return delivery control, non-authoritative CommandResultDeliveryObservationV1, the closed failure table, cross-backend process-fault/recovery E2E, direct no-mock script/case manifest, source/coverage/log joins, and separately rooted append-only non-authoritative RunnerPhase2SchemaOwnershipManifestV2. The manifest points to RunnerPhase1SchemaOwnershipRegistryV2, uses the same owner-entry vocabulary, never embeds in or moves RunnerSpecV2, and is joined beside other phase manifests later.

The chain preserves every POSIX, Windows, ContentStore, Absent, PreExistingEmpty, ROOT_CAPABILITY_REF, layout/path/key, accounting, lifecycle, result, publication, fault, recovery, collision, tamper, cancellation, timeout, no-deletion, unsafe-audit, provider-conformance, E2E, logging, redaction, and no-authority requirement from the former leaf. It corrects two implementability gaps: exact OS durability may require a minimal audited FFI leaf rather than safe std alone, and a real ContentStore proof requires a concrete sealed interface plus persistent allowed provider rather than an unspecified network client.

The rollup closes only on exact compatible child source/build/schema/policy/ABI/conformance/test/coverage/log roots from one stable snapshot. A passing reference provider does not prove any external provider; a passing POSIX cell does not prove Windows; static review does not replace release-built backend proof; and result delivery failure does not alter already-proved publication authority.


## Public launch, result transport, and native E2E reconciliation

The rollup now makes external launchability an explicit cross-child invariant. It exact-joins the 24.2.2.1-owned `RunnerLaunchContextV1` and one-shot `RunnerBootstrapTableV1` for `StandaloneOsProcessV1` and `HostedLibraryV1`, including inherited POSIX descriptors, inherited Windows handles, and opaque hosted ContentStore provider tokens.
