title: Runner V2 launch/bootstrap ABI, affine capability broker, stable destination binding, progress sink, and replay disjointness
description:
Implement the platform-neutral launch/bootstrap and affine capability boundary for Runner V2. Own checked handoff semantics, stable destination-resource binding, progress noninterference, replay source/destination separation, and non-authoritative verifier-input acquisition observations without owning any POSIX, Windows, or ContentStore primitive implementation.

## Acceptance Criteria

The dedicated Acceptance Criteria field is the canonical complete close gate. It preserves the domain-specific gate and the common nine-group unit/property/model/race/mutation/API/fault/E2E-or-contribution/logging/source-closure protocol; no description shorthand, checkpoint, parent status, aggregate count, or partial proof can replace it.
design: SOLE OWNERSHIP. Own RunnerLaunchContextV1, RunnerBootstrapTableV1, the supported-topology table, affine broker/capability-handle semantics, DestinationResourceBindingV1 semantic construction and resource-identity-policy abstraction, progress-sink capability, replay input/output disjointness, rights/freshness/revocation/generation checks, and VerifierInputAcquisitionObservationV1. Own shared CapabilityProviderEventV1 and BackendPrimitiveEventV1 schemas and checked constructors; backend children emit but never redefine them. Own the exact direct asupersync dependency row with no explicit feature and its source/feature closure. Emit immutable RunnerCapabilityBootstrapE2EContributionManifestV1. No platform primitive, FFI/unsafe boundary, provider operation, publisher transition, process controller, receipt, scientific, admission, or authority implementation is owned here.
acceptance_criteria:
DOMAIN CLOSE GATE. ROOT_CAPABILITY_REF handoff tests cover all tags/ranges/kinds/rights/profiles, wrong-kind/range/stale/duplicate/remapped handoffs without parser reimplementation, bootstrap table zero/one/exact/one-over cardinality/version/transfer, same-resource versus different-resource identity, slot-renumbering invariance, affine move/borrow/consume/return/close, progress absent/slow/full/closed/failing noninterference, source/output same-reference/alias/disjointness, revocation/generation/provider-policy movement, caller/table/child/transfer races, public-API escape attempts, cancellation/panic/timeout, and exact return. Immutable contributions bind the focused provider owner .24.2.2.1.5 and canonical harness owner .24.4.1.4 separately; no local process execution is claimed.

COMMON IMPLEMENTATION-LEAF CLOSE PROTOCOL (CONTROLLING). The nine preserved groups are literal/unit/boundary; property/metamorphic; state/typestate/model/race; mutation/fuzz; API/compile-fail/trait; fault/resource/cancellation; release-built no-mock E2E or immutable E2E contribution; deterministic detailed logging/redaction; and source closure. (1) Exact dependency, singular owner, schema/domain/constructor, source, build, toolchain, target, feature, policy, and consumed-root gates close on one compatible stable snapshot; missing, extra, duplicate, stale, mixed, reverse, shadow, or authority-widening ownership refuses. (2) Separately nonzero applicable literal, unit, and boundary corpora cover zero, one, exact, and one-over every count/size/rank/budget plus checked overflow before proportional allocation. (3) Separately nonzero applicable property and metamorphic corpora cover every declared invariance and semantic root-movement rule. (4) Separately nonzero applicable state, typestate, model, and race corpora cover every legal/illegal transition and bounded relevant interleaving. (5) Separately nonzero applicable mutation and fuzz corpora exercise every owned discriminant, field, edge, root, precedence row, limit, and authority boundary; every eligible mutant receives an exact outcome. (6) Separately nonzero applicable API, compile-fail, trait, doctest, dependency, and import-isolation corpora reject public literals, Default/bypass construction, callbacks/code-bearing data, raw resource escape, ambient discovery, generic-root substitution, reverse dependencies, and durability/scientific/admission/authority conversion. (7) Separately nonzero applicable fault, resource, cancellation, drain, quiescence, and return corpora inject each allocation/I-O/state boundary, require bounded cancellation polling, exact first failure, complete drain, and zero leaked task, arena, buffer, capability, descriptor, handle, lease, statement, transaction, provider token, or child resource. (8) Every owned E2E runs the exact named release binary/script with no mocks; non-owned execution is an immutable stable contribution naming exactly one downstream owner/driver/script, independent oracle, semantic inputs, explicit time/memory/work/process/artifact/output/log budgets, schema/log/source/build roots, expected disposition, and no-claim. Contributions cannot claim downstream execution. (9) Canonical bounded deterministic logs retain stable cell/category/facet IDs; semantic/source/build/schema/owner/oracle/budget/manifest/execution roots; ordered stages and terminal stage; expected/observed class; first divergence; drain/resource outcome; exact partitions; ranked declarative repairs; no-claim; and relative artifacts. Logs reject or type-redact credentials, environment values, live capabilities/resources, provider payloads, raw handles, physical/absolute paths, PIDs, wall time, scheduler noise, and bulk payloads. A rejected sentinel cannot echo through observed values, Display, Debug, canonical bytes, logs, diagnostics, or reproduction text. (10) Source closure exact-sets implementation, CONTRACT/rustdoc, schemas/domains/owners, independent oracles, fixtures, E2E scripts or contribution rows, log schemas, dependencies/features, and build configuration. (11) One source-authoritative full-set-only close manifest preserves all nine categories and distinct exact ordered ID sets and checked counters for eligible positives and matched positives; eligible expected refusals and matched expected refusals; eligible expected failures and matched expected failures; and eligible mutations and matched mutations; typed Unsupported and inapplicable cells with exact registered reasons; unexpected mismatches; execution failures; and unexplained skips. Green requires equality in every eligible/matched pair, every eligible ID once, nonempty applicable positive and adversarial corpora, exact reasons, and zero unexpected mismatches, execution failures, or unexplained skips; empty/filtered subsets cannot pass. (12) Every user-visible Refused, Unsupported, expected failure, divergent Negative, or unexpected mismatch carries a bounded deterministic actionable diagnostic with exact owner, retryability, prerequisites, no-claim, and uniquely ranked non-executable repairs. (13) Closeout reports focused, release-built E2E or contribution, source-closure, constellation, DSR, downstream, platform, durability, scientific, and authority proof statuses separately and never promotes one into another.

FIVE EXPLICITS DECLARATION, RUNTIME-EVIDENCE, AND COMPLETE-LOG GATE (CONTROLLING). Every stable literal, unit, boundary, property, metamorphic, state, typestate, model, race, mutation, fuzz, API, fault, and E2E cell binds one declaration-side Five Explicits contract: typed units for every numeric input, numeric grant, and expected numeric observation; one canonical seed declaration plus generator/minimizer version, or a registered `SeedInapplicable` code with owner, scope, prerequisite, and no-claim; seven-axis hard and soft time, memory, logical-work, process, artifact, output, and log budgets with process shape declared separately; exact API, wire, schema, source, build, toolchain, target, profile, and feature version requirements; one exact required/permitted semantic capability contract; and the exact no-claim. Runtime actual numeric observations, resolved seed provenance, budget reconciliation, observed versions, and actual required, granted, observed, returned, and revoked capability sets exist only inside disposition-gated runtime evidence. `Observed` requires complete actuals; `NotObserved` may retain only safe typed partial evidence plus its exact reason and cannot substitute expected values; `Deferred` and `Inapplicable` contain no fabricated actuals. Changing any applicable declaration or actual explicit moves exactly the intended component, cell, evidence, log, reproduction, aggregate, and report roots. Bounded log writers reserve sufficient bytes for one canonical terminal event before admitting detail events. The first event that would exceed the remaining detail budget emits one complete deterministic `LogBudgetExceeded` terminal containing the rejected event class and ordinal, digest, omitted count, applicable budget, first-divergence stage, disposition, drain/resource outcome, diagnostic owner, repair-manifest root, and no-claim. Partial JSONL, silent truncation, overwriting prior events, missing terminal state, expected-as-actual substitution, fabricated observed-empty data, or treating overflow as success refuses. Minimized reproduction evidence retains every applicable declaration and safe actual explicit without exposing a forbidden value.

E2E ROUTE OBLIGATION MANIFEST GATE (CONTROLLING). Every leaf owns one exact ordered route-obligation manifest rather than a lossy leaf-wide binary. Each applicable obligation appears exactly once with `LeafCloseRouteObligationKindV1`: 1 `LocalInProcess`, 2 `ExecutionOwned`, 3 `ContributionOnly`, or 4 `Inapplicable`; zero and unknown refuse. A LocalInProcess row binds the real public in-process entry point, immutable cell oracle, budgets, expected partitions, detailed-log schema/root, source closure, and no-mock no-authority boundary. An ExecutionOwned row binds one literal release driver, POSIX wrapper where applicable, direct native-Windows driver or PowerShell wrapper as frozen by the owner contract, immutable case-manifest path/root, exact close argv, release-artifact identity, platform/provider matrix, declared capability profile, runtime evidence-envelope contract, retained relative artifacts, and complete detailed-log root. A ContributionOnly row binds one immutable result-free payload and Deferred envelope to exactly one downstream execution owner plus its literal driver, script/native route, manifest, observer contract, budgets, expected partitions, logging schema, source/build roots, and no-claim; it cannot report downstream execution passed. An Inapplicable row binds one registered reason, owner, scope, prerequisite, and no-claim. The derived leaf class is exactly `LocalOnly`, `ExecutionOnly`, `ContributionOnly`, or `Mixed`; multiple obligations and multiple contribution rows are legal and must remain distinct. Missing, extra, duplicate, reordered, generic, ambiguous, rollup-owned, stale, remapped, wrong-script, unconsumed, multiply consumed, debug, ambient/PATH-resolved/alternate/unregistered Cargo-run, hidden-skip, contribution-as-execution, or inferred leaf-class routes refuse. A specifically registered source-closed focused probe is legal only when its owner Bead names it and remains separately labeled non-closing evidence. Unit/exact-set, property/model, mutation, API/compile-fail, no-mock in-process or release-built E2E/contribution, deterministic detailed-log/redaction, structured-reproduction, resume/shard, overflow, and source-closure tests cover empty, one, maximum, mixed, duplicate, reorder, route substitution, owner remap, and every row-kind/derived-class transition. Focused/unit proof cannot substitute for a required release-built row or immutable contribution contract.

EXACT CAPABILITY-PROVIDER ROUTE OBLIGATION (CONTROLLING). This leaf owns the immutable `ContributionOnly` row `runner-v2.route.24-2-2-1-1.to.capability-provider.v1` consumed exactly once by owner `.24.2.2.1.5`, driver `e2e-evidence-runner-capability-provider-v2-driver`, POSIX wrapper `scripts/ci/e2e_evidence_runner_capability_provider_v2.sh`, native Windows wrapper `scripts/ci/e2e_evidence_runner_capability_provider_v2.ps1`, and case manifest `scripts/ci/manifests/evidence_runner_capability_provider_v2_cases.v1.json`. The row binds declared profile `fs-evidence-runner.close-capability.release-publication.v1`, exact payload and source/build/schema/log roots, platform/provider prerequisite matrix, observer-contract root, all per-cell/shard budgets, expected partitions, retained-relative-artifact policy, no-claim, and a distinct Deferred evidence-envelope root using reason code 1; it carries no fabricated actuals and makes no provider execution, effect, return, durability, or authority claim. The owner exact-set consumes each bootstrap/POSIX/Windows/ContentStore contribution once and rejects missing, extra, duplicate, reordered, stale, remapped, wrong-profile/provider/wrapper/manifest, multiply consumed, payload-as-envelope, and contribution-as-execution rows. Unit/boundary, property/model/race, grant/use/return/revoke mutation and barrier-fault/cancellation, API/compile-fail, immutable-contribution plus release-built native E2E, deterministic step-prefixed logging/redaction, structured reproduction, overflow/resume, resource reconciliation, coverage, and source-closure tests prove this row. Additional routes remain separate registered rows.

AC57 EVIDENCE-DISPOSITION CONSUMER GATE (CONTROLLING). This leaf consumes, and MUST NOT redefine, the exact evidence-kind, RuntimeObservationDispositionV1, reason-registry, completeness, safe-partial-evidence, resource-reconciliation, EvidenceEnvelopeV1, and FirstDivergentExplicitComponentV1 contracts governed by program gate `.24.1.1.1` and base contract owner `.24.1.1.1`. Every stable local cell and every exact route-obligation row maps to one and only one legal evidence-kind/disposition pair. OwnedHarnessExecution and InProcessProjectionExecution admit only Observed or NotObserved; ImmutableDownstreamContribution admits only Deferred; ApplicabilityDeclaration admits only Inapplicable. LocalInProcess and ExecutionOwned work may close Observed only after a completed attempt supplies every applicable actual numeric-observation, observed-seed-disposition, budget-reconciliation, observed-version, observed-capability-set, execution-completeness, attempt-identity, retained-state, and resource-reconciliation root. A matched refusal, expected failure, executed Unsupported outcome, or mutation survivor/kill remains Observed when observation is complete; semantic outcome never substitutes for observation disposition.

NotObserved is fail-closed and uses exactly one registered reason: 1 execution-failed-before-completeness, 2 observation-channel-failed-before-completeness, or 3 unexpected-unstarted-or-skipped. It preserves attempt and payload identity and may preserve only a separately rooted redacted safe-partial-evidence object; it never copies expected values into actual fields, encodes missing actuals as observed-empty, claims successful execution, or permits a green aggregate. Every ContributionOnly row emits exactly one result-free upstream payload plus a distinct Deferred envelope with reason 1 immutable-contribution-awaits-designated-release-owner and the designated owner/driver/native-or-script route/manifest/observer contract; the designated owner later emits a separate execution envelope and cannot overwrite, alias, or promote the upstream envelope. Inapplicable is legal only for a predeclared exact source-registered applicability descriptor and cannot be synthesized from runtime skip, infrastructure failure, unsupported provider discovery, or missing observation.

The leaf's result, report contribution, stage evidence, runtime aggregate, detailed cell event, log context, structured reproduction, normal terminal, overflow terminal, bounded prefix, final bounded log, route contribution, and source closure exact-join the applicable declaration components, runtime disposition, and envelope root. Actual component roots are present only for Observed; every non-Observed form carries exact typed absence plus its reason/descriptor and no-claim. Comparisons use the AC57 exact twenty-position FirstDivergentExplicitComponentV1 precedence and stop at the first unequal applicable component without logging rejected raw values. Unit and literal-oracle tests cover every owned legal row; zero/unknown code and complete/partial/absent boundaries; property/model/state/typestate laws; mutation and API/compile-fail barriers; no-mock in-process or release-built owner E2E, or immutable contribution plus owner-consumption E2E; execution/observation/grant/use/return/revoke/cancellation/resource faults; deterministic step-prefixed detailed logging, redaction, structured reproduction, overflow-before-divergence, shard/resume, and one-component root movement; exact coverage partitions; and source closure. Tests MUST reject every illegal kind/disposition/reason pair, expected-as-actual, observed-empty-as-complete, payload-as-envelope, upstream-as-owner envelope, contribution-as-execution, applicability-as-skip, duplicate/missing/reordered evidence, hidden skip, forbidden-value echo, and stale or mixed-snapshot root.

AC58 SCHEMA-IMPACT CONSUMER AND MIGRATION GATE (CONTROLLING). This leaf consumes, and MUST NOT redefine, the canonical-schema migration registry and independent literal schema oracle owned by base contract owner `.24.1.1.1` under program gate `.24.1.1.1`. Its exact source-authoritative SchemaImpactManifestV1 classifies every canonical frame, nominal root, registry, manifest, log event, terminal, report, projection, contribution, route envelope, and structured-reproduction schema that this leaf owns or consumes exactly once by stable schema ID and exact u16 disposition: 1 NewV1NoPredecessor, 2 UnchangedV1, 3 MigratedV1ToV2, 4 DecodeOnlyLegacyV1, 5 RetiredV1, or 6 InapplicableNoCanonicalFrame. Each row binds API generation, wire version and wire-predecessor policy, separate canonical-schema migration policy, exact domain, magic, ordered field descriptors, nominal root role, owner, source path, authoritative/compatibility status, allowed parent/child versions, no-claim, and compatible-source-snapshot root. Zero/unknown codes and missing, extra, duplicate, reordered, owner-inferred, route-inferred, stale, or mixed-snapshot rows refuse.

Wire compatibility and canonical-schema migration are non-interchangeable. API generation 2, wire version 1, and Runner wire predecessor NoPredecessor remain separate from canonical-schema policies NoSchemaPredecessor, V1DecodeOnlyCompatibilityEvidence, and V1Retired. A new component may begin at V1 only when it has no canonical predecessor. Every enclosing schema whose field order, field meaning, canonical payload, or authority semantics changes rotates coherently to a distinct V2 type, `.v2` domain, versioned magic, field table, and V2 nominal root on the same compatible source snapshot. An unchanged V1 child is legal inside a V2 parent only when the independent oracle explicitly records that unchanged component role and exact position. Decode-only or retired V1 bytes never alias, parse as, substitute for, or close an authoritative V2 path; partial migration, V2-parent/V1-child substitution outside an allowed unchanged slot, generic ContentHash bridging, transmute-like accessors, shared domains/magics, compatibility aliases, and caller-minted roots refuse.

Every literal/unit/boundary, property/metamorphic, state/model/race, mutation/fuzz, API/compile-fail, fault/resource/cancellation, no-mock E2E or immutable-contribution, deterministic detailed-log/redaction, structured-reproduction, coverage, and source-closure fixture owned by this leaf names the authoritative schema versions and compatible snapshot. Tests freeze every V1 compatibility byte fixture before migration; exhaust exact-empty, one, exact maximum, one-over, missing/extra/duplicate/reordered rows; mutate every domain, magic, version, policy, field descriptor, nominal role, source owner, parent/child version, and snapshot; prove exact root movement and typed inspectability; reject V1/V2 and cross-role substitution, old-root-as-new-root, stale literal counts, and partial or mixed-snapshot migration; and exercise the exact release-built route or immutable contribution plus designated-owner consumption with step-prefixed logs, first explicit divergence, structured reproduction, overflow/resume, retained-relative-artifact policy, and no forbidden-value echo. CONTRACT/rustdoc, public accessors, route manifests, detailed log schemas, reproduction descriptors, coverage manifests, source closure, and all literal ratchets MUST agree on the same authoritative version; focused, strict-remote, release-built E2E, DSR, downstream, durability, scientific, and authority results remain separate proof states.

EXACT ORDERED LEAF ROUTE MANIFEST SUMMARY (CONTROLLING). The source-authoritative LeafCloseRouteObligationManifestV1 for this leaf contains exactly one row in kind-code then stable-route-ID order: runner-v2.route.24-2-2-1-1.to.capability-provider.v1. Exact counts are LocalInProcess=0, ExecutionOwned=0, ContributionOnly=1, and Inapplicable=0; the derived class is exactly ContributionOnly. Every prior route-specific criterion on this Bead specifies one of these same rows and does not create a duplicate. No prose-only owner, dependency, test fixture, schema provenance edge, focused probe, rollup mapping, or transitive consumer becomes an implicit route. Adding, removing, merging, splitting, or remapping a journey requires updating this exact list, its independent registry oracle, AC56 capability profile, AC57 evidence kind/disposition, AC58 schema-impact row, coverage ratchet, detailed-log/reproduction schemas, and source closure atomically.

Independent unit/exact-set and zero/one/exact/one-over manifest tests, kind-order and derived-class properties, owner/consumer model tests, every-row mutation, API/compile-fail nominal privacy, no-mock local/release/contribution E2E as applicable, disposition/capability/resource/cancellation faults, deterministic step-prefixed detailed logging/redaction/no-echo, structured reproduction, overflow-before-divergence, shard/resume, exact result partitions, and source closure reconstruct this list without reading the production registry table. They reject missing, extra, duplicate, reordered, stale, unknown-kind, inferred-class, wrong owner/profile/driver/wrapper/manifest/entrypoint, contribution-as-execution, local-as-release, applicability-as-skip, transitive-route invention, hidden skip, and mixed-snapshot rows.

ROUTE-SCHEMA V2 AND PROOF-DAG RECONCILIATION (CONTROLLING). Every leaf route manifest consumes the common closed route vocabulary owned by frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.1.1.1 and MUST NOT redefine it. LeafCloseRouteObligationKindV1 is exact: 1 LocalInProcess, 2 ExecutionOwned, 3 ContributionOnly, and 4 Inapplicable; zero and unknown refuse. LeafCloseRouteDerivedClassV1 is exact: 1 LocalOnly, 2 ExecutionOnly, 3 ContributionOnly, and 4 Mixed. Inapplicable rows do not by themselves determine the class; an empty or all-Inapplicable manifest refuses. LEAF_CLOSE_ROUTE_OBLIGATIONS_MAX_V1 is exactly 64 rows. Manifest input is already in kind-code then bytewise stable-route-ID order and is rejected rather than sorted. The exact runtime evidence enum name is BaseCoverageCloseEvidenceKindV1; no third generic EvidenceKindV1 is introduced alongside the existing close and logging vocabularies.

DIRECT NATIVE-WINDOWS ROUTE REPRESENTATION (CONTROLLING). NativeWindowsRouteV2 is a closed typed sum: code 1 PowerShellWrapper { wrapper_owner, logical_path: LogicalBundlePathV1 } and code 2 DirectDriver { driver_owner, driver_id: StableTokenV2, bootstrap_contract_root: NativeWindowsDriverBootstrapContractRootV1 }; zero and unknown codes refuse. DirectDriver names the same exact platform-neutral release driver frozen by the route row. It is never encoded as a path, inferred .ps1 companion, shell command, PATH-resolved executable, Wine/WSL/MSYS route, or optional wrapper. NativeWindowsDriverBootstrapContractV1 is the common declaration schema owned by .24.1.1.1, with stable ABI ID fs-evidence-runner.native-windows-driver-bootstrap-abi.v1, nominal root NativeWindowsDriverBootstrapContractRootV1, canonical domain org.frankensim.fs-evidence-runner.native-windows-driver-bootstrap-contract.v1, and magic ASCII FSNATIVEWINDOWSBOOTSTRAP followed by byte 0x01. Its exact frame order is API generation 2; wire generation 1; ABI ID; argv representation windows-utf16-code-units-v1; direct-driver/no-shell/no-PATH policy; and no-claim native-windows-bootstrap-contract-proves-argv-shape-not-driver-presence-launch-exit-or-authority. A concrete driver ID, source/build artifact, target/provider binding, and execution remain owned by the designated execution owner and exact-join this common contract.

BaseCoverageCloseDeferredObservationContractV1 remains compatibility-only because its windows_route field is path-only. It is never reinterpreted for DirectDriver. BaseCoverageCloseDeferredObservationContractV2 replaces that field with NativeWindowsRouteV2 and has domain org.frankensim.fs-evidence-runner.close-deferred-observation-contract.v2 and magic ASCII FSCLOSEDEFERREDOBSERVER followed by byte 0x02. Its exact order is route ID; semantic consumer; execution owner; driver owner; POSIX wrapper owner; capability profile; driver ID; POSIX route; complete NativeWindowsRouteV2 bytes/root; case-manifest path; case-manifest contract root; Deferred-reason registry root; Deferred reason; and no-claim. Because BaseCoverageCloseDownstreamContributionV2 embeds the V1 observer, route declarations use additive BaseCoverageCloseDownstreamContributionV3 plus BaseCoverageCloseDeferredEvidenceEnvelopeV2; the V2 contribution and V1 envelope remain compatibility evidence and cannot enter the authoritative route manifest. No existing V1 bytes are silently reinterpreted.

ROUTE DECLARATION/RUNTIME DAG CLARIFICATION (CONTROLLING). A source-authoritative LocalInProcess route row binds attempt_identity_contract_root, detailed_log_schema_root, and structured_reproduction_schema_root. It MUST NOT bind a per-invocation attempt_identity_root, detailed_log_root, or structured_reproduction_root. LocalInProcessRunRequestV1 binds the actual AttemptIdentityV1 only after declaration admission. RuntimeObservationV1, EvidenceEnvelopeV1, PresentedResultV2, aggregate/report, StructuredReproductionV2, terminal, and final log bind actual invocation roots in that forward order. StructuredReproductionV2 is constructed only after the completed report or safe partial report; its actual root enters the terminal afterward. Any reverse edge, expected-as-actual substitution, or source manifest whose root changes per attempt refuses. Static route rows bind a case_manifest_contract_root derived from exact owner/driver/native/POSIX/path/schema literals; they do not claim a downstream-owned file exists, has been read, has a runtime content root, or has executed.

OWNER ROLE EQUALITY MATRIX (CONTROLLING). Every owner role remains a separately encoded typed field even when two fields contain the same Bead ID. source_owner is the leaf that emits the declaration. For each ContributionOnly row, semantic_consumer equals execution_owner and driver_owner equals execution_owner unless an exact row explicitly freezes another owner. posix_wrapper_owner equals execution_owner when a POSIX wrapper is declared. windows_wrapper_owner equals execution_owner only for PowerShellWrapper; DirectDriver has no wrapper owner and its driver_owner equals execution_owner. source_owner MUST differ from semantic_consumer and execution_owner. Equal values across declared role fields are legal and do not collapse, omit, or infer fields. Rows may share an owner, driver, platform routes, and case-manifest contract only when explicitly listed, while their route ID, payload root, contribution root, and Deferred-envelope root remain distinct.

DECLARATION VERSUS ACTUAL ARTIFACTS AND FAULTS (CONTROLLING). Contribution rows use OwnerEnvelopeRelativePathsOnly. Local rows use a distinct LocalExplicitAbsentOrRelativePathsOnly policy. Both are declaration policy only; RetainedArtifactStateV1 is runtime evidence and is present only under the legal runtime disposition. A pure in-process leaf with no asupersync/runtime dependency may test deterministic model-only observation-loss, cancellation, deadline, and resource faults through private sealed fixtures, but MUST label them model evidence and MUST NOT call them actual runtime cancellation/drain proof. Actual scoped cancellation, stop, drain, process, and resource-return evidence remains with the exact execution owner whose dependency/capability contract permits it. A Boolean callback or public test hook cannot stand in for either model proof or actual cancellation.

CANONICAL ROUTE SCHEMAS AND TEST GATE (CONTROLLING). New route body, row, manifest, local-entrypoint registry, native-route, native-bootstrap, V2 observer, V3 contribution, V2 Deferred-envelope, declaration-policy, and runtime-result schemas have exact API/wire versions, domains, magic bytes, ordered fields, nominal roots, migration rows, source owners, source paths, compatible snapshot, and no-claim. New nominal roles use source-frozen LeafExtension fragments and never append to the immutable 47-role FrozenBase registry. Independent handwritten tests cover exact codes/literals and every route row; empty, one, 64, 65, exact-set, missing, extra, duplicate, reorder, stale, unknown kind, all class transitions, and all-Inapplicable refusal; every-field/root mutation; owner/consumer singularity and equality; PowerShell/direct-driver substitution; V1/V2/V3 barriers; raw-hash and cross-kind compile failures with exact Rust error codes and positive counterparts; result-free contribution plus Deferred-envelope separation; no-mock local or release owner E2E; Observed, NotObserved, Deferred, and Inapplicable matrices; safe partials; model-only versus actual cancellation scope; reserve-before-detail log overflow; deterministic step order, redaction, no-echo, and post-report structured reproduction; shard/resume and mixed-snapshot refusal; exact partitions; and complete source closure. Every test and compile-fail addition updates its live inventory, class count, route ratchet, schema-impact manifest, log/reproduction schema, and source closure atomically. Focused, release-built, source-closure, constellation, DSR, downstream, platform, durability, scientific, admission, and authority proof states remain separate.

DESTINATION BINDING SEMANTIC-OWNER RECONCILIATION 2026-07-29 (CONTROLLING). This Bead is the sole semantic constructor owner for `DestinationResourceBindingV1`: it consumes the pure canonical frame from `.24.2.1.2` and binds it to the acquired affine resource identity, freshness/generation, provider conformance, policy, and least-privilege capability evidence. title: Runner V2 publication typestate, native adapters, recovery, receipt, and release-E2E rollup
description:
Decomposed publication implementation-and-proof rollup for backend-neutral typestate and actual accounting, POSIX and native-Windows adapters, persistent ContentStore publication, cross-backend recovery, durable identity/Seal/final/receipt construction, full release-built publication-state E2E, sharding/resume, independent receipt equations, deterministic logs/reproduction, coverage, and source closure. Five direct children, including the nested publication proof-join epic, own disjoint domains; this epic exact-set joins them and remains the sole publication-state execution-route owner. Recovery never deletes or overwrites caller data, and publication proof mints no science, admission, or authority.


## Success Criteria

The dedicated Acceptance Criteria field, including its final live rollup topology/accounting reconciliation, is the canonical success gate. Every exact direct child must close on compatible proof and source roots, every assigned aggregate/integration/route obligation must pass, and focused, release-E2E, DSR, durability, scientific, admission, authority, and no-claim statuses must remain separate.
design:
This leaf owns publication semantics and recovery above the 24.2.2.1 capability/effect substrate. It consumes artifact/publication canonical bytes and schemas from 24.2.1.2, private capability primitives and DestinationResourceBindingRootV1 from 24.2.2.1, and the immutable upstream Runner schemas. It owns BundleLayout execution, checked nine-field PublicationAccountingV1, the acyclic publication typestate, backend-specific transaction state, ProvenDurablePreSealV2, DurablePublicationIdentityV2, production Seal/final commit/PublishedBundleReceipt construction, deterministic owned-transaction resume, and exact committed-output recovery. It does not own raw OS FFI, ContentStore provider implementation, outer-result write/flush/return, the global failure table, or cross-backend closeout.

All publication is capability-relative. The singular PublicationSelectionV2 remains exactly PlatformPathProfileV2, PublicationProtocolV2, DestinationAdmissionModeV2, PublicationTargetV2. RunnerBudgetsV2, ordered RootCapabilityPolicyRootV2, and DestinationResourceBindingRootV1 are separate bindings. A new broker slot to the same resource preserves the destination binding and recovery identity; a different resource, provider-policy/freshness/generation disagreement, or substitution refuses before a write to the requested publication. DestinationResourceBindingRootV1 never moves InvocationRootV2 or RunIdV2 but is mandatory in every publication identity from PublicationKey through receipt.

BundleLayoutV1 maps six exact system objects under runner/—lifecycle, run terminal, artifact inventory, bundle manifest, publication intent, and Seal—and ArtifactInventoryEntryV2 artifact_relative_path under artifacts/ exactly once. PublicationTargetV2 plus every derived full path must jointly satisfy 240-byte, 32-segment, platform-key, reserved-name, canonicalization, collision, and final duplicate/proper-prefix antichain rules before proportional allocation. ContentStoreEnvelopeV1 object keys are independently rederived from the selected ContentStore target plus exact full logical path. Physical roots, capability prefixes, staging names, transaction keys, generations, database rows, and locators never enter logical paths or object identity.

PublicationAccountingV1 has exactly nine ordered actual fields: lifecycle_encoded_bytes, artifact_encoded_bytes, artifact_stored_bytes, artifact_expanded_bytes, system_publication_stored_bytes, publication_stored_bytes, artifact_object_count, system_object_count, and publication_object_count. Checked equations require exactly six system objects, publication_object_count = artifact_object_count + 6, and publication_stored_bytes = artifact_stored_bytes + system_publication_stored_bytes. Complete ContentStore envelopes count as stored bytes. Physical commit/generation/recovery state is excluded. Every actual is bounded by the corresponding RunnerBudgetsV2 grant; system stored is at most 8 MiB and whole publication at most 73 MiB Smoke or 521 MiB Full. command_result_stdout_bytes is a separate delivery grant and never enters accounting, receipt, or publication identity.

Publication follows one acyclic DAG. PlannedPreIntentObjectSetRootV1 covers lifecycle, terminal, inventory, manifest, and every artifact with exact path/role/encoded root/length while excluding PublicationIntent and Seal. PublicationKeyV1 derives only from InvocationRootV2, BundleManifestRootV2, exact PublicationSelectionV2, DestinationResourceBindingRootV1, and PlannedPreIntentObjectSetRootV1. PublicationIntentV1 binds those principals, destination root, key, and expected intent/Seal paths and roles but never its own root. PreSealObjectSetRoot is exactly planned objects plus PublicationIntent and excludes Seal. Only retained durability evidence for that actual set yields ProvenDurablePreSealV2. DurablePublicationIdentityV2 binds DestinationResourceBindingRootV1, planned root, actual root, intent root, selection, manifest, backend durability basis, and PublicationKeyV1. Only then may SealV2 be constructed. Any intent/self/pre-seal/key/Seal/final/receipt feedback edge refuses.

The POSIX Absent workflow creates a deterministic sibling staging directory beneath the pinned parent, using only 24.2.2.1 proved descriptor-relative no-replace primitives. Matching owned residue resumes after exact verification; foreign residue refuses. After every file and directory is synced, Seal is installed last, the complete sealed staging tree is atomically installed only if the destination remains absent, and the parent is synced before receipt. The PreExistingEmpty workflow pins the affine root, proves exact empty state, requires PopulateEmptyDestination but no lease, creates transaction-private objects exclusively, verifies the exact set at each restart, installs each final name once, syncs all files/directories, creates Seal exclusively last, and syncs again. It never clears, replaces, or renames over the caller directory.

The Windows workflows have the same semantic state machines using only proved handle-relative primitives: no-replace create/install, file flush, directory-handle flush, and parent/root durability. Reparse, sharing, delete-pending, case/Unicode, or unavailable directory-flush cells are typed failures/Unsupported, never silently weakened to path-based or close-only success.

ContentStore publication uses only a sealed ContentStoreCapabilityV1 with a current ContentStoreProviderConformanceRootV1. Absent mode requires no lease. PreExistingEmpty alone acquires exact Enumerate+AcquireExclusiveLease, proves leased-empty state, and releases the lease on every path. Deterministic complete envelopes are immutable-put/read-verified; planned and actual pre-seal roots are separately reconstructed; the actual set receives a durable-commit proof; Seal is compare-and-swapped last; and a durable final generation is queried. Missing/stale provider conformance, changed generation, failed durable proof, or substituted store is Unsupported/Blocked/Stale before authority. The persistent FrankenSQLite reference provider supplies the release proof cell without ambient network or credentials.

SealV2 binds ProvenDurablePreSealV2 and DurablePublicationIdentityV2 but excludes itself and the final receipt. FinalCommitIdentityV1 binds DestinationResourceBindingRootV1, exact selection, PublicationKey, manifest, both object-set roots, SealRoot, final logical object set, and stable backend commit basis. Raw descriptor/handle/inode/file ID, slots, paths, timestamps, attempts, physical transaction names, and credentials are excluded. PublishedBundleReceiptV2 binds DestinationResourceBindingRootV1, DurablePublicationIdentityV2, exact selection, SealRootV2, final object-set root, FinalCommitIdentityV1, protocol, destination root class, final nine-field PublicationAccountingV1, complete RunnerBudgetsV2 root, authority/no-claim, and recovery version. Receipt and Seal are never lifecycle records or logical system objects beyond the single Seal object.

Recovery is a read/verify/repeat-durability state machine, not cleanup. It probes fixed manifest, intent, and Seal paths through the newly acquired capability; requires the same DestinationResourceBindingRootV1; independently reconstructs planned root, PublicationKey, self-root-free intent, actual pre-seal root, ProvenDurablePreSeal evidence, DurablePublicationIdentity, Seal, final object set, and commit identity; verifies every stored/encoded/expanded layer; repeats required sync/flush/query operations; and returns the identical receipt root. Exact states are no transaction, owned partial, planned-complete, intent-written/pre-seal-incomplete, actual-pre-seal-complete, durable-pre-seal, Seal-written/uncommitted, exact committed/lost-return, foreign, mixed, extra, missing, stale-generation, and tampered. Ambiguous residue never advances. No correctness path deletes or overwrites caller data.

Every operation is cancellation-aware at bounded object/I/O/durability barriers. Cancellation is request, drain, quiesce, close/release, then typed outcome. Backend acknowledgments, presented roots, booleans, paths, or residue cannot be converted into durability typestates. PublicationTransitionEventV1 is canonical/capped and logs logical stage/barrier, selection/policy/destination-binding digests, accounting equations, object/path/root derivations, capability/effect-conformance root, planned/key/intent/actual-pre-seal/proof/durable-identity/Seal/final/receipt roots, recovery state, first error, retry, drain, authority/no-claim, and relative artifacts. Raw resource identities and all sensitive/nonsemantic locator data are excluded.

## Final controlling cross-platform E2E execution contract

The sole publication-state E2E ownership is the platform-neutral release-built Rust driver `e2e-evidence-runner-publication-state-v2-driver` plus two thin native wrappers: `scripts/ci/e2e_evidence_runner_publication_state_v2.sh` for POSIX shells and `scripts/ci/e2e_evidence_runner_publication_state_v2.ps1` for native Windows PowerShell. Both wrappers consume the same immutable exact case-manifest root, require an explicitly provided verified release artifact identity/path from the DSR build handoff, pass only canonical driver options, and add no test semantics. Cargo/PATH/debug-binary fallback, Wine-as-Windows proof, wrapper-specific case filtering, or hand-maintained duplicate matrices are forbidden. Wrapper parity is source-closed and independently checked; an eligible Windows cell requires execution on the registered native Windows provider or is typed Unsupported with its exact prerequisite, never silently skipped.

The driver supports deterministic stable-cell sharding and verified resume. Every cell has one immutable globally unique ID, manifest ordinal, platform/backend prerequisite, semantic budget, and separate environmental wall deadline. Partitioning is recorded in `RunnerPublicationStateE2EShardPlanV1` and is a pure hash-style function of manifest root, stable cell ID, shard count, and algorithm version. A resume record binds manifest/source/build/toolchain/target/features roots, algorithm version, shard index/count, completed cell IDs, result/log roots, and retained relative artifacts; stale, mixed-context, partial, duplicate, cross-shard, or unverified entries refuse. Per-cell and per-shard compute/memory/output/open-resource budgets are enforced independently from environmental wall deadlines.

Final aggregation canonicalizes by stable cell ID and exact-set requires every eligible cell once, every typed Unsupported cell with one closed reason, nonempty positive and expected-refusal/expected-failure/mutation corpora, and zero unexpected mismatches. It rejects gaps, duplicates, inconsistent platform eligibility, mixed roots, stale resume, or count-only summaries. The aggregate semantic result and root are invariant to execution order, shard completion order, and shard count; physical durations and timeout checkpoints are logged as environmental observations under an explicit no-cross-run-bit-stability claim. Closed per-cell, per-shard, and aggregate logs retain logical sequence, budgets, result class, first typed difference, root joins, owner/no-claim/repairs, and safe relative reproduction data while excluding host noise and secrets.

Nested publication proof-join rollup for the exact publication-state case manifest, deterministic sharding/resume/aggregation, cross-backend recovery, independent receipt/accounting/DAG/durability equations, POSIX/native-Windows/persistent-provider release-E2E projection, wrapper parity, detailed logs/reproduction, coverage, proof-state reporting, and source closure. Three atomic children own manifest, oracle, and release-projection domains; this epic exact-set joins them. Only parent .24.2.2.2 owns the observed publication-state execution envelope.


## Success Criteria

The dedicated Acceptance Criteria field, including its final live rollup topology/accounting reconciliation, is the canonical success gate. Every exact direct child must close on compatible proof and source roots, every assigned aggregate/integration/route obligation must pass, and focused, release-E2E, DSR, durability, scientific, admission, authority, and no-claim statuses must remain separate.
acceptance_criteria:
ATOMIC PUBLICATION SCOPE AND OWNERSHIP (CONTROLLING). Own cross-backend recovery/receipt integration, independent root/equation/transition oracles, full publication-state case projection, deterministic sharding/resume/aggregation, release-E2E proof join, detailed logs/reproduction/coverage, and complete source closure. This package owns only its allocated semantic/effect implementation, independent oracles, tests, log/reproduction rows, and source fragment. Parent .24.2.2.2 remains the sole integrated PublicationStateV2 ExecutionOwned route, release driver/wrappers/manifest, cross-backend aggregate, and external receipt owner. No child may redefine upstream codecs or capability providers, emit an outer command result, claim another backend, or mint scientific/admission/authority evidence.

DOMAIN ACCEPTANCE MATRIX (CONTROLLING). Tests exact-set every neutral/POSIX/Windows/ContentStore child root and upstream base projection; execute or project zero/one/256 artifacts, all accounting boundaries, death at every planned/intent/pre-seal/proof/Seal/final barrier, collision/tamper/substitution/cancellation/timeout, committed/lost-return reconstruction, platform/provider applicability, arbitrary CWD/hostile paths, wrapper parity, and every shard/resume permutation. Independent oracles recompute all roots and equations without production helpers. Every transition is typestate checked and content/destination bound; every effect is observed through the exact acquired affine capability/provider interface. No raw path/handle/descriptor/provider acknowledgement, presented proof, boolean, or codec-only value constructs durability, finality, accounting, or a receipt. Recovery is idempotent and never deletes, overwrites, clears, or renames over caller/foreign data.

COMPREHENSIVE TEST MATRIX (CONTROLLING). The close manifest exact-sets separately nonzero applicable literal/unit/boundary; property/metamorphic; state/typestate/model/race; mutation/fuzz; API/compile-fail/trait; fault/resource/cancellation; no-mock local independent proof plus immutable parent-execution projection; detailed deterministic logging/redaction; and source-closure groups. Physical I/O, put/query/sync/flush, lease/CAS, reopen, platform, and provider faults are consumed as retained adapter evidence and are executed only by `.24.2.2.2`; this proof join never performs those effects or claims parent execution. Stable positives/refusals/failures/mutations/Unsupported/Inapplicable partitions exact-match, with zero unexpected mismatch, execution failure, or unexplained skip.

Its exact direct hierarchy children are: `frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.2.2.3.1`, `frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.2.2.3.2`, `frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.2.2.3.3`. Its current recursive subtree contains exactly 4 Beads: 3 implementation tasks totaling 1,590 minutes and 1 rollup epics totaling 90 minutes, for 1,680 minutes. The 3 internal `parent-child` relations are closure hierarchy only; no reciprocal parent-depends-on-child `blocks` edge is permitted. This rollup's own 90-minute estimate covers only its explicitly named aggregate, integration, join, driver, rerun, source-closure, or close-review work and is not duplicated in child estimates. While `br epic status` reports `eligible_for_close=false`, this rollup MUST have status `blocked`, never `open` or `in_progress`; when eligibility becomes true, transition it to `open` or `in_progress` only for its scoped closeout, then close it. Close this rollup only after every exact child-root, integration, test/E2E, detailed-log/redaction, reproduction, source-closure, proof-state, authority, and no-claim gate in this Bead passes. title: Runner V2 pure result preflight, delivery-state validation, failure precedence, and canonical projection
description:
Implement the pure Runner V2 result-delivery contract: fixed-shape/full-frame preflight, delivery-state validation, closed failure precedence, canonical result and native-exit projection, and immutable production-harness contributions without performing physical output or process effects.

## Acceptance Criteria

The dedicated Acceptance Criteria field is the canonical complete close gate. It preserves the domain-specific gate and the common nine-group unit/property/model/race/mutation/API/fault/E2E-or-contribution/logging/source-closure protocol; no description shorthand, checkpoint, parent status, aggregate count, or partial proof can replace it.
design: SOLE OWNERSHIP. Own pure future-result shape and complete header-plus-payload budget preflight; CommandResultDeliveryObservationV1; delivery-state typestate and validation; closed failure-precedence table; pure controlled native-exit projection; canonical result projection; and RunnerDeliveryPolicyE2EContributionManifestV1. Consume upstream semantic result constructors, transport codecs, and publication/receipt evidence without redeclaration. Do not parse native arguments, acquire capabilities, write stdout/stderr, consult clocks, launch/terminate processes, orchestrate publication, emit progress, perform backend/recovery effects, or construct lifecycle/receipt/durability/scientific/admission/authority.
acceptance_criteria:
DOMAIN CLOSE GATE. Tests independently hand-derive Catalog/Lifecycle/Durable payload shape, exact six-field transport header, payload/root/context and checked full-frame totals, zero/one-below/exact/one-over/overflow grants, preflight/post-receipt byte equality, zero/prefix/complete delivery classifications, every lifecycle/publication/delivery/failure precedence cross-product, retry observation movement with semantic-root stability, controlled exit projections and unsupported/uncontrolled classes. Pure component tests model short-write/EINTR/EOF/broken-pipe/flush/return schedules without performing production output. Every physical argv/stdout/process/backend/progress/exit/retry/drain/resource case is an immutable contribution to .24.4.1.4 using canonical-evidence-runner-v2-e2e-driver and scripts/ci/canonical_evidence_runner_v2.sh.

COMMON IMPLEMENTATION-LEAF CLOSE PROTOCOL (CONTROLLING). The nine preserved groups are literal/unit/boundary; property/metamorphic; state/typestate/model/race; mutation/fuzz; API/compile-fail/trait; fault/resource/cancellation; release-built no-mock E2E or immutable E2E contribution; deterministic detailed logging/redaction; and source closure. (1) Exact dependency, singular owner, schema/domain/constructor, source, build, toolchain, target, feature, policy, and consumed-root gates close on one compatible stable snapshot; missing, extra, duplicate, stale, mixed, reverse, shadow, or authority-widening ownership refuses. (2) Separately nonzero applicable literal, unit, and boundary corpora cover zero, one, exact, and one-over every count/size/rank/budget plus checked overflow before proportional allocation. (3) Separately nonzero applicable property and metamorphic corpora cover every declared invariance and semantic root-movement rule. (4) Separately nonzero applicable state, typestate, model, and race corpora cover every legal/illegal transition and bounded relevant interleaving. (5) Separately nonzero applicable mutation and fuzz corpora exercise every owned discriminant, field, edge, root, precedence row, limit, and authority boundary; every eligible mutant receives an exact outcome. (6) Separately nonzero applicable API, compile-fail, trait, doctest, dependency, and import-isolation corpora reject public literals, Default/bypass construction, callbacks/code-bearing data, raw resource escape, ambient discovery, generic-root substitution, reverse dependencies, and durability/scientific/admission/authority conversion. (7) Separately nonzero applicable fault, resource, cancellation, drain, quiescence, and return corpora inject each allocation/I-O/state boundary, require bounded cancellation polling, exact first failure, complete drain, and zero leaked task, arena, buffer, capability, descriptor, handle, lease, statement, transaction, provider token, or child resource. (8) Every owned E2E runs the exact named release binary/script with no mocks; non-owned execution is an immutable stable contribution naming exactly one downstream owner/driver/script, independent oracle, semantic inputs, explicit time/memory/work/process/artifact/output/log budgets, schema/log/source/build roots, expected disposition, and no-claim. Contributions cannot claim downstream execution. (9) Canonical bounded deterministic logs retain stable cell/category/facet IDs; semantic/source/build/schema/owner/oracle/budget/manifest/execution roots; ordered stages and terminal stage; expected/observed class; first divergence; drain/resource outcome; exact partitions; ranked declarative repairs; no-claim; and relative artifacts. Logs reject or type-redact credentials, environment values, live capabilities/resources, provider payloads, raw handles, physical/absolute paths, PIDs, wall time, scheduler noise, and bulk payloads. A rejected sentinel cannot echo through observed values, Display, Debug, canonical bytes, logs, diagnostics, or reproduction text. (10) Source closure exact-sets implementation, CONTRACT/rustdoc, schemas/domains/owners, independent oracles, fixtures, E2E scripts or contribution rows, log schemas, dependencies/features, and build configuration. (11) One source-authoritative full-set-only close manifest preserves all nine categories and distinct exact ordered ID sets and checked counters for eligible positives and matched positives; eligible expected refusals and matched expected refusals; eligible expected failures and matched expected failures; and eligible mutations and matched mutations; typed Unsupported and inapplicable cells with exact registered reasons; unexpected mismatches; execution failures; and unexplained skips. Green requires equality in every eligible/matched pair, every eligible ID once, nonempty applicable positive and adversarial corpora, exact reasons, and zero unexpected mismatches, execution failures, or unexplained skips; empty/filtered subsets cannot pass. (12) Every user-visible Refused, Unsupported, expected failure, divergent Negative, or unexpected mismatch carries a bounded deterministic actionable diagnostic with exact owner, retryability, prerequisites, no-claim, and uniquely ranked non-executable repairs. (13) Closeout reports focused, release-built E2E or contribution, source-closure, constellation, DSR, downstream, platform, durability, scientific, and authority proof statuses separately and never promotes one into another.

FIVE EXPLICITS DECLARATION, RUNTIME-EVIDENCE, AND COMPLETE-LOG GATE (CONTROLLING). Every stable literal, unit, boundary, property, metamorphic, state, typestate, model, race, mutation, fuzz, API, fault, and E2E cell binds one declaration-side Five Explicits contract: typed units for every numeric input, numeric grant, and expected numeric observation; one canonical seed declaration plus generator/minimizer version, or a registered `SeedInapplicable` code with owner, scope, prerequisite, and no-claim; seven-axis hard and soft time, memory, logical-work, process, artifact, output, and log budgets with process shape declared separately; exact API, wire, schema, source, build, toolchain, target, profile, and feature version requirements; one exact required/permitted semantic capability contract; and the exact no-claim. Runtime actual numeric observations, resolved seed provenance, budget reconciliation, observed versions, and actual required, granted, observed, returned, and revoked capability sets exist only inside disposition-gated runtime evidence. `Observed` requires complete actuals; `NotObserved` may retain only safe typed partial evidence plus its exact reason and cannot substitute expected values; `Deferred` and `Inapplicable` contain no fabricated actuals. Changing any applicable declaration or actual explicit moves exactly the intended component, cell, evidence, log, reproduction, aggregate, and report roots. Bounded log writers reserve sufficient bytes for one canonical terminal event before admitting detail events. The first event that would exceed the remaining detail budget emits one complete deterministic `LogBudgetExceeded` terminal containing the rejected event class and ordinal, digest, omitted count, applicable budget, first-divergence stage, disposition, drain/resource outcome, diagnostic owner, repair-manifest root, and no-claim. Partial JSONL, silent truncation, overwriting prior events, missing terminal state, expected-as-actual substitution, fabricated observed-empty data, or treating overflow as success refuses. Minimized reproduction evidence retains every applicable declaration and safe actual explicit without exposing a forbidden value.

E2E ROUTE OBLIGATION MANIFEST GATE (CONTROLLING). Every leaf owns one exact ordered route-obligation manifest rather than a lossy leaf-wide binary. Each applicable obligation appears exactly once with `LeafCloseRouteObligationKindV1`: 1 `LocalInProcess`, 2 `ExecutionOwned`, 3 `ContributionOnly`, or 4 `Inapplicable`; zero and unknown refuse. A LocalInProcess row binds the real public in-process entry point, immutable cell oracle, budgets, expected partitions, detailed-log schema/root, source closure, and no-mock no-authority boundary. An ExecutionOwned row binds one literal release driver, POSIX wrapper where applicable, direct native-Windows driver or PowerShell wrapper as frozen by the owner contract, immutable case-manifest path/root, exact close argv, release-artifact identity, platform/provider matrix, declared capability profile, runtime evidence-envelope contract, retained relative artifacts, and complete detailed-log root. A ContributionOnly row binds one immutable result-free payload and Deferred envelope to exactly one downstream execution owner plus its literal driver, script/native route, manifest, observer contract, budgets, expected partitions, logging schema, source/build roots, and no-claim; it cannot report downstream execution passed. An Inapplicable row binds one registered reason, owner, scope, prerequisite, and no-claim. The derived leaf class is exactly `LocalOnly`, `ExecutionOnly`, `ContributionOnly`, or `Mixed`; multiple obligations and multiple contribution rows are legal and must remain distinct. Missing, extra, duplicate, reordered, generic, ambiguous, rollup-owned, stale, remapped, wrong-script, unconsumed, multiply consumed, debug, ambient/PATH-resolved/alternate/unregistered Cargo-run, hidden-skip, contribution-as-execution, or inferred leaf-class routes refuse. A specifically registered source-closed focused probe is legal only when its owner Bead names it and remains separately labeled non-closing evidence. Unit/exact-set, property/model, mutation, API/compile-fail, no-mock in-process or release-built E2E/contribution, deterministic detailed-log/redaction, structured-reproduction, resume/shard, overflow, and source-closure tests cover empty, one, maximum, mixed, duplicate, reorder, route substitution, owner remap, and every row-kind/derived-class transition. Focused/unit proof cannot substitute for a required release-built row or immutable contribution contract.

AC57 EVIDENCE-DISPOSITION CONSUMER GATE (CONTROLLING). This leaf consumes, and MUST NOT redefine, the exact evidence-kind, RuntimeObservationDispositionV1, reason-registry, completeness, safe-partial-evidence, resource-reconciliation, EvidenceEnvelopeV1, and FirstDivergentExplicitComponentV1 contracts governed by program gate `.24.1.1.1` and base contract owner `.24.1.1.1`. Every stable local cell and every exact route-obligation row maps to one and only one legal evidence-kind/disposition pair. OwnedHarnessExecution and InProcessProjectionExecution admit only Observed or NotObserved; ImmutableDownstreamContribution admits only Deferred; ApplicabilityDeclaration admits only Inapplicable. LocalInProcess and ExecutionOwned work may close Observed only after a completed attempt supplies every applicable actual numeric-observation, observed-seed-disposition, budget-reconciliation, observed-version, observed-capability-set, execution-completeness, attempt-identity, retained-state, and resource-reconciliation root. A matched refusal, expected failure, executed Unsupported outcome, or mutation survivor/kill remains Observed when observation is complete; semantic outcome never substitutes for observation disposition.

NotObserved is fail-closed and uses exactly one registered reason: 1 execution-failed-before-completeness, 2 observation-channel-failed-before-completeness, or 3 unexpected-unstarted-or-skipped. It preserves attempt and payload identity and may preserve only a separately rooted redacted safe-partial-evidence object; it never copies expected values into actual fields, encodes missing actuals as observed-empty, claims successful execution, or permits a green aggregate. Every ContributionOnly row emits exactly one result-free upstream payload plus a distinct Deferred envelope with reason 1 immutable-contribution-awaits-designated-release-owner and the designated owner/driver/native-or-script route/manifest/observer contract; the designated owner later emits a separate execution envelope and cannot overwrite, alias, or promote the upstream envelope. Inapplicable is legal only for a predeclared exact source-registered applicability descriptor and cannot be synthesized from runtime skip, infrastructure failure, unsupported provider discovery, or missing observation.

The leaf's result, report contribution, stage evidence, runtime aggregate, detailed cell event, log context, structured reproduction, normal terminal, overflow terminal, bounded prefix, final bounded log, route contribution, and source closure exact-join the applicable declaration components, runtime disposition, and envelope root. Actual component roots are present only for Observed; every non-Observed form carries exact typed absence plus its reason/descriptor and no-claim. Comparisons use the AC57 exact twenty-position FirstDivergentExplicitComponentV1 precedence and stop at the first unequal applicable component without logging rejected raw values. Unit and literal-oracle tests cover every owned legal row; zero/unknown code and complete/partial/absent boundaries; property/model/state/typestate laws; mutation and API/compile-fail barriers; no-mock in-process or release-built owner E2E, or immutable contribution plus owner-consumption E2E; execution/observation/grant/use/return/revoke/cancellation/resource faults; deterministic step-prefixed detailed logging, redaction, structured reproduction, overflow-before-divergence, shard/resume, and one-component root movement; exact coverage partitions; and source closure. Tests MUST reject every illegal kind/disposition/reason pair, expected-as-actual, observed-empty-as-complete, payload-as-envelope, upstream-as-owner envelope, contribution-as-execution, applicability-as-skip, duplicate/missing/reordered evidence, hidden skip, forbidden-value echo, and stale or mixed-snapshot root.

AC58 SCHEMA-IMPACT CONSUMER AND MIGRATION GATE (CONTROLLING). This leaf consumes, and MUST NOT redefine, the canonical-schema migration registry and independent literal schema oracle owned by base contract owner `.24.1.1.1` under program gate `.24.1.1.1`. Its exact source-authoritative SchemaImpactManifestV1 classifies every canonical frame, nominal root, registry, manifest, log event, terminal, report, projection, contribution, route envelope, and structured-reproduction schema that this leaf owns or consumes exactly once by stable schema ID and exact u16 disposition: 1 NewV1NoPredecessor, 2 UnchangedV1, 3 MigratedV1ToV2, 4 DecodeOnlyLegacyV1, 5 RetiredV1, or 6 InapplicableNoCanonicalFrame. Each row binds API generation, wire version and wire-predecessor policy, separate canonical-schema migration policy, exact domain, magic, ordered field descriptors, nominal root role, owner, source path, authoritative/compatibility status, allowed parent/child versions, no-claim, and compatible-source-snapshot root. Zero/unknown codes and missing, extra, duplicate, reordered, owner-inferred, route-inferred, stale, or mixed-snapshot rows refuse.

Wire compatibility and canonical-schema migration are non-interchangeable. API generation 2, wire version 1, and Runner wire predecessor NoPredecessor remain separate from canonical-schema policies NoSchemaPredecessor, V1DecodeOnlyCompatibilityEvidence, and V1Retired. A new component may begin at V1 only when it has no canonical predecessor. Every enclosing schema whose field order, field meaning, canonical payload, or authority semantics changes rotates coherently to a distinct V2 type, `.v2` domain, versioned magic, field table, and V2 nominal root on the same compatible source snapshot. An unchanged V1 child is legal inside a V2 parent only when the independent oracle explicitly records that unchanged component role and exact position. Decode-only or retired V1 bytes never alias, parse as, substitute for, or close an authoritative V2 path; partial migration, V2-parent/V1-child substitution outside an allowed unchanged slot, generic ContentHash bridging, transmute-like accessors, shared domains/magics, compatibility aliases, and caller-minted roots refuse.

Every literal/unit/boundary, property/metamorphic, state/model/race, mutation/fuzz, API/compile-fail, fault/resource/cancellation, no-mock E2E or immutable-contribution, deterministic detailed-log/redaction, structured-reproduction, coverage, and source-closure fixture owned by this leaf names the authoritative schema versions and compatible snapshot. Tests freeze every V1 compatibility byte fixture before migration; exhaust exact-empty, one, exact maximum, one-over, missing/extra/duplicate/reordered rows; mutate every domain, magic, version, policy, field descriptor, nominal role, source owner, parent/child version, and snapshot; prove exact root movement and typed inspectability; reject V1/V2 and cross-role substitution, old-root-as-new-root, stale literal counts, and partial or mixed-snapshot migration; and exercise the exact release-built route or immutable contribution plus designated-owner consumption with step-prefixed logs, first explicit divergence, structured reproduction, overflow/resume, retained-relative-artifact policy, and no forbidden-value echo. CONTRACT/rustdoc, public accessors, route manifests, detailed log schemas, reproduction descriptors, coverage manifests, source closure, and all literal ratchets MUST agree on the same authoritative version; focused, strict-remote, release-built E2E, DSR, downstream, durability, scientific, and authority results remain separate proof states.

EXACT CONTRIBUTION-ONLY ROUTE ROW runner-v2.route.24-2-2-3-1.to.canonical-runner-v2.v1 (CONTROLLING). The leaf registers exactly one LeafCloseRouteObligationKindV1 ContributionOnly row with route ID runner-v2.route.24-2-2-3-1.to.canonical-runner-v2.v1; designated execution owner frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.4.1.4; declared owner capability profile fs-evidence-runner.close-capability.release-canonical.v1; owner release driver canonical-evidence-runner-v2-e2e-driver; POSIX route scripts/ci/canonical_evidence_runner_v2.sh; native-Windows route direct native-Windows companion route; immutable owner case manifest scripts/ci/manifests/canonical_evidence_runner_v2_cases.v1.json; and immutable result-free upstream payload contract the exact leaf-owned canonical-journey payload root. The row binds its own payload root and a distinct AC57 Deferred evidence envelope using reason 1 immutable-contribution-awaits-designated-release-owner, plus the exact observer-contract root, source/build/toolchain/target/feature/schema/log roots, per-cell and shard budgets, retained-relative-artifact policy, and no-claim. It contains no actual numeric observations, observed seed disposition, budget reconciliation, observed versions, observed capability sets, execution completeness, execution artifact, or owner execution envelope, and it cannot report that the downstream route passed. Semantic consumer, execution owner, driver owner, and wrapper owner remain distinct wherever named; rollups own none.

The exact expected ledger retains eligible/matched positives, expected refusals, expected failures, mutations, Unsupported reasons, and registered inapplicable reasons, with zero unexpected mismatches, execution failures, and unexplained skips required from the eventual owner result. Unit/literal and empty/one/exact/one-over boundary tests; property/model/state tests; mutation/fuzz and API/compile-fail tests; immutable contribution plus release-built no-mock designated-owner consumption E2E; observation-loss/cancellation/resource faults; deterministic step-prefixed detailed logging/redaction/no-echo; structured reproduction; overflow-before-divergence; shard/resume; exact coverage; and source closure reject missing, extra, duplicate, reordered, remapped, wrong-owner/profile/driver/wrapper/manifest/payload, multiply consumed, payload-as-envelope, upstream-as-owner envelope, contribution-as-execution, hidden-skip, fabricated actual, stale, or mixed-snapshot rows.

EXACT ORDERED LEAF ROUTE MANIFEST SUMMARY (CONTROLLING). The source-authoritative LeafCloseRouteObligationManifestV1 for this leaf contains exactly one row in kind-code then stable-route-ID order: runner-v2.route.24-2-2-3-1.to.canonical-runner-v2.v1. Exact counts are LocalInProcess=0, ExecutionOwned=0, ContributionOnly=1, and Inapplicable=0; the derived class is exactly ContributionOnly. Every prior route-specific criterion on this Bead specifies one of these same rows and does not create a duplicate. No prose-only owner, dependency, test fixture, schema provenance edge, focused probe, rollup mapping, or transitive consumer becomes an implicit route. Adding, removing, merging, splitting, or remapping a journey requires updating this exact list, its independent registry oracle, AC56 capability profile, AC57 evidence kind/disposition, AC58 schema-impact row, coverage ratchet, detailed-log/reproduction schemas, and source closure atomically.

Independent unit/exact-set and zero/one/exact/one-over manifest tests, kind-order and derived-class properties, owner/consumer model tests, every-row mutation, API/compile-fail nominal privacy, no-mock local/release/contribution E2E as applicable, disposition/capability/resource/cancellation faults, deterministic step-prefixed detailed logging/redaction/no-echo, structured reproduction, overflow-before-divergence, shard/resume, exact result partitions, and source closure reconstruct this list without reading the production registry table. They reject missing, extra, duplicate, reordered, stale, unknown-kind, inferred-class, wrong owner/profile/driver/wrapper/manifest/entrypoint, contribution-as-execution, local-as-release, applicability-as-skip, transitive-route invention, hidden skip, and mixed-snapshot rows.

ROUTE-SCHEMA V2 AND PROOF-DAG RECONCILIATION (CONTROLLING). Every leaf route manifest consumes the common closed route vocabulary owned by frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.1.1.1 and MUST NOT redefine it. LeafCloseRouteObligationKindV1 is exact: 1 LocalInProcess, 2 ExecutionOwned, 3 ContributionOnly, and 4 Inapplicable; zero and unknown refuse. LeafCloseRouteDerivedClassV1 is exact: 1 LocalOnly, 2 ExecutionOnly, 3 ContributionOnly, and 4 Mixed. Inapplicable rows do not by themselves determine the class; an empty or all-Inapplicable manifest refuses. LEAF_CLOSE_ROUTE_OBLIGATIONS_MAX_V1 is exactly 64 rows. Manifest input is already in kind-code then bytewise stable-route-ID order and is rejected rather than sorted. The exact runtime evidence enum name is BaseCoverageCloseEvidenceKindV1; no third generic EvidenceKindV1 is introduced alongside the existing close and logging vocabularies.

DIRECT NATIVE-WINDOWS ROUTE REPRESENTATION (CONTROLLING). NativeWindowsRouteV2 is a closed typed sum: code 1 PowerShellWrapper { wrapper_owner, logical_path: LogicalBundlePathV1 } and code 2 DirectDriver { driver_owner, driver_id: StableTokenV2, bootstrap_contract_root: NativeWindowsDriverBootstrapContractRootV1 }; zero and unknown codes refuse. DirectDriver names the same exact platform-neutral release driver frozen by the route row. It is never encoded as a path, inferred .ps1 companion, shell command, PATH-resolved executable, Wine/WSL/MSYS route, or optional wrapper. NativeWindowsDriverBootstrapContractV1 is the common declaration schema owned by .24.1.1.1, with stable ABI ID fs-evidence-runner.native-windows-driver-bootstrap-abi.v1, nominal root NativeWindowsDriverBootstrapContractRootV1, canonical domain org.frankensim.fs-evidence-runner.native-windows-driver-bootstrap-contract.v1, and magic ASCII FSNATIVEWINDOWSBOOTSTRAP followed by byte 0x01. Its exact frame order is API generation 2; wire generation 1; ABI ID; argv representation windows-utf16-code-units-v1; direct-driver/no-shell/no-PATH policy; and no-claim native-windows-bootstrap-contract-proves-argv-shape-not-driver-presence-launch-exit-or-authority. A concrete driver ID, source/build artifact, target/provider binding, and execution remain owned by the designated execution owner and exact-join this common contract.

BaseCoverageCloseDeferredObservationContractV1 remains compatibility-only because its windows_route field is path-only. It is never reinterpreted for DirectDriver. BaseCoverageCloseDeferredObservationContractV2 replaces that field with NativeWindowsRouteV2 and has domain org.frankensim.fs-evidence-runner.close-deferred-observation-contract.v2 and magic ASCII FSCLOSEDEFERREDOBSERVER followed by byte 0x02. Its exact order is route ID; semantic consumer; execution owner; driver owner; POSIX wrapper owner; capability profile; driver ID; POSIX route; complete NativeWindowsRouteV2 bytes/root; case-manifest path; case-manifest contract root; Deferred-reason registry root; Deferred reason; and no-claim. Because BaseCoverageCloseDownstreamContributionV2 embeds the V1 observer, route declarations use additive BaseCoverageCloseDownstreamContributionV3 plus BaseCoverageCloseDeferredEvidenceEnvelopeV2; the V2 contribution and V1 envelope remain compatibility evidence and cannot enter the authoritative route manifest. No existing V1 bytes are silently reinterpreted.

ROUTE DECLARATION/RUNTIME DAG CLARIFICATION (CONTROLLING). A source-authoritative LocalInProcess route row binds attempt_identity_contract_root, detailed_log_schema_root, and structured_reproduction_schema_root. It MUST NOT bind a per-invocation attempt_identity_root, detailed_log_root, or structured_reproduction_root. LocalInProcessRunRequestV1 binds the actual AttemptIdentityV1 only after declaration admission. RuntimeObservationV1, EvidenceEnvelopeV1, PresentedResultV2, aggregate/report, StructuredReproductionV2, terminal, and final log bind actual invocation roots in that forward order. StructuredReproductionV2 is constructed only after the completed report or safe partial report; its actual root enters the terminal afterward. Any reverse edge, expected-as-actual substitution, or source manifest whose root changes per attempt refuses. Static route rows bind a case_manifest_contract_root derived from exact owner/driver/native/POSIX/path/schema literals; they do not claim a downstream-owned file exists, has been read, has a runtime content root, or has executed.

OWNER ROLE EQUALITY MATRIX (CONTROLLING). Every owner role remains a separately encoded typed field even when two fields contain the same Bead ID. source_owner is the leaf that emits the declaration. For each ContributionOnly row, semantic_consumer equals execution_owner and driver_owner equals execution_owner unless an exact row explicitly freezes another owner. posix_wrapper_owner equals execution_owner when a POSIX wrapper is declared. windows_wrapper_owner equals execution_owner only for PowerShellWrapper; DirectDriver has no wrapper owner and its driver_owner equals execution_owner. source_owner MUST differ from semantic_consumer and execution_owner. Equal values across declared role fields are legal and do not collapse, omit, or infer fields. Rows may share an owner, driver, platform routes, and case-manifest contract only when explicitly listed, while their route ID, payload root, contribution root, and Deferred-envelope root remain distinct.

DECLARATION VERSUS ACTUAL ARTIFACTS AND FAULTS (CONTROLLING). Contribution rows use OwnerEnvelopeRelativePathsOnly. Local rows use a distinct LocalExplicitAbsentOrRelativePathsOnly policy. Both are declaration policy only; RetainedArtifactStateV1 is runtime evidence and is present only under the legal runtime disposition. title: Runner V2 certifier-of-certifier program: lifecycle oracle, upstream mutation corpus, independent decoder/verifier, and three-way replay
description:
Closeout-only phase for independent certification of Runner V2. It joins pure oracle rollup 24.3.1, bounded upstream mutation/registration rollup 24.3.2, and nested independent decoder/verifier/E2E rollup 24.3.3. The live phase contains 22 implementation tasks and seven non-root rollup epics, including a separately estimated complete safe-Rust Zstd decoder integration/contribution join.

## Success Criteria

The dedicated Acceptance Criteria field is the canonical complete close gate. All 22 implementation tasks, seven non-root rollup epics, and this phase root must agree on exact current schema, corpus, source, build, proof, route, log, reproduction, and no-authority roots. Exact nine-field accounting, acyclic publication identity, result-delivery feedback rejection, and ReplayLineage ownership are mandatory phase joins. Stable destination/platform/provider evidence and append-only Phase-3 schema ownership are explicit join dimensions.

ArtifactOnlyRead portability and OriginalOutputRecoveryVerification destination rebinding are separate close dimensions: portable read-only verification cannot bind semantic results to the verifier input resource, while original-output recovery verification must rederive and match the historical output binding without mutation.
