This phase has 22 implementation tasks under seven non-root rollup epics: four independent-oracle tasks under 24.3.1; four mutation/registration/schedule tasks under 24.3.2; seven decoder/codec tasks under 24.3.3.1 including nested safe-Rust Zstd rollup 24.3.3.1.3; four pure semantic-verifier tasks under 24.3.3.2; and three final verifier-v2 proof-plan/aggregate-manifest/live-host E2E tasks under 24.3.3.3. Rollup 24.3.3 exact-joins the decoder, verifier, and native-E2E slices. Rollups own only their explicit integration, aggregation, route, logging, reproduction, source-closure, and close-review work; implementation remains in tasks.

The oracle and verifier consume normative schemas but share no production transition, parser, codec, comparator, aggregate, publication, recovery, capability/provider/platform primitive, or verdict implementation. The decoder/verifier lives in a concrete publish-false fs-evidence-verifier TOOL crate with its own dependency/import gates, CONTRACT, workspace/lock governance, source closure, and release binary. It may share fs-blake3 identity primitives and raw normative schema assets, but never executable producer tables or code.

The phase models ArtifactDispositionV2::LifecycleOnlyNoBundle and canonical --bundle-rel BUNDLE_REL; OutputlessLifecycle and --artifact-dir are invalid aliases. It consumes, never redefines, the upstream LifecycleOnlyCommandResultV2 and DurableCommandResultV2 schemas/checked constructors. LifecycleOnlyCommandResultV2 has exactly api_generation, wire_version, command, InvocationRootV2, RunIdV2, complete LifecycleDocumentV2, LifecycleLogRootV2, RunTerminalRecordRootV2, AuthorityScopeRootV2, and no_claim_scope. DurableCommandResultV2 has the same first eight fields followed by complete PublishedBundleReceiptV2, PublishedBundleReceiptRootV2, AuthorityScopeRootV2, and no_claim_scope. Neither serializes a result root or redundant BundleManifestRootV2/SealRootV2. Exact semantic payload length, fixed six-field transport-header length, checked full-frame total, nominal payload root, and typed context root are separately preflighted before publication; RunnerBudgetsV2.command_result_stdout_bytes caps the total; and payload bytes plus payload-length/total/root/context are reproduced after receipt construction; actual write/flush/return is only non-authoritative CommandResultDeliveryObservationV1 outside accounting, receipt, and result identity. LifecycleDocumentV2 has exact record_count plus ordered records; clean completion is full outer-frame exhaustion under finalized-writer typestate, never a clean_eof field. Every CaseTerminal binds one closed CaseTerminalBasisV2 controlled by CaseExecutionPhase; RunSummary and RunTerminal share one RunOutcomeBasisRootV2 without a summary self/basis placeholder. The phase independently verifies List catalog; one lifecycle-only result after clean Check/SelfTest; empty durable stdout until commit/recovery; and one durable result containing lifecycle plus published receipt after exact publication.

StableTokenV2/RunnerLimitsV2 uses the widened 128-byte lowercase-ASCII cap; fully namespaced identifiers remain intact and exact 128/129-byte boundaries are joined. Independent verification is integrity-first: framing/caps; singular PublicationTargetV2 plus BundleLayout-derived full paths and ContentStore keys; retained historical-output DestinationResourceBindingV1 plus exact safe-API/audited-FFI and ContentStore provider-conformance roots; stored envelope/root; encoded frame/root; expanded content/root; schema/version; canonical bytes; identity/source closure; lifecycle basis/record-count/completion and CaseConformanceSpecV2/CaseRawOutcomeV2/CaseConformanceVerdictV2; summary/terminal shared outcome basis; singular four-field PublicationSelectionV2 plus separate Invocation/Manifest RunnerBudgetsV2 and RootCapabilityPolicyRootV2 bindings and the exact nine PublicationAccountingV1 actuals, with command-result length excluded; manifest and PlannedPreIntentObjectSetRootV1; PublicationKeyV1; self-root-free PublicationIntentV1; actual PreSealObjectSetRoot and ProvenDurablePreSealV2; DurablePublicationIdentityV2 binding DestinationResourceBindingRootV1 plus the planned and actual object-set roots; Seal; final commit/recovery; PublishedBundleReceipt; exact outer-result shape plus payload/header/checked-total/root/context preflight/post-receipt reproduction and non-authoritative delivery observation; authority/no-claim. Later schema, migration, or policy observations cannot mask earlier byte tamper.

Phase 3 executes no successful legacy migration and no real family/candidate/admission mutation before their owners exist. It parses and preserves current/unknown/future/legacy source envelopes, verifies exact Unsupported/tamper distinctions, enforces Match/Match only for newly selected Run cases, requires InvocationBasisV2 optional ReplayLineageRootV2 exactly for Replay with no direct MigrationExecutionBasisRootV2, requires ReplayLineageV2 to bind the current basis exactly once, preserves the exact source durable command/case-manifest roots/claim modes/expected comparison and effect frames including Negative mismatch/error, and freezes DownstreamMutationRegistrationV1 so later migration, family, performance, candidate, and authority owners add their own executable corpus cells without copying the base corpus. Successful artifact-only replay and migration remain 24.4.2.

RunnerPhase3SchemaOwnershipManifestV2 is separately rooted, append-only, non-authoritative, and fixed to phase 3. It points to the exact 24.1.3.2 RunnerPhase1SchemaOwnershipRegistryV2 and 24.2.2.3 RunnerPhase2SchemaOwnershipManifestV2 roots, uses the same owner-entry vocabulary, records only exact Phase-3 additions, never embeds in or moves base/family-only RunnerSpecV2, and is generated by 24.3.3.3. The three-way join, not 24.3.2, owns execution of every upstream mutant against producer, pure oracle, and independent verifier. This removes the former 24.3.2/24.3.3 prose cycle.

This Bead consumes and independently checks the normative StableTokenV2 grammar, checked constructor, and 128-byte cap owned by frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.1.1.1.1; Phase-2 parser rollup 24.2.1.1 supplies only hostile/native-byte acquisition, framing, offsets, and decoding into that checked type. Phase 3 does not own or redefine the grammar. The consumed grammar is exactly ^[a-z0-9]+([._-][a-z0-9]+)*$: nonempty lowercase-ASCII alphanumeric segments separated by a single period, underscore, or hyphen byte. Because every admitted token is ASCII, exact 127/128 acceptance and 129-byte refusal are required; Unicode normalization, non-ASCII lookalikes/confusables, uppercase, empty segments, leading/trailing separators, repeated separators, truncation, shortening, and alias substitution all refuse.

ArtifactOnlyRead is the default independent-verification acquisition mode. It accepts a complete retained bundle and receipt from any pinned read-only input resource, treats the DestinationResourceBindingRootV1 embedded in those bytes only as historical output identity, and records the live input in non-authoritative VerifierInputAcquisitionObservationV1 outside InvocationRootV2, RunIdV2, bundle, receipt, decoder, verifier, and result identities. A byte-identical complete copy to a different input resource must preserve all semantic decoder/verifier/result roots; only the acquisition observation may move. Descriptor, handle, capability, generation, revocation, short-read, or mixed-snapshot substitution during acquisition refuses with no partial result. OriginalOutputRecoveryVerification is a separate explicit mode pointed at the original output target: it live-rederives DestinationResourceBindingRootV1 and requires exact equality with the historical binding. The independent verifier remains read-only in both modes; mutating recovery belongs only to 24.2.2.2.

Phase 3 closes only when the independent lifecycle/publication oracle, isolated mutation corpus, and decoder/verifier/E2E rollup agree on the complete Presented-to-evaluation root chain and contextual artifact membership without sharing producer implementation tables. Mutant kills require exact lane/stage/tie/context/full roots, not terminal equivalence. Every evaluator contribution and retained artifact is source-closed, owner-bound, and separately classified.

Phase 3 closes only when the independent oracle, isolated mutation corpus, decoder, verifier, and three-way E2E agree on the complete acyclic evaluator topology and every exact enclosing root without sharing producer tables or semantic constructors. No Bash/WSL/MSYS fallback may satisfy native Windows. A phase closeout refuses missing, duplicate, extra, mixed-root/context, stale, partially completed, silently skipped, or over-budget cells and any aggregate that changes with wrapper, shard count/order, or valid interruption/resume schedule.

## Final phase-3 command-result transport gate

Phase 3 treats CommandResultTransportFrameV1 and CommandResultDeliveryObservationV1 as explicit non-authoritative verification dimensions. It exact-joins the Phase-2 owner descriptor with independent oracle, mutation, decoder, verifier, cross-platform driver, shard/resume aggregate, logs, and source closure; checks the complete frame against command_result_stdout_bytes; and preserves the distinction between malformed transport, incomplete outer-result delivery after valid publication, and semantic/publication failure.

This clause supersedes every earlier numeric node/estimate/subtotal claim and every earlier phrase treating hierarchy children as reciprocal `blocks` dependencies or this epic as an implementation task. It removes no scope, feature, functionality, test, E2E script/contribution, logging, reproduction, source, route, capability, durability, scientific, admission, authority, or no-claim obligation.

ROLLUP CLOSEOUT DISCOVERABILITY AND MANUAL-EVIDENCE GATE 2026-07-29 (FINAL CONTROLLING). `br ready --epic frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24 --type task --json --limit 0` is the canonical implementation-task query; `bv` robot output is dependency/impact diagnosis, not executable status. When `br epic status --eligible-only --json` first reports this epic eligible because all direct children are closed, the epic is not automatically complete. Its deterministic closeout view MUST expose any remaining integration/route/join/rerun/review work; exact route ID where applicable; immutable command/driver/manifest descriptor; compatible source/build/schema roots; unresolved stable cells and proof states; expected result partitions; retained relative artifact root; retryability; no-claim scope; and uniquely ranked non-executable repairs. A route-owning or integration-owning epic must be claimed and its own acceptance evidence completed before explicit close; task-only queries must not make that work disappear, and automatic bulk epic closure cannot substitute for it.

The transition from blocked -> eligible closeout -> in-progress closeout -> explicitly closed is deterministic and logged. Literal/unit, state/model/race, mutation, API/compile-fail, fault/cancellation, integrated E2E or child-evidence replay, detailed logging/redaction, reproduction, exact coverage, and source-closure tests cover premature surfacing, hidden remaining route work, missing/extra/duplicate child roots, stale eligibility, already-complete reruns, failed closeout and safe retry, mixed snapshots, bulk-close substitution, and exact final proof-state separation. Pure review rollups use a typed no-route closeout; no epic may invent or infer an unnamed route merely to become discoverable.

title: Mutation and late-bound verifier-registration schemas, ownership map, and base expectation catalog
description:
Own the non-authoritative mutation and late-bound downstream-registration schemas plus exact upstream owner/catalog inventory, without executing a mutant or claiming a kill.

## Acceptance Criteria

The dedicated Acceptance Criteria field is the canonical complete close gate. It preserves the domain-specific gate and the common nine-group unit/property/model/race/mutation/API/fault/E2E-or-contribution/logging/source-closure protocol; no description shorthand, checkpoint, parent status, aggregate count, or partial proof can replace it.
design: SOLE OWNERSHIP. Own MutationCaseV2, IndependentVerifierBindingV1, and DownstreamMutationRegistrationV1 schemas, descriptors, canonical codecs, checked constructors, and exact upstream owner/expectation catalog. IndependentVerifierBindingV1 is NotYetBound { owner_bead_id, ordered_prerequisite_bead_ids, no_claim_scope } for definition-only registrations or Bound { independent_verifier_root, verifier_source_closure_root, verifier_build_root } before executable registration/kill. Downstream registration exact fields include owner/namespace, feature/mutation/expectation/base roots, verifier binding, eligible cells, test-category/E2E-contribution/log-schema roots, time/memory/work/process/artifact/output/log budgets, release driver, downstream owner/script, source closure, ratchets, no-claim, version. Ratchets never replace stable-ID manifests. No callbacks/runtime mutant selection/execution/authority.
acceptance_criteria:
DOMAIN GATE. Literal/API/compile-fail/property/mutation tests exact-set every field/order/state/version/owner/root/budget/route. Definition-only NotYetBound cannot execute or claim a kill; executable registration requires Bound after verifier completion. Missing/extra/wrong-state/wrong-owner/stale/count-only/unbudgeted/route-ambiguous/result-contaminated records refuse. Registration cannot construct production schema ownership, receipt, verifier authority, evidence, candidate, decision, or admission receipt.

COMMON IMPLEMENTATION-LEAF CLOSE PROTOCOL (CONTROLLING). Preserve all nine groups: literal/unit/boundary; property/metamorphic; state/typestate/model/race; mutation/fuzz; API/compile-fail/trait; fault/resource/cancellation; release-built no-mock focused E2E or immutable contribution; deterministic detailed logging/redaction; and source closure. Every applicable slash facet has a separately nonzero corpus; true inapplicability has a stable typed code/name, owner, scope, prerequisite, and no-claim. One source-authoritative full-set manifest retains distinct exact ordered ID sets and checked counters for eligible positives and matched positives; eligible expected refusals and matched expected refusals; eligible expected failures and matched expected failures; and eligible mutations and matched mutations; exact Unsupported/inapplicable reasons; unexpected mismatches; execution failures; and unexplained skips. Green requires every eligible ID once, equality in each matched pair, nonempty applicable positive/adversarial corpora, exact reasons, and zero unexpected mismatches, execution failures, or unexplained skips; empty/subset execution cannot pass. Owned E2E uses one exact verified release route with no mocks; contributions bind one downstream owner/driver/script, independent oracle, explicit time/memory/work/process/artifact/output/log budgets, schema/log/source/build roots, expected disposition, and no-claim and cannot claim execution. Bounded canonical logs retain cell/category/facet ID, semantic/source/build/schema/oracle/budget/manifest/execution roots, ordered stages/terminal, redacted expected/observed class, first divergence, drain/resource outcome, exact partitions, diagnostic owner plus prerequisite/repair counts, no-claim, and relative artifacts. Exact prerequisites and repairs remain in bounded typed detail manifests that exact-join logs. Secrets, environment, live capabilities/resources, raw handles/provider payloads, physical/absolute paths, PIDs, wall time, scheduler noise, and bulk data are forbidden; rejected sentinels cannot echo through observed, Display, Debug, canonical bytes, logs, diagnostics, or reproduction. Source closure exact-sets modules, CONTRACT/rustdoc, schemas/owners, independent tables/oracles, fixtures, E2E scripts/contributions, log schemas, direct dependencies/features, and build inputs on one snapshot. Diagnostics have exact owner, retryability, prerequisites, no-claim, and unique non-executable ranked repairs. C1 schema/owner/import freeze, C2 literal/unit/boundary/API proof, C3 property/model/race/fault/mutation proof, and C4 E2E-or-contribution/log/redaction/source-closure proof are non-closing checkpoints only; root movement invalidates them. Focused, E2E/contribution, source-closure, constellation, DSR, downstream, platform, durability, science, admission, and authority statuses remain separate.

FIVE EXPLICITS DECLARATION, RUNTIME-EVIDENCE, AND COMPLETE-LOG GATE (CONTROLLING). Every stable literal, unit, boundary, property, metamorphic, state, typestate, model, race, mutation, fuzz, API, fault, and E2E cell binds one declaration-side Five Explicits contract: typed units for every numeric input, numeric grant, and expected numeric observation; one canonical seed declaration plus generator/minimizer version, or a registered `SeedInapplicable` code with owner, scope, prerequisite, and no-claim; seven-axis hard and soft time, memory, logical-work, process, artifact, output, and log budgets with process shape declared separately; exact API, wire, schema, source, build, toolchain, target, profile, and feature version requirements; one exact required/permitted semantic capability contract; and the exact no-claim. Runtime actual numeric observations, resolved seed provenance, budget reconciliation, observed versions, and actual required, granted, observed, returned, and revoked capability sets exist only inside disposition-gated runtime evidence. `Observed` requires complete actuals; `NotObserved` may retain only safe typed partial evidence plus its exact reason and cannot substitute expected values; `Deferred` and `Inapplicable` contain no fabricated actuals. Changing any applicable declaration or actual explicit moves exactly the intended component, cell, evidence, log, reproduction, aggregate, and report roots. Bounded log writers reserve sufficient bytes for one canonical terminal event before admitting detail events. The first event that would exceed the remaining detail budget emits one complete deterministic `LogBudgetExceeded` terminal containing the rejected event class and ordinal, digest, omitted count, applicable budget, first-divergence stage, disposition, drain/resource outcome, diagnostic owner, repair-manifest root, and no-claim. Partial JSONL, silent truncation, overwriting prior events, missing terminal state, expected-as-actual substitution, fabricated observed-empty data, or treating overflow as success refuses. Minimized reproduction evidence retains every applicable declaration and safe actual explicit without exposing a forbidden value.

E2E ROUTE OBLIGATION MANIFEST GATE (CONTROLLING). Every leaf owns one exact ordered route-obligation manifest rather than a lossy leaf-wide binary. Each applicable obligation appears exactly once with `LeafCloseRouteObligationKindV1`: 1 `LocalInProcess`, 2 `ExecutionOwned`, 3 `ContributionOnly`, or 4 `Inapplicable`; zero and unknown refuse. A LocalInProcess row binds the real public in-process entry point, immutable cell oracle, budgets, expected partitions, detailed-log schema/root, source closure, and no-mock no-authority boundary. An ExecutionOwned row binds one literal release driver, POSIX wrapper where applicable, direct native-Windows driver or PowerShell wrapper as frozen by the owner contract, immutable case-manifest path/root, exact close argv, release-artifact identity, platform/provider matrix, declared capability profile, runtime evidence-envelope contract, retained relative artifacts, and complete detailed-log root. A ContributionOnly row binds one immutable result-free payload and Deferred envelope to exactly one downstream execution owner plus its literal driver, script/native route, manifest, observer contract, budgets, expected partitions, logging schema, source/build roots, and no-claim; it cannot report downstream execution passed. An Inapplicable row binds one registered reason, owner, scope, prerequisite, and no-claim. The derived leaf class is exactly `LocalOnly`, `ExecutionOnly`, `ContributionOnly`, or `Mixed`; multiple obligations and multiple contribution rows are legal and must remain distinct. Missing, extra, duplicate, reordered, generic, ambiguous, rollup-owned, stale, remapped, wrong-script, unconsumed, multiply consumed, debug, ambient/PATH-resolved/alternate/unregistered Cargo-run, hidden-skip, contribution-as-execution, or inferred leaf-class routes refuse. A specifically registered source-closed focused probe is legal only when its owner Bead names it and remains separately labeled non-closing evidence. Unit/exact-set, property/model, mutation, API/compile-fail, no-mock in-process or release-built E2E/contribution, deterministic detailed-log/redaction, structured-reproduction, resume/shard, overflow, and source-closure tests cover empty, one, maximum, mixed, duplicate, reorder, route substitution, owner remap, and every row-kind/derived-class transition. Focused/unit proof cannot substitute for a required release-built row or immutable contribution contract.

EXACT PHASE-3 VERIFICATION ROUTE OBLIGATION (CONTROLLING). This leaf owns the immutable `ContributionOnly` row `runner-v2.route.24-3-2-1.to.upstream-mutation-v2.v1` consumed exactly once by owner `.24.3.2.4`, driver `evidence-runner-upstream-mutation-v2-e2e-driver`, POSIX wrapper `scripts/ci/e2e_evidence_runner_upstream_mutation_v2.sh`, the owner-frozen direct native-Windows route, and case manifest `scripts/ci/manifests/evidence_runner_upstream_mutation_v2_cases.v1.json`. The row binds declared profile `fs-evidence-runner.close-capability.release-verification.v1`, exact result-free payload plus source/build/toolchain/target/features/schema/log roots, observer-contract root, per-cell/shard budgets, expected positive/refusal/failure/mutation/Unsupported/Inapplicable partitions, retained-relative-artifact policy, no-claim, and one distinct Deferred evidence-envelope root using reason code 1. It contains no fabricated actual roots and cannot claim oracle, mutation, decoder, verifier-core, or full-verifier execution passed. The owner rejects missing, extra, duplicate, reordered, stale, remapped, wrong-profile/driver/native-route/manifest, mixed-snapshot, multiply consumed, payload-as-envelope, and contribution-as-execution rows. Unit/boundary, property/model, one-defect mutation, API/compile-fail, fault/cancellation/observation-loss, immutable-contribution plus release-built native E2E, deterministic step-prefixed detailed-log/redaction, structured reproduction, overflow/resume, coverage, and source-closure tests prove this row and exact owner consumption. Additional routes remain separately registered.

AC57 EVIDENCE-DISPOSITION CONSUMER GATE (CONTROLLING). This leaf consumes, and MUST NOT redefine, the exact evidence-kind, RuntimeObservationDispositionV1, reason-registry, completeness, safe-partial-evidence, resource-reconciliation, EvidenceEnvelopeV1, and FirstDivergentExplicitComponentV1 contracts governed by program gate `.24.1.1.1` and base contract owner `.24.1.1.1`. Every stable local cell and every exact route-obligation row maps to one and only one legal evidence-kind/disposition pair. OwnedHarnessExecution and InProcessProjectionExecution admit only Observed or NotObserved; ImmutableDownstreamContribution admits only Deferred; ApplicabilityDeclaration admits only Inapplicable. LocalInProcess and ExecutionOwned work may close Observed only after a completed attempt supplies every applicable actual numeric-observation, observed-seed-disposition, budget-reconciliation, observed-version, observed-capability-set, execution-completeness, attempt-identity, retained-state, and resource-reconciliation root. A matched refusal, expected failure, executed Unsupported outcome, or mutation survivor/kill remains Observed when observation is complete; semantic outcome never substitutes for observation disposition.

NotObserved is fail-closed and uses exactly one registered reason: 1 execution-failed-before-completeness, 2 observation-channel-failed-before-completeness, or 3 unexpected-unstarted-or-skipped. It preserves attempt and payload identity and may preserve only a separately rooted redacted safe-partial-evidence object; it never copies expected values into actual fields, encodes missing actuals as observed-empty, claims successful execution, or permits a green aggregate. Every ContributionOnly row emits exactly one result-free upstream payload plus a distinct Deferred envelope with reason 1 immutable-contribution-awaits-designated-release-owner and the designated owner/driver/native-or-script route/manifest/observer contract; the designated owner later emits a separate execution envelope and cannot overwrite, alias, or promote the upstream envelope. Inapplicable is legal only for a predeclared exact source-registered applicability descriptor and cannot be synthesized from runtime skip, infrastructure failure, unsupported provider discovery, or missing observation.

The leaf's result, report contribution, stage evidence, runtime aggregate, detailed cell event, log context, structured reproduction, normal terminal, overflow terminal, bounded prefix, final bounded log, route contribution, and source closure exact-join the applicable declaration components, runtime disposition, and envelope root. Actual component roots are present only for Observed; every non-Observed form carries exact typed absence plus its reason/descriptor and no-claim. Comparisons use the AC57 exact twenty-position FirstDivergentExplicitComponentV1 precedence and stop at the first unequal applicable component without logging rejected raw values. Unit and literal-oracle tests cover every owned legal row; zero/unknown code and complete/partial/absent boundaries; property/model/state/typestate laws; mutation and API/compile-fail barriers; no-mock in-process or release-built owner E2E, or immutable contribution plus owner-consumption E2E; execution/observation/grant/use/return/revoke/cancellation/resource faults; deterministic step-prefixed detailed logging, redaction, structured reproduction, overflow-before-divergence, shard/resume, and one-component root movement; exact coverage partitions; and source closure. Tests MUST reject every illegal kind/disposition/reason pair, expected-as-actual, observed-empty-as-complete, payload-as-envelope, upstream-as-owner envelope, contribution-as-execution, applicability-as-skip, duplicate/missing/reordered evidence, hidden skip, forbidden-value echo, and stale or mixed-snapshot root.

AC58 SCHEMA-IMPACT CONSUMER AND MIGRATION GATE (CONTROLLING). This leaf consumes, and MUST NOT redefine, the canonical-schema migration registry and independent literal schema oracle owned by base contract owner `.24.1.1.1` under program gate `.24.1.1.1`. Its exact source-authoritative SchemaImpactManifestV1 classifies every canonical frame, nominal root, registry, manifest, log event, terminal, report, projection, contribution, route envelope, and structured-reproduction schema that this leaf owns or consumes exactly once by stable schema ID and exact u16 disposition: 1 NewV1NoPredecessor, 2 UnchangedV1, 3 MigratedV1ToV2, 4 DecodeOnlyLegacyV1, 5 RetiredV1, or 6 InapplicableNoCanonicalFrame. Each row binds API generation, wire version and wire-predecessor policy, separate canonical-schema migration policy, exact domain, magic, ordered field descriptors, nominal root role, owner, source path, authoritative/compatibility status, allowed parent/child versions, no-claim, and compatible-source-snapshot root. Zero/unknown codes and missing, extra, duplicate, reordered, owner-inferred, route-inferred, stale, or mixed-snapshot rows refuse.

Wire compatibility and canonical-schema migration are non-interchangeable. API generation 2, wire version 1, and Runner wire predecessor NoPredecessor remain separate from canonical-schema policies NoSchemaPredecessor, V1DecodeOnlyCompatibilityEvidence, and V1Retired. A new component may begin at V1 only when it has no canonical predecessor. Every enclosing schema whose field order, field meaning, canonical payload, or authority semantics changes rotates coherently to a distinct V2 type, `.v2` domain, versioned magic, field table, and V2 nominal root on the same compatible source snapshot. An unchanged V1 child is legal inside a V2 parent only when the independent oracle explicitly records that unchanged component role and exact position. Decode-only or retired V1 bytes never alias, parse as, substitute for, or close an authoritative V2 path; partial migration, V2-parent/V1-child substitution outside an allowed unchanged slot, generic ContentHash bridging, transmute-like accessors, shared domains/magics, compatibility aliases, and caller-minted roots refuse.

Every literal/unit/boundary, property/metamorphic, state/model/race, mutation/fuzz, API/compile-fail, fault/resource/cancellation, no-mock E2E or immutable-contribution, deterministic detailed-log/redaction, structured-reproduction, coverage, and source-closure fixture owned by this leaf names the authoritative schema versions and compatible snapshot. Tests freeze every V1 compatibility byte fixture before migration; exhaust exact-empty, one, exact maximum, one-over, missing/extra/duplicate/reordered rows; mutate every domain, magic, version, policy, field descriptor, nominal role, source owner, parent/child version, and snapshot; prove exact root movement and typed inspectability; reject V1/V2 and cross-role substitution, old-root-as-new-root, stale literal counts, and partial or mixed-snapshot migration; and exercise the exact release-built route or immutable contribution plus designated-owner consumption with step-prefixed logs, first explicit divergence, structured reproduction, overflow/resume, retained-relative-artifact policy, and no forbidden-value echo. CONTRACT/rustdoc, public accessors, route manifests, detailed log schemas, reproduction descriptors, coverage manifests, source closure, and all literal ratchets MUST agree on the same authoritative version; focused, strict-remote, release-built E2E, DSR, downstream, durability, scientific, and authority results remain separate proof states.

EXACT ORDERED LEAF ROUTE MANIFEST SUMMARY (CONTROLLING). The source-authoritative LeafCloseRouteObligationManifestV1 for this leaf contains exactly one row in kind-code then stable-route-ID order: runner-v2.route.24-3-2-1.to.upstream-mutation-v2.v1. Exact counts are LocalInProcess=0, ExecutionOwned=0, ContributionOnly=1, and Inapplicable=0; the derived class is exactly ContributionOnly. Every prior route-specific criterion on this Bead specifies one of these same rows and does not create a duplicate. No prose-only owner, dependency, test fixture, schema provenance edge, focused probe, rollup mapping, or transitive consumer becomes an implicit route. Adding, removing, merging, splitting, or remapping a journey requires updating this exact list, its independent registry oracle, AC56 capability profile, AC57 evidence kind/disposition, AC58 schema-impact row, coverage ratchet, detailed-log/reproduction schemas, and source closure atomically.

Independent unit/exact-set and zero/one/exact/one-over manifest tests, kind-order and derived-class properties, owner/consumer model tests, every-row mutation, API/compile-fail nominal privacy, no-mock local/release/contribution E2E as applicable, disposition/capability/resource/cancellation faults, deterministic step-prefixed detailed logging/redaction/no-echo, structured reproduction, overflow-before-divergence, shard/resume, exact result partitions, and source closure reconstruct this list without reading the production registry table. They reject missing, extra, duplicate, reordered, stale, unknown-kind, inferred-class, wrong owner/profile/driver/wrapper/manifest/entrypoint, contribution-as-execution, local-as-release, applicability-as-skip, transitive-route invention, hidden skip, and mixed-snapshot rows.

ROUTE-SCHEMA V2 AND PROOF-DAG RECONCILIATION (CONTROLLING). Every leaf route manifest consumes the common closed route vocabulary owned by frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.1.1.1 and MUST NOT redefine it. LeafCloseRouteObligationKindV1 is exact: 1 LocalInProcess, 2 ExecutionOwned, 3 ContributionOnly, and 4 Inapplicable; zero and unknown refuse. LeafCloseRouteDerivedClassV1 is exact: 1 LocalOnly, 2 ExecutionOnly, 3 ContributionOnly, and 4 Mixed. Inapplicable rows do not by themselves determine the class; an empty or all-Inapplicable manifest refuses. LEAF_CLOSE_ROUTE_OBLIGATIONS_MAX_V1 is exactly 64 rows. Manifest input is already in kind-code then bytewise stable-route-ID order and is rejected rather than sorted. The exact runtime evidence enum name is BaseCoverageCloseEvidenceKindV1; no third generic EvidenceKindV1 is introduced alongside the existing close and logging vocabularies.

DIRECT NATIVE-WINDOWS ROUTE REPRESENTATION (CONTROLLING). NativeWindowsRouteV2 is a closed typed sum: code 1 PowerShellWrapper { wrapper_owner, logical_path: LogicalBundlePathV1 } and code 2 DirectDriver { driver_owner, driver_id: StableTokenV2, bootstrap_contract_root: NativeWindowsDriverBootstrapContractRootV1 }; zero and unknown codes refuse. DirectDriver names the same exact platform-neutral release driver frozen by the route row. It is never encoded as a path, inferred .ps1 companion, shell command, PATH-resolved executable, Wine/WSL/MSYS route, or optional wrapper. NativeWindowsDriverBootstrapContractV1 is the common declaration schema owned by .24.1.1.1, with stable ABI ID fs-evidence-runner.native-windows-driver-bootstrap-abi.v1, nominal root NativeWindowsDriverBootstrapContractRootV1, canonical domain org.frankensim.fs-evidence-runner.native-windows-driver-bootstrap-contract.v1, and magic ASCII FSNATIVEWINDOWSBOOTSTRAP followed by byte 0x01. Its exact frame order is API generation 2; wire generation 1; ABI ID; argv representation windows-utf16-code-units-v1; direct-driver/no-shell/no-PATH policy; and no-claim native-windows-bootstrap-contract-proves-argv-shape-not-driver-presence-launch-exit-or-authority. A concrete driver ID, source/build artifact, target/provider binding, and execution remain owned by the designated execution owner and exact-join this common contract.

BaseCoverageCloseDeferredObservationContractV1 remains compatibility-only because its windows_route field is path-only. It is never reinterpreted for DirectDriver. BaseCoverageCloseDeferredObservationContractV2 replaces that field with NativeWindowsRouteV2 and has domain org.frankensim.fs-evidence-runner.close-deferred-observation-contract.v2 and magic ASCII FSCLOSEDEFERREDOBSERVER followed by byte 0x02. Its exact order is route ID; semantic consumer; execution owner; driver owner; POSIX wrapper owner; capability profile; driver ID; POSIX route; complete NativeWindowsRouteV2 bytes/root; case-manifest path; case-manifest contract root; Deferred-reason registry root; Deferred reason; and no-claim. Because BaseCoverageCloseDownstreamContributionV2 embeds the V1 observer, route declarations use additive BaseCoverageCloseDownstreamContributionV3 plus BaseCoverageCloseDeferredEvidenceEnvelopeV2; the V2 contribution and V1 envelope remain compatibility evidence and cannot enter the authoritative route manifest. No existing V1 bytes are silently reinterpreted.

ROUTE DECLARATION/RUNTIME DAG CLARIFICATION (CONTROLLING). A source-authoritative LocalInProcess route row binds attempt_identity_contract_root, detailed_log_schema_root, and structured_reproduction_schema_root. It MUST NOT bind a per-invocation attempt_identity_root, detailed_log_root, or structured_reproduction_root. LocalInProcessRunRequestV1 binds the actual AttemptIdentityV1 only after declaration admission. RuntimeObservationV1, EvidenceEnvelopeV1, PresentedResultV2, aggregate/report, StructuredReproductionV2, terminal, and final log bind actual invocation roots in that forward order. StructuredReproductionV2 is constructed only after the completed report or safe partial report; its actual root enters the terminal afterward. Any reverse edge, expected-as-actual substitution, or source manifest whose root changes per attempt refuses. Static route rows bind a case_manifest_contract_root derived from exact owner/driver/native/POSIX/path/schema literals; they do not claim a downstream-owned file exists, has been read, has a runtime content root, or has executed.

OWNER ROLE EQUALITY MATRIX (CONTROLLING). Every owner role remains a separately encoded typed field even when two fields contain the same Bead ID. source_owner is the leaf that emits the declaration. For each ContributionOnly row, semantic_consumer equals execution_owner and driver_owner equals execution_owner unless an exact row explicitly freezes another owner. posix_wrapper_owner equals execution_owner when a POSIX wrapper is declared. windows_wrapper_owner equals execution_owner only for PowerShellWrapper; DirectDriver has no wrapper owner and its driver_owner equals execution_owner. source_owner MUST differ from semantic_consumer and execution_owner. Equal values across declared role fields are legal and do not collapse, omit, or infer fields. Rows may share an owner, driver, platform routes, and case-manifest contract only when explicitly listed, while their route ID, payload root, contribution root, and Deferred-envelope root remain distinct.

DECLARATION VERSUS ACTUAL ARTIFACTS AND FAULTS (CONTROLLING). Contribution rows use OwnerEnvelopeRelativePathsOnly. Local rows use a distinct LocalExplicitAbsentOrRelativePathsOnly policy. Both are declaration policy only; RetainedArtifactStateV1 is runtime evidence and is present only under the legal runtime disposition. A pure in-process leaf with no asupersync/runtime dependency may test deterministic model-only observation-loss, cancellation, deadline, and resource faults through private sealed fixtures, but MUST label them model evidence and MUST NOT call them actual runtime cancellation/drain proof. Actual scoped cancellation, stop, drain, process, and resource-return evidence remains with the exact execution owner whose dependency/capability contract permits it. A Boolean callback or public test hook cannot stand in for either model proof or actual cancellation.

CANONICAL ROUTE SCHEMAS AND TEST GATE (CONTROLLING). New route body, row, manifest, local-entrypoint registry, native-route, native-bootstrap, V2 observer, V3 contribution, V2 Deferred-envelope, declaration-policy, and runtime-result schemas have exact API/wire versions, domains, magic bytes, ordered fields, nominal roots, migration rows, source owners, source paths, compatible snapshot, and no-claim. New nominal roles use source-frozen LeafExtension fragments and never append to the immutable 47-role FrozenBase registry. Independent handwritten tests cover exact codes/literals and every route row; empty, one, 64, 65, exact-set, missing, extra, duplicate, reorder, stale, unknown kind, all class transitions, and all-Inapplicable refusal; every-field/root mutation; owner/consumer singularity and equality; PowerShell/direct-driver substitution; V1/V2/V3 barriers; raw-hash and cross-kind compile failures with exact Rust error codes and positive counterparts; result-free contribution plus Deferred-envelope separation; no-mock local or release owner E2E; Observed, NotObserved, Deferred, and Inapplicable matrices; safe partials; model-only versus actual cancellation scope; reserve-before-detail log overflow; deterministic step order, redaction, no-echo, and post-report structured reproduction; shard/resume and mixed-snapshot refusal; exact partitions; and complete source closure. Every test and compile-fail addition updates its live inventory, class count, route ratchet, schema-impact manifest, log/reproduction schema, and source closure atomically. Focused, release-built, source-closure, constellation, DSR, downstream, platform, durability, scientific, admission, and authority proof states remain separate.

LATE-BOUND REGISTRATION TYPESTATE GATE 2026-07-29 (CONTROLLING). A `NotYetBound` registration may seal an immutable mutation definition and its producer/oracle expectations, but it is never executable and cannot claim verifier coverage or mutation kill. Only `.24.3.3.3.1` may consume it and bind the completed verifier root, verifier source-closure root, and verifier build root into `Bound`. Literal, state/model, mutation, API/compile-fail, contribution, logging, and source-closure tests reject direct `Bound` construction, stale/wrong verifier roots, duplicates, bypass, execution of `NotYetBound`, and any authority inferred from a definition.

ORACLE/MUTATION STAGING AND INFORMATION-FLOW GATE 2026-07-29 (FINAL CONTROLLING). The `NotYetBound` mutation-definition stage binds normative schemas, oracle owner IDs, expectation-kind descriptors, and result-free contract roots only; it contains no completed oracle execution, executable oracle table/helper, or observed-result root. Command/evaluator/lifecycle corpus work consumes only immutable expectation contracts from `.24.3.1.1` and `.24.3.1.2`; codec/publication/recovery corpus work consumes only immutable expectation contracts from `.24.3.1.1` and `.24.3.1.3`. Neither branch imports executable oracle tables, helpers, fixtures, reducers, minimized results, or release receipts. Only `.24.3.2.4` consumes `.24.3.1.4`'s completed release-proof root and performs producer-versus-oracle execution. Literal/dependency, property/model, mutation, API/compile-fail, contribution/execution, detailed-log, and source-closure tests inspect exact imports/roots and reject result leakage, executable-helper sharing, future-result feedback, missing contract roots, wrong oracle owner, or stale/mixed snapshots.

description:

title: Independent Runner V2 decoder, semantic verifier, and three-way E2E exact-root rollup
description:
Closeout-only integration rollup for three bounded independent-verifier scopes: decoder/safe-Rust-codec rollup 24.3.3.1 including its nested complete-Zstd integration rollup; pure lifecycle/bundle/publication/recovery verifier rollup 24.3.3.2; and producer-oracle-verifier differential/native-host E2E rollup 24.3.3.3. Across them, 14 implementation tasks retain singular ownership. This parent exact-set joins their roots and performs no decoding, verification, acquisition, mutation execution, or authority action.

## Success Criteria

The dedicated Acceptance Criteria field is the canonical rollup close gate. This Bead implements no decoder, verifier rule, E2E case, migration adapter, family logic, publisher, or authority path. Exact accounting/result delivery separation, acyclic publication identity, and ReplayLineage ownership are mandatory join dimensions. The join also closes stable destination/platform/provider evidence and Phase-3 schema ownership without broadening authority. Artifact-only verification is resource-location-independent; only explicit original-output recovery verification live-rebinds historical destination identity.
design:
The verifier program is decomposed so implementation independence is reviewable rather than asserted inside one oversized task.

24.3.3.1 creates the concrete publish-false crates/fs-evidence-verifier TOOL crate and owns its Cargo.toml, initial root-workspace member row, Cargo.lock package row, CONTRACT, independent canonical wire-struct mirrors/streaming parser, singular-upstream-schema drift gate, BundleLayout and ContentStore envelope decoder with target/full-path/key derivation, complete safe-Rust no-dictionary ZstdFrameV1 decoder, dependency/import gate, focused tests, and decoder logs. Its only allowed normal dependency is fs-blake3 for the shared primitive hash/identity algorithm; it has no build script, features, producer, zstd, FFI, or foreign codec dependency.

24.3.3.2 consumes only the independent decoder and raw normative schema/policy assets. It owns independent comparison/effect evaluation under CaseConformanceSpecV2/CaseRawOutcomeV2/CaseConformanceVerdictV2, closed CaseTerminalBasis/RunOutcomeBasis and lifecycle-completion verification, artifact and exact-six-system-object accounting under the nine-field PublicationAccountingV1, conformance to singular PublicationSelectionV2 with separate budget/policy bindings, historical output DestinationResourceBinding and safe/unsafe/provider-conformance verification, location-independent ArtifactOnlyRead with non-authoritative acquisition observations, explicit OriginalOutputRecoveryVerification live rebind, acyclic planned/pre-intent/actual-pre-seal publication verification, protocol effect and recovery verification, receipt verification, exact upstream-result shape plus payload/header/checked-total/root/context preflight and post-receipt reproduction with separate delivery observation, exact ReplayLineage/current-basis ownership, exact integrity-first classification, authority/no-claim output, verifier binary, and semantic test corpus. It has no fs-evidence-runner dependency.

24.3.3.3 depends directly on completed 24.2.2.3, 24.3.2, and 24.3.3.2. It owns release-built three-way producer-versus-24.3.1-oracle-versus-verifier execution for every eligible upstream mutant, process/fault/recovery/tamper journeys including ArtifactOnlyRead copy/mid-read substitution, OriginalOutputRecoveryVerification destination/provider/platform evidence, publication/result feedback mutations and ReplayLineage ownership, minimized artifact-only seeds, the direct no-mock scripts/ci/e2e_evidence_verifier_v2.sh entry point and exact-set case manifest, retained outputs, and the final isolation/coverage join, and RunnerPhase3SchemaOwnershipManifestV2 anchored to the Phase-1 registry and Phase-2 manifest.

No child executes a successful legacy migration, real family/performance proof, CandidateArtifactBinding admission, or rjoq decision. Those later owners consume DownstreamMutationRegistrationV1 and add their own cells. The verifier can report current, malformed, tampered, future, or named-legacy envelopes and Unsupported adapter availability, but 24.4.2 owns adapter registration/execution and successful artifact-only replay. InvocationBasisV2 binds optional ReplayLineageRootV2 exactly for Replay and never a direct MigrationExecutionBasisRootV2 duplicate; ReplayLineageV2 binds the current basis exactly once while preserving the exact source durable command, case-manifest roots, claim modes, and expected comparison/effect frames.

StableTokenV2/RunnerLimitsV2 uses an exact 128-byte cap with intact identifiers, exact/one-over tests, and no shortening. The joined validation order is integrity-first: framing/caps; target/BundleLayout-derived object set and ContentStore key; historical DestinationResourceBindingRootV1 and safe/unsafe/provider-conformance roots, with live resource comparison only for OriginalOutputRecoveryVerification and none for ArtifactOnlyRead; stored envelope/root; encoded frame/root; expanded content/root; schema/version; canonical bytes; identities/source closure; lifecycle closed basis, record count, completion state, and lane conformance; summary/terminal shared outcome basis; singular four-field PublicationSelectionV2 plus separate Invocation/Manifest RunnerBudgetsV2 and RootCapabilityPolicyRootV2 bindings and exact nine-field PublicationAccounting actuals; manifest and PlannedPreIntentObjectSetRootV1; PublicationKeyV1; self-root-free PublicationIntentV1; actual PreSealObjectSetRoot and ProvenDurablePreSealV2; DurablePublicationIdentityV2 binding DestinationResourceBindingRootV1 plus the planned and actual object-set roots; Seal; final commit/recovery; PublishedBundleReceipt; exact outer-result shape plus payload/header/checked-total/root/context preflight/post-receipt reproduction; non-authoritative delivery observation; authority/no-claim. No later state masks an earlier integrity fault.

This rollup closes only on exact child source/build/schema/coverage/log roots from one stable snapshot and cannot infer completion from a producer exit code.

This Bead consumes and independently checks the normative StableTokenV2 grammar, checked constructor, and 128-byte cap owned by frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.1.1.1.1; Phase-2 parser rollup 24.2.1.1 owns only hostile/native-byte acquisition, framing, precise offsets, and decoding into that checked type. This Bead does not own, redefine, widen, normalize, or bypass the grammar. The consumed grammar is exactly ^[a-z0-9]+([._-][a-z0-9]+)*$: nonempty lowercase-ASCII alphanumeric segments separated by a single period, underscore, or hyphen byte. Because every admitted token is ASCII, exact 127/128 acceptance and 129-byte refusal are required; Unicode normalization, non-ASCII lookalikes/confusables, uppercase, empty segments, leading/trailing separators, repeated separators, truncation, shortening, and alias substitution all refuse.

## Final independent evaluator-verification gate

This rollup joins independent decoder, semantic verifier, and three-way E2E only when hostile bytes become Presented data without premature validation; registry, requirements, validated roots, contexts, all errors/details/outcomes, paired artifact membership, and scoped ArtifactSet roots are independently reconstructed; and the EvidenceVerifierV1 evaluator contribution is exact-set consumed alongside the base projection. Producer tags and roots remain claims until full-frame verification.

## Final acyclic evaluator and cross-platform E2E rollup gate

This rollup closes only when decoder, independent verifier, and three-way harness separately reconstruct and agree on the entire legal evaluator topology: EvaluationRegistryViewRootV2 and root-free CaseEvaluationKeyV2; expression and mechanically derived requirement roots; permitted presented fixture roots and optional preflight-validated fixture roots; root-free EvaluationPrecontextV2 and nested ExpectedMismatchFrameV2 or ExpectedEvaluationErrorFrameV2; CaseConformanceSpecRootV2; CaseManifestRootV2; then actual EvaluationContextRootV2, actual EvaluationErrorRootV2 or MismatchDetailRootV2, CaseRawOutcomeRootV2, and CaseConformanceVerdictRootV2. The actual context projection with only CaseManifestRootV2 removed must equal the corresponding precontext. Root-free values remain typed bounded fields inside real enclosing roots; CaseEvaluationKeyRootV2, EvaluationPrecontextRootV2, ExpectedMismatchFrameRootV2, ExpectedEvaluationErrorFrameRootV2, generic digest stand-ins, actual-result roots in expectations, reverse edges, self edges, and cyclic descriptor edges are refusals. Current, nested Replay, and migrated-source cases retain the exact source durable command, source spec/manifest, fixtures, key, precontexts, nested frames, claim mode, and no-claim boundary.

The executable rollup also exact-joins the native Unix scripts/ci/e2e_evidence_verifier_v2.sh route and the native-Windows scripts/ci/e2e_evidence_verifier_v2.ps1 route. Both are thin wrappers over one release-built Rust driver and one immutable exact case manifest; PowerShell cannot fall back to Bash, WSL, or MSYS. Stable manifest cell IDs, deterministic domain-separated BLAKE3-to-u64 shard assignment, shard-index/count validation, per-cell and per-shard budgets, and a canonical resumable proof ledger bind exact manifest/driver/wrapper/source/build/toolchain/target/feature roots. Resume accepts only already complete exact cells. Gaps, duplicates, extras, mixed roots or contexts, stale wrappers, hidden skips, budget overruns, and partial cells refuse. The invariant final aggregate is independent of shard count, shard order, wrapper, and valid interruption/resume schedule and retains detailed capped events and source closure.

## Final command-result transport rollup gate

The rollup exact-joins the Phase-2 CommandResultTransportFrameV1 descriptor/owner root, independent raw decoder, independent semantic/context verifier, mutation corpus, and native cross-platform E2E cells. Complete header-plus-payload budgeting, full exhaustion, typed context and nominal payload-root equality, truncation/refusal versus valid-publication Incomplete classification, non-authoritative delivery observation, and committed fresh-channel retry invariance are mandatory and cannot be inferred from result tags or process exit.

PHASE-3 MANIFEST OWNERSHIP PROJECTION (CONTROLLING). The exact Phase-3 entry set is owned and anchored only by frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.3.3.3. Earlier decoder and verifier leaves may consume generic append-only framing, descriptor vocabulary, and candidate entry frames but cannot claim the exact Phase-3 entry set or anchors. VerifierInputAcquisitionObservationV1 remains an exact Phase-2 entry owned by frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.2.2.1 and is consumed without relisting. Common LeafClose schemas remain exact Phase-1 entries. Missing, extra, duplicate, reordered, stale, wrong-phase, private-runtime, self-rooted, authority-bearing, or mixed-snapshot entries refuse.

PURE CORE EXECUTION BOUNDARY (CONTROLLING). Every earlier reference in this Bead to ArtifactOnlyRead acquisition, capability validation, live destination rebinding, provider restart, ContentStore restart, historical-effect checking, or OriginalOutputRecoveryVerification describes validation of bounded observations/evidence frames supplied by the external acquisition host; the verifier core itself opens no path, discovers no handle, invokes no provider, restarts no store, calls no production capability API, and performs no recovery mutation. The live host and cross-platform reacquisition/rebinding journeys are owned by frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.3.3.3 using the acquisition interface from frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.2.2.1. The core can conclude only PresentedPublicationEvidenceConformant: internal consistency of submitted evidence under the independent model. It cannot certify that an historical sync, flush, rename, restart, CAS, or durability effect occurred. Inapplicable acquisition is the explicit AcquisitionInapplicable status/exit and cannot be collapsed into Unsupported, Blocked, or a hidden skip.

PLATFORM AGGREGATION AND TIME SEMANTICS (CONTROLLING). Platform-neutral semantic projections are invariant across valid Unix and Windows wrappers. Each platform execution receipt separately binds target, platform, wrapper, provider, source, build, toolchain, and exact-feature roots and may differ when eligibility or native observations differ. The global cross-platform join exact-sets those platform receipts and is invariant only to receipt order, sharding, scheduling, and valid resume; it never requires byte-identical platform receipt roots. Canonical rooted logs retain configured environmental deadline, logical expiration checkpoint, stage, stable sequence, and typed outcome. Wall start/end/elapsed, host load, scheduling delay, worker identity, and physical timing are optional unrooted telemetry and cannot affect semantic roots or pass/fail except through the registered typed timeout checkpoint.

A route-owning or integration-owning epic must be claimed and its own acceptance evidence completed before explicit close; task-only queries must not make that work disappear, and automatic bulk epic closure cannot substitute for it.

The transition from blocked -> eligible closeout -> in-progress closeout -> explicitly closed is deterministic and logged. Literal/unit, state/model/race, mutation, API/compile-fail, fault/cancellation, integrated E2E or child-evidence replay, detailed logging/redaction, reproduction, exact coverage, and source-closure tests cover premature surfacing, hidden remaining route work, missing/extra/duplicate child roots, stale eligibility, already-complete reruns, failed closeout and safe retry, mixed snapshots, bulk-close substitution, and exact final proof-state separation. Pure review rollups use a typed no-route closeout; no epic may invent or infer an unnamed route merely to become discoverable.
