title: Independent verifier crate foundation, framed request/stop ABI, and bounded canonical framing
description:
Create the isolated fs-evidence-verifier TOOL crate foundation and its bounded request/cancellation/framing ABI without importing any producer implementation.

## Acceptance Criteria

The dedicated Acceptance Criteria field is the canonical complete close gate. It preserves the domain-specific gate and the common nine-group unit/property/model/race/mutation/API/fault/E2E-or-contribution/logging/source-closure protocol; no description shorthand, checkpoint, parent status, aggregate count, or partial proof can replace it.
design: SOLE OWNERSHIP. Own crates/fs-evidence-verifier Cargo/workspace/lock/CONTRACT foundation, dependency/import isolation, VerifierRequestFrameV1, base bounded canonical framing, and non-wire asupersync Cx integration. Normal dependencies are exactly fs-blake3 plus pinned workspace asupersync with no explicit feature; no build script/features or producer normal/build/dev/optional/target/generated/copy route. VerifierRequestFrameV1 is Begin; bounded ordinal Data { Input|PresentedEvidence }; Commit with claimed totals/roots for independent recomputation; and optional StopRequest { CallerCancellation|EnvironmentalDeadline, monotonic_ingress_ordinal } after Begin. Frames contain no ROOT_CAPABILITY_REF, path, handle, credential, provider payload, wall time, or authority.
acceptance_criteria:
DOMAIN GATE. Literal/framing/property/model/race/fault/cancellation/API/compile-fail/import tests cover zero/one/exact/one-over frames, lengths/ordinals/totals/roots, missing/duplicate/reordered/truncated/trailing/second Commit, stop before Begin, zero/one/duplicate/simultaneous/late stops, first accepted stop precedence, idempotence, cancel/deadline ties, blocked reader/writer, post-terminal stop, request-drain-quiesce-single Cancelled/TimedOut outcome, and zero resources. Cx/poll/scheduling never enters roots. Dependency/source/feature/lock closure is exact and producer implementation isolation is independently scanned.

COMMON IMPLEMENTATION-LEAF CLOSE PROTOCOL (CONTROLLING). Preserve all nine groups: literal/unit/boundary; property/metamorphic; state/typestate/model/race; mutation/fuzz; API/compile-fail/trait; fault/resource/cancellation; release-built no-mock focused E2E or immutable contribution; deterministic detailed logging/redaction; and source closure. Every applicable slash facet has a separately nonzero corpus; true inapplicability has a stable typed code/name, owner, scope, prerequisite, and no-claim. One source-authoritative full-set manifest retains distinct exact ordered ID sets and checked counters for eligible positives and matched positives; eligible expected refusals and matched expected refusals; eligible expected failures and matched expected failures; and eligible mutations and matched mutations; exact Unsupported/inapplicable reasons; unexpected mismatches; execution failures; and unexplained skips. Green requires every eligible ID once, equality in each matched pair, nonempty applicable positive/adversarial corpora, exact reasons, and zero unexpected mismatches, execution failures, or unexplained skips; empty/subset execution cannot pass. Owned E2E uses one exact verified release route with no mocks; contributions bind one downstream owner/driver/script, independent oracle, explicit time/memory/work/process/artifact/output/log budgets, schema/log/source/build roots, expected disposition, and no-claim and cannot claim execution. Bounded canonical logs retain cell/category/facet ID, semantic/source/build/schema/oracle/budget/manifest/execution roots, ordered stages/terminal, redacted expected/observed class, first divergence, drain/resource outcome, exact partitions, diagnostic owner plus prerequisite/repair counts, no-claim, and relative artifacts. Exact prerequisites and repairs remain in bounded typed detail manifests that exact-join logs. Secrets, environment, live capabilities/resources, raw handles/provider payloads, physical/absolute paths, PIDs, wall time, scheduler noise, and bulk data are forbidden; rejected sentinels cannot echo through observed, Display, Debug, canonical bytes, logs, diagnostics, or reproduction. Source closure exact-sets modules, CONTRACT/rustdoc, schemas/owners, independent tables/oracles, fixtures, E2E scripts/contributions, log schemas, direct dependencies/features, and build inputs on one snapshot. Diagnostics have exact owner, retryability, prerequisites, no-claim, and unique non-executable ranked repairs. C1 schema/owner/import freeze, C2 literal/unit/boundary/API proof, C3 property/model/race/fault/mutation proof, and C4 E2E-or-contribution/log/redaction/source-closure proof are non-closing checkpoints only; root movement invalidates them. Focused, E2E/contribution, source-closure, constellation, DSR, downstream, platform, durability, science, admission, and authority statuses remain separate.

FIVE EXPLICITS DECLARATION, RUNTIME-EVIDENCE, AND COMPLETE-LOG GATE (CONTROLLING). Every stable literal, unit, boundary, property, metamorphic, state, typestate, model, race, mutation, fuzz, API, fault, and E2E cell binds one declaration-side Five Explicits contract: typed units for every numeric input, numeric grant, and expected numeric observation; one canonical seed declaration plus generator/minimizer version, or a registered `SeedInapplicable` code with owner, scope, prerequisite, and no-claim; seven-axis hard and soft time, memory, logical-work, process, artifact, output, and log budgets with process shape declared separately; exact API, wire, schema, source, build, toolchain, target, profile, and feature version requirements; one exact required/permitted semantic capability contract; and the exact no-claim. Runtime actual numeric observations, resolved seed provenance, budget reconciliation, observed versions, and actual required, granted, observed, returned, and revoked capability sets exist only inside disposition-gated runtime evidence. `Observed` requires complete actuals; `NotObserved` may retain only safe typed partial evidence plus its exact reason and cannot substitute expected values; `Deferred` and `Inapplicable` contain no fabricated actuals. Changing any applicable declaration or actual explicit moves exactly the intended component, cell, evidence, log, reproduction, aggregate, and report roots. Bounded log writers reserve sufficient bytes for one canonical terminal event before admitting detail events. The first event that would exceed the remaining detail budget emits one complete deterministic `LogBudgetExceeded` terminal containing the rejected event class and ordinal, digest, omitted count, applicable budget, first-divergence stage, disposition, drain/resource outcome, diagnostic owner, repair-manifest root, and no-claim. Partial JSONL, silent truncation, overwriting prior events, missing terminal state, expected-as-actual substitution, fabricated observed-empty data, or treating overflow as success refuses. Minimized reproduction evidence retains every applicable declaration and safe actual explicit without exposing a forbidden value.

PRECISE PHASE-2 PREREQUISITE (CONTROLLING). This leaf depends directly on frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.2.2.3.2, the exact RunnerPhase2SchemaOwnershipManifestV2 and shared proof-schema owner, rather than the broader publication-policy E2E rollup .24.2.2.3. It consumes the completed schema/owner roots but no executable publication oracle or E2E result. The final three-way join remains responsible for combining independent oracle, decoder, verifier, and runtime evidence.

E2E ROUTE OBLIGATION MANIFEST GATE (CONTROLLING). Every leaf owns one exact ordered route-obligation manifest rather than a lossy leaf-wide binary. Each applicable obligation appears exactly once with `LeafCloseRouteObligationKindV1`: 1 `LocalInProcess`, 2 `ExecutionOwned`, 3 `ContributionOnly`, or 4 `Inapplicable`; zero and unknown refuse. A LocalInProcess row binds the real public in-process entry point, immutable cell oracle, budgets, expected partitions, detailed-log schema/root, source closure, and no-mock no-authority boundary. An ExecutionOwned row binds one literal release driver, POSIX wrapper where applicable, direct native-Windows driver or PowerShell wrapper as frozen by the owner contract, immutable case-manifest path/root, exact close argv, release-artifact identity, platform/provider matrix, declared capability profile, runtime evidence-envelope contract, retained relative artifacts, and complete detailed-log root. A ContributionOnly row binds one immutable result-free payload and Deferred envelope to exactly one downstream execution owner plus its literal driver, script/native route, manifest, observer contract, budgets, expected partitions, logging schema, source/build roots, and no-claim; it cannot report downstream execution passed. An Inapplicable row binds one registered reason, owner, scope, prerequisite, and no-claim. The derived leaf class is exactly `LocalOnly`, `ExecutionOnly`, `ContributionOnly`, or `Mixed`; multiple obligations and multiple contribution rows are legal and must remain distinct. Missing, extra, duplicate, reordered, generic, ambiguous, rollup-owned, stale, remapped, wrong-script, unconsumed, multiply consumed, debug, ambient/PATH-resolved/alternate/unregistered Cargo-run, hidden-skip, contribution-as-execution, or inferred leaf-class routes refuse. A specifically registered source-closed focused probe is legal only when its owner Bead names it and remains separately labeled non-closing evidence. Unit/exact-set, property/model, mutation, API/compile-fail, no-mock in-process or release-built E2E/contribution, deterministic detailed-log/redaction, structured-reproduction, resume/shard, overflow, and source-closure tests cover empty, one, maximum, mixed, duplicate, reorder, route substitution, owner remap, and every row-kind/derived-class transition. Focused/unit proof cannot substitute for a required release-built row or immutable contribution contract.

EXACT PHASE-3 VERIFICATION ROUTE OBLIGATION (CONTROLLING). This leaf owns the immutable `ContributionOnly` row `runner-v2.route.24-3-3-1-1.to.verifier-decoder-v1.v1` consumed exactly once by owner `.24.3.3.1.4`, driver `evidence-verifier-decoder-v1-e2e-driver`, POSIX wrapper `scripts/ci/e2e_evidence_verifier_decoder_v1.sh`, the owner-frozen direct native-Windows route, and case manifest `scripts/ci/manifests/evidence_verifier_decoder_v1_cases.v1.json`. The row binds declared profile `fs-evidence-runner.close-capability.release-verification.v1`, exact result-free payload plus source/build/toolchain/target/features/schema/log roots, observer-contract root, per-cell/shard budgets, expected positive/refusal/failure/mutation/Unsupported/Inapplicable partitions, retained-relative-artifact policy, no-claim, and one distinct Deferred evidence-envelope root using reason code 1. It contains no fabricated actual roots and cannot claim oracle, mutation, decoder, verifier-core, or full-verifier execution passed. The owner rejects missing, extra, duplicate, reordered, stale, remapped, wrong-profile/driver/native-route/manifest, mixed-snapshot, multiply consumed, payload-as-envelope, and contribution-as-execution rows. Unit/boundary, property/model, one-defect mutation, API/compile-fail, fault/cancellation/observation-loss, immutable-contribution plus release-built native E2E, deterministic step-prefixed detailed-log/redaction, structured reproduction, overflow/resume, coverage, and source-closure tests prove this row and exact owner consumption. Additional routes remain separately registered.

AC57 EVIDENCE-DISPOSITION CONSUMER GATE (CONTROLLING). This leaf consumes, and MUST NOT redefine, the exact evidence-kind, RuntimeObservationDispositionV1, reason-registry, completeness, safe-partial-evidence, resource-reconciliation, EvidenceEnvelopeV1, and FirstDivergentExplicitComponentV1 contracts governed by program gate `.24.1.1.1` and base contract owner `.24.1.1.1`. Every stable local cell and every exact route-obligation row maps to one and only one legal evidence-kind/disposition pair. OwnedHarnessExecution and InProcessProjectionExecution admit only Observed or NotObserved; ImmutableDownstreamContribution admits only Deferred; ApplicabilityDeclaration admits only Inapplicable. LocalInProcess and ExecutionOwned work may close Observed only after a completed attempt supplies every applicable actual numeric-observation, observed-seed-disposition, budget-reconciliation, observed-version, observed-capability-set, execution-completeness, attempt-identity, retained-state, and resource-reconciliation root. A matched refusal, expected failure, executed Unsupported outcome, or mutation survivor/kill remains Observed when observation is complete; semantic outcome never substitutes for observation disposition.

NotObserved is fail-closed and uses exactly one registered reason: 1 execution-failed-before-completeness, 2 observation-channel-failed-before-completeness, or 3 unexpected-unstarted-or-skipped. It preserves attempt and payload identity and may preserve only a separately rooted redacted safe-partial-evidence object; it never copies expected values into actual fields, encodes missing actuals as observed-empty, claims successful execution, or permits a green aggregate. Every ContributionOnly row emits exactly one result-free upstream payload plus a distinct Deferred envelope with reason 1 immutable-contribution-awaits-designated-release-owner and the designated owner/driver/native-or-script route/manifest/observer contract; the designated owner later emits a separate execution envelope and cannot overwrite, alias, or promote the upstream envelope. Inapplicable is legal only for a predeclared exact source-registered applicability descriptor and cannot be synthesized from runtime skip, infrastructure failure, unsupported provider discovery, or missing observation.

The leaf's result, report contribution, stage evidence, runtime aggregate, detailed cell event, log context, structured reproduction, normal terminal, overflow terminal, bounded prefix, final bounded log, route contribution, and source closure exact-join the applicable declaration components, runtime disposition, and envelope root. Actual component roots are present only for Observed; every non-Observed form carries exact typed absence plus its reason/descriptor and no-claim. Comparisons use the AC57 exact twenty-position FirstDivergentExplicitComponentV1 precedence and stop at the first unequal applicable component without logging rejected raw values. Unit and literal-oracle tests cover every owned legal row; zero/unknown code and complete/partial/absent boundaries; property/model/state/typestate laws; mutation and API/compile-fail barriers; no-mock in-process or release-built owner E2E, or immutable contribution plus owner-consumption E2E; execution/observation/grant/use/return/revoke/cancellation/resource faults; deterministic step-prefixed detailed logging, redaction, structured reproduction, overflow-before-divergence, shard/resume, and one-component root movement; exact coverage partitions; and source closure. Tests MUST reject every illegal kind/disposition/reason pair, expected-as-actual, observed-empty-as-complete, payload-as-envelope, upstream-as-owner envelope, contribution-as-execution, applicability-as-skip, duplicate/missing/reordered evidence, hidden skip, forbidden-value echo, and stale or mixed-snapshot root.

AC58 SCHEMA-IMPACT CONSUMER AND MIGRATION GATE (CONTROLLING). This leaf consumes, and MUST NOT redefine, the canonical-schema migration registry and independent literal schema oracle owned by base contract owner `.24.1.1.1` under program gate `.24.1.1.1`. Its exact source-authoritative SchemaImpactManifestV1 classifies every canonical frame, nominal root, registry, manifest, log event, terminal, report, projection, contribution, route envelope, and structured-reproduction schema that this leaf owns or consumes exactly once by stable schema ID and exact u16 disposition: 1 NewV1NoPredecessor, 2 UnchangedV1, 3 MigratedV1ToV2, 4 DecodeOnlyLegacyV1, 5 RetiredV1, or 6 InapplicableNoCanonicalFrame. Each row binds API generation, wire version and wire-predecessor policy, separate canonical-schema migration policy, exact domain, magic, ordered field descriptors, nominal root role, owner, source path, authoritative/compatibility status, allowed parent/child versions, no-claim, and compatible-source-snapshot root. Zero/unknown codes and missing, extra, duplicate, reordered, owner-inferred, route-inferred, stale, or mixed-snapshot rows refuse.

Wire compatibility and canonical-schema migration are non-interchangeable. API generation 2, wire version 1, and Runner wire predecessor NoPredecessor remain separate from canonical-schema policies NoSchemaPredecessor, V1DecodeOnlyCompatibilityEvidence, and V1Retired. A new component may begin at V1 only when it has no canonical predecessor. Every enclosing schema whose field order, field meaning, canonical payload, or authority semantics changes rotates coherently to a distinct V2 type, `.v2` domain, versioned magic, field table, and V2 nominal root on the same compatible source snapshot. An unchanged V1 child is legal inside a V2 parent only when the independent oracle explicitly records that unchanged component role and exact position. Decode-only or retired V1 bytes never alias, parse as, substitute for, or close an authoritative V2 path; partial migration, V2-parent/V1-child substitution outside an allowed unchanged slot, generic ContentHash bridging, transmute-like accessors, shared domains/magics, compatibility aliases, and caller-minted roots refuse.

Every literal/unit/boundary, property/metamorphic, state/model/race, mutation/fuzz, API/compile-fail, fault/resource/cancellation, no-mock E2E or immutable-contribution, deterministic detailed-log/redaction, structured-reproduction, coverage, and source-closure fixture owned by this leaf names the authoritative schema versions and compatible snapshot. Tests freeze every V1 compatibility byte fixture before migration; exhaust exact-empty, one, exact maximum, one-over, missing/extra/duplicate/reordered rows; mutate every domain, magic, version, policy, field descriptor, nominal role, source owner, parent/child version, and snapshot; prove exact root movement and typed inspectability; reject V1/V2 and cross-role substitution, old-root-as-new-root, stale literal counts, and partial or mixed-snapshot migration; and exercise the exact release-built route or immutable contribution plus designated-owner consumption with step-prefixed logs, first explicit divergence, structured reproduction, overflow/resume, retained-relative-artifact policy, and no forbidden-value echo. CONTRACT/rustdoc, public accessors, route manifests, detailed log schemas, reproduction descriptors, coverage manifests, source closure, and all literal ratchets MUST agree on the same authoritative version; focused, strict-remote, release-built E2E, DSR, downstream, durability, scientific, and authority results remain separate proof states.

EXACT ORDERED LEAF ROUTE MANIFEST SUMMARY (CONTROLLING). The source-authoritative LeafCloseRouteObligationManifestV1 for this leaf contains exactly one row in kind-code then stable-route-ID order: runner-v2.route.24-3-3-1-1.to.verifier-decoder-v1.v1. Exact counts are LocalInProcess=0, ExecutionOwned=0, ContributionOnly=1, and Inapplicable=0; the derived class is exactly ContributionOnly. Every prior route-specific criterion on this Bead specifies one of these same rows and does not create a duplicate. No prose-only owner, dependency, test fixture, schema provenance edge, focused probe, rollup mapping, or transitive consumer becomes an implicit route. Adding, removing, merging, splitting, or remapping a journey requires updating this exact list, its independent registry oracle, AC56 capability profile, AC57 evidence kind/disposition, AC58 schema-impact row, coverage ratchet, detailed-log/reproduction schemas, and source closure atomically.

Independent unit/exact-set and zero/one/exact/one-over manifest tests, kind-order and derived-class properties, owner/consumer model tests, every-row mutation, API/compile-fail nominal privacy, no-mock local/release/contribution E2E as applicable, disposition/capability/resource/cancellation faults, deterministic step-prefixed detailed logging/redaction/no-echo, structured reproduction, overflow-before-divergence, shard/resume, exact result partitions, and source closure reconstruct this list without reading the production registry table. They reject missing, extra, duplicate, reordered, stale, unknown-kind, inferred-class, wrong owner/profile/driver/wrapper/manifest/entrypoint, contribution-as-execution, local-as-release, applicability-as-skip, transitive-route invention, hidden skip, and mixed-snapshot rows.

ROUTE-SCHEMA V2 AND PROOF-DAG RECONCILIATION (CONTROLLING). Every leaf route manifest consumes the common closed route vocabulary owned by frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.1.1.1 and MUST NOT redefine it. LeafCloseRouteObligationKindV1 is exact: 1 LocalInProcess, 2 ExecutionOwned, 3 ContributionOnly, and 4 Inapplicable; zero and unknown refuse. LeafCloseRouteDerivedClassV1 is exact: 1 LocalOnly, 2 ExecutionOnly, 3 ContributionOnly, and 4 Mixed. Inapplicable rows do not by themselves determine the class; an empty or all-Inapplicable manifest refuses. LEAF_CLOSE_ROUTE_OBLIGATIONS_MAX_V1 is exactly 64 rows. Manifest input is already in kind-code then bytewise stable-route-ID order and is rejected rather than sorted. The exact runtime evidence enum name is BaseCoverageCloseEvidenceKindV1; no third generic EvidenceKindV1 is introduced alongside the existing close and logging vocabularies.

DIRECT NATIVE-WINDOWS ROUTE REPRESENTATION (CONTROLLING). NativeWindowsRouteV2 is a closed typed sum: code 1 PowerShellWrapper { wrapper_owner, logical_path: LogicalBundlePathV1 } and code 2 DirectDriver { driver_owner, driver_id: StableTokenV2, bootstrap_contract_root: NativeWindowsDriverBootstrapContractRootV1 }; zero and unknown codes refuse. DirectDriver names the same exact platform-neutral release driver frozen by the route row. It is never encoded as a path, inferred .ps1 companion, shell command, PATH-resolved executable, Wine/WSL/MSYS route, or optional wrapper. NativeWindowsDriverBootstrapContractV1 is the common declaration schema owned by .24.1.1.1, with stable ABI ID fs-evidence-runner.native-windows-driver-bootstrap-abi.v1, nominal root NativeWindowsDriverBootstrapContractRootV1, canonical domain org.frankensim.fs-evidence-runner.native-windows-driver-bootstrap-contract.v1, and magic ASCII FSNATIVEWINDOWSBOOTSTRAP followed by byte 0x01. Its exact frame order is API generation 2; wire generation 1; ABI ID; argv representation windows-utf16-code-units-v1; direct-driver/no-shell/no-PATH policy; and no-claim native-windows-bootstrap-contract-proves-argv-shape-not-driver-presence-launch-exit-or-authority. A concrete driver ID, source/build artifact, target/provider binding, and execution remain owned by the designated execution owner and exact-join this common contract.

BaseCoverageCloseDeferredObservationContractV1 remains compatibility-only because its windows_route field is path-only. It is never reinterpreted for DirectDriver. BaseCoverageCloseDeferredObservationContractV2 replaces that field with NativeWindowsRouteV2 and has domain org.frankensim.fs-evidence-runner.close-deferred-observation-contract.v2 and magic ASCII FSCLOSEDEFERREDOBSERVER followed by byte 0x02. Its exact order is route ID; semantic consumer; execution owner; driver owner; POSIX wrapper owner; capability profile; driver ID; POSIX route; complete NativeWindowsRouteV2 bytes/root; case-manifest path; case-manifest contract root; Deferred-reason registry root; Deferred reason; and no-claim. Because BaseCoverageCloseDownstreamContributionV2 embeds the V1 observer, route declarations use additive BaseCoverageCloseDownstreamContributionV3 plus BaseCoverageCloseDeferredEvidenceEnvelopeV2; the V2 contribution and V1 envelope remain compatibility evidence and cannot enter the authoritative route manifest. No existing V1 bytes are silently reinterpreted.

ROUTE DECLARATION/RUNTIME DAG CLARIFICATION (CONTROLLING). A source-authoritative LocalInProcess route row binds attempt_identity_contract_root, detailed_log_schema_root, and structured_reproduction_schema_root. It MUST NOT bind a per-invocation attempt_identity_root, detailed_log_root, or structured_reproduction_root. LocalInProcessRunRequestV1 binds the actual AttemptIdentityV1 only after declaration admission. RuntimeObservationV1, EvidenceEnvelopeV1, PresentedResultV2, aggregate/report, StructuredReproductionV2, terminal, and final log bind actual invocation roots in that forward order. StructuredReproductionV2 is constructed only after the completed report or safe partial report; its actual root enters the terminal afterward. Any reverse edge, expected-as-actual substitution, or source manifest whose root changes per attempt refuses. Static route rows bind a case_manifest_contract_root derived from exact owner/driver/native/POSIX/path/schema literals; they do not claim a downstream-owned file exists, has been read, has a runtime content root, or has executed.

OWNER ROLE EQUALITY MATRIX (CONTROLLING). Every owner role remains a separately encoded typed field even when two fields contain the same Bead ID. source_owner is the leaf that emits the declaration. For each ContributionOnly row, semantic_consumer equals execution_owner and driver_owner equals execution_owner unless an exact row explicitly freezes another owner. posix_wrapper_owner equals execution_owner when a POSIX wrapper is declared. windows_wrapper_owner equals execution_owner only for PowerShellWrapper; DirectDriver has no wrapper owner and its driver_owner equals execution_owner. source_owner MUST differ from semantic_consumer and execution_owner. Equal values across declared role fields are legal and do not collapse, omit, or infer fields. Rows may share an owner, driver, platform routes, and case-manifest contract only when explicitly listed, while their route ID, payload root, contribution root, and Deferred-envelope root remain distinct.

DECLARATION VERSUS ACTUAL ARTIFACTS AND FAULTS (CONTROLLING). Contribution rows use OwnerEnvelopeRelativePathsOnly. Local rows use a distinct LocalExplicitAbsentOrRelativePathsOnly policy. Both are declaration policy only; RetainedArtifactStateV1 is runtime evidence and is present only under the legal runtime disposition. A pure in-process leaf with no asupersync/runtime dependency may test deterministic model-only observation-loss, cancellation, deadline, and resource faults through private sealed fixtures, but MUST label them model evidence and MUST NOT call them actual runtime cancellation/drain proof. Actual scoped cancellation, stop, drain, process, and resource-return evidence remains with the exact execution owner whose dependency/capability contract permits it. A Boolean callback or public test hook cannot stand in for either model proof or actual cancellation.

CANONICAL ROUTE SCHEMAS AND TEST GATE (CONTROLLING). New route body, row, manifest, local-entrypoint registry, native-route, native-bootstrap, V2 observer, V3 contribution, V2 Deferred-envelope, declaration-policy, and runtime-result schemas have exact API/wire versions, domains, magic bytes, ordered fields, nominal roots, migration rows, source owners, source paths, compatible snapshot, and no-claim. New nominal roles use source-frozen LeafExtension fragments and never append to the immutable 47-role FrozenBase registry. Independent handwritten tests cover exact codes/literals and every route row; empty, one, 64, 65, exact-set, missing, extra, duplicate, reorder, stale, unknown kind, all class transitions, and all-Inapplicable refusal; every-field/root mutation; owner/consumer singularity and equality; PowerShell/direct-driver substitution; V1/V2/V3 barriers; raw-hash and cross-kind compile failures with exact Rust error codes and positive counterparts; result-free contribution plus Deferred-envelope separation; no-mock local or release owner E2E; Observed, NotObserved, Deferred, and Inapplicable matrices; safe partials; model-only versus actual cancellation scope; reserve-before-detail log overflow; deterministic step order, redaction, no-echo, and post-report structured reproduction; shard/resume and mixed-snapshot refusal; exact partitions; and complete source closure. Every test and compile-fail addition updates its live inventory, class count, route ratchet, schema-impact manifest, log/reproduction schema, and source closure atomically. Focused, release-built, source-closure, constellation, DSR, downstream, platform, durability, scientific, admission, and authority proof states remain separate.

EXACT DECOMPOSED PARSER DEPENDENCY 2026-07-29 (CONTROLLING). The independent verifier foundation consumes only canonical bounded framing work package .24.2.1.1.1 plus its separately named Phase-2 schema manifest. It does not need hostile native argv or evaluator projection implementation. This narrower edge preserves framing compatibility while maximizing verifier independence; compile-fail/source scans reject imports from the unrelated parser children.

DECODER-OUTCOME ABI CONTRACT SPLIT 2026-07-29 (FINAL CONTROLLING). Task `.24.3.3.1.1` owns only the immutable `DecoderOutcomeV1` schema, descriptor, checked constructor, nominal root, and refusal/status vocabulary as part of the verifier crate ABI foundation. It owns no semantic-document decoding, codec implementation, outcome production, binary, or decoder proof. Task `.24.3.3.1.4` consumes that contract and exclusively owns actual decoder-outcome production, decoder integration, shipping decoder artifact, and release proof. Pure-verifier task `.24.3.3.2.1` may consume the frozen contract from `.24.3.3.1.1` while decoder implementation proceeds independently; dependency/import/source-closure gates forbid decoder implementation code or result fixtures. Release integration task `.24.3.3.2.4` blocks on `.24.3.3.1.4` and exact-joins the real decoder artifact. Three-way plan task `.24.3.3.3.1` blocks on exact artifact owners `.24.3.1.4`, `.24.3.2.4`, `.24.3.3.1.4`, and `.24.3.3.2.4`, not their review rollups. `RunnerPhase3SchemaOwnershipManifestV2` records `DecoderOutcomeV1` under `.24.3.3.1.1` and decoder-outcome production under `.24.3.3.1.4` as separate schema and implementation ownership facts. Comprehensive literal/unit, dependency-DAG, property/model, mutation, API/compile-fail, release/contribution E2E, detailed-log, and source-closure tests reject schema-as-implementation, decoder imports in the pure core, fabricated outcomes, wrong artifact owner, rollup substitution, or stale/mixed snapshots.

PROGRAM-WIDE ATTEMPT CORRELATION, STAGE TELEMETRY, SHARD/RESUME, AND COMPLETE-LOG CONSUMER GATE 2026-07-29 (FINAL CONTROLLING). This task exact-binds, and does not redefine, the common three-plane contracts owned by `.24.1.1.1.4` through `.24.1.1.1.6`. Applicable actual execution additionally requires a complete AC57 envelope and finalized `AttemptRetentionReceiptV1` that correlate the canonical root set with nominal attempt identity, safe retention scope, resource/capability reconciliation, raw-audit roots, atomic finalization, and `RunnerStageTelemetryV1`. Comprehensive literal/unit/boundary, property/metamorphic, state/typestate/model/race, mutation/fuzz, API/compile-fail/trait, fault/resource/cancellation, no-mock local/release E2E or immutable contribution plus owner-consumption E2E, deterministic detailed logging/redaction/no-echo, structured reproduction, shard/resume, exact coverage, and source-closure tests cover missing/extra/duplicate/reordered stages/events/correlation rows, logical-sequence gaps/overflow, simultaneous same-cell attempts, causal-parent substitution, exact resume versus cross-attempt residue, shard gaps/duplicates/remaps, clock unavailable/regression/wrap/overflow, stage nesting and deadline reconciliation, observation loss, zero/one/exact/one-over log and telemetry budgets, reserve-before-detail terminal overflow, changing timing/attempt/raw noise without moving canonical roots, one-component movement in the correct outer plane, sentinel redaction across every output path, and missing terminal/correlation/artifact/reproduction evidence. title: Independent canonical semantic-document, lifecycle, layout, and envelope decoder
description:
Implement handwritten bounded canonical decoders for current normative semantic documents, lifecycle framing, layout, object-key, envelope, accounting, and publication structures without producer parser reuse.

## Acceptance Criteria

The dedicated Acceptance Criteria field is the canonical complete close gate. It preserves the domain-specific gate and the common nine-group unit/property/model/race/mutation/API/fault/E2E-or-contribution/logging/source-closure protocol; no description shorthand, checkpoint, parent status, aggregate count, or partial proof can replace it.
design: SOLE OWNERSHIP. Own independent JSON/JSONL/token/numeric/path and nominal document mirrors; hostile semantic-document parsing; lifecycle record/document decoding; BundleLayout, PublicationTarget/full-path/ContentStore key, ContentStoreEnvelope, PublicationAccounting and publication-DAG frame decoding. Consume generic Phase-3 candidate manifest framing only; exact Phase-3 anchors/entry set/owner map remain downstream .24.3.3.3. No semantic validation, producer constructor, live acquisition, codec compression, verifier result, provider, publisher, recovery effect, or authority.
acceptance_criteria:
DOMAIN GATE. Handwritten literal/golden/adversarial/property/chunking/fuzz/mutation tests exhaust every current field/order/type/presence/version/domain, canonical number/token/path spelling, duplicate/unknown/extension bounds, lifecycle cardinality/order/full exhaustion, layout/path/key framing, structural publication references, and current/future/legacy frames; semantically cyclic/self-referential but structurally well-formed publication documents remain decoder successes and downstream semantic-verifier fixtures, truncation/trailing/concatenation, cap/overflow/allocation, and generic manifest candidates. Tests reject producer constants/helpers, exact Phase-3 entry claims, public validated roots, live resource interpretation, and authority conversion; cancellation polls at bounded byte/record/object stages.

COMMON IMPLEMENTATION-LEAF CLOSE PROTOCOL (CONTROLLING). Preserve all nine groups: literal/unit/boundary; property/metamorphic; state/typestate/model/race; mutation/fuzz; API/compile-fail/trait; fault/resource/cancellation; release-built no-mock focused E2E or immutable contribution; deterministic detailed logging/redaction; and source closure. Every applicable slash facet has a separately nonzero corpus; true inapplicability has a stable typed code/name, owner, scope, prerequisite, and no-claim. One source-authoritative full-set manifest retains distinct exact ordered ID sets and checked counters for eligible positives and matched positives; eligible expected refusals and matched expected refusals; eligible expected failures and matched expected failures; and eligible mutations and matched mutations; exact Unsupported/inapplicable reasons; unexpected mismatches; execution failures; and unexplained skips. Green requires every eligible ID once, equality in each matched pair, nonempty applicable positive/adversarial corpora, exact reasons, and zero unexpected mismatches, execution failures, or unexplained skips; empty/subset execution cannot pass. Owned E2E uses one exact verified release route with no mocks; contributions bind one downstream owner/driver/script, independent oracle, explicit time/memory/work/process/artifact/output/log budgets, schema/log/source/build roots, expected disposition, and no-claim and cannot claim execution. Bounded canonical logs retain cell/category/facet ID, semantic/source/build/schema/oracle/budget/manifest/execution roots, ordered stages/terminal, redacted expected/observed class, first divergence, drain/resource outcome, exact partitions, diagnostic owner plus prerequisite/repair counts, no-claim, and relative artifacts. Exact prerequisites and repairs remain in bounded typed detail manifests that exact-join logs. Secrets, environment, live capabilities/resources, raw handles/provider payloads, physical/absolute paths, PIDs, wall time, scheduler noise, and bulk data are forbidden; rejected sentinels cannot echo through observed, Display, Debug, canonical bytes, logs, diagnostics, or reproduction. Source closure exact-sets modules, CONTRACT/rustdoc, schemas/owners, independent tables/oracles, fixtures, E2E scripts/contributions, log schemas, direct dependencies/features, and build inputs on one snapshot. Diagnostics have exact owner, retryability, prerequisites, no-claim, and unique non-executable ranked repairs. C1 schema/owner/import freeze, C2 literal/unit/boundary/API proof, C3 property/model/race/fault/mutation proof, and C4 E2E-or-contribution/log/redaction/source-closure proof are non-closing checkpoints only; root movement invalidates them. Focused, E2E/contribution, source-closure, constellation, DSR, downstream, platform, durability, science, admission, and authority statuses remain separate.

FIVE EXPLICITS DECLARATION, RUNTIME-EVIDENCE, AND COMPLETE-LOG GATE (CONTROLLING). Every stable literal, unit, boundary, property, metamorphic, state, typestate, model, race, mutation, fuzz, API, fault, and E2E cell binds one declaration-side Five Explicits contract: typed units for every numeric input, numeric grant, and expected numeric observation; one canonical seed declaration plus generator/minimizer version, or a registered `SeedInapplicable` code with owner, scope, prerequisite, and no-claim; seven-axis hard and soft time, memory, logical-work, process, artifact, output, and log budgets with process shape declared separately; exact API, wire, schema, source, build, toolchain, target, profile, and feature version requirements; one exact required/permitted semantic capability contract; and the exact no-claim. Runtime actual numeric observations, resolved seed provenance, budget reconciliation, observed versions, and actual required, granted, observed, returned, and revoked capability sets exist only inside disposition-gated runtime evidence. `Observed` requires complete actuals; `NotObserved` may retain only safe typed partial evidence plus its exact reason and cannot substitute expected values; `Deferred` and `Inapplicable` contain no fabricated actuals. Changing any applicable declaration or actual explicit moves exactly the intended component, cell, evidence, log, reproduction, aggregate, and report roots. Bounded log writers reserve sufficient bytes for one canonical terminal event before admitting detail events. The first event that would exceed the remaining detail budget emits one complete deterministic `LogBudgetExceeded` terminal containing the rejected event class and ordinal, digest, omitted count, applicable budget, first-divergence stage, disposition, drain/resource outcome, diagnostic owner, repair-manifest root, and no-claim. Partial JSONL, silent truncation, overwriting prior events, missing terminal state, expected-as-actual substitution, fabricated observed-empty data, or treating overflow as success refuses. Minimized reproduction evidence retains every applicable declaration and safe actual explicit without exposing a forbidden value.

E2E ROUTE OBLIGATION MANIFEST GATE (CONTROLLING). Every leaf owns one exact ordered route-obligation manifest rather than a lossy leaf-wide binary. Each applicable obligation appears exactly once with `LeafCloseRouteObligationKindV1`: 1 `LocalInProcess`, 2 `ExecutionOwned`, 3 `ContributionOnly`, or 4 `Inapplicable`; zero and unknown refuse. A LocalInProcess row binds the real public in-process entry point, immutable cell oracle, budgets, expected partitions, detailed-log schema/root, source closure, and no-mock no-authority boundary. An ExecutionOwned row binds one literal release driver, POSIX wrapper where applicable, direct native-Windows driver or PowerShell wrapper as frozen by the owner contract, immutable case-manifest path/root, exact close argv, release-artifact identity, platform/provider matrix, declared capability profile, runtime evidence-envelope contract, retained relative artifacts, and complete detailed-log root. A ContributionOnly row binds one immutable result-free payload and Deferred envelope to exactly one downstream execution owner plus its literal driver, script/native route, manifest, observer contract, budgets, expected partitions, logging schema, source/build roots, and no-claim; it cannot report downstream execution passed. An Inapplicable row binds one registered reason, owner, scope, prerequisite, and no-claim. The derived leaf class is exactly `LocalOnly`, `ExecutionOnly`, `ContributionOnly`, or `Mixed`; multiple obligations and multiple contribution rows are legal and must remain distinct. Missing, extra, duplicate, reordered, generic, ambiguous, rollup-owned, stale, remapped, wrong-script, unconsumed, multiply consumed, debug, ambient/PATH-resolved/alternate/unregistered Cargo-run, hidden-skip, contribution-as-execution, or inferred leaf-class routes refuse. A specifically registered source-closed focused probe is legal only when its owner Bead names it and remains separately labeled non-closing evidence. Unit/exact-set, property/model, mutation, API/compile-fail, no-mock in-process or release-built E2E/contribution, deterministic detailed-log/redaction, structured-reproduction, resume/shard, overflow, and source-closure tests cover empty, one, maximum, mixed, duplicate, reorder, route substitution, owner remap, and every row-kind/derived-class transition. Focused/unit proof cannot substitute for a required release-built row or immutable contribution contract.

EXACT PHASE-3 VERIFICATION ROUTE OBLIGATION (CONTROLLING). This leaf owns the immutable `ContributionOnly` row `runner-v2.route.24-3-3-1-2.to.verifier-decoder-v1.v1` consumed exactly once by owner `.24.3.3.1.4`, driver `evidence-verifier-decoder-v1-e2e-driver`, POSIX wrapper `scripts/ci/e2e_evidence_verifier_decoder_v1.sh`, the owner-frozen direct native-Windows route, and case manifest `scripts/ci/manifests/evidence_verifier_decoder_v1_cases.v1.json`. The row binds declared profile `fs-evidence-runner.close-capability.release-verification.v1`, exact result-free payload plus source/build/toolchain/target/features/schema/log roots, observer-contract root, per-cell/shard budgets, expected positive/refusal/failure/mutation/Unsupported/Inapplicable partitions, retained-relative-artifact policy, no-claim, and one distinct Deferred evidence-envelope root using reason code 1. It contains no fabricated actual roots and cannot claim oracle, mutation, decoder, verifier-core, or full-verifier execution passed. The owner rejects missing, extra, duplicate, reordered, stale, remapped, wrong-profile/driver/native-route/manifest, mixed-snapshot, multiply consumed, payload-as-envelope, and contribution-as-execution rows. Unit/boundary, property/model, one-defect mutation, API/compile-fail, fault/cancellation/observation-loss, immutable-contribution plus release-built native E2E, deterministic step-prefixed detailed-log/redaction, structured reproduction, overflow/resume, coverage, and source-closure tests prove this row and exact owner consumption. Additional routes remain separately registered.

AC57 EVIDENCE-DISPOSITION CONSUMER GATE (CONTROLLING). This leaf consumes, and MUST NOT redefine, the exact evidence-kind, RuntimeObservationDispositionV1, reason-registry, completeness, safe-partial-evidence, resource-reconciliation, EvidenceEnvelopeV1, and FirstDivergentExplicitComponentV1 contracts governed by program gate `.24.1.1.1` and base contract owner `.24.1.1.1`. Every stable local cell and every exact route-obligation row maps to one and only one legal evidence-kind/disposition pair. OwnedHarnessExecution and InProcessProjectionExecution admit only Observed or NotObserved; ImmutableDownstreamContribution admits only Deferred; ApplicabilityDeclaration admits only Inapplicable. LocalInProcess and ExecutionOwned work may close Observed only after a completed attempt supplies every applicable actual numeric-observation, observed-seed-disposition, budget-reconciliation, observed-version, observed-capability-set, execution-completeness, attempt-identity, retained-state, and resource-reconciliation root. A matched refusal, expected failure, executed Unsupported outcome, or mutation survivor/kill remains Observed when observation is complete; semantic outcome never substitutes for observation disposition.

NotObserved is fail-closed and uses exactly one registered reason: 1 execution-failed-before-completeness, 2 observation-channel-failed-before-completeness, or 3 unexpected-unstarted-or-skipped. It preserves attempt and payload identity and may preserve only a separately rooted redacted safe-partial-evidence object; it never copies expected values into actual fields, encodes missing actuals as observed-empty, claims successful execution, or permits a green aggregate. Every ContributionOnly row emits exactly one result-free upstream payload plus a distinct Deferred envelope with reason 1 immutable-contribution-awaits-designated-release-owner and the designated owner/driver/native-or-script route/manifest/observer contract; the designated owner later emits a separate execution envelope and cannot overwrite, alias, or promote the upstream envelope. Inapplicable is legal only for a predeclared exact source-registered applicability descriptor and cannot be synthesized from runtime skip, infrastructure failure, unsupported provider discovery, or missing observation.

The leaf's result, report contribution, stage evidence, runtime aggregate, detailed cell event, log context, structured reproduction, normal terminal, overflow terminal, bounded prefix, final bounded log, route contribution, and source closure exact-join the applicable declaration components, runtime disposition, and envelope root. Actual component roots are present only for Observed; every non-Observed form carries exact typed absence plus its reason/descriptor and no-claim. Comparisons use the AC57 exact twenty-position FirstDivergentExplicitComponentV1 precedence and stop at the first unequal applicable component without logging rejected raw values. Unit and literal-oracle tests cover every owned legal row; zero/unknown code and complete/partial/absent boundaries; property/model/state/typestate laws; mutation and API/compile-fail barriers; no-mock in-process or release-built owner E2E, or immutable contribution plus owner-consumption E2E; execution/observation/grant/use/return/revoke/cancellation/resource faults; deterministic step-prefixed detailed logging, redaction, structured reproduction, overflow-before-divergence, shard/resume, and one-component root movement; exact coverage partitions; and source closure. Tests MUST reject every illegal kind/disposition/reason pair, expected-as-actual, observed-empty-as-complete, payload-as-envelope, upstream-as-owner envelope, contribution-as-execution, applicability-as-skip, duplicate/missing/reordered evidence, hidden skip, forbidden-value echo, and stale or mixed-snapshot root.

AC58 SCHEMA-IMPACT CONSUMER AND MIGRATION GATE (CONTROLLING). This leaf consumes, and MUST NOT redefine, the canonical-schema migration registry and independent literal schema oracle owned by base contract owner `.24.1.1.1` under program gate `.24.1.1.1`. Its exact source-authoritative SchemaImpactManifestV1 classifies every canonical frame, nominal root, registry, manifest, log event, terminal, report, projection, contribution, route envelope, and structured-reproduction schema that this leaf owns or consumes exactly once by stable schema ID and exact u16 disposition: 1 NewV1NoPredecessor, 2 UnchangedV1, 3 MigratedV1ToV2, 4 DecodeOnlyLegacyV1, 5 RetiredV1, or 6 InapplicableNoCanonicalFrame. Each row binds API generation, wire version and wire-predecessor policy, separate canonical-schema migration policy, exact domain, magic, ordered field descriptors, nominal root role, owner, source path, authoritative/compatibility status, allowed parent/child versions, no-claim, and compatible-source-snapshot root. Zero/unknown codes and missing, extra, duplicate, reordered, owner-inferred, route-inferred, stale, or mixed-snapshot rows refuse.

Wire compatibility and canonical-schema migration are non-interchangeable. API generation 2, wire version 1, and Runner wire predecessor NoPredecessor remain separate from canonical-schema policies NoSchemaPredecessor, V1DecodeOnlyCompatibilityEvidence, and V1Retired. A new component may begin at V1 only when it has no canonical predecessor. Every enclosing schema whose field order, field meaning, canonical payload, or authority semantics changes rotates coherently to a distinct V2 type, `.v2` domain, versioned magic, field table, and V2 nominal root on the same compatible source snapshot. An unchanged V1 child is legal inside a V2 parent only when the independent oracle explicitly records that unchanged component role and exact position. Decode-only or retired V1 bytes never alias, parse as, substitute for, or close an authoritative V2 path; partial migration, V2-parent/V1-child substitution outside an allowed unchanged slot, generic ContentHash bridging, transmute-like accessors, shared domains/magics, compatibility aliases, and caller-minted roots refuse.

Every literal/unit/boundary, property/metamorphic, state/model/race, mutation/fuzz, API/compile-fail, fault/resource/cancellation, no-mock E2E or immutable-contribution, deterministic detailed-log/redaction, structured-reproduction, coverage, and source-closure fixture owned by this leaf names the authoritative schema versions and compatible snapshot. Tests freeze every V1 compatibility byte fixture before migration; exhaust exact-empty, one, exact maximum, one-over, missing/extra/duplicate/reordered rows; mutate every domain, magic, version, policy, field descriptor, nominal role, source owner, parent/child version, and snapshot; prove exact root movement and typed inspectability; reject V1/V2 and cross-role substitution, old-root-as-new-root, stale literal counts, and partial or mixed-snapshot migration; and exercise the exact release-built route or immutable contribution plus designated-owner consumption with step-prefixed logs, first explicit divergence, structured reproduction, overflow/resume, retained-relative-artifact policy, and no forbidden-value echo. CONTRACT/rustdoc, public accessors, route manifests, detailed log schemas, reproduction descriptors, coverage manifests, source closure, and all literal ratchets MUST agree on the same authoritative version; focused, strict-remote, release-built E2E, DSR, downstream, durability, scientific, and authority results remain separate proof states.

EXACT ORDERED LEAF ROUTE MANIFEST SUMMARY (CONTROLLING). The source-authoritative LeafCloseRouteObligationManifestV1 for this leaf contains exactly one row in kind-code then stable-route-ID order: runner-v2.route.24-3-3-1-2.to.verifier-decoder-v1.v1. Independent unit/exact-set and zero/one/exact/one-over manifest tests, kind-order and derived-class properties, owner/consumer model tests, every-row mutation, API/compile-fail nominal privacy, no-mock local/release/contribution E2E as applicable, disposition/capability/resource/cancellation faults, deterministic step-prefixed detailed logging/redaction/no-echo, structured reproduction, overflow-before-divergence, shard/resume, exact result partitions, and source closure reconstruct this list without reading the production registry table. Atomic internal work package for independent bounded safe-Rust sequence decoding, offsets, repeat history, overlap copy, reconstruction, work caps, and cancellation allocated by parent .24.3.3.1.3.


## Acceptance Criteria

The dedicated Acceptance Criteria field is the canonical complete close gate. It preserves the atomic domain ownership, comprehensive unit/property/model/race/mutation/API/fault/no-mock-E2E-or-contribution matrix, deterministic detailed logging/redaction and reproduction, exact source closure, route/capability semantics, and proof/no-claim boundaries; no description shorthand, parent status, checkpoint, aggregate count, or partial proof can replace it.
acceptance_criteria:
ATOMIC INDEPENDENT-DECODER SCOPE (CONTROLLING). Own sequence headers/counts, literal/match lengths, offset codes and repeat offsets, bitstream decoding, history/window addressing, overlap copy, expanded output reconstruction, logical-work accounting, and bounded cancellation. This work package is safe Rust and independent of production codec source, helpers, tables, generated constants, golden generation, and oracle implementation. Parent .24.3.3.1.3 remains the sole complete independent Zstd decoder and verifier-decoder contribution owner. No partial child may advertise the complete profile, decode semantic publication content, perform effects, or mint authority.

DOMAIN ACCEPTANCE MATRIX (CONTROLLING). Tests cover zero/one/max sequences, every length/offset boundary, three repeat-offset states, underflow/overflow/out-of-window references, overlapping matches, chunk splits at every bit/byte/sequence boundary, exact expanded/work caps, adversarial expansion, cancellation/resume at bounded sequence tiles, and byte-for-byte independent reconstruction. The implementation validates all declared encoded/expanded/window/table/block/sequence/offset/logical-work/cancellation caps before proportional allocation/work. It rejects unknown/unsupported/dictionary/skippable profiles as specified, noncanonical/truncated/trailing/checksum-invalid streams, overflow, bombs, stale table/history state, and mixed frame/source snapshots with precise bounded stream/frame/block/field/byte-range diagnostics.

COMPREHENSIVE PROOF (CONTROLLING). Separate nonzero applicable literal/unit/boundary, property/metamorphic, state/model/race, mutation/fuzz, API/compile-fail/trait, fault/resource/cancellation, no-mock local integration, detailed deterministic logging/redaction, and source-closure groups exact-set all stable cases. Independent handwritten vectors and at least one separately implemented oracle/checker cover every owned construct; production-encoded fixtures are adversarial inputs, never the only expectation. Chunking, task order, and valid resume are metamorphic; seed/version/budget/schedule changes move exact roots. Every failure is minimized deterministically and fresh-process reproducible within budget.

LOCAL ROUTE AND CONTRIBUTION HANDOFF (CONTROLLING). This child owns one LocalInProcess row runner-v2.route.24-3-3-1-3-3.local.independent-zstd-work-package.v1 at fs_evidence_verifier::zstd_work_packages::run_24_3_3_1_3_3_v1, profile fs-evidence-runner.close-capability.none.v1, counts 1/0/0/0, class LocalOnly. AC57 admits complete Observed or fail-closed NotObserved only; AC58 classifies every owned frame/log/reproduction schema. Parent .24.3.3.1.3 exact-set consumes each child proof/source root and emits the single result-free Deferred contribution runner-v2.route.24-3-3-1-3.to.verifier-decoder-v1.v1 to .24.3.3.1.4. Only the completed parent contribution can enter release-built verifier E2E; a child cannot claim decoder or verifier execution.

LOGGING, REPRODUCTION, AND SOURCE CLOSURE (CONTROLLING). Each cell binds units, seed or registered inapplicability, time/memory/work/process/artifact/output/log budgets, API/wire/profile/source/build/toolchain/target/features, empty capabilities, and no-claim. Bounded step logs retain stable cell, frame/profile roots, safe offsets/counts/caps, stage, disposition, drain/resources, first divergence, diagnostic/repair roots, relative artifacts, report/reproduction/source roots, and terminal while excluding bulk bytes, secrets, paths, PIDs, wall time, and scheduler noise. Overflow reserves a full terminal; reproduction never auto-executes. Source closure exact-sets implementation, contracts, independent tables/oracles/vectors, mutation/fuzz corpora, parent contribution projection rows, logs/reproduction, dependencies/features, and build inputs on one compatible snapshot. Child local, parent decoder contribution, release verifier E2E, DSR, semantic verification, and authority proofs remain separate.

FIVE EXPLICITS DECLARATION (CONTROLLING). Every stable cell explicitly binds typed units, canonical seed or registered SeedInapplicable reason, bounded time/memory/logical-work/process/artifact/output/log budgets, exact API/wire/profile/source/build/toolchain/target/features, the empty semantic capability contract, and the exact no-claim; runtime actuals appear only under AC57 disposition and move the intended component roots.

WORK-PACKAGE RESULT ACCOUNTING (CONTROLLING). The proof manifest retains distinct exact stable-ID sets and checked counters for eligible positives and matched positives; eligible expected refusals and matched expected refusals; eligible expected failures and matched expected failures; eligible mutations and matched mutations; typed Unsupported cells and typed Inapplicable cells with exact registered reasons; unexpected mismatches; execution failures; and unexplained skips. Green requires every matched subpartition to equal its own eligible subpartition, every eligible stable ID exactly once in canonical order, every applicable positive and adversarial corpus nonzero, exact typed-reason equality, and zero unexpected mismatches, execution failures, and unexplained skips. Aggregate totals, a parent status, a local-only route, or a downstream contribution cannot replace any subpartition.

PROGRAM-WIDE ATTEMPT CORRELATION, STAGE TELEMETRY, SHARD/RESUME, AND COMPLETE-LOG CONSUMER GATE 2026-07-29 (FINAL CONTROLLING). This task exact-binds, and does not redefine, the common three-plane contracts owned by `.24.1.1.1.4` through `.24.1.1.1.6`. Every executable cell declaration binds the common attempt-identity contract root; the actual nominal `AttemptIdentityRootV1` exists only after admission. Every child/downstream execution records its stable route/suite/case/cell/shard IDs and causal ordinal, with an optional typed parent-attempt root only in attempt-specific evidence. Canonical invocation/command/event/report/reproduction/terminal/final-log payloads bind the attempt-invariant `CanonicalRuntimeObservationProjectionRootV1` and contain deterministic schema/version, logical event sequence, stage code/ordinal, event kind/severity, expected/observed classification, semantic/budget/capability/no-claim roots, first divergence, bounded actionable diagnostic, terminal completeness, and safe relative artifacts. They contain no attempt identity/scope, raw transcript, timing sample, wall clock, physical path, host/environment/PID/scheduler/load, secret, live capability/resource value, or bulk payload.

Applicable actual execution additionally requires a complete AC57 envelope and finalized `AttemptRetentionReceiptV1` that correlate the canonical root set with nominal attempt identity, safe retention scope, resource/capability reconciliation, raw-audit roots, atomic finalization, and `RunnerStageTelemetryV1`. The bounded telemetry sidecar records attempt/optional parent correlation, stable route/suite/case/cell/shard IDs, causal ordinal, stage code/ordinal, start/finish disposition, checked monotonic offset and stage delta with explicit units, clock descriptor/root, resolution and suspend policy, applicable environmental time budget, terminal disposition, safe relative artifact references, and explicit no-performance-claim scope. Timing is an operator observation only: it never feeds semantic/source/build/schema/oracle/expected-result/publication/receipt/admission/authority roots or a portable performance claim. A read-only operator view may join receipt, canonical log, and telemetry after finalization; it cannot feed execution or mutate any root.

A ContributionOnly or deferred-local declaration carries its immutable result-free payload plus typed Deferred envelope and fabricates no attempt, timing, execution, resource, or terminal actual. A genuinely pure/non-executable facet uses a source-registered Inapplicable reason naming exact owner, scope, prerequisite, and no-claim. Every manifest explicitly declares `Sharded` or `ShardInapplicable` and `Resumable` or `ResumeInapplicable`; omission, runtime-skip synthesis, or Unsupported-as-Inapplicable refuses. Applicable E2E owners retain exact attempt-scoped relative artifact/reproduction references; contribution tasks bind the exact downstream owner/driver/script/manifest that will produce them.

Comprehensive literal/unit/boundary, property/metamorphic, state/typestate/model/race, mutation/fuzz, API/compile-fail/trait, fault/resource/cancellation, no-mock local/release E2E or immutable contribution plus owner-consumption E2E, deterministic detailed logging/redaction/no-echo, structured reproduction, shard/resume, exact coverage, and source-closure tests cover missing/extra/duplicate/reordered stages/events/correlation rows, logical-sequence gaps/overflow, simultaneous same-cell attempts, causal-parent substitution, exact resume versus cross-attempt residue, shard gaps/duplicates/remaps, clock unavailable/regression/wrap/overflow, stage nesting and deadline reconciliation, observation loss, zero/one/exact/one-over log and telemetry budgets, reserve-before-detail terminal overflow, changing timing/attempt/raw noise without moving canonical roots, one-component movement in the correct outer plane, sentinel redaction across every output path, and missing terminal/correlation/artifact/reproduction evidence. Silent truncation, hidden skip, unbounded logging, fabricated actuals, or a green subset is forbidden.

title: Independent evaluator/inventory/transport decoder, DecoderOutcomeV1, and decoder proof join
description:
Complete the decoder with evaluator/inventory/transport document decoding, own DecoderOutcomeV1 and the focused decoder release artifact/proof join, without semantic validation or live acquisition.

## Acceptance Criteria

The dedicated Acceptance Criteria field is the canonical complete close gate. It preserves the domain-specific gate and the common nine-group unit/property/model/race/mutation/API/fault/E2E-or-contribution/logging/source-closure protocol; no description shorthand, checkpoint, parent status, aggregate count, or partial proof can replace it.
design: SOLE OWNERSHIP AND ROUTE. Own evaluator/precontext/expected-frame/presented-input/inventory/transport frame decoding; DecoderOutcomeV1; shipping binary fs-evidence-verifier-decode; release driver evidence-verifier-decoder-v1-e2e-driver; and script scripts/ci/e2e_evidence_verifier_decoder_v1.sh. V1 names the internal decoder request/outcome wire generation, while the product remains Runner V2. Consume .1.2/.1.3 and generic Phase-3 candidate frames; do not claim exact Phase-3 manifest, semantic conformance, live copy/substitution/provider behavior, verifier result, or authority.
acceptance_criteria:
DOMAIN GATE. Focused release-built no-mock E2E plus unit/property/mutation/fuzz/API/fault/cancellation tests hand-encode all evaluator/root-free expectation/inventory/transport fields; 0/1/256/257/258 rows; every header byte/field/prefix and boundary-stratified interior cutoff; arbitrary chunks; wrong kind/length/root/context; trailing/second frame; clean exhaustion; cancellation/drain; and exact byte refusal versus semantic-error separation. Supplied VerifierInputAcquisitionObservationV1 is decoded as non-authoritative evidence; no path/handle/provider is opened. Exact output/log/coverage/source joins consume .1.2/.1.3 roots and reject PATH/debug/cargo-run/mock/producer-table substitution.

COMMON IMPLEMENTATION-LEAF CLOSE PROTOCOL (CONTROLLING). Preserve all nine groups: literal/unit/boundary; property/metamorphic; state/typestate/model/race; mutation/fuzz; API/compile-fail/trait; fault/resource/cancellation; release-built no-mock focused E2E or immutable contribution; deterministic detailed logging/redaction; and source closure. Every applicable slash facet has a separately nonzero corpus; true inapplicability has a stable typed code/name, owner, scope, prerequisite, and no-claim. One source-authoritative full-set manifest retains distinct exact ordered ID sets and checked counters for eligible positives and matched positives; eligible expected refusals and matched expected refusals; eligible expected failures and matched expected failures; and eligible mutations and matched mutations; exact Unsupported/inapplicable reasons; unexpected mismatches; execution failures; and unexplained skips. Green requires every eligible ID once, equality in each matched pair, nonempty applicable positive/adversarial corpora, exact reasons, and zero unexpected mismatches, execution failures, or unexplained skips; empty/subset execution cannot pass. Owned E2E uses one exact verified release route with no mocks; contributions bind one downstream owner/driver/script, independent oracle, explicit time/memory/work/process/artifact/output/log budgets, schema/log/source/build roots, expected disposition, and no-claim and cannot claim execution. Bounded canonical logs retain cell/category/facet ID, semantic/source/build/schema/oracle/budget/manifest/execution roots, ordered stages/terminal, redacted expected/observed class, first divergence, drain/resource outcome, exact partitions, diagnostic owner plus prerequisite/repair counts, no-claim, and relative artifacts. Exact prerequisites and repairs remain in bounded typed detail manifests that exact-join logs. Secrets, environment, live capabilities/resources, raw handles/provider payloads, physical/absolute paths, PIDs, wall time, scheduler noise, and bulk data are forbidden; rejected sentinels cannot echo through observed, Display, Debug, canonical bytes, logs, diagnostics, or reproduction. Source closure exact-sets modules, CONTRACT/rustdoc, schemas/owners, independent tables/oracles, fixtures, E2E scripts/contributions, log schemas, direct dependencies/features, and build inputs on one snapshot. Diagnostics have exact owner, retryability, prerequisites, no-claim, and unique non-executable ranked repairs. C1 schema/owner/import freeze, C2 literal/unit/boundary/API proof, C3 property/model/race/fault/mutation proof, and C4 E2E-or-contribution/log/redaction/source-closure proof are non-closing checkpoints only; root movement invalidates them. Focused, E2E/contribution, source-closure, constellation, DSR, downstream, platform, durability, science, admission, and authority statuses remain separate.

FIVE EXPLICITS DECLARATION, RUNTIME-EVIDENCE, AND COMPLETE-LOG GATE (CONTROLLING). Every stable literal, unit, boundary, property, metamorphic, state, typestate, model, race, mutation, fuzz, API, fault, and E2E cell binds one declaration-side Five Explicits contract: typed units for every numeric input, numeric grant, and expected numeric observation; one canonical seed declaration plus generator/minimizer version, or a registered `SeedInapplicable` code with owner, scope, prerequisite, and no-claim; seven-axis hard and soft time, memory, logical-work, process, artifact, output, and log budgets with process shape declared separately; exact API, wire, schema, source, build, toolchain, target, profile, and feature version requirements; one exact required/permitted semantic capability contract; and the exact no-claim. Runtime actual numeric observations, resolved seed provenance, budget reconciliation, observed versions, and actual required, granted, observed, returned, and revoked capability sets exist only inside disposition-gated runtime evidence. `Observed` requires complete actuals; `NotObserved` may retain only safe typed partial evidence plus its exact reason and cannot substitute expected values; `Deferred` and `Inapplicable` contain no fabricated actuals. Changing any applicable declaration or actual explicit moves exactly the intended component, cell, evidence, log, reproduction, aggregate, and report roots. Bounded log writers reserve sufficient bytes for one canonical terminal event before admitting detail events. The first event that would exceed the remaining detail budget emits one complete deterministic `LogBudgetExceeded` terminal containing the rejected event class and ordinal, digest, omitted count, applicable budget, first-divergence stage, disposition, drain/resource outcome, diagnostic owner, repair-manifest root, and no-claim. Partial JSONL, silent truncation, overwriting prior events, missing terminal state, expected-as-actual substitution, fabricated observed-empty data, or treating overflow as success refuses. Minimized reproduction evidence retains every applicable declaration and safe actual explicit without exposing a forbidden value.

EXACT PROOF INVOCATION, RETENTION, AND ATTEMPT-ISOLATION GATE (CONTROLLING). This suite owns immutable case manifest scripts/ci/manifests/evidence_verifier_decoder_v1_cases.v1.json and one canonical close-mode invocation contract containing the exact verified release-artifact identity, manifest root and path, target/provider prerequisite row, exact feature set, literal argv vector, shard index/count, optional resume-ledger root, capability-confined output root, expected native exit, and retained relative evidence paths. The retained proof records the verbatim results of scripts/ci/checkout_constellation.sh --verify-only, dsr repos info frankensim, dsr quality --tool frankensim, one literal registry-selected dsr build frankensim --target TARGET argv with TARGET replaced by the actual registered target in every retained row, and the exact suite script/driver invocation. A placeholder, reconstructed command, PATH lookup, Cargo-run, debug artifact, alternate rebuild, unretained output, or target token left unresolved cannot close. Debug filtering, single-cell execution, list, dry-run, and nonclosing checkpoints carry explicit NonClosingSubset disposition and can never emit a green close manifest. Concurrent executions of the same semantic cell use distinct nonsemantic capability-confined attempt scopes while preserving the same stable cell root. Resume accepts only rows and residue matching suite, manifest, source, build, toolchain, target, features, cell, and attempt-policy roots. Tests cover two simultaneous same-cell runs, interrupted atomic ledger update, stale/copied/mixed ledgers, same-cell/different-attempt isolation, residue substitution, exact resource return, and prevention of attempt identifiers entering semantic roots or rooted logs. The canonical relative retention layout is artifacts/runner-v2/{suite_id}/{build_root}/{shard_id}/{cell_id}/ containing bounded invocation.json, events.jsonl, summary.json, first-divergence.json, reproduction.json, and source-closure.json; exact names, presence, limits, roots, and no-absolute-path rules are unit-, boundary-, mutation-, fault-, resume-, native-E2E-, logging-, and source-closure-tested.

E2E ROUTE OBLIGATION MANIFEST GATE (CONTROLLING). Every leaf owns one exact ordered route-obligation manifest rather than a lossy leaf-wide binary. Each applicable obligation appears exactly once with `LeafCloseRouteObligationKindV1`: 1 `LocalInProcess`, 2 `ExecutionOwned`, 3 `ContributionOnly`, or 4 `Inapplicable`; zero and unknown refuse. A LocalInProcess row binds the real public in-process entry point, immutable cell oracle, budgets, expected partitions, detailed-log schema/root, source closure, and no-mock no-authority boundary. An ExecutionOwned row binds one literal release driver, POSIX wrapper where applicable, direct native-Windows driver or PowerShell wrapper as frozen by the owner contract, immutable case-manifest path/root, exact close argv, release-artifact identity, platform/provider matrix, declared capability profile, runtime evidence-envelope contract, retained relative artifacts, and complete detailed-log root. A ContributionOnly row binds one immutable result-free payload and Deferred envelope to exactly one downstream execution owner plus its literal driver, script/native route, manifest, observer contract, budgets, expected partitions, logging schema, source/build roots, and no-claim; it cannot report downstream execution passed. An Inapplicable row binds one registered reason, owner, scope, prerequisite, and no-claim. The derived leaf class is exactly `LocalOnly`, `ExecutionOnly`, `ContributionOnly`, or `Mixed`; multiple obligations and multiple contribution rows are legal and must remain distinct. Missing, extra, duplicate, reordered, generic, ambiguous, rollup-owned, stale, remapped, wrong-script, unconsumed, multiply consumed, debug, ambient/PATH-resolved/alternate/unregistered Cargo-run, hidden-skip, contribution-as-execution, or inferred leaf-class routes refuse. A specifically registered source-closed focused probe is legal only when its owner Bead names it and remains separately labeled non-closing evidence. Unit/exact-set, property/model, mutation, API/compile-fail, no-mock in-process or release-built E2E/contribution, deterministic detailed-log/redaction, structured-reproduction, resume/shard, overflow, and source-closure tests cover empty, one, maximum, mixed, duplicate, reorder, route substitution, owner remap, and every row-kind/derived-class transition. Focused/unit proof cannot substitute for a required release-built row or immutable contribution contract.

AC57 EVIDENCE-DISPOSITION CONSUMER GATE (CONTROLLING). This leaf consumes, and MUST NOT redefine, the exact evidence-kind, RuntimeObservationDispositionV1, reason-registry, completeness, safe-partial-evidence, resource-reconciliation, EvidenceEnvelopeV1, and FirstDivergentExplicitComponentV1 contracts governed by program gate `.24.1.1.1` and base contract owner `.24.1.1.1`. Every stable local cell and every exact route-obligation row maps to one and only one legal evidence-kind/disposition pair. OwnedHarnessExecution and InProcessProjectionExecution admit only Observed or NotObserved; ImmutableDownstreamContribution admits only Deferred; ApplicabilityDeclaration admits only Inapplicable. LocalInProcess and ExecutionOwned work may close Observed only after a completed attempt supplies every applicable actual numeric-observation, observed-seed-disposition, budget-reconciliation, observed-version, observed-capability-set, execution-completeness, attempt-identity, retained-state, and resource-reconciliation root. A matched refusal, expected failure, executed Unsupported outcome, or mutation survivor/kill remains Observed when observation is complete; semantic outcome never substitutes for observation disposition.

NotObserved is fail-closed and uses exactly one registered reason: 1 execution-failed-before-completeness, 2 observation-channel-failed-before-completeness, or 3 unexpected-unstarted-or-skipped. It preserves attempt and payload identity and may preserve only a separately rooted redacted safe-partial-evidence object; it never copies expected values into actual fields, encodes missing actuals as observed-empty, claims successful execution, or permits a green aggregate.
