title: Independent evaluator, lifecycle, aggregation, and contextual-artifact verifier
description:
Implement pure independent semantic verification for evaluator/conformance, lifecycle/aggregation, and contextual artifacts using handwritten rules and decoded values.

## Acceptance Criteria

The dedicated Acceptance Criteria field is the canonical complete close gate. It preserves the domain-specific gate and the common nine-group unit/property/model/race/mutation/API/fault/E2E-or-contribution/logging/source-closure protocol; no description shorthand, checkpoint, parent status, aggregate count, or partial proof can replace it.
design: SOLE OWNERSHIP. Own independent evaluator/registry/requirements/context/lane/error/detail/raw/verdict modules; CaseTerminalBasis/lifecycle/completion/aggregate/StopKey verification; contextual inventory membership/filter/projection and ArtifactSet recomputation; and their handwritten verifier tables/tests. Consume .24.3.3.2.1 interfaces and normative assets; share no production or oracle executable tables/helpers. No byte decoder, publisher, provider, live acquisition, VerifierResult schema, release binary, or authority.
acceptance_criteria:
DOMAIN GATE. Tests reconstruct every root-free key/precontext/nested expectation and enclosing root; both lanes, all errors/details/ties, actual-context projection, artifact relation/membership/isolation, every lifecycle variant/record/order/cardinality/completion/NotRun/aggregate/stop/drain path; simultaneous defects; all boundary/property/model/mutation/API/import/fault/cancellation cases; and exact stage/root movement. Producer/oracle helper reuse, tag-only agreement, digest-only membership, cross-case leakage, actual roots in expectations, fabricated roots, context collapse, missing drain, or authority conversion fails.

COMMON IMPLEMENTATION-LEAF CLOSE PROTOCOL (CONTROLLING). Preserve all nine groups: literal/unit/boundary; property/metamorphic; state/typestate/model/race; mutation/fuzz; API/compile-fail/trait; fault/resource/cancellation; release-built no-mock focused E2E or immutable contribution; deterministic detailed logging/redaction; and source closure. Every applicable slash facet has a separately nonzero corpus; true inapplicability has a stable typed code/name, owner, scope, prerequisite, and no-claim. One source-authoritative full-set manifest retains distinct exact ordered ID sets and checked counters for eligible positives and matched positives; eligible expected refusals and matched expected refusals; eligible expected failures and matched expected failures; and eligible mutations and matched mutations; exact Unsupported/inapplicable reasons; unexpected mismatches; execution failures; and unexplained skips. Green requires every eligible ID once, equality in each matched pair, nonempty applicable positive/adversarial corpora, exact reasons, and zero unexpected mismatches, execution failures, or unexplained skips; empty/subset execution cannot pass. Owned E2E uses one exact verified release route with no mocks; contributions bind one downstream owner/driver/script, independent oracle, explicit time/memory/work/process/artifact/output/log budgets, schema/log/source/build roots, expected disposition, and no-claim and cannot claim execution. Bounded canonical logs retain cell/category/facet ID, semantic/source/build/schema/oracle/budget/manifest/execution roots, ordered stages/terminal, redacted expected/observed class, first divergence, drain/resource outcome, exact partitions, diagnostic owner plus prerequisite/repair counts, no-claim, and relative artifacts. Exact prerequisites and repairs remain in bounded typed detail manifests that exact-join logs. Secrets, environment, live capabilities/resources, raw handles/provider payloads, physical/absolute paths, PIDs, wall time, scheduler noise, and bulk data are forbidden; rejected sentinels cannot echo through observed, Display, Debug, canonical bytes, logs, diagnostics, or reproduction. Source closure exact-sets modules, CONTRACT/rustdoc, schemas/owners, independent tables/oracles, fixtures, E2E scripts/contributions, log schemas, direct dependencies/features, and build inputs on one snapshot. Diagnostics have exact owner, retryability, prerequisites, no-claim, and unique non-executable ranked repairs. C1 schema/owner/import freeze, C2 literal/unit/boundary/API proof, C3 property/model/race/fault/mutation proof, and C4 E2E-or-contribution/log/redaction/source-closure proof are non-closing checkpoints only; root movement invalidates them. Focused, E2E/contribution, source-closure, constellation, DSR, downstream, platform, durability, science, admission, and authority statuses remain separate.

FIVE EXPLICITS DECLARATION, RUNTIME-EVIDENCE, AND COMPLETE-LOG GATE (CONTROLLING). Every stable literal, unit, boundary, property, metamorphic, state, typestate, model, race, mutation, fuzz, API, fault, and E2E cell binds one declaration-side Five Explicits contract: typed units for every numeric input, numeric grant, and expected numeric observation; one canonical seed declaration plus generator/minimizer version, or a registered `SeedInapplicable` code with owner, scope, prerequisite, and no-claim; seven-axis hard and soft time, memory, logical-work, process, artifact, output, and log budgets with process shape declared separately; exact API, wire, schema, source, build, toolchain, target, profile, and feature version requirements; one exact required/permitted semantic capability contract; and the exact no-claim. Runtime actual numeric observations, resolved seed provenance, budget reconciliation, observed versions, and actual required, granted, observed, returned, and revoked capability sets exist only inside disposition-gated runtime evidence. `Observed` requires complete actuals; `NotObserved` may retain only safe typed partial evidence plus its exact reason and cannot substitute expected values; `Deferred` and `Inapplicable` contain no fabricated actuals. Changing any applicable declaration or actual explicit moves exactly the intended component, cell, evidence, log, reproduction, aggregate, and report roots. Bounded log writers reserve sufficient bytes for one canonical terminal event before admitting detail events. The first event that would exceed the remaining detail budget emits one complete deterministic `LogBudgetExceeded` terminal containing the rejected event class and ordinal, digest, omitted count, applicable budget, first-divergence stage, disposition, drain/resource outcome, diagnostic owner, repair-manifest root, and no-claim. Partial JSONL, silent truncation, overwriting prior events, missing terminal state, expected-as-actual substitution, fabricated observed-empty data, or treating overflow as success refuses. Minimized reproduction evidence retains every applicable declaration and safe actual explicit without exposing a forbidden value.

E2E ROUTE OBLIGATION MANIFEST GATE (CONTROLLING). Every leaf owns one exact ordered route-obligation manifest rather than a lossy leaf-wide binary. Each applicable obligation appears exactly once with `LeafCloseRouteObligationKindV1`: 1 `LocalInProcess`, 2 `ExecutionOwned`, 3 `ContributionOnly`, or 4 `Inapplicable`; zero and unknown refuse. A LocalInProcess row binds the real public in-process entry point, immutable cell oracle, budgets, expected partitions, detailed-log schema/root, source closure, and no-mock no-authority boundary. An ExecutionOwned row binds one literal release driver, POSIX wrapper where applicable, direct native-Windows driver or PowerShell wrapper as frozen by the owner contract, immutable case-manifest path/root, exact close argv, release-artifact identity, platform/provider matrix, declared capability profile, runtime evidence-envelope contract, retained relative artifacts, and complete detailed-log root. A ContributionOnly row binds one immutable result-free payload and Deferred envelope to exactly one downstream execution owner plus its literal driver, script/native route, manifest, observer contract, budgets, expected partitions, logging schema, source/build roots, and no-claim; it cannot report downstream execution passed. An Inapplicable row binds one registered reason, owner, scope, prerequisite, and no-claim. The derived leaf class is exactly `LocalOnly`, `ExecutionOnly`, `ContributionOnly`, or `Mixed`; multiple obligations and multiple contribution rows are legal and must remain distinct. Missing, extra, duplicate, reordered, generic, ambiguous, rollup-owned, stale, remapped, wrong-script, unconsumed, multiply consumed, debug, ambient/PATH-resolved/alternate/unregistered Cargo-run, hidden-skip, contribution-as-execution, or inferred leaf-class routes refuse. A specifically registered source-closed focused probe is legal only when its owner Bead names it and remains separately labeled non-closing evidence. Unit/exact-set, property/model, mutation, API/compile-fail, no-mock in-process or release-built E2E/contribution, deterministic detailed-log/redaction, structured-reproduction, resume/shard, overflow, and source-closure tests cover empty, one, maximum, mixed, duplicate, reorder, route substitution, owner remap, and every row-kind/derived-class transition. Focused/unit proof cannot substitute for a required release-built row or immutable contribution contract.

EXACT PHASE-3 VERIFICATION ROUTE OBLIGATION (CONTROLLING). This leaf owns the immutable `ContributionOnly` row `runner-v2.route.24-3-3-2-2.to.verifier-core-v1.v1` consumed exactly once by owner `.24.3.3.2.4`, driver `evidence-verifier-core-v1-e2e-driver`, POSIX wrapper `scripts/ci/e2e_evidence_verifier_core_v1.sh`, the owner-frozen direct native-Windows route, and case manifest `scripts/ci/manifests/evidence_verifier_core_v1_cases.v1.json`. The row binds declared profile `fs-evidence-runner.close-capability.release-verification.v1`, exact result-free payload plus source/build/toolchain/target/features/schema/log roots, observer-contract root, per-cell/shard budgets, expected positive/refusal/failure/mutation/Unsupported/Inapplicable partitions, retained-relative-artifact policy, no-claim, and one distinct Deferred evidence-envelope root using reason code 1. It contains no fabricated actual roots and cannot claim oracle, mutation, decoder, verifier-core, or full-verifier execution passed. The owner rejects missing, extra, duplicate, reordered, stale, remapped, wrong-profile/driver/native-route/manifest, mixed-snapshot, multiply consumed, payload-as-envelope, and contribution-as-execution rows. Unit/boundary, property/model, one-defect mutation, API/compile-fail, fault/cancellation/observation-loss, immutable-contribution plus release-built native E2E, deterministic step-prefixed detailed-log/redaction, structured reproduction, overflow/resume, coverage, and source-closure tests prove this row and exact owner consumption. Additional routes remain separately registered.

AC57 EVIDENCE-DISPOSITION CONSUMER GATE (CONTROLLING). This leaf consumes, and MUST NOT redefine, the exact evidence-kind, RuntimeObservationDispositionV1, reason-registry, completeness, safe-partial-evidence, resource-reconciliation, EvidenceEnvelopeV1, and FirstDivergentExplicitComponentV1 contracts governed by program gate `.24.1.1.1` and base contract owner `.24.1.1.1`. Every stable local cell and every exact route-obligation row maps to one and only one legal evidence-kind/disposition pair. OwnedHarnessExecution and InProcessProjectionExecution admit only Observed or NotObserved; ImmutableDownstreamContribution admits only Deferred; ApplicabilityDeclaration admits only Inapplicable. LocalInProcess and ExecutionOwned work may close Observed only after a completed attempt supplies every applicable actual numeric-observation, observed-seed-disposition, budget-reconciliation, observed-version, observed-capability-set, execution-completeness, attempt-identity, retained-state, and resource-reconciliation root. A matched refusal, expected failure, executed Unsupported outcome, or mutation survivor/kill remains Observed when observation is complete; semantic outcome never substitutes for observation disposition.

NotObserved is fail-closed and uses exactly one registered reason: 1 execution-failed-before-completeness, 2 observation-channel-failed-before-completeness, or 3 unexpected-unstarted-or-skipped. It preserves attempt and payload identity and may preserve only a separately rooted redacted safe-partial-evidence object; it never copies expected values into actual fields, encodes missing actuals as observed-empty, claims successful execution, or permits a green aggregate. Every ContributionOnly row emits exactly one result-free upstream payload plus a distinct Deferred envelope with reason 1 immutable-contribution-awaits-designated-release-owner and the designated owner/driver/native-or-script route/manifest/observer contract; the designated owner later emits a separate execution envelope and cannot overwrite, alias, or promote the upstream envelope. Inapplicable is legal only for a predeclared exact source-registered applicability descriptor and cannot be synthesized from runtime skip, infrastructure failure, unsupported provider discovery, or missing observation.

The leaf's result, report contribution, stage evidence, runtime aggregate, detailed cell event, log context, structured reproduction, normal terminal, overflow terminal, bounded prefix, final bounded log, route contribution, and source closure exact-join the applicable declaration components, runtime disposition, and envelope root. Actual component roots are present only for Observed; every non-Observed form carries exact typed absence plus its reason/descriptor and no-claim. Comparisons use the AC57 exact twenty-position FirstDivergentExplicitComponentV1 precedence and stop at the first unequal applicable component without logging rejected raw values. Unit and literal-oracle tests cover every owned legal row; zero/unknown code and complete/partial/absent boundaries; property/model/state/typestate laws; mutation and API/compile-fail barriers; no-mock in-process or release-built owner E2E, or immutable contribution plus owner-consumption E2E; execution/observation/grant/use/return/revoke/cancellation/resource faults; deterministic step-prefixed detailed logging, redaction, structured reproduction, overflow-before-divergence, shard/resume, and one-component root movement; exact coverage partitions; and source closure. Tests MUST reject every illegal kind/disposition/reason pair, expected-as-actual, observed-empty-as-complete, payload-as-envelope, upstream-as-owner envelope, contribution-as-execution, applicability-as-skip, duplicate/missing/reordered evidence, hidden skip, forbidden-value echo, and stale or mixed-snapshot root.

AC58 SCHEMA-IMPACT CONSUMER AND MIGRATION GATE (CONTROLLING). This leaf consumes, and MUST NOT redefine, the canonical-schema migration registry and independent literal schema oracle owned by base contract owner `.24.1.1.1` under program gate `.24.1.1.1`. Its exact source-authoritative SchemaImpactManifestV1 classifies every canonical frame, nominal root, registry, manifest, log event, terminal, report, projection, contribution, route envelope, and structured-reproduction schema that this leaf owns or consumes exactly once by stable schema ID and exact u16 disposition: 1 NewV1NoPredecessor, 2 UnchangedV1, 3 MigratedV1ToV2, 4 DecodeOnlyLegacyV1, 5 RetiredV1, or 6 InapplicableNoCanonicalFrame. Every literal/unit/boundary, property/metamorphic, state/model/race, mutation/fuzz, API/compile-fail, fault/resource/cancellation, no-mock E2E or immutable-contribution, deterministic detailed-log/redaction, structured-reproduction, coverage, and source-closure fixture owned by this leaf names the authoritative schema versions and compatible snapshot. Tests freeze every V1 compatibility byte fixture before migration; exhaust exact-empty, one, exact maximum, one-over, missing/extra/duplicate/reordered rows; mutate every domain, magic, version, policy, field descriptor, nominal role, source owner, parent/child version, and snapshot; prove exact root movement and typed inspectability; reject V1/V2 and cross-role substitution, old-root-as-new-root, stale literal counts, and partial or mixed-snapshot migration; and exercise the exact release-built route or immutable contribution plus designated-owner consumption with step-prefixed logs, first explicit divergence, structured reproduction, overflow/resume, retained-relative-artifact policy, and no forbidden-value echo. CONTRACT/rustdoc, public accessors, route manifests, detailed log schemas, reproduction descriptors, coverage manifests, source closure, and all literal ratchets MUST agree on the same authoritative version; focused, strict-remote, release-built E2E, DSR, downstream, durability, scientific, and authority results remain separate proof states.

EXACT ORDERED LEAF ROUTE MANIFEST SUMMARY (CONTROLLING). The source-authoritative LeafCloseRouteObligationManifestV1 for this leaf contains exactly one row in kind-code then stable-route-ID order: runner-v2.route.24-3-3-2-2.to.verifier-core-v1.v1. It refuses a missing, extra, duplicate, reordered, stale, owner-remapped, cross-rollup, unknown-disposition, incompatible-snapshot, V1/V2-substituted, partial-migration, or multiply aggregated leaf/schema row, and refuses any authoritative V2 close claim while a required descendant is absent or still names an incompatible authoritative V1 parent.

Comprehensive rollup tests cover exact-empty where structurally legal, one descendant, the exact live maximum, one-over injected input, all six dispositions, nested-rollup associativity without double counting, order/shard/schedule/resume invariance, every missing/extra/duplicate/reorder and mixed-snapshot mutation, first explicit divergence, bounded deterministic step-prefixed logging and redaction, structured reproduction, overflow terminal, coverage counters, and exact source closure. A source-closed release-built E2E join consumes only already produced leaf evidence and proves aggregation fidelity; it does not execute descendants, replace their unit/property/model/mutation/API/fault/E2E/log/source-closure gates, or promote focused, DSR, downstream, durability, scientific, or authority proof. CONTRACT/rustdoc and the final rollup report list every descendant schema-impact manifest and all separate proof states.

ROLLUP EXACT RESULT-PARTITION LEDGER (CONTROLLING). The descendant join retains four separate canonical eligible/matched ID-set pairs and checked counters: eligible positives with matched positives; eligible expected refusals with matched expected refusals; eligible expected failures with matched expected failures; and eligible mutations with matched mutations. It separately retains typed Unsupported cells with exact matched reasons, typed inapplicable cells with exact matched registered reasons, unexpected mismatches, execution failures, and unexplained skips. Green requires every descendant stable ID exactly once, equality in each of the four eligible/matched pairs, exact Unsupported and inapplicable reason equality, nonempty applicable positive and adversarial corpora, and zero unexpected mismatches, execution failures, and unexplained skips. Aggregate adversarial totals are checked sums only and never replace the three exact adversarial subpartitions; expected failure is not execution failure, mutation is not refusal, Unsupported is not hidden skip, and an empty or filtered subset cannot pass.

LIVE ROLLUP TOPOLOGY, SCHEDULING, AND OPERABILITY 2026-07-29 (FINAL CONTROLLING). This issue is a `runner-v2-rollup` epic. Its exact direct hierarchy children are: `frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.3.3.3.1`, `frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.3.3.3.2`, `frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.3.3.3.3`. Its current recursive subtree contains exactly 4 Beads: 3 implementation tasks totaling 3,000 minutes and 1 rollup epics totaling 60 minutes, for 3,060 minutes. The 3 internal `parent-child` relations are closure hierarchy only; no reciprocal parent-depends-on-child `blocks` edge is permitted. This rollup's own 60-minute estimate covers only its explicitly named aggregate, integration, join, driver, rerun, source-closure, or close-review work and is not duplicated in child estimates. Functional implementation order remains solely in explicit `blocks` edges among owning tasks. While `br epic status` reports `eligible_for_close=false`, this rollup MUST have status `blocked`, never `open` or `in_progress`; when eligibility becomes true, transition it to `open` or `in_progress` only for its scoped closeout, then close it. The canonical executable-work query is `br ready --epic frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24 --type task`. `bv` robot output is diagnostic only; any surfaced rollup is not executable implementation work. Close this rollup only after every exact child-root, integration, test/E2E, detailed-log/redaction, reproduction, source-closure, proof-state, authority, and no-claim gate in this Bead passes. This clause supersedes every earlier numeric node/estimate/subtotal claim and every earlier phrase treating hierarchy children as reciprocal `blocks` dependencies or this epic as an implementation task. It removes no scope, feature, functionality, test, E2E script/contribution, logging, reproduction, source, route, capability, durability, scientific, admission, authority, or no-claim obligation.

ROLLUP CLOSEOUT DISCOVERABILITY AND MANUAL-EVIDENCE GATE 2026-07-29 (FINAL CONTROLLING). `br ready --epic frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24 --type task --json --limit 0` is the canonical implementation-task query; `bv` robot output is dependency/impact diagnosis, not executable status. When `br epic status --eligible-only --json` first reports this epic eligible because all direct children are closed, the epic is not automatically complete. Its deterministic closeout view MUST expose any remaining integration/route/join/rerun/review work; exact route ID where applicable; immutable command/driver/manifest descriptor; compatible source/build/schema roots; unresolved stable cells and proof states; expected result partitions; retained relative artifact root; retryability; no-claim scope; and uniquely ranked non-executable repairs. The transition from blocked -> eligible closeout -> in-progress closeout -> explicitly closed is deterministic and logged. title: Verifier E2E case manifest, event/shard/resume schemas, stable sharding, and proof plan
description:
Own the immutable verifier-v2 E2E case/proof plan and canonical event, shard, and resume schemas before any live execution.

## Acceptance Criteria

The dedicated Acceptance Criteria field is the canonical complete close gate. It preserves the domain-specific gate and the common nine-group unit/property/model/race/mutation/API/fault/E2E-or-contribution/logging/source-closure protocol; no description shorthand, checkpoint, parent status, aggregate count, or partial proof can replace it.
design: SOLE OWNERSHIP. Own VerifierE2ECaseManifestV1 and immutable artifact scripts/ci/manifests/evidence_verifier_v2_cases.v1.json; VerifierE2EHarnessEventV1, VerifierE2EShardPlanV1, VerifierE2EResumeLedgerV1, VerifierE2EShardReceiptV1 and checked constructors; exact stable cell IDs, platform prerequisites, expected dispositions, independent oracle roots, budgets, log schema, source closure, and context org.frankensim.fs-evidence-runner.verifier-e2e-shard.v1. StableIdShardAssignmentV1 uses BLAKE3 derive-key over canonical StableTokenV2 cell bytes, digest bytes 0-7 little-endian u64 modulo nonzero shard_count. V1 suffixes denote first internal harness wire generation, not product generation.
acceptance_criteria:
DOMAIN GATE. Literal/property/model/mutation/API/compile-fail tests exact-set every manifest/event/shard/resume field and stable cell; shard count/index zero/one/interior/max/one-over, empty/uneven shards, wrong context/digest slice/endianness/seed/wrapper salt/ordinal rule, interruption/resume, stale/mixed/gap/duplicate/misassigned results, exact per-cell/shard budgets, deterministic sorted IDs, and no authority. The plan includes all positive/refusal/failure/mutation/Unsupported/inapplicable/cancellation/drain/resource/log/source cells but cannot claim execution.

COMMON IMPLEMENTATION-LEAF CLOSE PROTOCOL (CONTROLLING). Preserve all nine groups: literal/unit/boundary; property/metamorphic; state/typestate/model/race; mutation/fuzz; API/compile-fail/trait; fault/resource/cancellation; release-built no-mock focused E2E or immutable contribution; deterministic detailed logging/redaction; and source closure. Every applicable slash facet has a separately nonzero corpus; true inapplicability has a stable typed code/name, owner, scope, prerequisite, and no-claim. One source-authoritative full-set manifest retains distinct exact ordered ID sets and checked counters for eligible positives and matched positives; eligible expected refusals and matched expected refusals; eligible expected failures and matched expected failures; and eligible mutations and matched mutations; exact Unsupported/inapplicable reasons; unexpected mismatches; execution failures; and unexplained skips. Green requires every eligible ID once, equality in each matched pair, nonempty applicable positive/adversarial corpora, exact reasons, and zero unexpected mismatches, execution failures, or unexplained skips; empty/subset execution cannot pass. Owned E2E uses one exact verified release route with no mocks; contributions bind one downstream owner/driver/script, independent oracle, explicit time/memory/work/process/artifact/output/log budgets, schema/log/source/build roots, expected disposition, and no-claim and cannot claim execution. Bounded canonical logs retain cell/category/facet ID, semantic/source/build/schema/oracle/budget/manifest/execution roots, ordered stages/terminal, redacted expected/observed class, first divergence, drain/resource outcome, exact partitions, diagnostic owner plus prerequisite/repair counts, no-claim, and relative artifacts. Exact prerequisites and repairs remain in bounded typed detail manifests that exact-join logs. Secrets, environment, live capabilities/resources, raw handles/provider payloads, physical/absolute paths, PIDs, wall time, scheduler noise, and bulk data are forbidden; rejected sentinels cannot echo through observed, Display, Debug, canonical bytes, logs, diagnostics, or reproduction. Source closure exact-sets modules, CONTRACT/rustdoc, schemas/owners, independent tables/oracles, fixtures, E2E scripts/contributions, log schemas, direct dependencies/features, and build inputs on one snapshot. Diagnostics have exact owner, retryability, prerequisites, no-claim, and unique non-executable ranked repairs. C1 schema/owner/import freeze, C2 literal/unit/boundary/API proof, C3 property/model/race/fault/mutation proof, and C4 E2E-or-contribution/log/redaction/source-closure proof are non-closing checkpoints only; root movement invalidates them. Focused, E2E/contribution, source-closure, constellation, DSR, downstream, platform, durability, science, admission, and authority statuses remain separate.

FIVE EXPLICITS DECLARATION, RUNTIME-EVIDENCE, AND COMPLETE-LOG GATE (CONTROLLING). Every stable literal, unit, boundary, property, metamorphic, state, typestate, model, race, mutation, fuzz, API, fault, and E2E cell binds one declaration-side Five Explicits contract: typed units for every numeric input, numeric grant, and expected numeric observation; one canonical seed declaration plus generator/minimizer version, or a registered `SeedInapplicable` code with owner, scope, prerequisite, and no-claim; seven-axis hard and soft time, memory, logical-work, process, artifact, output, and log budgets with process shape declared separately; exact API, wire, schema, source, build, toolchain, target, profile, and feature version requirements; one exact required/permitted semantic capability contract; and the exact no-claim. Runtime actual numeric observations, resolved seed provenance, budget reconciliation, observed versions, and actual required, granted, observed, returned, and revoked capability sets exist only inside disposition-gated runtime evidence. `Observed` requires complete actuals; `NotObserved` may retain only safe typed partial evidence plus its exact reason and cannot substitute expected values; `Deferred` and `Inapplicable` contain no fabricated actuals. Changing any applicable declaration or actual explicit moves exactly the intended component, cell, evidence, log, reproduction, aggregate, and report roots. Bounded log writers reserve sufficient bytes for one canonical terminal event before admitting detail events. The first event that would exceed the remaining detail budget emits one complete deterministic `LogBudgetExceeded` terminal containing the rejected event class and ordinal, digest, omitted count, applicable budget, first-divergence stage, disposition, drain/resource outcome, diagnostic owner, repair-manifest root, and no-claim. Partial JSONL, silent truncation, overwriting prior events, missing terminal state, expected-as-actual substitution, fabricated observed-empty data, or treating overflow as success refuses. Minimized reproduction evidence retains every applicable declaration and safe actual explicit without exposing a forbidden value.

SHARED SHARD-ASSIGNMENT CONSUMER BOUNDARY (CONTROLLING). This leaf consumes the exact compatible StableIdShardAssignmentV1 owner root from frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.2.2.2 and owns only its suite-specific derive-key context, typed plan, manifest, resume, receipt, and aggregate types. It cannot copy, redefine, fork, independently version, or substitute the shared assignment algorithm.

E2E ROUTE OBLIGATION MANIFEST GATE (CONTROLLING). Every leaf owns one exact ordered route-obligation manifest rather than a lossy leaf-wide binary. Each applicable obligation appears exactly once with `LeafCloseRouteObligationKindV1`: 1 `LocalInProcess`, 2 `ExecutionOwned`, 3 `ContributionOnly`, or 4 `Inapplicable`; zero and unknown refuse. A LocalInProcess row binds the real public in-process entry point, immutable cell oracle, budgets, expected partitions, detailed-log schema/root, source closure, and no-mock no-authority boundary. An ExecutionOwned row binds one literal release driver, POSIX wrapper where applicable, direct native-Windows driver or PowerShell wrapper as frozen by the owner contract, immutable case-manifest path/root, exact close argv, release-artifact identity, platform/provider matrix, declared capability profile, runtime evidence-envelope contract, retained relative artifacts, and complete detailed-log root. A ContributionOnly row binds one immutable result-free payload and Deferred envelope to exactly one downstream execution owner plus its literal driver, script/native route, manifest, observer contract, budgets, expected partitions, logging schema, source/build roots, and no-claim; it cannot report downstream execution passed. An Inapplicable row binds one registered reason, owner, scope, prerequisite, and no-claim. The derived leaf class is exactly `LocalOnly`, `ExecutionOnly`, `ContributionOnly`, or `Mixed`; multiple obligations and multiple contribution rows are legal and must remain distinct. Missing, extra, duplicate, reordered, generic, ambiguous, rollup-owned, stale, remapped, wrong-script, unconsumed, multiply consumed, debug, ambient/PATH-resolved/alternate/unregistered Cargo-run, hidden-skip, contribution-as-execution, or inferred leaf-class routes refuse. A specifically registered source-closed focused probe is legal only when its owner Bead names it and remains separately labeled non-closing evidence. Unit/exact-set, property/model, mutation, API/compile-fail, no-mock in-process or release-built E2E/contribution, deterministic detailed-log/redaction, structured-reproduction, resume/shard, overflow, and source-closure tests cover empty, one, maximum, mixed, duplicate, reorder, route substitution, owner remap, and every row-kind/derived-class transition. Focused/unit proof cannot substitute for a required release-built row or immutable contribution contract.

EXACT FULL-VERIFIER ROUTE OBLIGATION (CONTROLLING). This leaf owns the immutable `ContributionOnly` row `runner-v2.route.24-3-3-3-1.to.full-verifier-v2.v1` consumed exactly once by owner `.24.3.3.3.3`, driver `e2e-evidence-verifier-v2-driver`, POSIX wrapper `scripts/ci/e2e_evidence_verifier_v2.sh`, native Windows wrapper `scripts/ci/e2e_evidence_verifier_v2.ps1`, and case manifest `scripts/ci/manifests/evidence_verifier_v2_cases.v1.json`. The row binds declared profile `fs-evidence-runner.close-capability.release-verification.v1`, exact result-free payload and observer-contract roots, event/shard/resume schema, source/build/toolchain/target/features/schema/log roots, all per-cell/shard budgets and expected partitions, retained-relative-artifact policy, no-claim, and one distinct Deferred evidence-envelope root using reason code 1. It contains no fabricated actuals and cannot claim full-verifier execution passed. The owner exact-set consumes it once and rejects missing, extra, duplicate, reordered, stale, remapped, wrong-profile/driver/wrapper/manifest, mixed-snapshot, multiply consumed, payload-as-envelope, and contribution-as-execution rows. Unit/boundary, property/model, mutation, API/compile-fail, fault/cancellation/observation-loss, immutable-contribution plus release-built POSIX/native-Windows E2E, deterministic step-prefixed logging/redaction, structured reproduction, shard/resume/overflow, coverage, and source-closure tests prove the row and owner consumption.

AC57 EVIDENCE-DISPOSITION CONSUMER GATE (CONTROLLING). This leaf consumes, and MUST NOT redefine, the exact evidence-kind, RuntimeObservationDispositionV1, reason-registry, completeness, safe-partial-evidence, resource-reconciliation, EvidenceEnvelopeV1, and FirstDivergentExplicitComponentV1 contracts governed by program gate `.24.1.1.1` and base contract owner `.24.1.1.1`. Every stable local cell and every exact route-obligation row maps to one and only one legal evidence-kind/disposition pair. OwnedHarnessExecution and InProcessProjectionExecution admit only Observed or NotObserved; ImmutableDownstreamContribution admits only Deferred; ApplicabilityDeclaration admits only Inapplicable. LocalInProcess and ExecutionOwned work may close Observed only after a completed attempt supplies every applicable actual numeric-observation, observed-seed-disposition, budget-reconciliation, observed-version, observed-capability-set, execution-completeness, attempt-identity, retained-state, and resource-reconciliation root. A matched refusal, expected failure, executed Unsupported outcome, or mutation survivor/kill remains Observed when observation is complete; semantic outcome never substitutes for observation disposition.

NotObserved is fail-closed and uses exactly one registered reason: 1 execution-failed-before-completeness, 2 observation-channel-failed-before-completeness, or 3 unexpected-unstarted-or-skipped. It preserves attempt and payload identity and may preserve only a separately rooted redacted safe-partial-evidence object; it never copies expected values into actual fields, encodes missing actuals as observed-empty, claims successful execution, or permits a green aggregate. Every ContributionOnly row emits exactly one result-free upstream payload plus a distinct Deferred envelope with reason 1 immutable-contribution-awaits-designated-release-owner and the designated owner/driver/native-or-script route/manifest/observer contract; the designated owner later emits a separate execution envelope and cannot overwrite, alias, or promote the upstream envelope. Inapplicable is legal only for a predeclared exact source-registered applicability descriptor and cannot be synthesized from runtime skip, infrastructure failure, unsupported provider discovery, or missing observation.

The leaf's result, report contribution, stage evidence, runtime aggregate, detailed cell event, log context, structured reproduction, normal terminal, overflow terminal, bounded prefix, final bounded log, route contribution, and source closure exact-join the applicable declaration components, runtime disposition, and envelope root. Actual component roots are present only for Observed; every non-Observed form carries exact typed absence plus its reason/descriptor and no-claim. Comparisons use the AC57 exact twenty-position FirstDivergentExplicitComponentV1 precedence and stop at the first unequal applicable component without logging rejected raw values. Unit and literal-oracle tests cover every owned legal row; zero/unknown code and complete/partial/absent boundaries; property/model/state/typestate laws; mutation and API/compile-fail barriers; no-mock in-process or release-built owner E2E, or immutable contribution plus owner-consumption E2E; execution/observation/grant/use/return/revoke/cancellation/resource faults; deterministic step-prefixed detailed logging, redaction, structured reproduction, overflow-before-divergence, shard/resume, and one-component root movement; exact coverage partitions; and source closure. Tests MUST reject every illegal kind/disposition/reason pair, expected-as-actual, observed-empty-as-complete, payload-as-envelope, upstream-as-owner envelope, contribution-as-execution, applicability-as-skip, duplicate/missing/reordered evidence, hidden skip, forbidden-value echo, and stale or mixed-snapshot root.

AC58 SCHEMA-IMPACT CONSUMER AND MIGRATION GATE (CONTROLLING). This leaf consumes, and MUST NOT redefine, the canonical-schema migration registry and independent literal schema oracle owned by base contract owner `.24.1.1.1` under program gate `.24.1.1.1`. Its exact source-authoritative SchemaImpactManifestV1 classifies every canonical frame, nominal root, registry, manifest, log event, terminal, report, projection, contribution, route envelope, and structured-reproduction schema that this leaf owns or consumes exactly once by stable schema ID and exact u16 disposition: 1 NewV1NoPredecessor, 2 UnchangedV1, 3 MigratedV1ToV2, 4 DecodeOnlyLegacyV1, 5 RetiredV1, or 6 InapplicableNoCanonicalFrame. Each row binds API generation, wire version and wire-predecessor policy, separate canonical-schema migration policy, exact domain, magic, ordered field descriptors, nominal root role, owner, source path, authoritative/compatibility status, allowed parent/child versions, no-claim, and compatible-source-snapshot root. Zero/unknown codes and missing, extra, duplicate, reordered, owner-inferred, route-inferred, stale, or mixed-snapshot rows refuse.

Wire compatibility and canonical-schema migration are non-interchangeable. API generation 2, wire version 1, and Runner wire predecessor NoPredecessor remain separate from canonical-schema policies NoSchemaPredecessor, V1DecodeOnlyCompatibilityEvidence, and V1Retired. A new component may begin at V1 only when it has no canonical predecessor. Every enclosing schema whose field order, field meaning, canonical payload, or authority semantics changes rotates coherently to a distinct V2 type, `.v2` domain, versioned magic, field table, and V2 nominal root on the same compatible source snapshot. An unchanged V1 child is legal inside a V2 parent only when the independent oracle explicitly records that unchanged component role and exact position. Decode-only or retired V1 bytes never alias, parse as, substitute for, or close an authoritative V2 path; partial migration, V2-parent/V1-child substitution outside an allowed unchanged slot, generic ContentHash bridging, transmute-like accessors, shared domains/magics, compatibility aliases, and caller-minted roots refuse.

Every literal/unit/boundary, property/metamorphic, state/model/race, mutation/fuzz, API/compile-fail, fault/resource/cancellation, no-mock E2E or immutable-contribution, deterministic detailed-log/redaction, structured-reproduction, coverage, and source-closure fixture owned by this leaf names the authoritative schema versions and compatible snapshot. Tests freeze every V1 compatibility byte fixture before migration; exhaust exact-empty, one, exact maximum, one-over, missing/extra/duplicate/reordered rows; mutate every domain, magic, version, policy, field descriptor, nominal role, source owner, parent/child version, and snapshot; prove exact root movement and typed inspectability; reject V1/V2 and cross-role substitution, old-root-as-new-root, stale literal counts, and partial or mixed-snapshot migration; and exercise the exact release-built route or immutable contribution plus designated-owner consumption with step-prefixed logs, first explicit divergence, structured reproduction, overflow/resume, retained-relative-artifact policy, and no forbidden-value echo. CONTRACT/rustdoc, public accessors, route manifests, detailed log schemas, reproduction descriptors, coverage manifests, source closure, and all literal ratchets MUST agree on the same authoritative version; focused, strict-remote, release-built E2E, DSR, downstream, durability, scientific, and authority results remain separate proof states.

EXACT ORDERED LEAF ROUTE MANIFEST SUMMARY (CONTROLLING). The source-authoritative LeafCloseRouteObligationManifestV1 for this leaf contains exactly one row in kind-code then stable-route-ID order: runner-v2.route.24-3-3-3-1.to.full-verifier-v2.v1. Exact counts are LocalInProcess=0, ExecutionOwned=0, ContributionOnly=1, and Inapplicable=0; the derived class is exactly ContributionOnly. Every prior route-specific criterion on this Bead specifies one of these same rows and does not create a duplicate. No prose-only owner, dependency, test fixture, schema provenance edge, focused probe, rollup mapping, or transitive consumer becomes an implicit route. Adding, removing, merging, splitting, or remapping a journey requires updating this exact list, its independent registry oracle, AC56 capability profile, AC57 evidence kind/disposition, AC58 schema-impact row, coverage ratchet, detailed-log/reproduction schemas, and source closure atomically.

Independent unit/exact-set and zero/one/exact/one-over manifest tests, kind-order and derived-class properties, owner/consumer model tests, every-row mutation, API/compile-fail nominal privacy, no-mock local/release/contribution E2E as applicable, disposition/capability/resource/cancellation faults, deterministic step-prefixed detailed logging/redaction/no-echo, structured reproduction, overflow-before-divergence, shard/resume, exact result partitions, and source closure reconstruct this list without reading the production registry table. They reject missing, extra, duplicate, reordered, stale, unknown-kind, inferred-class, wrong owner/profile/driver/wrapper/manifest/entrypoint, contribution-as-execution, local-as-release, applicability-as-skip, transitive-route invention, hidden skip, and mixed-snapshot rows.

ROUTE-SCHEMA V2 AND PROOF-DAG RECONCILIATION (CONTROLLING). Every leaf route manifest consumes the common closed route vocabulary owned by frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.1.1.1 and MUST NOT redefine it. LeafCloseRouteObligationKindV1 is exact: 1 LocalInProcess, 2 ExecutionOwned, 3 ContributionOnly, and 4 Inapplicable; zero and unknown refuse. LeafCloseRouteDerivedClassV1 is exact: 1 LocalOnly, 2 ExecutionOnly, 3 ContributionOnly, and 4 Mixed. Inapplicable rows do not by themselves determine the class; an empty or all-Inapplicable manifest refuses. LEAF_CLOSE_ROUTE_OBLIGATIONS_MAX_V1 is exactly 64 rows. Manifest input is already in kind-code then bytewise stable-route-ID order and is rejected rather than sorted. The exact runtime evidence enum name is BaseCoverageCloseEvidenceKindV1; no third generic EvidenceKindV1 is introduced alongside the existing close and logging vocabularies.

DIRECT NATIVE-WINDOWS ROUTE REPRESENTATION (CONTROLLING). NativeWindowsRouteV2 is a closed typed sum: code 1 PowerShellWrapper { wrapper_owner, logical_path: LogicalBundlePathV1 } and code 2 DirectDriver { driver_owner, driver_id: StableTokenV2, bootstrap_contract_root: NativeWindowsDriverBootstrapContractRootV1 }; zero and unknown codes refuse. DirectDriver names the same exact platform-neutral release driver frozen by the route row. It is never encoded as a path, inferred .ps1 companion, shell command, PATH-resolved executable, Wine/WSL/MSYS route, or optional wrapper. NativeWindowsDriverBootstrapContractV1 is the common declaration schema owned by .24.1.1.1, with stable ABI ID fs-evidence-runner.native-windows-driver-bootstrap-abi.v1, nominal root NativeWindowsDriverBootstrapContractRootV1, canonical domain org.frankensim.fs-evidence-runner.native-windows-driver-bootstrap-contract.v1, and magic ASCII FSNATIVEWINDOWSBOOTSTRAP followed by byte 0x01. Its exact frame order is API generation 2; wire generation 1; ABI ID; argv representation windows-utf16-code-units-v1; direct-driver/no-shell/no-PATH policy; and no-claim native-windows-bootstrap-contract-proves-argv-shape-not-driver-presence-launch-exit-or-authority. A concrete driver ID, source/build artifact, target/provider binding, and execution remain owned by the designated execution owner and exact-join this common contract.

BaseCoverageCloseDeferredObservationContractV1 remains compatibility-only because its windows_route field is path-only. It is never reinterpreted for DirectDriver. BaseCoverageCloseDeferredObservationContractV2 replaces that field with NativeWindowsRouteV2 and has domain org.frankensim.fs-evidence-runner.close-deferred-observation-contract.v2 and magic ASCII FSCLOSEDEFERREDOBSERVER followed by byte 0x02. Its exact order is route ID; semantic consumer; execution owner; driver owner; POSIX wrapper owner; capability profile; driver ID; POSIX route; complete NativeWindowsRouteV2 bytes/root; case-manifest path; case-manifest contract root; Deferred-reason registry root; Deferred reason; and no-claim. Because BaseCoverageCloseDownstreamContributionV2 embeds the V1 observer, route declarations use additive BaseCoverageCloseDownstreamContributionV3 plus BaseCoverageCloseDeferredEvidenceEnvelopeV2; the V2 contribution and V1 envelope remain compatibility evidence and cannot enter the authoritative route manifest. No existing V1 bytes are silently reinterpreted.

ROUTE DECLARATION/RUNTIME DAG CLARIFICATION (CONTROLLING). A source-authoritative LocalInProcess route row binds attempt_identity_contract_root, detailed_log_schema_root, and structured_reproduction_schema_root. It MUST NOT bind a per-invocation attempt_identity_root, detailed_log_root, or structured_reproduction_root. LocalInProcessRunRequestV1 binds the actual AttemptIdentityV1 only after declaration admission. RuntimeObservationV1, EvidenceEnvelopeV1, PresentedResultV2, aggregate/report, StructuredReproductionV2, terminal, and final log bind actual invocation roots in that forward order. StructuredReproductionV2 is constructed only after the completed report or safe partial report; its actual root enters the terminal afterward. Any reverse edge, expected-as-actual substitution, or source manifest whose root changes per attempt refuses. Static route rows bind a case_manifest_contract_root derived from exact owner/driver/native/POSIX/path/schema literals; they do not claim a downstream-owned file exists, has been read, has a runtime content root, or has executed.

OWNER ROLE EQUALITY MATRIX (CONTROLLING). Every owner role remains a separately encoded typed field even when two fields contain the same Bead ID. source_owner is the leaf that emits the declaration. For each ContributionOnly row, semantic_consumer equals execution_owner and driver_owner equals execution_owner unless an exact row explicitly freezes another owner. posix_wrapper_owner equals execution_owner when a POSIX wrapper is declared. windows_wrapper_owner equals execution_owner only for PowerShellWrapper; DirectDriver has no wrapper owner and its driver_owner equals execution_owner. source_owner MUST differ from semantic_consumer and execution_owner. Equal values across declared role fields are legal and do not collapse, omit, or infer fields. Rows may share an owner, driver, platform routes, and case-manifest contract only when explicitly listed, while their route ID, payload root, contribution root, and Deferred-envelope root remain distinct.

Any reverse edge, expected-as-actual substitution, or source manifest whose root changes per attempt refuses. Static route rows bind a case_manifest_contract_root derived from exact owner/driver/native/POSIX/path/schema literals; they do not claim a downstream-owned file exists, has been read, has a runtime content root, or has executed.

OWNER ROLE EQUALITY MATRIX (CONTROLLING). Every owner role remains a separately encoded typed field even when two fields contain the same Bead ID. source_owner is the leaf that emits the declaration. For each ContributionOnly row, semantic_consumer equals execution_owner and driver_owner equals execution_owner unless an exact row explicitly freezes another owner. posix_wrapper_owner equals execution_owner when a POSIX wrapper is declared. windows_wrapper_owner equals execution_owner only for PowerShellWrapper; DirectDriver has no wrapper owner and its driver_owner equals execution_owner. source_owner MUST differ from semantic_consumer and execution_owner. Equal values across declared role fields are legal and do not collapse, omit, or infer fields. Rows may share an owner, driver, platform routes, and case-manifest contract only when explicitly listed, while their route ID, payload root, contribution root, and Deferred-envelope root remain distinct.

DECLARATION VERSUS ACTUAL ARTIFACTS AND FAULTS (CONTROLLING). Contribution rows use OwnerEnvelopeRelativePathsOnly. Local rows use a distinct LocalExplicitAbsentOrRelativePathsOnly policy. Both are declaration policy only; RetainedArtifactStateV1 is runtime evidence and is present only under the legal runtime disposition. A pure in-process leaf with no asupersync/runtime dependency may test deterministic model-only observation-loss, cancellation, deadline, and resource faults through private sealed fixtures, but MUST label them model evidence and MUST NOT call them actual runtime cancellation/drain proof. Actual scoped cancellation, stop, drain, process, and resource-return evidence remains with the exact execution owner whose dependency/capability contract permits it. A Boolean callback or public test hook cannot stand in for either model proof or actual cancellation.

CANONICAL ROUTE SCHEMAS AND TEST GATE (CONTROLLING). New route body, row, manifest, local-entrypoint registry, native-route, native-bootstrap, V2 observer, V3 contribution, V2 Deferred-envelope, declaration-policy, and runtime-result schemas have exact API/wire versions, domains, magic bytes, ordered fields, nominal roots, migration rows, source owners, source paths, compatible snapshot, and no-claim. New nominal roles use source-frozen LeafExtension fragments and never append to the immutable 47-role FrozenBase registry. Independent handwritten tests cover exact codes/literals and every route row; empty, one, 64, 65, exact-set, missing, extra, duplicate, reorder, stale, unknown kind, all class transitions, and all-Inapplicable refusal; every-field/root mutation; owner/consumer singularity and equality; PowerShell/direct-driver substitution; V1/V2/V3 barriers; raw-hash and cross-kind compile failures with exact Rust error codes and positive counterparts; result-free contribution plus Deferred-envelope separation; no-mock local or release owner E2E; Observed, NotObserved, Deferred, and Inapplicable matrices; safe partials; model-only versus actual cancellation scope; reserve-before-detail log overflow; deterministic step order, redaction, no-echo, and post-report structured reproduction; shard/resume and mixed-snapshot refusal; exact partitions; and complete source closure. Every test and compile-fail addition updates its live inventory, class count, route ratchet, schema-impact manifest, log/reproduction schema, and source closure atomically. Focused, release-built, source-closure, constellation, DSR, downstream, platform, durability, scientific, admission, and authority proof states remain separate.

THREE-WAY CLASSIFIER, MINIMIZATION, SCHEDULE, AND FORWARD-ROUTE RECONCILIATION 2026-07-29 (CONTROLLING).

1. Classification records observed equality topology without causal blame: all equal; producer-only different; oracle-only different; verifier-only different; all pairwise different; or `NotClassifiable` with exact missing/disposition reason. `NotObserved`, `Deferred`, missing decoder output, incomplete evidence, and internal failure cannot be coerced into a difference class. Diagnostic ownership may rank the next component to inspect but equality alone never proves fault.
2. Every classifier cell retains the exact `Bound` mutation-registration root. Deterministic minimization uses a frozen reducer order, preserves class and first divergent component, retains original/minimized roots, fresh-process reproduction, and one-minimality; `BudgetExhausted` keeps the best witness without claiming minimality; traces are bounded/redacted/no-echo.
3. Aggregate roots are invariant only to receipt arrival order, shard assignment/count, worker execution order, retries, and valid resume over an unchanged exact cell set. Changing `RaceScheduleV2`, stop sequence, semantic seed, mutation, platform receipt, or another semantic input creates a different cell and aggregate root.
4. This leaf now owns two bytewise-ordered ContributionOnly rows: `runner-v2.route.24-3-3-3-2.to.canonical-runner-v2.v1` consumed by `.24.4.1.4` using `canonical-evidence-runner-v2-e2e-driver`, `scripts/ci/canonical_evidence_runner_v2.sh`, native Windows `DirectDriver`, `scripts/ci/manifests/canonical_evidence_runner_v2_cases.v1.json`, and profile `fs-evidence-runner.close-capability.release-canonical.v1`; and existing `runner-v2.route.24-3-3-3-2.to.full-verifier-v2.v1`. Exact counts are LocalInProcess=0, ExecutionOwned=0, ContributionOnly=2, Inapplicable=0; derived class `ContributionOnly`. Both rows are result-free Deferred envelopes, have distinct payload/log/schema roots, and are consumed exactly once.
5. Unit/exact-set, property/model, mutation, API/compile-fail, fault/cancellation, both contribution journeys and designated-owner consumption, deterministic logging/redaction, structured reproduction, shard/resume, coverage, and source-closure tests update AC56/AC57/AC58 and reject missing, extra, duplicate, reordered, stale, remapped, wrong-owner/driver/wrapper/manifest/profile, mixed-snapshot, fabricated-actual, or contribution-as-execution rows.


FINAL EXACT ORDERED ROUTE MANIFEST 2026-07-29 (FINAL CONTROLLING). This source owner has exactly two current rows, both ContributionOnly and ordered bytewise by stable route ID: (1) runner-v2.route.24-3-3-3-2.to.canonical-runner-v2.v1; (2) runner-v2.route.24-3-3-3-2.to.full-verifier-v2.v1. Exact counts are LocalInProcess=0, ExecutionOwned=0, ContributionOnly=2, and Inapplicable=0; the derived class is ContributionOnly. Each row has a distinct immutable payload, Deferred envelope, consumer, profile, manifest contract, log/reproduction roots, AC56/AC57/AC58 row, coverage entry, and source-closure entry, and each is consumed exactly once by its designated execution owner. The earlier one-row exact summary is retained only in Bead notes as non-current migration history and is not a current manifest input or acceptance requirement. Missing, extra, duplicate, reordered, stale, remapped, shared-payload, multiply consumed, contribution-as-execution, fabricated-observation, mixed-snapshot, or third-route variants refuse. All existing comprehensive tests, designated-owner E2E consumption, deterministic detailed logging/redaction, structured reproduction, minimization, coverage, source closure, and no-claim obligations remain binding.

PHASE-3 SCHEMA-OWNERSHIP MANIFEST IMPLEMENTATION OWNERSHIP 2026-07-29 (FINAL CONTROLLING). This task, and no review rollup, owns `RunnerPhase3SchemaOwnershipManifestV2`, its exact entry set, anchors, classifier, aggregate constructor, independent literal oracle, detailed logs/reproduction, and source closure. It consumes the exact Phase-2 manifest from `.24.2.2.3.2`, exact decoder/verifier/external-host implementation rows from their atomic owners, and exact-set joins them on one compatible snapshot. It does not own any contributed implementation schema, decoder, verifier, acquisition host, driver, process observation, or authority result. Tests cover every owner/role/anchor mutation, missing/extra/duplicate/reordered row, rollup-as-owner, stale source, contribution-as-aggregate, and mixed snapshot.

PROGRAM-WIDE ATTEMPT CORRELATION, STAGE TELEMETRY, SHARD/RESUME, AND COMPLETE-LOG CONSUMER GATE 2026-07-29 (FINAL CONTROLLING). This task exact-binds, and does not redefine, the common three-plane contracts owned by `.24.1.1.1.4` through `.24.1.1.1.6`. Every executable cell declaration binds the common attempt-identity contract root; the actual nominal `AttemptIdentityRootV1` exists only after admission. Every child/downstream execution records its stable route/suite/case/cell/shard IDs and causal ordinal, with an optional typed parent-attempt root only in attempt-specific evidence. Canonical invocation/command/event/report/reproduction/terminal/final-log payloads bind the attempt-invariant `CanonicalRuntimeObservationProjectionRootV1` and contain deterministic schema/version, logical event sequence, stage code/ordinal, event kind/severity, expected/observed classification, semantic/budget/capability/no-claim roots, first divergence, bounded actionable diagnostic, terminal completeness, and safe relative artifacts. They contain no attempt identity/scope, raw transcript, timing sample, wall clock, physical path, host/environment/PID/scheduler/load, secret, live capability/resource value, or bulk payload.

Applicable actual execution additionally requires a complete AC57 envelope and finalized `AttemptRetentionReceiptV1` that correlate the canonical root set with nominal attempt identity, safe retention scope, resource/capability reconciliation, raw-audit roots, atomic finalization, and `RunnerStageTelemetryV1`. The bounded telemetry sidecar records attempt/optional parent correlation, stable route/suite/case/cell/shard IDs, causal ordinal, stage code/ordinal, start/finish disposition, checked monotonic offset and stage delta with explicit units, clock descriptor/root, resolution and suspend policy, applicable environmental time budget, terminal disposition, safe relative artifact references, and explicit no-performance-claim scope. Timing is an operator observation only: it never feeds semantic/source/build/schema/oracle/expected-result/publication/receipt/admission/authority roots or a portable performance claim. A read-only operator view may join receipt, canonical log, and telemetry after finalization; it cannot feed execution or mutate any root.

A ContributionOnly or deferred-local declaration carries its immutable result-free payload plus typed Deferred envelope and fabricates no attempt, timing, execution, resource, or terminal actual. A genuinely pure/non-executable facet uses a source-registered Inapplicable reason naming exact owner, scope, prerequisite, and no-claim. Every manifest explicitly declares `Sharded` or `ShardInapplicable` and `Resumable` or `ResumeInapplicable`; omission, runtime-skip synthesis, or Unsupported-as-Inapplicable refuses. Applicable E2E owners retain exact attempt-scoped relative artifact/reproduction references; contribution tasks bind the exact downstream owner/driver/script/manifest that will produce them.

Comprehensive literal/unit/boundary, property/metamorphic, state/typestate/model/race, mutation/fuzz, API/compile-fail/trait, fault/resource/cancellation, no-mock local/release E2E or immutable contribution plus owner-consumption E2E, deterministic detailed logging/redaction/no-echo, structured reproduction, shard/resume, exact coverage, and source-closure tests cover missing/extra/duplicate/reordered stages/events/correlation rows, logical-sequence gaps/overflow, simultaneous same-cell attempts, causal-parent substitution, exact resume versus cross-attempt residue, shard gaps/duplicates/remaps, clock unavailable/regression/wrap/overflow, stage nesting and deadline reconciliation, observation loss, zero/one/exact/one-over log and telemetry budgets, reserve-before-detail terminal overflow, changing timing/attempt/raw noise without moving canonical roots, one-component movement in the correct outer plane, sentinel redaction across every output path, and missing terminal/correlation/artifact/reproduction evidence. Silent truncation, hidden skip, unbounded logging, fabricated actuals, or a green subset is forbidden.

title: External acquisition host, native POSIX/Windows wrappers, sole verifier-v2 release driver, and full no-mock verifier-host three-way E2E
description:
Own the sole live verifier-v2 acquisition/process host and execute full release-built three-way cross-platform E2E using explicit producer, oracle, decoder, verifier, and driver artifacts.

## Acceptance Criteria

The dedicated Acceptance Criteria field is the canonical complete close gate. It preserves the domain-specific gate and the common nine-group unit/property/model/race/mutation/API/fault/E2E-or-contribution/logging/source-closure protocol; no description shorthand, checkpoint, parent status, aggregate count, or partial proof can replace it.
design: SOLE HOST AND ROUTE OWNERSHIP. Own e2e-evidence-verifier-v2-driver, thin Unix scripts/ci/e2e_evidence_verifier_v2.sh, thin native Windows scripts/ci/e2e_evidence_verifier_v2.ps1, live external acquisition host, platform receipt/global execution join, and final coverage/log/source closure. Consume .1 event/shard constructors and .2 aggregate/manifest constructors; do not redefine them. Explicit verified artifacts are producer evidence-runner-upstream-mutation-v2-e2e-driver, oracle evidence-runner-oracle-v2-e2e-driver, decoder fs-evidence-verifier-decode, verifier fs-evidence-verifier, and this driver. PATH/cargo-run/debug/mock substitution refuses. Consume Phase-2 VerifierInputAcquisitionObservationV1 without reownership. The host opens/acquires read-only inputs, detects revocation/copy/substitution, runs OriginalOutputRecoveryVerification read-only rebind cases, launches and observes registered child executions that return presented platform/provider evidence, sends VerifierRequestFrameV1/StopRequest frames, and never directly mutates provider state or lets physical identifiers enter semantic roots. Any provider restart, write, recovery, synchronization, or durability operation occurs only inside a separately registered child execution under that child's non-aliasing capability envelope.
acceptance_criteria:
DOMAIN GATE. Full release-built no-mock E2E executes every eligible mutation and manifest cell through producer/oracle/decoder/verifier agreement; native Unix/Windows wrapper semantic parity; ArtifactOnlyRead copy invariance and mid-read substitution; OriginalOutputRecoveryVerification read-only rebind; presented provider/platform/restart/durability evidence produced by registered child execution; the verifier host never directly mutates provider state; lifecycle/publication/recovery/transport/tamper/fault/cancellation/deadline/drain/resource cases; deterministic domain-separated sharding/resume; minimized first divergence; all partitions/logging/redaction/source closure. Platform-neutral projections are wrapper-invariant, while each platform receipt binds target/platform/wrapper/provider/source/build/toolchain/features and may differ; global join is order/shard/schedule/resume invariant only. Rooted logs retain configured deadline/logical timeout checkpoint, never wall/host/scheduler telemetry. Native Windows uses no Bash/WSL/MSYS. Missing/alternate/hidden-skip/leak/result substitution or historical-authority promotion fails.

COMMON IMPLEMENTATION-LEAF CLOSE PROTOCOL (CONTROLLING). Preserve all nine groups: literal/unit/boundary; property/metamorphic; state/typestate/model/race; mutation/fuzz; API/compile-fail/trait; fault/resource/cancellation; release-built no-mock focused E2E or immutable contribution; deterministic detailed logging/redaction; and source closure. Every applicable slash facet has a separately nonzero corpus; true inapplicability has a stable typed code/name, owner, scope, prerequisite, and no-claim. One source-authoritative full-set manifest retains distinct exact ordered ID sets and checked counters for eligible positives and matched positives; eligible expected refusals and matched expected refusals; eligible expected failures and matched expected failures; and eligible mutations and matched mutations; exact Unsupported/inapplicable reasons; unexpected mismatches; execution failures; and unexplained skips. Green requires every eligible ID once, equality in each matched pair, nonempty applicable positive/adversarial corpora, exact reasons, and zero unexpected mismatches, execution failures, or unexplained skips; empty/subset execution cannot pass. Owned E2E uses one exact verified release route with no mocks; contributions bind one downstream owner/driver/script, independent oracle, explicit time/memory/work/process/artifact/output/log budgets, schema/log/source/build roots, expected disposition, and no-claim and cannot claim execution. Bounded canonical logs retain cell/category/facet ID, semantic/source/build/schema/oracle/budget/manifest/execution roots, ordered stages/terminal, redacted expected/observed class, first divergence, drain/resource outcome, exact partitions, diagnostic owner plus prerequisite/repair counts, no-claim, and relative artifacts. Exact prerequisites and repairs remain in bounded typed detail manifests that exact-join logs. Secrets, environment, live capabilities/resources, raw handles/provider payloads, physical/absolute paths, PIDs, wall time, scheduler noise, and bulk data are forbidden; rejected sentinels cannot echo through observed, Display, Debug, canonical bytes, logs, diagnostics, or reproduction. Source closure exact-sets modules, CONTRACT/rustdoc, schemas/owners, independent tables/oracles, fixtures, E2E scripts/contributions, log schemas, direct dependencies/features, and build inputs on one snapshot. Diagnostics have exact owner, retryability, prerequisites, no-claim, and unique non-executable ranked repairs. C1 schema/owner/import freeze, C2 literal/unit/boundary/API proof, C3 property/model/race/fault/mutation proof, and C4 E2E-or-contribution/log/redaction/source-closure proof are non-closing checkpoints only; root movement invalidates them. Focused, E2E/contribution, source-closure, constellation, DSR, downstream, platform, durability, science, admission, and authority statuses remain separate.

FIVE EXPLICITS DECLARATION, RUNTIME-EVIDENCE, AND COMPLETE-LOG GATE (CONTROLLING). Every stable literal, unit, boundary, property, metamorphic, state, typestate, model, race, mutation, fuzz, API, fault, and E2E cell binds one declaration-side Five Explicits contract: typed units for every numeric input, numeric grant, and expected numeric observation; one canonical seed declaration plus generator/minimizer version, or a registered `SeedInapplicable` code with owner, scope, prerequisite, and no-claim; seven-axis hard and soft time, memory, logical-work, process, artifact, output, and log budgets with process shape declared separately; exact API, wire, schema, source, build, toolchain, target, profile, and feature version requirements; one exact required/permitted semantic capability contract; and the exact no-claim. Runtime actual numeric observations, resolved seed provenance, budget reconciliation, observed versions, and actual required, granted, observed, returned, and revoked capability sets exist only inside disposition-gated runtime evidence. `Observed` requires complete actuals; `NotObserved` may retain only safe typed partial evidence plus its exact reason and cannot substitute expected values; `Deferred` and `Inapplicable` contain no fabricated actuals. Changing any applicable declaration or actual explicit moves exactly the intended component, cell, evidence, log, reproduction, aggregate, and report roots. Bounded log writers reserve sufficient bytes for one canonical terminal event before admitting detail events. The first event that would exceed the remaining detail budget emits one complete deterministic `LogBudgetExceeded` terminal containing the rejected event class and ordinal, digest, omitted count, applicable budget, first-divergence stage, disposition, drain/resource outcome, diagnostic owner, repair-manifest root, and no-claim. Partial JSONL, silent truncation, overwriting prior events, missing terminal state, expected-as-actual substitution, fabricated observed-empty data, or treating overflow as success refuses. Minimized reproduction evidence retains every applicable declaration and safe actual explicit without exposing a forbidden value.

SEMANTIC SEED PROPAGATION AND PROOF JOIN (CONTROLLING). This bead does not invent a second seed type or hidden default. Every owned schema, fixture, command, execution, artifact, replay, verifier, receipt, log, source-closure, E2E row, or rollup join that carries an invocation or case preserves the exact upstream `InvocationSeedSelectionRootV2`, `CaseSeedPolicyV2`, and applicable `CaseExecutionSeedRootV2` or registered `NoRandomness` absence through typed parent bindings. Unit/property/model/race/mutation/API/compile-fail/release-E2E-or-contribution/log/source-closure proof covers omission, substitution, wrong case/run, stale/mixed snapshot, override, ambient randomness, and count-only evidence. Test-harness seeds remain separately typed Five-Explicit data and cannot substitute for the semantic workload seed. Seed evidence establishes reproducibility only and never scientific, publication, verification, or admission authority.

EXACT PROOF INVOCATION, RETENTION, AND ATTEMPT-ISOLATION GATE (CONTROLLING). This suite owns immutable case manifest scripts/ci/manifests/evidence_verifier_v2_cases.v1.json and one canonical close-mode invocation contract containing the exact verified release-artifact identity, manifest root and path, target/provider prerequisite row, exact feature set, literal argv vector, shard index/count, optional resume-ledger root, capability-confined output root, expected native exit, and retained relative evidence paths. The retained proof records the verbatim results of scripts/ci/checkout_constellation.sh --verify-only, dsr repos info frankensim, dsr quality --tool frankensim, one literal registry-selected dsr build frankensim --target TARGET argv with TARGET replaced by the actual registered target in every retained row, and the exact suite script/driver invocation. A placeholder, reconstructed command, PATH lookup, Cargo-run, debug artifact, alternate rebuild, unretained output, or target token left unresolved cannot close. Debug filtering, single-cell execution, list, dry-run, and nonclosing checkpoints carry explicit NonClosingSubset disposition and can never emit a green close manifest. Concurrent executions of the same semantic cell use distinct nonsemantic capability-confined attempt scopes while preserving the same stable cell root. Resume accepts only rows and residue matching suite, manifest, source, build, toolchain, target, features, cell, and attempt-policy roots. Tests cover two simultaneous same-cell runs, interrupted atomic ledger update, stale/copied/mixed ledgers, same-cell/different-attempt isolation, residue substitution, exact resource return, and prevention of attempt identifiers entering semantic roots or rooted logs. The canonical relative retention layout is artifacts/runner-v2/{suite_id}/{build_root}/{shard_id}/{cell_id}/ containing bounded invocation.json, events.jsonl, summary.json, first-divergence.json, reproduction.json, and source-closure.json; exact names, presence, limits, roots, and no-absolute-path rules are unit-, boundary-, mutation-, fault-, resume-, native-E2E-, logging-, and source-closure-tested.

VERIFIER-HARNESS OPERABILITY GATE (CONTROLLING). The POSIX and native-Windows wrappers expose one semantically identical documented interface for help, version, list-cells, dry-run, close mode, shard index/count, resume ledger, explicit release artifacts, immutable manifest, and retained output root. List, dry-run, filtered execution, and checkpoints are structurally non-closing. Wrapper parsing, defaults, errors, exits, reproduction text, redaction, capability acquisition, cancellation, and exact resource return are golden-tested against the native driver.

VERIFIER-HOST CAPABILITY AND PHASE-4 BOUNDARY (CONTROLLING). “Full three-way E2E” means release-built verifier-host execution through `e2e-evidence-verifier-v2-driver`; it does not prove canonical shipping Runner command execution. The host capability profile is exactly `control-input.read`, `release-process.control`, `retained-evidence.write`, and `evidence-input.read`. The host may acquire evidence, launch/observe/stop/drain/wait for registered release processes, and retain evidence only. It MUST NOT directly restart, write, synchronize, recover, lease, CAS, or otherwise mutate a provider. Any such operation runs inside a separately registered child execution under that child's distinct capability envelope and returns presented evidence. Host and child capability envelopes cannot alias, and process control cannot fabricate provider-effect evidence. This leaf remains ExecutionOnly and emits no Phase-4 contribution; `.24.3.3.3.2` owns the canonical Phase-4 contribution. Unit/property/model/mutation/API/fault/native-E2E tests attempt direct host restart/write/CAS/sync under the verification profile and require pre-effect refusal, prove envelope separation and non-forgeability, and log host and child envelope roots separately without exposing provider locators or handles.

E2E ROUTE OBLIGATION MANIFEST GATE (CONTROLLING). Every leaf owns one exact ordered route-obligation manifest rather than a lossy leaf-wide binary. Each applicable obligation appears exactly once with `LeafCloseRouteObligationKindV1`: 1 `LocalInProcess`, 2 `ExecutionOwned`, 3 `ContributionOnly`, or 4 `Inapplicable`; zero and unknown refuse. A LocalInProcess row binds the real public in-process entry point, immutable cell oracle, budgets, expected partitions, detailed-log schema/root, source closure, and no-mock no-authority boundary. An ExecutionOwned row binds one literal release driver, POSIX wrapper where applicable, direct native-Windows driver or PowerShell wrapper as frozen by the owner contract, immutable case-manifest path/root, exact close argv, release-artifact identity, platform/provider matrix, declared capability profile, runtime evidence-envelope contract, retained relative artifacts, and complete detailed-log root. A ContributionOnly row binds one immutable result-free payload and Deferred envelope to exactly one downstream execution owner plus its literal driver, script/native route, manifest, observer contract, budgets, expected partitions, logging schema, source/build roots, and no-claim; it cannot report downstream execution passed. An Inapplicable row binds one registered reason, owner, scope, prerequisite, and no-claim. The derived leaf class is exactly `LocalOnly`, `ExecutionOnly`, `ContributionOnly`, or `Mixed`; multiple obligations and multiple contribution rows are legal and must remain distinct. Missing, extra, duplicate, reordered, generic, ambiguous, rollup-owned, stale, remapped, wrong-script, unconsumed, multiply consumed, debug, ambient/PATH-resolved/alternate/unregistered Cargo-run, hidden-skip, contribution-as-execution, or inferred leaf-class routes refuse. A specifically registered source-closed focused probe is legal only when its owner Bead names it and remains separately labeled non-closing evidence. Unit/exact-set, property/model, mutation, API/compile-fail, no-mock in-process or release-built E2E/contribution, deterministic detailed-log/redaction, structured-reproduction, resume/shard, overflow, and source-closure tests cover empty, one, maximum, mixed, duplicate, reorder, route substitution, owner remap, and every row-kind/derived-class transition. Focused/unit proof cannot substitute for a required release-built row or immutable contribution contract.

BASE AC54 RELEASE-ROUTE CONSUMPTION (CONTROLLING). This leaf is the exact execution owner for e2e-evidence-verifier-v2-driver with scripts/ci/e2e_evidence_verifier_v2.sh, scripts/ci/e2e_evidence_verifier_v2.ps1, and scripts/ci/manifests/evidence_verifier_v2_cases.v1.json. It exact-set consumes every eligible Runner-base contribution row once and validates the immutable route owner, driver, native wrapper or companion, manifest path and root, source/build/schema/log roots, expected partitions, budgets, and no-claim before execution. Each consumed row preserves declaration-side five_explicits_declaration_root, numeric_inputs_root, numeric_grants_root, expected_numeric_observations_root, seed_requirement_root, budget_set_root, version_requirements_root, and capability_contract_root. The declared expected-observation component is not an observed result. `actual_numeric_observations_root`, `observed_versions_root`, and `observed_capability_sets_root` are present only when the owner disposition is `Observed` and are derived solely from this verified release execution; `NotObserved`, `Deferred`, and `Inapplicable` bind exact typed absence or reason and never fabricate complete roots; they cannot be copied from declarations, expectations, owners, route facts, or budgets. FixedManifest and InvocationDerived seeds retain exact manifest or invocation/case/registered-domain/generator/minimizer provenance, and NoRandomness retains its registered inapplicability. Detailed events, the complete reserve-before-detail LogBudgetExceeded terminal, reproduction, shard/resume rows, aggregate, and retained report exact-join all applicable roots without forbidden-value echo. Unit/boundary/property/model/mutation/API/compile-fail/native no-mock E2E/logging/source-closure tests reject missing, extra, duplicate, reordered, stale, remapped, wrong-route, wrong-unit, wrong-width, cross-role, declaration-as-observation, wrong-seed-provenance, mixed-snapshot, hidden-skip, multiply consumed, and contribution-only Pass evidence. A contribution manifest, focused check, source closure, or DSR status cannot substitute for the distinct release-route result, and none of those proof states upgrades scientific or admission authority.

BASE AC56 CAPABILITY-PROFILE CONSUMPTION (CONTROLLING). This execution owner consumes the exact capability profile fs-evidence-runner.close-capability.release-verification.v1 for external-e2e:verifier-v2.
