title: Runner V2 phase 4: contained execution, replay/migration, release fixtures, and exact receipt
description:
Phase-4 closeout rollup for pinned executable binding, provider-neutral and native platform containment, durable Run/Negative process E2E, integrity-first artifact replay and explicit migration adapters, exact publication discovery/accounting, seven bounded release fixture families, the early result-free specification corpus, and the final non-scientific CanonicalEvidenceRunnerV2Receipt.

This rollup is plan-space coordination only. It implements no process primitive, adapter, fixture, lifecycle, publication backend, corpus row/generator, receipt constructor, test cell, or authority. Its children preserve every prior feature while separating responsibilities into independently testable work.

## Acceptance Criteria

The dedicated Acceptance Criteria field is the canonical phase gate. All 26 implementation leaves and five nested rollups must close on exact current roots with comprehensive retained unit/property/model/race/mutation/fuzz/API/compile-fail/fault/resource/cancellation tests, release-built no-mock E2E or immutable contributions, independent replay, deterministic detailed logs/redaction, source closure, and proof/authority separation.

## Success Criteria

All 26 implementation leaves and all five nested rollups satisfy their dedicated close gates on exact current roots; Runner conformance, platform/provider support, publication durability, replay/migration, scientific-family proof, DSR, and admission remain separately reported.
design:
Phase 4 contains 26 implementation leaves and five nested coordination rollups beneath this phase gate. Rollup 24.4.1 aggregates pinned binding/resolution (24.4.1.1), the four-leaf platform-containment rollup (24.4.1.2), production controller/publication/transport/progress runtime (24.4.1.3), and canonical release harness/native driver/shards/full process E2E (24.4.1.4). Rollup 24.4.2 aggregates source discovery/current-wire support (24.4.2.1), adapter migration/rollback (24.4.2.2), and source-independent replay/publication/full replay E2E (24.4.2.3). Rollup 24.4.3 aggregates the eight-leaf result-free seven-fixture specification/source-closure and corpus-generator rollup (24.4.3.9), seven bounded `publish = false` release fixtures (24.4.3.1-.7), and the sole CanonicalEvidenceRunnerV2Receipt join (24.4.3.8). All five nested rollups own coordination only.

The 24.4.1 children preserve manifest-pinned executable identity; verification-to-exec closure; deterministic process control; bounded pipes; stop/drain/finalize/quiescence; destination-bound durable Run/Negative publication; and exact Linux cgroup-v2/pidfd, Windows Job/handle/flush, and macOS provider-or-pre-spawn-Unsupported matrices with ranked registered-provider then supported-Linux/Windows-worker repair. A pinned asupersync safe API is preferred only when its exact guarantees are proven; otherwise minimal Linux/Windows raw OS interfaces are isolated in audited leaves with unsafe denied elsewhere. Replay remains grammar/negative availability there. The 24.4.2 children exclusively own successful artifact-only replay; exact migration schema consumption; integrity-first exact-one source discovery; real contained adapters; immutable originals; rollback; portable non-authoritative `InputResourceAcquisitionObservationV1`, transitive verification of historical source-receipt published-output bindings, authoritative current-output `DestinationResourceBindingV1`; the exact output `PublicationSelectionV2`; all six protocol/mode cells; whole-publication accounting; and full source-independent replay.

The fixture leaves use family IDs 61697..61703 and exact namespaces `family.runner_fixture.sparse-invocation`, `family.runner_fixture.performance-ratio`, `family.runner_fixture.statistical-campaign`, `family.runner_fixture.theorem-certificate`, `family.runner_fixture.ledger-durability`, `family.runner_fixture.portfolio-activation`, and `family.runner_fixture.vertical-product`, each with separate family_version 1. Every serialized family-owned ID is fully qualified below its namespace. Each leaf freezes modes/cases/Negative IDs, artifacts, executable identity, roots, schemas, tests, and a no-scientific/no-admission boundary. The vertical-product fixture also emits exactly one required ordinary inventory artifact for the fully namespaced Runner-producer binding-catalog declaration; it is bound transitively by ArtifactInventoryRoot and adds neither a BundleManifest field nor a seventh system object. These release fixtures prove shared Runner mechanics only and never claim production-family adoption or authority.

Schema ownership remains nonrecursive: `RunnerSpecV2` binds base/family schemas only; the separately rooted `RunnerPhase1SchemaOwnershipRegistryV2` is owned by 24.1.3.2; exact `RunnerPhase2SchemaOwnershipManifestV2`, `RunnerPhase3SchemaOwnershipManifestV2`, and `RunnerPhase4SchemaOwnershipManifestV2` each contain only their phase-owned rows; and the receipt independently joins their roots in fixed phase order after the phase-1 registry. No later descriptor is inserted into RunnerSpec and no monolithic artifact-schema root feeds back.

24.4.3.8 privately constructs the exact 51-field receipt after independent exact-set equality across commands, process/platform/publication/migration cells, the seven fixtures, mutations, artifacts, nine-field `PublicationAccountingV1`, the planned/key/intent/pre-seal/durable-identity publication DAG, replay, and source closure. Receipt fields consume prerequisite fixture/process/replay publications only. The final conformance bundle, its lifecycle/accounting/inventory/manifest/intent/seal/published receipt, and outer durable result are constructed afterward and excluded from receipt inputs, preventing receipt/publication self-cycles. The receipt is descriptive conformance evidence, never scientific or rjoq authority.

The frozen CLI uses explicit publication protocol and destination mode, tagged capability refs, and `--bundle-rel`; raw paths/handles/credentials and retired aliases refuse. List emits one `RunnerCatalogV2`. Check/SelfTest emit exact ten-field `LifecycleOnlyCommandResultV2`: API/wire, command, invocation root, run ID, lifecycle document, lifecycle-log root, run-terminal root, authority root, and no-claim. Durable commands emit exact twelve-field `DurableCommandResultV2`: the shared eight-field prefix through run-terminal root, complete `PublishedBundleReceiptV2`, receipt root, authority root, and no-claim. No result serializes result_root or duplicates manifest/seal roots; frame roots are computed beside bytes. The receipt is never a lifecycle row.

Replay preserves source durable command, immutable case manifests, claim modes, and expected comparison/effect frames, including Negative mismatch/error. Only newly authored positive Run fixtures require Match/Match. Replay never rewrites source semantics or invokes source/tracker/producer/admission code; source discovery never substitutes for the upstream replay-support binding.

A live read-only input is represented only by bounded non-authoritative `InputResourceAcquisitionObservationV1` covering policy, profile, freshness, optional generation, pinned read, and TOCTOU; it is excluded from Invocation, Run, lineage, manifest, publication, result, and canonical receipt identity. A byte-identical source bundle copied to another input resource preserves replay and output identities; mid-read substitution or changed bytes refuses. The source receipt's historical published-output binding remains transitively verified. Only the current output `DestinationResourceBindingRootV1` enters PublicationKey, PublicationIntent, DurablePublicationIdentity, final commit, PublishedBundleReceipt, and recovery. The final receipt exact set contains prerequisite published-output bindings, including historical source-receipt bindings, never current input acquisitions.

The complete exact 18-field `RunnerBudgetsV2` root/order remains authoritative. Fields 11-15 are only the publication-accounting grant subsequence. Exact nine-field `PublicationAccountingV1` records lifecycle bytes; artifact encoded/stored/expanded bytes; system/whole stored bytes; and artifact/system/total object counts. It covers exact six-object `BundleLayoutV1`, 64/65/64 and 512/513/512 MiB artifact caps, 8,388,608-byte system cap, exact 76,546,048/546,308,096-byte whole caps, backend equations, and checked overflow. Command-result semantic-payload length, fixed six-field transport-header length, and checked full-frame total stay outside accounting and identity: payload and total are separately preflighted and reproduced after receipt construction, command_result_stdout_bytes caps the full frame, and the typed transport context root is independently matched. Lengths and delivery outcomes remain non-authoritative observations, never receipt inputs.

Lifecycle reconciliation requires `CaseTerminalBasisV2`, `CaseExecutionPhase`-controlled raw outcome presence, and one identical closed `RunOutcomeBasisRootV2` in RunSummary and RunTerminal. `LifecycleDocumentV2` is record_count plus ordered records; clean EOF is complete outer-frame exhaustion plus finalized-writer typestate, never a serialized field. Self-roots, placeholders, post-hoc patching, trailing frames, and divergent bases refuse.

Capability suffixes use canonical unsigned decimal: Posix through 2147483647 and Windows/ContentStore through 4294967295. Numeric slots and physical locators are nonsemantic and absent from logs. Reproduction output provides capability placeholders, exact semantic arguments/roots/seeds, and fresh-capability acquisition steps.

## Phase-4 native and E2E ownership

The canonical delivery suite has one thin POSIX `.sh` coordinator and one source-closed native companion driver invoked directly on Windows; it does not own or require a duplicate `.ps1`. Suites elsewhere retain `.ps1` only where their own leaf freezes that route. The result-free corpus-generation E2E belongs solely to 24.4.3.9.8, is exact-set reconciled by 24.4.3.9, owns the thin POSIX `scripts/ci/e2e_runner_v2_fixture_corpus.sh` coordinator plus direct native `runner-v2-fixture-corpus-e2e-driver` invocation on Windows, and may close after phase 1 without running a family executable, publisher, replay, verifier, or receipt join. The later canonical delivery suite consumes the immutable seven-row corpus and proves seven distinct context-bound executions. Both programs use exact retained DSR release artifact identity, deterministic stable cells, no mocks, detailed bounded logs, and separately nonzero positive and expected-refusal coverage; neither can substitute for the other.

## Final phase-4 release evaluator gate

Phase 4 joins contained execution, replay/migration, seven vertical fixtures, and the canonical receipt only after release-built journeys preserve and independently verify the final evaluator and paired-artifact provenance chain. The CanonicalRunnerV2 contribution is consumed once by its sole script owner; replay contributes rows without re-owning the script; fixture/receipt aggregation cannot collapse context roots into visible tags or terminal summaries.

description:
Coordinate Runner V2 executable resolution, provider-neutral and native platform containment, deterministic process-controller integration, and the canonical release harness through four direct children. Three direct children are implementation leaves: 24.4.1.1 owns pinned binding/resolution and source/build race proof; 24.4.1.3 owns the production controller, durable publication/result-transport integration, exit mapping, progress emitter, focused logs, and result-free contribution rows; and 24.4.1.4 owns the canonical script/native driver, retained release-artifact verification, deterministic shards/resume/aggregation, canonical harness logs, and full release-built no-mock process E2E. Direct child 24.4.1.2 is an exact-set rollup over provider-neutral, Linux, Windows/bootstrap, and macOS leaves.

This rollup implements no behavior, nominal schema, raw platform primitive, replay service, test cell, scientific claim, or admission authority.

## Acceptance Criteria

All four direct children and all four platform grandchildren close on exact roots and proof categories; this rollup reconciles their nonoverlap and combined coverage only.

## Success Criteria

Seven implementation leaves and the nested platform rollup satisfy their exact close gates; this rollup reconciles resolver, platform/provider, controller, and canonical-harness evidence without implementing competing behavior or collapsing focused, platform, full-process, DSR, replay, or scientific proof states.
design:
The decomposition is deliberately acyclic and parallelizable. 24.4.1.1 consumes frozen binding/spec ownership and returns one opaque affine verified executable token. Platform child 24.4.1.2.1 consumes that token interface plus registry/spec roots and freezes the neutral facade; Linux 24.4.1.2.2 and Windows/bootstrap 24.4.1.2.3 then proceed in parallel with macOS 24.4.1.2.4 after the facade, and 24.4.1.2 exact-set joins all four. Linux and Windows use pinned safe APIs when sufficient and otherwise their sole optional audited raw leaves; macOS remains provider-backed or pre-spawn Unsupported. 24.4.1.3 blocks on exact parser/transport/lifecycle/publication plus resolver/platform-rollup roots and solely owns the production controller. 24.4.1.4 blocks on the controller plus mutation/verifier prerequisites and solely owns the canonical script/native driver, DSR release-artifact binding, shards/resume/aggregation, logs/source closure, and full release-built no-mock process E2E.

Each implementation leaf contributes only its own exact schema, constructor, and owner rows; platform rollup 24.4.1.2 exact-set forwards the disjoint four-leaf union without owning a row to `RunnerPhase4SchemaOwnershipManifestV2`. The rollup checks the union for exact one-owner equality against the phase-4 manifest. No row enters the base/family-only RunnerSpec, the 24.1.3.2-owned phase-1 registry, or another phase manifest.

The combined contract preserves every prior feature: manifest-pinned executable identity and no PATH/shell reopening; verification-to-exec closure; Linux cgroup-v2/pidfd containment; Windows Job/handle/flush containment; macOS provider matrix and honest Unsupported; unsafe denied outside minimal audited leaves; deterministic StopKey request/drain/finalize/quiescence; bounded pipes/resources; complete frozen CLI; exact lifecycle and outer results; all eighteen budgets; exact destination-resource binding; six-object/nine-accounting publication; acyclic intent/seal/receipt chain; source closure; independent verification; full release E2E; mutation; and bounded reproduction logs.

This rollup carries no broad phase blockers. Exact upstream prerequisites live on the implementation leaves, and 24.4.2.2 depends on this rollup so migration-adapter execution cannot start before all process children close.

## Final contained-process evaluator gate

The executable-resolution, containment, and controller children join only after the canonical script exact-set consumes the CanonicalRunnerV2 evaluator contribution and reproduces the full Presented/validated/registry/requirements/context/outcome/artifact chain release-built. Process stop/drain/publication behavior cannot mask an evaluator mismatch, skipped Effect lane, missing validated root, or cross-context artifact substitution.


## Release-artifact, native process, and public-ingress reconciliation

The joined product is the exact Cargo package `fs-evidence-runner`, exact release binary `canonical-evidence-runner-v2`, exact release profile, executable-content root, and exact DSR artifact-manifest identity. The controller consumes the verified executable token from 24.4.1.1 and the launch/bootstrap plus platform provider contracts from 24.4.1.2; it cannot reopen by PATH, silently substitute a debug binary, or guess a sibling artifact. It separately verifies the exact fourteen-field RunnerVersionDocumentV1 order—document schema, tool name, package SemVer, CLI grammar, API generation, wire version, implementation schema ID, source/build/toolchain identities, target, feature set, build profile, and no-claim—against corresponding artifact-manifest facts. Package ID, binary target ID, content root, and locator stay artifact-manifest fields, not version-document additions.

`NativeArgvIngressV1` preserves POSIX argument bytes and Windows UTF-16 code units without lossy conversion; the canonical parser owns explicit UTF-8 and surrogate refusal. `NativeInterruptIngressV1` maps SIGINT/SIGTERM and CTRL_C/CTRL_BREAK into the existing StopKey request/drain/finalize/quiescence state machine, while broken output channels remain delivery faults. Handlers perform only async-safe bounded notification and never allocate, lock, log, publish, or construct authority. Uncontrolled console close, logoff, shutdown, kill, host failure, or forced process death remains an explicit no-claim boundary handled only by durable recovery.

`NativeDeadlineObservationV1` uses monotonic observation at named logical checkpoints. For a fixed accepted logical stop observation the terminal result is deterministic; actual wall-time selection of that checkpoint is environmental and is not bit-stable across runs. `NativeProcessExitObservationV1` preserves the full native exit/signal/exception/forced-termination class and width, and only controlled project-owned outcomes map to ProofExit. Windows inherited handles are provisioned into the bootstrap table before the child resumes; POSIX inherited descriptors obey the same no-ambient-reopen rule.

24.4.1.4's one release-built driver, `canonical-evidence-runner-v2-e2e-driver`, owns the cross-platform process matrix. POSIX scripts are thin coordination wrappers; Windows invokes the native driver directly. `RunnerCanonicalE2EShardPlanV1` exact-set partitions stable cells with explicit logical-work, memory, process, artifact, stdout/stderr, log, and environmental-deadline budgets; resume and aggregation bind exact version, release artifact, source, build, target, feature, schema, provider, cell, and contribution roots.

title: Runner V2 pinned executable binding, affine resolver, and source/build race proof
description:
Implement the exact pinned executable-binding and resolver boundary for Runner V2. This leaf freezes the nominal binding surface, resolves one manifest-declared release executable under an affine capability, proves source/build/content closure and verification-to-exec race resistance, and returns only an opaque validated execution token to later platform/controller leaves.

It owns no OS process creation, containment, lifecycle controller, publication, replay, migration, scientific claim, or admission authority.

## Acceptance Criteria

The dedicated Acceptance Criteria field is the canonical close gate. It requires literal schema and path oracles, unit/boundary/property/mutation/compile-fail coverage, real release-bundle resolution tests, source/build closure tests, deterministic bounded logs, and an explicit no-authority boundary.
design:
This leaf consumes the frozen base/family Runner V2 types and owns the private semantic resolver plus sealed constructor for `ExecutableBindingV2`; it does not mint an alternate wire type. The exact domain is `org.frankensim.fs-evidence-runner.executable-binding.v1`, with ordered fields executable_id, executable_role, package_id, binary_name, release_profile_id, target_triple, feature_set_root, source_closure_root, build_provenance_root, executable_content_root, release_bundle_root, executable_rel, capability_policy_root, granted_capabilities, environment_allowlist_root, working_directory_policy, argv_schema_root, containment_profile_id, and no_claim_scope.

Resolution is manifest-driven and capability-scoped. It never searches PATH, invokes a shell, accepts an absolute executable path, follows an unpinned symlink/junction/reparse target, inherits ambient environment or handles, or substitutes a same-name binary. It validates the canonical relative path; package, binary, profile, target, and features; immutable release-bundle identity; source/build/content roots; executable role; argv schema; environment allowlist; working-directory policy; and least-privilege grants before returning a token.

The safe output is an opaque affine `VerifiedExecutableTokenV1` internal to phase 4. It binds the acquired object identity, immutable measured identity, binding root, acquisition policy, verification generation, and platform handoff contract without serializing a host path, descriptor, handle, pointer, slot, or credential. It can be consumed exactly once by the platform boundary. The token cannot be cloned, forged, downgraded, converted to a raw executable locator, or reused after any freshness-affecting event.

Verification-to-exec closure is explicit. The resolver either acquires the same immutable object that was measured and hands that already acquired identity to neutral-facade child 24.4.1.2.1 and controller 24.4.1.3, with native provider children 24.4.1.2.2-.4 checked through rollup 24.4.1.2, or it refuses. It does not validate one pathname and later reopen another. Each supported platform profile must prove how the exact neutral facade and native provider child consume this token without a name-based gap; Unsupported is required when that proof cannot be made.

`SourceClosureV2` is narrow to all transitive resolver/binding inputs: Rust source, build scripts, manifests, target/features, release-bundle inventory, binding registry, schema/policy/capability code, generated tables, and relevant constellation rows. Family fixture sources and unrelated workspace files remain outside. Every exact schema, constructor, and owner row from this leaf appears once in `RunnerPhase4SchemaOwnershipManifestV2`; nothing enters `RunnerSpecV2`, `RunnerPhase1SchemaOwnershipRegistryV2`, or another phase manifest.

Canonical diagnostics and logs contain logical binding/package/binary/profile/target/features/role/content/source/build/bundle/policy roots, decision stage, exact refusal, retryability, no-claim, and the first failure. They exclude raw paths, descriptors, handles, slots, pointers, credentials, environment values, wall time, scheduler noise, and bulk file bytes. Reproduction uses a logical release-bundle capability placeholder and fresh-acquisition steps, never a live locator.

## Operator repair contract

Every user-visible Refused or Unsupported outcome owned or contributed by this leaf, and every unexpected divergence while executing a Negative case, carries exactly one bounded `ActionableDiagnosticV2` selected from the sealed diagnostic table. The diagnostic binds its registered code, precise redacted typed expected/observed values, owning component, retryability, exact prerequisites, no-claim scope, and one or more uniquely ranked `RepairActionV2` values within the upstream per-action, per-diagnostic, stderr, and count bounds. Repairs are deterministic declarative data for a human or orchestrator to consider; they may not contain or execute shell commands, callbacks, scripts, credentials, raw capability references, physical paths, live handles, provider payloads, or automatic mutations. Unsupported repairs name the missing platform/provider/capability prerequisite and a safe verification step; Refused repairs name the smallest semantic input or policy correction; Negative-case repairs distinguish an intentionally matched negative expectation, which remains Pass and is never mislabeled as a defect, from an unexpected key/precontext/detail/lane/result divergence that requires correction.

FOCUSED E2E ROUTE (CONTROLLING). The sole focused route is release binary `runner-v2-executable-resolver-e2e-driver`; POSIX coordination, when used, is only `scripts/ci/e2e_runner_v2_executable_resolver.sh`, while native Windows invokes the same driver directly. The driver is the sole semantic cell owner for this focused route; any coordinator is thin and owns no test cell, schema, oracle, or authority.
acceptance_criteria:
1. A handwritten literal oracle asserts the exact `ExecutableBindingV2` domain, all nineteen ordered fields, nominal root roles, widths, token grammar, executable roles, capability sets, environment allowlist, working-directory policy, containment profile, and no-claim scope. Delete, duplicate, reorder, rename, unknown/trailing, wrong-domain/version/width, raw-digest, role-coercion, and cross-binding substitutions fail. The shared exact-set token-length oracle enumerates all phase-4 declared `StableTokenV2` values, proves the maximum declared fixture ID length is 90 bytes within the widened 128-byte cap, accepts 127 and exact 128 bytes, and refuses one-over 129 bytes before construction. `StableTokenV2` length is measured over lowercase ASCII bytes: exact-set oracles reject uppercase, non-ASCII, Unicode normalization variants, confusable spellings, and invalid separators; independently verify the existing maximum declared fixture ID is 90 bytes <= 128; and reject 129 bytes.

2. Constructor/API/compile-fail tests prove all fields and direct constructors private and only the sealed resolver constructive. Default, struct literal, unchecked From/TryFrom, serde authority construction, post-validation mutation, raw-path/handle conversion, token Clone/Copy, role or digest coercion, and scientific/admission conversion are impossible; read-only accessors remain usable.

3. Resolver unit and boundary tests cover zero, one, and many manifest matches; wrong package/binary/profile/target/features; missing/extra manifest row; content/source/build/release-bundle root mismatch; wrong role/argv/environment/workdir/containment profile; missing or wider capabilities; stale inventory; permissions; and one-below/exact/one-over every bound. Exactly one pinned row and acquired object identity can resolve.

4. Canonical relative-path tests cover empty, one-segment, maximum segments/bytes, dot, dot-dot, absolute, drive-prefixed, UNC, forward/backslash, repeated separator, NUL, Unicode normalization, reserved component, and case-fold collision inputs. No host path or presentation alias enters semantic identity.

5. Verification-to-exec race tests replace, relink, rename, truncate, chmod, mutate, or swap the named executable at every barrier between lookup, acquisition, hashing, validation, handoff, and later consumption. Success always consumes the already acquired or immutably pinned measured object; otherwise resolution refuses before user code.

6. `VerifiedExecutableTokenV1` typestate tests prove one producer, one consumer, no clone, no reopen-by-name, exact binding-root match, exact freshness generation, deterministic close-on-drop for an unconsumed token, and no raw capability escape. Model tests cover resolve/cancel/fail/handoff/consume/close interleavings and establish close exactly once.

7. Capability and environment tests deny PATH/shell lookup, ambient cwd, undeclared environment variables, inherited descriptors/handles, network, nested spawn, and widened roots. Only the exact allowlist and working-directory policy are conveyed as data to the later controller.

8. Source/build closure properties mutate each transitive resolver source, schema, policy, capability provider, build script, manifest, generated binding table, target/features setting, release inventory, and relevant constellation row and require root movement or staleness. Fixture-family and unrelated workspace changes outside the declared closure do not stale the resolver proof.

9. Determinism and metamorphic tests permute manifest input order, host checkout root, numeric acquisition slot, filesystem enumeration order, and nonsemantic diagnostics while preserving semantic inputs. The binding and token roots remain identical. Changing any semantic binding, acquired resource, policy, source, build, target, features, or release identity moves the owning root.

10. Seeded mutants trust PATH, reopen by name, follow a replaced symlink/reparse target, skip one root or policy check, allow multiple matches, widen environment/capabilities, serialize a locator, clone a token, reuse a stale token, or accept a same-name different executable. Each mutant is executed and killed by a retained minimal fixture; zero-denominator or unexecuted mutation results cannot close the bead.

11. Release-built no-mock E2E resolves real fixture executables from an immutable release bundle through public resolver APIs, covers success and every exact refusal class, and hands the opaque token to a test consumer without spawning it. It uses no shell, PATH, mock manifest, production-family claim, or hidden fallback.

12. Exact `RunnerPhase4SchemaOwnershipManifestV2` tests include this leaf's schema, constructor, and owner rows once and reject insertion into `RunnerSpecV2`, `RunnerPhase1SchemaOwnershipRegistryV2`, or another phase manifest. Literal, unit, boundary, property/metamorphic, model, mutation, compile-fail, race, source-closure, release E2E, and logging categories expose nonzero checked counts and retained roots. Focused resolver proof, platform proof, full process E2E, DSR, replay, and family science remain separate statuses. Exact result accounting reports distinct exact ID sets and checked counts for eligible and matched positives; eligible and matched expected refusals; eligible and matched expected failures; eligible and matched mutations; typed Unsupported and inapplicable cells with exact matched reasons; unexpected mismatches; execution failures; and unexplained skips. Closure requires every eligible stable ID exactly once, nonzero applicable positive and adversarial corpora, equality within every eligible and matched subpartition, exact reason equality, and zero unexpected mismatches, execution failures, or unexplained skips.

13. Bounded canonical logs retain the exact semantic binding/source/build/content/bundle/policy roots, target/features, resolver transition, outcome, diagnostic, retryability, no-claim, and first failure. Reproduction templates use capability placeholders plus exact semantic roots and fresh-acquisition steps. Logs exclude secrets, host locators, descriptors/handles/slots/pointers, raw environment values, wall time, scheduler noise, and executable bytes.

14. Operator-repair UX proof exact-sets every user-visible Refused and Unsupported path plus every matched and divergent Negative path against the sealed diagnostic table. Literal, unit, boundary, property/model, mutation, API/compile-fail, release-built no-mock E2E contribution, deterministic detailed-log, coverage, and source-closure tests separately exercise diagnostic size/count exact/one-over limits; stable rank and tie-breaking; owner/retryability/prerequisite/no-claim accuracy; redacted expected/observed values; safe non-executable repairs; and expected-Negative Pass semantics. Missing, extra, duplicate, unranked, unstable, executable, secret-bearing, raw-path/capability/handle/provider-bearing, wrong-owner, wrong-prerequisite, authority-widening, or auto-applied repair data fails. Logs retain diagnostic/root/code/rank and symbolic safe verification steps without sensitive payloads, and exact result partitions require matched positives and expected refusals, typed Unsupported, and zero unexpected mismatches or unexplained skips.

15. GLOBAL REALITY-CHECK CLOSE-MANIFEST RECONCILIATION (CONTROLLING). Earlier `eligible`/`passed`/`failed` shorthand and any single collapsed `matched expected refusals` counter are compatibility-only and cannot close this leaf. The leaf must expose one result-free, source-authoritative, full-set-only close manifest that exact-sets every stable test and E2E cell into all nine preserved category groups: literal/unit/boundary; property/metamorphic; state/typestate/model/race; mutation/fuzz; API/compile-fail/trait; fault/resource/cancellation; release-built no-mock E2E or immutable E2E contribution; detailed deterministic logging/redaction; and source closure. Each applicable category and each applicable slash-separated facet has a separately nonzero corpus. A genuinely inapplicable facet requires a registered typed reason with stable code/name, exact owner, execution scope, prerequisite, and no-claim text; it cannot hide an eligible cell.

Result accounting retains distinct counters and exact ID sets for: eligible positives and matched positives; eligible expected refusals and matched expected refusals; eligible expected failures and matched expected failures; eligible mutations and matched mutations; typed Unsupported cells with exact matched reasons; typed inapplicable cells with exact matched registered reasons; unexpected mismatches; execution failures; and unexplained skips. It also reports checked aggregate adversarial totals as the sums of the three adversarial subpartitions without replacing them. Green requires each matched subpartition to equal its own eligible subpartition, every eligible stable ID exactly once in canonical order, nonzero applicable positive and adversarial corpora, exact Unsupported/inapplicable reason equality, and zero unexpected mismatches, execution failures, and unexplained skips. An expected failure is never an execution failure, a mutation is never relabeled as a refusal, and an empty/subset selection can never be green. Missing, extra, duplicate, reordered, stale, reclassified, wrong-reason, or wrong-scope manifest/result rows refuse structurally.

Where this leaf owns execution, comprehensive unit/integration/property/model/race/fault/mutation/API tests and the named E2E script run release-built with no mocks. Where execution belongs downstream, this leaf instead emits immutable stable rows binding independent literal expectations/oracles, semantic inputs, explicit time/memory/work/process/artifact/log budgets, schema and log-schema roots, source/build roots, exact downstream owner and script, and no-claim scope; it cannot report that downstream execution passed. E2E tests cover happy, boundary, expected-refusal, expected-failure, mutation, Unsupported, inapplicable, cancellation/drain, resource-return, and hidden-skip cases with deterministic stable IDs and exact first divergence.

Canonical bounded logs retain stable cell/category/facet IDs; semantic-input, source, build, schema, oracle, budget, manifest, and execution roots; ordered stage observations and terminal stage; expected/observed classification; first-divergence ID/root; resource and drain outcomes; exact result partitions; ranked non-executable repair manifest; no-claim scope; and safe relative retained-artifact references. They reject or type-redact secrets, credentials, environment values, live capabilities, raw resources/handles, absolute or physical paths, PIDs, wall clock, scheduler noise, and bulk payloads. Rejection diagnostics retain only a stable redacted data class and must not echo the sentinel through `observed`, Display, Debug, canonical bytes, logs, or reproduction text. Logging tests cover zero/one/exact/one-over limits, checked overflow, missing/extra/duplicate/reordered/truncated events, wrong roots/counts/reasons, redaction for every forbidden class, and deterministic replay.

Every user-visible Refused, Unsupported, divergent Negative, expected failure, and unexpected mismatch carries one bounded deterministic actionable diagnostic with registered code, precise redacted typed expected/observed values, owner, retryability, exact prerequisites, no-claim scope, and uniquely ranked declarative repairs. Repairs cannot contain or invoke commands, callbacks, scripts, credentials, raw capabilities/resources/handles/provider payloads, physical paths/locators, or automatic mutations. Source closure exact-sets all implementation, contract/rustdoc, schema/domain/owner tables, independent oracles, fixtures, E2E manifests/scripts or contribution rows, log schemas, dependencies/features, and build configuration on one compatible stable snapshot. Closeout reports focused proof, release-built E2E or contribution proof, source closure, DSR, and any downstream/scientific/authority proof separately and never promotes one into another.

16. CONTROLLING RELEASE-BUNDLE AND CAPABILITY INTERFACE GATE. This leaf consumes, and may not redeclare, the canonical stored/encoded/expanded artifact identities, release-bundle layout and codec contracts from frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.2.1.2 and the affine root-capability broker, rights, freshness, generation, pinned-acquisition, close-once, and redaction contracts from frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.2.2.1. Compile-fail, dependency-DAG, mutation, race, release-built no-mock E2E, detailed-log, and source-closure tests reject shadow bundle types, shadow capability types, raw-locator escape, independently reopened objects, mixed provider generations, and any resolver proof built against a different compatible-looking provider snapshot.

FOCUSED E2E ROUTE AND SOURCE-CLOSURE GATE (CONTROLLING). The sole focused route is release binary `runner-v2-executable-resolver-e2e-driver`; POSIX coordination, when used, is only `scripts/ci/e2e_runner_v2_executable_resolver.sh`, while native Windows invokes the same driver directly. The full-set close manifest, detailed deterministic log schema, and source closure bind this exact driver and coordinator tuple, release source/build/toolchain/target/exact-feature roots, every stable positive/refusal/failure/mutation/Unsupported/inapplicable cell, and retained relative evidence paths. Missing, alternate, PATH/debug, shell-only, stale, duplicated, or unrooted routes cannot close the leaf.

FIVE EXPLICITS DECLARATION, RUNTIME-EVIDENCE, AND COMPLETE-LOG GATE (CONTROLLING). Every stable literal, unit, boundary, property, metamorphic, state, typestate, model, race, mutation, fuzz, API, fault, and E2E cell binds one declaration-side Five Explicits contract: typed units for every numeric input, numeric grant, and expected numeric observation; one canonical seed declaration plus generator/minimizer version, or a registered `SeedInapplicable` code with owner, scope, prerequisite, and no-claim; seven-axis hard and soft time, memory, logical-work, process, artifact, output, and log budgets with process shape declared separately; exact API, wire, schema, source, build, toolchain, target, profile, and feature version requirements; one exact required/permitted semantic capability contract; and the exact no-claim. Runtime actual numeric observations, resolved seed provenance, budget reconciliation, observed versions, and actual required, granted, observed, returned, and revoked capability sets exist only inside disposition-gated runtime evidence. `Observed` requires complete actuals; `NotObserved` may retain only safe typed partial evidence plus its exact reason and cannot substitute expected values; `Deferred` and `Inapplicable` contain no fabricated actuals. Changing any applicable declaration or actual explicit moves exactly the intended component, cell, evidence, log, reproduction, aggregate, and report roots. Bounded log writers reserve sufficient bytes for one canonical terminal event before admitting detail events. The first event that would exceed the remaining detail budget emits one complete deterministic `LogBudgetExceeded` terminal containing the rejected event class and ordinal, digest, omitted count, applicable budget, first-divergence stage, disposition, drain/resource outcome, diagnostic owner, repair-manifest root, and no-claim. Partial JSONL, silent truncation, overwriting prior events, missing terminal state, expected-as-actual substitution, fabricated observed-empty data, or treating overflow as success refuses. Minimized reproduction evidence retains every applicable declaration and safe actual explicit without exposing a forbidden value.

E2E ROUTE OBLIGATION MANIFEST GATE (CONTROLLING). Every leaf owns one exact ordered route-obligation manifest rather than a lossy leaf-wide binary. Each applicable obligation appears exactly once with `LeafCloseRouteObligationKindV1`: 1 `LocalInProcess`, 2 `ExecutionOwned`, 3 `ContributionOnly`, or 4 `Inapplicable`; zero and unknown refuse. A LocalInProcess row binds the real public in-process entry point, immutable cell oracle, budgets, expected partitions, detailed-log schema/root, source closure, and no-mock no-authority boundary. An ExecutionOwned row binds one literal release driver, POSIX wrapper where applicable, direct native-Windows driver or PowerShell wrapper as frozen by the owner contract, immutable case-manifest path/root, exact close argv, release-artifact identity, platform/provider matrix, declared capability profile, runtime evidence-envelope contract, retained relative artifacts, and complete detailed-log root. A ContributionOnly row binds one immutable result-free payload and Deferred envelope to exactly one downstream execution owner plus its literal driver, script/native route, manifest, observer contract, budgets, expected partitions, logging schema, source/build roots, and no-claim; it cannot report downstream execution passed. An Inapplicable row binds one registered reason, owner, scope, prerequisite, and no-claim. The derived leaf class is exactly `LocalOnly`, `ExecutionOnly`, `ContributionOnly`, or `Mixed`; multiple obligations and multiple contribution rows are legal and must remain distinct. Missing, extra, duplicate, reordered, generic, ambiguous, rollup-owned, stale, remapped, wrong-script, unconsumed, multiply consumed, debug, ambient/PATH-resolved/alternate/unregistered Cargo-run, hidden-skip, contribution-as-execution, or inferred leaf-class routes refuse. A specifically registered source-closed focused probe is legal only when its owner Bead names it and remains separately labeled non-closing evidence. Unit/exact-set, property/model, mutation, API/compile-fail, no-mock in-process or release-built E2E/contribution, deterministic detailed-log/redaction, structured-reproduction, resume/shard, overflow, and source-closure tests cover empty, one, maximum, mixed, duplicate, reorder, route substitution, owner remap, and every row-kind/derived-class transition. Focused/unit proof cannot substitute for a required release-built row or immutable contribution contract.

AC57 EVIDENCE-DISPOSITION CONSUMER GATE (CONTROLLING). This leaf consumes, and MUST NOT redefine, the exact evidence-kind, RuntimeObservationDispositionV1, reason-registry, completeness, safe-partial-evidence, resource-reconciliation, EvidenceEnvelopeV1, and FirstDivergentExplicitComponentV1 contracts governed by program gate `.24.1.1.1` and base contract owner `.24.1.1.1`. Every stable local cell and every exact route-obligation row maps to one and only one legal evidence-kind/disposition pair. OwnedHarnessExecution and InProcessProjectionExecution admit only Observed or NotObserved; ImmutableDownstreamContribution admits only Deferred; ApplicabilityDeclaration admits only Inapplicable. LocalInProcess and ExecutionOwned work may close Observed only after a completed attempt supplies every applicable actual numeric-observation, observed-seed-disposition, budget-reconciliation, observed-version, observed-capability-set, execution-completeness, attempt-identity, retained-state, and resource-reconciliation root. A matched refusal, expected failure, executed Unsupported outcome, or mutation survivor/kill remains Observed when observation is complete; semantic outcome never substitutes for observation disposition.

NotObserved is fail-closed and uses exactly one registered reason: 1 execution-failed-before-completeness, 2 observation-channel-failed-before-completeness, or 3 unexpected-unstarted-or-skipped. It preserves attempt and payload identity and may preserve only a separately rooted redacted safe-partial-evidence object; it never copies expected values into actual fields, encodes missing actuals as observed-empty, claims successful execution, or permits a green aggregate. Every ContributionOnly row emits exactly one result-free upstream payload plus a distinct Deferred envelope with reason 1 immutable-contribution-awaits-designated-release-owner and the designated owner/driver/native-or-script route/manifest/observer contract; the designated owner later emits a separate execution envelope and cannot overwrite, alias, or promote the upstream envelope. Inapplicable is legal only for a predeclared exact source-registered applicability descriptor and cannot be synthesized from runtime skip, infrastructure failure, unsupported provider discovery, or missing observation.

The leaf's result, report contribution, stage evidence, runtime aggregate, detailed cell event, log context, structured reproduction, normal terminal, overflow terminal, bounded prefix, final bounded log, route contribution, and source closure exact-join the applicable declaration components, runtime disposition, and envelope root. Actual component roots are present only for Observed; every non-Observed form carries exact typed absence plus its reason/descriptor and no-claim. Comparisons use the AC57 exact twenty-position FirstDivergentExplicitComponentV1 precedence and stop at the first unequal applicable component without logging rejected raw values. Unit and literal-oracle tests cover every owned legal row; zero/unknown code and complete/partial/absent boundaries; property/model/state/typestate laws; mutation and API/compile-fail barriers; no-mock in-process or release-built owner E2E, or immutable contribution plus owner-consumption E2E; execution/observation/grant/use/return/revoke/cancellation/resource faults; deterministic step-prefixed detailed logging, redaction, structured reproduction, overflow-before-divergence, shard/resume, and one-component root movement; exact coverage partitions; and source closure. Tests MUST reject every illegal kind/disposition/reason pair, expected-as-actual, observed-empty-as-complete, payload-as-envelope, upstream-as-owner envelope, contribution-as-execution, applicability-as-skip, duplicate/missing/reordered evidence, hidden skip, forbidden-value echo, and stale or mixed-snapshot root.

AC58 SCHEMA-IMPACT CONSUMER AND MIGRATION GATE (CONTROLLING). This leaf consumes, and MUST NOT redefine, the canonical-schema migration registry and independent literal schema oracle owned by base contract owner `.24.1.1.1` under program gate `.24.1.1.1`. Its exact source-authoritative SchemaImpactManifestV1 classifies every canonical frame, nominal root, registry, manifest, log event, terminal, report, projection, contribution, route envelope, and structured-reproduction schema that this leaf owns or consumes exactly once by stable schema ID and exact u16 disposition: 1 NewV1NoPredecessor, 2 UnchangedV1, 3 MigratedV1ToV2, 4 DecodeOnlyLegacyV1, 5 RetiredV1, or 6 InapplicableNoCanonicalFrame. Each row binds API generation, wire version and wire-predecessor policy, separate canonical-schema migration policy, exact domain, magic, ordered field descriptors, nominal root role, owner, source path, authoritative/compatibility status, allowed parent/child versions, no-claim, and compatible-source-snapshot root. Zero/unknown codes and missing, extra, duplicate, reordered, owner-inferred, route-inferred, stale, or mixed-snapshot rows refuse.

Wire compatibility and canonical-schema migration are non-interchangeable. API generation 2, wire version 1, and Runner wire predecessor NoPredecessor remain separate from canonical-schema policies NoSchemaPredecessor, V1DecodeOnlyCompatibilityEvidence, and V1Retired. A new component may begin at V1 only when it has no canonical predecessor. Every enclosing schema whose field order, field meaning, canonical payload, or authority semantics changes rotates coherently to a distinct V2 type, `.v2` domain, versioned magic, field table, and V2 nominal root on the same compatible source snapshot. An unchanged V1 child is legal inside a V2 parent only when the independent oracle explicitly records that unchanged component role and exact position. Decode-only or retired V1 bytes never alias, parse as, substitute for, or close an authoritative V2 path; partial migration, V2-parent/V1-child substitution outside an allowed unchanged slot, generic ContentHash bridging, transmute-like accessors, shared domains/magics, compatibility aliases, and caller-minted roots refuse.

Every literal/unit/boundary, property/metamorphic, state/model/race, mutation/fuzz, API/compile-fail, fault/resource/cancellation, no-mock E2E or immutable-contribution, deterministic detailed-log/redaction, structured-reproduction, coverage, and source-closure fixture owned by this leaf names the authoritative schema versions and compatible snapshot. Tests freeze every V1 compatibility byte fixture before migration; exhaust exact-empty, one, exact maximum, one-over, missing/extra/duplicate/reordered rows; mutate every domain, magic, version, policy, field descriptor, nominal role, source owner, parent/child version, and snapshot; prove exact root movement and typed inspectability; reject V1/V2 and cross-role substitution, old-root-as-new-root, stale literal counts, and partial or mixed-snapshot migration; and exercise the exact release-built route or immutable contribution plus designated-owner consumption with step-prefixed logs, first explicit divergence, structured reproduction, overflow/resume, retained-relative-artifact policy, and no forbidden-value echo. title: Runner V2 platform containment rollup: neutral facade, Linux, Windows/bootstrap, and macOS matrix
description:
Reconcile the exact four-child Runner V2 platform-containment product: provider-neutral safe facade, audited Linux provider, audited Windows provider with bootstrap binding, and macOS registered-provider/Unsupported matrix.

This rollup implements no behavior, provider, native call, unsafe block, schema constructor, support decision, process lifecycle, publication, replay, migration, scientific claim, admission, or authority. It closes only when the frozen direct-child set is closed on one compatible snapshot and the children's nonoverlapping roots, ownership rows, focused native proofs or immutable contribution scope, logs, source closures, and distinct result partitions exact-join.

## Success Criteria

The dedicated Acceptance Criteria field is the authoritative exact-set rollup gate. Every direct child must close on one compatible source/build/proof snapshot with its complete test or contribution, release-built E2E, deterministic-log, result-partition, and source-closure roots; the rollup owns no implementation and cannot replace a missing child, proof class, or no-claim boundary with status, prose, or aggregate counts.
design:
CONTROLLING OWNERSHIP PROJECTION. Platform ownership is fixed: 24.4.1.2.1 owns the safe provider-neutral facade, support oracle, StableToken/native-observation contracts, affine token-consumption seam, and immutable E2E contributions; .1.2.2 owns the Linux cgroup-v2/pidfd provider, optional audited raw leaf, native driver, and focused E2E; .1.2.3 owns the Windows Job/handle/flush provider, bootstrap adapter, optional audited raw leaf, native driver, and focused E2E; .1.2.4 owns the macOS registered-provider or exact pre-spawn Unsupported matrix and native host conformance. Parent 24.4.1.2 owns only their exact-set join.

The implementation boundary is evidence-driven. A pinned asupersync safe API is used only if its documented and tested contract proves every required placement, descendant, process-identity, wait, termination, pipe, flush, and resource-return guarantee plus the actual platform ABI. Any unproved guarantee forces the platform-specific minimal audited leaf; there is no optimistic fallback.

Unsafe is denied everywhere except two named leaf modules with narrow safe facades: one Linux syscall/cgroup/pidfd leaf and one Windows Job/handle/overlapped-I/O leaf. Each freezes exact signatures, integer widths, layouts, alignment, constants, calling conventions, availability probes, pointer lifetimes, initialized-memory rules, owned/borrowed resource typestates, close-once behavior, and OS-error conversion. Every unsafe operation has a local SAFETY argument tied to executable invariants. The facades expose no raw pointer, descriptor, handle, uninitialized storage, or unchecked transition and add no external runtime dependency.

The exact platform profiles are:

- `linux-cgroup-v2-pidfd-v1`: Supported only with a delegated writable cgroup-v2 subtree and the pinned provider for `clone3(CLONE_INTO_CGROUP | CLONE_PIDFD)`, `pidfd_send_signal`, `waitid(P_PIDFD)`, `cgroup.kill`, and `cgroup.events populated=0`. The child enters atomically; descendants remain charged; pidfd identity prevents PID-reuse confusion; and terminal success requires populated=0 plus pipe/descriptor/resource return. Missing delegation, syscall, controller, provider capability, or exact ABI is Unsupported before spawn. Process-group-only fallback cannot close this cell.
- `windows-job-handle-flush-v1`: Supported only with a private Job Object using `JOB_OBJECT_LIMIT_KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE`, preflighted nested-job compatibility, `CreateProcessW(CREATE_SUSPENDED)`, assignment before resume, `PROC_THREAD_ATTRIBUTE_HANDLE_LIST`, noninheritable controller handles, bounded overlapped pipes, explicit `FlushFileBuffers`, job completion/`ActiveProcessZero`, and exact handle closure. Assignment failure kills the still-suspended child before user code. Missing nested-job, handle-list, completion, flush, provider, or exact ABI guarantees is Unsupported before user code.
- `macos-kernel-containment-v1`: Supported only through a pinned provider that proves kernel-enforced descendant membership, escape refusal, bounded termination, clean EOF, and zero descendants. Process groups, `killpg`, polling, and cooperative-child simulations are insufficient. Without the provider, every spawn-capable durable binding returns typed Unsupported before spawn with a structured, non-executable ranked repair: first install and select a registered `macos-kernel-containment-v1` provider when available; otherwise rerun on a declared Supported `linux-cgroup-v2-pidfd-v1` worker or `windows-job-handle-flush-v1` worker. The repair never recommends process groups or another weaker fallback. A future provider requires a new profile/version and complete conformance evidence.

Neutral-facade child 24.4.1.2.1 consumes one affine `VerifiedExecutableTokenV1` and one exact containment request, then returns only typed logical process, pipe, wait, stop, and quiescence handles to 24.4.1.3. Raw OS identities are diagnostic-only and never become Runner semantic identity. The controller owns logical ProcessIdV2/TaskIdV2 and StopKey semantics; child 24.4.1.2.1 freezes the provider-neutral fact contracts, while native children .1.2.2-.4 prove only the platform facts required to implement them.

Platform support is an explicit checked table containing profile, provider/API version, target, required primitive set, ABI audit root, Supported/Unsupported/Blocked result, exact pre-spawn/pre-exec boundary, diagnostic, retryability, and repair. It cannot infer support from an OS name or silently substitute a weaker primitive. Schema, constructor, provider, and ownership rows appear exactly once in `RunnerPhase4SchemaOwnershipManifestV2` and never in RunnerSpec, the phase-1 registry, or another phase manifest.

Canonical logs retain platform/profile/provider/API/ABI/source/build roots, logical operation and resource kind, support result, exact error mapping, retryability, no-claim, and first failure. They exclude raw pointers, descriptors/handles, OS PIDs, host paths, kernel addresses, secrets, wall time, scheduler noise, and bulk pipe data.

## Controlling native argv, interrupt, deadline, exit, and bootstrap-provider contract

Neutral-facade child 24.4.1.2.1 exposes the closed lossless native-observation descriptor, and native provider children .1.2.2-.4 populate platform process-boundary observations to the sole upstream parser/controller without redefining their semantic schemas. `NativeArgvIngressV1`, owned by child 24.4.1.2.1, contains an ordered vector of platform OS strings: POSIX bytes are preserved exactly; Windows UTF-16 code units are preserved exactly. No locale, active code page, shell, console, lossy replacement, Unicode normalization, or environment expansion occurs here. The upstream hostile parser alone accepts canonical UTF-8/scalar input and refuses invalid POSIX UTF-8 or unpaired Windows surrogates with a stable redacted Usage diagnostic. Raw invalid units are never logged.

`NativeInterruptIngressV1` is a private non-wire provider interface. On Linux/POSIX, supported operator requests are SIGINT and SIGTERM; SIGPIPE is suppressed for bounded result/diagnostic/progress writes and normalized to broken-channel delivery failure. On Windows, CTRL_C_EVENT and CTRL_BREAK_EVENT are supported operator requests; console close/logoff/shutdown, forced TerminateProcess, unhandled exception, and host death are uncontrolled-loss observations and cannot fabricate a canonical cancellation/result. The provider converts a supported request into one typed caller-cancellation notification carrying only source class and monotonic ingress ordinal. Handler code performs no allocation, blocking, lock acquisition, formatting, logging, capability use, or semantic construction; it uses a proved pinned safe asupersync API where sufficient or the existing named minimal Linux/Windows OS-interface leaf and safe facade. No third unsafe zone is introduced.

The controller remains the sole owner of StopKeyV2 acceptance and semantic lifecycle roots. The provider only delivers ingress observations. Duplicate/repeated/simultaneous requests are retained in stable provider order, but smallest accepted logical StopKey wins and later requests cannot rewrite the terminal. Escalation after a drain/finalize deadline follows the existing typed timeout/quiescence rules; a second Ctrl-C cannot bypass drain, convert an unproved kill into Cancelled, or leak descendants. Handler installation, handoff, disable, restoration, and provider-resource return are explicit typestate transitions completed on every exit.

`NativeDeadlineObservationV1` reads a proved monotonic source only at controller-declared logical checkpoints. Elapsed wall time and scheduling are environmental observations, not deterministic semantic inputs and never enter Invocation/Run identity or canonical logs. The provider returns only elapsed/not-elapsed plus checkpoint and budget identity to the controller; a different first elapsed checkpoint may legitimately produce a different StopKey and lifecycle root. No bit-stability claim spans different observed checkpoints.

`NativeProcessExitObservationV1` preserves the full platform termination class and width: controlled Runner exit code, POSIX signal termination, Windows unsigned 32-bit exit/exception status, or provider loss. Only controlled codes project through the upstream exact ProofExit table. No truncation, modulo-256 assumption on Windows, signedness coercion, shell status, signal-number-to-ProofExit conversion, or exception-to-InternalError fabrication is allowed. Uncontrolled termination has no canonical result/authority claim.

Windows child 24.4.1.2.3 also consumes the exact 24.2.2.1 bootstrap contract: its explicit inherited handle list and duplicate-rejected slot table are fixed before resume, controller/bootstrap handles are noninheritable unless listed, and wrong/missing/substituted entries kill the still-suspended child before user code. Child 24.4.1.2.2 owns the native Linux driver, child .1.2.3 owns the direct native Windows driver with no POSIX-shell prerequisite, and child .1.2.4 owns macOS provider-backed or exact pre-spawn Unsupported conformance; these ingress additions do not weaken containment or promote process groups.

DECOMPOSITION AND OWNERSHIP ADDENDUM (CONTROLLING). The direct child set is frozen in canonical order as 24.4.1.2.1 provider-neutral safe facade, 24.4.1.2.2 Linux cgroup-v2/pidfd provider, 24.4.1.2.3 Windows Job/handle/flush provider plus bootstrap binding, and 24.4.1.2.4 macOS registered-provider/Unsupported matrix. The facade freezes neutral ownership and immutable contribution rows. Linux and Windows consume it and the relevant 24.2.2.1 launch/bootstrap contracts in parallel without redeclaring either. macOS consumes the neutral facade and proves either a real registered provider or honest pre-spawn Unsupported. The parent then exact-set joins all four.

All prior implementation prose in this issue remains a controlling feature-preservation and reconciliation specification assigned to the exact child owners; it does not make the rollup an implementation owner. The parent owns no schema row. The child union must equal the exact platform-containment slice of RunnerPhase4SchemaOwnershipManifestV2: neutral descriptors once, Linux profile/ABI rows once, Windows profile/ABI/bootstrap-adapter rows once, and macOS provider/support/repair rows once.

The process-containment unsafe union is exactly the optional Linux raw leaf and optional Windows raw leaf, each selected only when the pinned safe API is insufficient. That union remains distinct from 24.2.2.1's capability/durability primitive boundary; neither child may duplicate those primitives. Focused provider evidence remains distinct from 24.4.1.4's canonical full Runner process E2E and cannot infer downstream canonical execution.
