Process-group-only, `killpg`, polling, or cooperative simulations cannot mark Supported. Literal diagnostics assert the exact ranked structured repair: registered macOS provider first when available, otherwise a declared Supported Linux cgroup-v2/pidfd worker or Windows Job worker; the repair is data, not an executable command, and contains no process-group fallback.

11. Safe-facade typestate/model tests explore acquire, consume-token, create, attach, resume, read/write, stop, wait, drain, quiesce, close, cancellation, panic, and provider-loss interleavings. Every OS object has one owner and one terminal close; no success is observable before descendant/resource quiescence and clean pipe completion.

12. Fault/resource tests inject every provider load/version check, allocation, syscall/API call, cgroup/Job operation, attribute setup, create/assign/resume, pipe read/write/flush, signal/terminate, wait/completion, enumeration, quiescence check, and close. Controlled failure leaks no child, descendant, cgroup, Job, task, descriptor, handle, pipe, allocation, or execution authority.

13. Determinism/metamorphic tests permute OS numeric identifiers, completion batching, pipe chunks, EINTR/pending schedules, host roots, and diagnostic detail while preserving logical requests. Logical observations remain identical. Changing provider/ABI/profile/target/primitive/support outcome moves the owning evidence root.

14. Seeded mutants misstate one signature/layout/constant/calling convention, omit an availability probe, trust a PID, use process groups, resume before Job assignment, inherit a handle, skip flush, accept dirty EOF, double-close/leak a resource, weaken quiescence, expose raw state, or mark an absent provider Supported. Every mutant is executed and killed by retained wrapper or platform E2E evidence.

15. The unsafe/source audit inventories every unsafe operation, exact invariant, caller proof, platform target, generated binding prohibition, dependency graph, source/build root, test mapping, and reviewer gate. It proves no external runtime or FFI-backed dependency entered the production graph and any leaf source, ABI table, target, feature, or provider change stales the audit.

16. Bounded platform logs retain semantic profile/provider/API/ABI/source/build roots, logical resource transition, support state, exact mapped diagnostic, ranked structured repair, retryability, no-claim, and first failure plus a capability-placeholder reproduction recipe. They exclude secrets, raw pointers/descriptors/handles, numeric PIDs, host paths, kernel details, wall time, scheduler noise, and bulk bytes. Literal, unit, boundary, property/metamorphic, model, mutation, compile-fail, wrapper, ABI, unsafe/source-audit, Linux E2E, Windows E2E, macOS provider/Unsupported, fault/resource, and logging categories expose nonzero checked counts and retained roots; full controller, replay, DSR, and family-science proof remain separate.

17. Source-closure tests exact-set-bind every file and generated input owned by each of children 24.4.1.2.1-.4; the parent exact-set joins all four source closures: implementation modules, CONTRACT/rustdoc, schema/domain/descriptor and constructor tables, independent oracles, unit/property/mutation fixtures, E2E case-manifest rows, log schemas, direct dependency/source/feature identities, and build configuration. One-at-a-time missing, extra, stale, reordered, ambient, unpinned, duplicate-owner, or mixed-snapshot inputs move the closure or refuse before proof; no retained binary/root can stand in for absent source. Each child coverage manifest reports distinct source-closure ID sets and checked counts for eligible positives and matched positives; eligible expected refusals and matched expected refusals; eligible expected failures and matched expected failures; and eligible mutations and matched mutations; exact Unsupported and inapplicable reasons; zero unexpected mismatches, execution failures, and unexplained skips; the exact source/build roots; and retained relative evidence paths.

18. NativeArgvIngressV1 literal/boundary tests preserve exact POSIX byte strings and Windows UTF-16 code units, vector order, empty arguments, quotes, spaces, trailing backslashes, valid non-ASCII scalar values, normalization-distinct spellings, embedded-NUL impossibility/refusal, invalid POSIX UTF-8, and lone/high/low surrogate faults. Locale, code page, shell quoting, current directory, environment, terminal, and lossy conversion cannot alter the handed-off sequence. Diagnostics/logs expose only argument ordinal and stable fault class.

19. NativeInterruptIngressV1 unit/model/race tests cover install, SIGINT/SIGTERM, CTRL_C/CTRL_BREAK, simultaneous and repeated sources, ingress ordinal overflow, before-spawn/active/drain/finalize/post-terminal windows, handler disable/restore, cancellation/panic/provider loss, SIGPIPE/broken channel, and uncontrolled console-close/logoff/shutdown/forced-death classes. The handler performs only the allowed async-safe notification; the controller alone constructs StopKey/lifecycle. Later or repeated requests never rewrite a closed terminal or bypass quiescence.

20. NativeDeadlineObservationV1 property/model tests sample only declared logical checkpoints; cover zero/one/exact/one-over wall, stop-observation, drain, and finalize budgets; monotonic-source failure/regression; scheduler delay; tie with caller cancellation; and different first-elapsed checkpoints. Fixed accepted logical observations are reproducible; changed timing observations move the typed stop/lifecycle owner and are explicitly outside the bit-stability claim. No wall-clock value, timestamp, or scheduler datum enters semantic identity or canonical logs.

21. NativeProcessExitObservationV1 tests exhaust every controlled ProofExit code, POSIX normal/signal/core-style classes, Windows 0/u8::MAX/u16::MAX/u32::MAX and exception/provider-loss values, signedness/endian/width mutations, shell/modulo truncation, and controlled versus uncontrolled termination. Only exact controlled codes project; uncatchable death or provider loss cannot mint a terminal/result/receipt. Resource/descendant quiescence remains mandatory before controlled completion.

22. Bootstrap/provider integration tests exact-set the Windows inherited handle list and slot table before resume; cover zero/one/max handles, duplicates, wrong kind/rights, inheritance leaks, stale/substituted handles, assignment/resume races, bootstrap cancellation, and child/user-code tripwires. They consume rather than redeclare RunnerLaunchContextV1/RunnerBootstrapTableV1, and every handle is closed exactly once.

23. Native release-built no-mock E2E runs the child-owned Linux driver 24.4.1.2.2 and direct native Windows driver 24.4.1.2.3 on every advertised Supported cell; child 24.4.1.2.4 runs the macOS provider-or-Unsupported matrix. It injects native OS-string argv, real SIGINT/SIGTERM or CTRL_C/CTRL_BREAK, broken result/progress channels, deadline boundaries, child/grandchild escape attempts, controlled exits and uncontrolled death, bootstrap handle transfer, restart, and cleanup. Bash/Git-Bash/PowerShell parsing cannot substitute for the native Windows route; macOS provider/Unsupported remains a separately typed cell.

24. Mutation/API/compile-fail/log/source-closure suites cover every native argv/interrupt/deadline/exit/bootstrap descriptor, provider transition, ABI constant, handler safety rule, platform width, support row, safe-versus-audited implementation choice, release driver, test manifest, and build input. They reject lossy strings, signal-handler allocation/locks/logging, direct StopKey construction, signal-to-ProofExit coercion, hidden shell/environment dependence, new unsafe zones, weak containment, and sensitive raw data. Closed logs retain source/build/provider/ABI roots, stable input/source classes, logical ordinals/checkpoints, controlled/uncontrolled exit class, first failure, cleanup, no-claim, and separately nonzero unit/property/model/race/mutation/compile-fail/no-mock E2E/source-closure counts with zero unexpected mismatches. Exact result accounting reports distinct exact ID sets and checked counts for eligible and matched positives; eligible and matched expected refusals; eligible and matched expected failures; eligible and matched mutations; typed Unsupported and inapplicable cells with exact matched reasons; unexpected mismatches; execution failures; and unexplained skips. Closure requires every eligible stable ID exactly once, nonzero applicable positive and adversarial corpora, equality within every eligible and matched subpartition, exact reason equality, and zero unexpected mismatches, execution failures, or unexplained skips.

25. GLOBAL REALITY-CHECK CLOSE-MANIFEST RECONCILIATION (CONTROLLING). Earlier `eligible`/`passed`/`failed` shorthand and any single collapsed `matched expected refusals` counter are compatibility-only and cannot close any mapped platform implementation child. Each mapped platform implementation child must expose one result-free, source-authoritative, full-set-only close manifest that exact-sets every stable test and E2E cell into all nine preserved category groups: literal/unit/boundary; property/metamorphic; state/typestate/model/race; mutation/fuzz; API/compile-fail/trait; fault/resource/cancellation; release-built no-mock E2E or immutable E2E contribution; detailed deterministic logging/redaction; and source closure. Each applicable category and each applicable slash-separated facet has a separately nonzero corpus. A genuinely inapplicable facet requires a registered typed reason with stable code/name, exact owner, execution scope, prerequisite, and no-claim text; it cannot hide an eligible cell.

Result accounting retains distinct counters and exact ID sets for: eligible positives and matched positives; eligible expected refusals and matched expected refusals; eligible expected failures and matched expected failures; eligible mutations and matched mutations; typed Unsupported cells with exact matched reasons; typed inapplicable cells with exact matched registered reasons; unexpected mismatches; execution failures; and unexplained skips. It also reports checked aggregate adversarial totals as the sums of the three adversarial subpartitions without replacing them. Green requires each matched subpartition to equal its own eligible subpartition, every eligible stable ID exactly once in canonical order, nonzero applicable positive and adversarial corpora, exact Unsupported/inapplicable reason equality, and zero unexpected mismatches, execution failures, and unexplained skips. An expected failure is never an execution failure, a mutation is never relabeled as a refusal, and an empty/subset selection can never be green. Missing, extra, duplicate, reordered, stale, reclassified, wrong-reason, or wrong-scope manifest/result rows refuse structurally.

Where the mapped platform implementation child owns execution, comprehensive unit/integration/property/model/race/fault/mutation/API tests and the named E2E script run release-built with no mocks. Where execution belongs downstream, that mapped platform implementation child instead emits immutable stable rows binding independent literal expectations/oracles, semantic inputs, explicit time/memory/work/process/artifact/log budgets, schema and log-schema roots, source/build roots, exact downstream owner and script, and no-claim scope; it cannot report that downstream execution passed. E2E tests cover happy, boundary, expected-refusal, expected-failure, mutation, Unsupported, inapplicable, cancellation/drain, resource-return, and hidden-skip cases with deterministic stable IDs and exact first divergence.

Canonical bounded logs retain stable cell/category/facet IDs; semantic-input, source, build, schema, oracle, budget, manifest, and execution roots; ordered stage observations and terminal stage; expected/observed classification; first-divergence ID/root; resource and drain outcomes; exact result partitions; ranked non-executable repair manifest; no-claim scope; and safe relative retained-artifact references. They reject or type-redact secrets, credentials, environment values, live capabilities, raw resources/handles, absolute or physical paths, PIDs, wall clock, scheduler noise, and bulk payloads. Rejection diagnostics retain only a stable redacted data class and must not echo the sentinel through `observed`, Display, Debug, canonical bytes, logs, or reproduction text. Logging tests cover zero/one/exact/one-over limits, checked overflow, missing/extra/duplicate/reordered/truncated events, wrong roots/counts/reasons, redaction for every forbidden class, and deterministic replay.

Every user-visible Refused, Unsupported, divergent Negative, expected failure, and unexpected mismatch carries one bounded deterministic actionable diagnostic with registered code, precise redacted typed expected/observed values, owner, retryability, exact prerequisites, no-claim scope, and uniquely ranked declarative repairs. Repairs cannot contain or invoke commands, callbacks, scripts, credentials, raw capabilities/resources/handles/provider payloads, physical paths/locators, or automatic mutations. Source closure exact-sets all implementation, contract/rustdoc, schema/domain/owner tables, independent oracles, fixtures, E2E manifests/scripts or contribution rows, log schemas, dependencies/features, and build configuration on one compatible stable snapshot. Closeout reports focused proof, release-built E2E or contribution proof, source closure, DSR, and any downstream/scientific/authority proof separately and never promotes one into another.

26. CONTROLLING TOKEN/BOOTSTRAP CONSUMPTION GATE. The safe platform facade consumes the exact affine VerifiedExecutableTokenV1 interface and typestate proved by frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.4.1.1 and the exact RunnerLaunchContextV1/RunnerBootstrapTableV1, slot-kind/right, inheritance, freshness, and close-once contracts proved by frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.2.2.1. It may not shadow, reconstruct, serialize, reopen, or weaken either interface. Dependency-DAG, compile-fail, ABI, model/race, mutation, native release-built no-mock E2E, detailed-log, and source-closure tests independently prove interface identity and reject mixed-snapshot or lookalike types.

27. DECOMPOSED PLATFORM ROLLUP CHILD-SET GATE (CONTROLLING). The frozen ordered direct-child set contains exactly frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.4.1.2.1, frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.4.1.2.2, frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.4.1.2.3, and frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.4.1.2.4. Every child must be closed with its exact terminal close manifest, source/build/schema/owner/oracle/log roots, E2E execution or contribution scope, and safe relative evidence references on one compatible stable snapshot.

28. Missing, extra, duplicate, reordered, reopened, blocked, stale, mixed-snapshot, wrong-owner, wrong-scope, or root-mismatched children refuse. Any intentional child-set change requires explicit rollup revision; a count or inherited parent status cannot substitute for exact identities.

29. Ownership reconciliation proves exactly one owner for neutral support/facade/native descriptors; Linux profile/provider/ABI/raw leaf; Windows profile/provider/ABI/bootstrap adapter/raw leaf; macOS provider/support/repair matrix; every focused driver/log/source row; and every E2E contribution. The rollup owns none.

30. Dependency reconciliation proves the neutral facade consumes 24.4.1.1 plus phase-1 registry/spec roots; Linux and Windows consume the exact facade plus 24.2.2.1 bootstrap contracts; macOS consumes the exact facade; and all three provider children can proceed in parallel after the facade. No hidden broad-phase blocker substitutes for an exact prerequisite.

31. Feature reconciliation preserves every original parent requirement: all-or-nothing safe API selection; affine token consumption; Linux cgroup-v2/pidfd containment; Windows Job/handle/flush containment and assignment-before-resume; macOS provider-or-Unsupported policy; exact native argv, interrupt, deadline, exit, bootstrap, wait, pipe, stop, quiescence, and resource-return contracts; no weak fallback; and no-authority boundaries.

32. The joined platform support oracle exact-sets every profile/target/provider/API/primitive/ABI/source/build/state/failure-boundary/diagnostic/retryability/repair/no-claim row. Every advertised Supported Linux or Windows cell carries actual retained native release-built no-mock evidence. macOS carries equivalent registered-provider evidence or exact tested pre-spawn Unsupported.

33. Unsafe reconciliation permits only the two named process-containment raw leaves when their safe API is proven insufficient. Their combined audits bind every operation/invariant/target/ABI/source/build/test/reviewer row. Neutral and macOS children remain safe; no raw state escapes and no third unsafe zone exists.

34. Native-observation reconciliation proves one neutral descriptor plus exact platform implementations for POSIX bytes, Windows UTF-16, SIGINT/SIGTERM, CTRL_C/CTRL_BREAK, SIGPIPE/broken channels, monotonic logical checkpoints, POSIX signal exits, Windows unsigned 32-bit exits/exceptions, uncontrolled-loss no-claim, bootstrap allowlists, and complete handler/resource restoration.

35. Focused E2E reconciliation exact-joins the Linux driver/thin script, direct Windows native driver/optional thin PowerShell coordinator, macOS native provider/Unsupported driver, neutral contribution rows, and their exact downstream 24.4.1.4 consumption mapping. Focused provider evidence cannot claim canonical Runner execution.

36. Log reconciliation exact-joins child schemas and proves deterministic ordering, bounds, exact result partitions, first divergence, ranked non-executable repairs, safe relative evidence references, and complete sentinel no-echo/redaction across observed, Display, Debug, canonical bytes, logs, and reproduction text.

37. Source-closure reconciliation exact-joins the four disjoint child source sets against one frozen parent ownership inventory. Missing, extra, overlap, duplicate owner, stale target/ABI/provider row, mixed snapshot, ambient source, or retained-binary substitution refuses.

38. Result accounting preserves distinct exact ID sets and checked counters for positives, expected refusals, expected failures, mutations, Unsupported, inapplicable, unexpected mismatch, execution failure, and unexplained skip for every child and their checked parent sums. Aggregate counts never substitute for a child or subpartition.

39. The shared StableTokenV2 oracle retains the exact phase-4 set, independently verified 90-byte existing maximum, lowercase-ASCII rules, applicable 127/128 acceptance, and exact 129 refusal without aliasing or truncation.

40. Estimate reconciliation proves implementation tasks total 300 + 720 + 900 + 180 = 2,100 minutes; this rollup is 90 minutes; and the five-node platform subtree totals exactly 2,190 minutes, preserving the outer 24.4.1 scheduling equation. Live hierarchy and `estimated_minutes` fields are authoritative.

41. Closeout makes only a Runner platform-provider conformance and exact-set reconciliation claim. Controller/canonical-harness, publication, replay/migration, constellation/DSR, family science, candidate, admission, and authority proof remain separately reported and cannot be inferred.

42. EXACT CHILD OWNERSHIP MAP (CONTROLLING). Platform ownership is fixed: 24.4.1.2.1 owns the safe provider-neutral facade, support oracle, StableToken/native-observation contracts, affine token-consumption seam, and immutable E2E contributions; .1.2.2 owns the Linux cgroup-v2/pidfd provider, optional audited raw leaf, native driver, and focused E2E; .1.2.3 owns the Windows Job/handle/flush provider, bootstrap adapter, optional audited raw leaf, native driver, and focused E2E; .1.2.4 owns the macOS registered-provider or exact pre-spawn Unsupported matrix and native host conformance. Parent 24.4.1.2 owns only their exact-set join. Every preserved semantic/test requirement is projected to that exact child owner or child union; no inherited parent-ownership wording is authoritative. It never grants implementation, constructor, test-cell, E2E-execution, contribution-row, source-closure, native-resource, scientific, admission, or authority ownership to this rollup. The rollup closes only from the frozen exact child set and cannot substitute its status or prose for any child close manifest.

ROLLUP FIVE-EXPLICITS AND LOG-COMPLETENESS JOIN (CONTROLLING). This rollup exact-set joins every direct child Five-Explicits root and complete-log root on the same source/build snapshot. Missing, extra, duplicate, stale, mixed, unit-ambiguous, seedless-without-typed-reason, over-budget, capability-incomplete, partially logged, silently truncated, or terminal-less child evidence refuses. Aggregate counts or a parent budget cannot replace any child cell exact explicit values or complete terminal log.

ROLLUP E2E ROUTE RESOLUTION JOIN (CONTROLLING). This rollup exact-set joins every direct child execution/contribution classification and proves a one-to-one mapping from each contribution row to one literal downstream owner, driver, script/native route, and immutable manifest. Every execution owner exact-set consumes its rows once and retains release identity, complete logs, source closure, result partitions, and relative artifacts. Missing, ambiguous, duplicate, stale, remapped, wrong-owner/script, unexecuted, multiply executed, hidden-skip, contribution-only-Pass, or focused-proof substitution refuses.

AC58 DESCENDANT SCHEMA-IMPACT JOIN (CONTROLLING ROLLUP). This rollup owns no implementation schema and may mint no leaf evidence. It consumes the exact SchemaImpactManifestV1 from every recursively contained implementation leaf on one compatible source snapshot and constructs a deterministic descendant join ordered by stable leaf ID, then stable schema ID. The join records exact descendant and schema-row counts plus exact counts for NewV1NoPredecessor, UnchangedV1, MigratedV1ToV2, DecodeOnlyLegacyV1, RetiredV1, and InapplicableNoCanonicalFrame; every count is checked against the literal descendant inventory rather than inferred from status, labels, estimates, source ordinals, or child aggregate totals. It refuses a missing, extra, duplicate, reordered, stale, owner-remapped, cross-rollup, unknown-disposition, incompatible-snapshot, V1/V2-substituted, partial-migration, or multiply aggregated leaf/schema row, and refuses any authoritative V2 close claim while a required descendant is absent or still names an incompatible authoritative V1 parent.

Comprehensive rollup tests cover exact-empty where structurally legal, one descendant, the exact live maximum, one-over injected input, all six dispositions, nested-rollup associativity without double counting, order/shard/schedule/resume invariance, every missing/extra/duplicate/reorder and mixed-snapshot mutation, first explicit divergence, bounded deterministic step-prefixed logging and redaction, structured reproduction, overflow terminal, coverage counters, and exact source closure. A source-closed release-built E2E join consumes only already produced leaf evidence and proves aggregation fidelity; it does not execute descendants, replace their unit/property/model/mutation/API/fault/E2E/log/source-closure gates, or promote focused, DSR, downstream, durability, scientific, or authority proof. CONTRACT/rustdoc and the final rollup report list every descendant schema-impact manifest and all separate proof states.

PLATFORM ROUTE MATRIX RECONCILIATION 2026-07-29 (CONTROLLING). The neutral facade exact-dispatches to Linux, Windows, or macOS child providers without cross-platform fallback: Linux owns native POSIX cgroup/pidfd execution, Windows owns direct native Job/handle execution, and macOS owns its explicit pre-spawn provider/Unsupported contract. Every nonmatching target is a registered Inapplicable cell, not a skip. Rollup tests exact-set platform IDs, native-route authority, optional-helper non-authority, estimates, logs/redaction, reproduction, coverage, source closures, and zero shell emulation or provider substitution.

LIVE ROLLUP TOPOLOGY, SCHEDULING, AND OPERABILITY 2026-07-29 (FINAL CONTROLLING). This issue is a `runner-v2-rollup` epic. Its exact direct hierarchy children are: `frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.4.1.2.1`, `frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.4.1.2.2`, `frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.4.1.2.3`, `frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.4.1.2.4`. Its current recursive subtree contains exactly 5 Beads: 4 implementation tasks totaling 2,100 minutes and 1 rollup epics totaling 90 minutes, for 2,190 minutes. The 4 internal `parent-child` relations are closure hierarchy only; no reciprocal parent-depends-on-child `blocks` edge is permitted. This rollup's own 90-minute estimate covers only its explicitly named aggregate, integration, join, driver, rerun, source-closure, or close-review work and is not duplicated in child estimates. Functional implementation order remains solely in explicit `blocks` edges among owning tasks. While `br epic status` reports `eligible_for_close=false`, this rollup MUST have status `blocked`, never `open` or `in_progress`; when eligibility becomes true, transition it to `open` or `in_progress` only for its scoped closeout, then close it. The canonical executable-work query is `br ready --epic frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24 --type task`. `bv` robot output is diagnostic only; any surfaced rollup is not executable implementation work. Close this rollup only after every exact child-root, integration, test/E2E, detailed-log/redaction, reproduction, source-closure, proof-state, authority, and no-claim gate in this Bead passes. This clause supersedes every earlier numeric node/estimate/subtotal claim and every earlier phrase treating hierarchy children as reciprocal `blocks` dependencies or this epic as an implementation task. It removes no scope, feature, functionality, test, E2E script/contribution, logging, reproduction, source, route, capability, durability, scientific, admission, authority, or no-claim obligation.

ROLLUP CLOSEOUT DISCOVERABILITY AND MANUAL-EVIDENCE GATE 2026-07-29 (FINAL CONTROLLING). `br ready --epic frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24 --type task --json --limit 0` is the canonical implementation-task query; `bv` robot output is dependency/impact diagnosis, not executable status. When `br epic status --eligible-only --json` first reports this epic eligible because all direct children are closed, the epic is not automatically complete. A route-owning or integration-owning epic must be claimed and its own acceptance evidence completed before explicit close; task-only queries must not make that work disappear, and automatic bulk epic closure cannot substitute for it.

title: Runner V2 provider-neutral containment facade, support oracle, native observation contracts, and E2E contributions
description:
Implement the provider-neutral, safe Runner V2 process-containment facade and its complete support, ingress, lifecycle-handoff, and contribution contracts. This leaf consumes the exact affine VerifiedExecutableTokenV1 interface from 24.4.1.1, the closed phase-1 registry/specification roots, and their source/build identities. It owns the neutral types and policies that Linux, Windows, macOS, and the canonical process harness consume; it owns no native syscall/API invocation, raw ABI binding, provider implementation, process spawn, publication, replay, scientific claim, admission, or authority.

The facade freezes all-or-nothing provider selection, exact typed Supported/Unsupported decisions, affine token consumption, native argv/interrupt/deadline/exit observation descriptors, lifecycle/resource typestate, bounded diagnostics, deterministic logs, and immutable downstream E2E contribution rows. It cannot infer support from an OS name, weaken missing primitives, or use a process-group/cooperative simulation as durable containment.

## Acceptance Criteria

The dedicated Acceptance Criteria field is the authoritative close gate. Every numbered criterion must pass, including the controlling nine-facet literal/unit/boundary, property/metamorphic, state/model/race, mutation/fuzz, API/compile-fail/trait, fault/resource/cancellation, release-built no-mock E2E or immutable E2E-contribution, deterministic detailed-logging/redaction, and source-closure manifest; the four explicit eligible/matched result partitions; exact Unsupported/inapplicable reasons; and zero unexpected mismatches, execution failures, or unexplained skips on one compatible source/build/proof snapshot.
design:
Define one safe, closed ProviderNeutralContainmentFacadeV1 whose public values contain only canonical logical identities and checked typed observations. The exact profile tokens are linux-cgroup-v2-pidfd-v1, windows-job-handle-flush-v1, and macos-kernel-containment-v1. A support row binds profile/version, target class, complete primitive set, provider/API/source/build roots, support state, exact failure boundary, diagnostic, retryability, ranked declarative repairs, and no-claim. This leaf defines and validates the closed support-row schema and support-decision algorithm; it emits no native conformance result and cannot itself mark a platform profile Supported. Children 24.4.1.2.2 through 24.4.1.2.4 alone populate provider and conformance roots and execute native cells. Rollup 24.4.1.2 may expose Supported only when every required primitive and the retained native conformance root for that exact profile are present; partial or absent providers remain typed Unsupported before spawn.

The affine state path is verified executable token -> prepared provider request -> platform-owned active containment -> stopped/drained/quiescent -> closed. The neutral facade cannot construct the platform-owned active state itself, duplicate/reopen/serialize a token, expose a raw resource, or report success before a provider proves clean EOF, descendant quiescence, and exact resource return. Each transition is checked, single-use, cancellation-aware, and has one terminal cleanup path.

NativeArgvIngressV1 preserves exact ordered POSIX byte strings or Windows UTF-16 units without lossy conversion. NativeInterruptIngressV1 admits only registered logical notifications; handlers cannot allocate, lock, format, log, acquire capability, or construct StopKey/ProofExit semantics. NativeDeadlineObservationV1 observes only declared monotonic logical checkpoints and keeps wall time nonsemantic. NativeProcessExitObservationV1 preserves full native exit/signal/exception classes and never coerces uncontrolled death into a controlled Runner terminal.

StableTokenV2 validation retains the exact registered phase-4 token set, the existing 90-byte maximum token, lowercase ASCII grammar, 127- and 128-byte accepted boundary fixtures where the owning schema permits them, and exact 129-byte refusal. No alias, case fold, locale rule, truncation, or implicit default is accepted.

The leaf emits immutable platform-specific contribution rows naming the Linux, Windows, macOS, and canonical 24.4.1.4 execution owners, drivers, platform prerequisites, semantic/environmental budgets, independent expectations, log/source/build roots, and no-claim. description:
Implement the exact linux-cgroup-v2-pidfd-v1 Runner V2 containment provider behind the safe neutral facade. The provider must give kernel-enforced descendant containment, identity-safe observation, bounded cooperative and forced stop, complete stdout/stderr drain, clean EOF, exact native exit observation, descendant quiescence, and complete resource return before controlled completion. Missing delegation, any required primitive, a recognized ABI row, or a retained native conformance path yields typed Unsupported before user code.

Use pinned safe Rust APIs where they completely preserve the contract. If and only if no adequate safe API exists, isolate the minimum raw Linux boundary in one audited private leaf with target-specific literal ABI tables and safe wrappers. Process groups, PID-only monitoring, polling-only identity, cooperative-child assertions, shell wrappers, or unproved cgroup placement cannot mark Supported.

title: Runner V2 Windows Job/handle/flush containment, bootstrap binding, audited ABI, and native E2E
description:
Implement the exact windows-job-handle-flush-v1 Runner V2 containment provider and its concrete 24.2.2.1 bootstrap consumption behind the safe neutral facade. The provider must create the child suspended, bind an explicit inherited-handle allowlist and slot table, assign the process to the Job before resume, provide kernel-enforced descendant containment, drain overlapped stdout/stderr to clean EOF, preserve full unsigned native exit/exception observations, flush required durable streams, observe completion and ActiveProcessZero, and return every handle/resource before controlled completion.

Use pinned safe Rust APIs where they fully preserve the contract. If and only if they are insufficient, isolate the minimum Windows ABI operations in one audited private raw leaf with target-specific literal layouts and safe wrappers. Nested-job ambiguity, missing handle-list/bootstrap/flush/completion primitives, unsupported targets, or incomplete retained native conformance yields exact Unsupported before resume. No Git-Bash, WSL, shell translation, cooperative-only child, PID polling, or user assertion can mark Supported.

## Acceptance Criteria

The dedicated Acceptance Criteria field is the authoritative close gate. Every numbered criterion must pass, including the controlling nine-facet literal/unit/boundary, property/metamorphic, state/model/race, mutation/fuzz, API/compile-fail/trait, fault/resource/cancellation, release-built no-mock E2E or immutable E2E-contribution, deterministic detailed-logging/redaction, and source-closure manifest; the four explicit eligible/matched result partitions; exact Unsupported/inapplicable reasons; and zero unexpected mismatches, execution failures, or unexplained skips on one compatible source/build/proof snapshot.
design:
Consume the neutral facade and the exact RunnerLaunchContextV1/RunnerBootstrapTableV1 slot-kind, rights, inheritance, freshness, assignment, and close-once contracts from 24.2.2.1; do not redeclare or shadow them. The exact support row binds supported target, Job primitives and limits, process/thread creation, PROC_THREAD_ATTRIBUTE_HANDLE_LIST handling, inherited slot mapping, completion-port messages, overlapped pipe/cancellation/flush operations, wait/exit APIs, provider/API/ABI/source/build roots, conformance root, failure boundary, diagnostic, retryability, repairs, and no-claim.

The provider state machine is preflight -> Job/port/pipes/bootstrap prepared -> process and primary thread created suspended with explicit handle list -> Job assignment proven -> bootstrap transfer validated -> resume -> I/O and completion active -> cooperative or forced stop -> overlapped drain plus required flush -> wait and ActiveProcessZero -> handle/resource return -> closed. No user code can run before assignment; no controlled success exists before clean EOF, flush outcome, zero descendants, and exact resource return.

The optional raw leaf freezes every function signature, calling convention, constant, width, structure/union layout/alignment/offset, attribute-list sizing and initialization rule, completion message, wait result, error conversion, pointer lifetime, supported target, source/build root, and mapped test. Unknown target/ABI/SDK contract or partial primitive set refuses before user code. Raw pointers/handles never cross the safe provider.

The release-built native Windows E2E driver invokes the production provider directly with native UTF-16 argv and console-control/exit paths. An optional thin PowerShell coordinator may select retained cells but owns no quoting, provider logic, oracle, handle list, case catalog, or classifier. Focused proof covers containment/bootstrap/transport resources only, not the canonical controller, publication, replay, science, admission, or authority.

FOCUSED E2E ROUTE (CONTROLLING). The sole Windows route is direct native execution of release binary `runner-v2-windows-containment-e2e-driver`. If the optional thin coordinator is retained, its only path is `scripts/ci/e2e_runner_v2_windows_containment.ps1`; the coordinator owns no cells or semantics, and its absence cannot make a native Supported cell inapplicable. The driver is the sole semantic cell owner for this focused route; any coordinator is thin and owns no test cell, schema, oracle, or authority.

title: Runner V2 macOS registered-provider contract, exact support/Unsupported matrix, and native host conformance
description:
Implement the versioned macos-kernel-containment-v1 registered-provider contract and exact macOS support/Unsupported matrix. With no qualifying pinned provider, every spawn-capable durable binding returns typed Unsupported before spawn with a deterministic ranked non-executable repair. If a provider is registered, Supported is possible only after complete retained native conformance proves kernel-enforced descendant membership, escape refusal, bounded cooperative and forced stop, clean EOF, zero descendants, exact native observations, and complete resource return.

This leaf introduces no raw macOS syscall layer and no third containment unsafe zone. Process groups, killpg, PID polling, cooperative-child simulation, OS-name inference, or a user-code assertion can never mark Supported.

## Acceptance Criteria

The dedicated Acceptance Criteria field is the authoritative close gate. Every numbered criterion must pass, including the controlling nine-facet literal/unit/boundary, property/metamorphic, state/model/race, mutation/fuzz, API/compile-fail/trait, fault/resource/cancellation, release-built no-mock E2E or immutable E2E-contribution, deterministic detailed-logging/redaction, and source-closure manifest; the four explicit eligible/matched result partitions; exact Unsupported/inapplicable reasons; and zero unexpected mismatches, execution failures, or unexplained skips on one compatible source/build/proof snapshot.
design:
Consume the exact neutral-facade root and contracts. The provider descriptor binds profile/version, target, complete primitive set, provider/API/source/build roots, retained conformance root, support state, exact failure boundary, diagnostic, retryability, ranked repair, and no-claim. Missing, stale, substituted, partial, unproved, or incompatible providers are Unsupported before spawn.

The repair manifest is declarative data, never a command: first use an eligible registered macos-kernel-containment-v1 provider; otherwise rerun on a declared Supported linux-cgroup-v2-pidfd-v1 worker; otherwise on a declared Supported windows-job-handle-flush-v1 worker. Unavailable candidates carry exact typed reasons and cannot be presented as actionable. Process groups and weaker fallbacks are absent.

A future provider requires a new registered profile/version and full conformance evidence. It cannot silently extend the existing profile or add raw code to this leaf. Its native argv, interrupt, deadline, exit, containment, drain, quiescence, resource-return, logging, and source-closure behavior must satisfy the exact neutral contracts.

A native release-built macOS driver executes the real provider-discovery/preflight path. When the provider is absent, a real tripwire executable proves Unsupported occurs before spawn. When present, the same driver runs the full provider conformance matrix. Unsupported is a tested result, not a skipped cell.

FOCUSED E2E ROUTE (CONTROLLING). The sole macOS route is release binary `runner-v2-macos-containment-e2e-driver` with thin coordinator `scripts/ci/e2e_runner_v2_macos_containment.sh`; the same route records typed Unsupported when no registered provider is present. The driver is the sole semantic cell owner for this focused route; any coordinator is thin and owns no test cell, schema, oracle, or authority.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Exact ownership tests bind the neutral-facade consumption root and assign the macOS profile/provider descriptor, support rows, repair rows, native driver, log rows, and source closure exactly once. Linux/Windows ABI/raw code, token/bootstrap schema, controller, canonical harness, publication, replay, and authority rows are absent.

2. Literal support-matrix tests freeze every provider/version/target/primitive/API/source/build/conformance-root/state/failure-boundary/diagnostic/retryability/repair/no-claim field. Unknown, missing, duplicate, reordered, partial, stale, substituted, mixed-snapshot, or OS-name-inferred rows refuse.

3. Provider-absent native tests prove every spawn-capable durable binding returns exact typed Unsupported before spawn. A real user-code tripwire remains untouched; no process, lifecycle, publication, result, resource, or authority exists.

4. Provider-present conformance, when eligible, requires real kernel-enforced descendant membership, new-session/process-group escape refusal, cooperative and forced bounded stop, clean EOF, exact wait/exit observations, zero descendants, and complete resource return. A profile cannot be advertised Supported without retained native conformance evidence.

5. Process-group, killpg, PID-only, polling, cooperative-child, in-process, mock, shell-only, and user-code-assertion implementations remain Unsupported. Seeded mutants attempting any such promotion execute and are killed.

6. Ranked-repair tests assert the stable provider/Linux/Windows order, contiguous ranks after predicate evaluation, exact typed prerequisites and unavailable reasons, retryability, owner, and no-claim. Repairs contain no command, callback, script invocation, credential, capability, raw provider payload, path/locator, or automatic mutation.

7. Native argv tests preserve POSIX bytes and parser ownership; interrupt/deadline/exit descriptor tests ensure a future provider must satisfy the same SIGINT/SIGTERM, async-safe notification, logical checkpoint, full exit-class, drain, and quiescence contracts. Provider absence cannot be bypassed by valid native ingress.

8. State/model/fault/resource tests cover provider discovery, version/target/primitive/conformance-root checks, preflight, consume request, cancellation, timeout, panic, provider loss, partial startup, stop, drain, wait, quiescence, and close. Absent-provider cells allocate/spawn nothing; present-provider failures leak no child, descendant, task, pipe, provider resource, token, or authority.

9. Property/metamorphic/mutation/fuzz tests permute host detail, provider enumeration, diagnostic detail, logical request order, and nonsemantic native identities while preserving support facts. Provider/version/primitive/target/conformance-root changes move the exact owning root or refuse.

10. API/compile-fail/trait and deny-unsafe tests reject public provider construction, raw syscall imports, raw PID/descriptor/handle exposure, support-by-OS-name, direct StopKey/ProofExit/authority construction, weak-fallback registration, callbacks/code pointers, and profile mutation without a new version.

11. The native release-built no-mock macOS driver covers provider absent, wrong version, wrong target, incomplete primitive set, stale/substituted conformance root, cancellation, provider loss, ranked repairs, tripwire nonexecution, cleanup, and—when genuinely eligible—full supported-provider containment. Typed Unsupported is a retained tested result, never an unexplained skip.

12. Detailed logs retain stable profile/provider/API/conformance/source/build/cell roots, support state, logical stage, typed reason, expected/observed class, first failure, repair, retryability, cleanup, no-claim, and relative evidence. They exclude raw argv faults, provider payloads, PIDs, paths, secrets, wall time, scheduler noise, and bulk bytes; forbidden sentinels never echo.

13. Source closure exact-sets macOS profile/provider/support/repair tables, neutral-interface consumption, contract/rustdoc, independent oracles, model/mutation/fault fixtures, native driver/thin coordinator, E2E manifest, log schema, dependencies/features, and build inputs. It contains no raw unsafe module.

14. Focused closeout claims only exact provider discovery/preflight and, when eligible, retained native provider conformance. It reports the absent-provider Unsupported matrix, supported-provider matrix, source closure, and E2E result partitions separately and cannot infer canonical Runner, publication, replay/migration, science, admission, or authority proof.

15. GLOBAL LEAF CLOSE-MANIFEST, E2E, LOGGING, AND SOURCE-CLOSURE RECONCILIATION (CONTROLLING). Earlier eligible/passed/failed shorthand, one collapsed adversarial counter, aggregate category totals, parent prose, inherited status, or a receipt root cannot close this leaf. The leaf emits one result-free, source-authoritative, full-set-only close manifest that exact-sets every stable test and E2E cell into all nine preserved category groups: literal/unit/boundary; property/metamorphic; state/typestate/model/race; mutation/fuzz; API/compile-fail/trait; fault/resource/cancellation; release-built no-mock E2E or immutable E2E contribution; deterministic detailed logging/redaction; and source closure. Every applicable slash-separated facet has a separately nonzero corpus. A genuinely inapplicable facet has a registered stable code/name, exact owner, scope, prerequisite, and no-claim reason and cannot hide an eligible cell.

Result accounting retains distinct exact ordered ID sets and checked counters for eligible positives and matched positives; eligible expected refusals and matched expected refusals; eligible expected failures and matched expected failures; eligible mutations and matched mutations; typed Unsupported cells with exact matched reasons; typed inapplicable cells with exact matched registered reasons; unexpected mismatches; execution failures; and unexplained skips. Aggregate positive, adversarial, and category totals are checked sums only. Green requires equality inside every eligible/matched subpartition, exact reason equality, every eligible ID exactly once, nonempty applicable positive and adversarial corpora, and zero unexpected mismatches, execution failures, and unexplained skips. Expected failures are not execution failures; mutations are not refusals; Unsupported is not a hidden skip; an empty or subset selection cannot be green.

An execution-owning leaf runs its named E2E release-built with no mocks through production interfaces. A contribution-only leaf instead binds immutable stable rows to independent expectations and oracles, semantic inputs, explicit time/memory/work/process/artifact/output/log budgets, schema/log/source/build roots, exact downstream execution owner/script, and no-claim; it cannot report downstream execution passed. Native provider cells cover happy, boundary, expected-refusal, expected-failure, mutation, Unsupported, inapplicable, cancellation/drain, resource-return, provider-loss, and hidden-skip cases with deterministic IDs and exact first divergence.

Canonical bounded logs retain stable cell/category/facet IDs; semantic, provider, ABI, source, build, schema, oracle, budget, manifest, and execution roots; ordered stages and terminal stage; expected/observed classification; first-divergence ID/root; drain/resource outcomes; exact result partitions; ranked non-executable repair manifest; no-claim scope; and safe relative evidence references. They reject or type-redact secrets, credentials, environment values, live capabilities, provider payloads, raw pointers/resources/handles, absolute/physical paths, PIDs, kernel addresses, invalid raw argv units, wall clock, scheduler noise, and bulk payloads. A forbidden sentinel must not echo through observed values, Display, Debug, canonical bytes, logs, or reproduction text. Tests cover zero/one/exact/one-over limits, checked overflow, missing/extra/duplicate/reordered/truncated events, wrong roots/counts/reasons, every forbidden class, and deterministic replay.

Every user-visible Refused, Unsupported, divergent Negative, expected failure, or unexpected mismatch carries one bounded deterministic actionable diagnostic with registered code, precise redacted typed expected/observed values, owner, retryability, exact prerequisites, no-claim scope, and uniquely ranked declarative repairs. Repairs cannot execute or contain commands, callbacks, scripts, credentials, raw capabilities/resources/provider payloads, physical locators, or automatic mutations.

Source closure exact-sets all owned implementation, CONTRACT/rustdoc, schema/domain/owner tables, independent oracles, fixtures, E2E driver/script or contribution rows, log schemas, direct dependencies/features, target/ABI tables, unsafe allowlist where applicable, and build configuration on one compatible stable snapshot. Missing, extra, duplicate, stale, reordered, ambient, unpinned, wrong-owner, wrong-route, or mixed-snapshot input refuses. Closeout reports focused proof, native release-built E2E or contribution proof, source closure, constellation, DSR, controller/canonical-harness, replay/migration, scientific, and authority status separately and never promotes one into another.

FOCUSED E2E ROUTE AND SOURCE-CLOSURE GATE (CONTROLLING). The sole macOS route is release binary `runner-v2-macos-containment-e2e-driver` with thin coordinator `scripts/ci/e2e_runner_v2_macos_containment.sh`; the same route records typed Unsupported when no registered provider is present. The full-set close manifest, detailed deterministic log schema, and source closure bind this exact driver and coordinator tuple, release source/build/toolchain/target/exact-feature roots, every stable positive/refusal/failure/mutation/Unsupported/inapplicable cell, and retained relative evidence paths. Missing, alternate, PATH/debug, shell-only, stale, duplicated, or unrooted routes cannot close the leaf.

FIVE EXPLICITS DECLARATION, RUNTIME-EVIDENCE, AND COMPLETE-LOG GATE (CONTROLLING). Every stable literal, unit, boundary, property, metamorphic, state, typestate, model, race, mutation, fuzz, API, fault, and E2E cell binds one declaration-side Five Explicits contract: typed units for every numeric input, numeric grant, and expected numeric observation; one canonical seed declaration plus generator/minimizer version, or a registered `SeedInapplicable` code with owner, scope, prerequisite, and no-claim; seven-axis hard and soft time, memory, logical-work, process, artifact, output, and log budgets with process shape declared separately; exact API, wire, schema, source, build, toolchain, target, profile, and feature version requirements; one exact required/permitted semantic capability contract; and the exact no-claim. Runtime actual numeric observations, resolved seed provenance, budget reconciliation, observed versions, and actual required, granted, observed, returned, and revoked capability sets exist only inside disposition-gated runtime evidence. `Observed` requires complete actuals; `NotObserved` may retain only safe typed partial evidence plus its exact reason and cannot substitute expected values; `Deferred` and `Inapplicable` contain no fabricated actuals. Changing any applicable declaration or actual explicit moves exactly the intended component, cell, evidence, log, reproduction, aggregate, and report roots. Bounded log writers reserve sufficient bytes for one canonical terminal event before admitting detail events. The first event that would exceed the remaining detail budget emits one complete deterministic `LogBudgetExceeded` terminal containing the rejected event class and ordinal, digest, omitted count, applicable budget, first-divergence stage, disposition, drain/resource outcome, diagnostic owner, repair-manifest root, and no-claim. Partial JSONL, silent truncation, overwriting prior events, missing terminal state, expected-as-actual substitution, fabricated observed-empty data, or treating overflow as success refuses. Minimized reproduction evidence retains every applicable declaration and safe actual explicit without exposing a forbidden value.

E2E ROUTE OBLIGATION MANIFEST GATE (CONTROLLING). Every leaf owns one exact ordered route-obligation manifest rather than a lossy leaf-wide binary. Each applicable obligation appears exactly once with `LeafCloseRouteObligationKindV1`: 1 `LocalInProcess`, 2 `ExecutionOwned`, 3 `ContributionOnly`, or 4 `Inapplicable`; zero and unknown refuse. A LocalInProcess row binds the real public in-process entry point, immutable cell oracle, budgets, expected partitions, detailed-log schema/root, source closure, and no-mock no-authority boundary. An ExecutionOwned row binds one literal release driver, POSIX wrapper where applicable, direct native-Windows driver or PowerShell wrapper as frozen by the owner contract, immutable case-manifest path/root, exact close argv, release-artifact identity, platform/provider matrix, declared capability profile, runtime evidence-envelope contract, retained relative artifacts, and complete detailed-log root. A ContributionOnly row binds one immutable result-free payload and Deferred envelope to exactly one downstream execution owner plus its literal driver, script/native route, manifest, observer contract, budgets, expected partitions, logging schema, source/build roots, and no-claim; it cannot report downstream execution passed. An Inapplicable row binds one registered reason, owner, scope, prerequisite, and no-claim. The derived leaf class is exactly `LocalOnly`, `ExecutionOnly`, `ContributionOnly`, or `Mixed`; multiple obligations and multiple contribution rows are legal and must remain distinct. Missing, extra, duplicate, reordered, generic, ambiguous, rollup-owned, stale, remapped, wrong-script, unconsumed, multiply consumed, debug, ambient/PATH-resolved/alternate/unregistered Cargo-run, hidden-skip, contribution-as-execution, or inferred leaf-class routes refuse. A specifically registered source-closed focused probe is legal only when its owner Bead names it and remains separately labeled non-closing evidence. Unit/exact-set, property/model, mutation, API/compile-fail, no-mock in-process or release-built E2E/contribution, deterministic detailed-log/redaction, structured-reproduction, resume/shard, overflow, and source-closure tests cover empty, one, maximum, mixed, duplicate, reorder, route substitution, owner remap, and every row-kind/derived-class transition. Focused/unit proof cannot substitute for a required release-built row or immutable contribution contract.

AC57 EVIDENCE-DISPOSITION CONSUMER GATE (CONTROLLING). This leaf consumes, and MUST NOT redefine, the exact evidence-kind, RuntimeObservationDispositionV1, reason-registry, completeness, safe-partial-evidence, resource-reconciliation, EvidenceEnvelopeV1, and FirstDivergentExplicitComponentV1 contracts governed by program gate `.24.1.1.1` and base contract owner `.24.1.1.1`. Every stable local cell and every exact route-obligation row maps to one and only one legal evidence-kind/disposition pair. OwnedHarnessExecution and InProcessProjectionExecution admit only Observed or NotObserved; ImmutableDownstreamContribution admits only Deferred; ApplicabilityDeclaration admits only Inapplicable. LocalInProcess and ExecutionOwned work may close Observed only after a completed attempt supplies every applicable actual numeric-observation, observed-seed-disposition, budget-reconciliation, observed-version, observed-capability-set, execution-completeness, attempt-identity, retained-state, and resource-reconciliation root. A matched refusal, expected failure, executed Unsupported outcome, or mutation survivor/kill remains Observed when observation is complete; semantic outcome never substitutes for observation disposition.

NotObserved is fail-closed and uses exactly one registered reason: 1 execution-failed-before-completeness, 2 observation-channel-failed-before-completeness, or 3 unexpected-unstarted-or-skipped. It preserves attempt and payload identity and may preserve only a separately rooted redacted safe-partial-evidence object; it never copies expected values into actual fields, encodes missing actuals as observed-empty, claims successful execution, or permits a green aggregate. title: Runner V2 deterministic controller, durable process publication, result transport, and progress runtime
description:
Implement the canonical production Runner V2 binary entry point and deterministic process controller over the frozen parser, lifecycle, resolver, containment, publication, and transport contracts. This leaf owns production state transitions, bounded resources, durable publication orchestration, result delivery integration, controlled exit projection, and progress emission. It owns no canonical release script/driver, shard/resume aggregation, platform-wide no-mock closeout, replay adapter, science, candidate, admission, or authority.

## Acceptance Criteria

The dedicated Acceptance Criteria field is the canonical close gate. Every numbered criterion must pass on one compatible stable snapshot; prose, a count-only summary, or an inherited rollup status cannot substitute for the named roots and retained evidence.
design:
This leaf owns the exact canonical-evidence-runner-v2 Cargo binary target and top-level semantic entry point. It consumes checked presentation values from the canonical parser branch, VerifiedExecutableTokenV1 from 24.4.1.1, the neutral facade from 24.4.1.2.1 and native provider roots from 24.4.1.2.2-.4 under exact compatibility rollup 24.4.1.2, lifecycle/result semantics from 24.1.2, result transport bytes from 24.2.1.3, and the 24.2.2.3 verified-delivery policy interface, which transitively binds and exposes the 24.2.2.2 publication/recovery constructors without redeclaration or reach-behind. It may not duplicate or reach behind any of those owners.

The controller maps the six-command grammar into Invocation/lifecycle/result execution and implements request -> drain -> finalize -> quiescence under exact StopKey ordering. It bounds child processes, parallelism, pipes, captured streams, discard, buffers, tasks, arenas, descriptors/handles, capabilities, leases, finalizers, output, logical work, memory, and environmental deadline observations. First cause, stop-window closure, ordinary continuation, controlled suppression, cleanup, terminal state, semantic outer exit, and native forced-termination distinctions are deterministic under their declared scope.

Run and Negative execute only pinned verified artifacts through the platform facade. Destination-bound durable commands construct the frozen lifecycle, orchestrate planned-object publication and committed-output recovery, verify the receipt, freeze the semantic result, and invoke the transport writer only after exact preconditions. Publication failure begins no stdout frame. A delivery prefix remains non-authoritative; controlled delivery faults use the frozen outer exit without rewriting lifecycle/publication authority. This leaf never owns result payload/frame codecs or CommandResultDeliveryObservationV1 schema, but it supplies bounded raw delivery observations through the owning 24.2.2.3 policy interface.

The controller is the sole production emitter of RunnerProgressEventV1. Progress uses a bounded nonblocking queue with deterministic event order, coalescing, checked dropped-count overflow, redaction, no post-terminal event, and complete observer resource return. Absent, fast, slow, blocked, closed, and failing observers cannot change semantic bytes, roots, lifecycle, publication, result, exit, retry, or authority.

This leaf owns a result-free ControllerE2EContributionManifestV1 containing immutable stable cells and expected roots for the canonical harness. It owns focused controller diagnostic/progress logs and source closure only. It does not own scripts/ci/canonical_evidence_runner_v2.sh, canonical-evidence-runner-v2-e2e-driver, release artifact verification, actual canonical no-mock process execution, shard/resume/aggregate records, RunnerE2EHarnessEventV1, or aggregate E2E receipts.

The controller makes no claim for unsupported platforms/providers, independent verification, replay/migration execution, family science, candidate correctness, rjoq admission, Evidence, or Certified. Focused controller tests cannot be reported as canonical release E2E, DSR-wide, or platform-wide proof.

1. Dependency/ownership gates require exact compatible 24.1.2, 24.2.1.3, 24.2.2.3, 24.4.1.1, neutral-facade 24.4.1.2.1, native-provider 24.4.1.2.2-.4, and compatibility-rollup 24.4.1.2 roots. The production binary/controller/progress/contribution rows are owned exactly once; parser, codec, resolver, platform, publisher, harness, replay, science, and authority rows are absent.

2. Binary/API tests freeze the canonical-evidence-runner-v2 package/binary/profile/features/source/build identity and one top-level semantic entry point. PATH lookup, Cargo-run, debug/source-tree fallback, alternate binary, callback injection, public state mutation, or duplicate entry point fails.

3. Command-mapping tests exhaust List, Check, SelfTest, Run Smoke/Full, Negative, and Replay grammar handoff; explicit mode/protocol/destination/capability selections; canonical rendering/identity; retired alias refusal; and exact pre-run versus active-run effect boundaries.

4. Deterministic state-machine tests cover every controller state and legal transition; ordinary terminal continuation; accepted cancellation/timeout/controlled internal stop; three NotRun causes; stop-window races; exact first-cause selection; no post-terminal writes; and no drop-synthesized authority.

5. Containment tests consume VerifiedExecutableTokenV1 and the platform facade only, reject token/source/build/policy substitution and raw process APIs, and prove bounded child/descendant/process-group/job-object behavior, pipe closure, stream drain, finalizers, quiescence, and zero escaped child.

6. Resource/backpressure tests cover zero/one/exact/one-over children, parallelism, stdout/stderr, discard, buffers, tasks, arenas, descriptors/handles, capabilities, leases, memory, logical work, output, and environmental deadline bounds. Overflow fails at the owning stage with complete drain and zero leaks/deadlock/livelock.

7. Publication-controller tests cover destination binding, planned set/key/self-free Intent/actual pre-seal/durable identity/Seal/final receipt orchestration through upstream constructors, collision/tamper, cancellation/timeout, process death, lost return, same-resource recovery, different-resource substitution, and publication-before-output.

8. Result-transport integration tests separately check semantic payload length, fixed header length, checked full-frame total, nominal payload root, typed context root, zero/truncated/complete output, every writer fault, fresh-channel committed retry, and exact outer/native exit mapping without reimplementing transport codecs or delivery-observation policy.

9. Signal/deadline tests cover first/duplicate/escalated POSIX SIGINT/SIGTERM, Windows CTRL_C/CTRL_BREAK, handler install/race/failure, forced death, every lifecycle/publication/transport phase, stop-window boundary, monotonic provider/suspend/resolution facts, checked deadlines, logical-work races, and explicit no-cross-run-timeout-bit-stability.

10. Progress tests cover absent, fast, slow, blocked, full, exact-one-over, coalesced, closed, and failing observers; deterministic event order; checked dropped counts; complete slot/payload redaction; no semantic feedback; no post-terminal event; cleanup; and byte-identical semantic outputs across observation schedules.

title: Runner V2 integrity-first source locator, retained anchor, acquisition, and current-wire binding
description:
Implement integrity-first source receipt discovery and immutable input acquisition for Runner V2 replay. This leaf parses and normalizes the replay request, acquires one read-only source capability, records a bounded non-authoritative input-acquisition observation, discovers exactly one expected source receipt, validates all stored/encoded/expanded and identity layers in fixed precedence, and classifies current-wire support without running an adapter or writing output.

It owns the private phase-4 source-discovery request/observation documents only. It does not own upstream migration schemas, adapter execution, replay reconstruction, output publication, scientific claims, or admission authority.

## Acceptance Criteria

The dedicated Acceptance Criteria field is the canonical close gate. It requires literal request/discovery frames, hostile integrity and precedence matrices, unit/boundary/property/model/mutation/compile-fail/fault coverage, clean-process discovery E2E, and detailed bounded logs.
design:
The canonical replay grammar is `--replay MANIFEST_REL --input-artifact-root INPUT_ROOT_CAPABILITY_REF --publication-protocol PROTOCOL --destination-mode DESTINATION_MODE --artifact-root ROOT_CAPABILITY_REF --bundle-rel BUNDLE_REL`. This leaf validates the replay-specific source operand and tagged input capability before reads. Numeric slots are presentation-only and excluded from InvocationRootV2, canonical documents, receipts, and logs. Raw paths, handles, credentials, generic predecessor flags, source-checkout flags, and `LifecycleOnlyNoBundle` as a fabricated source refuse.

Input acquisition is affine, read-only, and deliberately nonsemantic. Private non-authoritative `InputResourceAcquisitionObservationV1` has exact domain `org.frankensim.fs-evidence-runner.input-resource-acquisition-observation.v1` and seven ordered fields: input `RootCapabilityPolicyRootV2`; input `PlatformPathProfileV2`; bounded freshness observation; optional generation observation; pinned-read observation; TOCTOU observation; and no-claim scope. Its root is `InputResourceAcquisitionObservationRootV1`, but that root, the live input resource identity, and every slot, locator, handle, or provider payload are excluded from InvocationRootV2, RunIdV2, replay lineage, discovery request/observation, migration basis/observation, manifest, publication DAG, PublishedBundleReceipt, CanonicalEvidenceRunnerV2Receipt, and every authoritative identity. The capability is pinned for the complete stored/encoded/expanded read and closed once. A byte-identical verified bundle copied to a different input resource changes only this non-authoritative observation and preserves all replay/output identities. Revocation, mid-read substitution, an unpinned generation change, or changed bytes refuses before handoff.

Private non-authoritative `ReplaySourceDiscoveryRequestV1` has exact domain `org.frankensim.fs-evidence-runner.replay-source-discovery-request.v1` and ordered fields: `ReplayLineageRootV2`; source `RootCapabilityPolicyRootV2`; source `PlatformPathProfileV2`; source `PublicationProtocolV2`; source manifest `LogicalBundlePathV1`; expected `BundleManifestRootV2`; expected `SealRootV2`; expected `PublishedBundleReceiptRootV2`; discovery-policy root; and no-claim scope. `ReplaySourceDiscoveryObservationV1` has exact domain `org.frankensim.fs-evidence-runner.replay-source-discovery-observation.v1` and ordered fields: request root; bounded candidate-count class; discovered manifest, seal, and receipt roots when exact-one; verifier root; result classification; diagnostic-or-absent; and no-claim scope. Neither document contains or references `InputResourceAcquisitionObservationRootV1` or a current input-resource identity. 

Discovery admits exactly one source receipt matching the typed logical location and expected roots. Zero, multiple, nested/sibling, stale-index, or scanning-order-dependent candidates refuse deterministically; filesystem aliases or copied resources are acceptable only when they resolve to one exact candidate and the pinned bytes verify identically. The request/observation cross-check replay lineage, input policy, expected roots, and independent verifier. The expected source receipt transitively verifies its historical published-output `DestinationResourceBindingRootV1`; that historical binding is never compared with the current read resource. Neither discovery document nor the input-acquisition observation enters replay identity, replaces `ReplaySupportBindingV2`, or carries authority.

Admission is two-tier. Tier A, before content I/O, is structural CLI/path/request and output-selection validation; tagged input-capability kind, rights, and policy validation; affine acquisition; and establishment of one readable pinned snapshot. Denied, revoked, wrong-kind, unreadable, or unpinnable acquisition returns its exact typed Stale, Unsupported, or Refused outcome without a byte-level diagnosis. Tier B, only after a readable pinned snapshot exists, is stored envelope root/length; encoded frame root/length/codec; expanded content root/length; manifest/seal/receipt/run/replay-lineage identity and the historical published-output binding inside the source receipt; canonical encoding; readable-snapshot freshness/policy; exact current schema or one registered source-target support relation; then adapter eligibility. Tier-B primary classes remain EvidenceTampered, EvidenceIdentityMismatch, NonCanonicalEvidence, readable-snapshot Stale, Unsupported, then MigrationRefused. Discovery order, schema novelty, or adapter absence cannot mask tampering after a readable pinned snapshot exists.

Current API generation 2 / wire V1 is recognized only when all exact schema identities match. It produces the typed current-wire support classification with selected adapter absent and typed absent migration observation; it does not perform adapter lookup or construct final ReplaySupportBinding. Unknown/future/legacy sources are integrity-checked first, then handed to 24.4.2.2 only when one exact upstream registry relation exists.

Every private schema, constructor, and owner row appears once in `RunnerPhase4SchemaOwnershipManifestV2`. This leaf consumes the phase-1 registry and exact phase-2/phase-3 manifest roots without modifying RunnerSpec or any earlier manifest. Canonical logs retain semantic request/lineage/policy/profile/protocol/manifest/seal/receipt/verifier/classification roots plus a separately marked non-authoritative `InputResourceAcquisitionObservationRootV1`, candidate count class, state, diagnostic, retryability, no-claim, and first failure; physical acquisition details and payload bytes remain absent. The observation root never appears in the receipt join or any authoritative reproduction principal.

title: Runner V2 source-service-independent artifact-only replay, destination-bound publication, and full replay E2E
description:
Implement source-independent Runner V2 replay reconstruction and final destination-bound publication. This leaf consumes the verified discovery handoff and optional migration result, preserves the exact source durable command, lineage, manifests, claim modes, expected comparison/effect frames, and Negative semantics, reconstructs all lifecycle/artifact/publication identities without source services, publishes through every supported protocol/mode cell, and owns full replay E2E plus replay logs.

It owns no source producer, tracker, comparator/verdict service, admission service, platform primitive, or upstream nominal schema. It cannot widen scientific or admission authority.

## Acceptance Criteria

The dedicated Acceptance Criteria field is the canonical close gate. It requires literal replay/lineage/result/publication oracles; exact budgets/accounting/resource binding; unit/boundary/property/model/mutation/compile-fail/fault/idempotency coverage; clean-process source-independent no-mock E2E; and detailed bounded logs.
design:
This leaf consumes exact verified semantic outputs from 24.4.2.1 and 24.4.2.2 while treating `InputResourceAcquisitionObservationV1` as attempt-scoped non-authoritative diagnostics only. That observation and the current input resource are excluded from every identity and join. It never reopens discovery, reruns registry selection, invokes source checkout/tracker/family producer/producer comparator or verdict/admission code, or fabricates a migration observation. All input artifacts remain immutable and retained.

Upstream `PublicationSelectionV2` is exactly four ordered fields: PlatformPathProfileV2, PublicationProtocolV2, DestinationAdmissionModeV2, and PublicationTargetV2. It describes output only and contains no input root, duplicate bundle-rel, expected manifest/seal/receipt root, budget, capability policy, discovery policy, or resource binding. The CLI separately provides `--bundle-rel` and tagged output capability.

Output acquisition validates the exact three-protocol/two-mode Cartesian product: Posix/Absent, Posix/PreExistingEmpty, Windows/Absent, Windows/PreExistingEmpty, ContentStore/Absent, and ContentStore/PreExistingEmpty. Posix/Windows PreExistingEmpty require RootCapabilityRightV2 code 5 `PopulateEmptyDestination`, reject `ReplaceEmptyDestination`, and never acquire an OS lease. ContentStore PreExistingEmpty requires exact `Enumerate` plus `AcquireExclusiveLease` and leased-empty generation/CAS. Unsupported capability cells fail before writes; no third mode, inference, fallback, or protocol substitution exists.

The output capability is affine and write-scoped. Backend-neutral operational admission proves that current input and output capabilities do not alias for this attempt, but the live input resource and that alias-check observation are nonsemantic and never enter replay or publication identity. Its sealed `DestinationResourceBindingV1` binds backend class, profile, policy root, privacy-preserving stable ResourceIdentityRoot, identity-provider policy, freshness, optional generation, and no-claim. Same output resource under a fresh presentation slot is stable; a different output resource moves publication identity. Raw locator, slot, provider payload, and physical prefix are noncanonical. Final commit, PublishedBundleReceiptV2, and recovery all retain/rederive the same binding.

Replay identity is singular: InvocationBasisV2 contains optional ReplayLineageRootV2 exactly for Replay and no MigrationExecutionBasisRootV2 duplicate. ReplayLineageV2 contains the current MigrationExecutionBasisRootV2 exactly once. Every success transitively verifies the historical source receipt and its original published-output `DestinationResourceBindingRootV1`, without equating it to the current input resource, and retains upstream ReplaySupportBindingV2 as required ArtifactRoleV2::ReplaySupport inventory history. Current-wire uses typed absent MigrationObservationRootV2 plus original-as-output relation; migrated replay binds the exact observation and transformed artifact while retaining originals. Discovery observations never substitute for lineage or replay support.

Replay preserves the exact source durable command, immutable case manifests, claim modes, expected comparison/effect frames, source Negative mismatch/error semantics, all ten evaluator mappings, state-first/lowest-winning-ordinal aggregation, CaseTerminalBasisV2, CaseExecutionPhase, and one identical closed RunOutcomeBasisRootV2 in RunSummary/RunTerminal. It never normalizes Negative into Run. Only newly authored positive Run fixtures require Match/Match.

Whole publication consumes the exact six `BundleLayoutV1` system paths/kinds, at most 256 artifacts/262 objects, exact object caps, and nine-field PublicationAccountingV1. The complete eighteen-field RunnerBudgetsV2 root remains bound; fields 11-15 are only the publication grants. Artifact encoded/stored/expanded ceilings are 64/65/64 MiB Smoke and 512/513/512 MiB Full; system is 8,388,608 bytes; whole stored is 76,546,048/546,308,096. Publication stored equals artifact stored plus system stored; ContentStore counts complete envelopes with at most 4096 nonpayload bytes. Command-result length stays a separate non-authoritative delivery observation.

The exact acyclic DAG is planned objects excluding intent/seal; PublicationKey from invocation, manifest, selection, output DestinationResourceBindingRootV1, and planned root; self-free PublicationIntent binding those principals/key/expected paths; actual pre-seal as planned plus intent and no Seal; ProvenDurablePreSealV2; DurablePublicationIdentityV2 binding resource plus planned/actual roots; Seal; final commit; PublishedBundleReceiptV2; recovery resource rebind/reverification; then the exact twelve-field DurableCommandResultV2. No result_root, duplicated manifest/seal, receipt lifecycle row, partial/second frame, or feedback is allowed.

This leaf owns the replay schemas, typed integration APIs, immutable exact-set manifest rows, fixtures, expected roots, replay-specific checked results, and replay-specific bounded event payloads contributed to `scripts/ci/canonical_evidence_runner_v2.sh`. The 24.4.1.4 harness is the sole script, native-driver, RunnerE2EHarnessEventV1 schema, shard-plan, and aggregate owner; this leaf neither edits those files nor constructs their shared schemas. It contributes only replay/publication integration schema, constructor, owner rows, and source-closed replay cells once to RunnerPhase4SchemaOwnershipManifestV2.

## Canonical-script contribution boundary

Replay contributes exact registered rows and typed integration surfaces to the canonical script and native driver owned by 24.4.1.4. It never edits the script. Progress observation is tested as a nonsemantic replay invariant.

## Final controlling evaluator provenance in replay

Current-wire replay preserves or independently recomputes the complete Presented-to-validated evaluation chain: presented observation/snapshot roots; optional validated roots; registry-view root; mechanically derived requirements root; both context roots; retained lane errors/details/outcomes; raw-outcome root; and conformance-verdict root. It never normalizes a source Negative mismatch/error into Match, rebuilds an outcome from visible tags, drops a validated-root absence reason, or substitutes a current ambient registry. Byte-identical source semantics under the same sealed spec reproduce the exact chain; any disagreement refuses before destination publication.

Migrated replay keeps the original retained source bytes/roots and migration observation separate, then constructs the current-wire chain under the selected registered adapter and current sealed definitions. It does not assert cross-wire root equality. The current chain must still pass the same independent requirements/registry/context/evaluation verification and preserve the source durable command, claim mode, exact expected outcome, and no-claim boundary.

This leaf contributes immutable source Run, source Negative mismatch, source Negative evaluator-error, nested replay, simultaneous-defect, and context-substitution rows to the canonical-script owner; it neither edits nor re-owns that script. Replay preserves the complete acyclic evaluator chain, not merely visible outcome tags.
