Registered migration may transform legacy wire frames only under the exact adapter descriptor and MigrationObservation; independent decoding must reconstruct the target CaseEvaluationKey/precontext/spec/manifest/context/outcome chain and preserve the retained original. An adapter cannot wildcard an expectation, normalize a source Negative into Run or Match/Match, change fixture presence, replace a nested expected frame with an actual error/detail root, collapse presented and validated roots, or rebind actual contexts to a different case/ordinal/registry/expression/requirements set. Newly authored Run remains absent-fixture Match/Match; source Run/Negative/Check/SelfTest semantics and ExerciseOnly no-claim remain exact.

The new replay InvocationRootV2/RunIdV2 and destination publication do not feed backward into source case/evaluator frames. The replay lifecycle header may bind the new invocation/run, while its CaseTerminalBasis consumes the verified retained current semantic case roots. ArtifactSet projection remains scoped by both CaseEvaluationKey case ID and manifest ordinal; right-ID/wrong-ordinal, wrong-ID/right-ordinal, cross-case, and cross-registry entries refuse even when visible roles/digests match.

Replay execution consumes the release `canonical-evidence-runner-v2`, exact RunnerVersionDocumentV1 dependency facts, the external RunnerLaunchContextV1 bootstrap for disjoint input/output/progress capabilities, native argv/interrupt/deadline/exit observations, and CommandResultTransportFrameV1. Durable replay attempts no stdout before destination commit/recovery; zero/truncated/full transport outcomes follow the shared nominal context-root contract, and fresh-channel retry re-emits the identical frame after exact recovery. Native interrupts use CallerCancellation/StopKey; different real wall-time observation checkpoints may move lifecycle roots and are outside bit-stability, while a fixed retained logical schedule is deterministic.

This leaf still does not own or edit `scripts/ci/canonical_evidence_runner_v2.sh`, its native driver, the shared harness-event schema, or its shard/aggregate machinery. It contributes immutable replay cell rows, replay-specific checked expectations, and bounded redacted event payloads to the 24.4.1.4 owner. Each row has a stable ID, exact source/build/version/schema/provider/platform/migration/evaluator/artifact/publication dependencies, explicit time/memory/work/process/artifact/log caps, and expected positive/refusal/Unsupported result. The owner may partition them into deterministic ordinal-range shards; legal repartition/resume cannot change the sorted per-cell aggregate. Missing, duplicate, overlapping, stale, mixed-root, silently skipped, or result-contaminated contributions fail.

Complete replay-result transport correction: `command_result_stdout_bytes` caps the entire canonical `CommandResultTransportFrameV1`, including fixed header and encoded replay-result payload. The replay publisher separately checks payload length and checked header-plus-payload total during pure preflight and after receipt re-encoding; transport overhead never enters PublicationAccounting or any replay/evaluator/authority identity.

CAPABILITY-ROLE UX (CONTROLLING). Diagnostics and logs retain only option name, semantic role, stable policy/profile/classification roots, and placeholders; raw capability references, locators, handles, provider payloads, credentials, and environment values remain forbidden.

title: Runner V2 seven-fixture conformance and canonical receipt rollup
description:
Closeout-only rollup for one early result-free seven-fixture specification/source-closure corpus rollup, seven bounded `publish = false` release fixtures—sparse invocation, typed performance ratio, statistical campaign, theorem/certificate, ledger durability, portfolio activation, and vertical product—and the final CanonicalEvidenceRunnerV2Receipt exact-set join.

This rollup implements no corpus row or generator, fixture, adapter, process harness, replay engine, family mode, lifecycle, publication primitive, receipt constructor, scientific checker, test cell, or admission service. Its children preserve the complete representative feature set without claiming that not-yet-implemented production families adopted Runner.

## Acceptance Criteria

All nine direct children—eight implementation leaves and the nested eight-leaf corpus rollup—plus all corpus grandchildren close on exact current roots with comprehensive retained tests/E2E-or-contribution, independent replay, deterministic logs/redaction, source closure, and honest authority boundaries.

## Success Criteria

Sixteen implementation leaves and the nested corpus rollup satisfy their dedicated close gates on exact roots; this rollup reconciles them without implementing a competing family, selector, replay path, corpus generator, or receipt.

title: Runner V2 sparse-invocation release fixture
description:
Build the publish=false release fixture for sparse invocation conformance, with an exact `family.*` namespace with a separate family version, bounded modes/cases/artifacts, pinned executable binding, replay, mutations, and no-scientific-authority scope. The dedicated Acceptance Criteria field will be the canonical close gate.

## Acceptance Criteria

The dedicated Acceptance Criteria field is the canonical complete close gate. It preserves the domain-specific gate and the common nine-group unit/property/model/race/mutation/API/fault/E2E-or-contribution/logging/source-closure protocol; no description shorthand, checkpoint, parent status, aggregate count, or partial proof can replace it.
design:
This leaf owns one bounded `publish = false` fixture crate, `fs-evidence-runner-fixture-sparse`, and its release binary `runner-v2-fixture-sparse-v1`. It demonstrates Runner extension mechanics with real public sparse-fixture code; it does not claim that fs-sparse or any production sparse family has adopted Runner.

Row-specification child 24.4.3.9.1 freezes one checked upstream `FamilySpecV2` plus one test-only catalog identity: u16 family_id 61697 (0xF101); namespace `family.runner_fixture.sparse-invocation`; separate family_version 1; decision-detail namespace `family.runner_fixture.sparse-invocation.decision-detail`; diagnostic namespace prefix `family.runner_fixture.sparse-invocation.diagnostic.`; executable descriptor ID `family.runner_fixture.sparse-invocation.executable-descriptor.fixture-family`; executable binding ID `family.runner_fixture.sparse-invocation.executable-binding.fixture-family`; nominal owner/source/build roots `SparseInvocationFixtureOwnerRootV1`, `SparseInvocationFixtureSourceClosureRootV1`, and `SparseInvocationFixtureBuildRootV1` with registered IDs `family.runner_fixture.sparse-invocation.root.family-owner`, `family.runner_fixture.sparse-invocation.root.source-closure`, and `family.runner_fixture.sparse-invocation.root.build`; policy ID `family.runner_fixture.sparse-invocation.policy.no-claim`; extension schema IDs `family.runner_fixture.sparse-invocation.schema.invocation-observation` and `family.runner_fixture.sparse-invocation.schema.cancellation-observation`; empty fixture-owned unit registry consuming only upstream typed units; and no_claim_scope `runner-conformance-only:no-production-sparse-adoption,no-numerical-authority,no-performance-authority,no-admission-authority`.

Exact mode IDs are `family.runner_fixture.sparse-invocation.mode.csr-spmv`, `family.runner_fixture.sparse-invocation.mode.sell-spmv`, and `family.runner_fixture.sparse-invocation.mode.bsr-spmm`; short labels are display-only and this leaf cannot register `all`. Smoke cases are `family.runner_fixture.sparse-invocation.case.csr-spmv.empty-shape`, `family.runner_fixture.sparse-invocation.case.csr-spmv.singleton`, and `family.runner_fixture.sparse-invocation.case.csr-spmv.rectangular-partitioned`. Full adds `family.runner_fixture.sparse-invocation.case.sell-spmv.singleton`, `family.runner_fixture.sparse-invocation.case.sell-spmv.rectangular-partitioned`, `family.runner_fixture.sparse-invocation.case.sell-spmv.cancel-after-logical-tile`, `family.runner_fixture.sparse-invocation.case.bsr-spmm.singleton`, `family.runner_fixture.sparse-invocation.case.bsr-spmm.rectangular-partitioned`, and `family.runner_fixture.sparse-invocation.case.bsr-spmm.cancel-after-logical-tile`. Exact Negative IDs are `family.runner_fixture.sparse-invocation.negative.unknown-format`, `family.runner_fixture.sparse-invocation.negative.partition-root-mismatch`, `family.runner_fixture.sparse-invocation.negative.cancel-basis-mismatch`, and `family.runner_fixture.sparse-invocation.negative.artifact-role-missing`.

Exact artifact roles are `family.runner_fixture.sparse-invocation.artifact.matrix`, `family.runner_fixture.sparse-invocation.artifact.rhs`, `family.runner_fixture.sparse-invocation.artifact.partition-plan`, `family.runner_fixture.sparse-invocation.artifact.invocation-observation`, `family.runner_fixture.sparse-invocation.artifact.output`, and `family.runner_fixture.sparse-invocation.artifact.cancellation-observation`. The fixture preserves dimensions, format token, logical partition/tile identity, checked work counts, cancellation basis, typed expected/observed values, and all three artifact integrity layers; it cannot flatten them to a Boolean. Every family-owned mode, case, Negative, diagnostic, role, domain, policy, unit, schema, descriptor, decision-detail, executable, and registered-root ID begins with the exact family namespace; short display labels never enter canonical bytes.

The binary is resolved through 24.4.1 ExecutableBindingV2 with role `fixture-family`, release profile, exact target/features/source/build/content roots, no network, no shell/PATH lookup, and only declared input/output/process capabilities. It uses the canonical Run/Negative grammar with `--bundle-rel`, emits a durable result only after verified publication, and is replayed by 24.4.2.3 from a disjoint root across every supported protocol/mode cell. Check/SelfTest behavior is shared Runner behavior and uses `LifecycleOnlyNoBundle`; this fixture adds no local command or terminal state.

## Final controlling early-corpus consumption and late execution ownership

This execution leaf exact-set consumes its SparseInvocation row root from 24.4.3.9.1, aggregate `RunnerV2FixtureSpecificationCorpusV1` root from 24.4.3.9.8, and compatible reconciliation root from 24.4.3.9. Row child 24.4.3.9.1 owns only immutable result-free family/case/input definitions, expected CaseEvaluationKey/fixture/precontext/nested-frame topology, independent-oracle specification, mutation/cell catalogs, platform prerequisites, budgets, log schema, and source closure. This leaf remains the sole owner of the SparseInvocation executable independent-oracle implementation, contained release execution, current/nested/migrated replay cells, actual-context/outcome verification, retained runtime artifacts, context-bound execution/result roots, and contribution to the canonical release-script owner. Any earlier wording assigning static corpus ownership here is superseded only for preparation data; every domain feature, falsifier, mutation, E2E case, detailed-log field, and no-claim boundary remains mandatory.

Before execution, this leaf independently reconstructs and validates the consumed row and all transitive schema/source/oracle/mutation/cell roots. It cannot edit or redeclare the row, substitute another fixture, treat a source/golden/count as execution, or collapse root-free expected values into actual evaluator roots. Execution produces a distinct context-bound manifest tied to the exact release artifact, source/build/toolchain/target/features, platform/provider, shard plan, semantic budgets, environmental deadline observation, canonical logs, and retained relative artifacts. The late replay dependency remains a real close gate.

## Operator repair contract

Every user-visible Refused or Unsupported outcome owned or contributed by this leaf, and every unexpected divergence while executing a Negative case, carries exactly one bounded `ActionableDiagnosticV2` selected from the sealed diagnostic table. The diagnostic binds its registered code, precise redacted typed expected/observed values, owning component, retryability, exact prerequisites, no-claim scope, and one or more uniquely ranked `RepairActionV2` values within the upstream per-action, per-diagnostic, stderr, and count bounds. Repairs are deterministic declarative data for a human or orchestrator to consider; they may not contain or execute shell commands, callbacks, scripts, credentials, raw capability references, physical paths, live handles, provider payloads, or automatic mutations. Unsupported repairs name the missing platform/provider/capability prerequisite and a safe verification step; Refused repairs name the smallest semantic input or policy correction; Negative-case repairs distinguish an intentionally matched negative expectation, which remains Pass and is never mislabeled as a defect, from an unexpected key/precontext/detail/lane/result divergence that requires correction.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Handwritten literal oracles assert family ID, all namespaces/versions, package/binary/binding IDs, owner/source/build roots, exact modes, Smoke/Full case matrices, Negative IDs, artifact roles, diagnostic prefix, bounds, and no-claim string. Missing/extra/duplicate/reordered/colliding entries fail. Namespace grammar tests reject every reserved prefix, the retired `org.frankensim.fs-evidence-runner.*`, embedded `.v1`, missing `family.`, fewer than two following StableTokenV2 segments, unqualified short ID, cross-family prefix, and namespace/version alias; display labels never enter canonical bytes. A shared exact-set length oracle enumerates every declared phase-4 fixture ID, proves the maximum declared fixture ID length is 90 bytes and therefore within the widened 128-byte StableTokenV2 cap, and exercises 127-byte, exact-128-byte, and one-over-129-byte boundaries; 129 bytes refuses before registration. Every schema and constructor row owned by this leaf is included exactly once in `RunnerPhase4SchemaOwnershipManifestV2`; no row is inserted into `RunnerSpecV2`, `RunnerPhase1SchemaOwnershipRegistryV2`, or another phase manifest. `StableTokenV2` length is measured over lowercase ASCII bytes: exact-set oracles reject uppercase, non-ASCII, Unicode normalization variants, confusable spellings, and invalid separators; independently verify the existing maximum declared fixture ID is 90 bytes <= 128; and reject 129 bytes.

2. Unit/boundary tests cover empty, singleton, rectangular, zero-row/zero-column, checked dimension/product overflow, malformed sparse indices, duplicate entries, partition boundaries, tile zero/one/max, cancellation before/after a logical tile, typed value/unit widths, and one-below/exact/one-over every fixture cap.

3. Property/metamorphic tests permute canonical input storage, equivalent partition descriptions, worker schedules, host roots, independent CLI option order, and artifact chunking while preserving semantic roots. Changing a matrix value, format, partition/tile identity, cancellation basis, mode/case, target/features, or binding moves the owning root.

4. A deterministic state/model suite explores every invocation -> observation -> artifact -> publication transition, cancellation at each barrier, output-cap refusal, clean/dirty EOF, retry, and disjoint replay. Every started tile is accounted exactly once and all losing or stopped work drains.

5. Mutation tests alter every descriptor field, mode/case membership, sparse dimension/index/value, partition root, work count, cancellation observation, artifact role/root/length, expected/observed/effect row, diagnostic, no-claim, executable binding, and source/build root. Producer, independent verifier, and replay must each kill the relevant mutant.

6. API/compile-fail tests reject family-defined lifecycle/terminal/refusal states, `all`, arbitrary executable paths, public receipt/seal construction, collapsed content hashes, generic booleans, untyped numeric values, post-seal mutation, and conversion to sparse/scientific/rjoq authority. Positive tests use only frozen extension/public constructors.

7. Release-built no-mock E2E runs every Smoke/Full cell through the exact durable grammar with explicit `--publication-protocol PROTOCOL --destination-mode DESTINATION_MODE --artifact-root ROOT_CAPABILITY_REF --bundle-rel BUNDLE_REL`, every exact Negative ID, cancellation/fault cases, and 24.4.2.3 artifact-only replay with disjoint tagged input/output capabilities. It covers the exact three-protocol/two-mode matrix with capability-present Supported and capability-missing Unsupported realizations; it rejects raw roots and retired aliases, and never invokes fs-sparse production code. Matrix-right tests require Posix/Windows `PreExistingEmpty` code 5 `PopulateEmptyDestination`, reject `ReplaceEmptyDestination` and lease acquisition, and require ContentStore `PreExistingEmpty` exact `Enumerate` plus `AcquireExclusiveLease`; no third admission mode exists.

8. Independent replay recomputes dimensions, partition/work/cancellation observations, expected/observed/effects, lifecycle, all artifact layers, whole-publication accounting, inventory, manifest, pre-seal, seal, published receipt, and durable result. Source/producer/tracker tripwires remain uncalled.

9. Canonical JSONL logs retain family identity, binding/source/build roots, mode/case, dimensions/format/partition/tile, typed work/budgets/caps, cancellation/drain, expected/observed/effects, evaluator/aggregate basis, every artifact/publication root and length, protocol/mode, diagnostic/exit/retry/no-claim, and a canonical reproduction template with capability placeholders, exact semantic arguments/roots/seeds, and fresh-capability acquisition steps. They exclude secrets, absolute roots, PIDs, wall time, scheduler noise, and raw bulk arrays.

10. Literal, unit, boundary, property/metamorphic, model, mutation, compile-fail, cancellation/fault, no-mock E2E, independent replay, publication, and logging categories expose nonzero checked counts and retained roots. Fixture conformance, platform proof, DSR proof, and any future fs-sparse scientific proof remain separate statuses.

11. Source-closure tests exact-set-bind every file and generated input owned or consumed by this leaf: implementation modules, CONTRACT/rustdoc, schema/domain/descriptor and constructor tables, independent oracles, unit/property/mutation fixtures, E2E case-manifest rows, log schemas, direct dependency/source/feature identities, and build configuration. One-at-a-time missing, extra, stale, reordered, ambient, unpinned, duplicate-owner, or mixed-snapshot inputs move the closure or refuse before proof; no retained binary/root can stand in for absent source. The leaf coverage manifest reports distinct source-closure ID sets and checked counts for eligible positives and matched positives; eligible expected refusals and matched expected refusals; eligible expected failures and matched expected failures; and eligible mutations and matched mutations; exact Unsupported and inapplicable reasons; zero unexpected mismatches, execution failures, and unexplained skips; the exact source/build roots; and retained relative evidence paths.

12. Early-corpus handoff and late-execution tests exact-set consume the SparseInvocation row root from 24.4.3.9.1, aggregate corpus root from 24.4.3.9.8, and compatible reconciliation root from 24.4.3.9; independently rebuild every transitive input/schema/key/fixture/precontext/nested expectation/oracle-spec/mutation/cell/budget/platform/log/source root; and reject missing, extra, duplicate, stale, remapped, cross-fixture, result-contaminated, source-path-as-artifact, invented-root, or count-substituted rows. Real release-built execution implements the independent oracle, exercises every original positive/expected-refusal/expected-failure/mutation/replay/platform cell under exact budgets and native prerequisites, retains actual contexts and results separately from root-free expectations, and emits distinct context-bound execution/log/artifact roots. Unit/property/model/mutation/compile-fail/no-mock E2E/detailed-log/coverage/source-closure partitions are nonzero, every eligible stable ID appears once, Unsupported is typed, and unexpected mismatches are zero.

13. Operator-repair UX proof exact-sets every user-visible Refused and Unsupported path plus every matched and divergent Negative path against the sealed diagnostic table. Literal, unit, boundary, property/model, mutation, API/compile-fail, release-built no-mock E2E contribution, deterministic detailed-log, coverage, and source-closure tests separately exercise diagnostic size/count exact/one-over limits; stable rank and tie-breaking; owner/retryability/prerequisite/no-claim accuracy; redacted expected/observed values; safe non-executable repairs; and expected-Negative Pass semantics. Missing, extra, duplicate, unranked, unstable, executable, secret-bearing, raw-path/capability/handle/provider-bearing, wrong-owner, wrong-prerequisite, authority-widening, or auto-applied repair data fails. Logs retain diagnostic/root/code/rank and symbolic safe verification steps without sensitive payloads, and exact result partitions require matched positives and expected refusals, typed Unsupported, and zero unexpected mismatches or unexplained skips.

14. LEAF RESULT-PARTITION CLOSE GATE. Every coverage manifest and owned or contributed E2E suite reports distinct exact ID sets and checked counts for eligible and matched positives; eligible and matched expected refusals; eligible and matched expected failures; eligible and matched mutations; typed Unsupported cells with exact matched reasons; typed inapplicable cells with exact matched registered reasons; unexpected mismatches; execution failures; and unexplained skips. Checked aggregate adversarial totals are sums of the three adversarial subpartitions and never replace them. Green requires every eligible stable ID exactly once, nonzero applicable positive and adversarial corpora, equality within every eligible and matched subpartition, exact reason equality, and zero unexpected mismatches, execution failures, and unexplained skips. An expected failure is not an execution failure, a mutation is not a refusal, empty or subset execution cannot be green, and contribution-only rows cannot claim downstream execution.

15. GLOBAL REALITY-CHECK CLOSE-MANIFEST RECONCILIATION (CONTROLLING). Earlier `eligible`/`passed`/`failed` shorthand and any single collapsed `matched expected refusals` counter are compatibility-only and cannot close this leaf. The leaf must expose one result-free, source-authoritative, full-set-only close manifest that exact-sets every stable test and E2E cell into all nine preserved category groups: literal/unit/boundary; property/metamorphic; state/typestate/model/race; mutation/fuzz; API/compile-fail/trait; fault/resource/cancellation; release-built no-mock E2E or immutable E2E contribution; detailed deterministic logging/redaction; and source closure. Each applicable category and each applicable slash-separated facet has a separately nonzero corpus. A genuinely inapplicable facet requires a registered typed reason with stable code/name, exact owner, execution scope, prerequisite, and no-claim text; it cannot hide an eligible cell.

Result accounting retains distinct counters and exact ID sets for: eligible positives and matched positives; eligible expected refusals and matched expected refusals; eligible expected failures and matched expected failures; eligible mutations and matched mutations; typed Unsupported cells with exact matched reasons; typed inapplicable cells with exact matched registered reasons; unexpected mismatches; execution failures; and unexplained skips. It also reports checked aggregate adversarial totals as the sums of the three adversarial subpartitions without replacing them. Green requires each matched subpartition to equal its own eligible subpartition, every eligible stable ID exactly once in canonical order, nonzero applicable positive and adversarial corpora, exact Unsupported/inapplicable reason equality, and zero unexpected mismatches, execution failures, and unexplained skips. An expected failure is never an execution failure, a mutation is never relabeled as a refusal, and an empty/subset selection can never be green. Missing, extra, duplicate, reordered, stale, reclassified, wrong-reason, or wrong-scope manifest/result rows refuse structurally.

Where this leaf owns execution, comprehensive unit/integration/property/model/race/fault/mutation/API tests and the named E2E script run release-built with no mocks. Where execution belongs downstream, this leaf instead emits immutable stable rows binding independent literal expectations/oracles, semantic inputs, explicit time/memory/work/process/artifact/log budgets, schema and log-schema roots, source/build roots, exact downstream owner and script, and no-claim scope; it cannot report that downstream execution passed. E2E tests cover happy, boundary, expected-refusal, expected-failure, mutation, Unsupported, inapplicable, cancellation/drain, resource-return, and hidden-skip cases with deterministic stable IDs and exact first divergence.

Canonical bounded logs retain stable cell/category/facet IDs; semantic-input, source, build, schema, oracle, budget, manifest, and execution roots; ordered stage observations and terminal stage; expected/observed classification; first-divergence ID/root; resource and drain outcomes; exact result partitions; ranked non-executable repair manifest; no-claim scope; and safe relative retained-artifact references. They reject or type-redact secrets, credentials, environment values, live capabilities, raw resources/handles, absolute or physical paths, PIDs, wall clock, scheduler noise, and bulk payloads. Rejection diagnostics retain only a stable redacted data class and must not echo the sentinel through `observed`, Display, Debug, canonical bytes, logs, or reproduction text. Logging tests cover zero/one/exact/one-over limits, checked overflow, missing/extra/duplicate/reordered/truncated events, wrong roots/counts/reasons, redaction for every forbidden class, and deterministic replay.

Every user-visible Refused, Unsupported, divergent Negative, expected failure, and unexpected mismatch carries one bounded deterministic actionable diagnostic with registered code, precise redacted typed expected/observed values, owner, retryability, exact prerequisites, no-claim scope, and uniquely ranked declarative repairs. Repairs cannot contain or invoke commands, callbacks, scripts, credentials, raw capabilities/resources/handles/provider payloads, physical paths/locators, or automatic mutations. Source closure exact-sets all implementation, contract/rustdoc, schema/domain/owner tables, independent oracles, fixtures, E2E manifests/scripts or contribution rows, log schemas, dependencies/features, and build configuration on one compatible stable snapshot. Closeout reports focused proof, release-built E2E or contribution proof, source closure, DSR, and any downstream/scientific/authority proof separately and never promotes one into another.

16. CONTROLLING INDEPENDENT SPARSE-SEMANTICS ORACLE. Each CSR-SpMV, SELL-SpMV, and BSR-SpMM mode includes at least one tiny literal fixture whose output, checked work count, partition/tile trace, and cancellation prefix are derived independently by hand or by a structurally separate dense/exact-arithmetic oracle. Producer and oracle may not share sparse multiply, index canonicalization, partitioning, or accumulation helpers. The fixture contract freezes duplicate-index handling, zero-dimension behavior, block, stride, and layout interpretation, accumulation order, overflow behavior, and IEEE nonfinite and signed-zero handling where the declared value type admits them; genuinely inapplicable facets receive typed reasons. Mutations of one index, value, block coordinate, rhs entry, accumulation order, tile boundary, or output entry must be killed independently by producer verification and replay. This remains fixture conformance and mints no numerical authority.

Build the publish=false release fixture for commit, recovery, idempotency, and competing-writer durability conformance without claiming fs-ledger adoption. The dedicated Acceptance Criteria field will be the canonical close gate.

## Acceptance Criteria

The dedicated Acceptance Criteria field is the canonical complete close gate. It preserves the domain-specific gate and the common nine-group unit/property/model/race/mutation/API/fault/E2E-or-contribution/logging/source-closure protocol; no description shorthand, checkpoint, parent status, aggregate count, or partial proof can replace it.
design:
This leaf owns the bounded `publish = false` crate `fs-evidence-runner-fixture-ledger` and release binary `runner-v2-fixture-ledger-v1`. It uses a fixture-owned deterministic journal/state machine and real scoped filesystem operations to exercise commit, crash, recovery, idempotency, and contention evidence. It does not depend on or claim adoption by fs-ledger, FrankenSQLite, or any production transaction engine, and it cannot certify durability outside its fixture contract.

Row-specification child 24.4.3.9.5 freezes one checked upstream `FamilySpecV2` plus one test-only catalog identity: u16 family_id 61701 (0xF105); namespace `family.runner_fixture.ledger-durability`; separate family_version 1; decision-detail namespace `family.runner_fixture.ledger-durability.decision-detail`; diagnostic prefix `family.runner_fixture.ledger-durability.diagnostic.`; executable descriptor ID `family.runner_fixture.ledger-durability.executable-descriptor.fixture-family`; executable binding ID `family.runner_fixture.ledger-durability.executable-binding.fixture-family`; nominal owner/source/build roots `LedgerDurabilityFixtureOwnerRootV1`, `LedgerDurabilityFixtureSourceClosureRootV1`, and `LedgerDurabilityFixtureBuildRootV1` with registered IDs `family.runner_fixture.ledger-durability.root.family-owner`, `family.runner_fixture.ledger-durability.root.source-closure`, and `family.runner_fixture.ledger-durability.root.build`; policy ID `family.runner_fixture.ledger-durability.policy.no-claim`; extension schema IDs `family.runner_fixture.ledger-durability.schema.journal-observation` and `family.runner_fixture.ledger-durability.schema.recovery-trace`; empty fixture-owned unit registry consuming upstream byte/record/count units; and no_claim_scope `runner-conformance-only:no-fs-ledger-adoption,no-database-durability-authority,no-transaction-certification,no-scientific-authority,no-admission-authority`.

Exact Negative IDs are `family.runner_fixture.ledger-durability.negative.idempotency-root-mismatch`, `family.runner_fixture.ledger-durability.negative.commit-sequence-gap`, `family.runner_fixture.ledger-durability.negative.recovery-lineage-mismatch`, and `family.runner_fixture.ledger-durability.negative.competing-writer-double-commit`.

Exact artifact roles are `family.runner_fixture.ledger-durability.artifact.mutation-intent`, `family.runner_fixture.ledger-durability.artifact.journal-observation`, `family.runner_fixture.ledger-durability.artifact.sync-plan`, `family.runner_fixture.ledger-durability.artifact.commit-observation`, `family.runner_fixture.ledger-durability.artifact.recovery-trace`, `family.runner_fixture.ledger-durability.artifact.idempotency-record`, and `family.runner_fixture.ledger-durability.artifact.contention-schedule`. Artifacts retain logical transaction/key/writer identities, ordered records, sync/rename/commit boundaries, pre/post roots, exact fault point, recovery classification, and expected/observed/effects; they never collapse to a Boolean. Every family-owned mode, case, Negative, diagnostic, role, domain, policy, unit, schema, descriptor, decision-detail, executable, and registered-root ID begins with the exact family namespace; display labels remain nonsemantic.

The pinned release binding grants only its capability-scoped fixture directory, bounded child process execution required for crash injection, and declared publication capabilities; it denies network, PATH/shell, ambient database files, and caller data deletion. ## Final controlling early-corpus consumption and late execution ownership

This execution leaf exact-set consumes its LedgerDurability row root from 24.4.3.9.5, aggregate `RunnerV2FixtureSpecificationCorpusV1` root from 24.4.3.9.8, and compatible reconciliation root from 24.4.3.9. Any earlier wording assigning static corpus ownership here is superseded only for preparation data; every domain feature, falsifier, mutation, E2E case, detailed-log field, and no-claim boundary remains mandatory.

Before execution, this leaf independently reconstructs and validates the consumed row and all transitive schema/source/oracle/mutation/cell roots. It cannot edit or redeclare the row, substitute another fixture, treat a source/golden/count as execution, or collapse root-free expected values into actual evaluator roots. ## Operator repair contract

Every user-visible Refused or Unsupported outcome owned or contributed by this leaf, and every unexpected divergence while executing a Negative case, carries exactly one bounded `ActionableDiagnosticV2` selected from the sealed diagnostic table. The diagnostic binds its registered code, precise redacted typed expected/observed values, owning component, retryability, exact prerequisites, no-claim scope, and one or more uniquely ranked `RepairActionV2` values within the upstream per-action, per-diagnostic, stderr, and count bounds. Repairs are deterministic declarative data for a human or orchestrator to consider; they may not contain or execute shell commands, callbacks, scripts, credentials, raw capability references, physical paths, live handles, provider payloads, or automatic mutations. Unsupported repairs name the missing platform/provider/capability prerequisite and a safe verification step; Refused repairs name the smallest semantic input or policy correction; Negative-case repairs distinguish an intentionally matched negative expectation, which remains Pass and is never mislabeled as a defect, from an unexpected key/precontext/detail/lane/result divergence that requires correction.

title: Runner V2 result-free seven-fixture specification corpus rollup
description:
Exact-set proof-and-ownership rollup over eight result-free fixture-corpus children: seven independent immutable row-specification/source-closure leaves for SparseInvocation, TypedPerformanceRatio, StatisticalCampaign, TheoremAndCertificate, LedgerDurability, PortfolioActivation, and VerticalProductJourney; plus one exact-set aggregate corpus join and release-built corpus-generator driver.

The child union freezes complete result-free specifications, stable identities, independent-oracle contracts, platform/budget metadata, mutation catalogs, consumer handoffs, deterministic logs, and source closure early enough to proceed in parallel with publication, process, and replay implementation. Only child 24.4.3.9.8 executes corpus generation. This rollup owns no row, generator, fixture executable, runtime result, publication, replay, verifier, receipt, scientific claim, admission, or authority and closes only by exact-set joining the eight child close manifests on one compatible snapshot.

## Success Criteria

The dedicated Acceptance Criteria field is the authoritative exact-set rollup gate. Every direct child must close on one compatible source/build/proof snapshot with its complete test or contribution, release-built E2E, deterministic-log, result-partition, and source-closure roots; the rollup owns no implementation and cannot replace a missing child, proof class, or no-claim boundary with status, prose, or aggregate counts.
design:
CONTROLLING OWNERSHIP PROJECTION. Corpus ownership is fixed: 24.4.3.9.1-.7 each own exactly one result-free fixture row, its declarative oracle specification, cell catalog, downstream contribution, deterministic log contract, and source closure; .9.8 owns the aggregate corpus schema/value/root, exact seven-row join, validation manifest, independent aggregate oracles, sole release-built corpus-generator driver and routes, aggregate logs, and aggregate source closure. Parent 24.4.3.9 owns only the exact eight-child rollup manifest and no row, generator, schema constructor, source closure, or E2E execution.

Children 24.4.3.9.1-.7 move their seven result-free fixture rows ahead of the late replay gate without moving any execution or authority claim. Aggregate child 24.4.3.9.8 singularly owns the joined seven-fixture corpus, shared fixture-input schemas, aggregate stable-cell/result catalogs, independent aggregate-oracle catalog, aggregate mutation catalog, platform-prerequisite and budget catalogs, aggregate source closure, and consumer map. The eight implementation children consume the closed phase-1 Runner schemas and public constructors after 24.1; it owns no capability acquisition, publisher, process spawn/containment, adapter, replay execution, semantic verifier result, downstream script, canonical receipt, scientific authority, or rjoq admission.

`RunnerV2FixtureSpecificationCorpusV1` is a result-free non-production test manifest with exact domain `org.frankensim.fs-evidence-runner.fixture-specification-corpus.v1` and SourceClosure role. Its ordered fields are: API generation; wire version; corpus schema version; phase-1 schema rollup root; ordered duplicate-rejected fixture specification rows; shared canonical input-schema root; independent-oracle-specification catalog root; mutation-catalog root; stable-cell catalog root; platform-prerequisite catalog root; semantic-budget catalog root; deterministic-log schema root; corpus source-closure root; corpus build identity root; and no-claim scope. It contains no execution result, observed outcome, process/publication/replay/verifier/receipt root, retained runtime artifact claim, generic digest, callback, script, locator, capability, or authority.

`RunnerV2FixtureSpecificationV1` exact ordered fields are: stable fixture ID; ordinal; fixture kind; downstream execution-owner Bead ID; family namespace/version; family/mode/profile/command matrix; source-closed family/case/spec/input definition root; expected CaseEvaluationKey/fixture/precontext/nested-outcome topology specification; replay/migration scenario specification; independent oracle specification root; exact positive/expected-refusal/expected-failure/mutation stable cell IDs; target/platform/provider prerequisites; semantic compute/memory/output/resource budgets; separate environmental wall deadline and no-cross-run-timing claim; expected conformance/no-claim class; fixture source-closure root; and row no-claim scope. Expected root-free values remain typed nested data covered by the case/spec definition root; this corpus never invents CaseEvaluationKeyRoot, EvaluationPrecontextRoot, or expected-frame roots.

The exact seven rows and consumers are: 1 SparseInvocation -> 24.4.3.1; 2 TypedPerformanceRatio -> 24.4.3.2; 3 StatisticalCampaign -> 24.4.3.3; 4 TheoremAndCertificate -> 24.4.3.4; 5 LedgerDurability -> 24.4.3.5; 6 PortfolioActivation -> 24.4.3.6; and 7 VerticalProductJourney -> 24.4.3.7. Each row preserves every domain-specific fixture, oracle, mutation, replay, logging, and no-claim requirement already assigned to its consumer. Shared schema facts may be referenced once, but domain inputs/oracles/cells remain distinct and cannot be collapsed into a generic smoke test.

Preparation is topologically early and execution-free. The corpus uses real checked phase-1 constructors to freeze family definitions, CaseEvaluationKey-bound fixtures, root-free expectation precontexts/nested frames, CaseConformanceSpec, CaseManifest, and static replay scenario descriptors. It may independently recompute their expected roots from immutable inputs. It cannot invoke a family executable, resolve a bootstrap slot, publish, simulate a successful process/replay/verifier result, or claim a later script ran. Source files and future script paths use separate typed fields and cannot masquerade as retained runtime artifacts.

Independent oracle specifications are declarative algorithms/data with exact units, assumptions, tolerances, input domains, expected classifications, falsifiers, and no-claim boundaries. They cannot import the production evaluator/process/replay/verifier implementation under test or contain executable callbacks. Later consumer leaves implement/run independently reviewed oracles and bind a separate execution root. A specification root, golden expectation, or generated fixture is never proof that the oracle or journey executed.

Stable cells are globally unique and source-closed. Each cell binds fixture ID, scenario, platform/provider prerequisites, semantic budget, environmental deadline, expected result class, expected typed refusal/Unsupported reason where applicable, required log fields, downstream owner, and source inputs. The corpus defines deterministic shard inputs but no completed shard: partition and resume results are constructed only by later script owners. Missing, extra, duplicate, reordered, stale, mixed-source/build/schema, cross-fixture, budgetless, ownerless, or result-contaminated cells refuse.

Every consumer 24.4.3.1-.7 must exact-set consume its matching row root from 24.4.3.9.1-.7, the aggregate corpus root from 24.4.3.9.8, and the compatible reconciliation root from 24.4.3.9 and independently verify all transitive source/schema/oracle/mutation/cell roots before execution. It then produces a distinct context-bound execution manifest and real release/replay result roots; it may not mutate the source row, substitute a count, inherit another fixture's execution, or report the corpus source path as evidence. The seven consumers remain blocked on the real replay stack for closeout, while the eight-child corpus subtree and its reconciliation rollup can close before downstream execution and make immutable preparation reviewable in parallel.

Child 24.4.3.9.8 owns the release-built corpus-generation E2E, which is a TOOL-only test route with one source-closed native companion binary `runner-v2-fixture-corpus-e2e-driver`, one thin POSIX coordinator `scripts/ci/e2e_runner_v2_fixture_corpus.sh`, and direct native driver invocation on Windows. Both routes consume one immutable sorted seven-row cell manifest and the exact DSR artifact identities supplied by the owning build handoff; the shell contains no second case list, encoder, oracle, shard rule, or result classifier. It calls real public phase-1 constructors and independent encoders, emits only the result-free corpus and closed canonical logs, reruns byte-identically on the same source/build/toolchain/target/features snapshot, and injects one minimized defect per validation stage. POSIX and Windows routes must produce identical semantic corpus/log roots after declared platform classification. It does not use cargo/PATH/debug fallback, Bash/WSL/MSYS translation on Windows, mock constructors, or any downstream process/replay mock labeled as no-mock proof.

They produce only result-free corpus artifacts and explicitly absent downstream-execution evidence; route divergence, duplicate case logic, cargo/PATH/debug fallback, Bash/WSL/MSYS Windows translation, unrooted rebuilds, mock constructors, or mocked journey success cannot satisfy it.

14. Closed deterministic logs retain logical sequence; source/build/toolchain/target/features/artifact identities; corpus/row/input/schema/oracle/mutation/cell/log roots; field/stage; typed expected/observed/refusal/Unsupported data; budgets/units; owner/prerequisites/no-claim/repairs; mutation seed; and safe relative artifacts. They exclude raw bulk/sensitive data, capabilities, physical paths, PIDs, wall clocks, scheduler noise, and future script mappings mislabeled as evidence.

15. Unit, boundary, property/metamorphic, dependency-DAG, mutation, API/compile-fail, schema, independent-oracle, consumer-contract, release-built no-mock corpus-generation E2E, deterministic logging, coverage, and source-closure suites each expose separately nonzero eligible positives and matched positives; eligible expected refusals and matched expected refusals; eligible expected failures and matched expected failures; and eligible mutations and matched mutations. 17. CHILD-UNION COMPREHENSIVE TEST/E2E/LOGGING RATCHET. The final GLOBAL REALITY-CHECK CLOSE-MANIFEST RECONCILIATION is controlling. Every user-visible Refused, Unsupported, divergent Negative, expected failure, and unexpected mismatch carries one bounded deterministic actionable diagnostic with registered code, precise redacted typed expected/observed values, owner, retryability, exact prerequisites, no-claim scope, and uniquely ranked declarative repairs. Nonsemantic permutations preserve roots; every semantic change moves the exact row root.

9. API and compile-fail tests reject executable functions, callbacks, scripts, arbitrary results, post-freeze mutation, generic root coercion, process/publication/replay/verifier/receipt construction, authority promotion, and conversion of the row or source path into execution evidence. No numerical, sparse-kernel, or performance authority is minted.

15. CHILD CLOSE-MANIFEST RECONCILIATION (CONTROLLING). One result-free source-authoritative manifest exact-sets all applicable test, contribution, logging, redaction, and source-closure cells. It retains distinct exact ID sets for eligible positives and matched positives; eligible expected refusals and matched expected refusals; eligible expected failures and matched expected failures; and eligible mutations and matched mutations; exact Unsupported and inapplicable reasons; unexpected mismatches; execution failures; and unexplained skips. 16. GLOBAL DECOMPOSED-LEAF NINE-FACET CLOSE RECONCILIATION (CONTROLLING). This criterion supplements rather than replaces every domain-specific criterion above. The manifest retains distinct canonical ID sets and checked counters for eligible positives and matched positives; eligible expected refusals and matched expected refusals; eligible expected failures and matched expected failures; eligible mutations and matched mutations; typed Unsupported cells with exact matched reasons; typed inapplicable cells with exact matched registered reasons; unexpected mismatches; execution failures; and unexplained skips. Aggregate totals are checked sums only. Green requires equality inside every eligible/matched subpartition, exact reason equality, every eligible stable ID exactly once, nonempty applicable positive and adversarial corpora, and zero unexpected mismatches, execution failures, and unexplained skips. An expected failure is not an execution failure; a mutation is not a refusal; Unsupported is not a hidden skip; an empty or filtered subset cannot pass.

An execution-owning child runs its named release-built no-mock E2E through production interfaces with explicit semantic and environmental budgets. A contribution-only child instead emits immutable rows binding independent expectations/oracles, semantic inputs, time/memory/work/process/artifact/output/log budgets, schema/log/source/build roots, exact downstream execution owner and script, and no-claim; it cannot report downstream execution passed. Canonical bounded logs retain stable IDs and roots, ordered stages, expected/observed class, first divergence, drain/resource outcomes, exact partitions, ranked non-executable repairs, no-claim, and safe relative evidence references. Secrets, credentials, environment values, live capabilities, provider payloads, raw resources/handles, absolute paths, PIDs, wall clock, scheduler noise, invalid raw argument units, and bulk payloads are rejected or type-redacted and cannot echo through observed values, Display, Debug, canonical bytes, logs, diagnostics, or reproduction text. Source closure exact-sets every owned implementation, contract/rustdoc, schema/domain/owner table, independent oracle, fixture, E2E driver/script or contribution row, log/diagnostic schema, dependency/feature, toolchain/target identity, and build input on one compatible snapshot. Focused proof, E2E or contribution proof, source closure, constellation, DSR, downstream runtime, scientific, certificate, admission, and authority statuses remain separate.

FIVE EXPLICITS DECLARATION, RUNTIME-EVIDENCE, AND COMPLETE-LOG GATE (CONTROLLING). Every stable literal, unit, boundary, property, metamorphic, state, typestate, model, race, mutation, fuzz, API, fault, and E2E cell binds one declaration-side Five Explicits contract: typed units for every numeric input, numeric grant, and expected numeric observation; one canonical seed declaration plus generator/minimizer version, or a registered `SeedInapplicable` code with owner, scope, prerequisite, and no-claim; seven-axis hard and soft time, memory, logical-work, process, artifact, output, and log budgets with process shape declared separately; exact API, wire, schema, source, build, toolchain, target, profile, and feature version requirements; one exact required/permitted semantic capability contract; and the exact no-claim. Runtime actual numeric observations, resolved seed provenance, budget reconciliation, observed versions, and actual required, granted, observed, returned, and revoked capability sets exist only inside disposition-gated runtime evidence. `Observed` requires complete actuals; `NotObserved` may retain only safe typed partial evidence plus its exact reason and cannot substitute expected values; `Deferred` and `Inapplicable` contain no fabricated actuals. Changing any applicable declaration or actual explicit moves exactly the intended component, cell, evidence, log, reproduction, aggregate, and report roots. Bounded log writers reserve sufficient bytes for one canonical terminal event before admitting detail events. The first event that would exceed the remaining detail budget emits one complete deterministic `LogBudgetExceeded` terminal containing the rejected event class and ordinal, digest, omitted count, applicable budget, first-divergence stage, disposition, drain/resource outcome, diagnostic owner, repair-manifest root, and no-claim. Partial JSONL, silent truncation, overwriting prior events, missing terminal state, expected-as-actual substitution, fabricated observed-empty data, or treating overflow as success refuses. Minimized reproduction evidence retains every applicable declaration and safe actual explicit without exposing a forbidden value.

SEMANTIC SEED PROPAGATION AND PROOF JOIN (CONTROLLING). This bead does not invent a second seed type or hidden default. Every owned schema, fixture, command, execution, artifact, replay, verifier, receipt, log, source-closure, E2E row, or rollup join that carries an invocation or case preserves the exact upstream `InvocationSeedSelectionRootV2`, `CaseSeedPolicyV2`, and applicable `CaseExecutionSeedRootV2` or registered `NoRandomness` absence through typed parent bindings. Unit/property/model/race/mutation/API/compile-fail/release-E2E-or-contribution/log/source-closure proof covers omission, substitution, wrong case/run, stale/mixed snapshot, override, ambient randomness, and count-only evidence. Test-harness seeds remain separately typed Five-Explicit data and cannot substitute for the semantic workload seed. Seed evidence establishes reproducibility only and never scientific, publication, verification, or admission authority.

E2E ROUTE OBLIGATION MANIFEST GATE (CONTROLLING). Every leaf owns one exact ordered route-obligation manifest rather than a lossy leaf-wide binary. Each applicable obligation appears exactly once with `LeafCloseRouteObligationKindV1`: 1 `LocalInProcess`, 2 `ExecutionOwned`, 3 `ContributionOnly`, or 4 `Inapplicable`; zero and unknown refuse. A LocalInProcess row binds the real public in-process entry point, immutable cell oracle, budgets, expected partitions, detailed-log schema/root, source closure, and no-mock no-authority boundary. An ExecutionOwned row binds one literal release driver, POSIX wrapper where applicable, direct native-Windows driver or PowerShell wrapper as frozen by the owner contract, immutable case-manifest path/root, exact close argv, release-artifact identity, platform/provider matrix, declared capability profile, runtime evidence-envelope contract, retained relative artifacts, and complete detailed-log root. A ContributionOnly row binds one immutable result-free payload and Deferred envelope to exactly one downstream execution owner plus its literal driver, script/native route, manifest, observer contract, budgets, expected partitions, logging schema, source/build roots, and no-claim; it cannot report downstream execution passed. title: Runner-to-rjoq admission handoff conformance: exact-instance seam, non-forgeability, and migration replay
description:
Close the complete Runner-to-rjoq admission-handoff plan by joining a concrete typed seam, durable submission/recovery coordinator, independent raw-byte verifier, and final release-built no-mock authority E2E/receipt journey while preserving singular rjoq ownership and every Runner publication, migration, negative, fault, replay, resource, logging, and no-claim feature.

This phase rollup performs exact-root, graph/prerequisite, contradiction, authority, coverage-count, and proof-status reconciliation only. It implements no crate, script, schema, state machine, migration, test harness, or receipt.

## Acceptance Criteria

The dedicated Acceptance Criteria field is the complete 60-minute phase close gate. Status-only closure, inherited blockers, a happy-path receipt, or combined proof labels are insufficient.

## Success Criteria

All five implementation leaves and the nested rollup close on exact current roots; the complete request/basis/decision/receipt and dual-durability chains independently replay; every literal CLI, decision, refusal, publication, fault, recovery, migration, stored-byte, authority, no-claim, and logging coverage set is exact and nonzero; all required external edges are encoded; and cycle/lint/ownership checks remain clean without reintroducing the removed rjoq deadlock edge.

## Exact phase structure and estimates

Direct children are:

- 24.5.1, 960 minutes: concrete publish-false Runner/rjoq typed seam, exact three-field premanifest declaration catalog, exact 26-field postpublication CandidateArtifactBinding, direct generic ProducerBinding association, complete request construction, and non-forgeability conformance.
- 24.5.2, 960 minutes: migration-free Runner-side durable submission/recovery coordinator, publication preflight, non-authoritative journal, real-rjoq idempotency/fault/query conformance.
- 24.5.3, 90 minutes: nested final verification/E2E rollup.

Nested under 24.5.3:

- 24.5.3.1, 1,260 minutes: isolated publish-false raw full-frame verifier.
- 24.5.3.2, 1,680 minutes: final publish-false no-mock CLI/fault/migration/recovery/replay journey, Phase-5 manifest finalization/verifier rerun, and sole sealed-receipt invocation.
- 24.5.3.3, 720 minutes: private exact 33-field handoff conformance receipt, SeamConformanceOnly scope, sealed joiner, independent full-frame oracle, owner entries/contributions, and source closure.

The five implementation leaves total 5,580 minutes. The nested rollup is 90 minutes and this phase rollup is 60 minutes, for 5,730 minutes across the phase tree. The five direct external edges remain separately exact-set and outside in-program phase accounting. At closeout, regenerate the complete active transitive external closure from the same live `br` snapshot and retain every active external ID, status, estimate-or-typed-unestimated reason, and dependency edge. Any prose-rendered external count or minute figure is snapshot observation only and cannot close this Bead; an exact combined program-plus-external total remains forbidden while any active external node is unestimated.

## Frozen authority and identity join

The rollup verifies singular `fs-govern::admission_interface` ownership of the six-field AdmissionCandidateRefV1, exact eight-field AdmissionRequestV1 with CandidateRef once, complete AdmissionRequestRoot identity, generic ProducerBindingRoot, literal Refused codes/stages, receipt-free PolicyVerdict/AdmissionDecisionBasis, cycle-free receipt/final-decision ordering, and resolver-independent query/recovery after commit. Producer binding, budgets, no-claim scope, and caller key must appear in request identity, receipt cross-checks, retry matrices, logs, and one-field mutants.

The Runner seam is a concrete publish=false crate with Cargo member/lock/CONTRACT and one-way TOOL/dev dependencies. Before inventory, its exact three-field RunnerProducerBindingCatalog maps canonical `(family, case, artifact role, LogicalBundlePathV1)` keys to five-field producer declarations `(manifest ordinal, CandidateSchemaId, producing-family SourceClosure, ClaimScope, CaseManifestRoot)` and contains no inventory, manifest, receipt, binding, request, or later root. Its canonical bytes are then inserted as exactly one ordinary `ArtifactInventoryEntryV2` under the exact fully namespaced role/schema/path tuple owned by the selected family's frozen artifact registration. `BundleManifestV2` remains the frozen phase-1 schema and binds only `ArtifactInventoryRootV2`; it reaches the catalog root transitively through that inventory entry and never imports a phase-5 catalog field/type.

After a durable PublishedBundleReceipt exists, the exact 26-field CandidateArtifactBinding retains field 3 `producer_binding_catalog_root` and field 13 `artifact_inventory_root`. It proves that exactly one inventory entry matches the registered catalog-carrier tuple, canonically decodes/recomputes to field 3, and separately proves field 14 is the selected candidate artifact entry. Zero or multiple carrier matches, tuple/root/bytes drift, carrier/candidate role confusion, or noncanonical catalog bytes refuse. Explicit registered nominal associations preserve identical digest bytes from ArtifactContentRootV2 to CandidateBytesRootV1, BundleManifestRootV2 to ProducerManifestRootV1, and CandidateArtifactBindingRootV1 to generic ProducerBindingRootV1; no association rehashes or performs a generic conversion. Equal payload bytes under different schema/family/case/role/path/source/claim/no-claim/budget/manifest remain non-aliasing.

24.5.2 owns only client submission/recovery and a disposable no-authority journal. rjoq alone owns reservation, transcript, basis, decision, receipt, durable store, and query. Coordinator migration was removed; 24.5.3.2 integrates Runner migration only after exact 24.4.2 proof, preserving parallelism.

## Frozen user-facing and final evidence join

The final journey preserves the six-command semantic grammar, canonical `--bundle-rel BUNDLE_REL`, and `LifecycleOnlyNoBundle`; old `--artifact-dir`, `OutputlessLifecycle`, and aliases are Usage. Durable commands freeze the complete twelve-field DurableCommandResultV2 and nominal root only after separate semantic-payload and fixed-header-plus-payload total preflight, publication or exact recovery, receipt verification, and post-receipt reproduction of payload length and checked full-frame total; the receipt is not a lifecycle record. The bounded non-authoritative CommandResultTransportFrameV1 then carries its exact six-field header (including payload length, frame-kind-selected nominal root, and typed context root) followed by the exact semantic payload; it has no serialized completion field or self-root. Complete frame exhaustion plus independently recomputed nominal payload-root and typed CommandResultTransportContextRootV1 equality are required for acceptance. Pre-transport failures leave stdout empty; short/broken/truncated/concatenated/trailing/root-mismatched delivery or a valid prefix has zero authority and uses the exact bounded diagnostic/outer-exit contract without rewriting lifecycle state. No physical atomic-write claim is made.

AdmissionHandoffConformanceReceiptV1 uses the literal domain and exact 33 ordered fields, private sealed constructor, and independently hand-encoded full-frame oracle owned by 24.5.3.3 and invoked once by 24.5.3.2 over frozen journey/manifest/verifier inputs, nonzero coverage counts, and sole SeamConformanceOnly scope. It cannot promote Runner/family mathematics, candidate truth, publication durability, or an interface conformance expectation into AdmissionReceipt, Evidence, or Certified.

The phase covers every supported Posix/Windows/ContentStore protocol/path-profile/destination cell; Smoke/Full; all commands/family modes/cases; every Refused reason plus all non-Admitted branches; current and registered migration after 24.4.2; cancellation/timeout/process crash/lost return; postcommit resolver loss; independent separate-root replay; resource return; and detailed deterministic logs and safe reproduction templates.

Stored/encoded/expanded layers remain distinct. Stored-byte evidence includes ordered budgets, 4096-byte ContentStore envelope cap, 65/513 MiB stored ceilings for at most 256 artifacts, checked complete-object arithmetic, Posix/Windows equality, ContentStore exact relation, all boundary/mutation cells, admitted/non-Admitted E2E, logs, receipt coverage, and independent replay.

## External graph needs

All required in-scope and external dependencies are now encoded. Before implementation scheduling, the graph owner exact-set-verifies these special in-program and external edges: 24.5.1 -> 24.1.3.2; 24.5.3.1 -> 24.3.3; 24.5.3.2 -> 24.3.3, 24.4.2, 24.4.3, rjoq.7.2, and rjoq.7.2.1; and 24.5.3.3 -> 24.1.3.2, 24.3.3, 24.4.3, 24.5.1, 24.5.2, 24.5.3.1, and rjoq.7.2.1. rjoq.7.2.1 is purely generic and explicitly has no 24.1.3.2 edge; adding that edge or any rjoq-to-phase-5 concrete schema dependency would recreate the forbidden cycle. Existing 24.5.3 rollup blockers are retained but do not automatically block its children.
The complete phase budget identity is the complete RunnerBudgetsRootV2. Within that full upstream schema, the publication-accounting subsequence is exactly artifact encoded actual, artifact stored actual, artifact expanded actual, system-publication stored grant, and whole-publication stored grant in that relative order. Checked whole use equals actual artifact-stored plus system grant; system cap is 8 MiB, artifact caps are 65/513 MiB, and whole caps are 73/521 MiB. Identity/receipt/retry/migration/replay joins bind the complete root and treat every subsequence field and unit separately.
Phase-wide conformance accepts base DiagnosticCodeV2 code 1 only as `case.conformance_mismatch`, covering either or both evaluator lanes, and rejects legacy `comparison.mismatch`. Final Replay preserves the exact source durable command, case manifests, claim modes, and expected comparison/effect frames—including source Negative mismatch/error—while only new Run cases require Match/Match. These semantics remain bound through lineage, migration, producer binding, admission request/receipt, logs, conformance receipt, and independent replay.
The final phase identity join also requires closed CaseTerminalBasisV2, CaseExecutionPhaseV2-controlled raw outcomes, and the same RunOutcomeBasisRootV2 in RunSummary and RunTerminal, with no summary self-root/provisional placeholder or downstream repair.
The phase accepts LifecycleDocumentV2 only as record_count plus ordered records with full outer-frame exhaustion and finalized-writer typestate; no serialized clean_eof marker can authorize a truncated, trailing, mismatched, or unfinalized lifecycle.
Phase authority review validates: preinventory catalog construction -> canonical catalog bytes as exactly one ordinary registered ArtifactInventoryEntryV2 -> ArtifactInventoryRootV2 -> frozen BundleManifestV2 binding only that inventory root -> registered digest-preserving BundleManifestRootV2-to-ProducerManifestRootV1 association -> exact DestinationResourceBinding from acquisition -> planned set excluding Intent/Seal -> PublicationKey binding invocation+manifest+selection+destination+planned root -> self-root-free Intent -> actual pre-seal durability -> DurablePublicationIdentity preserving destination/planned/actual roots -> Seal/final receipt -> exact 26-field CandidateArtifactBinding proving unique catalog-carrier and separate candidate-entry membership -> registered digest-preserving CandidateArtifactBindingRootV1-to-ProducerBindingRootV1 association -> request. ArtifactContentRootV2-to-CandidateBytesRootV1 is likewise a registered role/schema-checked same-digest association. No direct BundleManifest catalog edge, destination/later root in catalog, generic digest conversion, raw locator/slot, unstable resource identity, result observation, conformance receipt, feedback, or cycle enters identity.

## Complete budget-root binding

RunnerBudgetsV2 is not a five-field schema. This handoff binds and verifies the complete RunnerBudgetsRootV2, or the rjoq-registered AdmissionBudgetsRootV1 mapping to that complete root. Within the full upstream schema, the publication-accounting subsequence is exactly artifact_encoded_bytes, artifact_stored_bytes, artifact_expanded_bytes, system_publication_stored_bytes, publication_stored_bytes in that relative order. The last two are grants. Tests independently verify the complete root plus this subsequence, units, checked actual/grant equations, caps, identity, receipt, retry/recovery, logs, and replay; no unnamed upstream budget field may be omitted or defaulted.

## Capability-reference and reproduction safety

`ROOT_CAPABILITY_REF` and `INPUT_ROOT_CAPABILITY_REF` accept only `posix-fd:N`, `windows-handle-slot:N`, or `content-store-capability-slot:N`. `N` is canonical unsigned decimal: no sign, separator, whitespace, or leading zero except the single token `0`. Posix descriptors are bounded by 2147483647; Windows and ContentStore slots are bounded by 4294967295. Overflow, an empty suffix, nondecimal text, and every noncanonical spelling are Usage before capability lookup, with empty stdout.

Numeric descriptor/slot values are redacted nonsemantic acquisition data: they never enter command, run, request, receipt, replay, or conformance identity. Final logs retain exact semantic arguments, seed, and roots but emit a reproduction template with fresh-capability placeholders plus backend-specific fresh-acquisition instructions; they never reveal or invite reuse of an actual descriptor, handle slot, ContentStore slot, or slot payload.

## Acyclic outer result, accounting, and Replay identity

Phase closure locks LifecycleOnlyCommandResultV2 to ten ordered fields and DurableCommandResultV2 to twelve: common api/wire/command/invocation/run/lifecycle/log/terminal prefix, then for Durable complete PublishedBundleReceipt and receipt root, followed by authority and no-claim roots. Result roots are computed beside frames, never serialized; BundleManifestRoot and SealRoot are not duplicated because the receipt binds them.

PublicationAccountingV1 is exactly nine ordered actual fields: `lifecycle_encoded_bytes: u64`, artifact encoded/stored/expanded `u64`, system/whole publication stored `u64`, `artifact_object_count: u32`, `system_object_count: u16`, and `publication_object_count: u32`. `command_result_stdout_bytes` remains only a field of the complete RunnerBudgetsV2 grant schema. Pure preflight separately computes semantic payload length, fixed six-field transport-header length, and checked full-frame total; post-receipt re-encoding must reproduce the payload and total, and command_result_stdout_bytes caps that total. Nominal payload-root and typed CommandResultTransportContextRootV1 equality are independently verified. All lengths and encode/write/flush/return outcomes remain bounded non-authoritative CommandResultDeliveryObservationV1/log data outside accounting, receipt, result, request, conformance receipt, and identity.

InvocationBasisV2 binds optional ReplayLineageRootV2 exactly for Replay and contains no direct MigrationExecutionBasisRootV2. ReplayLineageV2 contains the current migration basis exactly once. Phase migration/replay joins preserve this shape without duplication, normalization, or authority widening.

## Schema-ownership DAG closeout

RunnerSpecV2 remains base/family-only and carries no ownership root. Phase closeout freezes RunnerPhase5SchemaOwnershipManifestV2, then exact-set-verifies the ordered roots of the 24.1.3.2 RunnerPhase1SchemaOwnershipRegistryV2 followed by RunnerPhase2SchemaOwnershipManifestV2, RunnerPhase3SchemaOwnershipManifestV2, RunnerPhase4SchemaOwnershipManifestV2, and RunnerPhase5SchemaOwnershipManifestV2. AdmissionHandoffVerificationTranscriptRootV1 and the existing handoff_verification_root field carry that non-authoritative proof; no 34th receipt field, admission authority, prior registry/manifest mutation, or downstream feedback is allowed.

## Destination-resource identity closeout

DestinationResourceBindingV1 exact-set proof covers its domain and eight ordered fields: class, profile, RootCapabilityPolicyRootV2, privacy-preserving stable ResourceIdentityRootV2, identity-provider policy, freshness, optional generation, and no-claim; the root is computed beside the frame. Same resource through a fresh capability slot preserves the full publication/binding/request/outcome chain, while another resource moves it. Paths, inode/file IDs, handles/slots, credentials, capability/provider secrets, and locators are excluded. Unsupported identity, stale/generation/policy changes, crash/reacquisition, recovery, logging, and no-authority behavior are independently covered.
## Generic rjoq boundary and full-width refusal payload

rjoq.7.2.1 freezes only `ProducerBindingSchemaRegistrationV1`/registry and the generic digest-preserving association. The Runner-specific schema ID/domain, exact 26-field decoder, catalog-carrier verifier, manifest/content nominal associations, and Phase1 Registry plus Phase2-5 ownership chain are downstream-owned here by 24.5.1/24.5.3. No rjoq source or fixture imports those types. Admission CandidateRef/Request/receipt/idempotency functionality is unchanged.

AdmissionRefusedReasonV1 code 12 is exactly `AdmissionBudgetExceeded { admission_budgets_root, budget_dimension_code_u16, unit_code_u16, limit_u128, observed_u128 }`. All complete RunnerBudgetsV2 dimensions participate, including `logical_work_limit: u128`; ordinary u64 dimensions widen losslessly. No truncation, saturation, wrapping, or exclusion is permitted, and dimension/unit codes remain explicit even when magnitudes match.
Static row owner 24.4.3.9.7 freezes role `family.runner_fixture.vertical-product.artifact.runner-producer-binding-catalog` (79 bytes), schema ID `family.runner_fixture.vertical-product.schema.runner-producer-binding-catalog` (77 bytes), and path `family.runner_fixture.vertical-product/runner-producer-binding-catalog.json` (75 bytes). These are fixture literals only; production catalog lookup remains selected-family-registration-driven under the 128-byte StableTokenV2/RunnerLimitsV2 cap.
## Replay-input portability

DestinationResourceBindingV1 identifies only the output publication target. Current read-only Replay input acquisition—capability slot, resource identity, path, locator, provider handle, or copy location—is non-authoritative and excluded from Invocation, source lineage, catalog, inventory, manifest, publication, CandidateArtifactBinding, CandidateRef, request, admission outcome, and conformance-receipt identity. With the same canonical source bundle bytes/root, migration registration, semantic CLI inputs, and output destination, copying the source bundle to another read-only input resource preserves every downstream byte/root. Only substituting the output resource moves DestinationResourceBindingRootV1, PublicationKey, and descendants. An input target/generation change during a read or changed source bytes refuses before output mutation or handoff. No field is added to CandidateArtifactBindingV1.
## Catalog carrier codec and canonical JSON

The catalog carrier is an ordinary ArtifactInventoryEntryV2 with `artifact_codec_id = Identity`. Its encoded and expanded payload is the exact canonical JSON encoding of RunnerProducerBindingCatalogV1; encoded/expanded lengths agree and their nominal roots preserve the same digest bytes, while stored-object accounting still follows the selected publication backend and ContentStore envelope rules. Runner V2 admits no CBOR catalog codec or schema. Decoding must consume the complete JSON payload, reject any noncanonical but semantically equivalent spelling, and recompute RunnerProducerBindingCatalogRootV1 from those exact canonical bytes before inventory membership can verify.

## Final phase-5 acyclic evaluator provenance gate

Phase 5 requires the typed seam, real receipt consumer, migration/replay checks, and final verification rollup to agree on contextual ArtifactInventoryEntryRootV2 membership and the complete independently verified evaluator chain before any submission. That chain is: root-free CaseEvaluationKeyV2; expressions and EffectSnapshotRequirementsRootV2; presented fixtures plus optional validated roots; EvaluationPrecontextV2 and root-free nested ExpectedMismatchFrameV2 or ExpectedEvaluationErrorFrameV2 values inside CaseConformanceSpecV2; the matching sealed manifest; actual EvaluationContextRootV2 values containing CaseManifestRootV2; actual error/detail frames; complete two-lane raw outcome; conformance verdict; lifecycle mapping; and contextual artifact set/inventory membership. Removing only CaseManifestRootV2 from an actual context must reproduce the sealed precontext wherever an exact expectation exists.

One-field non-substitution tests cover every link and reject fabricated CaseEvaluationKeyRootV2 or EvaluationPrecontextRootV2 types, expected actual-context roots, generic digest substitution, reverse edges, mixed snapshots, and visible-tag-only acceptance. Evaluation provenance remains transitive Runner evidence and a verifier transcript, never a shortcut to CandidateRef, request, decision, receipt, durable publication, Evidence, or Certified authority.

## Final phase-5 native portability and execution-plan gate

Phase closeout requires the source-closed suite drivers, sole-owner thin POSIX `.sh` coordinators, and direct native Windows companion-driver routes to consume the same exact manifests and invoke the exact retained DSR release artifacts by BuildRoot, target, feature-set root, and profile. A `.ps1` wrapper is required only where its owning suite explicitly freezes one; it is not duplicated across direct-driver suites. Cargo-run, debug binaries, PATH lookup, alternate rebuilds, Bash/WSL/MSYS fallback on Windows, and wrapper-specific semantics are forbidden. The checked launch/bootstrap ABI supplies Windows handles, ContentStore capabilities, and progress observers; direct POSIX descriptors use inherited process-launch semantics. Raw slots, descriptors, handles, credentials, locators, provider secrets, and payloads remain nonsemantic and redacted.

Lossless native argv, exact `--help`, the fourteen-field RunnerVersionDocumentV1, first-interrupt ingress, duplicate/escalated/forced termination, lifecycle/outer/native exit distinctions, and progress noninterference are end-to-end close gates. Environmental `wall_time_ns` uses a monotonic provider descriptor and explicit no-cross-run-bit-stability scope; replay-stable stopping requires logical-work limits.

The final matrix has stable semantic cell IDs, a frozen shard derivation and ordering rule, explicit per-cell and per-shard logical/resource/output/wall budgets, fail-closed resume bound to release/manifest/oracle/shard-plan/completed-cell roots, and exact-set aggregation. Every eligible ID appears once with separate executed, passed, expected-refusal, Unsupported, failed, and skipped counts; unexplained skips or unexpected mismatches block. Per-cell, shard, aggregate, source-closure, transport, native-exit, and detailed deterministic log roots are retained with safe reproduction templates and relative artifacts.

Ownership is exact: static tuple declaration belongs to 24.4.3.9.7; aggregate corpus construction to 24.4.3.9.8; corpus reconciliation to 24.4.3.9; executable-oracle and actual carrier-artifact realization to 24.4.3.7; and canonical Runner receipt consumption to 24.4.3.

## PRESENTED-VERIFIER/LIVE-DURABILITY RECEIPT RECONCILIATION (CONTROLLING)

The 33-field conformance receipt keeps field 5 as exact `VerifierResultV2::PresentedPublicationEvidenceConformant` over retained presented bytes and field 26 as the separately executed live acquisition-host durability/publication/recovery chain-set root. They are mandatory, differently owned, independently rooted, non-derivable, and non-substitutable. A presented verifier result proves no host acquisition or durability; a live chain proves no independent byte conformance and cannot bypass field 5.

## INPUT-SOURCE VERSUS OUTPUT-DESTINATION CAPABILITY UX (CONTROLLING)

`--input-artifact-root` is a read-only source-bundle capability; `--artifact-root` is a distinct publication-destination capability and never source-read authority. Their backend-specific rights, lifetime, freshness, generation, and no-claim policies are separately typed. Same-ref dual use, swaps, wrong-kind or wrong-rights slots, stale/revoked resources, and role-policy substitutions refuse before source payload read, output mutation, or stdout. Help and diagnostics name the two roles plainly, retain only redacted role/policy roots, and rank acquisition of a fresh read-only source or distinct fresh destination capability without exposing a live ref.
