title: Runner-to-rjoq typed seam and non-forgeability
description:
Implement the concrete publish-false TOOL/dev seam that accepts fully typed, non-authoritative Runner V2 schema, artifact, publication-reference, and descriptive verification inputs; seals the producer-derived family/case/artifact binding catalog; proves the exact digest-preserving nominal associations; and constructs the singular rjoq.7.2.1 AdmissionCandidateRef/AdmissionRequest shape without duplicating any rjoq authority type. API/compile-fail/trait, boundary, property, mutation, neutral release-built no-mock interface E2E, independent-oracle, logging, and source-closure evidence must prove that neither the seam nor any Runner object can mint Evidence, Certified, a durable decision, or an admission receipt.

This leaf intentionally does not claim that its presented publication receipt or verification inputs came from a live durable or independently verified Runner execution, and it never calls durable submit/query/recover. The only live prerequisites consumed here are the exact Phase-1 schema/registry roots and the generic rjoq interface root; every Phase-2/3/4 publication or verification value is presented fixture data. The actual retained Phase-3 verifier result, live Phase-4 acquisition-host/publication chain, final Phase-5 ownership manifest, and complete durable rjoq journey are exact-set joined only by 24.5.3.2. This staged boundary preserves parallel implementation of the seam while preventing a fixture-backed neutral conformance result from being mislabeled as live verification or admission.

## Acceptance Criteria

The dedicated Acceptance Criteria field is the complete close gate. The leaf closes only with the concrete crate/manifest/lock/CONTRACT integration, exact byte schemas and producer map, exhaustive positive and negative matrices, independent oracles, comprehensive unit/E2E/logging/source-closure counts, and preserved no-authority boundaries.

## Concrete implementation surface and ownership

Create workspace member `crates/fs-evidence-runner-rjoq-seam` with package name `fs-evidence-runner-rjoq-seam`, Rust 2024, `publish = false`, safe Rust by default, and a checked `CONTRACT.md`. The implementation slice owns exactly its package `Cargo.toml`, `src/lib.rs`, focused test modules/fixtures, CONTRACT, the root workspace member entry, and the resulting Cargo.lock resolution. It is TOOL/dev integration code, not a production runtime dependency.

Dependency direction is one way: the seam may depend directly on `fs-evidence-runner`, `fs-govern` admission-interface owner APIs, and existing lower canonical-codec/hash utilities already admitted by policy. `fs-evidence-runner`, `fs-govern`, rjoq runtime, family producers, and production crates must not depend on or reexport the seam. Dependency/exact-owner scans enforce zero reverse edges and no duplicate candidate/request/receipt schema or encoder. rjoq owns AdmissionCandidateRefV1, AdmissionRequestV1/Root, ProducerBindingRootV1, all verdict/basis/decision/receipt types, and their authority constructors. Runner owns RunnerSpec/artifact/inventory/manifest/publication types. This seam owns only the Runner-specific descriptive declaration catalog, postpublication CandidateArtifactBinding, checked translation, and neutral conformance observations.

The crate CONTRACT freezes purpose/layer, allowed dependencies, exact domains/field order, determinism, cancellation/drain, budgets, unsafe-code denial, feature surface, error classifications, conformance tests, and the no-claim boundary. Cargo-member, lockfile, dependency, feature-unification, publish=false, package-metadata, and ownership tests are required.

## Candidate artifact binding

`CandidateArtifactBindingV1`, domain `org.frankensim.fs-evidence-runner-rjoq-seam.candidate-artifact-binding.v1`, is the sole postpublication Runner-specific binding record. It has exactly these 26 ordered fields:

1. `runner_spec_root: RunnerSpecRootV2`
2. `run_id: RunIdV2`
3. `producer_binding_catalog_root: RunnerProducerBindingCatalogRootV1`
4. `family_id: FamilyIdV2`
5. `case_id: CaseIdV2`
6. `artifact_role: ArtifactRoleV2`
7. `artifact_relative_path: LogicalBundlePathV1`
8. `producing_manifest_ordinal: u32`
9. `candidate_schema_id: CandidateSchemaIdV1`
10. `producing_family_source_closure_root: SourceClosureRoot`
11. `claim_scope_root: ClaimScopeRootV1`
12. `case_manifest_root: CaseManifestRootV2`
13. `artifact_inventory_root: ArtifactInventoryRootV2`
14. `artifact_inventory_entry_root: ArtifactInventoryEntryRootV2`
15. `artifact_codec_id: ArtifactCodecIdV2`
16. `stored_length: u64`
17. `stored_object_root: StoredObjectRootV2`
18. `encoded_length: u64`
19. `artifact_encoded_root: ArtifactEncodedRootV2`
20. `expanded_length: u64`
21. `artifact_content_root: ArtifactContentRootV2`
22. `bundle_manifest_root: BundleManifestRootV2`
23. `producer_manifest_root: ProducerManifestRootV1`
24. `presented_published_bundle_receipt_root: PublishedBundleReceiptRootV2`
25. `candidate_bytes_root: CandidateBytesRootV1`
26. `no_claim_scope_root: NoClaimScopeRootV1`

Field 13 is the root of the whole inventory. Field 14 is exclusively the selected candidate artifact's inventory-entry root, never the catalog-carrier entry. Validation must independently prove (a) field 14 membership and all selected catalog key/value, stored/encoded/expanded, receipt, and no-claim cross-fields, and (b) exactly one ordinary inventory entry under the selected family's exact registered catalog-carrier role/schema/path tuple whose expanded canonical bytes decode and recompute exactly field 3. Zero or two-or-more carrier matches, carrier/candidate role confusion, a matching tuple with different bytes/root, identical bytes under a different tuple, or noncanonical catalog encoding refuses.

Three associations are explicit and registered, never generic conversions: `ArtifactContentRootV2 -> CandidateBytesRootV1` validates the selected artifact role/schema/algorithm/length and preserves the same 32 digest bytes; `BundleManifestRootV2 -> ProducerManifestRootV1` validates the frozen BundleManifest domain/schema/role/algorithm/length and preserves the same digest bytes; and `CandidateArtifactBindingRootV1 -> ProducerBindingRootV1` uses rjoq's generic `ProducerBindingSchemaRegistrationV1` for this exact Runner schema and preserves the same digest bytes. None rehashes an existing digest or implies correctness/authority. `CandidateArtifactBindingRootV1` covers all 26 fields. In 24.5.1 the publication-receipt root remains presented non-authoritative fixture data; 24.5.2 alone validates the opaque real receipt before submission. No second RunnerProducerBinding type exists.


## Sealed producer-derived binding catalog

`RunnerProducerBindingCatalogV1`, domain `org.frankensim.fs-evidence-runner-rjoq-seam.producer-binding-catalog.v1`, is a declaration catalog constructed before inventory, BundleManifest, publication, or CandidateArtifactBinding. Its exact ordered fields are `runner_spec_root`, `run_id`, and `entries`. `entries` is a nonempty canonical sorted exact map with unique key `(family_id: FamilyIdV2, case_id: CaseIdV2, artifact_role: ArtifactRoleV2, artifact_relative_path: LogicalBundlePathV1)` and exact ordered value:

1. `producing_manifest_ordinal: u32`
2. `candidate_schema_id: CandidateSchemaIdV1`
3. `producing_family_source_closure_root: SourceClosureRoot`
4. `claim_scope_root: ClaimScopeRootV1`
5. `case_manifest_root: CaseManifestRootV2`

It contains no CandidateArtifactBinding, inventory, BundleManifest, ProducerManifest, PublishedBundleReceipt, CandidateBytes, generic ProducerBinding, request, decision, or receipt root. Every key/value is derived from the exact family receipt/case manifest and frozen artifact declaration, never caller defaults or seam guesses. Duplicate keys, omitted/extra eligible declarations, role/schema mismatch, inconsistent family/case/ordinal, or non-producer-derived source/claim/manifest data refuse sealing. Its root is `RunnerProducerBindingCatalogRootV1`.

After that root and canonical catalog bytes exist, inventory construction must encode those bytes as exactly one ordinary `ArtifactInventoryEntryV2`. The identifying triple is the exact fully namespaced `(artifact_role, candidate_schema_id, artifact_relative_path: LogicalBundlePathV1)` owned by the selected family's frozen artifact registration; the seam neither invents a global fallback tuple nor accepts caller-selected aliases. The carrier is metadata-only and cannot be selected as the admission candidate. `ArtifactInventoryRootV2` covers the carrier entry and all candidate artifacts. Frozen phase-1 `BundleManifestV2` binds only `ArtifactInventoryRootV2`; it contains no RunnerProducerBindingCatalog field/type and commits to the catalog only transitively through the inventory root. This order is acyclic because the catalog frame contains no inventory or manifest root.


## Exact request construction

The seam imports, never mirrors, rjoq's exact `AdmissionCandidateRefV1` and `AdmissionRequestV1`. CandidateRef appears once. AdmissionRequest fields are exactly candidate_ref, resolver_policy_root, checker_root, capability_root, producer_binding_root, admission_budgets_root, no_claim_scope_root, and caller_idempotency_key. The seam constructs and independently recomputes `AdmissionRequestRootV1`; producer binding, budgets, no-claim, and caller key are mandatory identity inputs.

Candidate source_closure_root must equal the selected catalog producing-family source closure; candidate claim_scope_root and producer_manifest_root must equal the selected catalog entry and CandidateArtifactBinding; CandidateSchemaId must equal both artifact and catalog values. Resolver handle/locator/credentials remain nonsemantic. The seam may exercise an implementation-backed interface-conformance journey but cannot call rjoq's durable submit/query/recover operations, persist basis/decision/receipt state, or return an AdmissionReceipt.

Authority objects remain nominally distinct: Runner rows/terminals, ArtifactInventory, BundleManifest, Seal, PublishedBundleReceipt, CandidateArtifactBinding, producer catalog/binding, CandidateRef, resolver, request, expectation, observed decision shape, verifier/replay output, and seam conformance result cannot construct or widen AdmissionReceipt, Evidence, or Certified.

## Stored bytes and frozen UX vocabulary

The complete RunnerBudgetsRootV2 remains authoritative. Within its full upstream schema, the publication-accounting subsequence contains `artifact_encoded_bytes`, `artifact_stored_bytes`, and `artifact_expanded_bytes` in that relative order before the two publication grants. Encoded/expanded bundle ceilings are 64 MiB Smoke and 512 MiB Full; stored ceilings are 65 MiB/513 MiB for at most 256 artifacts with at most 4096 canonical ContentStore envelope bytes per object. Posix/Windows require stored == encoded; ContentStore requires stored == encoded + exact nonpayload envelope length; aggregate arithmetic is checked before allocation/publication/verification.

Where the seam records outer Runner disposition, ArtifactDispositionV2 code 1 is spelled only `LifecycleOnlyNoBundle`; `OutputlessLifecycle` is rejected, not aliased. Canonical path terminology is `bundle_rel`; the legacy `artifact_dir`/`OUTPUT_REL` spelling is never introduced by this crate.
## Complete publication-budget identity

The selected Runner budget document and `admission_budgets_root` bind the complete RunnerBudgetsRootV2. Within that full schema, the publication-accounting subsequence is exactly `artifact_encoded_bytes`, `artifact_stored_bytes`, `artifact_expanded_bytes`, `system_publication_stored_bytes`, `publication_stored_bytes` in relative order. The last two are explicit grants. Checked whole-publication use is actual artifact-stored bytes plus the system-publication grant; the system cap is 8 MiB and whole ceilings are 73 MiB Smoke/521 MiB Full. Artifact-stored caps remain 65/513 MiB. The seam preserves the complete root and each named subsequence field/unit in request construction and neutral conformance; it neither omits another upstream field, infers a grant from actual totals, nor double-counts an envelope/staging copy.
## Case-conformance diagnostic spelling

Neutral Runner conformance observations use base DiagnosticCodeV2 code 1 only as `case.conformance_mismatch`, whether comparison, effect, or both lanes diverge. The legacy `comparison.mismatch` spelling is rejected rather than aliased. This Runner diagnostic remains distinct from AdmissionRefusedReasonV1 and carries no authority.
## Acyclic producer-binding construction order

The sole legal root DAG is: (1) construct RunnerProducerBindingCatalog over runner spec/run and exact declarations, with no inventory/destination/later root; (2) canonically encode it as exactly one ordinary inventory artifact under the selected family's registered fully namespaced role/schema/path; (3) compute ArtifactInventoryRootV2 over that carrier plus ordinary candidate artifacts; (4) frozen BundleManifestV2 binds only that inventory root; (5) registered BundleManifestRootV2-to-ProducerManifestRootV1 nominal association preserves the manifest digest; (6) capability acquisition constructs exact DestinationResourceBindingV1; (7) PlannedPreIntentObjectSetRootV1 excludes PublicationIntent/Seal; (8) PublicationKey derives only invocation+manifest+selection+destination+planned root; (9) self-root-free PublicationIntent binds expected paths; (10) actual PreSealObjectSetRoot/ProvenDurablePreSeal covers planned objects+Intent and excludes Seal; (11) DurablePublicationIdentity binds destination plus planned/actual roots; (12) Seal/final commit/PublishedBundleReceipt; (13) postpublication CandidateArtifactBinding proves the unique catalog carrier, separate candidate-entry membership, all 26 fields, registered content-to-candidate association, receipt, and no-claim; (14) the rjoq-registered CandidateArtifactBindingRoot-to-ProducerBindingRoot association preserves the digest; (15) CandidateRef/request bind the generic root and matching candidate/source/claim/manifest fields. No direct manifest-to-catalog edge, generic conversion, rehash, earlier-to-later feedback, Intent self-root, Seal in a pre-seal set, raw locator/slot identity, or redundant selected-binding record exists.

## Complete budget-root binding

RunnerBudgetsV2 is not a five-field schema. This handoff binds and verifies the complete RunnerBudgetsRootV2, or the rjoq-registered AdmissionBudgetsRootV1 mapping to that complete root. Within the full upstream schema, the publication-accounting subsequence is exactly artifact_encoded_bytes, artifact_stored_bytes, artifact_expanded_bytes, system_publication_stored_bytes, publication_stored_bytes in that relative order. The last two are grants. Tests independently verify the complete root plus this subsequence, units, checked actual/grant equations, caps, identity, receipt, retry/recovery, logs, and replay; no unnamed upstream budget field may be omitted or defaulted.

## Accounting, outer-result, and replay exclusions at the seam

The seam imports upstream PublicationAccountingV1 with exactly these ordered actual fields and types: `lifecycle_encoded_bytes: u64`, `artifact_encoded_bytes: u64`, `artifact_stored_bytes: u64`, `artifact_expanded_bytes: u64`, `system_publication_stored_bytes: u64`, `publication_stored_bytes: u64`, `artifact_object_count: u32`, `system_object_count: u16`, and `publication_object_count: u32`. It binds the complete RunnerBudgetsRootV2, including the separate `command_result_stdout_bytes` grant, but never treats an observed result length as accounting or request identity. Upstream pure preflight separately computes semantic payload length, fixed six-field transport-header length, and checked full-frame total; post-receipt encoding reproduces payload and total, command_result_stdout_bytes caps the total, and nominal payload-root plus typed context-root equality are independently verified. All lengths and encode/write/flush/return state remain non-authoritative CommandResultDeliveryObservationV1/log data. Neither that observation nor a LifecycleOnlyCommandResultRootV2/DurableCommandResultRootV2 enters CandidateArtifactBinding, ProducerBinding, CandidateRef, AdmissionRequest, basis, receipt, or seam conformance identity. The seam rejects outer-result self-roots and duplicated BundleManifestRoot/SealRoot fields; the PublishedBundleReceipt association is sufficient.

For Replay inputs, upstream InvocationBasisV2 binds optional ReplayLineageRootV2 exactly for Replay and never directly duplicates MigrationExecutionBasisRootV2. ReplayLineageV2 contains the current migration basis exactly once. The seam preserves the resulting invocation/manifest/source identities and refuses missing, duplicate, stale, mixed, or substituted lineage/basis data rather than repairing it.

## Schema-ownership manifest boundary

RunnerSpecV2 remains base/family-only; it contains no phase-1 or downstream schema-descriptor/ownership root. The seam consumes the RunnerPhase1SchemaOwnershipRegistryV2 root from 24.1.3.2 plus the separate append-only RunnerPhase2SchemaOwnershipManifestV2, RunnerPhase3SchemaOwnershipManifestV2, and RunnerPhase4SchemaOwnershipManifestV2 roots needed for CandidateSchemaId, catalog, CandidateArtifactBinding, and admission-interface resolution. It contributes its exact schema/domain/owner entries to the later RunnerPhase5SchemaOwnershipManifestV2 join but does not prematurely construct that final manifest. It exact-set-checks unique schema/domain/encoder ownership without editing an earlier registry/manifest or feeding a later root into RunnerSpec, the premanifest catalog, or another upstream frame.

## Destination-resource durability binding

The seam imports `DestinationResourceBindingV1`, domain `org.frankensim.fs-evidence-runner.destination-resource-binding.v1`, with exact ordered fields: `root_class: RootClassV2`, `platform_path_profile: PlatformPathProfileV2`, `root_capability_policy_root: RootCapabilityPolicyRootV2`, `resource_identity_root: ResourceIdentityRootV2`, `identity_provider_policy_root`, `freshness_observation_root`, optional `generation_observation_root`, and `no_claim_scope`. DestinationResourceBindingRootV1 is computed beside the root-free frame. ResourceIdentityRootV2 is privacy-preserving and stable; raw path, inode/file ID, handle/slot, credential, capability payload, provider secret, and physical locator fields are forbidden.

The seam verifies that a newly acquired slot for the same durable resource yields the same destination binding, PublicationKey, intent, durable identity, final commit, published receipt, CandidateArtifactBinding, producer binding, and request roots, while a genuinely different resource moves every downstream root beginning at DestinationResourceBinding/PublicationKey. Missing stable identity is Unsupported; stale/generation/policy disagreement has the exact upstream classification. The destination binding proves only durability target continuity. It cannot imply candidate truth, scientific Evidence/Certified, or admission authority.
## Generic-registration boundary and full-width budget refusal

This seam, not rjoq, owns and full-frame validates the Runner-specific 26-field binding and registers its schema/domain/digest association through rjoq's generic seven-field `ProducerBindingSchemaRegistrationV1`. rjoq.7.2.1 must not import the seam, CandidateArtifactBinding, catalog carrier, phase ownership roots, or Runner fixtures. The seam separately consumes Phase1-4 ownership roots and contributes Phase5 entries, maintaining a one-way phase5-to-rjoq dependency.

AdmissionRefusedReasonV1 code 12 is consumed literally as `AdmissionBudgetExceeded { admission_budgets_root, budget_dimension_code_u16, unit_code_u16, limit_u128, observed_u128 }`. Complete RunnerBudgetsV2 includes `logical_work_limit: u128`; every u64 budget widens losslessly and every registered dimension/unit remains explicit. The seam must not truncate, saturate, wrap, default, or exclude a budget dimension.
## Stable-token and vertical fixture registration

StableTokenV2 and RunnerLimitsV2 use the corrected 128-byte canonical lowercase-ASCII UTF-8 cap. Generic production logic consumes each selected family's frozen carrier registration. Static row owner 24.4.3.9.7 alone freezes the literal tuple: role `family.runner_fixture.vertical-product.artifact.runner-producer-binding-catalog` (79 bytes), schema ID `family.runner_fixture.vertical-product.schema.runner-producer-binding-catalog` (77 bytes), and LogicalBundlePathV1 `family.runner_fixture.vertical-product/runner-producer-binding-catalog.json` (75 bytes). None becomes a global default or is shortened to fit the obsolete 64-byte limit.
## Replay-input acquisition exclusion

DestinationResourceBindingV1 and its downstream publication chain describe only the output target. A Replay source bundle is identified by canonical retained bytes and content-bound source/manifests/lineage, never by its current read-only input resource, capability slot, locator, provider handle, or copy location. Moving byte-identical source bytes to another input resource while keeping semantic inputs and output destination fixed preserves the catalog, inventory, BundleManifest/ProducerManifest, CandidateArtifactBinding, generic binding, CandidateRef, and request roots. Only output-resource substitution moves DestinationResourceBinding/PublicationKey onward. Input target/generation changes during a read or changed bytes refuse before catalog/output/handoff construction. CandidateArtifactBindingV1 remains exactly 26 fields with no input-resource field.
## Catalog carrier codec and canonical JSON

The catalog carrier is an ordinary ArtifactInventoryEntryV2 with `artifact_codec_id = Identity`. Its encoded and expanded payload is the exact canonical JSON encoding of RunnerProducerBindingCatalogV1; encoded/expanded lengths agree and their nominal roots preserve the same digest bytes, while stored-object accounting still follows the selected publication backend and ContentStore envelope rules. Runner V2 admits no CBOR catalog codec or schema. Decoding must consume the complete JSON payload, reject any noncanonical but semantically equivalent spelling, and recompute RunnerProducerBindingCatalogRootV1 from those exact canonical bytes before inventory membership can verify.

Ownership is exact: static tuple declaration belongs to 24.4.3.9.7; aggregate corpus construction to 24.4.3.9.8; corpus reconciliation to 24.4.3.9; executable-oracle and actual carrier-artifact realization to 24.4.3.7; and canonical Runner receipt consumption to 24.4.3.

## EXACT DOWNSTREAM CONTRIBUTION ROUTE (CONTROLLING)

This leaf owns immutable stable contribution rows at `scripts/ci/manifests/runner_rjoq_seam_v1_contributions.v1.json`. Each row binds the presented-fixture seam input, independent expected bytes/roots, exact category/result partition, explicit time/memory/work/process/artifact/log budgets, schema/log/source/build roots, redacted diagnostic expectation, and no-claim scope. The sole execution consumer is `frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.5.3.2`, through canonical owner `frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.4.1.4`, driver `canonical-evidence-runner-v2-e2e-driver`, and `scripts/ci/canonical_evidence_runner_v2.sh`. This leaf owns neither that driver/script nor a live Phase-3/4 result and cannot report contributed execution passed.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Workspace/Cargo tests prove `crates/fs-evidence-runner-rjoq-seam` is one Rust-2024 publish=false member, appears in Cargo.lock as expected, has CONTRACT coverage, admits only the named direct dependencies/features, has zero reverse production dependencies, and adds no unsafe, runtime publication, schema-owner, or authority surface.

2. CONTRACT and ownership scans lock rjoq, Runner, and seam responsibilities. fs-govern::admission_interface declares only the generic CandidateRef/Request/ProducerBinding registration/root/verdict/basis/decision/receipt contracts; it imports or validates no Runner type. The seam declares RunnerProducerBindingCatalogV1, CandidateArtifactBindingV1, the concrete rjoq registration conformance, and the two Runner nominal-association registrations. Mirrors, RunnerProducerBindingV1, selected-binding records, aliases, reexports, structural lookalikes, generic conversions, duplicate domains, and any rjoq-to-phase-5 dependency fail.

3. CandidateArtifactBinding golden/full-frame tests assert the exact domain and 26 ordered fields/types/tags; field 3 catalog root; field 13 whole-inventory root; field 14 selected candidate-entry root; unique catalog-carrier membership; selected catalog key/value; three candidate byte layers; registered BundleManifestRoot-to-ProducerManifestRoot and ArtifactContentRoot-to-CandidateBytes associations; PublishedBundleReceipt; no-claim root; and complete root. Remove/reorder/duplicate/unknown/trailing-field, every one-field mutant, field-13/14 confusion, or carrier/candidate substitution changes identity or refuses.

4. Publication association tests independently prove exactly one catalog-carrier entry matches the selected family's frozen fully namespaced role/schema/path tuple, decode its canonical expanded bytes, recompute field 3, separately match field 14 to the candidate declaration by LogicalBundlePathV1/role/family/case/ordinal/codec, verify both entries' stored/encoded/content roots and lengths, prove BundleManifest binds only ArtifactInventoryRootV2, apply the registered same-digest manifest association, and distinguish presented from real PublishedBundleReceipt status. Zero/duplicate carriers, same tuple/different bytes, same bytes/wrong tuple, wrong role/schema/path/layer/identity/membership/manifest/receipt, a direct BundleManifest catalog field, or carrier selection as candidate refuses at the exact stage.

5. Producer catalog golden tests lock its domain, three top-level fields, LogicalBundlePathV1 key, exact five-field value, forbidden inventory/manifest/later roots, duplicate-key rejection, nonempty exact-set rules, canonical bytes, and root. Carrier tests lock the selected family's exact registered fully namespaced role/schema/path, exactly-one inventory occurrence, metadata-only status, and transitive BundleManifest commitment. Discovery/inventory/map order and concurrency permutations yield byte-identical catalog, inventory, and manifest roots.

6. Producer-derivation tests prove family/case/role/LogicalBundlePath/schema/source closure/claim scope/case manifest come only from the family owner receipt/manifest. Missing, extra, duplicated, stale, mixed-run/source/manifest, caller-injected, or later-root-bearing declarations block catalog sealing.

7. Nominal-association tests independently lock all three registered edges: ArtifactContentRootV2-to-CandidateBytesRootV1 under the exact artifact role/schema; BundleManifestRootV2-to-ProducerManifestRootV1 under the frozen manifest domain/schema; and CandidateArtifactBindingRootV1-to-ProducerBindingRootV1 under the generic seven-field rjoq registration. Each preserves identical 32-byte BLAKE3 digests and changes only the nominal role. Wrong algorithm/length/domain/role/schema, rehash, second digest, erased role, raw digest, generic conversion, or authority/durability inference fails; no RunnerProducerBindingV1 exists.

8. Cross-field tests require CandidateArtifactBinding declaration/inventory/CandidateBytes/source/claim/manifests/receipt/no-claim and CandidateRef/request fields to agree. Same payload bytes under different schema/family/case/role/path/source/claim/no-claim/budget/manifest or a different destination resource produce a different binding/request root or refusal; a newly acquired slot for the same resource preserves roots exactly.

9. Request tests assert CandidateRef appears exactly once and AdmissionRequestRoot covers candidate, resolver policy, checker, capability, producer binding, admission budgets, no-claim scope, and caller key. Flattened/repeated candidate fields, omitted roots, default budgets/no-claim, renamed Runner fields, or nonsemantic locator/attempt contamination fail.

10. Resolver tests cover both kinds, affine/read-only capability semantics, exact byte/cap/freshness handling, missing/stale/substituted/oversized/multi-object/wrong namespace/root class/expiry/revocation/race cases, and no root-to-locator conversion. Semantic policy changes alter request identity; handle/path spelling does not.

11. API/compile-fail/trait-coherence/wire tests reject every conversion from Runner lifecycle/bundle/publication, artifact/candidate/producer records, resolver/request, expectations/observations, verifier/replay results, booleans, or raw digests into AdmissionReceipt, Evidence, or Certified. Durable submit/query/recover and receipt constructors are unreachable from this crate.

12. The named `rjoq.runner-handoff.exact-bytes-root.v1` fixture runs through the release-built real seam and frozen resolver/checker interface with exact construction and neutral conformance output. It records `submission_performed=false`, returns no receipt, and does not claim Admitted. Full durable work remains 24.5.2.

13. Negative E2E journeys cover every candidate/artifact/catalog/producer/request/resolver/checker/capability/budget/no-claim substitution, missing/stale/tampered input, oversize, wrong publication protocol/mode association, expected/observed mismatch, and authority widening. Each yields exact stage/reason/effects and no authority.

14. Cancellation/timeout/fault tests span resolver acquisition/read, allocation, expansion/codec/hash, catalog derivation/sort/seal, checked associations, request construction, conformance dispatch/response decode, and return. Capabilities, descriptors, tasks, arenas, leases, buffers, and bytes drain; no partial catalog/request/receipt escapes.

15. Stored-byte/accounting boundary and mutation tests cover the exact nine-field PublicationAccountingV1 frame and types; zero/one/256 artifacts and 6/262 system/whole object boundaries; one-below/exact/one-over encoded/stored/expanded limits; 4096-byte envelope cap; 65/513 MiB artifact totals; 8 MiB system and 73/521 MiB whole caps; Posix/Windows equality; ContentStore exact envelope relation; checked overflow; and independent replay/log preservation. command_result_stdout_bytes is tested only as a complete RunnerBudgetsV2 grant, never an accounting actual.

16. UX/schema tests accept ArtifactDispositionV2 code 1 only as `LifecycleOnlyNoBundle`, reject `OutputlessLifecycle` as an alias, use canonical `bundle_rel` terminology, and reject legacy `artifact_dir` field/token introduction in this seam.

17. Independent byte oracles consume raw retained artifacts and frozen schema descriptors rather than seam serializers to recompute the preinventory catalog, canonical catalog-carrier bytes and inventory entry, complete inventory, inventory-only BundleManifest, manifest/content nominal associations, all 26 CandidateArtifactBinding fields, generic registration/association, CandidateRef, and AdmissionRequest roots. They independently count catalog carriers and refuse zero/duplicates. Cross-build/schedule/map/inventory-order results are byte-identical.

18. Canonical logs retain crate source/build/contract roots; Runner spec/run; selected family registration root and exact catalog-carrier role/schema/relative path; catalog-carrier match count; carrier and candidate inventory-entry roots; whole inventory root; stored/encoded/content roots and lengths; manifest/producer-manifest association roots; seal/presented-publication status; DestinationResourceBinding class/profile/policy/provider/freshness/generation roots; catalog/key/value/all-26-field CandidateArtifactBinding/generic-registration/binding roots; candidate/request roots; complete typed caps/budgets including explicit u128 dimension/unit limit/observation; expected/observed/effects; exact first stage/reason; stop/drain; submission_performed=false; no-claim/authority; repairs; relative artifacts; and a safe reproduction template. Secrets, absolute locators, numeric descriptors/slots and slot payloads, PIDs, wall clock, and bulk bytes are excluded; templates use fresh-capability placeholders and acquisition instructions.

19. Unit, boundary, schema/golden, property/metamorphic, API/compile-fail/trait, dependency/ownership, mutation, resolver, cancellation/timeout/fault, named-fixture release no-mock interface E2E, independent replay, and logging suites each expose nonzero exact counts, retained logs, and canonical reproduction templates with fresh-capability placeholders and acquisition instructions. Focused and applicable DSR proof statuses remain separately reported. Exact result accounting reports distinct exact ID sets and checked counts for eligible and matched positives; eligible and matched expected refusals; eligible and matched expected failures; eligible and matched mutations; typed Unsupported and inapplicable cells with exact matched reasons; unexpected mismatches; execution failures; and unexplained skips. Closure requires every eligible stable ID exactly once, nonzero applicable positive and adversarial corpora, equality within every eligible and matched subpartition, exact reason equality, and zero unexpected mismatches, execution failures, or unexplained skips.

20. Complete budget-identity tests lock the complete RunnerBudgetsRootV2 and, within it, the five named RunnerBudgetsV2 publication-accounting-subsequence fields in exact relative order. They independently mutate encoded/stored/expanded actuals, system-publication grant, whole-publication grant, every other upstream field, units, and root; enforce checked whole = actual artifact_stored + system grant, 8 MiB system cap, 65/513 MiB artifact caps, 73/521 MiB whole caps, exact/below/above/overflow cases; and propagate the complete identity through producer binding, AdmissionRequestRoot, neutral conformance, oracle, logs, and replay without implying publication or admission.

21. Conformance fixture/schema tests exercise comparison-only, effect-only, and dual-lane mismatches under DiagnosticCodeV2 code 1 `case.conformance_mismatch`; reject `comparison.mismatch` in bytes, schemas, logs, and expected observations; and prove the code cannot substitute for an rjoq Refused reason or receipt.

title: Runner-to-rjoq durable submission and recovery coordinator conformance
description:
Implement the Runner-side durable submission and recovery coordinator that verifies one published candidate bundle, submits the singular rjoq AdmissionRequestRoot, survives cancellation/crash/lost return, and queries the authority-owned committed outcome without duplicating admission persistence, policy judgment, decision construction, or receipt authority.

This leaf intentionally excludes Runner schema migration and migration consumption. Migration integration occurs only in the final 24.5.3 E2E child after the Runner migration leaf is complete, preserving parallelism between durable coordinator work and Runner migration work.

## Acceptance Criteria

The dedicated Acceptance Criteria field is the complete close gate and requires exhaustive coordinator-state, publication-preflight, idempotency/concurrency, cancellation/fault/recovery, real-rjoq no-mock E2E, independent replay, resource, negative, and detailed logging proof.

STAGED CURRENT-WIRE COORDINATOR BOUNDARY. This leaf locally executes the real-rjoq coordinator only against the exact completed Phase-1 contract plus a completed Phase-2 neutral current-wire publication fixture and the 24.5.1 presented seam result. It consumes no live Phase-3 independent-verifier root, Phase-4 canonical-harness receipt/acquisition-host chain, final Phase-5 ownership manifest, migration result, or 33-field final receipt. Those live joins and the vertical authority journey remain solely 24.5.3.2.
design:
## Authority boundary

This leaf owns only a Runner-side request coordinator and an optional non-authoritative recovery journal. Implemented rjoq.7.2 remains the sole owner of resolver validation, admission reservation, validation transcript, PolicyVerdictV1, AdmissionDecisionBasisV1, durable commit, AdmissionDecisionV1, AdmissionReceiptV1, and query/recover storage. The coordinator consumes the exact 24.5.1 seam and rjoq.7.2.1 interface; it never mirrors rjoq schemas, runs a local policy checker as authority, persists a substitute outcome, or guesses a decision.

## Durable publication preflight

Before submission the coordinator verifies the sole acyclic publication chain without owning its schemas: preinventory catalog; its canonical bytes as exactly one ordinary ArtifactInventoryEntryV2 under the selected family's exact fully namespaced registered role/schema/path; ArtifactInventoryRootV2; frozen BundleManifestV2 binding only that inventory root; the registered same-digest BundleManifestRootV2-to-ProducerManifestRootV1 association; exact DestinationResourceBindingV1 from capability acquisition; PlannedPreIntentObjectSet excluding Intent/Seal; PublicationKey from invocation+manifest+selection+destination+planned root; self-root-free Intent with expected paths; actual PreSealObjectSet/ProvenDurablePreSeal over planned+Intent excluding Seal; DurablePublicationIdentity binding destination and planned/actual roots; Seal/final commit/PublishedBundleReceipt preserving destination identity. After publication it requires a successful 24.5.1 seam verification of the exact 26-field CandidateArtifactBinding, including unique carrier and separate candidate-entry membership plus registered content/manifest/binding associations, then transports the complete request. It does not implement or decode that concrete schema itself. No RunnerProducerBindingV1/selected record exists. All supported protocol/path/destination cells are exercised. Publication/resource binding proves durable target continuity only, never admission.


The complete RunnerBudgetsRootV2 remains first-class. Within its full upstream schema, the publication-accounting subsequence contains `artifact_encoded_bytes`, `artifact_stored_bytes`, and `artifact_expanded_bytes` in that relative order before the two publication grants. Encoded/expanded bundle ceilings are 64 MiB Smoke and 512 MiB Full; stored ceilings are 65 MiB/513 MiB for at most 256 artifacts and at most 4096 canonical ContentStore envelope bytes each. Posix/Windows require stored == encoded; ContentStore requires stored == encoded + exact nonpayload envelope length. Complete-object sums use checked arithmetic before allocation, publication preflight, submission, retry, or replay.

## Exact request identity and submission

The coordinator transports `AdmissionRequestV1` unchanged. `AdmissionRequestRootV1` covers exactly one CandidateRef plus resolver_policy_root, checker_root, capability_root, producer_binding_root, admission_budgets_root, no_claim_scope_root, and caller_idempotency_key. This complete root, not a manually reconstructed tuple, is the durable idempotency address. Identical concurrent/retried submissions target one authority-owned outcome. Any semantic change, including producer binding, budgets, no-claim scope, or caller key, changes the root. Nonsemantic attempt token, transport connection, resolver handle, journal path, or locator cannot fork identity.

Before rjoq commits an outcome, first submission/recovery must present a current CandidateResolverV1 and pass owner validation. After rjoq has committed, the coordinator resolves ambiguous/lost returns exclusively through `query_by_request_root` or `recover_by_request_root`; it must not reacquire or dereference the original resolver. A committed outcome remains queryable if that resolver later expires, rotates, is revoked, or disappears. A new semantic request after rotation gets a new request root.

The coordinator observes rjoq's cycle-free ordering: receipt-free basis first; for Eligible, private receipt staging followed by one atomic public commit of basis, receipt, and final Admitted decision; for non-Admitted, one atomic public commit of matching basis and decision with no receipt. It accepts only Absent/InFlight-with-no-final-outcome or a complete Committed record and rejects orphan receipt, decision/receipt disagreement, multiple outcomes, or substituted roots.

## Non-authoritative journal

`HandoffAttemptJournalV1`, domain `org.frankensim.fs-evidence-runner.handoff-attempt-journal.v1`, has exactly these ordered fields:

1. `run_id: RunIdV2`
2. `published_bundle_receipt_root: PublishedBundleReceiptRootV2`
3. `candidate_artifact_binding_root: CandidateArtifactBindingRootV1`
4. `producer_binding_root: ProducerBindingRootV1`
5. `admission_request_root: AdmissionRequestRootV1`
6. `caller_idempotency_key: CallerIdempotencyKeyV1`
7. `logical_attempt_token: HandoffAttemptTokenV1`
8. `phase: HandoffAttemptPhaseV1`
9. `last_acknowledged_rjoq_operation_id: Option<RjoqOperationIdV1>`
10. `observed_basis_root: Option<AdmissionDecisionBasisRootV1>`
11. `observed_decision_root: Option<AdmissionDecisionRootV1>`
12. `observed_receipt_root: Option<AdmissionReceiptRootV1>`
13. `retryability: RetryabilityV1`
14. `no_claim_scope_root: NoClaimScopeRootV1`

Phase codes are 1 BundleVerified, 2 RequestPrepared, 3 Submitted, 4 OutcomeObserved, 5 Returned. Optional authority roots are opaque foreign observations. The journal cannot construct or validate a basis/decision/receipt, cannot advance rjoq state, and may be corrupt or absent without affecting authoritative idempotency. Cancellation before submission returns no admission outcome. Ambiguity after submission is always resolved by rjoq query/recovery using the same request root.

## Fault and resource semantics

Fault injection uses rjoq.7.2 owner-defined hooks and barrier names while independently checking externally visible atomicity. Runner pre-seal/seal/final-publication events and rjoq basis/receipt/final-decision commit events remain separately typed and logged. At every return, cancellation, timeout, lost response, malformed journal, transport break, or restart, the coordinator drains resolver capabilities, descriptors, tasks, arenas, leases, buffers, request handles, and caller-owned reservations.

No Runner lifecycle/bundle/publication object, seam binding, CandidateRef/Request, journal, expected/observed decision, coordinator conformance result, or replay output can construct Evidence, Certified, an AdmissionReceipt, or an admitted decision.

## Explicit migration exclusion and UX vocabulary

This leaf neither consumes Runner MigrationObservationV2 nor tests Runner/rjoq schema migration. It must have no dependency on the Runner migration leaf. The final no-mock E2E child owns migration integration after that leaf, using the coordinator's stable request/query API. Current wire inputs are exercised as-is here.

Where a publication preflight records ArtifactDispositionV2 code 1, the sole name is `LifecycleOnlyNoBundle`; `OutputlessLifecycle` is rejected. Canonical bundle-relative vocabulary is `bundle_rel`; legacy `artifact_dir` naming is not introduced.
## Complete publication-budget identity

Durable preflight and the transported `admission_budgets_root` bind the complete RunnerBudgetsRootV2. Within that full schema, the publication-accounting subsequence is exactly `artifact_encoded_bytes`, `artifact_stored_bytes`, `artifact_expanded_bytes`, `system_publication_stored_bytes`, `publication_stored_bytes` in relative order. System and whole publication fields are explicit grants. Checked whole use equals actual artifact-stored bytes plus the system grant; the system cap is 8 MiB, artifact caps are 65/513 MiB, and whole caps are 73/521 MiB. The complete root, every upstream field, and each named subsequence field remain semantic through request idempotency, rjoq basis/receipt cross-checks, lost-return recovery, journal observations, logs, and replay.

Any retained Runner case-conformance diagnostic in publication preflight uses DiagnosticCodeV2 code 1 only as `case.conformance_mismatch`; `comparison.mismatch` is rejected. The coordinator transports its bounded root as producer evidence only and never maps it into an rjoq Refused reason or local authority decision.

The coordinator rejects every reversed edge/cycle and records the exact order: catalog construction -> unique ordinary catalog-carrier entry -> ArtifactInventoryRootV2 -> BundleManifest inventory-only edge -> registered ProducerManifest association -> DestinationResourceBinding -> planned set -> key -> self-root-free Intent -> actual pre-seal durability -> DurablePublicationIdentity -> Seal/final receipt -> seam-verified CandidateArtifactBinding -> registered generic association -> request. The catalog contains no inventory, destination, or later root; the manifest contains no phase-5 catalog field; same-resource new slots preserve downstream roots; different resources move them; generic conversions/rehashes and raw locator/slot identity are absent; result-length observations never enter identity.

## Complete budget-root binding

RunnerBudgetsV2 is not a five-field schema. This handoff binds and verifies the complete RunnerBudgetsRootV2, or the rjoq-registered AdmissionBudgetsRootV1 mapping to that complete root. Within the full upstream schema, the publication-accounting subsequence is exactly artifact_encoded_bytes, artifact_stored_bytes, artifact_expanded_bytes, system_publication_stored_bytes, publication_stored_bytes in that relative order. The last two are grants. Tests independently verify the complete root plus this subsequence, units, checked actual/grant equations, caps, identity, receipt, retry/recovery, logs, and replay; no unnamed upstream budget field may be omitted or defaulted.

## Acyclic accounting and outer-result boundary

Publication preflight exact-set-checks the upstream nine-field PublicationAccountingV1 actuals record: `lifecycle_encoded_bytes: u64`, artifact encoded/stored/expanded `u64`, system/whole publication stored `u64`, `artifact_object_count: u32`, `system_object_count: u16`, and `publication_object_count: u32`. The complete RunnerBudgetsRootV2 remains the grant identity and separately includes `command_result_stdout_bytes`. That grant never becomes a PublicationAccounting actual. Pure upstream sizing separately computes the exact DurableCommandResultV2 semantic payload length, fixed six-field transport-header length, and checked full-frame total before publication; after receipt/recovery, re-encoding must reproduce payload and total, command_result_stdout_bytes must contain the total, and nominal payload-root plus typed context-root equality are independently verified. All lengths plus encode/write/flush/return state are bounded non-authoritative CommandResultDeliveryObservationV1/log observations outside the coordinator journal, request, rjoq basis/decision/receipt, and every publication/admission identity.

The coordinator does not own or construct either outer-result schema. It accepts no serialized result_root and no redundant BundleManifestRoot/SealRoot in a durable result; the receipt already binds them. For Replay-derived inputs it preserves the upstream InvocationBasisV2 optional ReplayLineageRootV2 identity exactly, never adds a direct MigrationExecutionBasisRootV2, and never interprets or executes migration. ReplayLineageV2 contains the current migration basis exactly once; migration integration remains exclusively 24.5.3.2.

## Schema-ownership manifest preflight

RunnerSpecV2 is base/family-only and cannot contain later schema-descriptor/ownership roots. Publication preflight separately exact-set-verifies the RunnerPhase1SchemaOwnershipRegistryV2 root from 24.1.3.2 followed in order by RunnerPhase2SchemaOwnershipManifestV2, RunnerPhase3SchemaOwnershipManifestV2, RunnerPhase4SchemaOwnershipManifestV2, and the current phase-5 leaf-entry set awaiting RunnerPhase5SchemaOwnershipManifestV2 final join. The coordinator records observed roots descriptively but never rewrites an earlier registry/manifest, inserts one into RunnerSpec, constructs the phase-5 final manifest, or treats the journal as registry authority.

## Destination-resource preflight and recovery

`DestinationResourceBindingV1` has the exact upstream domain and eight ordered fields: root class, platform path profile, RootCapabilityPolicyRootV2, privacy-preserving stable ResourceIdentityRootV2, identity-provider policy root, freshness observation root, optional generation observation root, and no-claim scope. Its root is computed beside the frame. Preflight and every recovery path verify this binding before mutation/submission. A replacement descriptor/handle/slot for the same resource must reproduce the same root and receipt; a different resource must move PublicationKey, intent, durable identity, final commit, published receipt, CandidateArtifactBinding, producer binding, and request. Raw paths, inode/file IDs, handle/slot values, credentials, capability payloads, provider secrets, and locators are prohibited.

The non-authoritative coordinator journal may retain only DestinationResourceBindingRootV1 and typed freshness/generation observations needed for retry diagnostics, never raw identity/provider payloads. Missing stable identity is Unsupported; stale/generation/policy mismatch follows upstream first-failure precedence. The coordinator cannot convert resource continuity into candidate truth, policy eligibility, AdmissionReceipt, Evidence, or Certified.
## Generic rjoq and full-width budget boundaries

The coordinator consumes rjoq's generic producer-binding registration/result only. Runner-specific schema/domain/catalog/26-field validation and Phase1-5 ownership live in 24.5.1/24.5.3; rjoq.7.2.1 has no Runner dependency. - 24.5.3.1, 1,260 minutes: independent publish-false raw-byte verifier for the exact three-field preinventory declaration catalog, its unique ordinary registered inventory carrier, frozen BundleManifest inventory-only commitment, PublishedBundleReceipt, exact 26-field CandidateArtifactBinding, three registered same-digest nominal associations, CandidateRef, complete AdmissionRequest, and descriptive verification result.

- 24.5.3.2, 1,680 minutes: final publish-false no-mock harness and complete six-command CLI journey, durable semantic-result staging and verifiable transport, real rjoq decisions/recovery, delayed Runner migration integration, Phase-5 manifest finalization/verifier rerun, sole final sealed-joiner invocation and oracle comparison, and dual-chain replay.

The rollup joins exact current source/build/CONTRACT/schema/registry/fixture/test/log/replay roots from all three children; the earlier seam/coordinator; independent Runner decoder; completed Runner migration/adoption; implemented rjoq interface/runtime; and named fixture. The child-specific external edges, including 24.4.2 and rjoq.7.2/.7.2.1, are now encoded directly on their owning children and exact-set-audited; parent-child blockers are never treated as inherited.

It reconciles these noninterchangeable layers:

1. Runner lifecycle plus exact ten-field LifecycleOnlyCommandResultV2 and twelve-field DurableCommandResultV2 fully staged semantic output with complete-or-detectably-truncated transport and computed roots beside frames.
2. Runner stored/encoded/content/inventory/manifest; exact DestinationResourceBinding; planned set; PublicationKey; self-root-free Intent; actual pre-seal durability; DurablePublicationIdentity; Seal/final receipt; exact nine-field PublicationAccounting; and non-authoritative result delivery.

4. CandidateRef and the complete eight-field AdmissionRequestRoot.

6. Independent handoff verification/replay.

The vocabulary join accepts ArtifactDispositionV2 code 1 only as `LifecycleOnlyNoBundle`, canonical `--bundle-rel BUNDLE_REL`, and rejects `OutputlessLifecycle`, `--artifact-dir`, and aliases. The PublishedBundleReceipt is not a lifecycle record. Child source closures must exact-set implementation, contracts, schemas/owners, independent oracles, fixtures, E2E scripts or contribution rows, log schemas, dependencies/features, and build inputs. Closeout reports all proof statuses separately and never promotes focused proof, a child Pass, a no-authority conformance receipt, or a publication/admission result into scientific or authority evidence.

40. PRESENTED-VERIFIER/LIVE-DURABILITY RECEIPT GATE (CONTROLLING). Exact-field, golden, full-frame, property/model, mutation, API/compile-fail, release-built E2E, detailed-log, coverage, and source-closure joins require field 5 to be exact `VerifierResultV2::PresentedPublicationEvidenceConformant` and field 26 to be the separately executed live acquisition-host durability/publication/recovery chain set. Missing, swapped, same-root, inferred, wrong-variant, wrong-owner, stale, or mixed-snapshot principals refuse; neither may substitute for or widen the authority of the other.

41. INPUT-SOURCE/OUTPUT-DESTINATION CAPABILITY-ROLE GATE (CONTROLLING). Exact CLI/help/completion, rights-policy, property/model/race, mutation, API, native-E2E, log/redaction, and source-closure joins preserve read-only `--input-artifact-root` versus distinct publication-only `--artifact-root`; exhaust absent/present/same/swapped/wrong-kind/wrong-right/stale/revoked cells; require refusal before reads/writes/stdout; and verify ranked redacted repairs.

ROLLUP FIVE-EXPLICITS AND LOG-COMPLETENESS JOIN (CONTROLLING). This rollup exact-set joins every direct child Five-Explicits root and complete-log root on the same source/build snapshot. Missing, extra, duplicate, stale, mixed, unit-ambiguous, seedless-without-typed-reason, over-budget, capability-incomplete, partially logged, silently truncated, or terminal-less child evidence refuses. Aggregate counts or a parent budget cannot replace any child cell exact explicit values or complete terminal log.

SEMANTIC SEED PROPAGATION AND PROOF JOIN (CONTROLLING). This bead does not invent a second seed type or hidden default. Every owned schema, fixture, command, execution, artifact, replay, verifier, receipt, log, source-closure, E2E row, or rollup join that carries an invocation or case preserves the exact upstream `InvocationSeedSelectionRootV2`, `CaseSeedPolicyV2`, and applicable `CaseExecutionSeedRootV2` or registered `NoRandomness` absence through typed parent bindings. Unit/property/model/race/mutation/API/compile-fail/release-E2E-or-contribution/log/source-closure proof covers omission, substitution, wrong case/run, stale/mixed snapshot, override, ambient randomness, and count-only evidence. Test-harness seeds remain separately typed Five-Explicit data and cannot substitute for the semantic workload seed. Seed evidence establishes reproducibility only and never scientific, publication, verification, or admission authority.

STAGED COORDINATOR VERSUS LIVE FINAL-JOURNEY SPLIT (CONTROLLING). Phase closeout records .24.5.2 local current-wire coordinator proof and its result-free contribution manifest separately from .24.5.3.2 live Phase-3/4/5 execution. No local coordinator row may claim live Phase-4 roots, migration, acquisition-host durability, final ownership, final receipt, or downstream execution; the final join must consume each row once and prove equality with the live fixture chain.

ROLLUP E2E ROUTE RESOLUTION JOIN (CONTROLLING). This rollup exact-set joins every direct child execution/contribution classification and proves a one-to-one mapping from each contribution row to one literal downstream owner, driver, script/native route, and immutable manifest. Every execution owner exact-set consumes its rows once and retains release identity, complete logs, source closure, result partitions, and relative artifacts. Missing, ambiguous, duplicate, stale, remapped, wrong-owner/script, unexecuted, multiply executed, hidden-skip, contribution-only-Pass, or focused-proof substitution refuses.

AC58 DESCENDANT SCHEMA-IMPACT JOIN (CONTROLLING ROLLUP). This rollup owns no implementation schema and may mint no leaf evidence. It consumes the exact SchemaImpactManifestV1 from every recursively contained implementation leaf on one compatible source snapshot and constructs a deterministic descendant join ordered by stable leaf ID, then stable schema ID. The join records exact descendant and schema-row counts plus exact counts for NewV1NoPredecessor, UnchangedV1, MigratedV1ToV2, DecodeOnlyLegacyV1, RetiredV1, and InapplicableNoCanonicalFrame; every count is checked against the literal descendant inventory rather than inferred from status, labels, estimates, source ordinals, or child aggregate totals. It refuses a missing, extra, duplicate, reordered, stale, owner-remapped, cross-rollup, unknown-disposition, incompatible-snapshot, V1/V2-substituted, partial-migration, or multiply aggregated leaf/schema row, and refuses any authoritative V2 close claim while a required descendant is absent or still names an incompatible authoritative V1 parent.

Comprehensive rollup tests cover exact-empty where structurally legal, one descendant, the exact live maximum, one-over injected input, all six dispositions, nested-rollup associativity without double counting, order/shard/schedule/resume invariance, every missing/extra/duplicate/reorder and mixed-snapshot mutation, first explicit divergence, bounded deterministic step-prefixed logging and redaction, structured reproduction, overflow terminal, coverage counters, and exact source closure. A source-closed release-built E2E join consumes only already produced leaf evidence and proves aggregation fidelity; it does not execute descendants, replace their unit/property/model/mutation/API/fault/E2E/log/source-closure gates, or promote focused, DSR, downstream, durability, scientific, or authority proof. CONTRACT/rustdoc and the final rollup report list every descendant schema-impact manifest and all separate proof states.

FINAL JOURNEY ROLLUP CLOSE RECONCILIATION 2026-07-29 (CONTROLLING). Final green requires the Observed execution envelope from `.24.5.3.2`. The independent verifier, private joiner/oracle contribution, focused coordinator execution, Phase-4 receipt, and rjoq contract are exact prerequisites but cannot individually close the journey. The rollup exact-joins every source/build/schema/log/reproduction/coverage root and separately reports local seam, focused durability, independent verification, immutable contribution readiness, observed final admission, recovery, replay, and no-authority status. Deferred-only, result-count-only, or context-free closure refuses.

LIVE ROLLUP TOPOLOGY, SCHEDULING, AND OPERABILITY 2026-07-29 (FINAL CONTROLLING). This issue is a `runner-v2-rollup` epic. Its exact direct hierarchy children are: `frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.5.3.1`, `frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.5.3.2`, `frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24.5.3.3`. Its current recursive subtree contains exactly 4 Beads: 3 implementation tasks totaling 3,660 minutes and 1 rollup epics totaling 90 minutes, for 3,750 minutes. The 3 internal `parent-child` relations are closure hierarchy only; no reciprocal parent-depends-on-child `blocks` edge is permitted. This rollup's own 90-minute estimate covers only its explicitly named aggregate, integration, join, driver, rerun, source-closure, or close-review work and is not duplicated in child estimates. Functional implementation order remains solely in explicit `blocks` edges among owning tasks. While `br epic status` reports `eligible_for_close=false`, this rollup MUST have status `blocked`, never `open` or `in_progress`; when eligibility becomes true, transition it to `open` or `in_progress` only for its scoped closeout, then close it. The canonical executable-work query is `br ready --epic frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24 --type task`. `bv` robot output is diagnostic only; any surfaced rollup is not executable implementation work. Close this rollup only after every exact child-root, integration, test/E2E, detailed-log/redaction, reproduction, source-closure, proof-state, authority, and no-claim gate in this Bead passes. This clause supersedes every earlier numeric node/estimate/subtotal claim and every earlier phrase treating hierarchy children as reciprocal `blocks` dependencies or this epic as an implementation task. It removes no scope, feature, functionality, test, E2E script/contribution, logging, reproduction, source, route, capability, durability, scientific, admission, authority, or no-claim obligation.

ROLLUP CLOSEOUT DISCOVERABILITY AND MANUAL-EVIDENCE GATE 2026-07-29 (FINAL CONTROLLING). `br ready --epic frankensim-epic-foundations-huq.24 --type task --json --limit 0` is the canonical implementation-task query; `bv` robot output is dependency/impact diagnosis, not executable status. When `br epic status --eligible-only --json` first reports this epic eligible because all direct children are closed, the epic is not automatically complete. Its deterministic closeout view MUST expose any remaining integration/route/join/rerun/review work; exact route ID where applicable; immutable command/driver/manifest descriptor; compatible source/build/schema roots; unresolved stable cells and proof states; expected result partitions; retained relative artifact root; retryability; no-claim scope; and uniquely ranked non-executable repairs. A route-owning or integration-owning epic must be claimed and its own acceptance evidence completed before explicit close; task-only queries must not make that work disappear, and automatic bulk epic closure cannot substitute for it.

The transition from blocked -> eligible closeout -> in-progress closeout -> explicitly closed is deterministic and logged. Literal/unit, state/model/race, mutation, API/compile-fail, fault/cancellation, integrated E2E or child-evidence replay, detailed logging/redaction, reproduction, exact coverage, and source-closure tests cover premature surfacing, hidden remaining route work, missing/extra/duplicate child roots, stale eligibility, already-complete reruns, failed closeout and safe retry, mixed snapshots, bulk-close substitution, and exact final proof-state separation. Pure review rollups use a typed no-route closeout; no epic may invent or infer an unnamed route merely to become discoverable.

ACCESSIBLE OPERATOR-EXPERIENCE AND HUMAN/MACHINE E2E JOIN 2026-07-29 (FINAL CONTROLLING). This rollup exact-set joins the shell-independent grammar/presentation contribution from `.24.1.2.1`, generated Bash/Zsh/Fish/PowerShell completion/help artifacts and release-test contribution from `.24.1.3.2.2`, canonical release-built operator journey from `.24.4.1.4`, and final Runner-to-rjoq recovery/admission journey from `.24.5.3.2` as they become applicable in this phase. Static contribution, generated-artifact proof, canonical Runner execution, and final admission execution remain distinct statuses; a later result cannot repair a missing earlier contract, and a contribution cannot claim observed execution.

Closeout separately reports novice and expert machine journeys; POSIX and direct native-Windows coverage; TTY/non-TTY, `TERM=dumb`, `NO_COLOR`, optional color, zero/narrow/wide widths, C/UTF-8 locale, Unicode/combining/CJK/emoji/control handling, ASCII fallback, plain-text/screen-reader order, no mandatory animation/prompt, progress sink variants, broken pipe, cancellation, channel/exit behavior, attempt/telemetry correlation, bounded logs/reproduction, retained relative artifacts, and semantic-root invariance. Missing/extra/duplicate/remapped cells, color/glyph/timing-only status, human/machine channel contamination, presentation-driven semantics, hidden prompt/skip, inaccessible diagnostics, unsafe echo, silent truncation, or mixed source/build snapshot refuses.
