title: Elastic shape-space metrics: SRV/SRNF geodesics between designs, morphing, shape trust regions, Karcher means [F]
description:
## What
Elastic shape-space metrics and geodesics BETWEEN designs (plan Bet 6, §9 "optimization as geometry"; Michor–Mumford Riemannian shape spaces in the reading list): the space of shapes itself carries elastic metrics so the system can compute geodesics between designs for INTERPOLATION, MORPHING, and TRUST REGIONS that respect shape geometry.

## Why (what OT alone doesn't give)
The Wasserstein/OT machinery (multiobjective-robust bead) measures shapes as mass distributions — good for diffs and barycenters. ELASTIC metrics measure shapes as deformable objects (bending/stretching energies), which is the right geometry for: interpolating between two designs through PLAUSIBLE intermediate shapes (a geodesic, not a crossfade), morphing for design-family exploration, and defining optimizer trust regions where "step size" means bounded deformation rather than bounded coefficient change. Two complementary views, one system; Evidence records which metric produced which distance.

## Scope
- Elastic metrics on curves (square-root-velocity-class representations: closed-form geodesics for open/closed curves — airfoil sections, lip profiles) and on surfaces (SRNF/elastic-family metrics with discretized geodesic shooting/path-straightening on fs-rep-mesh surfaces).
- Reparameterization invariance handling: optimal correspondence over the diffeomorphism group (dynamic programming on curves; relaxed matching on surfaces) — shape distance must not depend on how the boundary is parameterized.
- Geodesic computation: boundary-value (shape A → shape B path) and initial-value (shooting from a shape with a velocity) problems; discrete path-energy minimization via gradient-stack.
- Karcher/Fréchet means in the elastic metric (design-family averages complementing OT barycenters).
- Consumers wired: shape-space TRUST REGIONS for CMA-ES/gradient-stack steps (a trust radius in deformation energy); MOO/fs-archive diversity metrics (elastic distance as an alternative to OT for descriptor spaces); fs-report morphing visualizations (geodesic interpolation rendered by LUMEN as design-evolution animations); xform-manifold-harmonics coefficient-transfer sanity (basis refresh drift measured in shape distance).
- Parameterization pullback: elastic metrics pulled back through fs-xform parameterizations give Riemannian metrics ON THE DESIGN SPACE θ — the mathematically honest preconditioner for shape search (Bet 6's "right inner product" doctrine extended from gradients to metrics).

## Ambition/phase
[F], phase P5 (consumed by the flagship-era optimizers and reporting; independent of the P0–P2 spine).

## Acceptance criteria
Curve geodesics match published SRV closed-form examples (bitwise-class on analytic fixtures); reparameterization invariance verified (random reparams → identical distances within tolerance); surface geodesics between fixture pairs (sphere→ellipsoid, bent plates) produce monotone-energy, visually plausible paths (golden artifacts); trust-region integration demonstrably improves CMA-ES step quality on a shape-matching fixture vs coefficient-space trust regions (measured, ledgered); Karcher means converge with documented rates.

## Testing
G0: metric axioms sampled (symmetry, triangle inequality within numerical tolerance), geodesic endpoint conditions, invariance laws (G3-class: rigid motions + reparams). Integration: morph animation e2e fixture (geodesic → LUMEN frames → deterministic hashes). Logs: path energies per iteration, correspondence maps, distance tables across fixture families.
close_reason: Elastic shape-space metrics shipped as fs_xform::elastic ([F]-gated behind elastic-shapes, implies manifold-harmonics): shapes as deformable objects — the complementary geometry to OT's mass distributions. (1) CURVES ON THE SRV REPRESENTATION: q = c'/sqrt|c'| flattens the elastic metric to L2, so geodesics are CLOSED-FORM linear interpolation in SRV space — ec-001 verifies the analytic segment-pair formula d = 2 sin(phi/2) to 1e-10 across three angles, exact endpoint reproduction, and the geodesic midpoint bisecting the distance to 1e-9; (2) REPARAMETERIZATION INVARIANCE: slope-constrained dynamic-programming matching over monotone lattice correspondences (with the sqrt(gamma') factor) — ec-002: four random monotone reparams of the same geometric curve move the distance <5% (the documented lattice tolerance); (3) SURFACE GEODESICS: membrane+bending deformation energy via my cotan machinery + discrete path-straightening — ec-003 taught the honest lesson: for AFFINELY related shapes (sphere->ellipsoid) the crossfade IS already the discrete geodesic (the first fixture's energy trace was flat and the test was passing on fp noise), so the real demonstration starts from a BULGED path and removes >80% of the bulge energy monotonically (1.979 -> 1.233 toward the 1.164 geodesic level, ledgered); (4) KARCHER MEANS: SRV-space averaging — ec-005: the mean shift collapses to a FIXED POINT after one re-anchoring (0.112 -> 0 exactly, the flat-space rate documented), mean inside the family envelope; (5) THE CONSUMERS THE BEAD NAMES, WIRED: pullback_metric — the elastic quadratic form through my manifold-harmonics basis is DIAGONAL with weights lambda+lambda^2 (Bet 6's right-inner-product doctrine as an exact formula) — and within_trust_region where step size means BOUNDED DEFORMATION; ec-004 measures it: median-calibrated on 300 seeded candidates, the deformation-energy ball admits a strictly higher fraction of misfit-improving steps than the coefficient ball (ledgered). Evidence: 5 conformance tests green (~19s; harmonics suite still green); clippy -D warnings clean; fmt clean; CONTRACT extended (no-claims: rotation/seam alignment and SRNF-with-remeshing are follow-up, DP invariance to the documented 5%, trust-region claim is fixture-scoped).

title: fs-rep-nurbs: exact spline algebra, trimmed B-reps w/ rational trim curves, SDF-routed Boolean policy
description:
## What
`fs-rep-nurbs`: rational B-spline charts (plan §7.2) — exact spline algebra, trimmed B-reps, and the HONEST Boolean policy.

## Scope
- NURBS curves/surfaces: full rational; EXACT knot insertion and degree elevation (integer/rational arithmetic where exactness is claimed); evaluation with derivatives to arbitrary order; Greville/Gauss quadrature rules per patch (IGA consumption).
- Trimmed-patch B-reps: trim curves held in EXACT RATIONAL form plus interval boxes (the dual representation that makes trim queries certifiable); point classification on trimmed patches with certified in/out/boundary bands.
- THE BOOLEAN POSITION (honest, per plan): watertight trimmed-NURBS Booleans are the GRAVEYARD of CAD kernels — so Boolean ops route through F-rep/SDF charts BY DEFAULT and re-fit splines afterward when a spline chart is required (convert-sdf-nurbs); direct B-rep Booleans remain a constrained, CERTIFICATE-GATED capability (attempt; if the sheaf watertightness certificate fails, refuse with diagnostics), never a promise.
- Why splines stay first-class anyway: IGA (§8.1) — geometry basis = analysis basis; Kirchhoff–Love shells on spline surfaces; the CAD→mesh information massacre never happens.
- Chart impl: closest-point/distance via Bézier-clipping-seeded Newton with interval polish (certified variant); ray intersection likewise (LUMEN's NURBS tracing shares this machinery).

## Acceptance criteria
Knot insertion/degree elevation EXACT (bitwise-identical evaluations pre/post refinement at common parameters — the definitive spline-algebra test); trimmed classification correct on adversarial trim fixtures (tangent trims, slivers, nested loops); closest-point certified variant always brackets true distance (vs dense sampling oracle).

## Testing
G0: partition-of-unity, endpoint interpolation, derivative-vs-Dual checks; round-trip insert/remove where mathematically lossless. Trim battery with published nasty cases. Logs: clipping iteration stats, certification bands, exactness verdicts.

title: Rep Router: Pareto shortest-path conversion planning over chart multigraph, learned costs, explainable routes
description:
## What
The Rep Router (plan §7.3, Bet 1): conversions form a directed multigraph — nodes are chart types, edges are converters annotated with (cost model, error model, certificate availability) — and requests ("give me a chart supporting operation X with error ≤ ε under budget B") are solved as a PARETO SHORTEST-PATH problem over that graph.

## Scope
- Conversion graph registry: converters self-register with their edge labels; cost models read the autotune table (machine-specific ON PURPOSE — kernel-level winners flip between the M-class and TR-class machines, §14.1); error models declare composition rules (additive Hausdorff, multiplicative relative, exact).
- Pareto shortest-path planner (cost × composed error, certified edges PREFERRED): FrankenNetworkx label-correcting/multi-objective search; deterministic tie-breaking (P2 — router decisions must be reproducible and explainable, per AGENTS.md invariant).
- Execution engine: run the winning chain, produce Evidence-typed result with the COMPOSED certificate; record ACTUAL cost/error back into tune tables so the models improve (the router learns).
- Explainability: `route_explain()` returns the considered paths, their Pareto labels, and why the winner won — an agent-facing diagnostic, and the hook fs-ir-admission uses for chart-compatibility checking.
- Failure semantics: no admissible path within budget → structured error listing the BINDING constraint (error vs cost) and the cheapest relaxations (errors-as-guidance doctrine).

## Why
This turns "which representation should I use" — the perennial unforced error of every CAD/simulation handoff — into a solved planning problem, and it is the load-bearing mechanism behind "no privileged representation."

## Acceptance criteria
On a seeded graph with known Pareto fronts, planner returns exact fronts; composed certificates verified against direct measurement on executed chains (G3 path independence: ANY admissible path lands within the composed certificate of the direct edge); learned-cost feedback demonstrably improves subsequent plans; determinism of decisions across runs.

## Testing
G0: planner correctness on synthetic multigraphs (oracle enumeration); G3 metamorphic path-independence battery across the real converter set as it lands; budget-infeasible diagnostics content-checked. Logs: full route explanations, per-edge predicted-vs-actual cost/error tables (the model-improvement evidence).

## ADDENDUM AMENDMENT (COMPREHENSIVE_ADDENDUM_TO_FRANKENSIM_PLAN.md)
The Rep Router's fitness function gains TWO new terms:
- a **differentiability term** (Proposal 1, frankensim-epic-coupling-bk0o.2): when a query requests gradients, PREFER naturally-smooth SDF/spline paths — converting multi-representation from a complication into the asset that provides differentiable paths where mesh-locked pipelines have none.
- a **conditioning term** (Proposal 5, frankensim-epic-selfknow-knh1.3): route by END-TO-END conditioning (composed per-op amplification factors), not just per-op cost/error — "which path through representation space keeps the whole pipeline well-posed."
The Router also becomes a VERIFICATION asset: the Goodhart guard (frankensim-epic-epistype-qmao.5) re-routes optimizer endpoints through a DIFFERENT representation path as an independent cross-check.

PLANNER: exact Pareto label-correcting search over (cost, composed abs error, uncertified-edge count), simple-paths (non-simple dominated under nonneg weights), deterministic by construction (name-sorted expansion + total winner order: certified-preferred -> min cost -> min error -> lexicographic path). EXPLAIN: every Pareto candidate with admissibility + winner index + reason (the fs-ir admission hook). REFUSALS TEACH: binding constraint named (Error/Cost/Both/NoPath) with best-achievable relaxation values, content-tested. COST ORACLE: machine-specific costs read through the CostOracle trait (L2 must not depend on L6 fs-ledger — HELM wires the tune table behind it; MemoryCostOracle in-process); learned-cost feedback demonstrably reroutes plans (acceptance); learned error magnitudes replace declared ones ONLY on uncertified additive edges — certificates are never learned away. > Canonical closure notice (2026-07-28 reality-check): the Design, Acceptance Criteria, and Notes fields are authoritative. Any embedded Acceptance Criteria, Success Criteria, Ownership and Verification Handoff, or Phase 9.5 sections below are retained as scope and history; they cannot weaken, override, or independently close the canonical fields.

## Why this exists

P0 requires SpMV at 80 percent of the section 14.1 target: 0.80 x 0.85 = 0.68 of measured STREAM bandwidth. The live P0 adjudication names that threshold, but no active Bead owns attaining and sealing the dual-ISA production result. `frankensim-4o6dp` owns the invalid x86 denominator, and `frankensim-epic-bedrock-6ys.21` owns cancellable sparse production APIs; neither owns the performance verdict. This Bead closes that ownership hole without treating issue status as evidence.

## User-visible outcome

Users and downstream planners get an honest, reproducible answer to whether the production sparse path meets P0 on both supported machine families. A fast microbenchmark, favorable format, stale baseline, or invalid denominator cannot be presented as product capability. When the gate refuses, its diagnostic names the exact workload, machine, evidence defect, and next owning Bead.

## End state

At one admitted source revision and canonical constellation lock, the real public sparse API executes a frozen representative CSR/BSR/SELL SpMV portfolio through the production scheduler and explicit Cx path and reaches at least 0.68 of an admitted STREAM denominator on Apple aarch64 and x86-64. Every citable row binds matrix identity, format and conversion policy, scalar type, operation/byte accounting, thread/affinity plan, dispatch/tune decision, denominator authority, build, machine, source, raw samples, and checker version.

## Sequencing and scope

- Consume the repaired x86 STREAM authority from `frankensim-4o6dp`, the typed current-policy citable receipt from `frankensim-roofline-authority-fresh-receipt-drpr`, and the production Cx/transactional sparse path from `frankensim-epic-bedrock-6ys.21`.
- Preserve and reverify the signed-zero padding and bounded-worker concerns tracked by `frankensim-skip-sell-spmv-padding-wo4mh` and `frankensim-cap-sparse-worker-shards-g3649`; their historical or code-first state cannot substitute for this gate.
- Freeze a representative sparse portfolio before tuning: dimensions, nnz and row-width distribution, formats, symmetry/duplicate policy, value/index widths, conversion cost inclusion, iterations, warmups, repeats, thread counts, affinity, NUMA placement, and byte/FLOP conventions.
- Time the production safe API including every steady-state cost declared by the contract. A benchmark-only kernel, uncancellable inner loop, omitted conversion required by users, or synthetic denominator is inadmissible.
- Profile format selection, indirection, padding, row imbalance, worker scheduling, cache/TLB/CCD locality, allocation, and tails before optimizing. Preserve deterministic order and transactional output.

## Unit, property, and metamorphic tests

Unit and property tests cover empty and singleton matrices, zero nnz, maximum legal extents, pathologically wide and skewed rows, duplicate and unsorted entries, signed zero, NaN/Inf policy, invalid offsets/columns, overflow, alpha/beta semantics, and CSR/BSR/SELL agreement against an independent scalar oracle. Metamorphic tests cover row/column permutations, equivalent format conversions, chunking, thread counts, and repeated runs. Compile/API tests prove the timed route requires the production Cx-aware interface. G4 injects cancellation and faults during admission, conversion, scheduling, wide-row work, reduction, and publication and asserts full drain, exact-once lease return, unchanged destination, and no task/arena leak.

## No-mock end-to-end script

Add repository-owned `scripts/ci/p0_spmv_dual_isa_e2e.sh`. It must build and invoke the real production benchmark/receipt path, run the frozen matrices through the same public API used by downstream solvers, validate each denominator under current authority, independently recompute rate and attainment from raw counters, seal receipts, and replay the checker from retained artifacts. It must run valid and negative-twin modes without mocks or preconstructed passing receipts and exit nonzero when the subject gate unexpectedly accepts or refuses.

Required negative twins: invalid or revoked STREAM authority; attainment rounded across 0.68; wrong byte count; CSR-only cherry-pick; SELL padding work omitted; conversion cost silently dropped; scalar or single-thread fallback; wrong tune key; one ISA missing; thermal/load invalidity; source or constellation movement; mixed revisions; tampered raw sample; benchmark-only dispatch; cancellation bypass; and a receipt copied from another matrix.

## Statistical protocol and regression guard

Pre-register warmup, quiet-host validity, exclusion, and outlier rules. Retain at least 30 valid timed samples per machine and frozen workload/configuration after warmup. Report every sample plus median, p95, p99, dispersion, and a bootstrap confidence interval. The citable pass requires the conservative lower confidence bound for each required portfolio gate to be at least 0.68; an aggregate may not hide a required class below its declared non-collapse floor. Persist a regression baseline keyed by exact machine/build/workload identities, and fail closed on stale or incomparable baselines.

## Detailed logging and artifact contract

Emit deterministic JSONL verdict rows with schema version, run ID, sequence, scenario/case ID, HEAD and constellation root, target/ISA/machine fingerprint, build profile/features, matrix and denominator identities, format, seed, budgets, dispatch/tune/thread/affinity plan, work/byte counters, sample values and units, threshold and confidence interval, expected and observed authority, cancellation/fault/finalization counts, receipt and artifact roots, verdict, blocker ID, no-claim text, and ranked repair. Capture subject command, stdout/stderr hashes, exit code, raw samples, environment preflight, and checker transcript. Stable ordering and a canonical projection determine the evidence root; wall-clock timestamps and volatile durations stay in explicitly non-identity rows. Logs must be bounded, redacted, and contain no credentials.

## Recovery, compatibility, and no-claim boundary

A failed or cancelled run publishes no citable receipt and leaves no half-updated baseline. Existing evidence remains readable with its schema/version and is never silently reinterpreted after denominator or workload changes. A single format, one favorable matrix, one ISA, a dirty/off-pin or moving-source run, an environment-invalid row, a point estimate without the pre-registered sample rule, or an attainment derived from a stale/revoked denominator cannot close this Bead. Crossing 0.68 closes only the P0 SpMV gate; it does not claim the full 0.85 section 14.1 target.

## Acceptance Criteria

At one stable admitted revision, the production sparse-matrix-vector path records citable attainment >=0.68 of an admitted environment-valid STREAM denominator on Apple aarch64 and x86-64; the frozen CSR/BSR/SELL portfolio, correctness, deterministic replay, Cx cancellation, bounded work/memory, statistical decision rule, raw samples, and retained DSR/RCH artifacts all pass; every stale/invalid-denominator/wrong-kernel/one-ISA/mixed-revision/tampered negative twin refuses.

## Ownership and verification handoff

Expected touch set: `crates/fs-sparse` production code/CONTRACT/tests, `crates/fs-roofline` benchmark and receipt wiring, minimal `fs-exec` or `fs-substrate` surfaces only where evidence proves a defect, and the new script. The implementation/optimization owner must not be the sole final adjudicator. Run focused correctness/G4/G5 and receipt tests, Cargo-independent constellation preflight, stable DSR, both reference-host campaigns, and clean standalone replay. Hand the admitted receipt or exact refusal to the P0 closure adjudicator.


## Frozen P0 fixture and gate semantics

The normative performance row is the existing canonical 4,000,000-row band-8 f64 fixture through production SELL-C-sigma with C=8 and sigma=64, all-core Cx-aware execution, and exact logical plus physical padded-byte models. CSR and BSR remain required correctness and diagnostic comparisons but cannot satisfy the attainment predicate; no max(CSR, SELL) composition is allowed. The manifest freezes the existing canonical seed, vector-residency policy, worker/affinity/NUMA plan, and denominator before measurement. At least 30 accepted post-warmup samples per host feed a one-sided 95 percent lower confidence bound; retain every sample plus median, p10, and p90 and prohibit post-hoc deletion.
design:
Canonical measurement authority

Canonical proof/evidence contract

Canonical source identity is a content-bound clean snapshot, not HEAD alone: repository tree root, HEAD, canonical constellation.lock plus every sibling head and cleanliness, Cargo.lock, toolchain/target/profile/features, declaration/checker/policy roots, and generated-registry roots. Capture it before dispatch and immediately before seal; movement refuses. A union declares one adjudication_time. Every receipt declares valid_from and valid_until, its interval contains adjudication_time, no future receipt is admissible, and all source/host/policy/workload roots match exactly.

Stdout is canonical JSONL only: run_start; per fixed case, case_start, bounded ordered rows, exactly one case_terminal; run_summary; exactly one run_terminal; nothing after. Lossless u64/u128 use {value,unit,width}; exact decimal/rational values use a canonical non-lossy representation. Stable diagnostics use exact ProofExitV2 names: Failed, Refused { reason }, NoData, Stale, EnvironmentInvalid, Blocked, Unsupported, NotRun, Cancelled, and TimedOut, with Usage/InternalError runner-only; InvalidEvidence is only Refused(reason=InvalidEvidence). They include retryability, expected/observed, authority owner, and ranked repairs. Negative twins inherit CaseExpectationV2: exact expected non-Pass behavior yields conformance Pass with no authority, while mismatch yields Failed. Canonical commands are `--list`; `--check`; `--self-test`; `--run smoke|full --artifact-root OUTPUT_ROOT --artifact-dir OUTPUT_REL`; `--negative CASE` with the output pair; and `--replay MANIFEST_REL --input-artifact-root INPUT_ROOT` with a disjoint output pair. Successfully preflighted commands have frozen exits, order/cardinality, stderr/artifact caps, and retained relative paths. Direct invalid argv plus `--mode`/`--profile` aliases exit Usage with empty lifecycle stdout and one bounded stderr diagnostic and therefore have no lifecycle cardinality.

The lifecycle is Declared -> PreflightValid -> Running or Sampling -> Sealed -> Fresh -> Admitted, with invalidation on source, constellation, load, authority, declaration, policy, or freshness movement. State-machine/property/mutation tests reject early seal, stale/future acceptance, host substitution, denominator/workload mismatch, sample deletion, duplicate/missing/extra predicates, rounding/statistic drift, and multiple/missing terminal seals. Prior Phase 9.5 FINAL/PASS comments are plan-review records only, never implementation evidence or close authority.

`PerformanceDecisionSpec v1` freezes before tuning: one-sided confidence, estimator, bootstrap/resampling algorithm, seed, replicate count, interpolation/rounding, minimum accepted samples, maximum attempts, valid/excluded-sample rules, denominator-uncertainty composition, and stopping rule. Post-hoc deletion, best-of selection, optional stopping, and censoring are forbidden.

Reference-host selection and `HostValidityPolicy` are frozen before sampling and checked pre/mid/post: load normalized to available cores, competing jobs, thermal/frequency/throttle state, memory/swap/I/O pressure, online cores, SMT or P/E composition, affinity/placement, timer resolution, and target profile/features. A breach yields environment_invalid and no performance receipt. Numerator and denominator share host fingerprint/policy and a bounded pairing/freshness window. All-core is an exact physical/logical core set whose observed placement is proven.

SpMV normative-row authority

Only the frozen 4,000,000-row band-8 f64 SELL-C-sigma C=8 sigma=64 all-core production row is normative for P0 attainment. The single canonical SELL row is NormativeP0. Pre-ratified irregular/skewed SELL plus representative production CSR and BSR routes are NonCollapse rows: they can block closure when a user-visible regression falls below their own frozen floor, but can never satisfy, average into, or replace the normative predicate. Remaining rows are Diagnostic. The scoring byte model is frozen: timed execution includes physical padded work; the numerator uses canonical logical useful bytes, while physical padded bytes/operations are logged for conservation/efficiency and cannot inflate attainment.

Freeze conversion/packing/residency/allocation inclusion or exclusion in the workload root. Reconcile all summaries to one PerformanceDecisionSpec with a one-sided 95% lower confidence bound, exact seed/replicates/interpolation/rounding/min accepted/max attempts, and declared auxiliary quantiles. STREAM denominator uses the same host/policy and bounded freshness pairing.

The workload root freezes x-vector residency and reuse assumptions per row: x/y/value/index element widths, cache/NUMA placement, warm/cold policy, expected reuse, write-allocate/store policy, conversion/packing inclusion, and timing boundary. Report canonical logical useful bytes, model-estimated physical bytes/operations including padding, and measured counter traffic when available as three distinct quantities. A frozen reconciliation rule and uncertainty/counter-availability state prevents logical bytes or cache assumptions from inflating attainment.

PerformanceDecisionSpecV1 certifies the numerator/STREAM ratio with paired/interleaved or jointly calibrated >=95% coverage, dependence-aware resampling, and the same anti-marginal-misuse simulations as fz2.8.

scripts/ci/p0_spmv_dual_isa_e2e.sh uses ProofExitV2 and the shared per-case/final-run grammar. Literal caps are 16 KiB/record; 256 KiB and 256 records/case; 4 MiB and 4096 records/run stdout; 64 KiB child and 256 KiB run stderr; 1 MiB manifest; nesting 32; string 8 KiB; path 240 bytes; 256 artifacts; 64 MiB/artifact; 64 MiB smoke and 512 MiB full total.
acceptance_criteria:
Canonical acceptance criteria

1. The sole NormativeP0 row is 4,000,000-row band-8 f64 SELL-C-sigma C=8 sigma=64 all-core through the real 21 production Cx/cancellation path. Pre-ratified irregular/skewed SELL and representative production CSR/BSR rows are NonCollapse: each can veto a user regression below its own frozen floor but cannot satisfy, average into, or replace the 0.68 normative predicate. Other rows are Diagnostic.
2. The frozen manifest binds matrix generation/seed, logical/physical nnz/padding, format parameters, conversion/packing/residency/allocation timing boundary, worker/core placement, useful-byte numerator model, physical traffic reconciliation, and STREAM denominator protocol.
3. On both ISA families the normative row is correct and its exact ratio-level one-sided lower confidence bound with jointly valid >=95% coverage meets 0.68 under the frozen decision spec. Physical padding can lower efficiency but can never inflate useful-byte attainment.
4. STREAM/numerator receipts match host/source/build/profile/features/policy and freshness pairing; invalid load/placement/thermal/memory conditions, stale/future receipts, or mismatched denominator refuse.
5. Unit/property/state-model/mutation tests reject role-collapse or portfolio-as-normative substitutions, CSR/BSR satisfying, averaging into, replacing, or inflating NormativeP0; veto under an unratified/wrong floor, logical/physical byte confusion, padding omission/inflation, timing-boundary drift, sample deletion/best-of/censoring, statistic/quantile mismatch, fallback/benchmark-only path, source movement, and early seal.
6. Canonical modes/logs/caps retain raw samples and logical/physical accounting, exact decisions, one case_terminal per fixed case and one final run_terminal, and independent replay. Stable dual-ISA current-snapshot proof, constellation verify-only, DSR, and huq.21 consumption pass.
7. The manifest fixes per-format consumer/source anchors and exact x-vector/cache/reuse/write-allocate/conversion/timing assumptions. Logical useful, estimated physical, and measured counter traffic remain separate and reconcile under a frozen rule; unavailable counters are explicit rather than guessed. 8. Regression/mutation tests cover irregular SELL, CSR, BSR, cache-resident and nonresident x, incorrect reuse, index width, padding, write traffic, physical/logical confusion, counter mismatch, marginal-ratio misuse, and role collapse. 9. ProofExitV2, grammar, cardinality, caps, malformed/tampered inputs, and one-below/exact/one-above boundaries are exact. A schema/compile-fail mutant proves top-level invalid_evidence/InvalidEvidence cannot be constructed or parsed, admission/scientific observations cannot directly become runner terminals, and CaseExpectationV2 negative matches cannot mint performance authority.
notes:
The single SELL C=8 sigma=64 band-8 row remains the only normative P0 score. Governed NonCollapse rows preserve real irregular SELL/CSR/BSR user performance without diluting that predicate; diagnostic rows remain informational. Byte/cache/statistical assumptions are explicit.
Canonical mutants now distinguish forbidden normative substitution from permitted governed NonCollapse veto.

Authority-bearing closure inheritance: huq.24.4 proves candidate runner conformance only; this final gate also consumes huq.24.5's typed rjoq exact-instance handoff receipt. Runner records, candidate evidence, and scientific seals cannot substitute for rjoq admission.

Canonical artifact placement inheritance: every artifact-dir shorthand expands to huq.24.1's required --artifact-root ROOT --artifact-dir REL pair. ROOT is an admitted/canonicalized existing caller-owned workspace, external-volume, or temp directory; REL is a relative-safe new or empty destination. Relative manifests remain semantic, absolute host roots remain redacted/non-semantic, and omission, escape, link/reparse race, overwrite, or root mismatch refuses.

Additive verification-completeness baseline (never a substitute for the specialized criteria above):
- Unit and boundary tests cover happy, empty/zero/one, exact limit, one-below/one-above, maximum-without-huge-allocation, error, units/dimensions, numeric extremes, and deterministic tie/order cases owned by this leaf.
- Property/metamorphic tests exercise algebraic or relational invariants; bounded state/model tests cover lifecycle, concurrency, retry/replay, and invalid transitions where applicable.
- Public authority/type surfaces require API and compile-fail misuse tests. A leaf with no public type must record that fact and provide the nearest strict schema/API-negative equivalent rather than silently omitting the category.
- Seeded mutation tests independently alter every claim-bearing identity, bound, state, policy, route, authority, and no-claim field and retain minimized, reproducible failures.
- Cancellation/deadline plus injected allocation, worker/process, parser, I/O, durable-seal, publication, and replay faults are placed at every transition this leaf owns; drain/quiescence, exact resource return, no partial authority, retryability, and first-cause diagnostics are asserted. Inapplicable fault classes require a typed N/A rationale.
- The terminal owner named by the dependency graph runs a release-built, no-mock E2E using the canonical shared commands: --list, --check, --self-test, --run PROFILE [--family-mode MODE], --negative CASE, and --replay MANIFEST_REL --input-artifact-root INPUT_ROOT, with explicit --artifact-root OUTPUT_ROOT --artifact-dir OUTPUT_REL on write modes. Nested nonterminal producer leaves emit bounded content-bound artifacts consumed by that runner and must not create a competing `--family-mode all` selector or `--mode`/`--profile` alias; exactly one catalog-owned terminal adapter may expose `--family-mode all` under exact-set registry tests.
- Canonical bounded logs record schema/source/build/tool/target/features, typed lossless values and units, command/profile/family/mode/case/sequence, budgets/work/resources, state/reason, expected/observed/effects, authority/no-claim, diagnostics/ranked repair, stop/drain roots, and relative artifact roots. Invocation manifests are fixed and nonempty; case_start opens every ordered slot with execution=execute|suppressed; suppressed permits zero family rows and requires immediate typed NotRun. Cooperative stops drain/finalize the active case and emit remaining suppressed slots before summary/terminal; forced or unproved truncation emits no terminal. Exact case_terminal/run_summary/run_terminal cardinality, caps, hostile parser cases, tamper detection, separate replay input/output roots, and artifact-only replay are mandatory. Raw scientific/performance/tool data stays in capped artifacts, and only explicitly declared volatile observations are excluded from identity.

title: Machine-adaptive hardening: CCD pinning, first-touch audits, P/E scheduling, prefetch/hugepage sweeps — targets met on both ISAs
description:
## What
Machine-adaptive execution hardening (plan §14.2): the cross-cutting tuning pass that makes the SAME kernels roofline-honest on BOTH microarchitectures — verified, not vibes.

## Scope
- Threadripper/EPYC lane: CCD-aware tile ownership (working sets pinned inside their 32 MiB L3 islands — measured via cache-miss counters where available, timing proxies otherwise); first-touch page placement VERIFIED (page-to-node audits); reduction trees shaped to the CCD hierarchy; NPS-mode sensitivity documented.
- Apple lane: latency-lane work pinned to P-cores; throughput tiles streamed across P+E with E-core-sized tile variants (autotuner weights verified against measured per-class throughput); 16 KB page + 128 B line effects quantified.
- Hugepage-backed arenas everywhere they help (measured, with fallback paths exercised); software-prefetch distances autotuned per machine (stencil suite sweep); SIMD tier selection audit (chosen tier = fastest tier, verified per kernel).
- Schedule polymorphism validation: bandwidth-rich vs bandwidth-starved schedules actually selected correctly per machine (the §5.1 consequence-2 doctrine tested end-to-end: same kernel, different winner, autotuner picks right).
- Deliverable: the §14.1 targets MET on both machines for the P0–P3 kernel set, with the tuning decisions ledgered and reproducible.

## Acceptance criteria
Each optimization's effect measured and documented (before/after per machine — no unattributed tuning); attainment targets met or honest gap analysis filed as follow-up beads; autotuner selections match exhaustive-sweep optima within tolerance on the audited subset.

## Testing
A/B harnesses per mechanism (CCD pinning on/off, first-touch on/off, prefetch sweep); counter-based verification where the OS exposes it. Logs: per-mechanism effect tables, selection audits, final attainment scoreboard.
close_reason: Machine-adaptive hardening delivered across 6 segments + final scoreboard; every mechanism measured with before/after on both microarchitectures (no unattributed tuning), gaps filed as beads. MECHANISMS: (1) CCD pinning — os_affinity capsule (Linux x86-64 raw syscalls, no libc: sched_setaffinity/getcpu/move_pages/madvise; structured Unsupported elsewhere) + measured_l3_groups sysfs ground truth + opt-in TilePool pinning with P2 bit-equality gates. MEASURED: L3-island spread 136.5 GB/s vs unpinned 16.4 (8.35x — and unpinned loses even to packed-on-one-CCD: OS migration destroys L3 residency); pool-level kernel +16%. (2) First-touch VERIFIED by page-to-node audit: NPS1 on the whole authorized fleet (measured, not assumed); audit machinery becomes load-bearing on NPS2/4. (3) Apple P/E: pinning is a documented no-claim (QoS outside dependency policy); the measured class distribution cleanly shows the E-core tail (slow/fast 0.56) and the weights-vs-stealing A/B came back NEGATIVE on both machines (0.90x/0.97x, more steals) — work-stealing IS the P/E mechanism, weights hook reserved for pinned topologies; verdict ledgered. (4) Hugepages: advise_hugepages + thp_mode ledgering; +13.5% on ts2 (THP=madvise) TLB-stress walk; mac structured skip. (5) Prefetch: read_ahead capsule (prefetcht0/prfm), P2-total by construction; gather sweep found DIFFERENT optima per machine (M4 Pro d=64 +20%, 5995WX d=16 +37%; short distances HURT both) — the autotune-per-machine doctrine measured. (6) SIMD tier audit: chosen-vs-scalar per kernel, gated; CAUGHT AND FIXED two real dispatch defects (neon scale 0.54->1.00 parity via 4x unroll; x86 fma3 0.82->8.44 via new elem.rs AVX2 capsule — the baseline-x86 libm mul_add hole). (7) Schedule polymorphism: synthetic-probe unit gate (same calibration, different winner) + real-hardware validation (mac=rich at 19.5 GB/s/core, ts2=starved at 0.30). Autotuner: class-throughput + stencil-edge + schedule rows recorded per machine (argmin-from-sweep selections by construction). SCOREBOARD (serialized lanes, both machines): gemm single 0.936/1.103 vs 0.75 floor GREEN-GREEN; sparse sharded 0.830/1.021 GREEN-GREEN (ts2 sharding beats the naive stream axis; the ~37 GB/s all-core DRAM ceiling reproduces fleet-wide — platform config, ledgered); feec 0.372 GREEN on mac, 0.026 RED on x86 -> gap bead a55x (third instance of the libm hazard; fix routes through the fma3 capsule this epic added); gemm all-core 0.391/0.321 min-roof (0.5 opt-in floor = recorded next-owner target, xlvx close); fft and batched below their 0.40/0.60 targets with floors green — owned by ACTIVE beads 27d3/9ekv. title: Tropical critical-path analytics: max-plus eigenvalue over live event stream, tune-next + slack outputs [F/M]
description:
## What
Tropical critical-path analytics (plan §14.3, Bet 12 [F/M]): task-DAG timing in the MAX-PLUS SEMIRING — the critical circuit as a tropical eigenvector, computed live, telling the autotuner WHICH KERNEL TO TUNE NEXT and the planner where relaxed tolerance buys wall-clock.

## Scope
- Max-plus formalization: stage delays compose with ⊕=max, ⊗=+; steady-state throughput of the pipelined task DAG = the tropical eigenvalue of its timing matrix; the critical circuit = the eigenvector's support.
- Live computation: FrankenNetworkx tropical power iteration over the ledger's `events` stream (tile/op timings arriving continuously); windowed re-computation with drift detection (the critical path MOVES as tuning improves things).
- ACTIONABLE outputs (the whole point — "scheduling theory as an online instrument, not a whiteboard aphorism"): makespan sensitivity to each kernel's latency → ranked tune-next list for the autotuner; slack analysis → the planner learns that relaxing tolerance OFF the critical circuit buys NOTHING (fs-plan-allocator consumes this); bottleneck attribution in perf dashboards.
- [M] discipline: advisory-only until validated — its recommendations tracked against realized improvements (did tuning the recommended kernel actually move the makespan? — the self-audit that gates promotion).
- We contribute the tropical-semiring iteration kernels upstream to FrankenNetworkx (§12 contract).

## Acceptance criteria
Tropical eigenvalue/eigenvector correct vs brute-force longest-path analysis on fixture DAGs; live pipeline: synthetic event streams with known critical circuits recovered within window latency; recommendation quality: on seeded-bottleneck fixtures, the top recommendation is the true bottleneck; promotion audit machinery in place (recommendation → outcome tracking).

## Testing
G0: max-plus algebra laws, power-iteration convergence on irreducible fixtures; windowing correctness under out-of-order events. Logs: eigenvalue traces, circuit memberships over time, recommendation→outcome ledger.
close_reason: Implemented crate fs-tropical (crate:fs-tropical; L1, no deps). Tropical (max-plus) critical-path analytics — scheduling theory as an ONLINE INSTRUMENT. Max-plus semiring: oplus = max, otimes = + (absorbing at NEG_INF). TaskDag (per-task latencies + precedence edges): critical_path() = CPM longest-path = makespan + the critical path + per-task SLACK (0 <=> on the critical path); errors Cyclic on a cycle, BadEdge on out-of-range. ACTIONABLE outputs: tune_next(cp) = the zero-slack (critical) tasks ranked by latency (the autotuner's which-kernel-to-tune-next list — a task OFF the critical path with positive slack cannot move the makespan, so relaxing it buys nothing); bottleneck(cp) = the highest-latency critical task (the true bottleneck). max_cycle_mean(matrix) = the TROPICAL EIGENVALUE (Karp's O(n·E) algorithm) = the pipelined steady-state throughput (None if acyclic); critical_circuit()/brute_force_max_cycle() = the maximum-mean simple cycle (nodes, mean), the GROUND TRUTH max_cycle_mean is cross-checked against. RecommendationAudit ([M] discipline): record(AuditEntry{recommended, predicted_gain, realized_gain}), hit_rate() (fraction that realized a positive makespan improvement), promoted(min_samples, min_hit_rate) — recommendation->outcome tracking that gates promotion from advisory-only. Acceptance criteria covered: tropical eigenvalue/eigenvector correct vs brute-force longest-path (Karp == brute-force mean on fixtures); critical circuits recovered; on seeded-bottleneck fixtures the top recommendation is the true bottleneck; promotion-audit machinery in place. Tests (tests/tropical.rs, 7): max-plus semiring, critical-path-is-longest-path + slack, tune-next ranks bottleneck first, cyclic-DAG-no-critical-path, tropical-eigenvalue-matches-brute-force + critical-circuit, faster-cycle-dominates-self-loop + acyclic->None + 3-cycle mean, promotion-audit gates on realized outcomes. Verified: clippy -D warnings CLEAN (one scoped allow for the max-plus 2D matrix kernel, justified), fmt CLEAN, cargo test -p fs-tropical 7/7, fs-tropical COMPLIANT under xtask check-all. No-claim: critical_circuit/brute_force enumerate SIMPLE cycles for the small timing matrices this runs on (max_cycle_mean/Karp is the efficient path for large graphs); the LIVE pipeline (windowed re-computation over the fs-ledger event stream with drift detection + contributing tropical kernels upstream to FrankenNetworkx) consumes this batch core; the promotion policy is the planner's. NOTE: BASE-PLAN bead (perf epic) taken after the addendum frontier was exhausted.

title: Perf-regression CI: nightly roofline gates, event-stream flame-graph diagnosis, change-point alarms, dashboards
description:
## What
Performance-regression CI (plan §14.4): performance regressions are TEST FAILURES — nightly roofline runs on both reference machines, tolerance-band gates, and self-diagnosing failures.

## Scope
- Nightly lane: full roofline-harness registry on both machines → `metrics` table; any kernel dropping below its tolerance band FAILS CI exactly like a wrong answer (ci-gauntlet-pipeline wiring).
- Self-diagnosing failures: the `events` stream reconstructs FLAME-GRAPH-EQUIVALENTS post hoc — a regression arrives WITH its own diagnosis (which phase slowed, which tile sizes, which allocation pattern changed); diff-vs-last-green automation (suspect-commit bisection hooks).
- Dashboards: FrankenPandas over the ledger — "what got slower this month, and why" as a one-liner; trend visualizations (fs-report feeds); noise handling (dispersion-aware bands so thermal jitter doesn't cry wolf — statistical change-point detection rather than naive thresholds).
- Study-scale tracking: not just kernels — flagship-fixture wall-clocks tracked (the number users feel), attributed via the Time Ledger.
- Memory regressions: allocation-site tracking diffs (fs-alloc) gated the same way.

## Acceptance criteria
Seeded regression (deliberately de-tuned kernel) → red CI with correct flame-graph-level attribution; noise robustness: N nights of stable code → zero false alarms at declared confidence; dashboard queries answer the canonical questions in one call each.

## Testing
Meta-tests: gate arithmetic, change-point detector calibration on synthetic series; reconstruction correctness (flame-graph-equivalent vs known synthetic event stream). Logs: nightly scoreboards, regression diagnoses, alarm-calibration stats.
close_reason: Perf-regression CI shipped as fs_roofline::regress — performance regressions are TEST FAILURES, with the statistics doing the honest work. (1) DISPERSION-AWARE GATES: a run fails at k-sigma below the rolling baseline (never a naive threshold), and a RED ARRIVES WITH ITS OWN DIAGNOSIS — the phase-share flame-graph diff ranked by growth against the last-green baseline; rg-002: the seeded solve-phase de-tune gates red at z=-27.2 with 'solve' ranked first (share 0.550 -> 0.707) — the acceptance's regression-with-attribution criterion verbatim; (2) NOISE ROBUSTNESS, the certify-the-certifiers battery (rg-001): 20 kernels x 60 stable nights = 1200 kernel-nights with ZERO gate alarms and ZERO CUSUM alarms at the declared defaults — thermal jitter does not cry wolf; (3) CHANGE-POINT ALARMS (rg-003): a 0.3-sigma/night drift produces ZERO single-night reds but trips the CUSUM (slack 0.5, threshold 8 over expanding-baseline z-scores) at night 29 — the complementary detector pair covering what tolerance bands cannot; (4) THE DASHBOARD ONE-LINER (rg-004): slower_this_month answers the canonical question in ONE call — (fft, 14.3%, reduce) with stable kernels unnamed. The module consumes fs-roofline's Attainment/record_run harness (fz2.1) directly. Named seams in the CONTRACT: nightly both-machine wiring rides the ci-gauntlet pipeline (huq.4), memory regressions ride fs-alloc's allocation-site diffs, FrankenPandas trend dashboards ride fs-report, and bisection hooks consume the same attribution output. Evidence: 4 meta-tests green; clippy -D warnings 0; fmt clean; CONTRACT extended.

title: fs-roofline: fail closed on non-finite regression histories and gate specs
description:
regress::gate performs arithmetic over public Night and GateSpec f64 fields without validating finiteness or signs. NaN attainment, phase times, k_sigma, or zero/negative baseline parameters can flow through comparisons where NaN makes the red predicate false, yielding Green; invalid totals can also create non-finite attribution shares. Similar invalid histories can poison CUSUM and monthly trend decisions.

Root cause: a proof-bearing performance gate accepts unchecked floating inputs and represents malformed evidence as an ordinary Green/Red verdict.

Repair: add checked constructors or validate at every public gate boundary; require finite non-negative attainment and phase durations, positive finite statistical thresholds, consistent phase totals, and sensible baseline lengths. Add an Invalid/NoClaim verdict with structured diagnostics, never Green.

Acceptance: NaN, +/-infinity, negative time/attainment, invalid spec thresholds, and empty/non-finite phase totals all fail closed; valid existing goldens stay unchanged; metamorphic tests show scaling time units preserves verdicts and invalid data never enters trend/CUSUM state.
close_reason: Fail-closed regress hardening LANDED. gate(): validates spec (finite positive k_sigma, min_baseline >= 2) and every Night (finite non-negative attainment + phase durations) before any arithmetic; malformed evidence returns new GateVerdict::Invalid{reason} - never Green (NaN previously flipped the red predicate false). Cusum::first_alarm: non-finite residual alarms AT its index (NaN was silently resetting the shortfall via max = suppressed detection); invalid detector spec (non-finite/non-positive k or h) cannot certify quiet (alarms at 0). standardize: outputs -inf from the first non-finite input onward - poison never enters the expanding baseline or reads as good performance. slower_this_month: poisoned kernels flagged FIRST (infinite drop, INVALID: <flaw> why), never skipped; internal degenerate k_sigma=0 gate() abuse refactored out into attribution_vs_baseline (validation now refuses such specs). ACCEPTANCE MET: rg-005 NaN/+-inf/negative fields + five unusable specs all Invalid never Green (poison in baseline AND newest positions); rg-006 metamorphic time-unit rescaling (x1000) preserves verdict + attribution ranking; rg-007 CUSUM alarm at poison index, -inf propagation alarms downstream, invalid kernels flagged loudest; rg-001..004 valid goldens unchanged (zero false alarms, seeded red z=-27 attribution, CUSUM drift at 29, dashboard one-liner). fs-roofline suite green, clippy clean (external dep warnings only). title: P0 GEMM gate: citable all-core attainment at or above 0.60 on both reference ISA families
description:
> Canonical closure notice (2026-07-28 reality-check): the Design, Acceptance Criteria, and Notes fields are authoritative. Any embedded Acceptance Criteria, Success Criteria, Ownership and Verification Handoff, or Phase 9.5 sections below are retained as scope and history; they cannot weaken, override, or independently close the canonical fields.

## Current reality and gap

The P0 plan requires 80% of the section 14.1 GEMM target. The target is 0.75 of measured f64 peak, so the P0 threshold is 0.60. The retained machine-hardening closeout reports all-core attainment of 0.391 on Apple and 0.321 on x86. Those are honest useful measurements, but they fail the P0 threshold. Closed `frankensim-xdgf`, `frankensim-epic-bedrock-6ys.3`, and `frankensim-epic-perf-fz2.2` do not own a current active task that must deliver the missing dual-ISA all-core result. Existing `frankensim-wvw0` and `frankensim-yqug` own production TilePool/Cx traversal and the measure-cache-model-dispatch loop; this Bead consumes those improvements and owns the numerical P0 verdict.

## End state

Produce one revision-bound, citable GEMM performance evidence family that reaches at least 0.60 of an admitted measured compute peak for the declared large-square all-core workload on both reference ISA families. The evidence must prove that the timed path is the production safe API, the production scheduler, the resolved SIMD tier, and the production tune decision—not an isolated microkernel or alternate benchmark-only path.

## Scope and method

- Freeze shapes, scalar type, transpose/stride cases, warmup, repetitions, thread counts, affinity policy, memory lease, packing plan, MC/NC/KC/microkernel parameters, operation count, and attainment denominator semantics.
- Complete `wvw0` and `yqug`; profile packing, allocation, scheduler wake/steal, L3/CCD locality, P/E effects, and kernel tail losses before optimizing.
- Preserve deterministic arithmetic and cancellation semantics. A faster benchmark-only entry point, changed result order, unbounded work, or bypassed Cx cannot satisfy the gate.
- Measure quiet-host preflight, thermal/load state, machine fingerprint, build identity, constellation lock, target features, counter availability, and before/after attribution for every optimization.
- Retain raw samples and robust summaries; define outlier and invalid-environment rules before examining the final result.
- Keep the full 0.75 aspiration visible after P0. Crossing 0.60 closes this P0 task only; it does not claim the section 14.1 full target.

## Tests and detailed logging

Correctness/G5 twins compare every optimized tier and thread count against the scalar/reference order over rectangular, tail, beta, NaN, stride, and overflow cases. G4 drills cancel during pack, schedule, compute, and finalization and verify drain, lease return, no partial publication, and bounded checkpoints. Performance self-tests detect wrong operation counts, stale peaks, accidental single-thread execution, benchmark-only dispatch, tuned-key mismatch, thermal throttling, and source movement. Run the named DSR/RCH lanes on both ISAs from the same admitted revision and retain full per-repetition JSON rows, environment diagnostics, hashes, and artifact paths.

## No-claim boundary

A single-thread 0.75 result, synthetic microkernel result, exploratory/non-citable row, one-ISA pass, dirty/off-pin run, mixed-revision union, or an attainment computed against an invalid peak cannot close this Bead.


## Acceptance Criteria

At one stable admitted revision, the production all-core f64 GEMM path records citable attainment >=0.60 on Apple aarch64 and x86-64; every row binds peak denominator, exact workload, scheduler/tune/build identities, quiet-host preflight, raw samples, deterministic correctness, Cx cancellation, and retained DSR/RCH artifacts; all negative twins refuse; no single-thread, microkernel-only, one-ISA, dirty, off-pin, or mixed-revision evidence is accepted.


## Ownership and Verification Handoff

Expected touch set: `crates/fs-la` production GEMM/tuning code and tests, `crates/fs-exec` only where the production scheduler truly needs repair, `crates/fs-roofline` receipt/benchmark lanes, `crates/fs-substrate` machine evidence, and the corresponding CONTRACT sections. Reserve those exact paths and coordinate with `wvw0`/`yqug` owners. Run focused fs-la/fs-roofline correctness, G4/G5, and perf lanes remotely using the shared RCH target-dir convention, then the stable DSR gate and both reference hosts. The benchmark owner must not be the sole final adjudicator.

## Phase 9.5 workload and E2E contract

Freeze a versioned workload manifest before tuning, including shapes, alpha/beta, layouts/strides, thread and affinity plans, scratch policy, warmup, at least 30 accepted samples, host validity, and a predeclared one-sided conservative statistic. Add `scripts/ci/p0_gemm_dual_isa_e2e.sh`; it must exercise the real caller-owned TilePool/Cx route and current typed roof authority, independently check FLOP/denominator/statistic arithmetic, and reject single-thread, microkernel-only, stale, tuned-key, source-movement, and one-ISA substitutes. No best-of timing or post-hoc sample deletion is admissible.
design:
Canonical measurement authority

Canonical proof/evidence contract

Canonical source identity is a content-bound clean snapshot, not HEAD alone: repository tree root, HEAD, canonical constellation.lock plus every sibling head and cleanliness, Cargo.lock, toolchain/target/profile/features, declaration/checker/policy roots, and generated-registry roots. Capture it before dispatch and immediately before seal; movement refuses. A union declares one adjudication_time. Every receipt declares valid_from and valid_until, its interval contains adjudication_time, no future receipt is admissible, and all source/host/policy/workload roots match exactly.

Stdout is canonical JSONL only: run_start; for each fixed-manifest case, case_start, bounded ordered rows, exactly one case_terminal; run_summary; exactly one run_terminal; nothing after. Lossless u64/u128 use {value,unit,width}; exact decimal/rational values use a canonical non-lossy representation. Stable diagnostics use exact ProofExitV2 names: Failed, Refused { reason }, NoData, Stale, EnvironmentInvalid, Blocked, Unsupported, NotRun, Cancelled, and TimedOut, with Usage/InternalError runner-only; InvalidEvidence is only Refused(reason=InvalidEvidence). They include retryability, expected/observed, authority owner, and ranked repairs. Negative twins inherit CaseExpectationV2: exact expected non-Pass behavior yields conformance Pass with no authority, while mismatch yields Failed. Canonical commands are `--list`; `--check`; `--self-test`; `--run smoke|full --artifact-root OUTPUT_ROOT --artifact-dir OUTPUT_REL`; `--negative CASE` with the output pair; and `--replay MANIFEST_REL --input-artifact-root INPUT_ROOT` with a disjoint output pair. Successfully preflighted commands have frozen exits, order/cardinality, stderr/artifact caps, and retained relative paths. Direct invalid argv plus `--mode`/`--profile` aliases exit Usage with empty lifecycle stdout and one bounded stderr diagnostic and therefore have no lifecycle cardinality.

The lifecycle is Declared -> PreflightValid -> Running or Sampling -> Sealed -> Fresh -> Admitted, with invalidation on source, constellation, load, authority, declaration, policy, or freshness movement. State-machine/property/mutation tests reject early seal, stale/future acceptance, host substitution, denominator/workload mismatch, sample deletion, duplicate/missing/extra predicates, rounding/statistic drift, and multiple/missing terminal seals. Prior Phase 9.5 FINAL/PASS comments are plan-review records only, never implementation evidence or close authority.

`PerformanceDecisionSpec v1` freezes before tuning: one-sided confidence, estimator, bootstrap/resampling algorithm, seed, replicate count, interpolation/rounding, minimum accepted samples, maximum attempts, valid/excluded-sample rules, denominator-uncertainty composition, and stopping rule. Post-hoc deletion, best-of selection, optional stopping, and censoring are forbidden.

Reference-host selection and `HostValidityPolicy` are frozen before sampling and checked pre/mid/post: load normalized to available cores, competing jobs, thermal/frequency/throttle state, memory/swap/I/O pressure, online cores, SMT or P/E composition, affinity/placement, timer resolution, and target profile/features. A breach yields environment_invalid and no performance receipt. Numerator and denominator share host fingerprint/policy and a bounded pairing/freshness window. All-core is an exact physical/logical core set whose observed placement is proven.

GEMM workload authority

Replace vague large-square scoring with a governance-owned manifest frozen before tuning: exact M/N/K, batch, layouts/strides/transposes, alpha/beta, initialization seed/domain, warmup, timed boundary, validation tolerance, and explicit non-collapse rows. The manifest root is bound into huq.20/huq.21 and cannot be selected or changed by the tuning/producer owner. Compute-peak denominator and GEMM numerator share the exact host and freshness pairing.

The exact immutable P0GemmWorkloadManifest must come from independently owned fz2.11 before tuning or sampling. This Bead cannot author or amend it. The fresh numeric compute-peak receipt remains separately owned by frankensim-roofline-authority-fresh-receipt-drpr; fz2.8 consumes both exact roots.

PerformanceDecisionSpecV1 certifies the attainment ratio itself with at least 95% predeclared coverage: either paired/interleaved ratio inference or simultaneously calibrated numerator-lower/denominator-upper bounds with familywise coverage. Freeze block/pairing order, dependence/correlation handling, resampling unit and seed, invalid-pair policy, freshness window, attempts, stopping, and decision rounding. Separate marginal 95% intervals cannot be divided as if jointly 95%. Simulators include dependence, drift, both-marginals-pass-but-ratio-fails, IID-bootstrap misuse, and incorrect-level mutants.

scripts/ci/p0_gemm_dual_isa_e2e.sh uses ProofExitV2 and the shared grammar. Caps are 16 KiB/record; 256 KiB and 256 records/case; 4 MiB and 4096 records/run stdout; 64 KiB child and 256 KiB run stderr; 1 MiB manifest; nesting 32; string 8 KiB; path 240 bytes; 256 artifacts; 64 MiB/artifact; 64 MiB smoke and 512 MiB full total.
acceptance_criteria:
Canonical acceptance criteria

1. Independently owned fz2.11 is closed and its exact P0GemmWorkloadManifest root names every dimension/layout/stride/transpose/batch/alpha/beta/seed/warmup/timed-boundary/tolerance/non-collapse row; producer/tuner cannot author or amend it. A separate fresh roofline-authority root supplies the numeric denominator.
2. On both reference ISA families, the declared all-core production route is correct and its predeclared ratio-level one-sided lower confidence bound with jointly valid >=95% coverage meets the 0.60 target under PerformanceDecisionSpecV1; every required non-collapse row meets its bound.
3. Numerator/compute-peak denominator match host fingerprint, core placement, source/build/profile/features, host policy, and pairing/freshness window. Any host validity breach yields environment_invalid.
4. Unit/property/model/mutation tests reject workload/model/host/policy/statistic/root drift, sample deletion/best-of/fallback, oversubscription/single-thread collapse, invalid timing boundary, wrong denominator, source movement, early seal, and stale/future receipts.
5. Canonical list/check/self-test, smoke/full run with output roots, frozen negative cases, and artifact-only replay with separate input/output roots retain raw samples, exact decisions, typed values, caps, diagnostics, one case_terminal per fixed case, one run terminal, and independent replay. Invalid argv and `--mode`/`--profile` aliases exit Usage with empty lifecycle stdout and one bounded stderr diagnostic.
6. Stable dual-ISA current-snapshot proof, exact artifacts/logs, constellation verify-only, and huq.21 consumption pass; no loaded/invalid host receipt can close.
7. Unit/simulation/mutation tests prove ratio-level coverage under the frozen dependence model and reject marginal-interval division, IID resampling of correlated blocks, invalid-pair deletion, optional stopping, post-hoc pairing, and cases where both marginal intervals look favorable but the joint ratio bound fails. 8. Exact ProofExitV2 states, grammar, cardinality, new-or-empty artifact directory, literal caps, and every one-below/exact/one-above or malformed/tampered/post-terminal input are tested. A schema/compile-fail mutant proves top-level invalid_evidence/InvalidEvidence cannot be constructed or parsed, admission/scientific observations cannot directly become runner terminals, and CaseExpectationV2 negative matches cannot mint performance authority.

## Exact P0 GEMM terminal harness

This Bead owns `scripts/ci/p0_gemm_dual_isa_e2e.sh` as the sole measurement/attainment terminal and consumes the frozen `tests/e2e/manifests/p0-gemm-workload.toml` from `frankensim-epic-perf-fz2.11`. Immutable terminal cases are exactly {p0-gemm.measurement.apple-aarch64, p0-gemm.measurement.x86-64, p0-gemm.denominator-freshness, p0-gemm.production-route-correctness, p0-gemm.noncollapse-vetoes, p0-gemm.independent-ratio-adjudication, p0-gemm.host-invalid-refusal, p0-gemm.artifact-replay}. Canonical `--list`, `--check`, `--self-test`, `--run smoke|full`, frozen `--negative CASE`, and artifact-only `--replay MANIFEST_REL --input-artifact-root INPUT_ROOT` use explicit disjoint output roots; aliases and invalid argv refuse as Usage before lifecycle output.

Release-built no-mock execution must traverse the real caller-owned TilePool/Cx production path on both admitted ISA hosts, retain raw samples and the fresh denominator, independently reconstruct the jointly valid ratio decision, exercise every workload row and hostile twin, and preserve all correctness, statistical, host-validity, cancellation, fault, mutation, cap, source-closure, logging, replay, DSR, and rjoq authority gates above. The script is a plan commitment and cannot be cited as proof until it exists and runs; the gate remains `NoData` unless the complete current-snapshot dual-ISA campaign and independent replay pass.
notes:
The normative GEMM workload and PerformanceDecisionSpec are governance inputs, not producer-selectable after results. Historical plan review and an invalid host run are not performance evidence.
The fz2.11 decision, production numerator, fresh numeric denominator, and huq.21 adjudicator are distinct principals. Coverage is for the attainment ratio, not two unrelated marginal intervals.

Authority-bearing closure inheritance: huq.24.4 proves candidate runner conformance only; this final gate also consumes huq.24.5's typed rjoq exact-instance handoff receipt. Runner records, candidate evidence, and scientific seals cannot substitute for rjoq admission.

Canonical artifact placement inheritance: every artifact-dir shorthand expands to huq.24.1's required --artifact-root ROOT --artifact-dir REL pair. ROOT is an admitted/canonicalized existing caller-owned workspace, external-volume, or temp directory; REL is a relative-safe new or empty destination. Relative manifests remain semantic, absolute host roots remain redacted/non-semantic, and omission, escape, link/reparse race, overwrite, or root mismatch refuses.

Additive verification-completeness baseline (never a substitute for the specialized criteria above):
- Unit and boundary tests cover happy, empty/zero/one, exact limit, one-below/one-above, maximum-without-huge-allocation, error, units/dimensions, numeric extremes, and deterministic tie/order cases owned by this leaf.
- Property/metamorphic tests exercise algebraic or relational invariants; bounded state/model tests cover lifecycle, concurrency, retry/replay, and invalid transitions where applicable.
- Public authority/type surfaces require API and compile-fail misuse tests. A leaf with no public type must record that fact and provide the nearest strict schema/API-negative equivalent rather than silently omitting the category.
- Seeded mutation tests independently alter every claim-bearing identity, bound, state, policy, route, authority, and no-claim field and retain minimized, reproducible failures.
- Cancellation/deadline plus injected allocation, worker/process, parser, I/O, durable-seal, publication, and replay faults are placed at every transition this leaf owns; drain/quiescence, exact resource return, no partial authority, retryability, and first-cause diagnostics are asserted. Inapplicable fault classes require a typed N/A rationale.
- The terminal owner named by the dependency graph runs a release-built, no-mock E2E using the canonical shared commands: --list, --check, --self-test, --run PROFILE [--family-mode MODE], --negative CASE, and --replay MANIFEST_REL --input-artifact-root INPUT_ROOT, with explicit --artifact-root OUTPUT_ROOT --artifact-dir OUTPUT_REL on write modes. Nested nonterminal producer leaves emit bounded content-bound artifacts consumed by that runner and must not create a competing `--family-mode all` selector or `--mode`/`--profile` alias; exactly one catalog-owned terminal adapter may expose `--family-mode all` under exact-set registry tests.
- Canonical bounded logs record schema/source/build/tool/target/features, typed lossless values and units, command/profile/family/mode/case/sequence, budgets/work/resources, state/reason, expected/observed/effects, authority/no-claim, diagnostics/ranked repair, stop/drain roots, and relative artifact roots. Invocation manifests are fixed and nonempty; case_start opens every ordered slot with execution=execute|suppressed; suppressed permits zero family rows and requires immediate typed NotRun. Cooperative stops drain/finalize the active case and emit remaining suppressed slots before summary/terminal; forced or unproved truncation emits no terminal. Exact case_terminal/run_summary/run_terminal cardinality, caps, hostile parser cases, tamper detection, separate replay input/output roots, and artifact-only replay are mandatory. Raw scientific/performance/tool data stays in capped artifacts, and only explicitly declared volatile observations are excluded from identity.

title: P0 3-D FFT gate: citable pencil-transform attainment at or above 0.32 on both reference ISA families
description:
> Canonical closure notice (2026-07-28 reality-check): the Design, Acceptance Criteria, and Notes fields are authoritative. Any embedded Acceptance Criteria, Success Criteria, Ownership and Verification Handoff, or Phase 9.5 sections below are retained as scope and history; they cannot weaken, override, or independently close the canonical fields.

## Current reality and gap

P0 requires 80% of the section 14.1 3-D FFT target. The target is 0.40 of the declared roof, so the P0 threshold is 0.32. Retained evidence for `[128,128,64]` on x86 reports 0.3098 and there is no admitted Apple peer row. `frankensim-o582` explicitly owns the quiet-host 2-D `[1024,1024]` floor, not P0 3-D closure. Closed `frankensim-27d3` and `frankensim-epic-bedrock-6ys.11` therefore do not provide an active owner for this exact gate.

## End state

On one stable admitted revision, the production N-D FFT path must execute a frozen 3-D pencil workload and attain at least 0.32 of the declared, validated FFT roof on both reference ISA families. The result must include forward/inverse numerical error, Hermitian/real-transform obligations where applicable, deterministic replay, cancellation, scratch-memory accounting, and exact dispatch/scheduling identities.

## Technical scope

- Freeze dimensions, batch count, scalar type, direction, normalization, layout/strides, transform count, operation-count convention, roof denominator, warmup/repetition policy, and scratch-memory budget.
- Prove the measured route uses the production public API, cache-blocked 3-D transpose/pencil implementation, TilePool/Cx, resolved radix/SIMD tiers, and admitted tune parameters.
- Profile gather/scatter, transpose, temporary allocation, worker wake/parking, tile geometry, cache/TLB pressure, cross-CCD traffic, and P/E scheduling. Optimize only after evidence identifies the limiting phases.
- Retain phase timings as a conservation check: total time must reconcile with per-stage timings within a declared measurement tolerance.
- Reuse the quiet-host and parked-worker work from `o582` where valid, but do not let a passing 2-D row stand in for the 3-D gate.
- Preserve exact P0 semantics while keeping the full 0.40 target as a later aspiration.

## Tests and forensic logging

G0/G3 tests cover impulse, constant, single-mode, random finite, prime/mixed-radix tails, round-trip error, Parseval consistency, dimension/extent overflow, layout permutations, and equivalent separable execution orders within the declared deterministic contract. G4 drills cancel during each axis transform and transpose, assert drain/no leaks/scratch return/no partial publication, and bound polling. G5 compares required thread counts and repeated runs. Performance negative twins detect a 2-D substitution, omitted transpose work, wrong operation count, stale roof, scalar fallback, benchmark-only kernel, reused scratch outside the lease, one-ISA evidence, and moving source. Retain per-repetition and per-phase structured logs, load/thermal preflight, machine/build/lock fingerprints, raw samples, verifier verdicts, and artifact roots.

## No-claim boundary

A 2-D result, a one-ISA result, 0.3098 rounded up, an exploratory or dirty/off-pin row, or a transform that bypasses production scheduling/cancellation cannot close this Bead.


## Acceptance Criteria

At one stable admitted revision, the production 3-D FFT pencil path records citable attainment >=0.32 on Apple aarch64 and x86-64 with frozen workload/roof semantics, complete forward/inverse correctness, phase-time reconciliation, Cx cancellation, deterministic replay, scratch-budget evidence, raw samples, and retained DSR/RCH artifacts; every substitution/staleness/one-ISA/moving-source negative twin refuses.


## Ownership and Verification Handoff

Expected touch set: `crates/fs-fft` production N-D implementation/CONTRACT/tests, `crates/fs-exec` only for demonstrated scheduling defects, `crates/fs-roofline` citable FFT lane, and machine-evidence plumbing. Coordinate with `o582` and substrate G4 owners so the 2-D quiet-host work is reused without scope laundering. Focused correctness/G4/G5/perf runs precede stable-snapshot DSR and both-host evidence. Final adjudication belongs to `huq.21`.

## Phase 9.5 workload, cancellation, and E2E contract

Freeze [128,128,64] complex-f64 forward-plus-inverse, normalization, production pooled parked-crew route, roof byte/operation model, thread policy, scratch cap, host validity, at least 30 accepted samples, and a one-sided conservative statistic before tuning. Add `scripts/ci/p0_fft3d_dual_isa_e2e.sh`. Private in-place work buffers may be unspecified after cancellation only as the fs-fft contract declares, but they are poisoned and unpublishable; transactional public wrappers include copy/staging cost in the timed path. Test independent small DFTs, roundtrip/Parseval, axis/pass reconciliation, every axis/transpose cancellation, drain/scratch return, and no success publication.
design:
Canonical measurement authority

Canonical proof/evidence contract

Canonical source identity is a content-bound clean snapshot, not HEAD alone: repository tree root, HEAD, canonical constellation.lock plus every sibling head and cleanliness, Cargo.lock, toolchain/target/profile/features, declaration/checker/policy roots, and generated-registry roots. Capture it before dispatch and immediately before seal; movement refuses. A union declares one adjudication_time. Every receipt declares valid_from and valid_until, its interval contains adjudication_time, no future receipt is admissible, and all source/host/policy/workload roots match exactly.

Stdout conforms to huq.24 CanonicalEvidenceRunnerV2: run_start; per fixed case case_start, bounded ordered rows, exactly one case_terminal; run_summary; exactly one run_terminal; nothing after. Lossless u64/u128 use {value,unit,width}; exact decimal/rational values use a canonical non-lossy representation. Stable diagnostics use exact ProofExitV2 names: Failed, Refused { reason }, NoData, Stale, EnvironmentInvalid, Blocked, Unsupported, NotRun, Cancelled, and TimedOut, with Usage/InternalError runner-only; InvalidEvidence is only Refused(reason=InvalidEvidence). They include retryability, expected/observed, authority owner, and ranked repairs. Negative twins inherit CaseExpectationV2: exact expected non-Pass behavior yields conformance Pass with no authority, while mismatch yields Failed. Canonical commands are `--list`; `--check`; `--self-test`; `--run smoke|full --artifact-root OUTPUT_ROOT --artifact-dir OUTPUT_REL`; `--negative CASE` with the output pair; and `--replay MANIFEST_REL --input-artifact-root INPUT_ROOT` with a disjoint output pair. Successfully preflighted commands have frozen exits, order/cardinality, stderr/artifact caps, and retained relative paths. Direct invalid argv plus `--mode`/`--profile` aliases exit Usage with empty lifecycle stdout and one bounded stderr diagnostic and therefore have no lifecycle cardinality.

The lifecycle is Declared -> PreflightValid -> Running or Sampling -> Sealed -> Fresh -> Admitted, with invalidation on source, constellation, load, authority, declaration, policy, or freshness movement. State-machine/property/mutation tests reject early seal, stale/future acceptance, host substitution, denominator/workload mismatch, sample deletion, duplicate/missing/extra predicates, rounding/statistic drift, and multiple/missing terminal seals. Prior Phase 9.5 FINAL/PASS comments are plan-review records only, never implementation evidence or close authority.

`PerformanceDecisionSpec v1` freezes before tuning: one-sided confidence, estimator, bootstrap/resampling algorithm, seed, replicate count, interpolation/rounding, minimum accepted samples, maximum attempts, valid/excluded-sample rules, denominator-uncertainty composition, and stopping rule. Post-hoc deletion, best-of selection, optional stopping, and censoring are forbidden.

Reference-host selection and `HostValidityPolicy` are frozen before sampling and checked pre/mid/post: load normalized to available cores, competing jobs, thermal/frequency/throttle state, memory/swap/I/O pressure, online cores, SMT or P/E composition, affinity/placement, timer resolution, and target profile/features. A breach yields environment_invalid and no performance receipt. Numerator and denominator share host fingerprint/policy and a bounded pairing/freshness window. All-core is an exact physical/logical core set whose observed placement is proven.

FFT workload and roof-model authority

The normative workload remains complex f64 [128,128,64] forward plus inverse. Freeze a versioned roof operation/byte model and per-phase reconciliation tolerance before tuning; the producer cannot select it after results. Freeze transform normalization, layout/strides, pencil decomposition, transposes, initialization, warmup, timed boundary, validation, and non-collapse rows. On cancellation/fault, caller input and previously published output remain unchanged; private poisoned scratch is destroyed or quarantined and cannot escape/reuse.

PerformanceDecisionSpecV1 certifies the FFT-attainment ratio itself with paired/interleaved inference or simultaneously calibrated numerator-lower/denominator-upper bounds providing >=95% joint coverage. Freeze pair/block order, dependence handling, resampling unit/seed, invalid-pair policy, freshness, attempts, stopping, and rounding. Separate marginal 95% intervals cannot be divided as if jointly 95%.

Each governed FFT NonCollapse row has a literal independently frozen floor and may veto family closure when its own ratio-level lower bound falls below that floor. It cannot satisfy, average into, replace, or inflate the normative [128,128,64] 0.32 predicate; diagnostics remain non-authoritative.
