title: ED-5 Air and thin-gap model ladder with moving-boundary coupling and ablations
description:
## Purpose

Determine when surrounding-air or thin-gap loss materially affects Euler-disc dynamics without assuming the answer. Air is a separately selectable, ablatable model family whose applicability is diagnosed from dimensionless groups and held-out interventions.

## Model ladder

1. Analytic/no-air and simple bulk-drag baselines used only inside declared regimes.
2. Reduced oscillatory-boundary-layer or wedge/gap models with independently sourced gas properties and explicit discrepancy.
3. Moving-boundary three-dimensional resolved flow with gap-aware resolution/remap, body traction, and conservation receipts.
4. Cross-fidelity comparison and certify-or-escalate policy.

The regime map includes gap ratio, Reynolds/Womersley-type measures, Mach/compressibility, Knudsen/continuum adequacy, wall roughness, contact topology, and solver resolution. Pressure, gas identity, solid versus annular/vented geometry, mass, radius, and late-time crossover are orthogonal interventions, not tuning knobs.

## Coupling obligations

Fluid traction produces equal-and-opposite body impulse, torque, and boundary work. Fresh-cell/topology changes, narrow-gap regularization, interpolation, iteration, and numerical defects remain explicit. Partitioned iteration has a stability/escalation record; a monolithic or smaller-window fallback is not silently substituted.

## No-claims

A 2-D moving-wall receipt or normal cylinder lubrication correction is not a 3-D spinning-disc air solver. A power-law exponent alone is not mechanism authority. The recent air-drag preprint is a version-pinned hypothesis and benchmark source, not validation of this apparatus.

## Done means

Independent limiting cases, pressure/gas/venting ablations, grid/time/gap refinement, force/work balance, moving-boundary fault/cancellation tests, cross-fidelity discrepancy, and full logs establish where each air rung is applicable and whether it changes held-out predictions.

## Exact ownership and split

Generic reduced moving-body gas wrench is frankensim-b8bxd.8; generic lubrication/film capability is frankensim-ext-tribo-lubrication-e1ob; moving-boundary resolved flow is frankensim-ext-flux-lbm-moving-4v7w. Euler adapters live in crates/fs-euler-disc-e2e/src/air.rs. frankensim-euler-disc-emergent-flagship-t6314.5.5 owns reduced/thin-gap coupling; frankensim-euler-disc-emergent-flagship-t6314.5.8 separately owns expensive resolved-flow/flexible-base coupling. Every gas region and traction has exactly one owner or an explicit conservative matched decomposition.
acceptance_criteria:
The exact direct-child set is frankensim-euler-disc-emergent-flagship-t6314.5.1 through frankensim-euler-disc-emergent-flagship-t6314.5.10. The rollup has one hard terminal dependency on .5.10. The ladder includes sealed gas/property/boundary cards, independently executable reduced external, compressible gas-film, rigid/prescribed-base resolved, and flexible FSI rungs; gas/control fixture design; separate economical and resolved-flexible verification batteries; and explicit applicability/domain ownership.

title: Freeze the Euler-disc gas-flow regime map and air-model applicability ladder
description:
## Background

The relative importance of external drag, rotating boundary layers, edge flow, squeeze-film pressure, and rare terminal gap physics changes with inclination, spin/precession, clearance, size, pressure, gas, and surface state. A single fitted drag torque can hide this crossover.

## Deliverable

Define dimensionless and dimensional regime descriptors over the registered geometry/state envelope: Reynolds and rotational Reynolds numbers, Mach, Knudsen where relevant, gap/aspect ratios, squeeze number, Womersley/Stokes-layer measures, roughness ratio, and disc/base velocity scales. Bind each descriptor to measured/simulated state and uncertainty.

Specify a hierarchy: vacuum/no-air ablation; reduced external/body drag; reduced rotating-boundary/edge loss; thin-gap lubrication or compressible-film rung; resolved moving-boundary flow; and typed regimes where no admitted model exists. Predeclare admission, overlap, escalation, and no-comparison rules with cost/error budgets.

## Epistemic boundary

The ladder does not assume air is negligible until the final seconds. Nor does the presence of a thin gap prove a singular-film mechanism; those are scored outcomes.

## Surface/interface inputs

The regime map consumes the exact roughness, surface-history, coating, cleaning, and gas-solid interface state from frankensim-euler-disc-emergent-flagship-t6314.2.8 and optional sealed as-built binding frankensim-euler-disc-emergent-flagship-t6314.2.9/frankensim-euler-disc-emergent-flagship-t6314.2.11, not bulk material identity alone. Missing required interface data widens uncertainty, demotes, or refuses according to the declared rung.

## Gas-card authority

Every regime descriptor consumes the exact .5.9 atmosphere/property/boundary card and its covariance, source, validity, ambient motion, and far-field/vent identity. Gauge pressure, nominal gas name, or independently recomputed inconsistent properties cannot select a rung.
acceptance_criteria:
Closure requires dimensional/unit validation, uncertainty containment, analytic limit fixtures, continuous descriptor behavior across state, explicit overlap/gap detection, deterministic rung selection, and boundary tests for every admitted validity inequality. Hostile twins cover missing atmosphere, inconsistent velocity scale, continuum breakdown, compressibility onset, unresolved roughness/gap, unavailable capability, and budget exhaustion. Mutation tests prove every regime threshold/model/version changes applicability identity. Logs include scenario/state/atmosphere identity, descriptors and bounds, selected/refused rung, budgets, no-claim state, and reproduction command.

Hostile fixtures prove that identical bulk materials with different surface/interface histories do not alias and that missing roughness cannot silently select a favorable gas regime.

Add card/source/covariance mutations, gauge-versus-absolute pressure, inconsistent mean-free-path/EOS/viscosity values, ambient motion, and far-field/vent boundary changes. Each must alter regime identity or refuse.

title: Design the identifiable specimen and intervention matrix with alias controls
description:
## Background

Disc/ring/cone, size, density, edge radius, base material, curvature, support compliance, and atmosphere are correlated in commercial objects. A one-factor story assembled from different products cannot identify causal effects.

## Deliverable

Create a typed factorial or optimal-design matrix that independently varies, as manufacturable: outer scale; solid/ring/center-thick mass distribution; total mass; axial and transverse inertia; true fillet versus chamfer and edge radius; bulk material/density; surface finish/history; base material/thickness/curvature; support topology/compliance; pressure/gas/venting; and initial-state protocol. Audit structural and practical aliases, define randomization/blocking by day/operator/lot/apparatus, replication, fixed sample size or preregistered group-sequential/anytime-valid information rules paired with matching inference and alpha/evidence accounting, safe ranges, missing cells, and decision consequences. Use simulation only for design sensitivity before outcome unlock, never to prelabel expected signs.

## No-claims

A complete matrix improves identifiability but does not guarantee it; infeasible aliases and weak interventions remain explicit limitations.

Closure requires a machine-readable design with rank/alias and power/information diagnostics under declared noise assumptions, deterministic seeded randomization, resource/safety constraints, complete factor units/ranges, replication and stopping rules, and hostile confounded matrices. Logs include design/protocol identity, rank/alias metrics, assumptions, randomization, resources/budgets, limitations, and reproduction command without expected outcomes.

No outcome-driven early stop is allowed. Sequential rules must be immutable before acquisition and prove their anytime/group-sequential coverage under adversarial stopping.

title: Extract terminal events, mode transitions, and censored outcomes from raw evidence
description:
## Background

Ordinary rest, intermittent contact, gross slip, escape, rim strike, saturation, and recording end are different outcomes. A single manually chosen stop time can hide the mechanism and bias rankings.

## Deliverable

Using frozen event definitions, fuse kinematic and permitted auxiliary channels to produce intervals/probabilities or typed Unknown for release, steady observation start, mode transitions, contact loss/reimpact proxies, gross slip, rim approach/escape/impact, ordinary terminal rest, sensor saturation, operator abort, and right/left censoring. Preserve competing event hypotheses and raw supporting samples.

Algorithms and thresholds are frozen before blind labels. Manual review, if allowed, is blinded, double-reviewed, reason-coded, and stored separately. The output never overwrites raw data or drops failed attempts.

## No-claims

An acoustic chirp or image blur alone is not conclusive contact loss or a mathematical singularity. Event uncertainty must propagate to scores.

## Auxiliary-channel dependency

Because event extraction fuses permitted acoustic, contact-proxy, base, atmosphere, and launcher channels, it consumes the calibrated alignment/features from .6.11. If an event uses kinematics alone, that channel set is recorded explicitly; no favorable auxiliary alignment may be chosen after outcomes.
acceptance_criteria:
Closure requires synthetic and independently annotated event fixtures, simultaneous/grazing/ambiguous events, threshold/window sensitivity, inter-rater/adjudication behavior, censored and incomplete runs, saturation, escape/rim impact, missing channels, and deterministic tie policy. Seeded favorable stop selection, outcome-dependent threshold, deleted attempt, and acoustic-only overclaim must be rejected/demoted. Logs identify run/event-spec/algorithm/reviewer identity, evidence intervals, uncertainty/hypotheses, censoring/disposition, budgets, authority, and reproduction command.

Add kinematic-only versus fused-channel identities, missing/ambiguous alignment, proxy Unavailable, and hostile use of an unregistered aligned feature. Acoustic-only singularity/contact-loss classification remains forbidden.

title: Synchronize base, acoustic, contact-proxy, atmosphere, and launcher channels
description:
## Background

Base vibration, acoustic chirps, contact proxies, pressure, and kinematics are meaningful only with known clock alignment, bandwidth, phase, and uncertainty. Cross-correlating until a favorable story appears is outcome-informed analysis.

## Deliverable

Estimate drift, latency, phase response, dropped intervals, and alignment uncertainty from calibration signals independent of target outcomes. Produce base modal coordinates/energy proxies, spectral/acoustic summaries, atmosphere histories, launcher release state, and contact-proxy features with units and covariance.

Predeclare time-frequency transforms, windows, leakage correction, alias checks, and multiplicity. Preserve raw channels and alternative alignment hypotheses where ambiguity remains; never force a single phase relation.

## No-claims

An acoustic frequency that scales with precession is a correlation until a validated sensor/source model supports attribution.

## Pose/base proxy authority

Channel alignment consumes .6.9 reconstructed kinematics and .6.3 base mobility/calibration. A derived base modal-energy value is ProxyBacked unless modal mass, normalization, bandwidth, contact-location transfer, and omitted-mode closure are established. It cannot be scored as raw observed energy.
acceptance_criteria:
Closure requires shared-signal and synthetic-clock truth, drift/latency/phase response tests, resampling conservation, missing/dropout/saturation/alias fixtures, uncertainty coverage, and deterministic time-frequency outputs. Seeded cross-correlation cherry-picking, outcome-dependent windows, clock swapping, and unsupported source attribution must refuse/demote. Logs identify run/channel/instrument/clock/calibration/algorithm identity, rates/units, alignment/phase uncertainty, missingness, budgets, authority, and reproduction command.

Add pose/aux clock joins, base-calibration and mode-normalization mutation, omitted-mode/bandwidth limits, proxy-domain escape, and latent/proxy-to-observed promotion attacks.

title: Compile the raw-to-QoI measurement equation and uncertainty budget
description:
## Background

Prediction intervals can only be scored against observations if measurement uncertainty, filtering, event ambiguity, and calibration covariance are propagated consistently. Treating derived curves as exact overstates model error and can distort mechanism rankings.

## Deliverable

Assemble a versioned measurement equation from raw pixels/sensors through pose, velocities, contact orbit, base/acoustic/environment features, event intervals, and registered score inputs. Trace random and systematic uncertainty, covariance, timing/phase, calibration hierarchy, censoring, and missingness. Distinguish aleatory run variation, measurement error, parameter uncertainty, and model discrepancy.

Provide linearized and sampling propagation where valid, coverage diagnostics from independent references, and typed refusal where transformations are non-identifiable or uncertainty cannot be bounded. Bind exact algorithms/windows/calibrations to QoI identities.

## No-claims

A wide interval is not evidence of model adequacy, and a narrow algorithmic covariance is not a complete uncertainty budget.

## Uncertainty ownership split

This observation-side measurement equation owns measurement, calibration, clock, filtering, event, censoring, and missingness uncertainty only. Simulation parameter posterior, numerical uncertainty, and model discrepancy belong to prediction-side .7.2; between-run process variation belongs to the study model. A typed ownership graph rejects the same covariance contribution on both sides.
acceptance_criteria:
Closure requires end-to-end synthetic truth and physical reference coverage tests, dimensional/frame closure, covariance positive-semidefiniteness, calibration and timing perturbations, filtering/window sensitivity, censored/event uncertainty, missing-channel and non-identifiability refusal, and independent reconstruction of representative QoIs. Mutation tests cover every calibration, transform, window, covariance, missingness and event-policy field. Logs identify run/QoI/measurement-equation/calibration identity, uncertainty components and coverage, missing/censored state, authority, budgets, and reproduction command.

Add duplicate/missing covariance owner, measurement-versus-process variation, prediction posterior inserted into observations, numerical error relabeled measurement, and cross-side covariance identity attacks. Every uncertainty component has one source and owner.

description:
## Background

description:

title: Characterize base plates, housings, feet, leveling state, and foundation interfaces
description:
## Background

Base curvature and wobble claims require as-built plate and support data. Plate thickness, dish/slope/warp, modal response, housing mass/rigidity, foot location and preload, foundation compliance, and leveling drift are separate variables.

## Deliverable

For each coded base assembly, measure plate surface map, local curvature and flatness, thickness, mass/inertia, material identity, roughness/waviness, housing and outrigger geometry, foot/adjuster locations, contact-tip form, adjustment range, preload/reaction distribution, support/foundation interface, and level versus time/temperature. Bind raw measurements, calibration, uncertainty, assembly state, reassembly/adjustment events, foundation and environmental state, and canonical identity. Preserve three- and four-support comparison variants without assuming their outcome.

## No-claims

Three measured support points do not prove dynamic rigidity; modal fits do not identify microscopic damping or energy return to the disc.

## Adoption path

Base surface maps and assembly state bind through frankensim-euler-disc-emergent-flagship-t6314.2.11 and existing fs-asbuilt/vvreg authorities. Preserve raw topography, registration, covariance, resolution, and every re-level/reassembly event; nominal base geometry remains separately executable and visibly non-as-built.

## Component-resolved mobility and de-embedding

Separately characterize free-free plate mobility, assembled plate-housing-support mobility, foundation transmissibility/background vibration, and contact-location transfer functions. Bind disc-plate, foot-housing, and foot-foundation interface identities plus .4.8 inclusion/de-embedding receipts. ## Background

## Deliverable

Implement a calibrated raw-to-pose measurement equation using stereo/multi-view geometry and specimen feature/marker identity. Resolve axis/sign and quaternion symmetries, occlusions, rolling shutter, lens distortion, blur, and camera timing. Estimate pose and covariance, then angular/linear velocity and contact-orbit quantities with declared smoothing/filtering, phase delay, endpoints, and uncertainty.

Preserve raw observations, residuals, alternative hypotheses, missing intervals, and calibration version. Do not use simulator trajectories as a hidden tracking prior in blind partitions; any declared physics prior is separately scored.

## No-claims

A smooth reconstructed curve does not prove the underlying late-time rate or event. Unresolved symmetry/occlusion stays Unknown.

title: ED-7 Prediction freeze, uncertainty, scoring, identifiability, and mechanism adjudication
description:
## Purpose

Turn simulations and measurements into a preregistered prediction assessment rather than a favorable retrospective story. This workstream owns immutable prediction bundles, proper scoring, effect/ranking/optimum inference, model discrepancy, mechanism signatures, one-way unblinding, and next-evidence decisions.

## Prediction bundle

Before target unlock, bind source revision, model structures and rungs, calibration roots, parameter distributions, priors, discrepancy choices, numerical tolerances, seeds, budgets, validity/refusal states, and predicted distributions for full trajectories, terminal events, energy channels, rankings, effect directions, crossovers, and optima. Target tuning invalidates this identity and changes the claim class.

## Scoring and attribution

Score trajectories and predictive intervals with preregistered proper or otherwise justified scores, empirical coverage, state/time/event residuals, and censoring-aware rules. Test mechanism signatures using multiple interventions: surface-sensitive versus air-sensitive regimes, pressure/gas/venting response, mass/radius prefactors, base-mode correlations, contact/slip observations, runout impulses, and direct energy-channel evidence. Never adjudicate from exponent agreement alone.

Factorial effects, interactions, rankings, and nonlinear optima retain block structure, alias rank, multiplicity/stopping policy, practical-effect thresholds, and uncertainty. Rival contact/base/air models undergo identifiability, confounding, prior sensitivity, profile/posterior checks, and held-out predictive comparison.

## Terminal outcomes

Independent adjudication verifies the model freeze, exact input roots, deviations, scores, coverage, and authority consequences. Success, confident miss, uncertainty-covered miss, refusal, and inconclusive evidence are distinct. Every outcome produces failure attribution and a ranked next-evidence plan without post-hoc replacing the blind case.

## Done means

Artifact-only recomputation reproduces scores and dispositions; mutation/leakage/optional-stopping/favorable-window attacks fail; uncertainty contributions and applicability are explicit; no physical or mechanism claim outranks its weakest load-bearing evidence.
acceptance_criteria:
The exact direct-child set is frankensim-euler-disc-emergent-flagship-t6314.7.1 through frankensim-euler-disc-emergent-flagship-t6314.7.12. The rollup has one hard terminal dependency on .7.11. Generic algorithms are owned by frankensim-jmh21; these leaves configure/apply them to Euler QoIs, factors, mechanism signatures, and sealed evidence.

Closure requires immutable input/output predictions, target-inaccessible ensembles, protected analyzer guards, trajectory/event/effect/mechanism/terminal-asymptotic scoring, identifiability, one-way original and replication unlocks, explicit trust/key/crash semantics, independent adjudication, retained failures/errata/invalidation, OED/no-recommendation, and artifact-only terminal replay. Forced winners, post-unlock retuning, stop-time/exponent-only success, or local scoring by acquisition/analyzer leaves fail. Favorable, failed, inconclusive, non-identifiable, refused, and invalid outcomes are all valid retained dispositions.

title: Freeze immutable execution inputs, authority, and blind-partition bindings
description:

## No-claims

title: Implement preregistered terminal-asymptotic, chirp, crossover, and finite-time-singularity analysis
description:
## Purpose

The audible/kinematic terminal acceleration motivates a finite-time-singularity question, but physical rates remain bandwidth-limited and other processes take over. Implement a preregistered analysis that can support, reject, or leave unresolved a model-specific asymptotic extrapolation without declaring physical infinity.

## Required behavior

Register candidate asymptotic families for inclination, precession/contact frequency, body spin, bounce/contact interval, and energy; their derivation/source, validity domain, nuisance terms, and expected crossover/breakdown mechanisms. Fit/score only frozen nested windows with measurement covariance, timing/phase, censoring, alias/saturation, filter delay, event ambiguity, and multiplicity. Compare rival exponents/functions, change points, and terminal takeover by compliance, contact loss/impact, gas-film/rarefaction, adhesion, roughness, or sensor limits.

Return ModelAsymptoticSupportedInWindow, ResolvedCrossover, NonIdentifiable, BandwidthLimited, EventAmbiguous, OutOfDomain, or Refused. Extrapolated collapse time/frequency is labeled latent mathematical diagnostic unless independently observed. Acoustic chirp alone cannot establish contact frequency or a singularity. Protected application requires the sole unlock capability.

## No-claims

No finite dataset observes infinity. Agreement with a fitted exponent or transcript sound cannot identify a mechanism or validate extrapolation beyond the model domain.
acceptance_criteria:
Closure requires safe-Rust production behavior at the named owner, a versioned contract, canonical identities for every semantic input, units/frames/seeds/budgets/versions/capabilities, structured refusal and no-claim state, bounded cancellation and request-drain-finalize with no partial authority. Focused unit tests cover happy, empty, malformed, n-1/n/n+1, maximum/maximum-plus-one, boundary, unit/frame, deterministic-order, error, and refusal cases. Property, metamorphic, mutation, checkpoint/replay, fault, work/memory/deadline/output-cap, and independent-checker tests exercise every mathematical and authority-bearing field. Logs follow the frozen Euler schema: bounded, deterministic, redacted before buffering or hashing, content-addressed, with case/stage/attempt, source/schema/model/checker identities, Five Explicits, stable reason, expected/observed disposition, first divergence, cancellation/drain/finalization, relative artifacts, and a repository-relative reproduction command; secrets, absolute paths, host identity, PIDs, wall-clock noise, and unbounded payloads are forbidden. Focused proof, DSR, blind physical evidence, and maturity promotion remain distinct.

Synthetic known-asymptotic, finite-crossover, alternative-exponent, no-singularity, truncated, saturated, aliased, noisy, censored, simultaneous-event, filter-phase, and acoustically confounded cases are required. Window/exponent/model/multiplicity mutations, favorable terminal truncation, physical-infinity wording, target-tuned family selection, and latent-to-observed promotion must fail. Independent scoring and interval reconstruction plus sensitivity to bandwidth and breakdown thresholds are mandatory.

description:

description:

Preserve shared assumptions and correlated errors. Return Supported-in-domain, Disfavored, Non-identifiable, Missing-observable, Out-of-domain, or Refused—not a forced winner.

## No-claims

A fitted power-law exponent, acoustic chirp, or energy-ledger percentage alone cannot establish a microscopic mechanism. Model selection is conditional on the candidate set.

title: Quantify identifiability, parameter sensitivity, discrepancy, and extrapolation risk
description:
## Background

title: Perform one-way unlock and independent blind adjudication
description:
## Background

The moment target outcomes become visible, the original blind claim is spent. Unlock, scoring, deviations, and conclusions must therefore be mechanical, independently checked, and irreversible.

## Deliverable

Verify custody, complete attempts, sealed prediction/software/model/metric identities, instrument calibration, deviations, and checker readiness before authorized one-way unlock. Record principals, time, exact partition, access events, and spent status. Run frozen scoring and adjudication from artifacts; compare producer and independent checker; classify discrepancies and permitted reruns without editing the sealed prediction.

Issue a signed disposition for each claim and run: pass/partial/fail/refused/inconclusive/experiment-invalid, with evidence, limitations, domain, and downstream authority. Any revised model is a post-unlock follow-up with a new study and cannot retroactively improve the score.

## No-claims

A clean process cannot guarantee a favorable result. Independent adjudication verifies evidence use, not universal physical truth.

## Sole unlock authority

This leaf is the only owner of one-way target unlock and any predicted-versus-observed score or scientific disposition. Physical leaves frankensim-euler-disc-emergent-flagship-t6314.6.16 through .6.19 terminate at sealed raw acquisition and unlock readiness. The unlock transaction verifies all prediction-output and raw-bundle seals, marks the partition spent atomically, then invokes frozen scoring and an independent checker. No producer or acquisition leaf may precompute a comparison.

## Trust, authorization, and crash semantics

Freeze principal roles and required separation among modeler, acquisition operator, unlock authority, and independent checker; named authority or quorum; key identities, validity periods, revocation, and compromised-key consequences. Authorization signs canonical bytes covering ledger/sequence root, exact partition, prediction/raw/measurement/metric roots, and requested disposition operation.

The generic unlock transaction spends atomically with first access. Once protected bytes are released, a crash before score/publication still leaves the partition spent; idempotent recovery may finish the same transaction but never reopen, widen, relabel, or reuse it. Record checker implementation, build, and dependency identity rather than accepting a disjointness assertion.

title: Produce failure attribution, corrective-model discipline, and next-evidence plans
description:
## Background

A failed blind prediction is valuable only if it is not explained away post hoc. Diagnosis must separate software defects, invalid inputs, apparatus/measurement problems, out-of-domain models, numerical error, and missing physics without rewriting the original claim.

## Deliverable

For every failed, partial, refused, or inconclusive result, apply a fixed failure taxonomy and evidence graph. Re-run only preregistered numerical/measurement sensitivity checks against sealed artifacts; label exploratory analyses explicitly. Rank rival explanations by discriminating existing evidence, then generate a new-study plan specifying changed assumptions, new measurements/interventions, expected falsifiers, cost/safety, and what remains unchanged.

Preserve original predictions, scores, and all failed hypotheses. Correct software defects through versioned errata and rescore only under separately labeled corrected-software analysis; never replace the original blind result.

## No-claims

A plausible explanation after failure is not validated. Post-hoc fit is hypothesis generation, not emergent prediction.

## Downstream invalidation without erasure

A confirmed software defect, source erratum, invalid calibration, or checker failure emits an immutable invalidation/demotion receipt naming affected prediction, score, report, L3/L4 eligibility, and optional-promotion artifacts. Consumers in phase 8 must refuse superseded authority while retaining the original result and corrected analysis as distinct histories.
acceptance_criteria:
Closure requires fixtures for software/input/measurement/apparatus/numerical/applicability/model-form/unknown failures, deterministic taxonomy, evidence lineage, explicit exploratory labels, and new-study identity. Seeded retrospective claim narrowing, deleted failure, target-tuned parameter, unmarked bug-fix rescore, and unfalsifiable explanation must be detected. Logs identify original prediction/score/evidence, failure taxonomy and supporting artifacts, exploratory analyses, proposed new study/budgets, authority/no-claim state, and reproduction commands.

Add exact dependency-closure impact, partial claim invalidation, stale report/gate rejection, corrected-software reanalysis, attempted deletion/overwrite, and unrelated-claim preservation. Invalidation cannot silently broaden or retroactively improve the original.

title: Optimize the next experiment for discrimination, safety, cost, and validity
description:
## Background

After initial evidence, the best next run is not necessarily the most dramatic. It should distinguish plausible mechanisms or constrain decisions while respecting safety, manufacturability, apparatus, time, and evidence-role boundaries.

## Deliverable

Using only currently permitted evidence, formulate candidate specimens, bases, atmospheres, sensors, and launch protocols as typed design variables. Optimize expected information/discrimination or decision value with constraints on safety, cost, time, manufacturability, identifiability, model applicability, and blind-partition integrity. Include robust or multi-objective alternatives and sensitivity to priors/discrepancy.

Return a ranked batch plus diversity, rationale, expected falsifiers, resource plan, and a no-recommendation outcome when uncertainty/model disagreement makes value unreliable. Proposed target outcomes remain sealed and are not used to choose within an active blind partition.

## No-claims

An optimal design under a model is not guaranteed informative in reality and cannot promote the model it assumes.
acceptance_criteria: Closure requires synthetic information-gain recovery, constraint/safety enforcement, deterministic seeded replay, robust/multi-objective fronts, prior/discrepancy sensitivity, diversity/batch behavior, and no-recommendation fixtures. Leakage from active blind outcomes, out-of-domain candidate selection, infeasible manufacture, unsafe pressure/speed, or single-model certainty must be detected. Logs identify evidence/design/model/objective/constraint identity, seed/budgets, candidate scores/uncertainty, feasibility/rationale, authority/no-claim state, and reproduction command.

title: ED-8 E2E manifest, independent replay, user report, DSR, and maturity gates
description:
## Purpose

Integrate the entire campaign into a reproducible user workflow with exhaustive software verification, hostile twins, no-mock end-to-end execution, artifact-only checking, deterministic reporting, DSR proof, and deliberately separate L3 and L4 decisions.

## Ownership

Create a dedicated versioned Euler campaign manifest and wrapper that consume the shared runner; never modify the exact-membership new-domains E2 manifest. A future fs-euler-disc-e2e crate owns orchestration, domain fixtures, prediction/report schemas, and user experience only. Generic physics and evidence components remain with their owning crates.

## Verification surface

The software battery covers exact mass properties, ideal conservative top/rolling limits, frames and units, contact and air limiting cases, base-mode limits, synthetic tracking truth, boundary/min/max/malformed cases, property/metamorphic/refinement checks, seeded mutations and hostile twins, work/memory/deadline/output exhaustion, fault/panic/cancellation drain, checkpoint/resume, thread-count replay, tamper, leakage, swapped/stale identities, missing attempts, and checker disagreement.

The no-mock E2E executes digital specimen -> dynamics/contact/tribology/base/air -> trajectory/prediction -> physical ingest -> scoring -> report. Mechanism ablations must make the independent checker observe the intended semantic change. Artifact-only replay uses read-only input roots and a fresh output root.

## User and authority outcomes

The deterministic report presents hypotheses, specimens, metrology, model ladder, deviations, raw and prediction roots, scores, failed mechanisms, validity domain, uncertainty, no-claims, evidence colors, and exact reproduction commands. NO-DATA is distinct from measured zero.

An L3 candidate concerns the integrated software workflow only and requires a deliberate blocked-promotion rehearsal. L4 requires sealed blind physical evidence, metrology and custody authority, empirical coverage, discrepancy assessment, external reproduction, artifact replay, and exact Context of Use. Failure or insufficient evidence yields a typed no-promotion receipt, not an unfinished campaign.

## Done means

Focused tests and the dedicated release-built no-mock manifest pass, required DSR commands have terminal logs/artifacts, independent replay agrees or produces an adjudicated refusal, and the root epic can close with an immutable result even when no maturity promotion is earned.

## Terminal split

Software L3 evidence and always-runnable no-promotion adjudication do not wait for physical success. frankensim-euler-disc-emergent-flagship-t6314.8.11 can terminate with typed NO-DATA/no-promotion. Only the positive frankensim-euler-disc-emergent-flagship-t6314.8.12 submission hard-depends on completed blind adjudication, replication, and physical evidence.
acceptance_criteria:
The exact direct-child set is frankensim-euler-disc-emergent-flagship-t6314.8.1 through frankensim-euler-disc-emergent-flagship-t6314.8.11 plus frankensim-euler-disc-emergent-flagship-t6314.8.13. The rollup has one hard terminal dependency on .8.11; that always-runnable audit consumes software L3 evidence and .8.6 ingestion capability and terminates with either a typed no-promotion receipt or a non-promotional exact claim/domain eligibility receipt.

Mandatory ed.core.* cases, hostile twins, canonical logging, traceability, artifact-only replay, deterministic reports, exact DSR evidence, and software-only L3 are unconditional. Capability-optional resolved/physical cases use NO-DATA and cannot replace mandatory positives. The strictly positive central L4 submission .8.12 is reparented under optional epic frankensim-16dip and is not a phase-8 closure child. No report, fixture, L3 receipt, or local PASS may mint physical authority.

title: Freeze the Euler-disc user workflow, CLI/session contract, diagnostics, and safety tiers
description:
## Background

A scientifically careful system can still fail users if setup is opaque, expensive runs start accidentally, inputs are ambiguous, or diagnostics merely say invalid. The campaign needs an agent- and human-usable path from question to preview, verified simulation, experiment bundle, and honest report.

## Deliverable

Specify typed commands/session calls for: inspect capabilities; create/validate a digital specimen; choose a controlled protocol; preview regime/applicability/cost; run a cheap ideal/reduced simulation; run verified multiphysics tiers; prepare/freeze a prediction; ingest a physical bundle; score/adjudicate; replay; and render a report. Every mutating call has an idempotency key; units, seeds, budgets, versions, capabilities, and evidence role are explicit.

Define fast preview, standard verified, expensive resolved, and physical/blind tiers with clear cost and authority. Admission diagnostics name the failing field/precondition, units/domain, affected claim, and ranked repairs. Dry-run/preflight never consumes a blind partition or expensive budget.

## No-claims

Ease of use cannot erase scientific distinctions. Defaults may be convenient but cannot silently choose target-favorable physics or authority.

## Content-bound confirmation and progress

Dry-run/preflight emits a canonical PlanReceipt binding request, source/scenario/protocol/model rungs, expected artifacts, capabilities, estimated work/time/memory/storage, safety tier, blind effect, and expiry. Expensive resolved, physical-control, prediction-freeze, unlock, or promotion actions require a separate content-bound confirmation token over that exact receipt; dry-run itself is never confirmation. Any semantic change invalidates the token.

Define deterministic human and machine progress/status/resume output under .1.8, including current stage, admitted/consumed/remaining budgets, checkpoint, cancellation/drain/finalization, artifact status, and ranked next action. A novice journey is exercised independently, not merely documented.
acceptance_criteria:
Closure requires complete command/session schemas, deterministic help/examples, dry-run and idempotency tests, ambiguous-unit/frame and missing-capability diagnostics, tier/cost preflight, blind-role safeguards, cancellation/resume UX, and successful novice-path usability checks. Hostile twins attempt implicit units, hidden seed, default target tuning, accidental unlock, expensive unbounded run, and report promotion without evidence. Logs are structured/bounded and identify request/session/scenario/protocol identity, units, seed/budgets/capabilities, admission/ranked fixes, authority, and reproduction command.

Add wrong/stale/expired/replayed confirmation, changed budget/model/partition, dry-run-as-confirmation, accidental unlock/physical action, duplicate idempotency key, status/resume after crash, cancellation progress, and independently observed novice-path usability cases.

title: Integrate the software-complete campaign as an L3 maturity candidate
description:
## Background

The campaign can become a mature software flagship before a physical blind challenge exists, but only if the maturity gate says exactly what is and is not proven. L3 should require integrated production execution, verification, replay, and operational readiness—not physical claims.

## Deliverable

Prepare the Euler campaign for the existing claim-integrity and capability-maturity L3 process with accepted contracts, code review, component and integrated batteries, hostile twins, numerical convergence, energy closure, deterministic/cancellation/resource evidence, DSR logs, source manifest, dependency policy, user guide, and clean artifact-only replay. Produce a claim matrix that marks physical prediction/mechanism rows NO-DATA or BLOCKED until designated bundles exist.

Run the central gate rather than self-promoting. Any missing generic dependency, unavailable resolved lane, or unresolved defect remains named with an owner and impact.

## No-claims

L3 software maturity does not mean the simulator predicted the Mould effects, validates an Euler disc, or identifies contour friction.

## Software-only gate boundary

Hard prerequisites are production integration, hostile twins, replay, operator contract, and DSR/software evidence. Physical ingest/reporting, blind adjudication, replication, and L4 state are not L3 blockers and remain NO-DATA in the claim matrix. Use frankensim-extreal-program-f85xj.2.3 and frankensim-extreal-program-f85xj.16.1 as the generic gate/registry owners. frankensim-4gh8t is related portfolio history, not a reusable blocker.

## Exact mandatory-case maturity binding

The L3 candidate binds the exact mandatory ed.core.* IDs from .8.2, their positive production receipts from .8.3, the hostile deck, .8.13 traceability matrix, replay, user guide, DSR, and source manifest. Capability-optional NO-DATA cannot satisfy or replace a mandatory core case. The central gate consumes the matrix and may refuse stale or incomplete mappings.
acceptance_criteria:
Closure requires the designated L3 gate receipt over the exact source revision and accepted dependencies, no unresolved P0 software defect, all required software cases and hostile twins, DSR command/status/log paths, reproducible artifact checker, documentation, and a per-claim proof/no-proof matrix. Fixtures or producer statements cannot substitute for the gate. If designated evidence is absent, the bead remains blocked/in-progress with the exact missing proof rather than reporting PASS.

A clean L3 candidate must be independently adjudicable with no physical bundle. The gate must refuse any attempt to promote a physical prediction/mechanism row from software evidence.

Add one-missing-mandatory-case, optional-resolved-substitution, SKIP/NO-DATA-as-PASS, stale traceability matrix, invalidated report/receipt, and exact source/build/case-root mutation. Physical rows remain NO-DATA without blocking software L3.

title: Always audit physical eligibility and retain a typed no-promotion result
description:
## Purpose and terminal semantics

This is phase 8's always-runnable terminal physical-eligibility audit. It accepts current Context of Use, requested claim/domain pairs, software claim matrix, traceability/DSR receipts, and any available physical receipts. It never submits to or updates the central maturity registry.

## Deliverable

Evaluate the presence and validity of prediction seals, blind partition/access ordering, complete attempts, measurement equations, proper scores/coverage, adverse cases, mechanism identifiability, replication/independence, artifact replay, and central policy. With zero or insufficient physical artifacts, emit a complete typed no-promotion receipt naming exact missing/failed/leaked/inconclusive/refused/unreplicated/out-of-domain proof and ranked next evidence. When every prerequisite is present, emit a non-promotional eligibility receipt for the exact claim/domain pair; .8.12 alone may submit it.

The audit is deterministic and artifact-only. It cannot broaden one specimen, base, lab, or regime, and it honors .7.8 invalidation/errata.

## No-claims

Eligibility is not promotion. A complete no-promotion result is an honest terminal outcome; neither outcome changes the central registry here.
acceptance_criteria:
Closure requires a deterministic eligibility or no-promotion audit. The leaf must run with zero physical artifacts and return typed NO-DATA/no-promotion; complete designated evidence yields only a content-bound eligibility receipt. It never calls or mutates the central maturity registry. Claim-by-claim domain/authority, blind ordering/custody, attempt completeness, score/coverage/identifiability, independent replay, replication, adverse cases, invalidation, and missing proof are explicit.

Hostile cases include local/static fixture or L3 prose minting physical authority, stale/invalidated scorecard, missing .8.6 capability, incomplete replication, leaked/retuned partition, overbroad domain, central submission attempted here, and eligible receipt reused for a different claim. Logs follow .1.8 and include request/gate/evidence/claim/domain roots, disposition, missing proof, and exact audit command.

title: Submit only physically eligible claim-domain pairs to the designated L4 promotion gate
description:
## Purpose and ordering

The sibling eligibility bead must always be able to publish an explicit no-promotion result when physical evidence is absent. This leaf is the strictly positive path and therefore waits for completed one-way blind adjudication, replication, physical ingest, and an eligible claim-domain receipt.

## Deliverable

For each eligible claim/domain pair, bind the exact Context of Use, prediction seal, blind partition and access ledger, complete attempts, measurement equation, scores/coverage, adverse cases, identifiability result, replication and independence evidence, source/software/schema snapshots, and central maturity policy. Submit through the designated maturity registry and claim-integrity gate; never self-promote or batch-promote unrelated claims.

A refusal, missing designated source, failed replication, leakage, out-of-domain result, or insufficient mechanism discrimination returns to the retained no-promotion outcome without weakening it. Promotion is claim- and domain-specific and cannot universalize one specimen, base, lab, or regime.

## No-claims

Even accepted L4 status is not regulatory approval, universal mechanism truth, or evidence outside the exact Context of Use.

## Protected scorecard application

Before central submission, invoke .8.6 on the actual protected physical bundle under the exact already-spent .7.7/.7.11 disposition capability, reproduce the claim-specific scorecard, and bind any .7.8 invalidation state. Eligibility alone cannot substitute for this final content-bound application.
acceptance_criteria:
Closure requires an eligible physical receipt from the separate audit, completed blind adjudication, replication, independent artifact-only reconstruction, central gate output, mutation tests for every source/domain/access/score/checker field, and hostile attempts to promote software-only, leaked, failed, unreplicated, or broader claims. Focused unit tests cover happy, empty, malformed, n-1/n/n+1, maximum/maximum-plus-one, unit/frame, deterministic ordering, and structured refusal cases. Property, metamorphic, and mutation tests exercise every semantic identity and authority guard. Long work is budgeted and cancellation-correct with request-drain-finalize and no partial publication. Logs are schema-versioned, bounded, deterministic, redacted, content-addressed, and include case/source/schema/model/checker identities, Five Explicits, expected and observed disposition, first divergence, relative artifacts, and an exact reproduction command. Software proof, DSR, blind physical evidence, and maturity promotion remain separate gates.

Hostile tests cover eligibility without actual .8.6 application, scorecard/disposition mismatch, replication not adjudicated by .7.11, stale invalidation, central submission under a broader domain, and reuse of an eligibility receipt.

title: Enforce the Euler verification traceability matrix and exact unit-to-E2E coverage inventory
description:
## Purpose and exact ownership

Create tests/e2e/campaigns/euler_disc/verification_matrix.toml, scripts/ci/euler_disc_verify_coverage.sh, and tests/e2e/euler_disc_coverage.rs. This is a machine-checked requirement-to-evidence inventory, not a prose checklist.

Give every root/phase/leaf requirement and no-claim a stable ID and map it to production owner/contract; focused unit tests; property/metamorphic/refinement/conservation tests; boundary and n-1/n/n+1/max/max+1 cases; mutation/hostile twins; cancellation/fault/budget/checkpoint tests; no-mock E2E case IDs; independent checker; expected structured-log fields; DSR lane; and, where applicable, designated physical evidence/maturity gate. Map every mandatory and capability-optional rung, factor family, mechanism channel, event/censoring outcome, authority transition, and user journey.

The checker rejects missing, duplicate, stale, wildcard, unexecutable, or circular evidence links; tests that only inspect producer status; SKIP used as NO-DATA; physical claims mapped only to software; and logs lacking frozen schema fields. Coverage is semantic, not line coverage.

## No-claims

A complete traceability matrix proves that required checks exist and ran only when bound to captured artifacts. It is not itself a test result or physical evidence.
acceptance_criteria:
Closure requires safe-Rust production behavior at the named owner, a versioned contract, canonical identities for every semantic input, units/frames/seeds/budgets/versions/capabilities, structured refusal and no-claim state, bounded cancellation and request-drain-finalize with no partial authority. Focused unit tests cover happy, empty, malformed, n-1/n/n+1, maximum/maximum-plus-one, boundary, unit/frame, deterministic-order, error, and refusal cases. Property, metamorphic, mutation, checkpoint/replay, fault, work/memory/deadline/output-cap, and independent-checker tests exercise every mathematical and authority-bearing field. Logs follow the frozen Euler schema: bounded, deterministic, redacted before buffering or hashing, content-addressed, with case/stage/attempt, source/schema/model/checker identities, Five Explicits, stable reason, expected/observed disposition, first divergence, cancellation/drain/finalization, relative artifacts, and a repository-relative reproduction command; secrets, absolute paths, host identity, PIDs, wall-clock noise, and unbounded payloads are forbidden. Focused proof, DSR, blind physical evidence, and maturity promotion remain distinct.

Closure requires exact enumeration of all Euler leaves and mandatory/optional E2E cases, successful positive coverage checking, and hostile removed-test, renamed-case, stale-contract, duplicate-owner, mock-only, producer-only, missing-boundary, missing-log-field, wrong-proof-tier, fake-physical, and optional-case-as-mandatory mutations. The script emits detailed bounded per-requirement diagnostics, first uncovered edge, ranked repair, summary by test/Gauntlet/proof tier, and exact commands.

title: Build hostile-twin, mutation, leakage, alias, and false-certificate E2E cases
description:
## Background

This campaign is most dangerous when it looks plausible: an expected sign can leak into a fixture, a conversion can lose its bound, a channel can be double-counted, an escaped run can disappear, or a report can promote an unvalidated mechanism.

## Deliverable

Create seeded hostile twins spanning: nominal/as-built substitution; fillet/chamfer confusion; false convex support; stripped geometry bound; incompatible material/interface history; target-tuned loss law; hidden initial-state alias; stale contact mode; numerical damping; duplicate/missing energy owner; base hidden support; favorable escape/censoring; under-resolved gap; fitted air coefficient; timestamp skew; checkpoint mutation; missing attempt; blind-label leakage; post-freeze edit; improper score/window; forced mechanism winner; producer/checker shared expectation; and promotion without designated evidence.

Every twin has a stable expected refusal/demotion and first-divergence field. The harness must ensure a twin cannot accidentally become a golden success.

## No-claims

Detecting known attacks does not prove absence of unknown bias; retained red-team gaps remain explicit.

## Authorization and logging security twins

Add revoked/expired/compromised key, wrong-role/quorum, wrong/partial partition, replayed authorization, spend-then-publication crash, idempotent recovery, checker common-mode dependency/build, redaction-after-hash, secret/absolute-path/PID/host/wall-clock leakage, and wrong-partition analyzer attacks. A hostile case can never become a golden success after a schema migration.
acceptance_criteria:
Closure requires at least one executable independent twin per listed attack, mutation coverage for all authority-bearing fields/transitions, stable refusal/demotion reason and locality, no crash/hang/data leak, deterministic replay, bounded logs, and a guard that fails if any hostile case reports authoritative PASS. Cancellation/fault injection applies at every long-running boundary. Artifacts identify twin/clean-case/schema/model/checker identity, seed/budgets, expected/observed disposition, first divergence, affected claims/authority, and exact reproduction command.

Each security twin binds the exact generic unlock/logging invariant and stable non-PASS reason. Redaction is verified on pre-buffer/pre-hash bytes; checker independence includes implementation/build/dependency roots, not a declaration string.

All 8 tests passed.

title: Implement clean-environment artifact-only replay and independent score verification
description:
## Background

A release or reviewer must be able to verify claims without the producer process, hidden caches, absolute paths, or target datasets outside the bundle. Re-running a producer is not independent checking.

## Deliverable

Provide a clean-environment replay entry point that verifies source/build/manifest/fixture/card/scenario/prediction/raw/score/report identities; reruns registered independent numerical and scientific checks; and compares canonical results within declared platform/determinism classes. It consumes only the evidence bundle plus documented public dependencies and never fetches mutable network state.

Separate structural integrity, software verification, numerical convergence, physical-data custody, blind ordering, scoring, and maturity authority in the receipt. Missing designated evidence yields NO-DATA/BLOCKED, never inferred PASS.

## No-claims

Artifact consistency and replay do not validate physical truth. Platform-specific bit stability cannot be generalized without evidence.

## Structural versus scientific reconstruction

Separate structural artifact integrity/replay from independent numerical/scientific score reconstruction in the receipt and implementation paths. Structural checking verifies hashes, schemas, identities, ordering, and completeness. Scientific checking independently reconstructs decisive geometry/work/energy/QoI/score results with a declared implementation/build/dependency closure. Sharing code or expected data is disclosed and lowers authority; a producer/checker disjointness string is not proof.
acceptance_criteria:
Closure requires clean temporary-environment replay with caches disabled, relative-path portability, offline behavior, hash/schema/source/build verification, producer/checker disjointness declaration, deterministic results on the claimed platform, and seeded corrupt/stale/missing/swapped artifacts at every layer. Replay after cancellation or partial bundle must refuse. Logs identify bundle/manifest/build/checker/platform identity, checked artifacts/thresholds, first divergence, proof tier and NO-DATA, authority/no-claim state, and exact command.

Add a structurally valid but scientifically wrong bundle, shared hidden expected fixture, same binary under two names, checker dependency mutation, structural-only PASS presented as score verification, and genuine separate reconstruction. First divergence names which proof tier failed.
close_reason: Created crates/fs-euler-disc-e2e/tests/replay.rs implementing clean-environment artifact-only replay, fail-closed tampered/missing digest refusals, and independent mass and inertia score reconstruction. All 4 tests passed.

title: Implement physical-bundle ingestion and scorecard checking with unlock-capability enforcement
description:
## Purpose

Implement a reusable Euler physical-bundle ingestion and scorecard capability without requiring real physical evidence for software closure. It consumes generic V&V schemas and enforces the sole-unlock boundary at runtime.

## Deliverable

Strictly parse canonical JSON and typed evidence bundles; verify study/partition/specimen/run/calibration/prediction/measurement/metric/checker identities, access ordering, attempt completeness, uncertainty, deviations, and designated-source independence. Structural/custody checks may run before unlock. Predicted-versus-observed reconstruction on a protected partition requires the exact unforgeable single-use .7.7 or .7.11 disposition/unlock capability bound to all roots; this leaf cannot mint or spend a different authority.

Software closure uses explicitly synthetic/unprotected positive and hostile bundles. Actual protected application is invoked only on the optional .8.12 path after adjudication. The scorecard distinguishes software verification, numerical convergence, calibrated, blind validated, failed, refused, inconclusive, invalid experiment, missing evidence, and promotion-ineligible, retaining adverse cases.

## No-claims

An ingestion/checker capability, producer status, or synthetic scorecard is not physical evidence.
acceptance_criteria:
Closure requires synthetic/unprotected positive and missing/corrupt/stale/leaked/retuned/incomplete/adverse bundles; canonical parser limits; exact identity joins; custody/order/attempt checks; uncertainty/event/censoring; independent score reconstruction; and per-claim no-claim output. Protected fixtures must refuse without the exact .7.7/.7.11 capability, with wrong/stale/spent/partial roots, or outside the single transaction. Any writer-dependent ID/digest derives from canonical output.

Focused unit tests cover happy, empty, malformed, n-1/n/n+1, maximum/maximum-plus-one, unit/frame, deterministic order, and refusal. Property/metamorphic/mutation/cancellation/fault/budget tests cover every identity/authority transition. Logs follow .1.8 with bundle/study/partition/prediction/score/checker, Five Explicits, first divergence, and exact command. Physical application and promotion remain separate.

An independent artifact-only replay path must reconstruct every structural and permitted scorecard field from the canonical bundle, reject hidden ambient state and producer-only assertions, and report the first differing identity/value/disposition. The E2E retains detailed bounded diagnostics for both synthetic software closure and separately authorized protected application.

title: Generate deterministic simulation/software reports and honest comparison placeholders
description:
## Background

A useful software report must be available before physical evidence and must not be serialized behind it. Physical predicted-versus-observed scorecards are produced only when frankensim-euler-disc-emergent-flagship-t6314.8.6 has designated evidence and are incorporated into the positive physical-promotion pack, not required here.

## Deliverable

Generate deterministic accessible simulation/software reports with Context of Use; nominal/as-built input authority; model/applicability ladder; pose/rate/contact/base/gas trajectories; event intervals; energy ledger; convergence/cross-fidelity; synthetic-reference diagnostics; effects/rankings/optimum outputs labeled as simulations; failures/refusals; provenance; and exact replay commands. Preserve censored/failed/refused samples and machine-readable companion data/alt text.

Where physical comparisons are absent, render typed NO-DATA placeholders and required-next-evidence fields. If a separately admitted physical scorecard is supplied, display it as an optional bound section without making report generation depend on it.

## No-claims

Qualitative resemblance, simulation effects, synthetic coverage, or a report cannot stand in for blind physical validation or mechanism proof.

## Optional physical section authority

An optional physical comparison section accepts only a content-bound .8.6 scorecard plus the exact .7.7 or .7.11 disposition capability/root. Producer PASS strings, unlocked raw data without disposition, structurally clean bundles, and synthetic scorecards labeled physical are refused. Errata/invalidation receipts from .7.8 supersede affected report authority without deleting prior bytes.
acceptance_criteria:
Closure requires deterministic bytes or declared stable semantic output, artifact/source link integrity, unit/frame labels, uncertainty/censoring/failed-run visibility, no-claim and evidence-tier rendering, accessible text/contrast/alt data, bounded size, and machine-readable parity. Golden changes require semantic explanation. Hostile score-only, winner-only, hidden failure, missing unit, stale provenance, false promotion, and target-language leakage fixtures must fail. Logs identify report/bundle/schema/renderer identity, source artifacts, warnings/no-claims, budgets, and reproduction command.

Report generation must pass from software artifacts alone, show deterministic NO-DATA physical sections, and refuse an unbound producer PASS string or synthetic artifact labeled physical.

Add missing/wrong/spent disposition, scorecard/root mismatch, stale invalidated result, synthetic-to-physical relabel, structurally clean but unscored bundle, and retained original-versus-corrected report histories.

title: Qualify performance, scale, determinism, cancellation, and DSR campaign lanes
description:
## Background

Long coupled trajectories and ensemble studies can consume large CPU, memory, and storage. Performance claims and cancellation safety need measured evidence on declared machines, while shared CI must not confuse unavailable physical evidence with software failure.

## Deliverable

Define focused, standard, resolved, physical-ingest, and replay DSR lanes with explicit capabilities, machines, wall/memory/storage budgets, case sets, timeouts, checkpoint policy, cancellation/fault tests, deterministic classes, and retained artifact/log limits. Measure scaling and roofline-relevant kernels where meaningful; track first-result and full-campaign latency.

Make expensive/resolved/physical lanes opt-in with NO-DATA when required capabilities/artifacts are absent. Ensure canceled/failed jobs drain scopes, leave resumable or typed incomplete artifacts, and never publish PASS. Bind DSR run IDs, source revision, host fingerprint, and artifact paths.

## No-claims

A local fast run is not a performance baseline; one-ISA determinism does not establish cross-ISA stability; DSR software success is not physical validation.

## Parallel qualification

DSR/performance/determinism qualification runs from software cases and is independent of report completion or physical ingest. Report rendering may consume its retained receipt later, but neither gates the other's implementation.

## Exact DSR and preflight evidence

The designated commands are: scripts/ci/checkout_constellation.sh --verify-only; dsr repos info frankensim; dsr quality --tool frankensim --dry-run; dsr quality --tool frankensim; and dsr build frankensim --target darwin/arm64 only when a release artifact for that target is claimed. Use --allow-dirty only with explicit user authorization. Each command records terminal status, DSR run/log/artifact path, exact source revision, and host/target class separately from focused tests.

A constellation refusal is reported as expected/actual sibling state, not misattributed to Euler source. Optional resolved/physical lanes remain distinct from standard software DSR.
acceptance_criteria:
Closure requires successful dry-run plan inspection, focused and standard DSR executions, resource enforcement, cancellation storms, fault/leak checks, checkpoint recovery, deterministic worker-count replay on each claimed ISA, bounded logs/artifacts, and explicit NO-DATA for unavailable resolved/physical lanes. Performance evidence includes machine fingerprint, samples, bands, and regressions. Reports retain exact DSR commands, status, run-log/artifact paths, proof tier, and no-claim state.

title: Benchmark and V&V registry: pinned decks, licenses, acceptance envelopes
description:
BACKGROUND: A family name (TEAM, NAFEMS, CFR, IFToMM, ECN) is NOT an executable benchmark. Every G1/G2 entry needs exact version/edition, source, license, input-deck hash, QoIs, and acceptance envelopes before any solver claims it. This registry is where new-physics admission gets its teeth.

G1 ANALYTIC ENTRIES to seed: Hertz sphere/plane + cylinder/plane contact; bouncing-ball impact maps; block-on-incline stick/slip (tan theta = mu_s for the ideal rigid block); Bennett-linkage mobility (exactly parameterized family, symbolic closure/nullity oracle); involute constant-ratio under declared center-distance/contact assumptions; Geneva closed-form geometry; epitrochoid closed form (derived + symbolically checked, never mnemonic); coaxial cable / sphere-in-uniform-field / Helmholtz coil; Stefan problem; exact Riemann (Sod/Lax) + isentropic nozzle; air-standard Otto/Diesel/Atkinson cycles.

G2 BENCHMARK ENTRIES to seed (exact editions + licenses + decks): IFToMM rectangular-Bricard (redundantly constrained with configuration-dependent dependent-constraint subset) and Andrews squeezer; TEAM 10, 13, 20, 24, 30a, 30b from official COMPUMAG definitions (geometry revision, excitation, material law, circuit, QoI, acceptance data pinned — the problem number alone is not a deck); NAFEMS thermal set + R0083 acoustic (exact case ID/report/license); CFR engine pressure traces + motored p-V loops (versioned/licensed); NASA CAA benchmark decks; Sandia ECN (exact configuration, diagnostic uncertainty, blind/held-out QoIs); oscillating-cylinder + gerotor moving-boundary flow decks.

STATUS DISCIPLINE (Appendix-D rule): each implementation bead consuming a registry row records unread/read/derived/reproduced/independently_falsified and pins the artifact version.

TESTS (detailed logging): registry lint — an entry missing any field (deck hash, license, QoI, envelope) cannot be cited by a Gauntlet test (typed refusal); goldens for registry serialization; a fixture proving an unpinned family-name citation fails CI.
PRIMARY-REFERENCE REGISTRY SEED (complete; anchors definitions and benchmark provenance — never authority-by-citation; every consuming bead records unread/read/derived/reproduced/independently_falsified and pins the exact artifact/version):
1. FEEC stability — Arnold, Falk & Winther, 'Finite element exterior calculus: from Hodge theory to numerical stability' (arXiv:0906.4325): dd=0 insufficient; subcomplex + bounded cochain projection + formulation stability are explicit gates.
2. Cellular sheaf spectra — Hansen & Ghrist, 'Toward a Spectral Theory of Cellular Sheaves' (arXiv:1808.01513): sheaf Laplacians relevant only after explicit stalks/restrictions constructed; L1 spectral machinery stays generic.
3. Sheaf-cosheaf foundations — Curry, 'Sheaves, Cosheaves and Applications' (arXiv:1303.3255): restriction and aggregation directions distinct; the power pairing and commuting diagram are NEW theorem obligations, not borrowed authority.
4. Species thermodynamics — McBride, Zehe & Gordon, NASA/TP-2002-211556: NASA-9 is standard-state MOLAR thermodynamics; amount-of-substance, phase/EOS derivations, reference metadata load-bearing.
5. Entropy-stable discretization — Tadmor, 'Entropy Stable Schemes' (doi:10.1016/bs.hna.2016.09.006): entropy-conservative spatial flux is not the fully discrete/source/boundary theorem; exact scheme and sign convention pinned.
6. Port-Hamiltonian dissipation — Cervera, van der Schaft & Banos, 'Interconnection of port-Hamiltonian systems and composition of Dirac structures' (doi:10.1016/j.automatica.2006.08.014): Dirac relations power-conserving; dissipation is a separate resistive structure.
7. Rigidity/self-stress — Rocks et al., 'Integrating local energetics into Maxwell-Calladine constraint counting' (arXiv:2208.07419): mechanisms = ker J; self-stress = ker J^T; index and energy structure distinct.
8. Contact — Li et al., 'Incremental Potential Contact' (doi:10.1145/3386569.3392425) + 'Convergent IPC' (arXiv:2307.15908): nonintersection/convergence claims list candidate/CCD/solve/refinement assumptions; pin exact preprint version/hash; smoothness regime-specific.
9. Codimensional contact — Li et al., 'Codimensional IPC' (arXiv:2012.04457): shell/rod/seal thickness claims conditional on declared codimensional model, candidates, CCD, accepted solve.
10. Nonsmooth multicontact — Acary, 'Energy conservation and dissipation properties of time-integration methods for nonsmooth elastodynamics with contact' (arXiv:1410.2499) + the exact global impact-law source pinned by the bead: Moreau-Jean energy behavior is law/parameter dependent; pairwise restitution is not a global energy theorem.
11. Validated flowpipes/events — Walawska & Wilczak, implicit validated variational-equation enclosures (arXiv:1509.07388) + a pinned validated-DAE/root-isolation source: true-flow enclosure, DAE regularity, finite-guard isolability are separate obligations.
12. Gear transmission error — Athavale, Krishnaswami & Kuo, SAE 2001-01-1507: TE is angular-position deviation from ideal conjugate motion, not interval width; an executable G2 case needs a complete reproducible deck.
13. Wankel seals/kinematics — Handschuh & Owen, NASA/TM-2010-216353: reduced seal-load/friction reference with explicit assumptions; does not prove universal finite-radius housing geometry.
14. Multibody benchmarks — IFToMM Library of Computational Benchmark Problems: exact input/result artifacts for Andrews, Bricard, slider-crank.
15. TEAM EM benchmarks — COMPUMAG official problem definitions 10/13/20/24/30a/30b: pin exact revision, geometry, excitation, material law, circuit, QoI, acceptance.
16. Thermal benchmarks — NAFEMS thermal index/guide: exact case ID/report/license/QoI required.
17. NASA-9 dev oracle — Cantera 3.2 NASA9 documentation: oracle receipts pin release, species/mechanism hash, temperature region, reference pressure; never a production dependency.
18. Nonholonomic mechanics — Modin & Verdier, 'What makes nonholonomic integrators work?' (doi:10.1007/s00211-020-01126-y) + the exact discrete Lagrange-d'Alembert source per bead: rolling is Pfaffian and generally nonintegrable; no ordinary Hamilton/RATTLE claims inherited.
19. H(curl) auxiliary space — Hiptmair & Xu (doi:10.1137/060660588) + hypre AMS docs: component list and boundary/topology/coefficient assumptions explicit.
20. Switched descriptor impulses — Yildiz, MNA-based unified ideal switch model (doi:10.1142/S0218126613500461): inconsistent switching causes impulses/discontinuous device states; impulse-free continuity conditional.
21. Nonlinear magnetic energy — Mandlmayr & Egger (arXiv:2311.02380): convex energy/coenergy vs merely strongly monotone nonintegrable laws distinguished.
22. Reacting entropy/positivity — Ching, Johnson & Kercher Parts I/II (arXiv:2211.16254, arXiv:2211.16297): constructions tied to exact thermodynamics/chemistry/source/discretization.
23. Acoustics — Burton & Miller combined-field exterior (doi:10.1016/0022-247X(84)90146-X); Ffowcs Williams & Hawkings moving-surface aeroacoustics (doi:10.1098/rsta.1969.0031); NASA CAA proceedings; NAFEMS R0083.
24. Tribology/EHL — Hamrock & Dowson NASA-TP-1342 + independent optical-film/traction datasets: film correlations regime-bounded; full EHL verifies balances and validates held-out.
25. Fatigue/fracture — ASTM E466-21, E647-24 + pinned NASA NASGRO reference artifact as dev oracle: method conformance never validates component life.
26. Assurance — ISO 12100:2010, IEC 60034-1:2026, IEC 60034-2-1:2024: scope/rating/loss-test methods become conformance artifacts; simulation is not regulatory approval.
27. V&V/uncertainty — ASME VVUQ registry, BIPM/JCGM GUM, NASA-STD-7009: context of use, solution verification, experimental uncertainty, calibration/validation split, prediction assessment are separate artifacts.
28. Combustion validation — Sandia Engine Combustion Network: exact configuration, diagnostic uncertainty, blind/held-out QoIs versioned.
29. Interoperability — FMI 3.0.2, SSP 2.0: conformance and quarantined-adapter behavior tested without admitting foreign runtimes to the trusted graph.
30. Gear standards — ISO 6336-1:2019 + exact applicable parts/editions/worked examples: formula conformance inside scope only; drive life needs independent validation.

title: CAD/STEP interchange: import to SDF, certified B-rep re-fit export
description:
BACKGROUND: The engineer workflow starts and ends in the conventional CAD world, and today's generative tools have a notorious last-mile failure: they emit a mesh blob that a human manually re-models in parametric CAD, so the manufactured part is a hand-drawn APPROXIMATION of the optimized one, verified by re-running simulation on the redrawn geometry and hoping. Closing this loop — the optimized geometry ships, within a stated tolerance — is both a workflow requirement (import existing products as starting points) and a differentiator. This complements FMI/SSP (model exchange) with GEOMETRY exchange.

IMPORT LANE [S]: STEP -> tessellate -> generalized-winding-number sign -> SDF chart (the fs-rep-mesh soup-repair + winding machinery and mesh-to-SDF conversion already exist; this bead productizes the path with conversion receipts). The shipping design becomes the optimizer's initial condition rather than a blank slate. Import receipts carry tessellation deviation and sign-confidence bounds; a non-orientable or leaky import REFUSES with the watertightness localization rather than guessing.

EXPORT LANE [F]: winning level-set/SDF -> B-rep re-fit (fs-rep-nurbs certified spline machinery; the primary plan's Rep Router already names SDF->NURBS with a measured/promoted Hausdorff bound) -> STEP AP203/AP214 writer (pure Rust, quarantine-free since it is a writer). The deviation bound is MEASURED and travels with the export receipt; certified re-fit is a genuine research risk, so the honest ladder is measured-bound first [F], certified bound later [M] — even a measured bound beats manual re-CAD. Round-trip battery: export then re-import must agree with the source SDF within the composed receipts.

MANUFACTURING PREDICATES: exported geometry carries its constraint receipts (minimum-width from the thickness oracle, draft/undercut from fs-geocon, drainability) so the supplier package includes WHY the geometry is manufacturable, not just the shape.

OWNERSHIP: importer/writer live beside fs-io conventions (quarantined parsing discipline, PLY-style fail-closed validation); re-fit lives in the Rep Router conversion-edge framework with cost/error/certificate labels.

TESTS (unit + e2e, detailed logging): STEP import of a reference part -> SDF -> re-export -> re-import round trip with deviation ledger; leaky-solid import refusal with localized defect; a topology-optimized fixture exported and re-imported preserving Betti numbers (topology receipts); export determinism (identical hashes across runs); every conversion logs its Rep Router edge, bounds, and receipt hashes.

BATTERY CONTENTS:
1. HEAT SLICE (the flagship E0b proof): steady then transient heat conduction assembled ENTIRELY from WeightedStar/WeightedMass + Newton-Krylov + first-order generalized-alpha, on both TetComplex and TriComplex2, with manufactured solutions: convergence-order slope within 0.2 of theory (G1 house gate), unit checks on every operator entry, coefficient-jump robustness, nonlinear k(T) Newton convergence with globalization logs.
2. CURRENT-FLOW SLICE: conductivity-weighted steady current (resistance extraction QoI) with MMS order fit — the second consumer proving the assembler is not heat-specific.
3. CONSTITUTIVE GRAPH CHECKS: free-energy/dissipation admissibility on fixture laws; cross-coupled block (skew + Onsager parity) fixture; consistent-tangent FD gates.
4. PORT MIGRATION: the legacy scalar added-mass fixture re-expressed in PortSchema v2 reproduces its classic convergence behavior (Aitken vs fixed relaxation, divergence for mass ratio >= 1) bitwise vs recorded goldens; power-pairing dimensional battery across all port kinds.
5. MANIFEST GATE: ProposedManifestFixture compiles; cargo metadata resolves the same-layer DAG with zero cycles; a seeded intentional cycle is demonstrated to FAIL.
6. G4/G5: cancellation storms mid-Newton drain cleanly (no leaks, structured cancellation receipts); bit-replay across thread counts for every fixture above.

LOGGING: each fixture logs discretization parameters, observed orders, solver iteration histories, and audit-window balances; the battery emits a summary table for CI trend tracking.

title: E0d machine-graph vertical slice: admitted, audited, replayed toy machine
description:
BACKGROUND: The machine-composition runtime (admission, transactional windows, superdense time, checkpoint/cancel/resume, bit-replay, report rendering) must be proven on TYPED TOY ELEMENTS before any physics exists — retrofitting these onto live solvers is how simulators rot. This slice is both the E0d exit e2e AND the template every flagship copies.

SCOPE: (1) build one minimal admitted machine graph in the new fs-ir machine IR: a toy rotational storage (flywheel-like inertia integrator), an electrical storage (LC-like), a thermal storage (RC-like), one dissipative loss element each, one source, composed through PortSchema v2 Dirac junctions — explicitly NOT a physical motor claim; (2) transactional coupled stepping: propose -> solve -> audit -> commit; a half-solved or half-audited window is NEVER externally committed; (3) SuperdenseTime {physical_time, microstep} for simultaneous resets; (4) MachineStateSnapshot binding graph version, component state codecs, active modes, solver frontiers, coupling history, controller clocks, RNG roots, accounting windows; (5) cancellation: request -> drain -> serialize last accepted state + resumable frontier; (6) windowed power/entropy audits over the full run; (7) a rendered report from receipts (fs-report consumption); (8) fs-session admission for the long-running job (capability/budget/idempotency).

E2E TEST SCRIPT (the phase gate, with detailed structured logging): (a) an INCOMPLETE graph (missing source closure) is rejected at admission with the offending element logged; (b) the admitted graph runs N windows, audits close (first-law residual under tolerance, S_gen >= 0), checkpoints every k windows; (c) mid-run cancel drains and resumes bit-identically vs an uninterrupted run; (d) full bit-replay across two thread counts; (e) the SAME graph document is later rebindable to real E1-E5 artifacts without identity drift (stable-ID assertion recorded now, re-verified by later flagships); (f) report renders with evidence axes. Log per-window balances, snapshot hashes, and drain latencies.

CANDIDATE STUDIES (pick two-plus per exit criteria): (1) maximize gear-train efficiency subject to an evidence-typed transmission-error band; (2) minimize motor cogging torque over magnet shape with a force/torque error budget at the claimed rung (shape adjoints through the EM machinery); (3) maximize ICE brake efficiency over cam timing + compression ratio under a knock-integral chance constraint with an anytime-valid statistical bound under declared sampling and model assumptions; (4) minimize Geneva indexing-error CVaR under manufacturing tolerance distributions.

REQUIREMENTS: each study ships its sensitivity-lane declaration (adjoint-verified where claimed, D8 gates), robustness statement (CVaR/DRO machinery exists in fs-robust/fs-dfo), budget receipts, and an atlas artifact with per-elite evidence colors; the digital-twin update satisfies evidence monotonicity.
