title: E8 summit: independent reproduction and adjudication of theorem cards
description:
BACKGROUND: E8 is the reproduction/adjudication SUMMIT, not the start date — cards open beside their enabling phases and this bead closes the program's research arc.

SCOPE: (1) every card audited for: exact quantifiers, trusted computing base, boring baseline, counterexample generator, executable checker, retained falsifier, reproduction pack; (2) independent reproduction attempts (fresh implementation or independent reviewer per the review-state axis); (3) formal adjudication/promotion: a proved card may promote an [F] lane ONLY after its checker survives independent falsification; (4) the E8 exit: at least THREE independent cards spanning (i) topology/coupling, (ii) mechanisms/hybrids/contact, (iii) thermodynamics/fidelity/life are BOTH KernelChecked AND ScaleQualified; (5) failed moonshots remain versioned/refuted — visible and unavailable, never hidden prerequisites; (6) integration: nonlinear stacks, multisymplectic composition, set-valued hybrid reachability, and adaptive model-category routing attempts recorded with honest state.

TESTS/LOGGING: reproduction-pack completeness lint per card; promotion-gate enforcement (an [F] lane consuming an unproved card refused); the summit report renders the full card portfolio with orthogonal state axes; every adjudication decision logged with reviewer identity and artifacts.

NORMATIVE SUMMIT/PROMOTION CORRECTION: A counterexample candidate never forces Refuted merely by existing. It is adjudicated as ConfirmedCounterexample, SatisfiableWitness, AssumptionViolation, NumericalArtifact, CheckerArtifact, or ClassificationPending under exact quantifiers/domain/assumptions. E8 portfolio success and per-card runtime promotion are distinct. Runtime eligibility requires the dedicated promotion receipt and the full conjunction Stable + SatisfiableWitnessed + Proved or fully discharged ConditionalProof + exact-instance Admitted + strength-matched nonvacuity + no unresolved authority gap + KernelChecked + ScaleQualified + Reproduced + no active invalidation/revocation/source or policy drift. Missing axes remain visible Unknown/Refused; no score or summit vote fills them. Failed or repaired conjectures stay versioned evidence.

## Success Criteria

Maintain a 15-row immutable per-card matrix with exact statement revision, lane, ambition, quantifiers/assumptions/domain/units, TCB, baseline, falsifier, checker, reproduction pack, taxonomy outcome, independent-review identity, axis states, scale status, support/revocation effects, artifact roots, and no-claim reason. Apply the high-precedence six-outcome taxonomy and Refuted gate exactly. Run independent reproduction on each ready card without requiring unrelated cards to finish first; preserve incomplete/failed cards as explicit states. Phase completion requires every card to have a terminal adjudication or explicitly retained ClassificationPending/no-claim record, and at least three independent cards spanning topology/coupling, mechanisms/hybrids/contact, and thermodynamics/fidelity/life to be both KernelChecked and ScaleQualified. No failed moonshot may block solid lanes or become a hidden prerequisite. Tests include checker/falsifier unit suites, transition and support-graph properties, adversarial assumption/domain/satisfiability cases, tamper/stale/cancellation/checker-disagreement and revocation E2Es, G4 bounded drain/no-leak, and G5 semantic replay. Bounded logs retain all matrix fields, raw observations, budgets, cancellation/drain/finalization, independent checker and reviewer, classification rationale, authority transition, support/threat deltas, and exact evidence paths. A green software harness alone never proves a theorem.

title: EPIC E0b — Constitutive operators and solver spine
description:

title: EPIC E2 — Dynamic interaction: multibody, contact, dry tribology
description:
PHASE EPIC (new-domains expansion; self-contained bead graph).

WHY: With motion and kinematics in hand, this phase makes bodies MOVE UNDER FORCES and TOUCH: constrained rigid multibody dynamics on SE(3), validated true-flow hybrid events, body-body contact (smooth barrier lane + nonsmooth complementarity lane), and the dry tribology baseline. The Geneva flagship closes the phase because intermittent motion exercises every piece: events, unilateral contact, dwell retention, tolerance UQ.

SCOPE: true-flow ValidatedStep/TrajectoryTube + fs-ad saltation protocols (ext-time-validated-step); SE(3)/variational integrator lanes (ext-time-se3-lanes); adjoint composition + gradient gates (ext-adjoint-composition); fs-mbd rigid core with three lanes (ext-mbd-core); contact detection/CCD (ext-contact-detection-ccd); IPC barrier lane (ext-contact-ipc-lane); Moreau-Jean nonsmooth lane (ext-contact-nonsmooth-lane); dry tribology baseline (ext-tribo-dry-baseline); Geneva geometry + retention certificates (ext-kinematics-geneva-retention); E2 battery (ext-e2-test-battery); FLAGSHIP fs-geneva-e2e (ext-flagship-geneva).

NORMATIVE DELTA (binding): a dry-tribology baseline is a prerequisite of the E2 Geneva exit. Contact ownership: reusable detection/response protocols live in L3 fs-contact; fs-solid and fs-mbd consume adapters; generic conic/nonlinear math stays in L1 fs-solver.

title: EPIC E5 — Reactive-flow machine stack

title: EPIC E8 — Theorem Foundry integration summit
description:
PHASE EPIC (new-domains expansion; self-contained bead graph).

WHY: The program deliberately attempts NEW mathematics (15 theorem cards spanning electromechanical pairing, equivariant gluing, force enclosures, nonlinear mechanism descent, hybrid completeness, whole-machine thermodynamics, fidelity descent, conjugate geometry, contact-tribology limits, reactive ALE entropy, multisymplectic composition, closed-loop risk, acoustic transfer, failure-mode descent, constitutive learning). E8 is the INDEPENDENT REPRODUCTION AND ADJUDICATION SUMMIT, not the start date — cards open beside their enabling phases (E0d onward).

SCOPE: four theorem-lane beads grouped by enabling area (ext-theorem-lane-mechanics, ext-theorem-lane-electromech, ext-theorem-lane-thermo, ext-theorem-lane-systems) plus the summit itself (ext-e8-summit).

EXIT CRITERIA: every card has exact quantifiers, trusted computing base, boring baseline, counterexample generator, executable checker, retained falsifier, and reproduction pack; at least THREE independent cards spanning (i) topology/coupling, (ii) mechanisms/hybrids/contact, and (iii) thermodynamics/fidelity/life are BOTH KernelChecked AND ScaleQualified; failed moonshots remain versioned/refuted and never block solid lanes or become hidden prerequisites.

GOVERNANCE (D12 + normative delta): one unproven mechanism per independently falsifiable proof lane, under a portfolio WIP/budget cap. Theorem state axes are ORTHOGONAL (statement/mathematics/formalization/falsification/implementation/review). Every candidate is classified as ConfirmedCounterexample, SatisfiableWitness, AssumptionViolation, NumericalArtifact, CheckerArtifact, or ClassificationPending. Only an independently checked, satisfiable, in-domain, assumption-satisfying failure of the exact conclusion against the exact immutable statement revision may set that revision to Refuted. A sharper successor is a new versioned statement and never silently edits the old theorem. Proof assistants are isolated dev/research oracles; production consumes only versioned proof artifacts and FrankenSim-native checkers.

## Success Criteria

The structured `acceptance_criteria` field contains the controlling, complete Success Criteria exact-set close gate. This navigation heading neither weakens nor duplicates that gate.

Only a ConfirmedCounterexample that is independently checked, satisfiable under the retained model, in-domain, assumption-satisfying, and demonstrates failure of the exact conclusion may transition that revision to Refuted. SatisfiableWitness confirms satisfiability or an example but is not a refutation unless it violates the conclusion; AssumptionViolation is evidence about scope; NumericalArtifact and CheckerArtifact are implementation evidence; ClassificationPending grants no promotion or refutation. Never average conflicting classifications, silently edit the statement, transfer a result across revisions, or allow Refuted to mean unsupported/incomplete. A sharper statement is a new content-addressed successor linked to the old revision. Unit tests exhaust the transition matrix and reject illegal transitions; property/metamorphic tests cover serialization/order/replay invariance; mutation tests remove each admission, satisfiability, domain, assumption, independence, revision, and conclusion guard; E2E fixtures exercise all six outcomes, tamper/stale/checker-disagreement/cancellation paths, revocation propagation, and runtime refusal. description:

title: P0 fs-govern: enforce one active unproven mechanism per independently falsifiable proof lane
description:
ROOT CAUSE: The program documents a one-bet discipline but has no executable admission rule. A naive global singleton would suppress the intended theorem portfolio, while no rule permits unlimited correlated mechanisms inside one proof lane and lets agents spend all resources on favorable variants.

SEMANTICS: Define an authenticated ProofLaneId from statement/quantifiers, admissible domain, assumptions, target authority, baseline, falsifier family, and independence class. Permit multiple active unproven mechanisms across independently falsifiable lanes. Atomically refuse a second active mechanism in the same lane unless the policy explicitly declares a preregistered head-to-head experiment with bounded shared resources. Separately enforce global work, memory, reviewer, and falsification-capacity envelopes so lane partitioning cannot evade portfolio limits. Terminal Refuted, Tombstoned, Withdrawn, or superseded states release a slot only after durable ledger finalization; Unknown or stalled work does not silently release it. Prevent lane-ID spoofing, assumption laundering, split/merge gaming, and concurrent double admission.

ACCEPTANCE AND TESTS: Multiple distinct lanes admit concurrently; a second active mechanism in the same authenticated lane refuses atomically; explicit bounded comparison mode admits only its declared candidates; global portfolio caps still bind; terminal/tombstone transitions release exactly once; crash/retry/idempotency and concurrent admissions cannot oversubscribe. G0 state-machine and identity laws, G3 equivalent statement/assumption canonicalization and lane split/merge adversaries, G4 races/cancellation/storage faults with no partial admission, G5 deterministic replay. Mutation tests remove each same-lane, global-cap, terminal-release, and identity guard. Real no-mock E2E registers two independent theorem lanes plus competing mechanisms in one lane through fs-govern, ledger, package, checker, and replay. Bounded logs include lane/mechanism IDs, canonical statement/domain/assumptions, policy/version, resource and falsification reservations, atomic decision, terminal release, idempotency key, and ranked remedy.

title: P0 Phase 0B: executable evidence authority, threat allocation, adjudication, and portable replay spine
description:
MISSION: Build the executable authority spine that sits between typed Phase 0 evidence objects and every theorem, simulation, optimization, and production claim. Phase 0A establishes core colors and identities; Phase 0B must make exact-instance admission, threat-directed doubt reduction, revocation, support recomputation, portable checking, and real fail-closed replay one coherent system. This is a leapfrog foundation, not a paperwork phase: new theorem-discovery machinery is welcome, but no candidate acquires production authority merely by being ambitious or internally consistent.

ARCHITECTURE: Six ordered leaves own contract algebra; canonical schema and admission; authenticated support/threat graphs plus anytime consequence-times-doubt allocation; counterexample adjudication and transitive revocation; portable package/checker authority recomposition; and no-mock red-team/cancellation/replay proof. Keep statement truth, satisfiability/nonvacuity, empirical scale evidence, checker result, reproduction, and runtime admission as orthogonal axes. Bind every edge to exact semantic identity, assumptions, domain, units, versions, capabilities, budgets, and source receipts. Preserve Unknown, Refused, Refuted, and partially supported states without collapsing them.

EXIT GATE: The epic completes only after the real E2E leaf proves an exact claim can be authored, admitted, attacked, adjudicated, packaged, checked independently, replayed, revoked by a new counterexample, and removed transitively from downstream authority under cancellation/fault injection. All six leaves have G0-G5 evidence appropriate to risk, mutation tests for every authority guard, bounded structured logging, and DSR proof. The epic depends on the terminal E2E leaf so graph completion cannot precede the executable gate.

title: Phase 0B-B: canonical evidence schema, exact-instance admission, and immutable receipts
description:
ROOT CAUSE: Correct Rust types do not suffice if serialization, migration, or capability checks can alter meaning. Implement the canonical on-wire schema and the sole exact-instance admission boundary.

SCOPE: Encode every Phase 0B contract object canonically with bounded sizes, sorted set fields, explicit units/seeds/budgets/versions/capabilities, content and semantic identities, source bindings, and schema migrations that never widen historical authority. Admission validates structure, source identities, statement/domain/assumption satisfiability requirements, policy fingerprint, checker capability, artifact availability, budget, and no-claim state before minting an opaque receipt. Receipt identity binds the exact candidate bytes and accepting policy decision; retries are idempotent, policy rotation is explicit, and accepting-verifier lies or mismatched fingerprints fail closed. Unknown fields/versions, ambiguous canonicalization, duplicate IDs, forged receipts, missing artifacts, and source drift refuse with ranked fixes.

ACCEPTANCE AND TESTS: G0 canonical round trips, duplicate/set handling, limits, malformed JSON/binary, nonfinite values, identity collisions, idempotency, policy mismatch, and migration monotonicity. G3 equivalent field ordering/units and historical schema replay. G4 parser/allocation/storage/capability/cancellation faults publish no receipt; concurrent identical admissions mint one durable result. G5 bit-stable bytes across ISAs. Independent schema checker and mutation suite target every bound and authority field. Real fixture logs retain candidate/source/semantic/policy IDs, validation order, budget consumption, decision, receipt, retry key, and ranked remedy.

## Acceptance Criteria

The dedicated Acceptance Criteria field is the canonical implementation close gate and cannot be weakened by the summary above.
design:
Implement the exact interface frozen by child rjoq.7.2.1 as the sole production admission authority. rjoq owns canonical candidate parsing, capability-scoped byte resolution, exact-instance validation, policy/checker/capability evaluation, deterministic decision ordering, durable idempotent storage, opaque receipt construction, schema migration, cancellation/fault recovery, and independent historical replay. Producers and Runner V2 remain TOOL/dev clients and cannot mint or link admission authority.

AdmissionCandidateRefV1 carries the six nominal semantic roots; CandidateResolverV1 is a separate affine capability with semantic CandidateResolverPolicyV1 root and nonsemantic locator/credential/handle. rjoq reads exact bytes, recomputes candidate_bytes_root before interpretation, validates every schema/policy/source/claim/producer/checker/budget/no-claim binding in the frozen order, then alone constructs immutable AdmissionReceiptV1.

Durability uses explicit Prepare/Reserved/Validated/DecisionPrepared/DurablyPublished/Returned states, one idempotency tuple, atomic manifest/seal publication, exact crash recovery, and no receipt before durable commit. Cancellation before commit drains and publishes none; retry after commit returns the same decision/receipt. Migration is explicit/content-bound/monotone, retains originals, and follows the frozen classification precedence.

The real `rjoq.runner-handoff.exact-bytes-root.v1` fixture is implemented through the same resolver/checker/policy/storage path as other candidates and yields a fixture-only admitted scope. Independent checker/replay consumes retained bytes and canonical policy/schema assets rather than trusting producer or admission logs. Unknown versions/fields, canonical ambiguity, duplicates, missing/stale/tampered artifacts, resolver substitution, policy mismatch, checker lies, capability mismatch, budget breach, and authority widening fail closed with ranked repairs.

title: rjoq exact-instance interface freeze: CandidateResolverV1, admission schemas, validation order, and eligible fixture
description:
Freeze the exact public rjoq admission interface before implementation or producer integration: one nonduplicated canonical request, receipt-free policy/basis algebra, literal refusal taxonomy and validation precedence, generic registered producer binding, width-safe generic budgets, durable idempotency/query semantics, explicit migration, and one rjoq-local fixture-only eligible candidate.

This is a specification and conformance leaf. It may build an interface conformance implementation, exhaustive unit/property/mutation/API tests, and a release-built no-mock rjoq-local fixture journey, but it cannot mint a production admission receipt; parent rjoq.7.2 alone implements durable admission authority. It neither imports nor validates any future producer schema, Runner type, Runner ownership manifest, or phase-specific artifact DAG.

## Acceptance Criteria

The dedicated Acceptance Criteria field is the complete close gate. No prose summary, fixture success, or downstream producer observation substitutes for every named generic schema, ownership, durability, recovery, test, oracle, budget-width, and logging requirement below.
design:
## Singular owner and nominal candidate identity

`fs-govern::admission_interface` is the sole Rust and wire-schema owner. `AdmissionCandidateRefV1`, domain `org.frankensim.fs-govern.admission-candidate-ref.v1`, has exactly these ordered fields and no others:

1. `candidate_bytes_root: CandidateBytesRootV1`
2. `candidate_schema_id: CandidateSchemaIdV1`
3. `policy_fingerprint: PolicyFingerprintV1`
4. `source_closure_root: SourceClosureRoot`
5. `claim_scope_root: ClaimScopeRootV1`
6. `producer_manifest_root: ProducerManifestRootV1`

The candidate describes semantic identity and never locates bytes. Each wrapper is private-field, nominal, role checked, versioned, and non-interchangeable. Producer crates consume owner types directly; mirrors, aliases, structural lookalikes, substitute encoders, public literals, and generic digest conversions are forbidden.

## Generic producer-binding registration and association

`ProducerBindingRootV1` is the authority-owned generic nominal role for a producer-specific canonical binding record. rjoq owns no concrete producer binding schema. Its sole checked association constructor accepts a registered `ProducerBindingSchemaIdV1` and the private role-checked digest supplied under that registration, verifies the registration and exact digest-association contract, preserves the same 32 BLAKE3-256 digest bytes, and assigns only the generic ProducerBinding role. It never imports, decodes, compiles, rehashes, or generically converts the producer record and does not imply durability, correctness, scientific evidence, or admission authority.

`ProducerBindingSchemaRegistrationV1`, domain `org.frankensim.fs-govern.producer-binding-schema-registration.v1`, has exactly these seven ordered fields:

1. `producer_binding_schema_id: ProducerBindingSchemaIdV1`
2. `canonical_domain: CanonicalDomainV1`
3. `digest_association: ProducerBindingDigestAssociationV1`
4. `verifier_capability_root: CapabilityRootV1`
5. `verifier_policy_root: ProducerBindingVerifierPolicyRootV1`
6. `verifier_source_closure_root: SourceClosureRoot`
7. `no_claim_scope_root: NoClaimScopeRootV1`

`ProducerBindingDigestAssociationV1` is exact and nominal: it records the registered source-root role, BLAKE3-256 algorithm code, 32-byte digest length, and generic ProducerBinding target role, and permits only byte-for-byte digest preservation. `ProducerBindingSchemaRegistrationRootV1` is computed over the complete frame. `ProducerBindingSchemaRegistryV1` is a canonical sorted exact map keyed by schema ID with unique schema ID/domain/owner tuple; duplicate, missing, ambiguous, stale, unknown, role-erasing, rehashing, wrong-algorithm, wrong-length, or authority-bearing registrations refuse. Registry and registration roots are policy inputs, never admission receipts or producer truth.

A registered producer verifier is reached only through the capability and policy roots in its registration. It returns a bounded descriptive `ProducerBindingVerificationV1` carrying registration root, presented source digest, expected and observed generic digest, verdict code, diagnostic root, verifier source closure, and no-claim scope. It cannot construct CandidateRef, request, decision, receipt, Evidence, or Certified. Downstream producers own and test their concrete full-frame decode, cross-field checks, and registration conformance; rjoq merely verifies the generic registration result and exact nominal association.

`ProducerManifestRootV1` and `CandidateBytesRootV1` retain analogous named checked associations. The former accepts only a registered producer-manifest schema/domain role and preserves the exact manifest digest bytes; the latter accepts only the independently verified digest of exact expanded candidate payload bytes. Neither constructor accepts stored-object, encoded-frame, source, arbitrary-digest, or generic-conversion inputs, and neither rehashes an existing digest.

## Resolver

`CandidateResolverV1` is a separately supplied affine, read-only, capability-scoped handle. Paths, descriptors, object-store handles, credentials, process identity, attempt numbers, and transport locators are nonsemantic and nonserializable. `CandidateResolverPolicyV1`, domain `org.frankensim.fs-govern.candidate-resolver-policy.v1`, binds an exact `ResolverKindV1` (`bundle-relative-v1` or `content-store-v1`), allowed root class and namespace, read-only scope, byte/object caps, freshness/lifetime rule, and capability root.

## Exact request and root

`AdmissionRequestV1`, domain `org.frankensim.fs-govern.admission-request.v1`, has exactly these ordered fields and no duplicated candidate subfields:

1. `candidate_ref: AdmissionCandidateRefV1`
2. `resolver_policy_root: CandidateResolverPolicyRootV1`
3. `checker_root: CheckerRootV1`
4. `capability_root: CapabilityRootV1`
5. `producer_binding_root: ProducerBindingRootV1`
6. `admission_budgets_root: AdmissionBudgetsRootV1`
7. `no_claim_scope_root: NoClaimScopeRootV1`
8. `caller_idempotency_key: CallerIdempotencyKeyV1`

`AdmissionRequestRootV1` is BLAKE3-256 over the complete canonical domain/version/field-tag/length/value frame. `AdmissionCandidateRefV1` occurs exactly once; its fields are neither flattened nor repeated. Every semantic change to candidate, resolver policy, checker, capability, producer binding, budgets, no-claim scope, or caller key changes the root. Resolver handles, transport, attempt data, and verifier execution observations are nonsemantic. The request root is the complete idempotency identity; no shorter tuple is authoritative. Reusing one caller key with a different request root is a conflict, while concurrent/retried use of one request root addresses one durable outcome.

## Receipt-free verdict and decision basis

`PolicyVerdictV1` is receipt-free and exactly one of `Eligible { admitted_authority_scope_root }`, `Refused { reason }`, `NoData { reason_code }`, `Stale { reason_code }`, `EnvironmentInvalid { reason_code }`, `Blocked { reason_code }`, or `Unsupported { reason_code }`. It cannot contain an admission receipt or final decision root.

`AdmissionDecisionBasisV1`, domain `org.frankensim.fs-govern.admission-decision-basis.v1`, has exactly these ordered fields: `admission_request_root`, `validation_transcript_root`, `policy_verdict`, `rjoq_interface_schema_root`, and `rjoq_source_closure_root`. `AdmissionDecisionBasisRootV1` covers the complete frame. The basis is immutable, receipt-free, and records complete pre-receipt adjudication; Eligible alone is not Admitted and grants no authority.

`AdmissionDecisionV1` is exactly `Admitted { opaque_receipt: AdmissionReceiptV1 }`, `Refused { basis }`, `NoData { basis }`, `Stale { basis }`, `EnvironmentInvalid { basis }`, `Blocked { basis }`, or `Unsupported { basis }`. Every non-Admitted outer variant must match its receipt-free verdict and contains no receipt. Only Admitted may carry exactly one receipt.

## Literal Refused reasons and u128-safe budget payload

`AdmissionRefusedReasonV1` uses these stable numeric codes, names, ordered fields, and sole primary stages:

1. `InvalidEvidence { validation_stage, evidence_role_code_u16, diagnostic_root }`
2. `ResolverScopeMismatch { expected_resolver_policy_root, observed_capability_root }`
3. `CandidateReadBudgetExceeded { resolver_policy_root, limit_bytes_u64, observed_bytes_u64 }`
4. `CandidateBytesMismatch { expected_candidate_bytes_root, observed_candidate_bytes_root }`
5. `CandidateCanonicalFormInvalid { candidate_schema_id, canonicalization_diagnostic_root }`
6. `CandidateIdentityMismatch { candidate_ref_root, identity_observation_root }`
7. `ProducerBindingMismatch { expected_producer_binding_root, observed_producer_binding_root }`
8. `PolicyIneligible { policy_fingerprint, policy_rule_root }`
9. `CheckerRejected { checker_root, checker_diagnostic_root }`
10. `CapabilityInsufficient { required_capability_root, observed_capability_root }`
11. `StatementUnsatisfied { statement_root, domain_root, assumptions_root, checker_result_root }`
12. `AdmissionBudgetExceeded { admission_budgets_root, budget_dimension_code_u16, unit_code_u16, limit_u128, observed_u128 }`
13. `AuthorityScopeViolation { claim_scope_root, no_claim_scope_root, requested_authority_scope_root }`
14. `IdempotencyConflict { caller_idempotency_key, committed_request_root, attempted_request_root }`
15. `MigrationNotMonotone { source_schema_id, target_schema_id, migration_observation_root }`

The exact V1 payload uses canonical unsigned `u128` for both limit and observation so a registered logical-work budget is never truncated or excluded. Ordinary `u64` byte/object/time budgets widen losslessly before comparison and encoding. `budget_dimension_code_u16` and `unit_code_u16` remain mandatory, registered, mutually consistent semantic discriminants; width, dimension, and unit are never inferred from magnitude. A legacy `u64` field tag/frame, narrowing cast, saturation, wrapping, dimension/unit substitution, or value above the registered dimension range refuses. No variant contains a path, credential, PID, wall-clock value, raw bulk payload, or unbounded message.

## Validation stages and precedence

`AdmissionValidationStageV1` has this exact numeric order: (1) ResolverCapabilityAndPolicy; (2) CandidateReadAndCaps; (3) CandidateBytesRoot; (4) CandidateCanonicalSchema; (5) CandidateIdentity; (6) ProducerBinding; (7) PolicyEligibility; (8) CheckerAndCapability; (9) StatementDomainAssumptions; (10) AdmissionBudgets; (11) NoClaimAndAuthorityScope; (12) IdempotencyReservation; (13) DecisionBasisPersistence; (14) ReceiptAndFinalDecisionCommit; (15) DurableRecoveryOrMigration.

Missing bytes map to NoData; freshness failures to Stale; host/storage/transport failures to EnvironmentInvalid; revocation or policy block to Blocked; unsupported resolver kind, schema, checker, or migration to Unsupported. Semantic disagreement at a supported stage maps to the exact stage-specific Refused reason. `InvalidEvidence` is permitted only at stages 5, 6, 8, or 9 when a registered semantic object cannot be decoded enough for a more specific reason. Multiple faults select the earliest stage independent of map iteration, task schedule, or storage discovery; bounded secondary diagnostics sort by `(stage_code, reason_code, diagnostic_root)` and never alter the primary decision. Stage 13/14 storage faults are EnvironmentInvalid or non-final InFlight, never Refused.

## Generic budgets

`AdmissionBudgetsRootV1` is an authority-owned nominal root over a registered producer-neutral budget document. The budget registration supplies an exact schema/domain, canonical dimension and unit registry, verifier capability/policy/source roots, range rules, and no-claim scope. All fields of the registered budget document participate in the root; no field may be omitted, defaulted, collapsed, inferred from another field, or replaced by an observation. Dimensions may use their registered natural unsigned width through `u128`, including logical-work limits. Every comparison uses checked `u128` widening/arithmetic and produces the exact code-12 payload above.

## Receipt, cycle-free commit, and recovery

`AdmissionReceiptV1`, domain `org.frankensim.fs-govern.admission-receipt.v1`, has private fields and one rjoq-only constructor. Its exact ordered semantic fields and types are: `AdmissionRequestRootV1`, `AdmissionCandidateRefRootV1`, `CandidateResolverPolicyRootV1`, `CheckerRootV1`, `CapabilityRootV1`, `ProducerBindingRootV1`, `AdmissionBudgetsRootV1`, `NoClaimScopeRootV1`, `CallerIdempotencyKeyV1`, `AdmissionValidationTranscriptRootV1`, `AdmissionDecisionBasisRootV1`, `AdmittedAuthorityScopeRootV1`, `SourceClosureRoot`, and `AdmissionCommitBasisRootV1`. `AdmissionReceiptRootV1` covers the full canonical frame. Every repeated audit field equals the referenced request/basis field, and the receipt contains no final-decision or committed-record root.

`AdmissionCommitBasisV1`, domain `org.frankensim.fs-govern.admission-commit-basis.v1`, is pre-receipt and has exact ordered fields `admission_request_root`, `admission_decision_basis_root`, `idempotency_reservation_root`, `durability_protocol_id`, and `durability_generation_root`. It contains no receipt, final decision, or committed-record root.

After receipt and final-decision construction, rjoq atomically publishes `CommittedAdmissionRecordV1`, domain `org.frankensim.fs-govern.committed-admission-record.v1`, with exact ordered fields `admission_request_root`, `admission_decision_basis_root`, `admission_commit_basis_root`, and `final_admission_decision`. It carries no second receipt. Private staging is not query-visible. A crash exposes only Absent, InFlight with no final outcome, or one complete Committed outcome—never a receipt without its decision, two decisions, or two receipts.

Precommit submission/recovery validates a current resolver capability and recomputes bytes. After commit, `query_by_request_root` and `recover_by_request_root` return the exact stored basis/decision/receipt without reacquiring a resolver. Lost-return recovery uses only `AdmissionRequestRootV1`. Explicit registered migration preserves retained originals, is content-bound and authority-monotone, records a distinct migration observation, and produces a new request root.

## Rjoq-local fixture only

`rjoq.local-fixture.exact-bytes-root.v1` is retained entirely inside the rjoq conformance surface. Its `ClaimStatementV1` asserts the BLAKE3-256 root of one fixed byte string over a singleton nonempty domain with empty assumptions, the real `exact-bytes-root-checker-v1`, explicit generic budgets, and fixture-only no-scientific-claim scope.

`RjoqLocalExactBytesProducerBindingV1`, domain `org.frankensim.fs-govern.fixture.exact-bytes-producer-binding.v1`, has exactly six ordered fields: `fixture_id`, `candidate_bytes_root`, `producer_manifest_root`, `fixture_source_closure_root`, `claim_scope_root`, and `no_claim_scope_root`. Its registration uses the generic seven-field contract and exact digest-preserving association. The local producer manifest uses a fixture-only registered manifest schema. These types exist solely for rjoq interface E2E; they import no Runner crate/type/domain/root, publication object, catalog, inventory, destination resource, or phase ownership registry/manifest. The conformance implementation records expected basis/decision/receipt shape but mints no production authority.

## Logging and no-claim boundary

Canonical logs retain request root and semantic component roots; producer-binding schema/registration/registry/verification roots; candidate/manifest exact-association roots; validation stage/reason; basis/verdict/decision/receipt/commit roots; complete typed budgets with explicit dimension/unit and full-width limit/observation; retry/query/recovery state; expected/observed/effects; first cause/drain; no-claim/authority scope; source/build closures; repairs; relative retained artifacts; and a safe reproduction template. Logs exclude credentials, absolute paths, locators, descriptors/slots and payloads, PIDs, wall-clock values, raw bulk bytes, and unregistered producer-specific internals.

This leaf owns only generic admission schemas and generic producer-binding registration/association. Concrete producer schema ownership, concrete full-frame validation, phase manifests, publication protocols, and producer-specific E2E live downstream and can depend on this contract; no dependency or schema reference points back from rjoq to a future producer or phase.
## Stable-token width

Generic registry schema IDs, canonical domains, dimension/unit IDs, and other StableTokenV2 values use the authority-owned 128-byte cap over the frozen lowercase-ASCII grammar. rjoq owns the generic parsing rule but no concrete downstream tuple. Length is the ASCII token's UTF-8 byte count. Every non-ASCII/multibyte, normalization-dependent, confusable, invalid-UTF-8, truncated, or 129-byte spelling rejects; no normalization or shortening is attempted and the obsolete 64-byte ceiling is not a policy limit.

title: Phase 0B-C: authenticated support and threat graphs with anytime consequence-times-doubt allocation
description:
MISSION: Turn evidence planning into an authenticated graph problem that spends scarce falsification and checking effort where failure would matter most, without Goodharting on favorable evidence.

SCOPE: Maintain content-addressed typed support and attack graphs over exact claim instances, assumptions, artifacts, checkers, falsifiers, consumers, and authority states. Reject cycles where policy requires a DAG and represent legitimate mutual constraints without circular support. Compute consequence from reachable downstream authority and doubt from calibrated uncertainty, attack coverage, independence, and unresolved assumptions. Build an anytime allocator using consequence times doubt plus explicit diversity, holdout, independence, and exploration floors; use e-process or other anytime-valid accounting under optional stopping. Integrate the per-proof-lane one-bet rule and global portfolio caps. Every allocation decision retains the graph snapshot, utility model, priors, correlations, alternative sensitivity, budget, and no-action option. New cohomological or tropical summaries of obstruction/support structure are encouraged behind versioned theorem receipts.

ACCEPTANCE AND TESTS: G0 graph identity, support monotonicity, attack propagation, cycle/circularity refusal, budget conservation, deterministic ties, and anytime validity. G2 seeded high-consequence weak claims receive priority without starving blind falsification. G3 graph relabeling, duplicated correlated evidence, support decomposition, utility/prior perturbation, and lane split/merge gaming. G4 concurrent graph mutation, cancellation, storage faults, optional-stopping adversaries, and allocator restart preserve budgets and publish no partial decision. G5 deterministic replay. title: Phase 0B-D: counterexample adjudication, revocation, and transitive support recomputation
description:
ROOT CAUSE: A candidate counterexample is not automatically a refutation, and an adjudicated refutation is useless if descendant authority remains cached. Build the transactional truth-maintenance path.

SCOPE: Admit counterexample candidates only with exact target statement/quantifiers/domain/assumptions, witness identity, numerical/formal authority, provenance, and reproduction requirements. Use a six-way candidate taxonomy: ConfirmedCounterexample, SatisfiableWitness, AssumptionViolation, NumericalArtifact, CheckerArtifact, and ClassificationPending. Universal refutation requires an in-domain satisfiable witness and independent adjudication; existential claims are not refuted by failed search. Adjudication emits immutable evidence, may strengthen or repair a theorem, and never deletes failed conjectures. Confirmed invalidation atomically revokes affected proof/support edges, recomputes transitive downstream authority, tombstones stale runtime receipts, and preserves unaffected evidence. Races, retries, contradictory adjudications, partial graph failure, and later theorem repair have explicit versioned semantics.

ACCEPTANCE AND TESTS: G0 taxonomy/existential-universal laws, exact target binding, idempotent state transitions, minimal affected-set recomputation, and no unrelated demotion. G2 analytic true/false conjectures and numerical artifacts. G3 equivalent witness representation, assumption strengthening/weakening, theorem repair, and support-graph refactoring. G4 concurrent candidate races, cancellation at every adjudicate/revoke/recompute/publish boundary, storage/checker faults, and crash recovery are atomic. G5 deterministic replay. Mutation tests kill domain, satisfiability, independence, revocation, and descendant-recompute guards. A real ledger workflow shows a runtime-admitted descendant becoming unavailable immediately after confirmed refutation. Logs retain target/candidate/witness/assumption IDs, taxonomy transition, reviewer/checker authority, affected edges/receipts, transaction identity, cancellation, and no-claim.

title: Phase 0B-F: real no-mock red-team, cancellation, revocation, and replay gate
description:
PURPOSE: This is the non-negotiable executable exit gate for Phase 0B. Exercise the production implementations and real persistence/package/checker paths; mocks, handwritten pass reports, and producer-self-verification do not satisfy it.

PIPELINE: Author a true claim, a false universal claim, a vacuous/unsatisfiable candidate, and a conditional claim with unresolved assumptions. Freeze their contracts, canonicalize and admit exact instances, build support/threat graphs, allocate falsification effort anytime-validly, run real falsifiers/checkers, adjudicate all six counterexample outcomes, persist ledger state, package and independently check it, admit only eligible runtime consumers, then inject a later confirmed counterexample and prove transitive revocation plus deterministic replay. Include the per-lane one-bet rule, global portfolio caps, holdouts, correlated evidence, source/policy rotation, historical schema, and no-action decisions.

GAUNTLET: G0 asserts every state transition and authority conjunction. G2 uses analytic fixtures with independently known outcomes. G3 mutates units, quantifiers, assumptions, ordering, representation, graph factoring, and utility/priors. G4 cancels and fault-injects every author/admit/allocate/run/adjudicate/revoke/package/check/publish boundary; tests crash recovery, concurrent races, allocation failure, corrupt storage/artifacts, checker disagreement, and no leaks or partial authority. G5 replays bytes, decisions, graph roots, and logs across thread counts and both reference ISAs. Mutation tests must fail when any admission, nonvacuity, independence, holdout, taxonomy, revocation, checker, reproduction, or runtime gate is removed. Structured logs are bounded and sufficient for future-self diagnosis without consulting plan prose: all semantic/content IDs, units, assumptions, domains, seeds, versions, budgets/consumption, capabilities, graph roots, state transitions, cancellation drain/finalize, checker/adjudicator identities, invalidated descendants, and artifact paths.

title: New-domains shared E2E runner, manifest schema, and retained-log contract
description:
PURPOSE: Own the shared execution protocol for E0a through E8 without absorbing or weakening any phase's scientific acceptance criteria. ## Acceptance Criteria

title: fs-feec: WeightedStar/WeightedMass operators plus formulation proof lanes
description:
BACKGROUND: FEEC splits every PDE into exact topology (incidence, dd=0, machine-checkable today) and metric content (Hodge stars). Bulk material properties — heat capacity rho*c, conductivity k, permittivity eps, reluctivity nu, density — are weights on mass/Hodge operators. This is THE highest-EV lever (62.5): one assembler unlocks heat, electrostatics, current flow, magnetics, and Darcy. But the honest version of the claim matters: weighting cannot break dd=0 (the star never touches d), yet dd=0 alone proves NEITHER stability NOR absence of spurious modes.

SCOPE (fs-feec upgrade): (1) WeightedStar/WeightedMass assembling scalar, SPD-tensor, and nonlinear (e.g., nu(|B|^2) per Newton iterate) bulk weights over existing Whitney/Nedelec/RT spaces AND the new TriComplex2; piecewise-constant-per-cell weights first [S], quadrature-point anisotropic/frequency/history-dependent maps behind [F] flags; (2) explicit primal/dual/twisted-form and trace orientation contracts; (3) typed block operators carrying reversible skew and cross-coupling (Hall, gyroscopic, piezo/thermoelectric later) WITHOUT pretending each block is SPD; (4) the formulation proof-lane scaffolding every consumer must fill: subcomplex + bounded commuting projection, boundary/gauge treatment, coercivity or inf-sup, discrete compactness/eigenmode behavior where applicable, material positivity/monotonicity, quadrature consistency, and QoI convergence.

DOCTRINE BOUNDARY (D2): interface laws, reactions, and history-dependent internal variables do NOT enter stars — they are typed constitutive-graph nodes (separate bead). No Hodge-star claim extends beyond the mathematics it proves.

Each subsystem implementation (lumped, 1-D, 2-D, ROM, 3-D field, empirical correlation) becomes an OBJECT with typed ports, validity domain, cost/error model, state projection/lifting maps, and falsifiers — so fidelity selection is planning under budgets, not vibes.

title: FLAGSHIP fs-coldplate-e2e: conjugate cold plate, spec to supplier STEP
description:
BACKGROUND: The earliest commercially meaningful whole-workflow demonstrator — a liquid-cooled inverter cold plate (metal block with internal coolant channels keeping SiC power modules under temperature limits while minimizing pressure drop and mass). Chosen deliberately: laminar channel-scale flow (no turbulence-closure or chaotic-adjoint cliffs — the physics is in the industrialized half), genuinely coupled multiphysics (flow + heat), a real commercial reference point (single-purpose cloud services sell exactly this), and it needs NO contact/multibody/EM — so it can close as soon as its thermal/fluid/adjoint dependencies exist, ahead of the harder machine flagships. It is ALSO the thermal-management story for the motor/genset inverters, so it feeds the drive-stack narrative. Suite/module ID inside fs-flagship-e2e; campaign pattern + fs-wasm companion.

REFERENCE PROBLEM (the pinned deck): envelope 250x180x15 mm; three mapped heat-source footprints (~350 W each); 50/50 glycol-water at 8 L/min, 65 C inlet; minimize junction temperature and pressure drop; keep mass down; min channel width 1.5 mm (brazing rule); no trapped volumes (must drain); export supplier-ready STEP.

WORKFLOW (each stage exercises a named capability): (1) envelope/ports/bosses as an F-rep program with exposed parameters; the coolant channel region is a LEVEL-SET DESIGN FIELD — topology (channel count, branching) is an OUTPUT of optimization, not an hour-one human guess; optionally import an existing plate via ext-cad-step-interchange as the initial condition; (2) CutFEM conjugate discretization directly on the SDF: laminar incompressible NS in the fluid (fs-flux ladder), conduction in the solid (fs-thermal), coupled at the implicit interface; NO meshing stage, no defeaturing; resolution allocated by the goal-oriented (DWR) error estimator toward the two QoIs; (3) BCs attach to GEOMETRIC PREDICATES (port region, module footprints) so they survive topology changes — the automation-breaker test is explicit; (4) adjoint of the objective w.r.t. the ENTIRE design field (one extra solve), Sobolev-smoothed descent, topological derivatives for channel nucleation/merging (fs-topols/fs-xform level-set machinery + fs-adjoint); (5) CONSTRAINTS AS CODE: min channel width via the medial-axis/thickness oracle differentiably (fs-query thickness machinery); drainability/no-trapped-volume as a persistent-homology audit gate — zero enclosed voids via the existing cubical Betti b2 check (fs-topo); brazeability rules as a typed supplier-constraint card; (6) ROBUSTNESS + HONEST ERROR: declared budget up front (e.g., junction temperature to +/-2 K at 95% confidence within a wall-clock budget); coolant viscosity varies with temperature/glycol ratio (matdb cards — the water-glycol coolant is in the seed dataset), so the objective is CVaR over that band; anytime-valid confidence sequences stop sampling the moment candidates are separable; dominated candidates cancelled mid-solve; the error ledger ITEMIZES discretization vs material-property vs sampling contributions — replacing the safety factor with an itemized bill; (7) EXPORT: winning level-set re-fit to B-rep with measured deviation bound, STEP out (ext-cad-step-interchange) — the thing the supplier brazes is the thing that was optimized; (8) LEDGER LIFECYCLE: fork the study when the coolant spec changes; diff the two Pareto fronts geometrically.

DELIVERABLES: Pareto atlas (T_junction, pressure drop, mass) with per-elite evidence colors; constraint receipts (width/drainability/brazeability) per elite; itemized error budget; supplier STEP package with manufacturability receipts; the fork/diff demonstration; a CompetitiveCapabilityLedger deck row (this is a natural named-competitor comparison).

WHAT BREAKS FIRST: level-set/CutFEM conditioning on thin channels -> ghost-penalty + aggregation machinery (exists in fs-cutfem); adjoint accuracy through the conjugate interface -> gradient-verification gates (D8) with FD falsifiers; re-fit deviation eating the optimization gain -> the deviation bound is part of the objective audit, visible not hidden.

title: fs-gas: conservative 0-D control volumes with typed uncertainty budget
description:
BACKGROUND: Industry-standard engine engineering is 0-D/1-D. The conservative filling-and-emptying cylinder model is the first useful ICE rung — and the place where honest energy accounting is won or lost. New L3 crate fs-gas (deps: fs-thermochem, fs-material, fs-time, fs-ivl, fs-solver + fs-couple stream protocols; wall heat arrives through PORTS, never a crate edge to fs-thermal; fs-gas never depends on fs-flux).

SCOPE: (1) conservative state: total mass AND species; a no-momentum lumped volume may evolve total internal energy; if momentum is evolved, the state uses total energy incl. kinetic + declared potential convention; explicit reference/formation convention; THE DOUBLE-COUNT GUARD: the energy derivation chooses EITHER total chemical energy OR sensible energy + explicit reaction source — never both; (2) closures: intake/exhaust flows, residual gas/EGR, crevice volumes, blow-by, valve lift/discharge coefficients, wall heat (Woschni/Annand as Validated-per-dataset cards), fuel evaporation, combustion phasing (Wiebe card — Estimated until an independent named dataset validates it; calibration data never reused as validation), friction, leakage — the balance CLOSES; (3) certified compressible orifice/valve flow: isentropic nozzle with discharge coefficient, choked/unchoked branch as a CERTIFIED EVENT; V(theta) supplied as an input volume trajectory by the composing layer (slider-crank or Wankel closed forms from the kinematics kit — a data input, not a crate dependency); (4) stiff integration via IMEX/adaptive lanes; (5) INTERVAL p-V LANE [F]: propagate parameter intervals through a cycle for certified p-V/indicated-work envelope bounds — numerical enclosure, parametric uncertainty, and model-form discrepancy reported as SEPARATE typed components, combined only under a declared probability or worst-case semantics (never implying a correlation became verified).

TESTS (detailed logging): air-standard Otto/Diesel/Atkinson closed-form oracles in the adiabatic limit (efficiency = 1 - r^(1-gamma) for Otto — a brutal G1 gate); choked-flow transition events certified; energy-balance closure ledger per cycle (every term logged); double-count adversarial fixture refused; motored-engine p-V loop vs pinned G2 trace; uncertainty-budget component separation asserted in the receipt schema.

PARALLELISM NOTE (review pass): this bead deliberately does NOT block on the fs-motion V(theta) machinery — the gas stack depends only on E0 foundations (per the phase parallelism doctrine), and development/testing uses inline analytic volume trajectories (slider-crank closed form) as fixtures. The certified V(theta) integration (ext-motion-clearance-volume, related edge) is consumed by the FLAGSHIPS, which do depend on both sides.

## Acceptance Criteria

title: fs-ir: versioned L6 machine-graph IR with stable identity and lineage
description:
BACKGROUND: A machine is a declarative graph of subsystems, typed relations, interfaces, clocks, controllers, and accounting policy — and that graph must be DATA with stable identity, because windings, contacts, constraints, and adjoints all attach to named features that survive remeshing and wear. Array indices are not identity.

SCOPE (fs-ir upgrade, E0): (1) stable semantic IDs: BodyId, SurfacePatchId, ContactFeatureId, TerminalId, PortId, StateSlotId; (2) subsystem/model relations, typed terminals/clocks, materials/interfaces bindings; (3) IC/BC, motion/event/reset semantics, tolerance/correlation declarations; (4) sensors/experiments, hazards/faults (HazardId for the E7 safety case), ContextOfUse/QoIs/acceptance, accounting and fidelity/escalation policy; (5) one-way lowering into versioned scenario/domain artifacts preserving canonical identity via explicit crosswalks — fs-ir lowers INTO fs-scenario, never the reverse; (6) LINEAGE MORPHISMS: split/merge/remesh/wear/fracture events emit lineage records; ambiguous lineage returns a TYPED REFUSAL and invalidates dependent caches/contacts/windings/adjoints instead of silently rebinding them. Joints, terminals, controllers, and resets are machine-graph relations — NOT fake boundary-condition kinds.

WHY E0: the E0d vertical slice must run against this IR, and every later domain artifact references these IDs; changing ID semantics after E4 would orphan winding/contact/adjoint attachments program-wide.

TESTS (unit + round-trip, detailed logging): FrankenScript -> machine graph -> scenario/domain artifacts -> package/replay preserves stable IDs and semantic hashes; admission rejects dimension/orientation/causality gaps, algebraic loops without a solve policy, missing source closure, unaccounted state — each rejection logged with the offending element ID and rule; lineage-ambiguity fixtures refuse and enumerate invalidated dependents.

STAGING / PR PLAN: PR-1 stable-ID types + lineage morphisms + ambiguity refusal (the identity kernel everything else references); PR-2 graph schema (subsystems/relations/terminals/clocks/materials/interfaces) + admission checks; PR-3 IC/BC/motion/event/reset + tolerance/correlation semantics; PR-4 sensors/hazards/ContextOfUse/accounting/fidelity policy; PR-5 one-way scenario lowering + stable-ID/hash round-trip battery. Each PR lands with its unit tests and structured admission-decision logging.
ENTRY POINTS: crates/fs-ir/src/ (FrankenScript typed AST, s-expr/JSON syntaxes, lowering — extend, do not fork); crates/fs-scenario/src/scenario.rs + frame.rs (the lowering targets); fs-ledger schema rows for lineage receipts.

title: fs-matdb: L1 immutable cross-physics materials data layer
description:
BACKGROUND: 'Real material properties' means a NAMED CONDITION with uncertainty, not a marketing-grade label. Every downstream physics claim automatically inherits its weakest LOAD-BEARING material datum through the evidence system — and that only works if material data is typed, immutable, provenance-complete, and queried through receipts. New L1 crate fs-matdb (deps: fs-qty, fs-evidence, fs-blake3 only).

SCHEMA (all immutable): ObservationDataset {specimen/process record, method/instrument, observation artifact ref, covariance/censoring, provenance}; PropertyClaim {key, value (scalar/curve/tensor/distribution/model params), fs_evidence::ValidityDomain over typed axes (T, p, frequency, field, strain/rate, composition, history, named dimensionless groups), uncertainty model, joint-uncertainty correlation refs, interpolation policy, evidence descriptor, observation refs, provenance with license + ContentHash}; ConstitutiveModelCard {LawId, LawVersion, canonical parameter block, StateSchemaVersion, InitialStatePolicy, validity, source hashes}; MaterialCard {MaterialStateId = chemistry+phase+temper/process+revision, schema version, supersedes links, claims map, constitutive models, by-key index, content hash}; InterfaceSystemCard {surface_a, surface_b, intervening medium, lubricant/third body, environment, texture frame (opaque L1 ID), claims, models} — friction/wetting/conductance are SYSTEM+HISTORY properties, never unordered pair constants; wetting is a solid-liquid-gas system.

QUERY DISCIPLINE: every query returns Evidence<PropertySample> + PropertyUsageReceipt {query point, selected claims, selection/fusion policy, correlation slices, evaluator/law version, frame transform receipt, interpolation-or-EXTRAPOLATION decision, source hashes}. Conflicting observations stay separate PropertyClaims — fusion is explicit policy; NO map overwrite invents a canonical value. Only load-bearing receipts enter a claim dependency closure (irrelevant weak data cannot demote; relevant weak data cannot be laundered). A citation alone does not make a value Validated — specimen/process match and uncertainty context required.

OWNERSHIP: owns NO executable closures and NO per-run state (those are L3 fs-material/domain adapters); never imports L2 transforms, L3 state types, or L6 persistence.

title: Offline material/species/kinetics pack compiler (L6/xtask)
description:
BACKGROUND: Source parsing, license admission, unit/basis normalization, covariance preservation, and canonical hashing for material/species/kinetics packs must NOT live in L1 (it would drag parsers and policy into the runtime data layer). title: Curated seed material dataset with citations and process states
description:
BACKGROUND: Flagships must run on real numbers with honest provenance, and may REFUSE when a needed process state or interface system is missing. The seed set covers every flagship in the program.

MATERIALS TO SEED (each: named condition, redistributable/licensed source, uncertainty, validity domains; conflicts preserved as separate claims): structural steels 4140 + AISI 1045; aluminum 6061-T6; gray cast iron AND representative aluminum/wear-resistant-coating systems for explicitly named engine and Wankel configurations (never treated as universal — real Wankel housings are coated aluminum, rotors cast iron); OFHC copper; a pinned bearing steel; a NAMED carburized gear-steel + process; winding enamel, slot liner, impregnation epoxy (insulation stack for motor thermal/dielectric work); a named bearing grease; water-glycol coolant; application-specific gear and bearing oils; electrical steel M-19 (BH curve + Steinmetz coefficients + thickness/anneal/test method PINNED — grade name alone is not identity); NdFeB N42 and ferrite Y30 magnets (supplier/process/temperature state pinned; remanence/coercivity/energy product + temperature-dependent demagnetization/recoil limits); PTFE, PEEK, nitrile (seals); air; iso-octane reference fuel then a VERSIONED multicomponent gasoline surrogate; methane; exhaust-gas mixture; a fully identified redistributable 5W-30 reference formulation (viscosity grade alone is not a material identity).

title: fs-mbd: rigid multibody core with three validated integrator lanes
description:
BACKGROUND: Blocker B2 — no multibody dynamics at all. New L3 crate fs-mbd (deps: fs-kinematics, fs-contact, fs-ga, fs-time, fs-solver, fs-spectral, fs-query, fs-matdb; NO hard edge to fs-solid/fs-machine — flexible substructures arrive later as abstract operators composed one-way from above).

STATE: bodies carry normalized PGA motors (double-cover M ~ -M with deterministic convention) + twists in se(3); 6x6 spatial inertia = fs-query GeometricMoments x fs-matdb uniform density receipt (spatially varying density later via neutral weighted integration — geometry never knows materials). Certified mass/COM/inertia with interval bounds are deliverables in their own right. Constraints: holonomic Phi(M)=0 (joints, gear ratios, cam profiles as driven constraints), Pfaffian A(M)xi=0 nonholonomic (ideal rolling/no-slip — never integrated into fictitious position constraints without a Frobenius proof), unilateral delegated to fs-contact.

THREE LANES (all resumable + deterministic): (1) structure-preserving [F]: Lie-group variational + RATTLE-style discrete null-space/projection, with the honest conditional claim scope from the SE(3) lanes bead; (2) engineering [S]: Lie-group generalized-alpha (Bruls-Cardona-Arnold) on index-3 DAE with GGL/stabilized-index-2 option and controllable dissipation — the industrial workhorse for stiff contact-rich problems; (3) nonholonomic [F]: discrete Lagrange-dAlembert enforcing A(q)xi=0 WITHOUT claiming ordinary Hamilton/RATTLE/canonical symplecticity; ideal reaction zero-work receipt paired with a friction-cone feasibility test; exhausting traction triggers a LEDGERED no-slip -> creep/slip/contact transition, never projection onto an infeasible distribution.

RECEIPT DISCIPLINE (load-bearing distinctions): interval evaluation of ||Phi(q_h)|| is a ConstraintResidualReceipt, NOT a bound on distance to the true constraint manifold — ConstraintStateEnclosure additionally requires a validated nonlinear solve/Krawczyk enclosure or certified regularity + inverse-Jacobian bound. Every projection emits ProjectionReceipt {dq, dxi, constraint_impulse, dE, dp, dL, symmetry_defect, adjoint_defect}; only a work/symmetry-compatible projection retains strong invariant claims — otherwise retry/reject or debit the defect into adjoints. Solvers: Newton-Krylov on the saddle system per implicit step; joint-space fast path for open chains; absolute coordinates + multipliers for loops.

TESTS: see ext-e2-test-battery for the full deck (pendulum elliptic-integral period, manufactured-forced trajectory, torque-free top, slider-crank, IFToMM, rolling disk, Chaplygin sleigh); unit tests here cover lane-level receipts, projection accounting, and inertia assembly vs closed forms, all with per-step structured logs (energy/momentum/constraint series).

ARTIFACT NAMES (canonical, for cross-bead reference): ConstraintResidualReceipt, ConstraintStateEnclosure, ProjectionReceipt {dq, dxi, constraint_impulse, dE, dp, dL, symmetry_defect, adjoint_defect}, RollingConstraintReceipt (ideal reaction zero-work + friction-cone feasibility + transition ledger entries), NonholonomicDistributionReport (from fs-kinematics), and the per-lane balance/defect series consumed by flagships.

STAGING / PR PLAN: PR-1 crate skeleton + body/state types (motor + twist, double-cover convention) + inertia assembly from GeometricMoments x density receipts (independently valuable: certified mass properties); PR-2 engineering lane (Lie-group generalized-alpha, index-3 GGL) + ConstraintResidualReceipt + joint-space fast path; PR-3 variational lane + projection receipts + conditional-claim honesty fixtures; PR-4 nonholonomic lane + rolling receipts + transition ledger; PR-5 ConstraintStateEnclosure (validated Krawczyk lane). Each lane lands with its slice of the E2 battery.
ENTRY POINTS: crates/fs-ga/src/pga.rs:273-457 (Motor, exp/log, renormalize — the state algebra); crates/fs-time/src/lie.rs:24-84 (SO(3) precedent + rigid_body_step), galpha.rs:23-135 (the dense generalized-alpha to generalize); crates/fs-solver/src/op.rs:10-21 (LinearOp for the KKT blocks).

## Acceptance Criteria

All existing description clauses remain normative. This leaf is the sole producer and adjudication-contribution owner for immutable case_id e2.mbd_core in tests/e2e/new_domains/e2.toml; the phase gate alone owns manifest membership and terminal promotion. Scope retained: Rigid multibody state, inertia, constraints and three integrator lanes retain SE3 conventions, balance and symmetry receipts, hard budgets, validated applicability and explicit no-claim outside smooth admitted regimes.. Closure requires focused unit tests for happy, empty, minimum, boundary n-1/n/n+1, maximum/max+1, malformed/error, unit and frame semantics, deterministic ties and enumeration; property and metamorphic tests for equivalent representations, permutation, scaling, refinement and replay invariants that actually apply; cancellation, panic/fault, allocation, work/memory/deadline/output exhaustion and request-drain-finalize with no partial authority wherever work is admitted; mutation tests removing every identity, unit, budget, evidence, checker, publication and no-claim guard; and a real release-built no-mock e2 case with hostile twin and independent reconstruction. Bounded redacted structured logs retain case/source/schema identities, units, seeds, capabilities, admitted and consumed budgets, expected and observed QoIs or dispositions, first divergence, cancellation/drain/finalization, checker, authority/no-claim, relative artifacts, stable exit class, and a copy-paste reproduction command. title: fs-motion: two-sided clearance over time and chamber-volume functions
description:
BACKGROUND: Backlash analysis, cam-follower interference, assembly feasibility, and every contact broad phase need certified clearance of MOVING bodies over a time span. Engine thermodynamics needs chamber volume V(theta) as a certified function of mechanism angle. Existing fs-query::separation gives a static positive-gap lower bound only.

CLEARANCE (two-sided is the point): separation_over(a: SpacetimeChart, b: SpacetimeChart, span) -> ClearanceRange {lower, upper, witness_time, errors}. A lower bound alone can prove a positive gap but does NOT enclose the minimum: branch-and-bound over time supplies the global LOWER bound; a feasible time/configuration WITNESS supplies the UPPER bound; if no admissible witness is available the receipt is explicitly one-sided. Chart-conversion, spatial-discretization, motion-tube, and optimization errors are ALL inflated into the range so the claim applies to abstract regions, not merely a converted mesh.

OVERLAP VS PENETRATION (definitional honesty): min over x of max(phi_A, phi_B) exposes a deepest-common-interior WITNESS/inradius for exact SDFs; it is NOT minimum translation distance nor SE(3) separating displacement. Those live in fs-query upgrades (GJK/EPA convex lane; decomposition/interval global optimization nonconvex; pose-space optimization with declared metric). Contact response uses local signed gaps and normals, never a mislabeled global overlap scalar.

CHAMBER VOLUMES: V(theta) for closed chambers formed between moving charts (Wankel three faces; cylinder above piston) via certified quadrature of the region bounded by named charts. Closed forms are G1 oracles ONLY for declared ideal nominal geometries/seal conventions; finite seals, clearances, port cutouts, deformation, as-built geometry all use certified quadrature/enclosures.

TESTS (unit, detailed logging): two-sided range on analytic fixtures (rotating cam vs follower) with witness verification; one-sided receipt honesty when witness search is disabled; V(theta) vs derived Wankel/slider-crank closed forms within enclosure; error-inflation accounting logged per contribution source.

title: fs-motion: CertifiedMotorTube, SpacetimeChart, and motion binding
description:
BACKGROUND: The deepest architectural gap (blocker B1): fs-ga has complete SE(3) motor algebra (screw exp/log, slerp, renormalization) and fs-scenario has rotating FrameTrees, but NOTHING binds a motor path to a chart — geometry is static per-evaluation. New L2 crate fs-motion (deps: fs-ga, fs-geom, fs-query, fs-ivl — NEVER fs-scenario; higher layers lower into it).

CORE DESIGN (subtle and load-bearing): a trajectory is NOT an unconstrained vector of Taylor polynomials — that would leave SE(3). CertifiedMotorTube stores Taylor models in a LOCAL LIE-ALGEBRA CHART plus a certified retraction (or component models with unit-motor/Study-constraint residual bounds); it fixes the motor double-cover sign deterministically; encloses normalization, composition, inversion, and point/AABB action; performs validated chart transitions BEFORE a logarithm cut; and is falsified against pointwise fs-ga::Motor evaluation. MotorPath is the point-evaluation view of a tube.

A MOVING OBJECT DOES NOT IMPLEMENT THE TIMELESS Chart CONTRACT: SpacetimeChart exposes snapshot(t) -> ChartAtTime and certified eval_over(x,[t0,t1]) -> Interval; immutable snapshots may implement Chart with time and path provenance frozen. Analytic constructors: constant-twist screws and the Wankel rotor POSE (eccentric-center orbit + rotor phasing — the epitrochoid is the derived APEX LOCUS, not the body motion). A builder trait lets higher layers (fs-scenario frame trees, fs-mbd trajectories) lower motions into paths — dependency direction stays downward.

title: fs-motion: swept-volume and envelope implicit enclosure charts
description:
BACKGROUND: Gear conjugate action IS envelope theory (the mating tooth profile is the envelope of the moving tooth in the other gear frame), and the Wankel bore/flank geometry is a family of trochoid/envelope constructions. Nothing in the tree computes swept volumes or envelopes (only minkowski_ball exists).

SWEPT VOLUME (honest formulation): for a sign-correct implicit field, inf over t of phi(M(t)^-1 x) represents the union inside/outside predicate — it is NOT generally a signed-distance function even for exact SDF inputs; distance accuracy must be stated separately by region and may fail at medial sets. SweptChart evaluates certified lower/upper implicit bounds by DETERMINISTIC branch-and-bound over t, returning Enclosure or Unknown, never silently advertising exact distance. Rep Router integration only through conversion edges preserving that enclosure class (swept -> mesh via dual contouring; swept -> voxel).

ENVELOPE (the hard honest part): interior candidates satisfy F(x,t)=0 AND dF/dt(x,t)=0, but tangency regularity, parameter-endpoint contributions, branch selection, visibility, self-intersection, and membership in the actual swept boundary must be PROVED, not assumed. Trace the characteristic set by parameterized slices or validated implicit-manifold continuation; classify rank singularities/endpoints/trimming/visibility BEFORE admitting a branch. envelope(chart, motor_path) -> EnvelopeChart with interval-certified containment (envelope inside enclosure band).

WANKEL DISCIPLINE (three distinct certified objects, never conflated): ideal apex-point epitrochoid; apex-seal CENTER/CONTACT locus for the declared finite seal-tip geometry; actual bore as envelope of the seal-circle family under the declared clearance model. Rotor flank is a SEPARATE conjugate-envelope design problem. The rotor is Reuleaux-LIKE, not an exact constant-width triangle; apex seals SLIDE (they do not roll). Analytic trochoid parameterization must be DERIVED and symbolically checked — no mnemonic formula promoted without derivation.

TESTS (unit + falsifier, detailed logging): derived epitrochoid + involute-rack-conjugate G1 oracles; PO-5 soundness — interval set inclusion + exhaustive subdivision is the PROOF, Monte Carlo/adversarial sampling only FALSIFIES (a sampled point outside a claimed enclosure is Sev-0); envelope branch-classification fixtures incl. tangency degeneracies returning Unknown; logging of subdivision counts and rejection reasons per branch.

title: Program risk register: 12 seed risks with owners, triggers, kill actions
description:
BACKGROUND: Distinct from runtime physics fallbacks, the PROGRAM risk register tracks risks to the expansion effort itself. The charter is explicit: E0 planning cannot close until every seed risk has a named owner, quantitative trigger, and kill/escalation action. Schema per row: RiskId | owner | likelihood | impact | leading indicator | trigger | mitigation | contingency | residual risk | review gate — persisted in the ledger, not prose.

THE 12 SEED RISKS: (1) flowpipe wrapping/certificate cost explosion (validated integration may be too expensive at machine scale); (2) contact candidate/certificate explosion; (3) coefficient/topology-robust EM preconditioning may not materialize (HX assumptions); (4) chemistry stiffness overwhelming the integrator lanes; (5) material-data licensing and experimental scarcity (redistributable cited data is genuinely hard); (6) hybrid-adjoint invalidity (event-dependent gradients may be unusable where needed most); (7) same-layer Cargo cycles emerging from the 15-crate atlas; (8) schema/hash migration errors during the six-base transition; (9) theorem-tool trusted-computing-base risk (proof kernel bugs); (10) single-node scale ceiling vs accelerator-policy mismatch (constitutional dependency policy may forbid the needed substrate); (11) interoperability adoption failure (FMI/SSP quarantine may deter users); (12) misuse of scientific receipts as safety/regulatory certificates (reputational/legal).

ACCEPTANCE: register artifact exists with all 12 rows complete; each trigger is QUANTITATIVE (a number, not vibes); review gates assigned to phase exits; the register is wired into session-end reporting so a tripped leading indicator surfaces automatically.

title: fs-qty: six-base dimension migration (mole) plus semantic quantity kinds
description:
BACKGROUND: fs-qty encodes Dims as [m,kg,s,K,A] (ampere/kelvin already base dims, so volts/teslas/henries are expressible today). But chemistry, equilibrium constants, molar NASA reference data, stoichiometric rates, electrochemistry, and Faraday coupling CANNOT be dimensionally honest if kg/mol is faked as an ordinary five-base quantity. Decision (normative delta, EV score 62.5 — tied for highest in program): add amount-of-substance NOW as an intentional source break, atomically, before any consumer exists. These prevent dimensionally legal 2*pi, pole-pair, sqrt(2), Celsius-offset, and basis errors. (5) SpeciesId, ElementId, elemental matrix A, stoichiometric matrix N, charge vector z as immutable artifacts.

title: Safety, EMC, and assurance program: hazards, fault trees, containment
