title: Theorem Foundry authoring/schema and core checker infrastructure
description:
PURPOSE: Provide the shared governance, schemas, proof-artifact lifecycle, executable checkers, falsifiers, adjudication, and replay infrastructure for genuinely new mathematics. FrankenSim deliberately pursues results stronger than existing simulation systems; rigor here protects ambition from being confused with a finite test campaign or an inapplicable theorem.

THEOREM CARD: Persist immutable statement_id and revision, exact quantifiers, units and sign/frame conventions, AssumptionManifestId, imported lemmas, statement relation and lifecycle, mathematics state, formalization state, falsification campaign state, implementation state, independent review/reproduction state, trusted-computing-base identities, kernel version, derivation/proof hashes, unresolved gaps, formal artifacts, executable checker, counterexample generator/corpus, scale qualification, downstream evidence edges, baseline relation, and claim/no-claim boundary. Keep axes orthogonal: Draft/Stable/Superseded/Withdrawn; Conjectured/ConditionalProof/Proved/Refuted; Unformalized/PartiallyFormalized/KernelChecked; Unchallenged/CampaignRunning/FalsifierSurvived/AdmittedCountermodel; Absent/ConformanceChecked/ScaleQualified; Unreviewed/IndependentAuditPassed/Reproduced. A finite checker or survived falsifier never sets Proved.

ASSUMPTION AND APPLICABILITY MODEL: AssumptionManifestId contains individually versioned predicates, decidability class, witness requirements, units/conventions, and incompatibility edges. AssumptionSetState is Unchecked, SatisfiableWitnessed, InconsistentProved, or Unknown. Each tested theorem instance receives a separate AdmissibilityReceipt with InstanceAdmissibility Admitted, OutOfDomain, Indeterminate, or Malformed, per-assumption results, exact statement/manifest versions, witness bytes/roots, checker/TCB identity, and independent-reproduction state. Logical implication under inconsistent assumptions may remain formally valid, but applicability/promotion is NoClaim. Unknown never coerces to admitted.

NONVACUITY: Every statement declares NonVacuityRequirement Point, OpenFamily, PositiveMeasureFamily, ScaleFamily, or Custom with exact witness obligation. Each witness produces a separate NonVacuityReceipt bound to statement/assumption versions, family description, parameter domain and units, witness roots, checker/TCB, and independent reproduction. A point cannot satisfy an open, positive-measure, or scale-family requirement. A boring established baseline and explicit claim-relation receipt are immutable parts of every card.

COUNTEREXAMPLE ADJUDICATION: Raw candidates are not card-level counterexamples. Each candidate is classified as ConfirmedCounterexample, SatisfiableWitness, AssumptionViolation, NumericalArtifact, CheckerArtifact, or ClassificationPending against exact quantifiers, assumptions, domain, units, conclusion, statement revision, and trusted-computing-base identities. Only a ConfirmedCounterexample that is independently checked, satisfiable under the retained model, in-domain, assumption-satisfying, and demonstrates failure of the exact conclusion may set that exact mathematics revision to Refuted. SatisfiableWitness confirms an example or satisfiability without necessarily refuting; AssumptionViolation narrows scope; NumericalArtifact and CheckerArtifact demote the appropriate implementation evidence; ClassificationPending grants neither promotion nor refutation. Invalidation removes or demotes only affected evidence edges and recomputes downstream authority; an independently supported downstream claim is not automatically refuted. Assumption strengthening, weakening, or replacement creates a new statement revision plus a direction-checked relation receipt; the old revision is never silently edited.

INFRASTRUCTURE AND PORTFOLIO: Implement ledger/package schema, independent checker harness, counterexample corpus and shrinker, immutable baselines, claim-relation and TCB-overlap receipts, invalidation/recomputation, reproduction receipts, and portfolio WIP/resource caps. Proof assistants and symbolic systems are isolated research/dev oracles; production consumes versioned artifacts through FrankenSim-native checkers. The 15 canonical theorem-card child beads own their statements; this infrastructure does not duplicate them.

ACCEPTANCE, TESTS, AND LOGGING: Illegal state promotion, forged/stale receipts, contradictory assumptions, point-versus-family mismatch, admission Indeterminate, out-of-domain falsifier, genuine countermodel, checker divergence, compromised kernel/TCB, alternative downstream support, cancellation, and transitive invalidation all have deterministic typed outcomes. G0 covers state/evidence lattice and schema laws; G3 covers equivalent encodings, statement revisions, and independent checker paths; G4 covers cancellation/faults during proof, campaign, adjudication, invalidation, and publication with no partial authority; G5 replays across workers/ISAs. Mutation tests kill every admission, nonvacuity, adjudication, and invalidation guard. A real no-mock E2E packages a statement, assumptions, baseline, proof/checker/falsifier artifacts, candidate adjudications, scale run, independent reproduction, and downstream recomputation. Bounded schema-versioned logs retain all IDs, exact states, receipts, TCB overlap, budgets/consumption, invalidated edges, authority/no-claim, and artifact paths.

AUDIT SNAPSHOT: Current entry-point assertions trace to docs/NEW_DOMAINS_AUDIT_SNAPSHOT_2acc39f13b49724cf94cb6bb88afbb9c2ed3ad0b.json at source commit 2acc39f13b49724cf94cb6bb88afbb9c2ed3ad0b. The snapshot is authoritative only for listed rows; implementation must re-audit unlisted or changed entry points against the execution source.

NORMATIVE SCOPE OVERRIDE (supersedes earlier monolithic/four-outcome wording): This bead owns authoring schemas, bounded card storage, statement/assumption/domain identities, baseline/falsifier/checker interfaces, and a non-authoritative core checker harness only. It does not adjudicate candidate truth, invalidate support graphs, or authorize production consumption. Candidate records use the six-way schema ConfirmedCounterexample, SatisfiableWitness, AssumptionViolation, NumericalArtifact, CheckerArtifact, and ClassificationPending; interpretation and transitions belong to the dedicated adjudication bead. Card authoring may proceed early and remains ambitious, but outputs are research artifacts until the separate promotion gate succeeds. The implementation must migrate all existing card main descriptions to this taxonomy and retain any stronger comment detail in the authoritative description.

## Acceptance Criteria

HIGH-PRECEDENCE THEOREM OUTCOME CONTRACT: Every candidate falsifier is admitted against one exact immutable statement revision with explicit quantifiers, assumptions, domain, units/conventions, and trusted-computing-base identities, then classified by the exact taxonomy ConfirmedCounterexample | SatisfiableWitness | AssumptionViolation | NumericalArtifact | CheckerArtifact | ClassificationPending. Only a ConfirmedCounterexample that is independently checked, satisfiable under the retained model, in-domain, assumption-satisfying, and demonstrates failure of the exact conclusion may transition that revision to Refuted. SatisfiableWitness confirms satisfiability or an example but is not a refutation unless it violates the conclusion; AssumptionViolation is evidence about scope; NumericalArtifact and CheckerArtifact are implementation evidence; ClassificationPending grants no promotion or refutation. Never average conflicting classifications, silently edit the statement, transfer a result across revisions, or allow Refuted to mean unsupported/incomplete. A sharper statement is a new content-addressed successor linked to the old revision. Unit tests exhaust the transition matrix and reject illegal transitions; property/metamorphic tests cover serialization/order/replay invariance; mutation tests remove each admission, satisfiability, domain, assumption, independence, revision, and conclusion guard; E2E fixtures exercise all six outcomes, tamper/stale/checker-disagreement/cancellation paths, revocation propagation, and runtime refusal. Bounded structured logs retain statement/revision, assumptions/domain/units, raw witness, solver and independent-checker identities, budgets, cancellation/drain/finalization, classification rationale, axis transitions, support/threat deltas, authority effect, successor links, and artifact roots.

comments.text: 2026-07-14 THEOREM-GOVERNANCE RATCHET (authoritative refinement): Preserve maximal ambition while separating mathematical refutation from defects in statements or machinery. Counterexample adjudication must distinguish GenuineCountermodel, OutOfDomain, SpecificationDefect, AdmissionCheckerDefect, ImplementationCheckerDefect, and ProofKernelOrTcbDefect. Only an independently reproduced, instance-Admitted genuine countermodel to the exact immutable revision refutes a universally quantified claim. Existential and other non-universal statements may instead be refuted by an independently kernel-checked proof of negation with its own assumptions, TCB, and applicability receipts; absence of a witness is not refutation. A specification defect creates a repaired statement revision and direction-checked relation; an admission-checker defect invalidates affected admissibility receipts; implementation/checker or proof-kernel defects demote only evidence that transitively depends on them. Authority must be recomputed as a support graph so independently supported downstream claims survive. Card-level FalsifierSurvived and Reproduced states are derived from immutable campaign/reproduction receipts, never freely mutable summary flags. Nonvacuity receipts for OpenFamily, PositiveMeasureFamily, fibrewise, and ScaleFamily obligations bind the topology, reference measure, fibre map, and scale order used. Promotion/E8 requires Stable statement; SatisfiableWitnessed assumptions; Proved or a fully discharged authority-relevant ConditionalProof; Admitted instances; strength-matched nonvacuity; no unresolved authority gap; KernelChecked formalization; ScaleQualified implementation; Reproduced independent evidence; and no active invalidation. Conjectured mathematics remains first-class, fundable moonshot work but cannot pass a production theorem gate merely because code, finite tests, or a falsifier campaign survived.

title: [M] TC13 Acoustic radiation and source-transfer theorem
description:
CARD 13

TARGET: Characterize structure, flow, and source-surface transfers that preserve the correct acoustic power pairing, radiation condition, and far-field QoIs under bounded interpolation, dispersion, quadrature, geometry, and source defects. Prove reciprocity only for reciprocal admitted media/operators; moving mean flow and nonreciprocal cases receive separate statements.

BASELINE AND NONVACUITY: Compare with pulsating sphere, baffled piston, compact monopole/dipole, and a structural mode transferred to an exterior solver. Require a ScaleFamily over frequency, mesh, source surface, basis, and Mach-number regimes.

CHECKER AND FALSIFIERS: Check source-surface conservation, power balance, radiation or combined-field conditions, reciprocity-domain admission, and far-field error enclosure. Attack normal reversal, nonenclosing FW-H surfaces, source aliasing, resonance, nonreciprocal flow mislabeled reciprocal, phase mismatch, and basis mismatch. G0-G5 cover power/reciprocity laws, analytic radiation convergence, canonical acoustic decks, surface/basis/frequency metamorphics, cancellation in BEM/FMM/source transfer, and deterministic far-field reduction.

COMMON AUTHORITY CONTRACT: Freeze an immutable statement revision with exact quantifiers, domain, units, sign/frame/orientation conventions, coefficient system, regularity, discretization and scale hypotheses, and a versioned AssumptionManifestId. Record an established boring baseline and an explicit stronger/equivalent/conditional claim relation. Per candidate instance, issue an AdmissibilityReceipt with Admitted, OutOfDomain, Indeterminate, or Malformed; never store one mutable card-wide admission result. Satisfy a declared NonVacuityRequirement (Point, OpenFamily, PositiveMeasureFamily, ScaleFamily, or Custom) with separate reproduced NonVacuityReceipts; a point witness cannot satisfy a family/scale claim.

DELIVERABLES: Produce human derivation, formal-kernel artifact where feasible, FrankenSim-native executable checker, independent counterexample generator and shrinker, adversarial corpus, dependency/TCB manifest, scale qualification, downstream invalidation map, and independent reproduction receipt. A finite checker, numerical convergence study, or survived falsifier never proves the theorem. Classify every candidate as ConfirmedCounterexample, SatisfiableWitness, AssumptionViolation, NumericalArtifact, CheckerArtifact, or ClassificationPending against the exact immutable statement revision, quantifiers, assumptions, domain, units, conclusion, and trusted computing base. Only a ConfirmedCounterexample that is independently checked, satisfiable under the retained model, in-domain, assumption-satisfying, and demonstrates failure of the exact conclusion may refute that mathematics revision. Other outcomes preserve or demote the appropriate statement, implementation, or formalization axis and recompute dependent authority without erasing independent support.

TEST AND OBSERVABILITY CONTRACT: G0 algebraic/unit/property laws and assumption-boundary tests; G1 manufactured solutions or convergence orders where meaningful; G2 canonical analytic/experimental benchmarks; G3 representation, basis, gauge, partition, unit/frame, and equivalent-formulation metamorphics; G4 cap, cancellation, fault, corrupt-artifact, and adversarial-search storms with request-drain-finalize and no partial authority; G5 deterministic replay across thread counts and both reference ISAs. Include doctests, compile/API guards, mutation tests, certifier-of-certifier checks, and a real no-mock end-to-end path through source construction, solver/evidence production, ledger/package/checker, candidate adjudication, scale run, and independent replay. Emit bounded schema-versioned logs with statement/assumption/baseline/instance IDs, admission and nonvacuity receipts, TCB/proof/checker/falsifier versions, budgets/consumption, state transitions, candidate class, invalidated edges, no-claim reason, and artifact paths.

## Success Criteria

HIGH-PRECEDENCE THEOREM OUTCOME CONTRACT: Every candidate falsifier is admitted against one exact immutable statement revision with explicit quantifiers, assumptions, domain, units/conventions, and trusted-computing-base identities, then classified by the exact taxonomy ConfirmedCounterexample | SatisfiableWitness | AssumptionViolation | NumericalArtifact | CheckerArtifact | ClassificationPending. Only a ConfirmedCounterexample that is independently checked, satisfiable under the retained model, in-domain, assumption-satisfying, and demonstrates failure of the exact conclusion may transition that revision to Refuted. SatisfiableWitness confirms satisfiability or an example but is not a refutation unless it violates the conclusion; AssumptionViolation is evidence about scope; NumericalArtifact and CheckerArtifact are implementation evidence; ClassificationPending grants no promotion or refutation. Never average conflicting classifications, silently edit the statement, transfer a result across revisions, or allow Refuted to mean unsupported/incomplete. A sharper statement is a new content-addressed successor linked to the old revision. Unit tests exhaust the transition matrix and reject illegal transitions; property/metamorphic tests cover serialization/order/replay invariance; mutation tests remove each admission, satisfiability, domain, assumption, independence, revision, and conclusion guard; E2E fixtures exercise all six outcomes, tamper/stale/checker-disagreement/cancellation paths, revocation propagation, and runtime refusal. Bounded structured logs retain statement/revision, assumptions/domain/units, raw witness, solver and independent-checker identities, budgets, cancellation/drain/finalization, classification rationale, axis transitions, support/threat deltas, authority effect, successor links, and artifact roots.

title: [M] TC14 Failure-mode descent theorem
description:
CARD 14

TARGET: Compose competing degradation modes, common causes, inspections, censoring, maintenance, and repairs through an explicit causal/dependency structure without false independence. Prove conditions under which local evidence descends to a system risk bound while retaining epistemic uncertainty and intervention semantics. Repair may change age, hazard, and hidden state and cannot silently become perfect renewal.

BASELINE AND NONVACUITY: Compare with exact state enumeration for a small dependent fault tree or Markov-renewal model. Require a ScaleFamily of bearing, gear, insulation, corrosion, and common-cause examples with inspection and repair schedules.

CHECKER AND FALSIFIERS: Check dependency graph or hypergraph/coupla bounds, competing-risk accounting, inspection likelihood, censoring, and intervention transitions. Attack omitted common causes, informative censoring, double-counted modes, survivorship bias, perfect-repair assumptions, and stale post-repair evidence. G0-G5 cover probability/causal laws, manufactured reliability populations, life/repair decks, graph-refactor/unit/time-scale metamorphics, cancellation during rare-event inference, and deterministic posterior/risk replay.

COMMON AUTHORITY CONTRACT: Freeze an immutable statement revision with exact quantifiers, domain, units, sign/frame/orientation conventions, coefficient system, regularity, discretization and scale hypotheses, and a versioned AssumptionManifestId. Record an established boring baseline and an explicit stronger/equivalent/conditional claim relation. Per candidate instance, issue an AdmissibilityReceipt with Admitted, OutOfDomain, Indeterminate, or Malformed; never store one mutable card-wide admission result. Satisfy a declared NonVacuityRequirement (Point, OpenFamily, PositiveMeasureFamily, ScaleFamily, or Custom) with separate reproduced NonVacuityReceipts; a point witness cannot satisfy a family/scale claim.

DELIVERABLES: Produce human derivation, formal-kernel artifact where feasible, FrankenSim-native executable checker, independent counterexample generator and shrinker, adversarial corpus, dependency/TCB manifest, scale qualification, downstream invalidation map, and independent reproduction receipt. A finite checker, numerical convergence study, or survived falsifier never proves the theorem. Classify every candidate as ConfirmedCounterexample, SatisfiableWitness, AssumptionViolation, NumericalArtifact, CheckerArtifact, or ClassificationPending against the exact immutable statement revision, quantifiers, assumptions, domain, units, conclusion, and trusted computing base. Only a ConfirmedCounterexample that is independently checked, satisfiable under the retained model, in-domain, assumption-satisfying, and demonstrates failure of the exact conclusion may refute that mathematics revision. Other outcomes preserve or demote the appropriate statement, implementation, or formalization axis and recompute dependent authority without erasing independent support.

TEST AND OBSERVABILITY CONTRACT: G0 algebraic/unit/property laws and assumption-boundary tests; G1 manufactured solutions or convergence orders where meaningful; G2 canonical analytic/experimental benchmarks; G3 representation, basis, gauge, partition, unit/frame, and equivalent-formulation metamorphics; G4 cap, cancellation, fault, corrupt-artifact, and adversarial-search storms with request-drain-finalize and no partial authority; G5 deterministic replay across thread counts and both reference ISAs. Include doctests, compile/API guards, mutation tests, certifier-of-certifier checks, and a real no-mock end-to-end path through source construction, solver/evidence production, ledger/package/checker, candidate adjudication, scale run, and independent replay. Emit bounded schema-versioned logs with statement/assumption/baseline/instance IDs, admission and nonvacuity receipts, TCB/proof/checker/falsifier versions, budgets/consumption, state transitions, candidate class, invalidated edges, no-claim reason, and artifact paths.

## Success Criteria

HIGH-PRECEDENCE THEOREM OUTCOME CONTRACT: Every candidate falsifier is admitted against one exact immutable statement revision with explicit quantifiers, assumptions, domain, units/conventions, and trusted-computing-base identities, then classified by the exact taxonomy ConfirmedCounterexample | SatisfiableWitness | AssumptionViolation | NumericalArtifact | CheckerArtifact | ClassificationPending. Only a ConfirmedCounterexample that is independently checked, satisfiable under the retained model, in-domain, assumption-satisfying, and demonstrates failure of the exact conclusion may transition that revision to Refuted. SatisfiableWitness confirms satisfiability or an example but is not a refutation unless it violates the conclusion; AssumptionViolation is evidence about scope; NumericalArtifact and CheckerArtifact are implementation evidence; ClassificationPending grants no promotion or refutation. Never average conflicting classifications, silently edit the statement, transfer a result across revisions, or allow Refuted to mean unsupported/incomplete. A sharper statement is a new content-addressed successor linked to the old revision. Unit tests exhaust the transition matrix and reject illegal transitions; property/metamorphic tests cover serialization/order/replay invariance; mutation tests remove each admission, satisfiability, domain, assumption, independence, revision, and conclusion guard; E2E fixtures exercise all six outcomes, tamper/stale/checker-disagreement/cancellation paths, revocation propagation, and runtime refusal. Bounded structured logs retain statement/revision, assumptions/domain/units, raw witness, solver and independent-checker identities, budgets, cancellation/drain/finalization, classification rationale, axis transitions, support/threat deltas, authority effect, successor links, and artifact roots.

SEMANTIC ROLLUP: Preserve the full ambitious TC14 parent and exact six-outcome contract. Children frankensim-ext-theorem-lane-systems-yttz.4.1, frankensim-ext-theorem-lane-systems-yttz.4.2, frankensim-ext-theorem-lane-systems-yttz.4.3, frankensim-ext-theorem-lane-systems-yttz.4.4 own statement/applicability/nonvacuity, derivation/formal artifact/TCB, independent checker/falsifier/taxonomy/invalidation, and scale/consumer/reproduction respectively. Close only when all reconcile and terminal frankensim-ext-theorem-lane-systems-yttz.4.4 completes. One terminal hard edge points to that child; existing Foundry edges remain. No counts, finite studies, survived falsifiers, green harnesses, or unrelated-card state substitute for exact receipts or promote theorem/runtime authority.

comments.text: 2026-07-14 canonical-card governance ratchet: this card inherits the Foundry's refined defect taxonomy and proof-of-negation path. Keep the theorem as ambitious as its strongest coherent revision; do not weaken it merely to make implementation easy. Nonetheless, production promotion requires Stable + SatisfiableWitnessed + Proved (or fully discharged authority-relevant ConditionalProof) + exact-instance Admitted + strength-matched nonvacuity + no unresolved authority gap + KernelChecked + ScaleQualified + Reproduced, with no active invalidation. Genuine countermodels must be independently admitted to this exact revision; specification, admission-checker, implementation-checker, and proof-kernel/TCB defects revise or invalidate the right artifact rather than being mislabeled mathematical refutations. Open/positive-measure/fibrewise/scale nonvacuity binds topology, measure, fibre map, and scale order. Survived falsifiers and reproduction states derive from immutable receipts and never prove the theorem by themselves.

title: Theorem lane: thermodynamics, fidelity, learning (cards 6, 7, 10, 15)
description:
BACKGROUND: Four cards whose enabling work spans E0d coupling, E5 gas, E6 fidelity. Same card discipline.

CARD 6 — WHOLE-MACHINE DISCRETE THERMODYNAMICS: find a composition and time-discretization class in which Dirac interconnections, storage gradients, memoryless maximal-monotone dissipators, and STATEFUL hysteretic/reactive/frictional internal-variable laws with explicit free-energy/dissipation updates, stream ports, and asynchronous multirate windows yield an EXACT discrete first-law balance and a SIGNED second-law inequality for the assembled open machine — not just each component; quantify the defect and restore the theorem under adaptive window refinement when exact asynchronous closure is impossible. Artifact: ComposedThermodynamicsTheorem + exergy and boundary ledgers (PO-19; the genset audit backbone).

CARD 7 — PROOF-PRESERVING FIDELITY DESCENT: treat model crosswalks as morphisms carrying conserved state, QoIs, validity predicates, and evidence; prove a global decision-error bound from local naturality defects; show refinement/escalation is MONOTONE in an evidence preorder — a router may spend more or less compute but cannot silently strengthen a claim. Artifact: FidelityDescentTheorem, the formal spine of the proof-carrying machine twin (PO-20).

CARD 10 — REACTIVE MOVING-MESH ENTROPY/POSITIVITY: unify variable thermodynamics, detailed-balance chemistry, invariant domains, source/boundary entropy, nonlinear-solve defect, and ALE GCL in a FULLY DISCRETE inequality, with a separate free-energy inclusion at phase boundaries. Artifact: ReactiveAleEntropyTheorem (PO-6; the E6 multi-D reacting rung consumes it).

CARD 15 — THERMODYNAMIC CONSTITUTIVE LEARNING: build a guarded learned-law class whose architecture and checker ENFORCE objectivity, material symmetry, free-energy/dissipation admissibility, state-update consistency, and extrapolation refusal, with approximation and discretization errors kept separate. Artifact: ThermodynamicConstitutiveLearningTheorem (guarded learned laws enter fs-material only through this gate).

ACCEPTANCE: cards registered complete; the thermodynamics card's checker consumes E0d slice ledgers as its first baseline; states tracked honestly.

Every listed theorem MUST supply its complete immutable-statement, derivation/proof, independent-checker/falsifier, and scale-qualification/consumer-replay receipts before the lane can close.

The lane owns portfolio-level joins only: exact child accounting, stable ordering, schema/version compatibility, assumption and applicability intersections, baseline and nonvacuity consistency, authority monotonicity, support and invalidation propagation, retained artifact closure, and classification in exactly the shared six-outcome taxonomy. It MUST NOT mint, strengthen, or promote a theorem claim, replace a child checker, average away disagreement, or treat missing, cancelled, inconclusive, unsupported, stale, or tampered evidence as success. Mathematical adjudication and promotion remain the E8 summit's responsibility; the E8 software battery is related validation, not a hard proof dependency.

Unit and integration tests MUST cover exact-set membership; happy, empty, missing, duplicate, extra, reordered, stale-version, malformed, and unsupported child receipts; all six classifications; statement/proof/checker/replay identity mismatches; assumption and unit incompatibility; evidence support loss; invalidation and successor propagation; deterministic tie-breaking; budgets; cancellation; crash recovery; and stable typed refusals. A production-backed lane journey MUST aggregate all and only the immutable child set, exercise a hostile negative twin for every rejection class, independently replay every card receipt and the portfolio join, and demonstrate that no software-only or incomplete evidence can yield theorem authority. Logs MUST be schema-versioned, bounded, deterministic, and redacted before buffering or hashing; include lane/theorem/card/stage/attempt IDs, seed and budgets, input and artifact identities, assumption/support deltas, classification and stable reason codes, first divergence, ranked repairs, and repository-relative reproduction commands; and exclude secrets, capability material, absolute paths, host identity, PIDs, addresses, wall-clock noise, and unbounded diagnostics.

title: [M] TC06 Whole-machine discrete thermodynamics theorem
description:
CARD 06

TARGET: Identify a composition and time-discretization class where Dirac interconnections, storage gradients, maximal-monotone dissipators, stateful hysteretic/reactive/frictional laws, stream ports, and asynchronous multirate windows yield exact first-law closure and a signed second-law inequality. Where exact asynchronous closure is impossible, prove an explicit defect identity and conditions under which adaptive window refinement contracts it.

BASELINE AND NONVACUITY: Compare with a synchronous lumped storage/resistor/source network. Require a ScaleFamily from an E0d toy machine through reactive, frictional, hysteretic, and multirate assemblies.

CHECKER AND FALSIFIERS: Reconcile whole-graph energy, entropy, exergy, species, and boundary ledgers. Attack effort/flow sign reversal, interpolation-created energy, omitted hysteretic state work, stream enthalpy or chemical-potential omissions, reaction heat double counting, asynchronous leakage, and cancellation mid-window. G0-G5 cover port-power algebra, manufactured discrete balances, toy-machine and genset decks, partition/window/unit metamorphics, drain/finalize, and deterministic reductions.

COMMON AUTHORITY CONTRACT: Freeze an immutable statement revision with exact quantifiers, domain, units, sign/frame/orientation conventions, coefficient system, regularity, discretization and scale hypotheses, and a versioned AssumptionManifestId. Record an established boring baseline and an explicit stronger/equivalent/conditional claim relation. Per candidate instance, issue an AdmissibilityReceipt with Admitted, OutOfDomain, Indeterminate, or Malformed; never store one mutable card-wide admission result. Satisfy a declared NonVacuityRequirement (Point, OpenFamily, PositiveMeasureFamily, ScaleFamily, or Custom) with separate reproduced NonVacuityReceipts; a point witness cannot satisfy a family/scale claim.

DELIVERABLES: Produce human derivation, formal-kernel artifact where feasible, FrankenSim-native executable checker, independent counterexample generator and shrinker, adversarial corpus, dependency/TCB manifest, scale qualification, downstream invalidation map, and independent reproduction receipt. A finite checker, numerical convergence study, or survived falsifier never proves the theorem. Classify every candidate as ConfirmedCounterexample, SatisfiableWitness, AssumptionViolation, NumericalArtifact, CheckerArtifact, or ClassificationPending against the exact immutable statement revision, quantifiers, assumptions, domain, units, conclusion, and trusted computing base. Only a ConfirmedCounterexample that is independently checked, satisfiable under the retained model, in-domain, assumption-satisfying, and demonstrates failure of the exact conclusion may refute that mathematics revision. Other outcomes preserve or demote the appropriate statement, implementation, or formalization axis and recompute dependent authority without erasing independent support.

TEST AND OBSERVABILITY CONTRACT: G0 algebraic/unit/property laws and assumption-boundary tests; G1 manufactured solutions or convergence orders where meaningful; G2 canonical analytic/experimental benchmarks; G3 representation, basis, gauge, partition, unit/frame, and equivalent-formulation metamorphics; G4 cap, cancellation, fault, corrupt-artifact, and adversarial-search storms with request-drain-finalize and no partial authority; G5 deterministic replay across thread counts and both reference ISAs. Include doctests, compile/API guards, mutation tests, certifier-of-certifier checks, and a real no-mock end-to-end path through source construction, solver/evidence production, ledger/package/checker, candidate adjudication, scale run, and independent replay. Emit bounded schema-versioned logs with statement/assumption/baseline/instance IDs, admission and nonvacuity receipts, TCB/proof/checker/falsifier versions, budgets/consumption, state transitions, candidate class, invalidated edges, no-claim reason, and artifact paths.

## Success Criteria

HIGH-PRECEDENCE THEOREM OUTCOME CONTRACT: Every candidate falsifier is admitted against one exact immutable statement revision with explicit quantifiers, assumptions, domain, units/conventions, and trusted-computing-base identities, then classified by the exact taxonomy ConfirmedCounterexample | SatisfiableWitness | AssumptionViolation | NumericalArtifact | CheckerArtifact | ClassificationPending. Only a ConfirmedCounterexample that is independently checked, satisfiable under the retained model, in-domain, assumption-satisfying, and demonstrates failure of the exact conclusion may transition that revision to Refuted. SatisfiableWitness confirms satisfiability or an example but is not a refutation unless it violates the conclusion; AssumptionViolation is evidence about scope; NumericalArtifact and CheckerArtifact are implementation evidence; ClassificationPending grants no promotion or refutation. Never average conflicting classifications, silently edit the statement, transfer a result across revisions, or allow Refuted to mean unsupported/incomplete. A sharper statement is a new content-addressed successor linked to the old revision. Unit tests exhaust the transition matrix and reject illegal transitions; property/metamorphic tests cover serialization/order/replay invariance; mutation tests remove each admission, satisfiability, domain, assumption, independence, revision, and conclusion guard; E2E fixtures exercise all six outcomes, tamper/stale/checker-disagreement/cancellation paths, revocation propagation, and runtime refusal. Bounded structured logs retain statement/revision, assumptions/domain/units, raw witness, solver and independent-checker identities, budgets, cancellation/drain/finalization, classification rationale, axis transitions, support/threat deltas, authority effect, successor links, and artifact roots.

SEMANTIC ROLLUP: Preserve the full ambitious TC06 parent and exact six-outcome contract. Children frankensim-ext-theorem-lane-thermo-tbss.1.1, frankensim-ext-theorem-lane-thermo-tbss.1.2, frankensim-ext-theorem-lane-thermo-tbss.1.3, frankensim-ext-theorem-lane-thermo-tbss.1.4 own statement/applicability/nonvacuity, derivation/formal artifact/TCB, independent checker/falsifier/taxonomy/invalidation, and scale/consumer/reproduction respectively. title: fs-thermal: storage/transport lanes, radiation, phase change, loss intake
description:
BACKGROUND: No thermal-domain solver stack exists (blocker B6) — only BC types, an adjoint fixture, and an LBM fixture. New L3 crate fs-thermal (deps: fs-feec, fs-solver, fs-matdb, fs-material, fs-motion, fs-query, fs-xform, fs-couple).

FIELD LANE: semidiscrete storage and transport SEPARATE: M_HT(T,z) dT/dt + M_Hz(T,z) dz/dt + D0^T M_k(T,z) D0 T = f + b(T), with surface mass, Neumann/Robin, contact, radiation, and moving-boundary terms oriented and unit-checked; implicit first-order steppers; nonlinear enthalpy derivatives; anisotropic composites; temperature-dependent properties; direct energy-balance receipts (enclosure only where numerical AND data paths support one). If internal state z is frozen/energetically neutral the card omits H_z dz/dt EXPLICITLY; otherwise the total-enthalpy residual includes it.

NETWORK LANE: lumped RC networks with storage nodes, lossless junctions, dissipative conductances, and reservoirs DISTINCT (port-thermodynamic primitives) — engine/motor thermal management is network-first (D7).

SOURCES (via ports only — fs-thermal never reaches into peers): Joule J.E only for stationary Ohmic; moving conductors use the three-way split receipts from fs-em (thermal consumes only the loss share); Hall/thermoelectric cross-effects via the coupled Onsager-Casimir entropy-production receipt, never the scalar shortcut; friction heat from fs-contact/fs-tribo partitions; combustion from fs-gas. LossOwnershipReceipt enforcement: thermal credit equals upstream debit within accounting bounds.

PHASE CHANGE: PRIMARY-ENTHALPY/inclusion formulation for sharp latent-heat plateaus (dH/dT may be singular/set-valued); apparent heat capacity is an explicitly REGULARIZED lane, labeled; interface tracking via level-set kernels HOISTED from fs-topols (L4) into fs-xform (L2) — hoist is part of this bead: canonical LevelSetGrid + WENO5 advection + FIM redistancing + velocity extension with compatibility re-exports, canonical bytes, goldens preserved, plus conservative remap and split/merge lineage receipts; LEVEL-SET TRANSPORT ALONE DOES NOT CONSERVE LATENT HEAT — the phase-front flux jump and remap get a direct balance certificate. RADIATION: nonlinear T^4 surface exchange as a funded [F] lane with view-factor/radiosity reciprocity and enclosure checks; participating media later. Gap/contact conductance via InterfaceSystemCards (pressure/roughness/coating/history-dependent) coupled to contact normal traction.

TESTS (detailed logging): 1-D/2-D conduction closed forms; Stefan problem (G1) with front-flux balance certificate; radiative-exchange reciprocity fixtures; laser-flash parameter-recovery fixture; loss-intake double-count refusal; NAFEMS thermal pinned decks (G2); per-window energy/entropy audit logs.
STAGED COUPLED-RESPONSE CHARTER (funded successors, assembled by fs-couple/L6 adapters — never peer-to-peer crate dependencies): conjugate heat transfer (first exercised by the cold-plate flagship); coolant/cooling-loop networks; boiling/evaporation; thermal contact/gap transfer (v1 here); THERMOELASTIC expansion/stress (the thermo-mechanical clearance loop the pump-bearing flagship consumes); and bidirectional electrothermal/magnetothermal feedback (iterate or solve monolithically when feedback is stiff — the co-simulation lanes own the escalation).

title: V&V artifact schemas: ContextOfUse through PredictionAssessment
description:
BACKGROUND: Verification is not validation (doctrine D9). A result may be numerically Verified and physically only Estimated. Making that distinction MACHINE-READABLE — not a slogan — requires typed artifacts that every flagship report consumes.

SCOPE — six schemas: (1) ContextOfUse: what decision the model serves, QoIs, acceptance criteria, applicability domain; (2) ValidationPlan: which experiments/datasets validate which QoIs; (3) ExperimentArtifact: instrument calibration, synchronized clocks, repeatability/covariance, data authenticity; (4) CalibrationSplit: calibration vs validation vs BLIND HOLDOUT partitions, enforced mechanically so calibration data can never be reused as validation evidence; (5) SolutionVerificationReceipt: mesh/time/nonlinear/iterative uncertainty for a specific solve; (6) PredictionAssessment: model-form, parameter, numerical, data, aleatory, epistemic components + validation metrics that include experimental AND numerical uncertainty + posterior-predictive checks + applicability/extrapolation decision.

RULES ENCODED: the claim dependency graph is QoI-SPECIFIC; numerical/data/model errors may form a declared bound or probabilistic budget waterfall; categorical evidence colors NEVER become percentages or an averaged confidence score; evidence from a high-fidelity code or second implementation is verification/discrepancy evidence, never physical validation. Observability/identifiability/confounding diagnostics and inverse-crime prevention fields included. ASME V&V / JCGM GUM / NASA-STD-7009 inform the schemas; conformance to a process standard is a SEPARATE receipt from model validation.

TESTS (unit, detailed logging): schema round-trips; a fixture that tries to count calibration data as validation is refused; a fixture converting colors to a numeric score is refused; budget-waterfall arithmetic checks; each refusal logs the violated rule by name.
ASSUMPTIONS-LEDGER SCHEMA (seventh schema owned here; runtime-physics assumptions, distinct from the program risk register): every artifact refines rows of the form AssumptionId | predicate | scope | evidence | runtime monitor | violation effect | owner | expiry/review gate. Leaving any domain DEMOTES OR REFUSES per policy — never silent extrapolation.

A-002 MQS wavelength/displacement-current regime valid (dimensionless regime receipt + frequency monitor; electroquasistatic/full-wave escalation; fs-em; E4-E6). title: Engineer workflow and FMI/SSP quarantined interoperability
description:
BACKGROUND: Adoption requires the end-to-end engineer workflow to be explicit and the interchange story honest: import/create geometry -> assemble/joint -> bind materials/interfaces/as-built state -> declare IC/BC, drive/load cycle, tolerances, faults, hazards -> choose ContextOfUse/QoIs/acceptance/budgets -> admit fidelity/solver/escalation policy -> calibrate on training data -> verify/validate on holdouts -> simulate/UQ/optimize -> export replay, evidence, decision package.

SCOPE: (1) the workflow above as an executable, documented path over the machine IR (each arrow a checked admission step); (2) canonical interchange stays FrankenSim-native and content-addressed; (3) FMI 3.0.2 / SSP 2.0: pure-Rust PARSING/EXPORT, or quarantined isolated-process adapters — foreign FMU execution stays OUTSIDE the trusted production dependency graph and its outputs CANNOT inherit native certificate status (they enter as Estimated external evidence at best); (4) round-trip batteries: FrankenScript -> machine graph -> scenario/domain artifacts -> package/replay preserving stable IDs and semantic hashes (extends the E0a round trip to the full workflow).

ACCEPTANCE (E7 exit item): FMI/SSP quarantine conformance demonstrated — import an external model description, run it isolated, consume outputs with honest evidence labeling; export a FrankenSim machine as SSP without losing identity.

TESTS (detailed logging): round-trip battery; a quarantine-escape attempt (FMU output claiming Verified) refused; workflow-step admission failures produce actionable diagnostics; determinism of export hashes.
CONVENTIONAL-CAD VOCABULARY MAP (the onboarding/positioning contract for engineers coming from SolidWorks/Fusion/NX; each row is a design requirement on our side, not marketing):
1. Feature tree (sketch->extrude->fillet) MAPS TO F-rep program with exposed parameters — same geometry-as-a-program idea, but differentiable, with no rebuild errors because there are no trimmed-surface intersections to fail.
2. Fillet feature MAPS TO R-function blend — radius is a smooth optimizable parameter.
3. Named faces for loads/BCs MAPS TO geometric predicates on regions — BCs attach to predicates ('the port region', 'within the module footprint') that SURVIVE TOPOLOGY CHANGES; the number-one automation-breaker in conventional loops (parameter change deletes the named face, chain dies at run 37 overnight) disappears by construction. fs-scenario region binding + machine-IR stable IDs already implement this discipline; this row makes it a tested guarantee (a topology-changing parameter sweep must never orphan a BC).
4. Design table/configurations MAPS TO the parameterization theta — table rows become the optimizer domain.
5. Mesh + convergence study MAPS TO CutFEM on implicit geometry + goal-oriented error budget — the meshing stage (and its calendar cost) leaves the loop; the error budget replaces mesh-independence folklore.
6. DOE wrapper (HEEDS/Isight/modeFRONTIER) MAPS TO adjoint-driven optimization + e-raced populations — gradients over design FIELDS instead of a GA over a dozen parameters; doomed candidates cancelled mid-solve.
7. PDM vault/file versions MAPS TO the content-addressed ledger — explain() any number; fork any study; diff Pareto fronts geometrically.
8. STEP export MAPS TO certified/measured B-rep re-fit (see ext-cad-step-interchange) — the optimized geometry ships, not a manual redrawing of it.
9. Safety factor MAPS TO the itemized error ledger — ignorance becomes attributable (discretization vs material-data vs sampling) and reducible.
HONESTY ROWS (what does not improve): physical prototype tests remain; accuracy stays bounded by materials data (the error ledger will report when brazed-joint conductivity dominates discretization error — clarifying and humbling); GD&T/drawings/code compliance live in the conventional world reached through STEP; analyst sign-off culture ('show me the mesh') is earned benchmark-by-benchmark via the Gauntlet, not asserted.

title: EXTREAL program: make the epistemic architecture answer to one externally validated engineering decision
description:
PROGRAM ROOT — the External-Reality Program (EXTREAL), distilled 2026-07-20 from a three-review strategic synthesis (Kimi review + two adversarial critiques, ~85% adopted). This bead tree is self-contained: no need to consult the original review documents.

CENTRAL THESIS: FrankenSim's assurance architecture (typed units, evidence colors, deterministic kernels, ledger, certificates) is now MORE mature than the physical models, external validation corpus, interoperability, and product workflow it is supposed to support. The failure mode this creates is specific: a result can be precisely provenance-tracked, numerically certified, and cancellation-correct while still being PHYSICALLY WRONG from omitted physics, uncertain BCs, bad constitutive/material data, or invalid context of use — "precisely wrong with an excellent pedigree." The remedy is NOT abandoning the epistemic architecture; it is making that architecture answer to ONE externally validated engineering decision, while treating the sibling constellation, data sources, adapters, and certifiers as part of one auditable trust system. Slogan: "the project needs the friction of external reality more than additional internal elegance."

ACCURACY HIERARCHY (the program ladder — we are strong at 1-2, promising at 3, and levels 4-6 must become the product): 1 arithmetic/implementation correctness; 2 solver/discretization error; 3 geometry/parameter/BC uncertainty; 4 model-form discrepancy and omitted physics; 5 experimental validation in actual context of use; 6 decision risk (can remaining uncertainty flip the engineering decision).

MATURITY LEVELS used across this program (record per capability, see governance epic): L1 experimental component; L2 numerically verified component; L3 integrated workflow component; L4 experimentally validated workflow; L5 supported engineering product capability. Local crate test counts do NOT move the product score unless they advance an end-to-end capability.

PHASING (calendar honesty — the reviews' own 90-day plan conflated L3 and L4): (a) first ~30 days: re-score and ratify the vertical wedge with MEASURED inputs, secure datasets, define context of use and acceptance criteria; (b) by ~90 days: a LEVEL-3 thin slice — stable beta CLI + project schema + one real input artifact + deterministic thermal solve + convergence/uncertainty evidence + report + evidence package; (c) 3-9 months: LEVEL-4 — >=3 external experimental datasets, calibrated uncertainty, a preregistered blind case, independent external reproduction. The L4 clock does NOT start until data and a validation partner exist; (d) thereafter L5 (packaging, support policy, migration guarantees, published validation domain).

GOVERNANCE RULE (the admission test for ALL new work): every new workstream must either (1) unblock the selected vertical, (2) reduce a named cross-cutting trust risk, or (3) consume a tightly capped research budget with an explicit falsifier. Crate creation and issue generation are COSTS that must justify themselves through an end-to-end engineering decision.

PRIMARY METRIC: time from raw/dirty CAD to a defensible, evidence-complete engineering decision. Supporting metrics: error vs blind experiments; empirical uncertainty coverage; false-safe-decision rate; % outputs with complete error budgets; CAD import success on a retained supplier corpus; time-to-explain a surprising result; cross-machine reproducibility; surrogate escalation correctness; independent reproduction success. Kernel throughput and crate/test counts remain diagnostics, not north stars.

GROUNDED CODE FACTS this program was scoped against (verified 2026-07-20): fs-ladder::cht() declares correlation-Nu -> RANS -> LES rungs but supplies only a Refine1d 1-D placeholder transfer; NO conduction-FEM thermal solver, NO Nusselt correlation library, NO contact/interface resistance, NO fan-curve model, NO conjugate coupling exist (thermal reality today = fs-lbm Boussinesq thermal LBM + fs-adjoint heat-equation adjoint + fs-couple port schemas + fs-matdb property storage). fs-wedge KernelMaturity=8 rationale overstates the code. No MPFR/Arb-class oracle exists for fs-ivl (dd-only + 2-ISA golden hashes). fs-evidence UncertaintyBreakdown is 3-term (numerical/statistical/model), not the 8-term engineering budget. No EngineeringDecision type, no project schema (.fsim), no product CLI (only the PV fs-vskeleton .fsir runner). fs-report renders Markdown only. fs-matdb JointStatistics are stored but not wired into query receipts. fs-checker/fs-package are FORMAT 8 / protocol 6; fs-govern Phase-0B-B (durable authenticated checker receipts) is unimplemented. Constellation = 7 pinned siblings verified for content identity, not for governance/review.

CHILD EPICS (all parent-child under this root): e01 wedge re-scoring & ratification; e02 claim-integrity burn-down; e03 certified-arithmetic root audit; e04 external V&V corpus; e05 CHT physics kernels; e06 Cooling 0.1 product workflow (L3); e07 Level-4 validation program; e08 error-budget doctrine & DecisionAssessment; e09 certificate-regime doctrine; e10 fidelity graph; e11 CAD admission & interop; e12 design-build-measure-update loop; e13 constellation trust cone; e14 surrogates-as-proposers governance; e15 GPU policy; e16 governance & metrics; e17 scenario semantics.

ANTI-GOALS (explicit, to prevent drift): do not choose the wedge by declaration (measure it); do not treat GPU as automatically next (evidence-driven only); do not let a numerical certificate promote model-form or experimental authority (no-promotion policy, epic e08); do not build a universal god type for decisions (DecisionAssessment is an L6 projection); do not equate "not fully production-ready" with "absent" when writing status docs (epic e16 doc-drift task); a V&V "pyramid" is actually an evidence PORTFOLIO with independent axes — field data is not automatically strongest.

## Success Criteria

The structured `acceptance_criteria` field contains the controlling, complete Success Criteria exact-set close gate. This navigation heading neither weakens nor duplicates that gate.
design: PROGRAM ROLLUP ONLY. Preserve the complete ExtReal portfolio while projecting one uniquely triaged Cooling/TDA product spine and its externally validated decision. Implementation, scientific authority, runner publication, user journey, and DSR evidence remain owned by terminal children; this root never substitutes for them.
acceptance_criteria:
Close only when the frozen verification inventory maps every descendant to rollup, execution leaf, contributor, checker, journey, or historical evidence; the Cooling/TDA user journey runs no-mock from admitted input through decision/report/package and independent replay; every implementation leaf names comprehensive unit/property/metamorphic/mutation tests or a justified N/A; bounded structured logs and exact authority/no-claim transitions are retained; external validation is separate from code verification; and exact qualified DSR evidence names source, machine, command, result, log, receipt, and artifacts. Related adjacent flagships improve portfolio visibility but do not block the primary product.

## Success Criteria

1. The direct-child set is exactly frankensim-extreal-program-f85xj.1 through frankensim-extreal-program-f85xj.17. Every child is classified in the frozen verification inventory and reaches an honest terminal outcome on one compatible source, constellation, schema, policy, and authority snapshot. Missing, substituted, aggregate-count, or merely related work cannot close the root.
2. The Level-3 Cooling milestone is necessary but not sufficient for this root: an admitted no-mock raw/dirty-CAD to solve to QoI/DecisionAssessment to report/package journey must carry complete error-budget and binding-witness evidence, hostile twins, independent replay, deterministic bounded logs, source closure, and qualified DSR evidence.
3. Root closure additionally requires the E07 Level-4 experimental-validation program: at least three independently sourced external experimental datasets inside an explicit ContextOfUse, calibrated uncertainty with retained coverage and false-safe/decision-flip risk, one preregistered blind case whose outcomes were unavailable during calibration, and independent external reproduction under disjoint analysis authority.
4. Verification, numerical certification, experimental validation, human review, performance qualification, product support, and release authority remain orthogonal. Code/DSR success cannot substitute for external data; a validation Pass outside its retained domain cannot widen the ContextOfUse; NoData, Refused, Inconclusive, or failed thresholds remain visible and restrict claims.
5. Every implementation leaf retains comprehensive unit/boundary/property/metamorphic/mutation/fault/cancellation tests or an exact typed N/A; every terminal owner retains release-built no-mock E2E, detailed redacted deterministic JSONL, artifact-only replay, and exact source closure. Independent checkers may not reuse producer decision logic.
6. The primary metric and all supporting decision metrics are computed from retained row membership and receipts, never invented or inferred from crate/test counts. title: E01 Wedge re-scoring and vertical ratification (measured inputs, 3 candidates, kill criteria)
description:
WHY: The commercial wedge (conjugate heat transfer for electronics cooling, fs-wedge rank 1) was selected by STRATEGIC DECLARATION: fs-wedge/src/lib.rs itself says the four scores are "the plan's strategic judgement encoded as data, not empirical measurements", the 5-day cycle-time baseline is a placeholder, and the KernelMaturity=8 rationale claims "conduction FEM + forced-convection CFD with correlation-based Nusselt rungs" which the code does NOT contain (fs-ladder cht() supplies rung names + a Refine1d 1-D placeholder; no thermal FEM, no Nu correlations). Meanwhile actual technical depth is stronger around SDF geometry, CutFEM, elasticity, adjoints, topology optimization. Choosing wrongly costs a year; re-scoring costs days. The review synthesis: re-score the wedge with OBSERVED inputs before committing the product epic.

WHAT (children): (1) measured wedge inputs; (2) three-candidate comparison — full electronics-cooling CHT vs SDF-based structural/topology assurance vs the compromise "thermal design assurance" (conduction + anisotropic boards + contact resistance + radiation + fan curves + calibrated low-fidelity convection, validated RANS later); (3) measured cycle-time baseline protocol replacing the 5-day placeholder; (4) ratification decision record with kill criteria and falsifier; (5) test/audit lane.

SCORING FUNCTION (record in fs-wedge, keep as data): WedgeScore = f(customer pain, kernel readiness MEASURED against the code inventory, validation tractability, data access, CAD burden, time to decision, differentiation, compute cost, regulatory risk).

SEQUENCING NOTE: conduction/contact/radiation/fan/correlation kernels (epic e05 tasks 1-6) are deliberately robust to this decision — they are required by BOTH thermal candidates — so they are not blocked by ratification; only the RANS rung and the product schema freeze are gated on e01.4.

DONE WHEN: a ratified decision record exists in fs-govern + fs-wedge with measured scores, a measured baseline, explicit kill criterion (>=3x cycle-time reduction within the stated quarters), and a named falsifier; downstream epics e04/e05/e06 cite it.

## Success Criteria

Rollup acceptance requires explicit terminal states and retained evidence for direct children .1.1 through .1.5: measured-input normalization, three-candidate scoring, uncertainty/sensitivity treatment, ratification decision, and the conformance battery. The ratification record must join immutable child artifact identifiers, scoring-model version, units, source provenance, uncertainty intervals, kill-criterion results, and rerun instructions; contradictory or missing child evidence forces NoDecision rather than an inferred winner. The terminal E01 verification owner is .1.5, which must own scripts/ci/e2e_extreal_wedge_scoring.sh with unit, boundary, property, metamorphic, mutation, fault, cancellation, and resource-limit cases plus bounded structured logs and deterministic replay. The KernelMaturity=8 rationale asserts conduction FEM + forced-convection correlation rungs that DO NOT EXIST in the code (fs-ladder cht() has only rung names + a Refine1d 1-D placeholder transfer; no thermal FEM, no Nu correlations, no contact resistance, no fan model — verified inventory 2026-07-20). title: Three-candidate wedge comparison with an explicit scoring function (CHT vs SDF-structural vs thermal-design-assurance)
description:
WHY: Market logic may favor electronics cooling, but current technical depth is stronger around SDF geometry, CutFEM, elasticity, adjoints, and topology optimization. The decision must weigh both honestly, using the measured inputs from the predecessor task, and must consider the productive compromise explicitly.

WHAT: Score at least three candidates with a recorded function WedgeScore = f(customer pain, kernel readiness, validation tractability, data access, CAD burden, time to decision, differentiation, compute cost, regulatory risk): (1) full electronics-cooling CHT (conduction + forced-convection RANS eventually); (2) SDF-based structural/topology optimization assurance (plays to existing CutFEM/adjoint/topopt depth); (3) "thermal design assurance" compromise — conduction, anisotropic boards, contact resistance, radiation, fan curves, CALIBRATED low-fidelity convection, with a validated RANS rung deferred. HOW: implement as data + a small pure scoring routine in fs-wedge (keep the crate's pure-const/no-deps character where possible); the output is a ranked recommendation record whose every factor cites a measured input. Include a sensitivity table: which single factor change would flip the ranking (this is decision-epistemics practice applied to our own planning).

DONE WHEN: a ranked recommendation with per-factor evidence and ranking-flip sensitivities exists in fs-wedge and is referenced by the ratification task.

TESTS: unit tests for the scoring function (monotonicity in each factor, weight normalization, deterministic tie-breaking); a metamorphic test that permuting candidate order does not change scores; an e2e audit script that renders the full scoring table + flip-sensitivity analysis to a deterministic report artifact with verbose per-factor logging.

title: Replace the 5-day placeholder cycle-time baseline with a measured baseline protocol
description:
WHY: fs-wedge CHT_BASELINE.baseline_days = 5 is documented as "a scoping placeholder to be replaced with a real measured baseline." The commercial kill criterion (>=3x cycle-time reduction, meets_kill_criterion()) is meaningless until the denominator is real. Shipping a product claim against a fabricated baseline would be exactly the "precisely wrong with excellent pedigree" failure mode applied to our own marketing.

WHAT: Define and execute a measured-baseline protocol for the chosen vertical's incumbent workflow: (a) enumerate the incumbent toolchain steps (CAD cleanup, meshing, solver setup, solve, post-processing, report) for a representative cooling task; (b) measure or credibly source wall-clock + engineer-time for each step (published case studies, practitioner interviews, or an actually executed incumbent-workflow run), with provenance for every number; (c) store as data in fs-wedge with uncertainty bounds (a baseline is an ESTIMATED quantity — give it a range, not false precision); (d) update meets_kill_criterion to consume the measured record and refuse a placeholder.

DONE WHEN: CycleTimeBaseline carries measured values with provenance + uncertainty, the placeholder is unreachable in the decision path, and the kill-criterion evaluation logs which baseline record it used.

TESTS: unit tests that a placeholder-flagged baseline is REFUSED by the kill-criterion evaluation with a typed error; serialization round-trip; an e2e script that recomputes the kill criterion from the stored record and prints the full derivation (baseline breakdown, target, measured value, verdict) for auditability.
close_reason: Landed at 224ff739. CycleTimeBaseline is now a six-step sourced envelope (4.5-128 h = 0.5625-16 working days, first-pass iteration of the representative PCB+heatsink CHT task) with per-figure provenance (citation, verbatim quote, URL, authority class, bias caveat) backed by crates/fs-wedge/data/cycle-time-baseline-dossier.md. Sources: Sandia DART SAND2005-4647 (the only genuine time-and-motion study; itself shows thermal is the EXCEPTION to 80%-meshing folklore — post-processing dominates at 37%), 6SigmaET 2018 survey (vendor-run, flagged), Tech-Clarity 2016, peer-reviewed solve wall-clocks (SAE 2025-01-5073, BuildSys'20 Kalibre, IEEE TCAPT 2008); Hughes-2005 '80%' documented as uncited in its primary. evaluate_kill_criterion refuses Placeholder/incomplete/non-measurable with typed errors and returns conservative Met/NotMet/Indeterminate (met only if the LOW bound clears 3x) plus a printed derivation naming the record used; retired 5.0-day figure survives only as RETIRED_PLACEHOLDER_BASELINE proving the refusal drill; audit() + to_json extended. title: Ratify the vertical: decision record in fs-govern/fs-wedge with kill criteria and falsifier
description:
WHY: The program needs ONE ratified vertical so that the schema freeze (e06), RANS rung (e05), Level-C data acquisition (e04), and the cooling fidelity-graph instance (e10) proceed against a stable target. The decision must be recorded the way this project records claims: with inputs, alternatives, kill criteria, and a falsifier — so a future re-evaluation is a data update, not an archaeology project.

WHAT: A ratification record containing: chosen vertical; the measured scoring table it rests on (predecessor tasks); the runner-up and the minority report; the kill criterion (measured cycle-time reduction target and quarters-to-kill) bound to the MEASURED baseline; a named falsifier ("what observed fact would force re-selection", e.g. Level-C thermal datasets prove unobtainable within N months, or measured kernel-readiness gap exceeds budget); and the review date. Register it through fs-govern's proposal/doctrine machinery so it is machine-readable, and mirror the conclusion into fs-wedge data.

DEFAULT EXPECTATION (do not preempt the data): prefer the declared electronics-cooling/thermal family unless the measured comparison selects otherwise; the "thermal design assurance" compromise is an acceptable ratified outcome — it shares e05 kernels 1-6 and defers only the RANS rung.

DONE WHEN: downstream beads cite this record's ID; fs-govern lists it; the falsifier is concrete enough that an agent could evaluate it mechanically in a quarterly review.

TESTS: unit test that the record refuses construction without falsifier/kill-criterion/baseline provenance; e2e governance script listing all program-level decision records and verifying this one's completeness, with verbose field-by-field logging.

title: E10 Fidelity graph: replace the scalar ladder with a context- and QoI-specific model graph
description:
WHY: The current doctrine treats fidelity as a totally ordered ladder (fs-ladder: correlation-Nu < RANS < LES with scalar relative_cost hints), and plan language calls RANS merely a "clearly labeled low-fidelity screen". That ordering is too categorical for industrial engineering: a VALIDATED RANS setup can predict a mean load better than an under-resolved LES; LES carries inflow/wall-model/averaging-time/domain-size errors; different QoIs rank models differently; a model can be high-resolution yet outside its validated context; computational expense is NOT epistemic rank. Fidelity must become a GRAPH whose edges are empirical claims.

TARGET DESIGN: nodes = models (correlation families, low-Re RANS variants, buoyancy/radiation treatments, LBM, surrogates, BEM); edges carry (cost model, discrepancy evidence between the pair, validation domain, and the CONDITIONS under which one model is more informative than the other, per QoI and regime). Selection = admission query (fs-regime distance-to-validity) + discrepancy evidence (fs-evidence DiscrepancyModel fit on FidelityPairs) + cost (fs-plan CostModel), not index comparison. fs-ladder's Transfer machinery (prolongate/restrict) remains the state-map substrate between adjacent models.

CHILDREN: fs-ladder v2 graph data model (backward-compatible: a ladder is a path graph); empirical edge population from corpus runs (adjacent-fidelity probes); escalation-policy integration (certify_or_escalate + EscalationAdvice::EscalateModelFidelity route through the graph, choosing the CHEAPEST edge that fixes the dominant uncertainty); the cooling-vertical graph instance.

DONE WHEN: for at least two cooling QoIs (max junction temp, pressure drop), the graph selects DIFFERENT models under different regimes with recorded justification, and a case exists where the calibrated correlation legitimately outranks a higher-cost model in its validated domain — demonstrating cost != authority. Related existing beads: qmao.7 (ladder registry, closed), t2td (FidelitySheaf crosswalk, open), lmp4.16 (greedy ladder planner, closed).

## Success Criteria

Rollup acceptance requires .10.1 through .10.4 to supply the fidelity-graph schema, context and QoI dependent edge admission, planner semantics, and a complete cooling instance showing that cost and authority are separate dimensions. The joined graph artifact must bind model and edge versions, applicability predicates, QoIs, resource estimates, calibration and validation evidence, discrepancy, escalation and refusal rules, provenance, and deterministic tie breaks; disconnected, cyclic-authority, or incomparable alternatives must yield actionable diagnostics. The terminal owner is .10.4 for scripts/ci/e2e_cooling_fidelity_graph.sh, including unit, boundary, property, metamorphic, mutation, fault, cancellation, resource-budget, planner-replay, and stale-edge tests with bounded decision logs. E10 closes only after the configured DSR lane validates the immutable graph and repeated planning result; no inexpensive model, frontier rung, or learned proposer may acquire authority solely through cost, availability, or graph reachability.

title: fs-ladder v2: fidelity GRAPH data model (edges carry cost, discrepancy, validity, informativeness conditions)
description:
WHY: fs-ladder's total order (index-ordered rungs, scalar relative_cost) structurally cannot express "the calibrated correlation outranks RANS inside its validated domain for T_mean, but not for recirculation-zone T_max" — which is the actual shape of engineering model choice. The graph model is the substrate for honest escalation (e10_3) and for the corpus to TEACH the system which model to trust where (e10_2).

WHAT: (a) Data model: nodes = model identities (with ModelCard refs); directed edges between comparable models carry: cost relation (fs-plan CostModel refs, per size/regime — not a scalar constant); discrepancy evidence between the pair (DiscrepancyModel refs from FidelityPairs, per QoI); each edge's validity domain (where the comparison has evidence); informativeness conditions (typed predicates over regime + QoI declaring when the target model is MORE informative than the source — empty predicate = unknown, which is an honest state, not a default ordering); (b) backward compatibility: a Ladder is exactly a path graph with total-order predicates — LadderRegistry::cht() and existing consumers keep working via a lossless embedding, migrated not broken; (c) Transfer machinery generalizes to edges (prolongate/restrict along any evidenced edge); (d) queries: best-model-for(QoI, regime, budget), cheapest-adequate, and explain (why this model here) — all deterministic with recorded reasoning; (e) serialization + identity for ledger/report.

DONE WHEN: graph model shipped; ladder embedding proven; queries answer with recorded reasoning on a synthetic graph; the CHT instance migrates.

TESTS: unit (graph construction validation — no self-loops, card refs resolve; ladder embedding round-trip; query determinism incl. tie-breaks); property (query monotonicity: adding evidence to an edge never makes explanations less specific; removing an edge never IMPROVES a recommendation); e2e: synthetic 4-node graph exercising every query with full reasoning logs.

title: Populate fidelity-graph edges empirically from corpus runs (adjacent-fidelity probes as data)
description:
WHY: A fidelity graph with declared edges is the old ladder wearing new clothes. Edges must be EARNED from data: paired runs of adjacent models on shared cases (corpus Level A/B/C) yield FidelityPairs whose fitted discrepancy + measured cost become the edge content, per QoI and regime. This is also where "computational expense is not epistemic rank" becomes measurable fact.

WHAT: (a) Probe campaigns: for each candidate edge in the cooling graph (correlation<->thermal-LBM natural-convection overlap now; correlation<->RANS when e05_8 lands; linearized<->full radiation from e05_4; homogenized<->resolved PCB from e05_6), run both models on every shared-validity corpus case, recording per-QoI pairs + measured costs into the ledger; (b) edge fitting: DiscrepancyModel fits per (edge, QoI) with regime binning (e07_2 machinery — partition-enforced, held-out-checked); informativeness predicates derived where data supports them (model B beats A beyond envelope X in regime R) and left UNKNOWN where it does not — unknown edges are visible gaps that corpus growth fills, and the gap list is itself an output steering e04 acquisition; (c) cost models fit from the same runs (fs-plan power-law fits with residual bands); (d) refresh discipline: edges carry the corpus version + run set they were fit on; stale edges (corpus grew, kernels changed) flagged by a staleness check like fs-plan's freshness machinery.

DONE WHEN: >=3 real edges populated with fitted discrepancy + cost + explicit unknowns; the gap list renders; staleness flagging works.

TESTS: unit (pair extraction correctness; edge-fit plumbing; staleness triggers); statistical (synthetic two-model truth recovered into correct edge content); e2e: one full probe campaign logging per-case pairs, fits, informativeness derivations, and the resulting graph diff.

title: Escalation through the graph: certify-or-escalate + EscalationAdvice choose the cheapest adequate edge
description:
WHY: Escalation advice today is directional (EscalateModelFidelity) and certify-or-escalate is binary (use surrogate | escalate). With a graph, escalation becomes a ROUTED decision: when model-form dominates the budget, move along the specific edge whose discrepancy evidence addresses the failing QoI in the current regime, at the lowest cost that achieves decision adequacy — and REFUSE with a gap report when no evidenced edge helps (the graph's unknown edges become explicit evidence-acquisition demands rather than blind escalation).

WHAT: (a) Escalation planner: input = current model, failing QoI + its budget breakdown (E08), regime, decision tolerance, session budget; output = ranked edge walk (possibly multi-step) with predicted post-escalation uncertainty (from edge discrepancy evidence) and cost, or EscalationGap{missing edges, suggested probes} when the graph cannot help; the prediction is checked after the escalated run (predicted-vs-actual improvement recorded — the planner's own calibration becomes data, feeding e14 metrics discipline); (b) integration: fs-surrogate certify_or_escalate gains a graph-aware variant (Decision::Escalate carries the planned edge); e06_5 orchestration honors escalation plans within budget; EscalationAdvice::EscalateModelFidelity routes here; (c) anti-thrash: hysteresis and a max-escalation budget per run (no oscillating between models on noise — borrow fs-spectral's hysteresis discipline); (d) every escalation ledgered with its reasoning.

DONE WHEN: a fixture where correlation fails on a recirculation QoI escalates along the evidenced edge (or reports the gap pre-e05_8, which is the honest current answer); planner-calibration recording works; anti-thrash proven.

TESTS: unit (ranking arithmetic; gap reporting; hysteresis; budget caps); integration (certify-or-escalate variant compatibility with existing consumers); e2e: escalation scenarios (helpful edge / no edge / budget-blocked) logging plans, predictions, actuals, and calibration records.

title: The cooling fidelity graph instance: models, edges, and the demonstration that cost != authority
description:
WHY: The doctrine and machinery need their production instance. The cooling vertical's model set is rich enough to be a real graph (multiple convection treatments, two radiation rungs, two PCB treatments, natural-convection overlap between correlation and thermal-LBM) and it is where the wedge's commercial claim (cheap rungs that are TRUSTWORTHY where validated) becomes demonstrable.

WHAT: (a) Assemble the graph: nodes = {correlation rung (e05_2+e05_5+e05_7 assembly), thermal-LBM natural-convection (fs-lbm), linearized radiation, gray-diffuse radiation, homogenized PCB, resolved-stackup PCB, [RANS when e05_8 lands], lumped transient [staged]}; edges from e10_2 probe campaigns; every node carded; (b) the flagship demonstrations, kept as tested artifacts: (1) cost!=authority — a regime + QoI where the calibrated correlation carries TIGHTER validated uncertainty than a nominally higher-fidelity model outside its validated domain, with the graph query explaining why; (2) regime-dependent choice — the same QoI routed to different models in different regimes (natural-vs-forced convection crossover is the natural candidate); (3) honest gap — a (QoI, regime) with no adequate evidenced model, rendered as an acquisition demand; (c) product wiring: e06 fidelity selection ("auto") consults this instance; the report names the chosen model + graph reasoning per QoI.

DONE WHEN: instance assembled with >=5 nodes and >=3 evidenced edges; all three demonstrations automated and green; product auto-selection consumes it; fs-wedge's kernel-readiness matrix (e01) updated to cite it.

TESTS: instance-validation battery (cards resolve, edges fresh, embedding of the legacy cht() ladder intact); the three demonstrations as standing e2e tests with full reasoning logs; graph-diff regression (unexpected edge/node changes fail loudly, golden-bump discipline).
acceptance_criteria: Assemble the cooling fidelity graph with at least five fully carded nodes and three evidenced edges spanning correlation, thermal-LBM, radiation, PCB, and admitted frontier rungs, then retain demonstrations of cost not equaling authority, regime-dependent choice, and an honest evidence gap. Unit tests validate node and edge cards, QoI/context predicates, legacy-rung embedding, freshness, reachability, and deterministic tie breaks; boundary tests cover no path, one path, expired edge, overlapping regimes, equal cost, and unsupported QoI. Property tests require removal or weakening of evidence never to increase authority; metamorphic tests cover graph serialization, node ordering, and equivalent unit/context representation; mutants that rank solely by cost, use a stale edge, hide a gap, or invent reachability must fail. Corrupt cards, cycles, cancellation, timeout, memory and search caps, missing capabilities, and log overflow must return bounded acquisition or refusal diagnostics. This Bead owns scripts/ci/e2e_cooling_fidelity_graph.sh and the immutable graph plus three demonstration bundles consumed by product auto-selection. Graph-diff replay and the configured DSR gate must pass; a nominally higher-fidelity or faster node gains no authority outside its admitted evidence.
