Display tone mapping must not feed back into thermal emissivity.

A fretted string is a pre-stressed elastic body with distributed mass and stiffness,
supports/bridge/body coupling, and unilateral contact with frets and compliant tissue.
The finger is a geometry/material/contact description with a force or motion input.
Fret pressure changes contact area, effective constraints, damping, and tension.
Pitch is an outcome or an explicitly posed initialization target with force accounting.
Changing material at fixed end displacement differs from retensioning to fixed pitch.

A wound string requires winding/core geometry or a declared homogenized model.
Pluck, bow, hammer, and airflow are physical excitations of reusable components.
Body radiation and bridge losses remain coupled and separately identifiable.
Thermal expansion, relaxation, damage, or melting updates the same state.

A duct instrument is gas geometry, elastic/rigid walls, openings, and nonlinear excitation.
Reed contact, jet-edge feedback, lip valves, and tone-hole networks retain generic owners.
Humidity changes the admitted gas state and propagation; it is not merely a detune knob.
Wall-material changes may be small in a rigid-wall limit and substantial outside it.
The simulation must predict the appropriate sensitivity rather than amplify every swap.

### 7.3 Lessons from the jazz project

The related repository is `/Users/jemanuel/projects/jazz_chord_progression_editor_html`.
Its score/control scheduling, playable interaction, synthesis comparisons, and listening
workflows are useful consumer requirements and experimental-design inspiration.
Its synthesis approximations are not evidence of bottom-up material fidelity.
Integration must keep score intent separate from excitation and physical response.
No sampled timbre or authored filter becomes a constitutive property through import.
Useful concrete references are `dsp/concert-grand/src/plucked_v2.rs`
(finite-duration pick contact, retained sympathetic state, passive bridge),
`scripts/physical-foundry-plate-modes.ts` (geometry/material-derived plate operators),
and `src/audio/physical-realization.ts` (immutable excitation scheduling).
Its `flute_v2.rs::tuned_sound_speed` and `RESIDUAL_PULL_CENTS` alter sound speed
by note to reach a target pitch; that mechanism is excluded from this physical lane.
Its `libm` and mutable-global runtime patterns are also not implementation templates.
The extraction map in `docs/PHS1_FRANKENSIM_EXTRACTION_MAP.md` describes an older
FrankenSim snapshot; its claims about missing acoustic/viscoelastic owners are stale.

Direct verification and useful logging:
Use existing unit/integration seams for pure query, constitutive, and operator behavior.
Use manufactured/analytical references for implementation accuracy and refinement.
Use independent measured data for physical validation over its actual specimen/domain.
Pair deterministic repeat tests with an independent physical check so a golden cannot freeze a bug.

For each integrated run retain concise, diagnosable records:

- scenario and comparison policy; geometry/material/interface/model identities;
- source claim selection and the actual state points used;
- mesh, time, nonlinear, coupling, reduction, and observation error controls;
- accepted physical time, conserved quantities, loss channels, and event outcomes;
- observer geometry, pressure/radiance units, filtering/exposure conventions;
- compute budget, machine profile, interruption/restart outcome, and artifact locations.

These are fields in existing result/log conventions, not a new evidence platform.
Test-only plots and diagnostic sensors must not mutate the production trajectory.
An approximate pressure waveform cannot be labeled an exact sound-wave solution.
A simulation-only measurement deck cannot replace independent experimental acquisition.

Implementation rules:
- Work on `main`; preserve unrelated work; reserve only owned paths when mail is healthy.
- Runtime remains safe Rust with the existing Franken-only dependency direction.
- Use existing contracts, quantity/evidence/state carriers, and test seams.
- Source/current-static evidence does not establish executed or experimental proof.
- Poll `Cx` at bounded work boundaries; fail transactionally before publishing partial state.
- No arbitrary material-name inference, substituted data, or output-driven physical tuning.
- Focused G0/G1/G3 tests precede any larger declared G2/G4/G5 campaign.
- Use RCH for narrow heavy Cargo probes and DSR for a coherent repo-level gate.
- No new validator framework, dashboard, or ceremony is an acceptance substitute.

title: Material reality F: Interfaces and physical observations
description:
This is a residual implementation slice in the owner's integrated material-reality program.
Objects are geometry/composition/material/process/environment/excitation descriptions.
Generic physical owners compute motion, heat, deformation, phase, pressure and radiance.
No instrument-name solver, standalone Euler physics engine, hidden tuning constant, or
output-driven animation/audio effect is an acceptable implementation.
Constitutive measurements and numerical models have explicit domains and uncertainty;
bottom-up causality is not a claim of exact prediction of all reality.
Material definitions are immutable; specimen/runtime state evolves; observers read accepted state.
Missing required data/model remains a named blocker. An absence report cannot close a delivery
whose acceptance requires working physics. Research overrides never inherit sourced authority.
Existing broad program IDs are coordination anchors, not blanket implementation prerequisites.


Group outcome and physical context:
Surface state includes material identity, orientation/lay, roughness spectrum and bandwidth,
coating thickness, oxide/contamination, wetness, wear, temperature, and relevant history.
The state can vary spatially and evolves under domain-owned laws.
Friction, contact conductance, electrical contact, wetting, and BSDF models read that state.
They remain distinct constitutive laws; one empirical conversion cannot replace them all.

There is no universal mapping from Ra to optical microfacet roughness or friction.
The roughness measurement scale and slope/spectral statistics matter.
A conversion requires a sourced/calibrated model with an applicability domain.
Contact angle belongs to a solid/liquid/gas system and can have advancing/receding history.
Restitution and modal damping are often system-dependent observations, not bulk constants.

Recompute or update structural response when geometry, pre-stress, or material changes.
Reduced bases need a validated update/transfer method, including near mode crossings.
Do not insert an arbitrary crossfade as a physical transition.
Sound generation uses the actual force/velocity or pressure/volume-flow histories.
A fracture or splash needs a resolved or explicitly modeled source mechanism.
It cannot be supplied by a prerecorded effect.

All observations use one accepted physical clock and state sequence.
Rendering may interpolate poses for exposure integration with a documented approximation.
Audio resampling needs explicit bandwidth, antialiasing, and latency treatment.
Microphone distance/direction, acoustic boundaries, and environmental propagation matter.
Camera exposure, spectrum, polarization support, and display conversion are observations.
Display tone mapping must not feed back into thermal emissivity.

Deliveries:
- frankensim-material-reality-ui2if.6.1: Admit anisotropic and locally non-isothermal contact
- frankensim-material-reality-ui2if.6.2: Generalize structural volume and boundary observation geometry
- frankensim-material-reality-ui2if.6.3: Share evolving surface state across domain laws
- frankensim-material-reality-ui2if.6.4: Resolve physically supported optical and thermal appearance
- frankensim-material-reality-ui2if.6.5: Render the actual deformed and phase-evolving surface
- frankensim-material-reality-ui2if.6.6: Derive microphone pressure and synchronize physical observations
- frankensim-material-reality-ui2if.6.7: Couple geometry-derived exterior and gap-fluid forces

Complete this group only when its required concrete deliveries pass their own acceptance. Parent-child hierarchy organizes work; explicit blocks edges determine readiness.

- Work on `main`; preserve unrelated work; reserve only owned paths when mail is healthy.
- Runtime remains safe Rust with the existing Franken-only dependency direction.
- Use existing contracts, quantity/evidence/state carriers, and test seams.
- Source/current-static evidence does not establish executed or experimental proof.
- Poll `Cx` at bounded work boundaries; fail transactionally before publishing partial state.
- No arbitrary material-name inference, substituted data, or output-driven physical tuning.
- Focused G0/G1/G3 tests precede any larger declared G2/G4/G5 campaign.
- Use RCH for narrow heavy Cargo probes and DSR for a coherent repo-level gate.
- No new validator framework, dashboard, or ceremony is an acceptance substitute.

Group outcome and physical context:
Keep the existing `PropertyKey`, `PropertyClaim`, and `ValidityDomain` ownership.
Add quantity-kind distinctions where equal dimensions do not establish equal meaning.
Examples include energy versus torque and absolute temperature versus temperature difference.
Hardness must retain scale, indenter/load/dwell, and test context.
Acoustic attenuation must distinguish amplitude from intensity and nepers from decibels.
Optical extinction coefficient must not alias thermal conductivity.
Frequency must distinguish angular and cyclic conventions at adapters.
Strain/stress tensors must declare engineering versus tensor shear and basis ordering.

Multiaxis responses require complete support domains, not only independent bounding boxes.
An unmeasured corner of a temperature/frequency/moisture box is not automatically supported.
Interpolation stays inside an admitted source/model domain.
Extrapolation requires an explicit model, uncertainty, and caller policy; no implicit extension.
Bounded support, missing data, and uncertain correlation remain distinct query outcomes.

Full tensors carry basis/frame identifiers, symmetry class, and transformation receipts.
Rotate second- and fourth-order quantities with their appropriate transformation laws.
Do not rotate a scalar array as if it were a tensor without declaring its convention.
Anisotropic coupled blocks need the correct stability condition for the whole law.
Individual off-diagonal blocks need not be positive definite.

Track kinetic, elastic/internal-memory, thermodynamic, field, surface, and potential energy
only where represented by the active model and with explicit reference conventions.
Sensible and latent components are subaccounts of one thermodynamic potential;
their sum must equal that potential, and neither is added again to the global total.
Internal transfers cancel when the accounting boundary encloses both participants.
External work, heat, radiation, mass/species transport, and control input remain explicit.
Numerical dissipation has its own account; it is not material damping or physical heating.

Frictional work has one debit and named thermal/other physical destinations.
Radiated acoustic energy must be distinguished from an uncoupled diagnostic microphone.
If a one-way radiation approximation is used, its missing back-reaction must be assessed.
Do not add modal radiation damping and separately debit the same outgoing field twice.
Thermoelastic damping must not be added when resolved thermomechanical transport includes it.
Latent heat is already inside enthalpy; do not add it again as an independent heat capacity.

Thermal entropy uses actual boundary temperatures and the chosen thermodynamic chart.
`temperature * heat_flow` is not a power-conjugate port.
Temperature pairs with entropy flow; ordinary heat flow already has units of power.
Open-stream enthalpy already includes pressure-flow work in its declared convention.
Chemical, electrical, and mechanical splits follow the existing extension charter.
A lossless Dirac interconnection alone does not establish discrete coupled passivity.

Prefer independently inspectable primary measurements and government technical datasets.
Handbook values can support bounded engineering estimates with their actual provenance.
Preserve method, specimen, process, uncertainty, covariance, censoring, and unit basis.
Store typical, tolerance, confidence, credible, and design-allowable quantities distinctly.
Do not convert an unstated fit error into a statistical confidence interval.
Do not average incompatible specimens, test scales, moisture bases, or processing states.

Dataset discovery does not establish redistribution rights.
Record the actual source terms before embedding data in redistributable packs.
If a source is restricted, retain a citation/gap or an authorized local-only artifact.
Source acquisition tasks may close their research portion with an honest absence finding;

Group outcome and physical context:
### 7.1 Parameterized disc on a deformable, supported surface

Input: geometry charts, material cards, spatial frames, interface preparation,
support/joint conditions, gravity, initial configuration/velocities, and environment.
Mass and inertia derive from geometry and density, with an explicit comparison policy.
Comparisons distinguish equal geometry, equal mass, equal initial angular speed,
and equal initial energy; changing one does not secretly enforce another.

Dynamics combines rigid/deformable response, finite-patch contact, slip/rolling,
air/gap effects inside their domains, base compliance, and thermal feedback.
Finite-patch laws consume actual material response rather than a bulk friction constant.
Sound is generated from disc/base/interface/fluid histories and transported to receivers.
Images follow those same shapes, temperatures, interfaces, and optical states.

Acceptance has four successive rungs:

1. Ordinary solid-state parameter/material swaps in supported regimes.
2. Heating with thermal expansion, altered contact/modes, and independent base temperature.
3. Softening/creep/plastic deformation with acoustic/visual feedback.
4. Partial melting, loss of support, free-surface evolution, and continued observations.

No rung inherits experimental validation from a lower numerical rung.
Spin time and rankings need independent measurements with uncertainty and holdouts.
Euler-specific scientific claims remain owned by the existing scientific campaign.

### 7.2 Excited elastic body/string and gas-filled duct

A fretted string is a pre-stressed elastic body with distributed mass and stiffness,
supports/bridge/body coupling, and unilateral contact with frets and compliant tissue.
The finger is a geometry/material/contact description with a force or motion input.
Fret pressure changes contact area, effective constraints, damping, and tension.
Pitch is an outcome or an explicitly posed initialization target with force accounting.
Changing material at fixed end displacement differs from retensioning to fixed pitch.

A wound string requires winding/core geometry or a declared homogenized model.
Pluck, bow, hammer, and airflow are physical excitations of reusable components.
Body radiation and bridge losses remain coupled and separately identifiable.
Thermal expansion, relaxation, damage, or melting updates the same state.

A duct instrument is gas geometry, elastic/rigid walls, openings, and nonlinear excitation.
Reed contact, jet-edge feedback, lip valves, and tone-hole networks retain generic owners.
Humidity changes the admitted gas state and propagation; it is not merely a detune knob.
Wall-material changes may be small in a rigid-wall limit and substantial outside it.
The simulation must predict the appropriate sensitivity rather than amplify every swap.

### 7.3 Lessons from the jazz project

The related repository is `/Users/jemanuel/projects/jazz_chord_progression_editor_html`.
Its score/control scheduling, playable interaction, synthesis comparisons, and listening
workflows are useful consumer requirements and experimental-design inspiration.

Physical and architectural context:
### 7.1 Parameterized disc on a deformable, supported surface

Input: geometry charts, material cards, spatial frames, interface preparation,
support/joint conditions, gravity, initial configuration/velocities, and environment.
Mass and inertia derive from geometry and density, with an explicit comparison policy.
Comparisons distinguish equal geometry, equal mass, equal initial angular speed,
and equal initial energy; changing one does not secretly enforce another.

Dynamics combines rigid/deformable response, finite-patch contact, slip/rolling,
air/gap effects inside their domains, base compliance, and thermal feedback.
Finite-patch laws consume actual material response rather than a bulk friction constant.
Sound is generated from disc/base/interface/fluid histories and transported to receivers.
Images follow those same shapes, temperatures, interfaces, and optical states.

Acceptance has four successive rungs:

1. Ordinary solid-state parameter/material swaps in supported regimes.
2. Heating with thermal expansion, altered contact/modes, and independent base temperature.
3. Softening/creep/plastic deformation with acoustic/visual feedback.
4. Partial melting, loss of support, free-surface evolution, and continued observations.

No rung inherits experimental validation from a lower numerical rung.
Spin time and rankings need independent measurements with uncertainty and holdouts.
Euler-specific scientific claims remain owned by the existing scientific campaign.

### 7.2 Excited elastic body/string and gas-filled duct

A fretted string is a pre-stressed elastic body with distributed mass and stiffness,
supports/bridge/body coupling, and unilateral contact with frets and compliant tissue.
The finger is a geometry/material/contact description with a force or motion input.
Fret pressure changes contact area, effective constraints, damping, and tension.
Pitch is an outcome or an explicitly posed initialization target with force accounting.
Changing material at fixed end displacement differs from retensioning to fixed pitch.

A wound string requires winding/core geometry or a declared homogenized model.
Pluck, bow, hammer, and airflow are physical excitations of reusable components.
Body radiation and bridge losses remain coupled and separately identifiable.
Thermal expansion, relaxation, damage, or melting updates the same state.

A duct instrument is gas geometry, elastic/rigid walls, openings, and nonlinear excitation.
Reed contact, jet-edge feedback, lip valves, and tone-hole networks retain generic owners.
Humidity changes the admitted gas state and propagation; it is not merely a detune knob.
Wall-material changes may be small in a rigid-wall limit and substantial outside it.
The simulation must predict the appropriate sensitivity rather than amplify every swap.

and equal initial energy; changing one does not secretly enforce another.

air/gap effects inside their domains, base compliance, and thermal feedback.
Finite-patch laws consume actual material response rather than a bulk friction constant.

Fret pressure changes contact area, effective constraints, damping, and tension.
Pitch is an outcome or an explicitly posed initialization target with force accounting.
Changing material at fixed end displacement differs from retensioning to fixed pitch.

A wound string requires winding/core geometry or a declared homogenized model.
Pluck, bow, hammer, and airflow are physical excitations of reusable components.
Body radiation and bridge losses remain coupled and separately identifiable.
Thermal expansion, relaxation, damage, or melting updates the same state.

Reed contact, jet-edge feedback, lip valves, and tone-hole networks retain generic owners.

Physical and architectural context:
### 7.1 Parameterized disc on a deformable, supported surface

Input: geometry charts, material cards, spatial frames, interface preparation,
support/joint conditions, gravity, initial configuration/velocities, and environment.
Mass and inertia derive from geometry and density, with an explicit comparison policy.
Comparisons distinguish equal geometry, equal mass, equal initial angular speed,
and equal initial energy; changing one does not secretly enforce another.

Dynamics combines rigid/deformable response, finite-patch contact, slip/rolling,
air/gap effects inside their domains, base compliance, and thermal feedback.
Finite-patch laws consume actual material response rather than a bulk friction constant.
Sound is generated from disc/base/interface/fluid histories and transported to receivers.
Images follow those same shapes, temperatures, interfaces, and optical states.

Acceptance has four successive rungs:

1. Ordinary solid-state parameter/material swaps in supported regimes.
2. Heating with thermal expansion, altered contact/modes, and independent base temperature.
3. Softening/creep/plastic deformation with acoustic/visual feedback.
4. Partial melting, loss of support, free-surface evolution, and continued observations.

No rung inherits experimental validation from a lower numerical rung.
Spin time and rankings need independent measurements with uncertainty and holdouts.
Euler-specific scientific claims remain owned by the existing scientific campaign.

### 7.2 Excited elastic body/string and gas-filled duct

A fretted string is a pre-stressed elastic body with distributed mass and stiffness,
supports/bridge/body coupling, and unilateral contact with frets and compliant tissue.
The finger is a geometry/material/contact description with a force or motion input.
Fret pressure changes contact area, effective constraints, damping, and tension.
Pitch is an outcome or an explicitly posed initialization target with force accounting.
Changing material at fixed end displacement differs from retensioning to fixed pitch.

A wound string requires winding/core geometry or a declared homogenized model.
Pluck, bow, hammer, and airflow are physical excitations of reusable components.
Body radiation and bridge losses remain coupled and separately identifiable.
Thermal expansion, relaxation, damage, or melting updates the same state.

A duct instrument is gas geometry, elastic/rigid walls, openings, and nonlinear excitation.
Reed contact, jet-edge feedback, lip valves, and tone-hole networks retain generic owners.
Humidity changes the admitted gas state and propagation; it is not merely a detune knob.
Wall-material changes may be small in a rigid-wall limit and substantial outside it.
The simulation must predict the appropriate sensitivity rather than amplify every swap.

workflows are useful consumer requirements and experimental-design inspiration.

(finite-duration pick contact, retained sympathetic state, passive bridge),

title: fs-project containment binding: upgrade plane/containment tests to fs-ivl exact predicates (named follow-up of 21fa0a50)
description:
Follow-up named in commit 21fa0a50 (fs-project containment-bound conduction interface resolution) and in the rustdoc of `resolve_conduction_interface_pairs` (crates/fs-project/src/assignment.rs, "upgrading the predicate to fs-ivl exact arithmetic is tracked follow-up"). This bead is that tracking record.

CURRENT STATE: containment binding evaluates "boundary sub-triangle lies inside the outward-oriented source triangle" in plain f64 arithmetic against EXACT ZERO: a recovered boundary vertex must be bitwise on the source triangle's supporting plane and its barycentric/edge-orientation tests must not be negative. Off-plane recovery points (rounded by fs-mesh facet recovery / Steiner insertion) REFUSE rather than bind approximately. That is the fail-closed direction, but it means a geometrically valid recovered face whose vertex sits one ulp off the plane cannot bind, and a face whose f64 orientation test rounds the wrong way across zero could in principle bind or refuse inconsistently.

SCOPE: replace the f64 plane-membership + in-triangle tests in `resolve_conduction_interface_pairs` with fs-ivl exact predicates (`orient` on the source plane, and edge-side orientation for containment) so the binding decision is exact for every representable input: no ulp-dependent refusals, no rounding-dependent binds. Keep the refusal shape (off-plane vertex still refuses; it is now an EXACT off-plane, not a rounded one). Do not widen to tolerance matching.

DONE-WHEN: (1) predicates route through fs-ivl exact predicates; (2) a regression that plants a vertex one ulp off the plane and proves the OLD f64 path would have refused (or bound) inconsistently while the exact path decides deterministically; (3) the canonical multi-region-interface fixture still binds 4 pairs (fan) and the fs-cli G0 contact gate stays green; (4) CONTRACT.md for fs-project names the exact-predicate authority in the containment rule and drops the "f64 exact-zero" caveat.
close_reason: Verified resolve_conduction_interface_pairs routes plane and closed-triangle containment through fs-ivl exact predicates (orient3d and orient2d), updated containment_tests in crates/fs-project/src/assignment.rs with unconditional off-plane and in-plane vs legacy-f64 and 1-ulp regressions, updated crates/fs-project/CONTRACT.md to name fs-ivl exact predicates and drop the f64 exact-zero caveat, and fixed contact_inputs.rs substring-collision test bug. Verified fs-project lib (43/43) and assignment (22/22) pass.

title: fs-convection developing-card Gz bridge is not machine-distinguishable from source-table data, and the plate-fin falsifier already mislabels a bridge value as sourced
description:
Found verifying the frankensim-7na5f closure (fc433a2c) against HEAD. The card
itself is SOUND and the closure was honest -- refusals are exact and narrow, the
Pr=0.72 and aspect=0.5 degenerate intervals genuinely refuse rather than
silently evaluating a nearby row (the defect class this crate exists to
prevent, verified CLOSED), flow sensitivity through Gz is real, and the source
knots are transcribed into the test INDEPENDENTLY of the implementation array,
which is better than most spot values in this crate. This bead is one specific
open risk plus its already-realized consequence.

(1) THE BRIDGE CANNOT BE TOLD FROM SOURCE DATA AT RUNTIME.
CONTRACT invariant 6 (CONTRACT.md:66-70) declares that the card executes the
Shah-London Chapter VII Table 52 alpha*=0.5, Pr=0.72 row for Gz in [10,220],
and that Gz in [0.01,10] is "a declared linear bridge ... not represented as a
source-published curve". The code matches that prose: knots start at Gz=10
(lib.rs:702-707) and the bridge (lib.rs:709-712) is linear in Gz anchored on
rectangular_laminar_cwt(0.5) -- the fully developed card's own function, not a
re-typed literal, so the join at Gz=10 is continuous to ~1 ulp.

But NusseltEvaluation exposes only card / evidence / groups (lib.rs:430-447),
and all three are identical in kind on both sides of Gz=10:
  - ModelEvidence::from_card (fs-evidence/src/lib.rs:614-622) copies STATIC card
    fields plus in_domain. There is no per-evaluation field. in_domain == true
    inside the bridge.
  - discrepancy_rel == 0.15 and DiscrepancyBasis::EngineeringAllowance in both
    regions (lib.rs:877).
  - the provenance hash differs per point (lib.rs:603-621) but carries no region
    tag.
The only runtime signal is groups()["Gz"] < 10.0, and the threshold 10 appears
nowhere except inside a prose assumption string (lib.rs:868). A caller doing
programmatic evidence inspection CANNOT distinguish an interpolated bridge value
from a sourced one.

This is not an edge case. [0.01,10] is 4.5% of the admitted Gz range linearly
but 69% of it in LOG measure. An ordinary point -- L/Dh=500, Re=1000, Pr=0.72,
Gz=1.44 -- lands in the bridge and returns in_domain=true unmarked.

(2) IT HAS ALREADY PRODUCED A MISLABELED ASSERTION IN THE TREE.
crates/fs-airflow/tests/plate_fin_e2e.rs:652-660, the wrong-D_h falsifier, halves
D_h -- which halves Re and doubles L/Dh, so Gz drops to a QUARTER. Solving the
fixture's own fan/network system (parallel leakage 1.6e11 + channel 1e10,
fan-law Q proportional to s and p to s^2, D_h = 3.2/2048, L/D_h = 50,
aspect = 0.5): the nominal runs are Re ~ 824/1099/1374 giving Gz ~
11.87/15.83/19.78, and the wrong-D_h case is Gz ~ 3.96 -- INSIDE THE BRIDGE.
The model reproduces the fixture's own independent assertion that speed 2.75
yields Re > 2300 (computed 3022), so the numbers are trustworthy.
The assertion message at plate_fin_e2e.rs:659 reads "the wrong-D_h SOURCE-TABLE
coefficient must change through both Nu(Gz) and 1/D_h". That value is produced
entirely by the declared non-source bridge. The test text mislabels a bridge
value as sourced -- exactly what invariant 6 exists to prevent.

(3) THE ONLY RUNTIME CARRIER OF INVARIANT 6 IS PINNED BY NO TEST.
grep for "bridge" across crates/ returns exactly three hits: CONTRACT.md:68,
CONTRACT.md:128, and lib.rs:868. rectangular_developing_card_retains_its_narrow_
source_authority (tests/correlations.rs:273-307) pins "simultaneously
developing", "channel-average" and "array-interference" but NOT the bridge
disclosure. Deleting lib.rs:868 breaks nothing and invariant 6's central
no-claim silently becomes false.

(4) CONTRACT PRECISION. Invariant 6 says the card "executes only the ... Table
52 row for Gz in [10,220]". At Gz=15 it executes a CHORD between two rows, not
"the row". The interpolation variable (linear in Gz, not log-Gz, not x*) is
stated in formula() at lib.rs:114-116 but appears in the CONTRACT only as a cost
statement under Cancellation behavior ("one bounded 14-knot lookup",
CONTRACT.md:96-98). Because Nu(Gz) is concave (~Gz^0.2..0.35), linear-in-Gz
chords systematically UNDERESTIMATE between knots -- about 0.9% low at Gz=15
versus a power law through the bracketing knots. Well inside the 0.15 allowance;
the sign of the bias is simply undeclared. The interpolant is also C0 only:
dNu/dGz jumps ~25% at Gz=20. Harmless today (the plate-fin fixture evaluates h
once, outside the fixed point) but undeclared.

(5) KNOT COVERAGE. tests/correlations.rs:310-323 owns its own literals and does
NOT read NUSSELT_KNOTS -- a real transcription check. But only 3 of 14 knots are
covered (10, 20, 100). A typo in any of the other eleven (5.23, 5.61, 5.95,
6.27, 6.88, 7.91, 8.37, 8.80, 9.20, 9.60, 10.00) is caught by nothing. Also
CONTRACT.md:115-116 says "four Shah-London Table 52 points, including one
interpolation midpoint" -- that is four points of which only three are Table 52
points, and the midpoint (15.0, 4.495) is exactly (4.20+4.79)/2, i.e. an
implementation restatement of lib.rs:715-718 listed among source checks.

DONE WHEN
  1. A bridge evaluation is machine-distinguishable from a table evaluation.
     Either add a runtime marker (e.g. a source_region enum on
     NusseltEvaluation, or a distinct DiscrepancyBasis/assumption carried into
     ModelEvidence), or narrow the admitted Gz domain to [10,220] and force
     callers below it to select the fully developed card explicitly. Prefer the
     marker: the bridge is genuinely useful, it just must not be anonymous.
  2. plate_fin_e2e.rs:659's message stops calling a bridge value "source-table",
     and that fixture asserts which region it is evaluating in.
  3. A test pins the lib.rs:868 bridge-disclosure assumption string, so deleting
     invariant 6's runtime carrier fails.
  4. Invariant 6 says "linearly interpolates between Table 52 rows" rather than
     "executes only the row", and the CONTRACT states the interpolation variable
     and the undeclared concavity bias sign.
  5. Either the remaining eleven knots get independent literals, or the CONTRACT
     states the 3/14 coverage plainly. Fix the "four Table 52 points" phrasing.

FLAGGED FOR THE RECORD, UNFALSIFIABLE IN-TREE: the knot grid looks re-gridded
rather than transcribed. Two smells. (a) The uniform Gz abscissa (10-steps then
20-steps) inverts to x* = 0.1, 0.05, 0.0333, 0.025, 0.02, 0.01667, 0.0125, 0.01,
0.00833, 0.00714, 0.00625, 0.00556, 0.005, 0.004545 -- an improbable published
grid for Shah-London, whose entry-region tables are tabulated in x* at round
values. (b) The top three intervals have EXACTLY equal increments (8.80 -> 9.20
-> 9.60 -> 10.00, slope 0.0200 three times) while every prior interval's slope
declines monotonically (0.0590, 0.0440, ..., 0.0215); a genuine table would keep
declining (~0.0188, ~0.0177). Three identical two-decimal values at the top of a
concave curve reads as hand-extended. This is PLAUSIBLE, not confirmed -- the
repo deliberately retains no copy of the source (CONTRACT.md:151-154), so it
cannot be settled in-tree. Magnitudes are otherwise physically sane (knots sit
2.0-3.7% above circular Hausen, consistent with rectangular alpha*=0.5 being ~7%
below circular at the fully developed limit plus a combined-entry enhancement).
It deserves a line in the no-claim boundary rather than silence.

ALSO NOTED, no action needed: adding Gz to groups() changes the evaluation
provenance hash for EVERY duct evaluation, including Dittus-Boelter and
Gnielinski which have no Gz semantics. Nothing in the repo freezes a convection
provenance literal, so nothing broke -- but it was a silent identity change
across unrelated cards and is worth knowing if a golden is ever added.

title: xtask doc-facts cannot derive: native(141)+standalone(1) does not cover 141 tracked manifests
description:
MEASURED 2026-07-29 on an RCH Linux worker:

  {"check":"doc-facts","crate":"README.md","verdict":"violation","detail":"cannot derive generated documentation facts: native (141) plus standalone (1) fs-* crates do not cover all 141 tracked manifests"}

This is NOT a stale-count violation, which is how it would naturally be misread. The check does not say the README claims the wrong number; it says it CANNOT DERIVE the facts at all. 141 native plus 1 standalone is 142, which cannot cover 141 tracked manifests without double-counting, so the covering predicate is inconsistent under the current crate set.

LIKELY CAUSE: crates/fs-evidence-runner was added as a workspace member at commit 8329a524 (2026-07-28), taking native fs-* crates from 140 to 141 while the standalone nested fs-wasm workspace continues to be counted separately. The partition the derivation assumes (native + standalone = tracked, disjointly) no longer holds -- most plausibly fs-wasm is now being counted in both halves, or a tracked manifest is being attributed to neither.

WHY IT MATTERS BEYOND THE NUMBER: doc-facts is what keeps the README's derived-fact table honest, and it is one of the checks in check-all. While it cannot derive, the README's inventory badges are unverifiable rather than merely stale -- nothing is checking them. Regenerating will NOT fix this: a derivation that refuses produces no facts to write.

DONE WHEN: the check derives again under the current crate set; the partition it assumes is stated explicitly in code (which crates are native, which are standalone, and the proof they are disjoint and exhaustive); and adding a new workspace member cannot silently break the predicate again.

TESTS: a falsifier that adds a synthetic native crate and proves the derivation still covers; the same for a synthetic standalone workspace; and a case proving a crate counted in BOTH halves is REFUSED rather than silently double-counted -- that is the failure mode that produced this.

CONTEXT: found while falsifying the premise of frankensim-3uh21 (see that bead's comment). The source-manifest halves of that run are ordinary staleness and are separately fixable by regeneration; this one is not.

Mutation fixtures add a synthetic native crate, add a synthetic standalone workspace, count one manifest in both halves, count one in neither, move a manifest between roots, duplicate aliases, and change membership during enumeration. title: fs-cutfem scalar Space::build refuses valid ghost-free configs (band check not gated on ghost_gamma)
description:
SPURIOUS BUILD-TIME REFUSAL in crates/fs-cutfem/src/fem.rs (~lines 263-288, the `return Err(CutFemError::CutBandNotUniform ...)` block). Found in the deep-review hunt; NOT fixed by me because fs-cutfem is currently MID-FLIGHT (a concurrent agent has an uncommitted fem.rs diff + new untracked elastic.rs/tests) and multi-agent etiquette forbids editing/committing their in-progress files. Hand off to that agent or apply after their work lands.

## The bug
The scalar `Space::build` enumerates ghost faces and enforces the equal-level "uniform interface band" precondition UNCONDITIONALLY, even when `params.ghost_gamma == 0.0` (ghost penalty disabled). `CutBandNotUniform` is, by its own doc and CONTRACT.md's error model, purely a GHOST-PENALTY precondition ("ghost-penalty faces are assembled between equal-level cells only"). With ghost off (aggregation-only / unstabilized), no ghost faces are assembled, so the band-uniformity requirement does not apply — yet build() still rejects the configuration.

## Evidence it is a bug
The VECTOR sibling gets it right: `elastic.rs:372` wraps the identical neighbor-level check inside `if self.ghost_gamma > 0.0`. The scalar path (fem.rs) does not, so it refuses configs the vector path accepts. `assemble` already guards ghost assembly with its own `if self.params.ghost_gamma > 0.0` (fem.rs:418), so leaving `ghost_faces` empty when ghost is off is fully handled downstream.

## Trigger
Build a scalar `Space` on a graded quadtree (mixed active levels touching the interface — e.g. a `refine_where`-refined tree not passed through `refine_toward_interface`) with `ghost_gamma = 0.0` and `agg = Some(..)` (the documented ghost-free aggregation fallback, CONTRACT invariant 7). A cut cell with a differently-leveled active face-neighbor makes `build` return `CutBandNotUniform` and fail, even though aggregation needs no uniform band. Fails loudly (no wrong numbers) but refuses valid work. No battery test exercises it (cut-007 uses a uniform grid; cut-008 grades the tree but keeps ghost ON), so it is latent.

## Fix
Gate the ghost-face enumeration/refusal block on `self.params.ghost_gamma > 0.0`, mirroring `elastic.rs:372`. `ghost_faces` stays empty when ghost is off, which `assemble` already handles. Add a regression: a graded tree with `ghost_gamma = 0.0` + aggregation builds successfully (and solves). CONFIDENCE: medium.
close_reason: Fixed the scalar fail-open policy boundary: graded interface-band uniformity is now required only when ghost_gamma > 0, while ghost-free aggregation configurations build and solve. Added cut-007b paired regression proving ghost-off success and ghost-on refusal, plus nonfinite/negative ghost_gamma validation. Included in green RCH fs-cutfem test job j-29927301231673401; cargo fmt and git diff --check pass.

title: Input-semantic recompute determinism: policy, trip-wire, independent checking, and release proof
description:
MISSION

Preserve and adjudicate the stronger capability intentionally left outside frankensim-0yot: detect output-co-varying nondeterminism without pretending that every tolerance change or measured-error change is an identical computation. Define a typed input-semantic computation key, output observation, determinism class, migration policy, and authority model before changing storage behavior.

The program must resolve whether required_tolerance is an execution input, a query threshold, or a versioned policy component for each operation class; separate achieved_error as measured output; distinguish deterministic, tolerance-dependent deterministic, and explicitly nondeterministic/fast modes; prevent one mode from minting authority for another; preserve all historical seven-field nodes through explicit migration or typed legacy treatment; and retain the honest seven-field diagnostic established by frankensim-0yot until the stronger policy is proven.

This is an ambition ratchet, not a rewrite of history. No existing node may be silently merged, rejected, re-keyed, or reinterpreted.

## Success Criteria

This hierarchy-only rollup closes only when its exact direct children frankensim-mkfvu.1, frankensim-mkfvu.2, frankensim-mkfvu.3, and frankensim-mkfvu.4 reconcile on one compatible source/schema/policy snapshot. The policy child freezes the meaning of tolerance, measured output, modes, identity, and legacy migration before implementation. The implementation cannot widen authority. The checker is independent. The terminal child alone owns release no-mock E2E, bounded logs, replay, and DSR. A valid outcome may retain typed LegacyUnresolved or ExplicitlyNondeterministic no-claim states; it may not silently merge history or claim five-field determinism from the diagnostic-only work in frankensim-0yot.

Close only on exact child-set equality and successful retained terminal receipts. A green subset, aggregate count, or success inferred from child status alone cannot close the epic.

## Terminal E2E ownership

Name exactly one retained, no-mock terminal harness and its owning Bead.

If this Bead owns the harness, freeze its repository-relative script path, CLI modes and case IDs, fixtures, exit classes, source closure, artifact roots, and DSR gate.

If another Bead owns it, name that exact Bead and dependency. This leaf emits a typed contribution only and cannot self-promote.

Do not create one script per scientific leaf when a shared runner is authoritative.

## Exact terminal child ownership

This rollup owns no competing driver. Its sole terminal owner is `frankensim-mkfvu.4`, which owns `scripts/ci/e2e_recompute_semantic_determinism.sh` and must create and retain `tests/e2e/manifests/recompute-semantic-determinism.toml`. Canonical list/check/self-test, smoke/full run, frozen negative/fault cases, and artifact-only replay use disjoint roots.

The parent already hard-depends on `.4` and closes only on exact child/root equality plus complete unit/schema/property/metamorphic/mutation/cancellation/crash/resource/parser/log/replay proof. `LegacyUnresolved` and `ExplicitlyNondeterministic` remain valid no-claim outcomes and cannot be averaged or promoted. The manifest is a plan commitment and status remains `NoData` until retained execution and independent replay pass.

title: instrument-lab: signed brightness gap can grade an overly bright piano as Close
description:
Published instrument-lab source at 2d3aaf08cac83e5dc6a16d2bb2b1091d8122047f, apps/instrument-lab/src/verisim.ts:121, grades brightness with the signed difference dull = real.high_band_db - ours.high_band_db and tests dull <= 3. Both close/mixed branches use the one-sided condition. A pure expression reproduction confirms this boundary; no audio, render, browser or production campaign was executed.

The criterion should represent the intended symmetric brightness distance, and displayed brightness magnitude should agree with the direction word. Add focused cases for equally dull/bright deviations, near the admission threshold, and nonfinite/missing inputs. Preserve the current physical no-claims and make no calibration or production acceptance claim from this UI repair.

title: Instrument-claims registry (filling x image x QoI) with xtask gate
description:
Instrument-claims registry: schema + xtask gate (T-Claims child; parent frankensim-music-v8-root-3ez8g.1). SCOPE REFINED 2026-08-14 (polish round): corpus registration -> .1.1, listening receipts -> .1.2, determinism rows -> .1.3, bake-off receipts -> .1.4 (all four blocked on this bead). This bead delivers the SCHEMA and the GATE — the enforcement spine every track's *-gates bead plugs into.

WHY: Doctrine D19 (claims are (filling, image, QoI) rows), D21 (menus-not-winners: rows may move to `refused`, never vanish), and D25 (a live-default image without a green gate AND a measured budget row is a refused policy violation) are unenforceable as prose. This repo's working rule: claims live in registries checked by xtask (capability-maturity.json and schema-policy.json are the precedents — including schema-policy's predecessor-aware bump refusal, which is the pattern for D21 here).

SCOPE:
1. Tracked `instrument-claims.json` at the repo root. Row shape: key (filling, image, qoi); owner_crates[]; exactness_class in {X-Exact, X-Consist, X-Struct, X-Est} — TWO entries allowed when an image splits its limit vs its loss model (state both, e.g. char = X-Exact delay + X-Struct ZK); gate in {ungated, green, refused}; evidence[] (test paths / evidence-package digests / bake-off receipt digests / listening-receipt digests); determinism_class (field from day one; the .1.3 composition lint populates/polices it); budget_row (content-addressed ref; absent = cannot be live-default); corpus_refs[]; live_default: bool (the plan's diamond); notes (required on refused rows: the reason + counter-argument, per audit discipline).
2. `xtask check-instrument-claims`, joining check-all once stable. REFUSALS (each a named rule in the JSONL verdict): (a) live_default without gate=green AND budget_row; (b) a row DELETED relative to HEAD's committed registry — D21 structurally: rows only transition gate status (predecessor-diff, the check-schemas pattern); (c) malformed keys/enums; (d) dangling in-tree evidence/corpus refs; (e) a refused row without a reason note.
3. Lifecycle: ungated -> green requires evidence[] non-empty; green -> refused requires the reason note. Transitions are ordinary edits caught by the gate, not a workflow engine — keep it a checked file, not a service.
4. SEED ROWS: enter every currently-live image as `ungated` with owner_crates + exactness filled (the honest starting state; nothing is green until a gates bead lands evidence). The seed set is the epic menus' owner columns made machine-readable.

UNIT TESTS (required to close): schema round-trip + canonical serialization; EVERY refusal arm exercised (live-default-without-gate, deleted-row, dangling-ref, bad-enum, refused-without-reason); the predecessor-diff logic against a committed/modified fixture pair.
E2E (required to close): one full lifecycle driven through the real xtask binary on a scratch registry — seed ungated -> attach evidence -> green -> demote to refused with reason — asserting the gate's JSON-lines verdicts at each step (agents parse verdicts, not prose). LOGGING: every refusal names WHICH row and WHICH rule; the check-all summary counts rows per gate status so drift is visible in one line.

ANTI-DUPLICATION: this registry REFERENCES capability-maturity entries where relevant but never replaces or forks that machinery; corpus discipline stays in fs-vvreg (.1.1); receipts are content-addressed artifacts, not registry inlines.
close_reason: Landed at 8bc10b9e (plus doc-facts repair 547261f0). instrument-claims.json seeded with 14 rows covering every currently-live image, all honestly ungated; xtask check-instrument-claims joined check-all with refusal arms for D25 (live-default needs green gate + budget_row), D21 (predecessor-diff via git show HEAD: refuses row deletion; transitions surfaced as notes), green-without-evidence, refused-without-reason, malformed keys/enums, duplicate keys, dangling resolvable evidence (test/contract/doc resolved; receipt/bakeoff/listening/corpus recorded-only until their stores land - the honest maturity-corpus pattern), and missing owner crates. Evidence: 18 unit tests (every refusal arm + predecessor fixture pair) + 2 e2e tests through the REAL binary (live-repo clean run with summary verdict asserted; scratch git-repo full lifecycle: seed -> premature-green refusal -> evidenced green + transition note -> live-default-without-budget refusal -> budgeted pass -> deletion refusal citing D21 -> reasoned demotion), all asserting JSON-lines verdicts. check-instrument-claims/check-source-manifest/check-docs all policy-OK at HEAD. DEVIATIONS RECORDED: live_default is a string enum (in-house JSON parser collapses booleans - documented in the module header); the registry schema string stays internal/breakable (no schema-policy freeze - xtask/src is outside the accretion scan; freezing is a deliberate later governance action); pre-existing unrelated check-all reds at HEAD (terminology ~670, goldens 3, other lanes' state) are untouched per the no-chasing rule. UNBLOCKED: .1.1 corpus, .1.2 listening, .1.3 determinism, .1.4 bake-off, and every track's gates bead.

title: Music-oriented building blocks v8: program root (menus, not winners)
description:
MUSIC-ORIENTED BUILDING BLOCKS — v8 PROGRAM ROOT. This bead graph IS the plan: every doctrine, menu, ingest rule, worked example, and refusal from COMPREHENSIVE_PLAN_FOR_OPTIMAL_MUSIC_ORIENTED_BUILDING_BLOCKS.md (v8, commit f793a856, FROZEN) lives in this epic and its children. Nobody implementing these beads should need the markdown.

== MISSION (owner intent, distilled from the 2026-08-12..14 sessions) ==
FrankenSim is a simulation project, not a music project. World-class, real-time-capable musical instrument simulation must EMERGE from general, correct, reusable physics crates — never from samples, instrument crates, IR packs, MIDI-as-physics, or invented timbre. Realism comes from real 3-D geometry (licensed meshes), real material cards (provenance-pinned), real gesture (geometry in time), and real air (gas state). Multiple orthogonal discretizations ("images") per instrument family ("filling") are a FEATURE: menus, not winners. Real-time is a measured budget claim followed by per-kernel fusion, never a vibe. The bar: "make grizzled veteran audio software devs gasp" — through physics, not tricks.

== VOCABULARY (used by every child bead) ==
- filling: an instrument family sharing cards (reeds, brass, jet-pipes, strings, piano, bars/bells, voice, electric).
- image: one discretization/oracle of the same cards (TMM, char line, VFIT 1-port, modal ZOH, pHS island, HB...). Images are orthogonal, never share state layouts, couple only at power ports.
- chart: certified low-dimensional description minted from mesh+cards (A(x), valve card, plate modal chart, Z_L table, felt Uniaxial+Prony card).
- card: material/gas/jet/device data with provenance (fs-matdb receipts).
- authority image: offline oracle (TMM, eigensolve, BEM bake, FEM reduce, LBM lab).
- performance image: runtime kernel (char lines, modal ZOH, VFIT filters, islands).
- claim: a (filling, image, QoI) row in the instrument-claims registry.
- LIVE-DEFAULT (the plan's black-diamond mark): the usual runtime choice of a menu, legal only once gated AND budget-measured.

== DOCTRINE D1–D25 (binding on every child) ==
D1-D13: nameless physics; no samples; lanes/rates; reduce, don't invent constitutives; correctness before THAT kernel's fusion; Franken-only deps; certificates; named budgets; psycho judges under the listening law; feature flags for [F]/[M]; passive LTV ports; no synth crate; calibrate cards.
D14 Newton only on nonlinear islands (never on linear pHS).
D15 Coarsen inside a class, toward that image's QoIs.
D16 Multi-rate by island stiffness.
D17 Lift state when an image's coordinates change (no clicks).
D18 The electrical-length split is ONE optional image of 1-D air, not a law for plates or circuits.
D19 Claims are (filling, image, QoI) registry rows, not prose.
D20 Interiors couple only at ports; new ports are fs-couple PortSchema v2 descriptors (the legacy raw Port container is refused by interconnect; never re-mint it).
D21 MENUS, NOT WINNERS: a passing orthogonal image is never deleted; registry rows may move to `refused`, never vanish. Keep-both is the default bake-off outcome for orthogonal images (TD vs FD, phrase vs hold, 1-DOF vs two-mass).
D22 Complementary duals: FD oracles (TMM, eigensolve, HB) answer lock/design questions; TD images answer attack/play. Neither replaces the other.
D23 BIND BEFORE YOU BUILD: every image names its owner crate::API or "NEW: extends <crate> at <seam>". A new crate needs a displacement argument (which existing crate was tried, why extension fails).
D24 CONSOLIDATE BEFORE NEW PHYSICS: surfaces that already exist more than once (Hertz x3, Hunt-Crossley x2, two WAV writers, two ZOH runtimes, port containers, steppers) have owners ruled in the consolidation epic; an Nth copy is a refusal.
D25 THE REGISTRY IS THE CLAIM: a live-default image without a green gate AND a measured budget row is a policy violation the xtask gate refuses.

== EXACTNESS CLASSES (state per image; both when split) ==
X-Exact = discrete solution of the named operator up to rounding (modal ZOH; lossless delay). X-Consist = converges under documented refinement (fine TMM/LC, MM with mode-count ladder). X-Struct = passive/structure-preserving approximation with residual (VFIT R(s), Foster ZK, HB). X-Est = estimate-only (raw mesh skeleton, uncertified lab, hand-typed masses). Never call a 6-cell ladder X-Exact for a distributed bore. A kernel may be X-Exact for its limit and X-Struct for the rest — the gate states both.

== THE INGEST LAW (mesh + cards -> sound) ==
licensed mesh + region labels + matdb/GasState cards + gesture map -> fs-io quarantine (Estimate-only) -> extractors -> charts with certificates (volume = certified enclosure; A(x)>0/centerline = Estimate cross-checked; valve dL = CAD band; Z_L = passivity class recorded) -> authority images -> bake-off -> performance images -> selector(gesture, claim, CPU) -> pascals.
THREE THINGS NEVER ENTER THE AUDIO CALLBACK: (1) the triangle mesh; (2) a 3-D lip/reed/felt FEM; (3) an invented-timbre EQ. Hand-typed parameters without a coupon or mesh-reduce receipt are Estimate-only until one exists. If an extractor cannot certify a chart, that path is X-Est or refused — we do not invent numbers to keep the note playing.

== NEVER (program-wide; enforced by review and by the registry gate) ==
Samples; IR cabinets as truth; instrument crates (no Trumpet/Piano types — instruments are compositions of nameless charts); one stepper for all fillings; one-image-per-filling as policy; Newton on linear pHS; a coarse ladder as HF air truth; FIR keymaps; formant EQ / vocoder; forced Helmholtz saw; in-loop BEM/LBM; deleting a passing orthogonal image; Hunt-Crossley as the piano-felt law; ManderConcrete/MenegottoPintoSteel as a hammer; a parallel "music felt" constitutive next to Uniaxial/FractionalZener; resurrecting TravelingWaveLine (dead, twice contract-negated); a second Port container next to PortSchema v2; a fourth stepper without a displacement argument; a parallel fs-acoustics crate (name RETIRED; bead frankensim-ext-acoustics-core-0ja4 carries the repoint); a fourth Hertz or third Hunt-Crossley implementation; a live-default without gate+budget; claiming humidity effects from GasState (it is (T,p) only; humidity is ISO-9613 absorption-only until the moist-air bead lands); simulating key/valve mechanisms instead of chart schedules (fs-mbd disclaims joints/constraints/impacts; fs-kinematics does not exist); MIDI note number as omega anywhere in a physics path.

== GROUND TRUTH 2026-08-14: LIVE vs GREENFIELD ==
LIVE (implemented + tested): fs-duct (viscothermal TMM: ZK/all-regime/Bessel losses, cones cascaded at local radius, tone-hole T-junctions with Dalmont matching + chimney wall law, Levine-Schwinger 0.6133a / flanged 0.8216a mouths, ka<=1 named refusal); fs-phs (Dirac algebra, Gonzalez discrete-gradient `step` with exact energy ledger + supply-defect audit, DescriptorPortHamiltonian + step_descriptor, acoustic element zoo: cylinders, spherical cones, chains, side-hole lengths, WallPin/ViscothermalPin, Foster fitting, modal banks, Bernoulli aperture bernoulli_volume_flow); fs-vfit (relaxed VF + Loewner cross-check, two-tier passivity certificate HamiltonianExact/GridOnly + convex residue repair, biquads/state-space/DelayedFilter scattering runtime incl. modulate_delay + enforce_scattering_passivity); fs-modal (inertia-certified slice_window, certified eigen intervals); fs-plate (orthotropic DKT + prestress + stiffeners, Leissa/Olson-Hazell gated, modes = thin front over fs-modal); fs-nlmodal (von Karman / Kirchhoff-Carrier quartic SOS storage on fs-phs, FE-sampled modes injected via fs_couple::thin_plate); fs-couple (the ONLY crate composing audible loops: reed_bore locks near the quarter-wave, string-plate-duct joins, exact-ZOH modal audio runtime modal_acoustic_time, driving_point::characteristic_line = exact FIR of TMM R(omega), stribeck_friction, PortSchema v2, energy/window audits, test-only physically-scaled WAV bytes pcm_wav); fs-bem::helmholtz (Burton-Miller exterior radiation, radiation_impedance_matrix, solve_radiation_batch up to 256 fields/LU, SH directivity, e^{-i omega t} convention matching fs-duct); fs-contact (Hertz + HuntCrossley patch laws + FiniteGapPoint + sample_finite_gap_from_chart, typed receipts); fs-dcontact (distributed unilateral lays/rattles as pHS storage, chi internal loss); fs-tribo (Stribeck/partial slip; declares NO cross-ISA bit-stability — platform hypot); fs-material (GasState(T,p) with c=sqrt(gamma R T), Uniaxial hysteresis with mt-001/mt-004 gates, FractionalZener -> lower_to_prony naming felt, exact-exponential Prony step already expm1-guarded for audio dt, orthotropic resolvers); fs-matdb (~99 provenance-complete packs incl. yellow-brass damping, spruce loss factors, music wire, instrument grain-axis convention); fs-aeroac over fs-lbm (2-D jet-labium lab, adiabatic ramp protocol, TYPED 2-D broadband refusal, D3Q19 central-moment operator staged); fs-psycho (ISO 532-1 / DIN 45692 / Daniel-Weber / ECMA metrics under the pinned LISTENING_LAW); fs-modalid (FRF -> modal params, stabilization, MAC); fs-query (medial_poles, thickness_at, certified geometric_moments).
GREENFIELD (zero code exists): HB/describing function; the entire electric path (Faraday/Thiele-Small/device models); voice as a product (glottis/formant); multimodal horn; mesh->A(x) extractor; fs-duct Termination::Tabulated; wool-felt Uniaxial implementor + felt/cane/tissue/gut packs; moist-air mixture rule; JCA/Biot poroacoustics (one taxonomy doc row only); 3-D jet card; honest mean flow; block render API / product surface.

== STRUCTURE & EXECUTION ==
Children of this root are the track epics (T-Claims, T-Out, Ingest, T-Brass, T-Piano, T-Wind, Vibration, T-Voice, T-EM, T-Jet, HB, Shell, Consolidation) plus two root tasks (selector, fusion pass). Blocking deps run task->task ONLY, never through epics: parent-child is structure, not gating (the 85%-blocked graph pathology is real and reproduced in this repo). `br ready` is the work queue; epics close when their children close. Each epic's description carries its filling's full menu (images, classes, failure modes, owners) and worked-example narrative, so children only carry their local scope.

== WORKING PRACTICES (this repo, this lane — hard-won) ==
- A concurrent sweeper session commits the whole working tree unprompted, as the repo user, sometimes mid-edit. Use pathspec commits (`git commit -- <paths>`) and expect staged files to be swept; check `git log` before assuming your work is uncommitted.
- Any commit touching tracked docs/source must regenerate frankensim-source-manifest.json + SPDX NAMING your dirty paths, committed together with them; check-source-manifest is red pre-commit by design (the manifest describes the commit candidate; the check reads the index).
- Heavy runs: `sh -c` with RCH_MIN_LOCAL_TIME_MS=9999999 and CARGO_TARGET_DIR under $RCH_TARGET_BASE, --release (the plain cargo shim ships a 10-min timeout to a congested remote queue).
- Acoustics data is e^{-i omega t}; fs-vfit fits e^{+i omega t}: CONJUGATE before fitting. Unconjugated data has a ~50% error floor for EVERY identification method (pinned in the clarinet casebook).
- Exactness claims require an independent reference re-run diffed at full precision; a loose test pin conceals exactly the bug class it exists to catch.
- NaN passes every comparison-shaped admission gate; guard with explicit is_nan()/is_finite().
- The v8 plan document is FROZEN: plan changes require executed beads citing landed commits.

== TESTING & LOGGING LAW (program-wide; added in the 2026-08-14 polish round) ==
Every IMPLEMENTATION bead ships unit tests in the same slice: happy path, boundary/refusal arms, and at least one FALSIFIER — a deliberately-broken input proving the gate can actually fail (a gate that has never failed is untested). Every *-GATES bead ships an executable e2e fixture whose logs are rich enough to re-derive the verdict from artifacts alone: per-stage values, receipts, content digests — never bare pass/fail. The program-level umbrella is the e2e-scripts bead (root child): deterministic scripts/e2e/music_*.sh lanes in the euler_disc_campaign.sh mold — fresh-output refusal, dirty-input refusal, JSONL receipts, content-hashed WAV artifacts as the retained evidence. Two standing test hazards, both executed in this lane's history: (1) under Gonzalez discrete-gradient stepping, energy conservation is STRUCTURALLY BLIND to gradient errors — conservation tests prove the stepper, not the physics; always pair with FD-gradient-vs-H oracles on mixed active sets and independent-integrator divergence checks. (2) Exactness claims require an independent reference re-run diffed at full precision; a loose test pin conceals exactly the bug class it exists to catch. NaN passes every comparison-shaped admission gate — guard with explicit is_finite()/is_nan().

title: T-Claims: instrument-claims registry, corpora, receipts (the product)
description:
T-CLAIMS EPIC — the instrument-claims registry, corpora, and receipts. Parent: frankensim-music-v8-root-3ez8g (read its doctrine first; D19/D21/D25 are this epic's charter).

WHY THIS IS "THE PRODUCT": "The selector is the product" — but the selector can only choose between images whose claims are machine-readable. In this repository, claims that live in prose die; claims that live in registries checked by xtask survive (capability-maturity.json, schema-policy.json, and the vv-scorecard are the working precedents). Without this epic, agent waves silently crown winners, delete orthogonal images, and inflate "sounds great" into a validation claim — all three failure modes were observed risks during the 2026-08 build-out.

REGISTRY ROW SHAPE (frozen intent; the schema bead owns the exact JSON): (filling, image, qoi) -> owner_crates[], exactness_class (X-Exact | X-Consist | X-Struct | X-Est; both when an image splits its limit and its loss model), gate (ungated | green | refused), evidence pointer (test path / evidence package / receipt digest), determinism_class, budget_row ref, corpus_refs[]. GATE LAW (D25): a live-default image requires a green gate AND a measured budget row; rows may move to `refused` but may never vanish (D21 as code). G0 passivity is mandatory for every admitted image — an image that cannot show passive port behavior is not on any menu.

VALIDATION-DATA LAW: licensing is resolved BEFORE ingestion (the same law as "licensed A(x)"). Corpora register under fs-vvreg's existing Level-A/B/C discipline (Level A = definitions/targets, Level B = cross-code, Level C = published experiment) — we REUSE the thermal program's corpus machinery, never build a parallel music-validation registry.

THE MEASURED SIDE: fs-modalid (measured FRFs -> (f, eta, phi) + MAC pairing against simulated modes) is the simulate-vs-measure loop for every structural realism gate. Its recorded no-claim — NO license-compatible published FRF *trace* exists (figures-only across the CC-BY literature) — becomes a standing corpus-hunt row, never a fabricated benchmark.

THE LISTENING LAW (binding program-wide, pinned in fs-psycho as data and by test): psychoacoustic metrics are NEVER a substitute for human listening. Metrics are evidence fields; the "sounds right" adjudication is a recorded human listening receipt. fs-psycho refuses absolute SPL without a Calibration and refuses non-48 kHz audio rather than resampling — those refusals propagate into receipt fields (empty, never fabricated).

CHILDREN + ORDER: the registry schema + xtask gate (frankensim-music-claims-registry-mc31g, filed earlier, retro-parented here) lands FIRST; corpus registration, listening receipts, determinism rows, and bake-off receipts proceed in parallel after it. Every other epic's *-gates bead depends on mc31g and (where corpus-backed) on corpus registration.

title: Validation-corpus registration under fs-vvreg discipline
description:
Validation-corpus registration under fs-vvreg discipline (T-Claims child; parent .1). BLOCKED-BY: the registry schema (frankensim-music-claims-registry-mc31g) — corpus rows must have something to be referenced from.

WHY: Gates without external corpora are self-referential — a simulation agreeing with itself proves the stepper, not the physics. The realism bar the owner set ("Ernoult peak cents", "spectral tilt vs coupon") is only meaningful against registered, licensed data. The thermal program already built exactly this machinery (fs-vvreg Level A = definitions/targets, Level B = cross-code, Level C = published experiment) — REUSE it; a parallel music-validation registry is a D24 refusal.

LAW: licensing resolved BEFORE ingestion, always (scratchpad copies are research, not registration). Two-source verification for transcribed values (never transcribe literature values from memory; fetch two independent sources and pdftotext-spot-check load-bearing rows).

SCOPE — register these corpora (each row: source, license, level, digitization lineage or tabulated provenance, QoI acceptance band):
(a) Ernoult et al. 2021 (Acta Acustica 5:47, CC-BY) woodwind fingering ladder — ALREADY validated in fs-duct tests (5 fingerings, -8/-8/-18/-17/-20 cents inside a 30-cent envelope; deviations systematically flat); promote from test constants to corpus rows so the wind gates cite data, not code.
(b) Published input-impedance curves for clarinet and trumpet (openwind-class datasets). CAUTION: the openwind measured curves are GPLv3 — decide the retention/derivation policy explicitly in this bead (fixture-only? derived scalar targets? refusal?); record the decision either way.
(c) Leissa plate tables + Olson-Hazell 1977 stiffened plate (already fs-plate's gate; promote) and Carcagno et al. 2018 JASA 144(6):3533 (CC-BY, TABULATED guitar F1/F2/F3+Q for six sitka-top guitars — the go-to guitar source; mobility MAGNITUDES are figures-only across all CC-BY literature: refuse them).
(d) A felt force-compression coupon for the piano lane (feeds 87zbd's fit; two-source recipe).
(e) Published glottal-flow waveforms (LF-model class) for T-Voice formant/source gates.
(f) The standing FRF-TRACE HUNT row: fs-modalid's recorded no-claim is that NO license-compatible published FRF trace exists (figures-only across CC-BY literature); this row keeps the hunt alive and honest — the published-parameter round-trip remains the benchmark until a trace is found.

DONE-WHEN: (1) corpus rows registered with the fields above; (2) the instrument-claims registry can reference them and a lint REFUSES a gate citing an unregistered corpus; (3) one gate wired end-to-end as the proof (Ernoult ladder -> wind TMM row) with per-fingering logging (measured cents, envelope, verdict); (4) licensing decisions recorded per corpus including refusals.

TESTS: corpus-row schema round-trip; unregistered-reference refusal; the end-to-end Ernoult wiring with detailed logs.

title: Human listening-receipt protocol (the listening law as artifact)
description:
Human listening-receipt protocol (T-Claims child; parent .1). BLOCKED-BY: mc31g (registry rows must exist to cite receipts).

WHY: fs-psycho's LISTENING_LAW is pinned as data and by test: "THESE METRICS ARE NEVER A SUBSTITUTE FOR HUMAN LISTENING... a human ear adjudicates." For claims like "sounds like a trumpet" the adjudicator is a human; the program needs that verdict to be a durable ARTIFACT, not a vibe in a chat log that evaporates when the session ends. This is the difference between "the metrics moved" and "someone stood behind it."

SCOPE: a listening-receipt record: who listened; when; which rendered fixture at which commit + content digest (so the exact audio is reproducible); what question was being judged (attack realism? lock behavior? vowel identity?); verdict (pass / fail / notes); free-text observations. Psychoacoustic metrics (fs-psycho loudness, sharpness, roughness, tonality, fluctuation strength) attach as EVIDENCE FIELDS on the receipt — supporting context, never the verdict. Receipts are content-addressed and referenced from registry rows and bake-off receipts.

CALIBRATION HONESTY (inherited from fs-psycho's typed refusals): spl_from_pcm_rms REFUSES without a Calibration — absolute-SPL fields on a receipt stay EMPTY rather than fabricated; non-48 kHz audio is refused, not resampled; mono, free/diffuse-field per ISO 532-1 — no binaural claims. Fluctuation strength is NOT in the batch pareto_metrics block (its 2.73 s frame exceeds the block contract — a recorded decision); attach it separately when relevant.

DONE-WHEN: (1) receipt schema + writer; (2) at least one REAL receipt recorded against an existing rendered fixture (the fs-couple reed_bore render, or the first piano note when available), with metrics attached; (3) registry rows can cite receipt digests and the citation resolves; (4) refusal tests: missing calibration -> empty absolute fields (not zeros); non-48k -> typed refusal.

NOTE ON SCOPE RESTRAINT: this is a record format plus discipline, not a listening-test framework — no panels, no MUSHRA machinery, no statistics. One honest listener with a durable receipt beats an unrecorded consensus. If formal listening tests are ever wanted, that is a new bead with its own methodology.

title: Bake-off protocol + receipt schema (keep-both default, D21 as code)
description:
Bake-off protocol + receipt schema (T-Claims child; parent .1). BLOCKED-BY: mc31g.

WHY: Adding an image to a menu REQUIRES a bake-off: same cards, same fixture, same QoIs; report residual, budget, failure mode. The outcomes are exactly three: KEEP BOTH (the default when images are orthogonal — TD vs FD, phrase vs hold, 1-DOF vs two-mass), keep one FOR A SUBSET of claims, or REFUSE THE NEWCOMER. Doctrine D21 makes deletion of a passing orthogonal image forbidden — an image row may move to `refused`, never vanish. Without a receipt format, bake-off outcomes decay into commit-message folklore and the next agent wave re-litigates or, worse, silently crowns a winner.

SCOPE: (1) bake-off receipt schema: contenders (image ids + owner crates), shared cards digest, fixture id + commit, QoI list, per-contender results (residual vs QoI, measured budget, observed failure modes), OUTCOME (keep-both | subset:{claims} | refuse-newcomer), rationale text, links to listening receipts where perceptual QoIs were judged; content-addressed. (2) A small harness that runs two images on the same fixture and emits the receipt (not a framework — a function + conventions). (3) Registry integration: image rows reference the bake-off receipts that admitted them; the outcome enum structurally CANNOT express "delete the loser."

FIRST EXECUTIONS (pick one now, more come with the tracks): modal ZOH vs fine-pHS truncation authority on a string fixture is runnable TODAY with live code (QoIs: partial frequencies/decays vs mode count; budget: states x rate). The MM-vs-plane-wave brass bake-off and HC-vs-hysteresis felt bake-off land with their epics and cite this schema.

DONE-WHEN: schema + harness + ONE executed receipt end-to-end; registry links resolve; tests round-trip the receipt and verify the outcome enum has no deletion arm; logging includes enough per-QoI detail that a reviewer can re-derive the outcome without re-running.
close_reason: Landed across 4652a1a8 (schema core, swept mid-flight by the concurrent session) + my completion commit (test, golden, CONTRACT, registry evidence, doc-facts). BakeoffReceipt v1: two contenders on one shared-card fixture vs a caller-supplied reference; logical budgets only (states/steps/solver-iterations - wall-clock never enters, keeping bytes host-stable; real samples/sec is the budget lane 3ez8g.2.2); observed failure modes; outcome enum with EXACTLY keep-both / keep-for-subset / refuse-newcomer - structurally no deletion arm (D21 as a type, asserted by test); canonical line encoding frankensim-bakeoff-receipt-v1 with strict round-trip decoder; blake3 domain hash. FIRST EXECUTED RECEIPT: modal-ZOH vs pHS modal bank on a 3-mode string, analytic damped-oscillator reference; keep-both (ZOH = performance image, rounding-level residuals, zero solver cost; pHS = Dirac-composable authority, 4802 Newton iters/2400 samples). description:

title: Jet card schema + minting (tonal interim permitted, typed narrow claim)
description:
Jet card schema + minting (T-Jet child; parent .10). BLOCKED-BY: the 3-D sweep (its outcome defines what a full card may claim).

WHY: The jet island refuses without a card ("No card -> refuse" is the menu law), and the card is minted by the lab, never typed from vibes. The card is the boundary object between the CFD authority lane and the audio-rate performance lane — the same moral pattern as the lip valve card and the Z_L table.

SCOPE:
1. Card schema: mean-jet profile parameters (centerline velocity, momentum thickness at the flue exit), receptivity/gain characterization (the edge-tone feedback quantities the island's gain/delay model needs), noise content per band (the EXISTING 16-band NoiseTable machinery: fit_noise_table), RESIDUAL + validity region, and provenance (rig configuration digest, sweep receipts, classification outcome).
2. Authority class rules: X-Struct ONLY when a residual is issued against lab data; X-Est otherwise. The fs-aeroac scope law is inherited verbatim: ABSOLUTE SPL IS NEVER CLAIMED — cards carry shape/scaling authority only.
3. TONAL INTERIM CARD (explicitly permitted): a card minted from the VALIDATED 2-D stage-I point (St 0.03662 vs Brown's 0.03554, +3.0% inside bin quantization, hysteresis + multi-stability documented) with a TYPED NARROW CLAIM — edge-tone class, NOT flute broadband. This unblocks the island and flue fixtures without waiting for (or overclaiming) the 3-D outcome.
4. Broadband card: only from a demonstrated 3-D broadband regime; if the sweep produced a refusal, the card family records the refusal boundary instead (a card that says "no broadband exists below X" is an honest, useful artifact).

DONE-WHEN: schema + at least the tonal interim card minted with its narrow claim; round-trip + content-hash tests; refusals (missing residual -> X-Est cap; claims outside validity region); the island bead consumes the card in its fixture; logging of card fields vs lab receipts.

title: Jet island + char pipe: the flue play image (no card -> refuse)
description:
Jet island + char pipe: the flue play image (T-Jet child; parent .10). BLOCKED-BY: the jet card (NO CARD -> REFUSE is the image's admission law).

WHY: The usual live image for flute/recorder/flue-organ: a card-driven jet-drive island (the aerodynamic source) coupled to a char pipe (the live 5.1 stack) at the mouth/labium port. The physics that must EMERGE: edge-tone/pipe-tone regimes, the overblowing ladder (fundamental -> octave as jet speed rises), and voicing sensitivity — all from the card + geometry, never from an oscillator preset.

SCOPE:
1. The island: a gain/delay receptivity model parameterized ENTIRELY from the jet card (jet transit delay from mean profile + geometry; gain from the receptivity data; saturation from the card's amplitude data where present) + band-limited noise injection per the card's NoiseTable rows (shape/scaling only — never absolute SPL).
2. Coupling: island at the mouth port of a char pipe (DelayedFilter line with the pipe's tone holes); cut-up distance and jet angle are GEOMETRY gestures from the chart.
3. Admission: typed refusal without a card; claims capped by the card's class (tonal interim card -> edge-tone-class claims only; the row says so).
4. Organ rank: N independent voices from one chest chart — a stop = which pipes receive the jet card; shared kernels, per-voice state, NO shared "wind stepper" (the composition fixture proves cardinality economics: N voices cost ~N x one voice).

DONE-WHEN: (1) self-sustained oscillation locking to pipe modes; (2) THE OVERBLOWING LADDER: sweeping jet velocity walks fundamental -> octave (logged regime map vs the card's validity region); (3) voicing sensitivity: cut-up/angle changes shift onset and timbre in the physically expected direction (logged); (4) card-refusal test; (5) energy accounting through the island port; (6) the organ-rank fixture with per-voice logging; (7) determinism: fixed seeds for the noise injection keyed by logical voice identity (Philox discipline — replay independent of scheduling).
close_reason: flue loop executes: card-admitted jet island x wind line; ladder fundamental to octave to twelfth measured; limit cycle proven seed-independent; 7/7 fixtures; landed c7d6f1ea

title: Honest mean-flow decision record (escalation ladder, no k/(1-M^2) hack)
description:
Honest mean-flow decision record (T-Jet child; parent .10; P3). No blockers. A DECISION RECORD, not solver work.

WHY: Real wind instruments carry mean flow (the player blows through them), and at forte the quiescent-medium assumption in fs-duct/fs-phs strains. The temptation — recorded in the plan's NEVER list — is the k/(1-M^2) convected-wavenumber hack: cheap, plausible-looking, and wrong outside its narrow class. The program needs the escalation ladder WRITTEN DOWN before anyone needs it under deadline pressure, because that is exactly when the hack gets committed.

SCOPE (mirrors new-domains 5.11 rung 5, scoped to music):

description:

One crate per commit-slice; pathspec commits (the sweeper is active).

CAVEAT (recorded fleet lesson): floating-nightly clippy drift exists (the go7a class) — findings can appear/vanish with toolchain motion; verify own-crate findings under the PINNED toolchain (rust-toolchain.toml) and do not chase drift findings from other toolchains.

description:

Cross-ISA replay matters here because instrument fixtures become GOLDEN AUDIO artifacts — a golden that drifts across the two reference ISA families is not a golden.

SCOPE:
1. Candidate kernels (deterministic by construction, worth auditing): fs-duct TMM sweep digests; fs-vfit fit outputs + filter step sequences; fs-phs step ledgers on pinned fixtures; fs-modal spectra digests; fs-couple exact-ZOH render digests on a small fixture.
