title: solve stage producer: assigned mesh -> ConductionMesh + scenario lowering + conjugate solve stage
description:
Child of f85xj.6.5 (solve orchestration). The conduction/coupling stage must turn retained import evidence into a real solve: (a) promoted surface meshes (geometry-mesh-ply artifacts) -> volumetric TetComplex + positions for fs_conduction::ConductionMesh::new — this is a MESHING step (fs-mesh tetrahedralization/PLC recovery) the pipeline currently lacks entirely; (b) material resolution receipts -> per-region conductivity; power section -> volumetric/surface sources (fs-conduction power.rs lumped-nodal-volume trick per f85xj.5.9); interface cards / perfect contacts -> ThermalInterfaces (note fs-project bind currently REFUSES perfect-contact with project-perfect-contact-unsupported until fs-conduction supplies a verified operator — that refusal is load-bearing, do not bypass); (c) flow-network OperatingPoint -> fs_convection card selection -> fs_airflow::conjugate::solve_conjugate (landed at f85xj.5.7) with the balance gate and cancellation drills already proven there; envelope section -> ambient reference.

DONE WHEN: the reference enclosure project produces a converged ConjugateSolution through the solve pipeline with per-stage ledgered evidence, or refuses with typed diagnoses; the stage-gap refusals for conduction in fs-cli/src/solve.rs are deleted.

## Acceptance Criteria

The conduction producer consumes the actual promoted surface-mesh artifact and assignment receipt, constructs a PLC with exact units/orientation/named-region correspondence, runs production constrained tetrahedralization/recovery, audits the TetComplex, and builds ConductionMesh without substituting a test fixture. Open, non-manifold, self-intersecting, degenerate, unrecovered, inverted, over-budget, or region-incomplete geometry refuses with source-region/face diagnostics and remediation.

Every volume receives conductivity and uncertainty only from re-attested material receipts. Volumetric/surface power lowers with exact units and a total-power conservation receipt. Interfaces use declared cards; undeclared interfaces and currently unsupported perfect contact remain fail-closed, and zero resistance is never inferred. The flow OperatingPoint/regime evidence lowers through declared convection cards into named Robin regions. Ambient, boundary, source, material, interface, mesh, and flow identities bind into the conduction receipt. The real solve_conjugate path must satisfy numerical convergence and cross-domain balance; max iteration, invalid correlation regime, singularity, non-finite result, or unclosed balance is a refusal, never warning-only success.

A successful stage transaction publishes the solution field, mesh correspondence, convergence history, regional heat-flow accounting, balance audit, authority/no-claim state, and deterministic checkpoint with consistent lineage. Cancellation/faults at meshing, assembly, solve, conjugate exchange, audit, serialization, or publication leave the prior flow checkpoint recoverable and no partial authoritative solution.

Unit/G0/G1/property/metamorphic tests cover PLC closure/orientation/units/source correspondence/named-region coverage; constrained segment/facet recovery and exact tet audit; deterministic meshing; open/non-manifold/self-intersecting/degenerate/inverted/over-budget/capped fixtures; material permutations, absent/mismatched/out-of-domain cards, supported anisotropic/temperature policy; source mapping and total-power conservation; missing/duplicate/overlapping source regions; interface mapping, undeclared/perfect-contact refusal, and contact-dominated fixtures; analytic slab/source/Robin cases and manufactured-order gates through production lowering; stiff/nonconvergent coupling, invalid convection, singular systems, non-finite aggregates, and balance failure; rigid transforms, vertex/triangle reindexing, declaration permutations, equivalent source splitting, channel segmentation, and mesh refinement. Cancellation/fault injection covers PLC construction, recovery, tet audit, allocation, assembly, solver tiles, every conjugate exchange, balance audit, artifact write, ledger link, and resume. Substituted material/flow/checkpoint evidence refuses before compute; uninterrupted and resumed solution roots match.

scripts/ci/solve_stage_producers_e2e.sh --through conduction --profile <pr|full|recovery> --artifact-dir <path> invokes the real release-built frankensim CLI, canonical .fsim project, real promoted geometry and card packs, actual material/flow predecessors, production mesh/conduction/coupling paths, and real FrankenSQLite ledger. It runs clean success twice, the full geometry/material/interface/source/regime refusal corpus, cancellation at every work boundary, checkpoint resume, budget exhaustion, corrupt/stale/tampered evidence, ledger write/link failure, duplicate invocation, and retry with no mocked mesh/solver/receipt or earlier-stage bypass.

Canonical JSONL has deterministic record/field order and includes schema/version, case/event sequence, revision/constellation/workspace, run/project/stage/operation/predecessor IDs, capability verb, PLC/tet/correspondence audits, material/interface/source/convection identities, assembly/solver/conjugate/balance counters and residuals, input/output/receipt roots, budget grant/use, cancellation boundary, resume source, authority/no-claim state, diagnostic code, ranked fix, and verdict. Timing/load are separate non-authoritative rows. Meta-tests reject missing, duplicate, reordered, mixed-run/revision, truncated, unknown-version, and tampered records. Focused tests, no-mock E2E, constellation preflight, and named DSR lane must pass with retained artifacts before closure.

### Implementability and Proof-State Binding

Both `frankensim-s93ej.1` (domain-conforming multi-region volumetricization) and `frankensim-s93ej.2` (heterogeneous regionwise conductivity) are hard prerequisites. Convex-hull fill, hand-built `TetComplex` fixtures, a single global material, scalar `element_scale` material selection, averaged cards, or silently shared interface nodes cannot satisfy the product stage. The stage binds mesh region labels to the generic checked element-material map and retains the child receipts without raising their authority.

Immediately before and after authoritative proof, `scripts/ci/checkout_constellation.sh --snapshot` reports identical complete root-plus-sibling content identities and unchanged `constellation.lock` identity. Evidence binds source/snapshot/toolchain/target/profile/features plus DSR run/log/artifact roots and rejects cross-snapshot splicing. Full solver cross-ISA semantics use predeclared tolerances until actual dual-runtime G5 evidence; focused Cargo/RCH is focused proof only.

## Success Criteria

Mesh and operator leaves remain independently schedulable; stage prerequisites live on frankensim-s93ej.3; Runner phase 4 lives only on frankensim-extreal-program-f85xj.6.5.3. title: fs-mesh constrained multi-region PLC volumetricization with exterior carving and cell labels
description:
> Canonical closure notice (2026-07-28 reality-check): the Design, Acceptance Criteria, and Notes fields are authoritative. Any embedded Acceptance Criteria, Success Criteria, Ownership and Verification Handoff, or Phase 9.5 sections below are retained as scope and history; they cannot weaken, override, or independently close the canonical fields.

## Outcome

Provide the missing L2 production capability that turns a closed, assigned multi-body PLC into a domain-conforming tetrahedral complex. The result represents only declared solids, cavities, and interfaces—not the ambient convex hull—and labels every retained cell and boundary facet with replayable source correspondence.

## Scope

Admit bounded oriented surface components plus declared solid/cavity/interface identities and unambiguous region seeds/policies. Recover all required segments/facets in general position, carve exterior and cavity cells, preserve adjacent-solid interfaces, assign every tet exactly one declared region, and emit deterministic source-face/region correspondence. Refuse open/non-manifold/self-intersecting/degenerate input, inconsistent nesting/orientation, gaps/overlaps, ambiguous or missing labels, unrecovered constraints, inverted/zero-volume tets, resource exhaustion, or failed exact audit. Current convex-hull Delaunay and limited convex/axis-aligned `recover_facets` evidence cannot satisfy this bead by themselves. Conformity and quality remain separate claims with separate measured gates.

## Required Tests and Logging

Unit/G0 tests cover segment/facet correspondence, exterior/cavity classification, region partition exclusivity/completeness, interface two-sidedness, orientation, exact audit, and volume/boundary conservation. Corpus fixtures include convex baseline; concave L/U bodies; rotated/general-position facets; disjoint solids; nested shell/cavity; adjacent materials sharing an interface; internal void; thin feature/sliver; duplicate/reversed/missing faces; self-intersection; non-manifold/open surface; seed on boundary; ambiguous nesting; and recovery/budget caps. Independent analytic volumes/boundaries or a separately implemented classifier checks every positive fixture. Metamorphics cover vertex/triangle/component permutations, rigid transforms, unit rescaling, and equivalent subdivision. G4/G5 cover bounded cancellation through recovery/carving/labeling/audit, crash/restart, stale/tampered source artifacts, deterministic ordering, and transactional publication.

`scripts/ci/solve_stage_producers_e2e.sh --through conduction --case multi-region-volumetricization --profile <pr|full|recovery>` feeds real promoted geometry and assignment receipts through the production mesher, retains mesh/correspondence/audit artifacts, independently rechecks them, and lets the real conduction consumer open them. Hand-built `TetComplex`, fixture substitution, convex-hull fill, or writer self-check does not count.

Canonical JSONL binds schema/version/event sequence, source revision/constellation identity, project/run/operation IDs, PLC/region/source roots, work/cancel/resume counters, tet/boundary/interface counts, signed volumes, exact-audit results, correspondence roots, diagnostics/ranked fixes, and publication roots. Volatile observations are separate; meta-tests reject missing, duplicate, reordered, mixed-run/revision, truncated, unknown-version, and tampered records.

## Acceptance Criteria

All positive fixtures contain no exterior/cavity tet, every tet has exactly one declared region, and every required PLC constraint/interface has verified source correspondence; independent audits pass and deterministic/restart roots agree. Every adversarial fixture refuses with a localized stable diagnostic and publishes no complete mesh. The no-mock E2E and corruption/cancel corpus pass; `scripts/ci/checkout_constellation.sh --snapshot` passes against the unchanged pinned source snapshot; terminal `dsr quality --tool frankensim` PASS evidence retains run/log/artifact identities. No blanket cross-ISA mesh-byte claim is made until both runtime ISAs execute the same corpus.

### Snapshot Evidence Binding

Capture the complete root-plus-sibling constellation snapshot immediately before and after authoritative proof. The two snapshot identities and constellation.lock identity must be exact matches; evidence rows bind source HEAD, snapshot schema/identity, toolchain, target ISA, profile/features, and DSR run/log/artifact roots, and reject cross-snapshot splicing. A dirty/off-pin refusal is reported, never repaired by repinning a shared sibling.
design:
This is a generic L2 geometry capability, not a conduction-specific operation. The type-state pipeline is UnverifiedPlc -> checked admission -> ConstraintRecoveredPlc -> classified and carved LabeledTetComplex -> independent audit -> AuditedLabeledTetComplex. Only the audited type can satisfy downstream geometry authority. Each transition is bounded, cancellation-aware, content-bound, and atomic; failures retain diagnostic artifacts but do not mint the next state.

Input identity includes oriented surface components, stable solid, cavity, and interface labels, seeds or classification policy, units, exact-predicate and degeneracy policy, feature and quality policy, source correspondence, and budgets. Output identity includes canonical vertex, tet, boundary and interface order; each tet has exactly one declared region; every required segment and facet has source correspondence; no exterior or cavity tet survives; adjacent-material interfaces remain two-sided; orientation and volume conservation pass.

Independent audit does not call the producer classifier or trust producer counts. It rechecks topology, signed volumes, region partition completeness and exclusivity, boundary and interface incidence, source constraints, exterior and cavity classification, and deterministic canonicalization. Conformity and quality are separate claims.

The leaf no-mock E2E stops after volumetricization and independent audit. A conduction consumer belongs to the parent combined journey, preventing this L2 capability from depending upward on L3.

VolumeConservationWitness is dimensioned and independently recomputed. For finite binary64 PLC/tet coordinates, the auditor uses exact determinant expansion/dyadic accumulation where the bounded exact representation admits it; otherwise it uses directed outward interval determinant and summation. It records method, length unit and cubic unit, coordinate/source-certification scale, resource cap, per-tet sign, per-region total, cavity/exterior exclusion total, interface cancellation, declared-solid total, and union total. Exact mode requires exact equality; interval mode requires mutual containment/declared difference bound derived from source coordinate/geometry certificates and meshing policy, never a free epsilon or producer-selected tolerance.

Per-region totals are disjoint, each tet counts once, internal interfaces cancel exactly once, cavities/exterior contribute zero retained solid, and the union matches the declared solid within the typed bound. Producer and auditor cannot share accumulation/verdict code. huq.24 provides runner mechanics while geometry records remain family-specific.
acceptance_criteria:
1. The generic L2 type-state API admits only bounded oriented PLCs with explicit units, solid, cavity, interface, seed or classification, degeneracy, exactness, feature, and budget policy. 2. Every positive output retains only declared solids and interfaces, assigns exactly one region to each tet, recovers every required constraint, preserves two-sided interfaces, and passes independent topology, orientation, volume, and correspondence audit. 3. Open, nonmanifold, self-intersecting, degenerate, inconsistent, ambiguous, missing-label, overlap, gap, unrecovered, inverted, zero-volume, and exhausted cases refuse without an audited output. 4. Unit and corpus tests cover convex, concave, rotated, disjoint, nested cavity, adjacent regions, void, thin and sliver, duplicate, reversed, missing, crossing, nonmanifold, open, boundary-seed, ambiguous, and capped cases. 5. Property and metamorphic tests cover vertex, face, component, and label permutations, rigid transforms, unit scaling, equivalent subdivision, and deterministic ordering. 6. Bounded transition models, compile-fail type-state tests, cancellation at every stage, fault, crash-restart, stale-source, tamper, and atomic-publication tests pass. 7. Classifier, constraint, label, exterior, cavity, interface, orientation, audit, source, budget, cancel, and writer-self-check mutants are killed. 8. The release-built no-mock E2E runs through volumetricization only, consumes real promoted geometry and assignment receipts, invokes production meshing, and independently audits artifacts; direct TetComplex fixtures and convex-hull substitution fail. 9. Bounded canonical JSONL has one case_terminal per fixed case, then one run_summary and one final run_terminal and complete input, stage, count, audit, budget, cancellation, diagnostic, and artifact roots. 10. Matching before and after snapshots, verify-only preflight, DSR registry and dry-run, terminal quality proof, and replay pass.
11. Independent volume tests cover exact dyadic simple solids, translated/scaled/rotated cases, large cancellation, alternating orientation, slivers, underflow/overflow/resource fallback, adjacent regions, cavities, disjoint unions, and exact-versus-interval methods. They verify each region, excluded cavity/exterior, interface cancellation, and global union in cubic units. 12. One-ULP coordinate, determinant sign, omitted/doubled tet/region/interface, cancellation-order, interval-rounding, underflow/overflow, tolerance-width/unit/scale, producer-auditor-common-code, and ordinary-float-equality mutants fail with worst-region expected/observed enclosure and ranked repair. 13. Canonical logs bind method/units/source bound/per-region and union enclosures/worst margin/resource state without inflating mesh authority; huq.24 ProofExit/cardinality/caps/parser/tamper tests pass.
notes:
Reality-check revision removes an unnecessary conduction requirement from the L2 leaf while preserving full downstream integration at the parent. It adds explicit type-state authority, independent audit, exhaustive geometry and failure tests, and user-safe diagnostics.
Volume conservation now has exact or outward-interval mathematical authority with dimensioned source-bound tolerances, not implementation-defined floating equality.

Additive verification-completeness baseline (never a substitute for the specialized criteria above):
- Unit and boundary tests cover happy, empty/zero/one, exact limit, one-below/one-above, maximum-without-huge-allocation, error, units/dimensions, numeric extremes, and deterministic tie/order cases owned by this leaf.
- Property/metamorphic tests exercise algebraic or relational invariants; bounded state/model tests cover lifecycle, concurrency, retry/replay, and invalid transitions where applicable.
- Public authority/type surfaces require API and compile-fail misuse tests. A leaf with no public type must record that fact and provide the nearest strict schema/API-negative equivalent rather than silently omitting the category.
- Seeded mutation tests independently alter every claim-bearing identity, bound, state, policy, route, authority, and no-claim field and retain minimized, reproducible failures.
- Cancellation/deadline plus injected allocation, worker/process, parser, I/O, durable-seal, publication, and replay faults are placed at every transition this leaf owns; drain/quiescence, exact resource return, no partial authority, retryability, and first-cause diagnostics are asserted. Inapplicable fault classes require a typed N/A rationale.
- The terminal owner named by the dependency graph runs a release-built, no-mock E2E using the canonical shared commands: --list, --check, --self-test, --run PROFILE [--family-mode MODE], --negative CASE, and --replay MANIFEST_REL --input-artifact-root INPUT_ROOT, with explicit --artifact-root OUTPUT_ROOT --artifact-dir OUTPUT_REL on write modes. Nested nonterminal producer leaves emit bounded content-bound artifacts consumed by that runner and must not create a competing `--family-mode all` selector or `--mode`/`--profile` alias; exactly one catalog-owned terminal adapter may expose `--family-mode all` under exact-set registry tests.
- Canonical bounded logs record schema/source/build/tool/target/features, typed lossless values and units, command/profile/family/mode/case/sequence, budgets/work/resources, state/reason, expected/observed/effects, authority/no-claim, diagnostics/ranked repair, stop/drain roots, and relative artifact roots. Invocation manifests are fixed and nonempty; case_start opens every ordered slot with execution=execute|suppressed; suppressed permits zero family rows and requires immediate typed NotRun. Cooperative stops drain/finalize the active case and emit remaining suppressed slots before summary/terminal; forced or unproved truncation emits no terminal. Exact case_terminal/run_summary/run_terminal cardinality, caps, hostile parser cases, tamper detection, separate replay input/output roots, and artifact-only replay are mandatory. Raw scientific/performance/tool data stays in capped artifacts, and only explicitly declared volatile observations are excluded from identity.

title: fs-conduction heterogeneous regionwise conductivity field and operator/solver support
description:
> Canonical closure notice (2026-07-28 reality-check): the Design, Acceptance Criteria, and Notes fields are authoritative. Any embedded Acceptance Criteria, Success Criteria, Ownership and Verification Handoff, or Phase 9.5 sections below are retained as scope and history; they cannot weaken, override, or independently close the canonical fields.

## Outcome

Extend L3 steady conduction from one global `ConductivityModel` to a checked heterogeneous material field so each tet samples the model assigned to its declared region while retaining material authority, validity, and uncertainty. This is constitutive selection, not the existing scalar `element_scale` design-density path.

## Scope

Introduce a canonical `MaterialTable` plus one checked `MaterialId` per element, or an equivalent typed region field, and bind both roots into `ConductionProblem` and receipts. Assembly, residual, nonlinear Jacobian, and steady solver select each element's exact isotropic/orthotropic/tensor `k(T)` model at local temperature, preserve anisotropic frames and provenance, and validate temperature domains before and during iteration. Interfaces remain separate jump operators; region materials cannot erase or double-count them. Refuse map-length mismatch, missing/duplicate/unknown IDs, unassigned elements, receipt/region mismatch, invalid SPD/frame/units, out-of-domain `k(T)`, non-finite values, and unsupported solver paths. Never encode material identity in `element_scale` or average distinct cards into one global model.

## Required Tests and Logging

Unit/G0/G1 tests cover one-material parity with the existing path; analytic two- and three-layer 1-D slabs with discontinuous conductivity and exact series resistance; flux continuity and temperature behavior; a 3-D multi-region patch; rotated anisotropy; temperature-dependent materials crossing/remaining within domains; material/interface coexistence; regional power and energy balance; and Jacobian versus independent finite differences. Negative tests cover every map/table/receipt/domain error, overlapping/missing assignment, singular/extreme contrast, stale/tampered table/map, and unsupported transient/adjoint paths unless extended. Properties/metamorphics cover material-table/region-ID/tet permutations, rigid rotations with tensor-frame transformation, equivalent units, identical-material coalescing, contrast monotonicity, and mesh refinement. G4/G5 inject cancellation, budget, allocation, numeric, serialization, and ledger failures through assembly, iteration, audit, and publication; resumed/uninterrupted semantic roots match.

`scripts/ci/solve_stage_producers_e2e.sh --through conduction --case regionwise-conductivity --profile <pr|full|recovery>` consumes real material-resolution receipts and a real labeled `TetComplex` through production assembly/solve, independently checks regional heat flow and global balance, and retains the real ledger/checkpoint chain. Cases include homogeneous parity, multi-material analytic, anisotropic, nonlinear, interface, missing/tampered mapping, out-of-domain, cancel/resume, and deterministic repeat. Mocked material fields, `element_scale` selectors, fabricated receipts, or direct solver outputs do not count.

Canonical JSONL binds schema/version/event sequence, source revision/constellation identity, project/run/stage IDs, mesh/region/material-table/element-map/receipt roots, per-region model/domain/provenance, solver/Jacobian/balance metrics, work/cancel/resume counters, authority/no-claim state, diagnostics/ranked fixes, and output roots. Volatile observations are separate; meta-tests reject missing, duplicate, reordered, mixed-run/revision, truncated, unknown-version, and tampered records.

## Acceptance Criteria

Production steady assembly/solve demonstrably uses the declared model on every element; independent layered/flux oracles and finite-difference Jacobian checks pass; mapping/domain/provenance mutations fail closed; one-material behavior remains equivalent; interfaces remain separate; no partial solution publishes on fault; deterministic/restart roots agree. The no-mock E2E and negative corpus pass; `scripts/ci/checkout_constellation.sh --snapshot` passes against the unchanged pinned source snapshot; terminal `dsr quality --tool frankensim` PASS evidence retains run/log/artifact identities. Same-ISA bit replay is required; cross-ISA solver semantics use predeclared tolerances until actual dual-runtime G5 evidence exists.

### Snapshot Evidence Binding

Capture the complete root-plus-sibling constellation snapshot immediately before and after authoritative proof. The two snapshot identities and constellation.lock identity must be exact matches; evidence rows bind source HEAD, snapshot schema/identity, toolchain, target ISA, profile/features, and DSR run/log/artifact roots, and reject cross-snapshot splicing. A dirty/off-pin refusal is reported, never repaired by repinning a shared sibling.
design:
This is a generic L3 constitutive and operator capability. Its admitted seam is AuditedLabeledTetComplex plus canonical MaterialTable plus checked RegionMaterialAssignment plus assignment receipt -> HeterogeneousConductionProblem. It consumes lower-layer audited geometry types but does not depend on a particular mesher implementation or on s93ej.1.

The leaf E2E uses an independently retained, audited, real labeled mesh artifact with its own producer and auditor roots. That fixture is not hand-built solver state and cannot be certified by this conduction implementation. The parent combined product journey later proves that s93ej.1 output is consumed here.

Every element resolves exactly one material with physical units, isotropic, orthotropic, or tensor law, frame, temperature domain, uncertainty and provenance. Assembly, residual, Jacobian, nonlinear iteration, checkpoint, and receipt bind table and assignment roots. Material identity never uses element_scale. Interface jump operators remain distinct and cannot be erased or double-counted. Invalid or out-of-domain values refuse before authority-bearing publication.

Public errors name region, element, material, expected domain or units, observed state, retryability, and ranked repair. Cancellation is request-drain-finalize and atomic for complete solution authority; diagnostics may retain a typed no-solution artifact.
acceptance_criteria: 1. The public L3 seam requires an independently AuditedLabeledTetComplex, canonical MaterialTable, checked assignment, and receipt; no dependency on one mesher implementation is introduced. 2. Every element uses exactly one declared material in assembly, residual, Jacobian, nonlinear iteration, and receipts; element_scale never encodes material identity. 3. Isotropic, orthotropic, tensor, frame, units, temperature-domain, uncertainty, provenance, and interface coexistence semantics are exact. 4. Missing, duplicate, unknown, unassigned, length, stale-root, region, SPD, frame, unit, domain, non-finite, extreme-contrast, and unsupported-path cases refuse with localized repair. 5. Unit and G1 tests cover homogeneous parity, analytic two and three layer resistance, flux continuity, 3-D patch, rotated anisotropy, nonlinear temperature laws, interface coexistence, regional power, energy balance, and independent finite-difference Jacobian. 6. Property and metamorphic tests cover table, region, and tet permutations, tensor rotations, unit conversion, identical-material coalescing, contrast monotonicity, and refinement. 7. Bounded model, compile-fail seam, cancellation, allocation, numeric, serialization, ledger, crash-restart, tamper, and no-partial-publication tests pass. 8. Material, assignment, domain, frame, unit, Jacobian, interface, element-scale, cancel, source, and self-certified-mesh mutants are killed. 9. The release-built no-mock E2E consumes a retained independently audited labeled mesh and real material-resolution receipt through production steady conduction; the parent separately proves end-to-end mesh-to-conduction integration. 10. Bounded canonical JSONL has one case_terminal per fixed case, then one run_summary and one final run_terminal and separates mesh, auditor, table, assignment, operator, solver, execution, publication, diagnostic, and artifact roots. 11. Matching snapshots, verify-only preflight, DSR registry and dry-run, terminal quality, and replay pass.
notes:
Reality-check revision keeps heterogeneous conduction parallel with volumetricization by consuming a generic independently audited mesh. This avoids a false implementation dependency while preserving the parent integration proof, full material functionality, and detailed user diagnostics.

Runner inheritance is explicit: implementation may begin after huq.24.1 freezes RunnerSpecV2, but terminal E2E evidence and closure require the huq.24.4 conformance receipt. Family-specific material and solver records extend the shared bounded envelope without redefining ProofExitV2.

Additive verification-completeness baseline (never a substitute for the specialized criteria above):
- Unit and boundary tests cover happy, empty/zero/one, exact limit, one-below/one-above, maximum-without-huge-allocation, error, units/dimensions, numeric extremes, and deterministic tie/order cases owned by this leaf.
- Property/metamorphic tests exercise algebraic or relational invariants; bounded state/model tests cover lifecycle, concurrency, retry/replay, and invalid transitions where applicable.
- Public authority/type surfaces require API and compile-fail misuse tests. A leaf with no public type must record that fact and provide the nearest strict schema/API-negative equivalent rather than silently omitting the category.
- Seeded mutation tests independently alter every claim-bearing identity, bound, state, policy, route, authority, and no-claim field and retain minimized, reproducible failures.
- Cancellation/deadline plus injected allocation, worker/process, parser, I/O, durable-seal, publication, and replay faults are placed at every transition this leaf owns; drain/quiescence, exact resource return, no partial authority, retryability, and first-cause diagnostics are asserted. Inapplicable fault classes require a typed N/A rationale.
- The terminal owner named by the dependency graph runs a release-built, no-mock E2E using the canonical shared commands: --list, --check, --self-test, --run PROFILE [--family-mode MODE], --negative CASE, and --replay MANIFEST_REL --input-artifact-root INPUT_ROOT, with explicit --artifact-root OUTPUT_ROOT --artifact-dir OUTPUT_REL on write modes. Nested nonterminal producer leaves emit bounded content-bound artifacts consumed by that runner and must not create a competing `--family-mode all` selector or `--mode`/`--profile` alias; exactly one catalog-owned terminal adapter may expose `--family-mode all` under exact-set registry tests.
- Canonical bounded logs record schema/source/build/tool/target/features, typed lossless values and units, command/profile/family/mode/case/sequence, budgets/work/resources, state/reason, expected/observed/effects, authority/no-claim, diagnostics/ranked repair, stop/drain roots, and relative artifact roots. Invocation manifests are fixed and nonempty; case_start opens every ordered slot with execution=execute|suppressed; suppressed permits zero family rows and requires immediate typed NotRun. Cooperative stops drain/finalize the active case and emit remaining suppressed slots before summary/terminal; forced or unproved truncation emits no terminal. Exact case_terminal/run_summary/run_terminal cardinality, caps, hostile parser cases, tamper detection, separate replay input/output roots, and artifact-only replay are mandatory. Raw scientific/performance/tool data stays in capped artifacts, and only explicitly declared volatile observations are excluded from identity.

title: Conduction stage integration: labeled volume, heterogeneous operator, conjugate solve, and candidate evidence
description:
Own the terminal conduction-stage integration after the independent constrained-volume and heterogeneous-conductivity children. Bind region labels and material identities into the ConductionMesh and operator, consume the admitted airflow/network result where conjugate coupling requires it, run the real solver with explicit budgets and cancellation, publish one atomic stage result, and preserve checkpoint/restart, residual, energy-balance, and candidate evidence. Material and scenario prerequisites belong here, not on the core mesh or operator leaves.

Focused unit, manufactured-solution, property, metamorphic, and fault tests cover empty and minimum meshes, label permutations, missing/duplicate/unknown regions, anisotropic and extreme finite conductivity, units, rigid transforms, refinement, conservation, deterministic assembly/solve order, one-before/exact/one-after budgets, cancellation at every phase, panic/allocation failure, drain, retry, checkpoint/resume/fork, and no-partial publication. It contributes real positive and hostile cases to scripts/ci/solve_stage_producers_e2e.sh. Bounded V.3 JSONL records mesh/region/material/operator/network/scenario roots, units, budgets, residual and balance bounds, checkpoint, cancellation/drain, authority/no-claim, relative artifacts, and reproduction.

title: fs-diffreal-e2e: every as-built run refuses at finalization — fs-exec seals an InvocationReceipt its own verify_semantics rejects (20 tests red)
description:
## Defect (native, 2026-09-26, M4 release build at 256bdcd5e; reproduced with fs-report at HEAD)

`cargo test -p fs-diffreal-e2e` has 20 failures:
- lib: 10 of 11 report_policy_tests.
- tests/e2e: 10, including g0_as_built_receipt_is_one_completed_affine_transaction, g3_as_built_exact_envelope_succeeds_and_one_below_refuses, g5_as_built_invocation_receipt_replays_bit_for_bit, the_as_built_loop_localizes_a_defect_and_reduces_misfit, the_battery_is_deterministic, every_cx_identity_field_is_replay_bound.

Every failure has the same cause: the as-built loop refuses at invocation finalization.

    the fixed as-built loop completes under an infinite budget: Invocation(FinalizationReceiptMismatch { invariant: "producer-invocation-receipt" })

It is raised at crates/fs-exec/src/invocation.rs:2357, where the freshly built InvocationReceipt fails its own `verify_semantics()`. So the producer seals a receipt its own verifier rejects. fs-exec's last change was 2026-08-26 (8c53e7e06); fs-diffreal-e2e's was 2026-09-05 (ac722088c).

## Do

Find which verify_semantics invariant fails. Temporarily map the error through instead of `map_err(|_| ...)`: the `|_|` discards the reason, which is itself worth fixing. Then fix the producer or the invariant, whichever is wrong. Do not relax the check to make the battery pass.

## Done when

`cargo test -p fs-diffreal-e2e` is green natively. The FinalizationReceiptMismatch error carries the failed invariant's own reason.
close_reason: Fixed at b6d90f78b, verified natively (M4 release): fs-exec plus fs-diffreal-e2e are 314/0 (20 were red). Carrying the verifier's invariant name through the finalizer identified nested-affine-transfer. The verifier subtracted summed nested grants before adding returns, which underflowed on sequential grandchildren reusing memory: memory is reusable capacity, so the net transfer is zero. Add-first is identical whenever the old order did not underflow. The finalizer error now carries the failing invariant's own name.

title: Publish review shards with resumable journaled br-only protocol
description:
ROOT CAUSE: br child creation, bounded payload completion, declared-edge binding, raw and semantic lint, export, graph validation, replay, and activation are separate operations. There is no multi-object transaction or deletion-safe creation inverse. Whole-tracker roots and sequence ordinals are unstable child identities. Large target context cannot be pushed through unbounded argv, superseded children can otherwise block forever, and repeated wave calls can flood br ready.

PURPOSE: After .1.3 has admitted or fail-closed the .1.1 reviewed v2 plan, add exact versioned publish, reconcile, status, cooperative .8-claimed advance-wave, and manual-wave-handoff routes. Tracker changes use only br with scoped no-auto-import/no-auto-flush mutations and explicit batch export. The journal/comments are append-only evidence; child fields/edges/status and .8 claim/release are observed scoped mutations. Target apply is not owned here; .1.3 owns version dispatch and authority/capability gating.

TRANSPORT AND OVERSIZE: Use description-file for the large body and bounded argv for acceptance/design/notes. A target whose full context exceeds child caps becomes OVERSIZE_REVIEW_REQUIRED: the child retains exact target/field/clause roots, bounded relevant index, safe retained full-plan artifact reference, reproduction, and escalation route. The target remains the canonical full source; no semantic text is discarded.

LIFECYCLE: Stable external_ref keys exclude global roots/ordinals. Publication binds parent, .5, and a closed intended edge set; runs semantic lint and safe live-cycle/export/robot/replay order; reaches PUBLISHED; then capacity admits waves based on current open/in_progress occupancy. Every activation is exported, witnessed, graph-checked, and replayed before ACTIVATED. Supersession is reviewed forward migration, never compensation.

## Acceptance Criteria

The structured acceptance field requires closed CLI grammar, safe transport/oversize handling, stable keys/versioned supersession, complete edge publication, occupancy-aware waves with post-activation proof, forward recovery, comprehensive tests/no-mock E2E/logging/replay, and strict target-immutability/shared-path boundaries.
acceptance_criteria:
## Journaled shard-publication acceptance

1. Consume only .1.1 reviewed v2 standard or OVERSIZE_REVIEW_REQUIRED specs whose selected-target, grouping, bounded child payload, reviewer identity, declared authority, compatibility, and artifact roots verify. Stale, unresolved, truncated, over-cap non-escalation, or v1-only input refuses before br mutation. Target apply is delegated exclusively to .1.3.
2. Preserve prior modes and standardize every v2 artifact-producing mode on the existing output grammar: --publish-shards PLAN_REL --artifact-root ROOT_REL --artifact-dir FRESH_RUN_REL; --reconcile-shards PRIOR_RUN_REL --artifact-root ROOT_REL --artifact-dir FRESH_RUN_REL; --materialization-status RUN_REL --artifact-root ROOT_REL --artifact-dir FRESH_RUN_REL; --advance-wave PRIOR_RUN_REL --artifact-root ROOT_REL --artifact-dir FRESH_RUN_REL; --emit-manual-wave-handoff PRIOR_RUN_REL --artifact-root ROOT_REL --artifact-dir FRESH_RUN_REL. Do not add --output. Mutating routes require --expected-plan-root, support --dry-run and --max-children default 10, and allow exactly one mode. Reconcile/advance/handoff never modify PRIOR_RUN_REL; FRESH_RUN_REL chains its semantic root. Status and handoff emission are tracker-read-only. Duplicate output options refuse.
3. Every input, ROOT_REL, and FRESH_RUN_REL is normalized safe relative, bounded by byte/component/depth caps, has no dot/parent/backslash/drive/tilde/control ambiguity or symlink traversal, is disjoint from inputs, and is no-overwrite beneath the allowed artifact root. Missing input, wrong artifact kind/root, same input/output, existing FRESH_RUN_REL, unsafe Unicode/path, --output use, or invalid/duplicate flag combination has stable typed refusal.
4. Logical key covers schema, lane, hard/compatibility vector, exact membership, and complete bounded payload semantic root; exclude whole-tracker roots and sequence. Store exact external_ref fs-template-hygiene:v2:<key>. Global source/inventory/tool identities live in observation receipts. Relevant membership/payload change creates a new key plus reviewed supersession; unrelated drift cannot duplicate work.
5. Preflight sync status, DB/export witness, selected targets, plan root, and current campaign occupancy. Per-child br mutators use --no-auto-import --no-auto-flush. Journal expected/observed successors. Export only explicit bounded checkpoints with br sync --flush-only. Journal/comments are append-only; fields/labels/edges/status are scoped mutations.
6. Enumerate br list --all --deferred --json --limit 0 under a bounding label, compare exact external_ref, and br show matches. One exact match reuses, zero creates, multiple/conflicts refuse. Full conflicting IDs stay in artifact; CLI shows bounded preview+total.
7. Initial br create requests one status=deferred issue with external_ref, title, description via --description-file, estimate, coordination assignee, and intended parent/labels, but makes no multi-object atomicity claim. Bind description bytes immediately before use and reobserve the child. Parent and publication-quarantine labels are separately journaled and verified while the issue remains deferred; any partial create is safe-deferred, never activated, and reconciled forward. One subsequent br update sets acceptance/design/notes while deferred. Caps are 131,072 description bytes, 32,768 acceptance bytes, 16,384 design bytes, 16,384 notes bytes, 65,536 aggregate non-description argv bytes, and 262,144 total retained child payload bytes; n-1/n/n+1 tests are exact.
8. If one target cannot fit without semantic loss, publish a bounded OVERSIZE_REVIEW_REQUIRED escalation child containing exact target/field/clause roots, missing-section/disposition evidence, bounded clause index, canonical br show reproduction, safe retained full review-plan artifact/root, owner/governance questions, and no-claim. The external artifact may exceed child payload but remains within run artifact cap. No source semantics are copied partially and presented as complete; .5 treats the escalation leaf as unresolved until reviewed.
9. Separate informational source_dependency_snapshot from closed actual intended_edges. Actual edges include atomic parent-child, exact direction br dep add <.5> <child> --type blocks, any declared governance blocker, and reviewed supersedes relation. State DECLARED_EDGES_BOUND verifies missing/extra/reversed/duplicate/type/metadata errors before cycles. Informational target dependencies never silently become blockers.
10. Split lifecycle authority into three closed fields. preparation_stage is PREPARED before creation. durable_mutation_state is NOT_CREATED, CHILD_OBSERVED, QUARANTINE_BOUND, PAYLOAD_COMPLETE, PARENT_BOUND, CLOSEOUT_EDGE_BOUND, or DECLARED_EDGES_BOUND and advances only after the corresponding child/field/edge projection is observed. evidence_stage_receipts[] contains RAW_LINT_CLEAN, SEMANTIC_LINT_CLEAN, LIVE_CYCLE_CLEAN, BATCH_EXPORTED, EXPORT_WITNESSED, EXPORTED_GRAPH_CLEAN, and REPLAY_VERIFIED with input/output roots and freshness. publication_terminal is NOT_PUBLISHED or derived PUBLISHED; activation_terminal is separately derived under criteria 11-13. Raw lint uses explicit ID and all-status semantics; semantic lint reruns v1 real-Markdown, placeholder, copied-boilerplate, and scope-loss checks. Run live br blocking cycles before export and robot bv after export.
11. PUBLISHED may remain deferred for capacity. Available activation slots are max(0, campaign_cap minus current open/in_progress ACTIVATED campaign leaves), lane_cap similarly, and owner_cap similarly. Versioned defaults: 20 campaign, 10 lane, 3 per coordination owner. Repeated --advance-wave without completed/deferred existing work activates zero. Unassigned/unresolved rows activate only governance/review questions. Every leaf blocks .5.
12. Wave states are ACTIVATION_SELECTED, DEQUARANTINE_SELECTED, DEQUARANTINE_OBSERVED, STATUS_OPEN_SELECTED, STATUS_OPEN_OBSERVED, ACTIVATION_EXPORT_PENDING, WAVE_EXPORTED, WAVE_EXPORT_WITNESSED, WAVE_GRAPH_CLEAN, WAVE_REPLAY_VERIFIED, ACTIVATED. Remove publication quarantine while the child is still deferred, reobserve exact absence, then make status=open the final activation mutation and reobserve it. Status and label are never described as one atomic update. Batch flush, witness, exported graph check, and replay remain mandatory; until they pass, state is ACTIVATION_EXPORT_PENDING and recovery is forward-only.
13. Desired open activation first uses a tested label-only br update to remove publication quarantine while status remains deferred, reobserves the exact child and label set, then uses a separate final br update to status=open. Cancellation, failure, or ambiguity between these checkpoints leaves a deferred dequarantined child that cannot be selected again until reconciliation; it never silently opens. Desired semantic-deferred publication stops after verified dequarantine while staying deferred and records reason/key through br comments add plus journal observation. Do not claim a transition-comment without a status transition. Publication defer and semantic defer are distinct.
14. Supersession is convergent: new child declares exact supersedes relation to old and must reach PUBLISHED first. A fully PUBLISHED old child may close only through independent reviewed br close reason citing old/new keys, membership/payload roots, and exact coverage; partial/conflicted old work remains quarantined/governed. This is lifecycle migration, not failure compensation. .5 journal/dependency union retains both historical old and current new IDs. Test every crash boundary.
15. Recovery is observation-first and forward-only. Transport ambiguity re-observes; cancellation drains. Matching partials complete. Conflicts stay deferred/quarantined with additive records. Never delete/tombstone/direct-edit/close as compensation/call creation reversible. Selected targets stay byte-identical.
16. Every successful run retains the exact mandatory base set reviewed-plan.json, observation-receipts.jsonl, materialization-journal.jsonl, child-map.json, edge-map.json, events.jsonl, terminal.json, and reproduce.txt. Optional oversize files are allowed only through a closed oversize_content[] inventory recording each relative path, media/schema kind, byte length, semantic root, target/field/clause roots, and aggregate-cap accounting. Any unlisted, duplicate, unsafe, missing, changed, or over-cap file refuses replay. Closed schemas, no-overwrite, unique-last terminal, root chaining, and artifact replay reconstruct keys, versions, edges, states, waves, supersession, and unchanged targets with live tracker denied.
17. Unit/schema/boundary/property/metamorphic/state tests cover zero/one/many, all target/field/argv/payload/artifact caps, safe paths/CLI grammar, stable key versus observation drift, external_ref matches, oversize escalation, source versus intended edges, raw versus semantic lint, state/export order, occupancy/repeated wave, semantic deferred, supersession, opaque IDs, deterministic scheduling/errors, and target identity.
18. Mutation/fault/resource/cancellation/restart/no-mock E2E through scripts/ci/beads_template_hygiene.sh covers lost responses/crashes at every state, file TOCTOU, argv/shell/Unicode/large payloads, auto-import/export drift, wrong/missing/reversed edges, key collision, journal loss, forged review, semantic mutants, cycle/graph/export/replay failures, queue flood, dequarantine/open split failure, activation export failure, supersession handoff, output caps, and signals. Released br/robot bv fixtures prove exact behavior and artifact replay. Logs retain argv arrays, exit/category, allowlisted semantic-field projections, and raw-stream roots, never raw stdout/stderr bodies. Redaction rejects credentials, environment values, source_repo_path/other absolute paths, PIDs, scheduler noise, and bulk descriptions. .1.2 owns that script and the v2 manifest after .1.3 and hands them to .7 only after proof; it creates no duplicate harness.

## Plan-space refinement 2026-07-30 (controlling)

19. Hard-depend on .1.3, which transitively consumes .1.1. Reserve scripts/ci/beads_template_hygiene.sh and tests/e2e/manifests/beads-template-hygiene-v2.toml only after .1.3 releases them, preserve fail-closed v1/v2 apply, dry-run, manual-handoff, and reconcile modes, then add publisher modes. Hand shared paths to .7 after proof. This ordering supersedes the earlier .1.2-to-.1.3 handoff.
20. Admission has explicit workflow classes. Standard semantic-remediation publication requires DECLARED_READY plus a root-bound reviewer declaration. Owner/governance questions and OVERSIZE_REVIEW_REQUIRED may publish a limited REVIEW_ONLY child containing only review/escalation work. Neither limited workflow is mechanically eligible. MANUAL_BR_REVIEW remains operator-owned; AUTOMATED_CONDITIONAL requires both .1.3 gates.
21. Publication and activation use one campaign_epoch_root. Relevant membership or lane movement invalidates affected specs and emits reviewed successor lineage; unrelated coherent drift only updates observations. If a source target is in_progress, actively assigned, or in another recorded workflow, its child remains deferred until a root-bound coordination acknowledgement permits activation. Acknowledgement prevents operational collision only and grants no semantic authority.
22. Current --advance-wave is cooperative campaign-single-writer through exact sentinel .8 and released br atomic --claim, but live admission is graph-gated. Before live activation it verifies .7 is closed with retained terminal Pass and .8 has no remaining hard blocker and a fresh admission receipt validates deferred/unassigned state with a matching release root; otherwise it returns NODATA_SENTINEL_NOT_ADMITTED without mutating .8 or a child. .1.2 exercises claim/release/recovery success only in a disjoint released-br fixture and never claims live .8 during its own implementation. Once admitted, acquire with the exact unique --actor argv, validate the claim-capability and preclaim receipts, hold through dequarantine/status/export/graph/replay, and release only to deferred/unassigned after exact postflight. Missing, ambiguous, stale, wrongly owned, crashed, or unreconciled .8 blocks activation while publication stays deferred. This proves cooperative serialization only.
23. durable_mutation_state contains only observed mutation checkpoints; evidence_stage_receipts are immutable, input-rooted observations and never masquerade as mutable child state. Derive PUBLISHED only when durable_mutation_state=DECLARED_EDGES_BOUND and every required current evidence receipt verifies against the same child/campaign roots. Derive ACTIVATED only after the separate dequarantine/status/export/graph/replay protocol verifies. Stale receipts demote the derived terminal without rewriting historical receipts. Comments or labels alone never authorize any state.
24. --materialization-status is tracker-read-only and double-captures comparison against a retained run. Dry-run proves unchanged DB/export/selected-target identities and emits exact planned argv/content roots. Both provide a bounded operator synopsis: created/reused/conflicted/quarantined/PUBLISHED/ACTIVATED counts, ready-queue delta, selected IDs, active conflicts, occupancy before/after, cap and zero-activation reasons, recovery, next eligible work, artifacts, reproduction, and no-claim. Rename or document --max-children as an invocation publication cap so it cannot be confused with targets-per-child.
25. Feed verified description bytes to br create --description-file - from a bound in-memory/stdin source; retain content as evidence and reobserve resulting field root. Use only an admitted relationship representation for supersession: related plus rooted relation=supersedes-v2 metadata unless capability proof admits a native type. The new child must reach PUBLISHED before any reviewed exact-ID old-child close.
26. No exactly-once claim is possible under concurrent publishers without an admitted uniqueness/conditional primitive. Publication does not acquire .8: stable-key full lookup and double observation detect likely duplicates, while duplicate or ambiguous creates remain deferred/quarantined, never activate, and reconcile forward through exact IDs. .8 serializes activation only and cannot be cited as concurrent-publication protection. Creation remains irreversible and targets remain unchanged.
27. The v2 manifest must execute named cases for simultaneous publishers, active-target conflict, NODATA_SENTINEL_NOT_ADMITTED, SENTINEL_NEVER_READY_BETWEEN_WAVES, sentinel claim/refusal, SENTINEL_DEQUARANTINE_BEFORE_STATUS, SENTINEL_DEQUARANTINE_CRASH_REFUSES_STATUS, and SENTINEL_STATUS_BEFORE_DEQUARANTINE_REFUSES, cross-lane movement, duplicate key, bv unavailable/timeout/malformed output, journal truncation, crash at every durable boundary, wave retry, hostile payload/path/result body, and replay with network/live tracker denied. Detailed logs and explicit redaction assertions cover case/assertion IDs, content roots, occupancy, argv/results, first divergence, recovery, and unique terminal while rejecting secrets, environment dumps, absolute paths, PIDs, timing noise, and bulk bodies; prose-only case descriptions do not pass.
28. The 10,080-minute planning floor is explicit: 1,440 publisher schemas, stable keys, and safe transport + 1,440 journal/reconcile/publication + 1,200 status/operator/manual-handoff UX + 1,440 sentinel, occupancy, and recovery protocol + 1,200 generated-leaf schema/validator integration + 1,920 unit/property/mutation/fault/cancellation coverage + 1,440 released-tool E2E, redacted logging, offline replay, and review. Fresh arithmetic adds effort; this is not a cap and no scope is reduced to fit it.

29. Activation has three explicit routes. CURRENT_COOPERATIVE_CLAIM_WAVE uses .8 atomic claim for well-behaved current-tool actors and makes no fencing/exactly-once claim. MANUAL_ACTIVATION_REQUIRED emits a reviewed handoff whose operator must also claim .8. AUTOMATED_FENCED_WAVE requires the separately admitted conditional lease/occupancy capability in deferred related frankensim-template-hygiene-campaign-lease-wcivr. The future route is nonblocking; absence is AUTOMATION_NODATA, while missing or unreconciled .8 blocks present-day activation.
30. A manual-wave handoff is bounded, argv-form, and never shell-evaluated. It binds campaign/lane/source roots, exact .8 claim/reobserve/release argv and unique actor token, ordered child IDs/projections, occupancy/caps, active-target acknowledgements, immediate per-child show/abort-on-difference queries, exact one-child update argv, post-observation, batch br sync --flush-only, graph/replay, independent operator/reviewer scopes, recovery, and NO_FENCED_DISTRIBUTED_OR_EXACTLY_ONCE_CLAIM. The harness emits but never executes it.
31. Manual execution requires one declared operator, an explicit quiescent coordination window, and successful unique-token .8 claim. Before each child activation reobserve .8 ownership, campaign/lane/owner occupancy, and child projection; drift, competing operator, changed state, cap uncertainty, or ambiguous response stops the wave and routes to reconcile while .8 remains held until independent recovery. After each write reobserve the child; after the batch flush/export, graph-check, replay, verify occupancy, and release .8 exactly once. A clean receipt can satisfy present-day closeout but proves only cooperative serialization.
32. Executable current-tool cases use the canonical v2 registry IDs: NODATA_SENTINEL_NOT_ADMITTED, SENTINEL_NEVER_READY_BETWEEN_WAVES, SENTINEL_CLAIM_RACE, SENTINEL_SAME_HUMAN_DISTINCT_RUN, SENTINEL_MISSING_DEFAULT_REUSED_ACTOR_REFUSES, SENTINEL_ACTOR_AUDIT_MISMATCH_REFUSES, SENTINEL_LOST_CLAIM_RESPONSE, SENTINEL_PRECLAIM_STATE_MISMATCH, SENTINEL_PRECLAIM_CAPABILITY_MISMATCH, SENTINEL_CRASH_HELD, SENTINEL_WRONG_OWNER_RELEASE, SENTINEL_STALE_MANUAL_RECOVERY, SENTINEL_RELEASE_AMBIGUOUS, DECLARED_MANUAL_WAVE_OPERATOR, ACTIVATION_WITHOUT_SENTINEL_REFUSES, SENTINEL_DEQUARANTINE_BEFORE_STATUS, SENTINEL_DEQUARANTINE_CRASH_REFUSES_STATUS, SENTINEL_STATUS_BEFORE_DEQUARANTINE_REFUSES, CAP_REOBSERVE_EACH_CHILD, WAVE_MANUAL_HANDOFF, WAVE_MANUAL_PARTIAL_RECONCILE, WAVE_CANCEL_EACH_BOUNDARY, WAVE_LOG_REDACTION, and WAVE_OFFLINE_REPLAY. WAVE_FUTURE_FENCED_SUCCESS and WAVE_FUTURE_STALE_FENCE are schema/simulator cases only and cannot satisfy authentic E2E or current closure; authentic success belongs to frankensim-template-hygiene-campaign-lease-wcivr and later versioned requalification.
33. Criterion 28 already includes manual-wave schemas, .8 atomic-claim sentinel integration, generated-leaf validation, operator UX, reconciliation, current optional-automation NoData, non-authoritative future schema fixtures, concurrency/fault tests, detailed redacted logs, and offline replay. Retain fresh bottom-up arithmetic and re-estimate upward rather than removing campaign caps, manual recovery, or safety evidence.

34. Own the closed generated-leaf terminal schema and validator contract; .7 implements/tests it, .8 applies it operationally, and .5 independently adjudicates it. Verified close classes are REVIEW_RESOLVED_NO_TARGET_CHANGE, MANUAL_REPAIR_VERIFIED, AUTOMATED_REPAIR_VERIFIED, SUPERSEDED_COVERED, MOVED_TO_LANE_COVERED, MOVED_TO_HISTORY_COVERED, and MOVED_FROM_HISTORY_COVERED. Each movement class binds coherent before/after like-unit all-status roots, exact destination partition, one successor owner and leaf key, successor publication plus .5 blocker, immutable prior evidence, and proof of no simultaneous live/history ownership. Canonical non-close classes are BLOCKED_MANUAL_AUTHORIZATION, ACTIVE_TARGET_CONFLICT, CONCURRENT_DRIFT, AMBIGUOUS_POSTSTATE, COMPENSATION_BLOCKED_BY_DRIFT, COMPENSATION_FAILED, BLOCKED_AUTOMATION_PREREQUISITE, BLOCKED_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW, PARTIAL_PUBLICATION, REPLAY_MISMATCH, and MANUAL_RECOVERY_REQUIRED. Legacy AMBIGUOUS_MANUAL_RESULT is accepted only as migration input and normalizes to AMBIGUOUS_POSTSTATE, never success. AUTOMATION_NODATA is nonblocking only when a separately verified manual or no-change close class exists. Each class has exact required roots, events, falsifiers, recovery, and permitted exact-ID br close behavior.
35. Close .1.2 only after publisher/status/reconcile/manual-handoff schemas pass unit/property/mutation/fault/cancellation/restart and current released-tool no-mock E2E; immutable v1 regression, detailed redaction, artifact-only replay, duplicate quarantine, split dequarantine/open checkpoints, generated-leaf validation, live NODATA_SENTINEL_NOT_ADMITTED refusal, and disjoint-fixture-only .8 claim/release/recovery proof pass; every implementation-run terminal is resolved; and shared paths release to .7. No live .8 claim or authentic future fenced success is required or permitted here. Dynamic campaign leaves remain owned by .8/.5.

36. Optional oversize artifacts are governed solely by the criterion 16 oversize_content[] inventory. Unit, mutation, no-mock E2E, log, and replay cases reject missing/unlisted/extra files, path aliasing, media/schema mismatch, byte-length/root mismatch, aggregate-cap overflow, truncated bounded indexes, or semantic laundering.
37. A deferred target may produce only ANALYSIS_ONLY review/governance work. DECLARED_MANUAL_AUTHORIZATION and both automation gates do not override deferred status. Owner-reviewed exact reactivation must occur outside the harness, then a fresh coherent campaign capture, reinventory, and replan must admit MANUAL_BR_REVIEW or AUTOMATED_CONDITIONAL. DEFERRED_MANUAL_REFUSES_UNTIL_REACTIVATED and DEFERRED_REACTIVATE_REINVENTORY are mandatory cases.

title: Version-gate target apply through verified authority and conditional-write capability
description:
ROOT CAUSE: The v1 --apply-manifest route accepts a declarative current-owner review receipt. The v2 contracts correctly distinguish self-reported br coordination from externally verified review authority, but merely preserving the v1 live route would allow a downgrade around that boundary. A second, independent safety boundary is also mandatory: the installed br 0.2.19 exposes no conditional-update/CAS precondition over an observed target revision or semantic field root. A final show followed by ordinary br update therefore has an unavoidable race and cannot promise that it will not overwrite an unseen concurrent edit; an inverse update can likewise overwrite a later edit.

SCOPE: Preserve v1 parsing, artifact, replay, self-test, and compatible diagnostic behavior; the current v1 command has no dry-run, so add explicit fail-closed dry-run support. The legacy v1 apply schema cannot carry the new exact authority/capability bindings, so live --apply-manifest is permanently AUTOMATION_NODATA and may never become a future automation downgrade path; frozen disjoint-fixture apply cases remain historical compatibility evidence only. Add --apply-reviewed-v2 MANIFEST_REL --artifact-root ROOT_REL --artifact-dir FRESH_RUN_REL as the sole possible future automated route. That v2 route requires both configured external exact-scope review authority and admitted atomic conditional write. Dry-run, DECLARED_MANUAL_AUTHORIZATION handoff, reconcile diagnostics, and replay remain available. A separately authorized operator may act outside the harness under exact pre/post/independent-review receipts and explicit no-CAS/no-clobber/no-exactly-once boundary.

AUTHORITY ADAPTER: The closed receipt records adapter identity/version/trust-registry root, issuer/provider, subject, target ID, old/proposed field roots, proposal/plan roots, operation, issuance, expiry, revocation freshness, outcome, and replay. Wrong scope, stale/unknown/self-issued claims, downgrade, or unavailable provider refuses automation. No adapter means every row remains at most DECLARED_READY and harness apply is AUTOMATION_NODATA; it does not erase an independently approved DECLARED_MANUAL_AUTHORIZATION route.

CONDITIONAL-WRITE CAPABILITY: A closed capability record identifies the released br implementation and version, command grammar, atomic precondition semantics, lock scope, exact compare key, refusal behavior, forward-write and compensation support, idempotency/ambiguous-response reconciliation semantics, probe evidence, and conformance verdict. Advisory Agent Mail reservations, a repeated show, timestamps observed outside the write transaction, ordinary br locking, and optimistic post-write comparison do not qualify. MECHANICALLY_APPLY_ELIGIBLE requires both verified review authority and a conforming conditional-write capability. The current tool therefore cannot reach this state.

RECOVERY BOUNDARY: Even with a future conforming capability, compensation is conditional on the exact intended poststate still being current. Never inverse over an unknown or concurrently changed poststate. CONCURRENT_DRIFT, AMBIGUOUS_POSTSTATE, COMPENSATION_BLOCKED_BY_DRIFT, COMPENSATION_FAILED, and MANUAL_RECOVERY_REQUIRED are retained terminal outcomes that never report success, block Bead closeout, and preserve exact before/attempted/observed/inverse evidence. The system may prove that it refused an unsafe write; it may not promise unconditional restoration across concurrency or infrastructure failure.

USER CLARITY: Template review_minutes and generated-child estimated_minutes describe review work only. Preserve the underlying target implementation estimate in a separate snapshot field; never imply feature completion or replace its estimate.

## Acceptance Criteria

Closed rows are exact-once immutable history with unchanged sources and consumer dispositions. Every P0-P4/status cell is exact membership or verified zero receipt. ## Plan-space refinement 2026-07-30 (controlling)

14. Enforce the exact base direct blocking set {.1.2, .1.3, .2, .3, .4, .4.1, .4.2, .4.3, .6, .7, .8}. The .5 reviewer is distinct from .7/.8 owners and all campaign publishers.
16. Present-day closure uses reviewed MANUAL_BR_REVIEW with DECLARED_MANUAL_AUTHORIZATION. Authorization binds exact target/proposal/field roots plus one explicit source: current user instruction, current live target/program/domain-owner approval, or resolved governance child. The operator cannot self-authorize and aggregate waivers refuse. Each repair binds before projection, one-target argv/content root, authorization/operator/reviewer identities and scopes, immediate precondition reobservation, observed result, after projection, independent semantic review, DB/export convergence, and no unexplained drift. Independently prove P4 all-status accounting after projecting and deduplicating by issue_id: p4_all_status_issue_ids_root equals the disjoint union of .4.3 nonclosed_p4_issue_ids_root and .6 closed_p4_issue_ids_root under one coherent capture or explicit rebase lineage; warning-row and consumer-edge roots remain separate typed units and are never compared directly; and every MOVED_TO_HISTORY, MOVED_FROM_HISTORY, or MOVED_TO_LANE transition has coherent before/after capture roots and one successor lineage. Every live and closed consumer disposition is terminal or has an exact blocking child, and neither lane silently relies on the other. Mismatch is a typed non-close finding owned by a new additive correction Bead.
18. Consume the immutable .7 base traceability matrix and .8 lifecycle schema/receipts, then produce a separate no-overwrite .5 adjudication overlay. The joined view has one row for every controlling criterion of the root, .1-.8, every generated leaf, and every gate rule; it binds criterion ID/root to implementation/evidence owner, unit/property/mutation IDs, released-tool E2E assertion IDs, deterministic log keys, replay, DSR result, and no-claim from producers, plus actual independent reviewer identity/scope/conflict/verdict in the overlay. The overlay binds closed .7/.8 roots and never edits producer evidence. Missing, duplicate, prose-only, stale, conflicted, or many-to-none mappings refuse.
19. Closeout has stable run terminals PASS, FAIL_SEMANTIC, FAIL_GRAPH, FAIL_TRACEABILITY, FAIL_REPLAY, BLOCKED_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW, BLOCKED_MANUAL_AUTHORIZATION, BLOCKED_AUTOMATION_PREREQUISITE, NODATA_TRACKER_CONVERGENCE, NODATA_DSR, and INFRASTRUCTURE_ERROR. Missing optional automation is item-level AUTOMATION_NODATA, not a run terminal, when the item has a complete verified manual/no-change terminal. BLOCKED_AUTOMATION_PREREQUISITE applies only when a row explicitly requires automation and has no admitted manual route. terminal.json is unique-last and records terminal, automation summaries, first divergence, IDs/roots, recovery, evidence, reproduction, and unchanged-state receipt. Only PASS permits close.
20. Independent E2E adjudication replays every v2 case offline, then runs authentic current released-br/robot-bv fixtures for clean, DECLARED_MANUAL_AUTHORIZATION sources/conflicts, manual repair, optional automation NoData, all current .8 sentinel claim/release/crash/recovery cases, every current leaf terminal, cross-lane movement, history movement, deferred-reactivation refusal, oversize handling, active conflict, closed/live consumer, P4 zero/nonzero, duplicate/partial publication, hostile mutation, graph drift, unknown Git base, DSR refusal, and reviewer conflict. Future both-gates and fenced-wave success are schema/simulator cases only until those providers exist; absence of an authentic future provider never blocks the current manual/no-change journey. A required CURRENT_BR_MANUAL_PROGRAM_CLOSE journey first proves the prerequisite chain .1.1 -> .1.3 -> .1.2 and exact-ID closes .7, publishes a nonzero child, exact-ID closes producer lanes .2, .3, .4.1, .4.2, .4.3, and .6 after their publication handoffs, then claims .8, activates, emits the handoff, authorizes and performs operator repair, and independently verifies and exact-ID closes every generated leaf. It then exact-ID closes .4, releases and exact-ID closes .8, exact-ID closes .5, and finally exact-ID closes root in that order in a disjoint fixture, converges export, and replays to PASS with all future providers absent. Negative twins refuse a missing sentinel claim or missing authorization. V1 remains unchanged.
21. Operator output is one-screen first and evidence-rich on demand: terminal, blockers, debt by priority/status/route, manual versus automated eligibility, active conflicts, generated/open leaves, graph/cycle state, DB/export convergence, traceability coverage, replay, DSR status, independent-review status, first divergence, exact next br command, artifacts, reproduction, and no-claim. Detailed logs retain only allowlisted command-result fields plus roots, byte counts, and relative artifact paths for raw stdout/stderr streams; they never embed unbounded bodies and exclude secrets, environment dumps, absolute paths, PIDs, scheduler timing, and bulk Bead bodies.
22. Current br epic close-eligible is workspace-wide and therefore diagnostic dry-run evidence only. After all blockers and generated leaves are proven closed, close .5 by exact-ID ordinary br close with cited receipts; then the root may be independently exact-ID closed after its rollup preflight. No force, bypass, broad epic close, implicit descendant closure, or status-only update is permitted.
23. Observe the root related hierarchy-normalization and estimate/priority/owner-hygiene Beads in the final report. They are nonblocking context unless a fresh exact check shows this program violates their current contract; any real violation creates an explicit corrective blocker rather than a silent scope expansion. The 7,200-minute planning floor is 2,400 independent corpus reconstruction + 2,400 all-row traceability and replay + 1,440 current-tool E2E and DSR adjudication + 960 reviewer conflict, failure triage, and recovery. Fresh leaves, findings, retries, or infrastructure evidence add effort; re-estimate instead of dropping proof.
24. Present-day wave closeout requires .8 cooperative atomic-claim receipts for either current-tool lifecycle automation or reviewed manual execution: unique epoch/run actor, exact claim owner, ordered child IDs, per-child pre/post projections, fresh campaign/lane/owner occupancy, active-target acknowledgements, export/graph/replay, exact release, and explicit no-fenced/no-exactly-once claim. Any missing/held/wrong-owner/ambiguous sentinel claim, overlap, drift, cap uncertainty, or partial wave is non-close until independently reconciled. Deferred frankensim-template-hygiene-campaign-lease-wcivr is optional future fenced automation.
25. Generated-leaf closure uses the closed .1.2 schema implemented/tested by .7 and operationally validated by .8. Verified close classes are REVIEW_RESOLVED_NO_TARGET_CHANGE, MANUAL_REPAIR_VERIFIED, AUTOMATED_REPAIR_VERIFIED, SUPERSEDED_COVERED, MOVED_TO_LANE_COVERED, MOVED_TO_HISTORY_COVERED, and MOVED_FROM_HISTORY_COVERED. Movement closure requires coherent before/after like-unit all-status roots, exact destination partition, one successor owner and leaf key, successor publication plus .5 blocker, immutable prior evidence, and no simultaneous live/history ownership. Canonical non-close classes are BLOCKED_MANUAL_AUTHORIZATION, ACTIVE_TARGET_CONFLICT, CONCURRENT_DRIFT, AMBIGUOUS_POSTSTATE, COMPENSATION_BLOCKED_BY_DRIFT, COMPENSATION_FAILED, BLOCKED_AUTOMATION_PREREQUISITE, BLOCKED_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW, PARTIAL_PUBLICATION, REPLAY_MISMATCH, and MANUAL_RECOVERY_REQUIRED. Legacy AMBIGUOUS_MANUAL_RESULT is accepted only as migration input and normalizes to AMBIGUOUS_POSTSTATE, never success. Only a verified class permits exact-ID ordinary br close with reason/transition receipt; REVIEW_ONLY, OVERSIZE, conflicted, ambiguous, blocked, compensation-failed, or unreplayed leaves remain open.
26. The independent matrix includes named positive and falsifying unit, property, mutation, fault, cancellation, restart, released-tool E2E, log-redaction, and offline-replay cases for all-status/history movement, deferred reactivation, oversize full-artifact retention, relation-versus-neighbor drift, every canonical generated-leaf close/non-close class, legacy-class normalization, future-capability simulation, and a current manual journey with every future provider absent. Any missing case or unrooted expected result is FAIL_TRACEABILITY.
notes: CANONICAL TWO-GATE CLOSEOUT AMENDMENT (2026-07-30): The independent gate must reconstruct .1.3 two-factor mechanical eligibility, not merely external review authority. A row or generated child may report MECHANICALLY_APPLY_ELIGIBLE only when separate exact-scope authority and admitted atomic conditional-write capability receipts both verify. Current br 0.2.19 makes every current row at most DECLARED_READY and harness-automated live target mutation AUTOMATION_NODATA; this does not prohibit a separately DECLARED_MANUAL_AUTHORIZATION operator action under the explicit no-CAS/no-clobber/no-exactly-once contract. Full-universe, incremental, local, hermetic DSR, mutation, no-mock E2E, logs, and replay must reject authority-only eligibility, missing/failed/lying/non-atomic/version-mismatched capability, ordinary-update fallback, inverse over unknown poststate, or an unresolved BLOCKED_MANUAL_AUTHORIZATION, ACTIVE_TARGET_CONFLICT, CONCURRENT_DRIFT, AMBIGUOUS_POSTSTATE, COMPENSATION_BLOCKED_BY_DRIFT, COMPENSATION_FAILED, BLOCKED_AUTOMATION_PREREQUISITE, BLOCKED_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW, PARTIAL_PUBLICATION, REPLAY_MISMATCH, or MANUAL_RECOVERY_REQUIRED terminal. Such terminals block .5/root closure and cannot be laundered as restoration or success. This amendment is additive and preserves all existing feature, history, review, publication, proof, and no-claim requirements.
