title: Adjudicate closed template debt through immutable-source clarification
description:
Review 727 retained closed warning rows without rewriting proof history; fresh exact membership controls. The v1 projection conservatively classifies all as historical immutable, 410 have dependency candidates, 726 lack explicit owners, and legacy br records may expose closed_at/reason but no reliable closer. Missing legacy closer identity is NoData, not permission to infer creator or assignee and not a reason to deadlock immutable accounting.

A closed source Bead is byte- and relation-immutable. Do not change fields, notes/comments, status, priority, assignment, parent, dependencies, timestamps, close reason, evidence, or no-claim. Clarification links are payload references to the closed source ID and field roots inside a new child parented under .6; never add an edge or comment to the closed source. Classify closure provenance as KNOWN(value,source), LEGACY_UNAVAILABLE(observed surfaces,reason), or CONFLICTED.

Build a supplemental exact history manifest. Separate graph-edge consumer candidates from reviewed actual consumers and citations. Every nonclosed actual consumer maps the consumed clause/root and terminal owner to a clarification child blocking .5 or a reviewed DOES_NOT_CONSUME disposition. An assignee may receive coordination work but cannot approve history or semantic authority. Route unresolved ownership through explicit live program/domain owners or a governance-escalation child.

Publish complete children through .1.2 and its capacity waves. Historical source bytes never move. All br attribution is self-reported unless an external authority receipt is configured, so the default outcome is declared review accounting, not human authority.

## Acceptance Criteria

The structured acceptance field requires immutable sources and relations, tri-state legacy provenance, exact consumer adjudication, owner escalation, bounded journaled publication, comprehensive tests/no-mock E2E/logs/replay, and honest NoData/no-claim.
acceptance_criteria:
## Immutable closed-history acceptance

1. Hard-depend only on .1.2, which transitively proves .1.1 planning and .1.3 authority/apply behavior. Freeze fresh exact closed warning membership twice under the shared campaign epoch and bind it to v1 plus v2 tool, rule, DB/export, source, immutable-history, dependency, harness, manifest, and field roots. Counts orient only; exact IDs and fields control.
2. Each history row includes ID/title/type/priority; created/updated/closed timestamps; close reason; closer provenance KNOWN(value,source), LEGACY_UNAVAILABLE(observed_surfaces,reason), or CONFLICTED; assignee/owner; description/design/acceptance/notes/comment roots; parent; dependencies/dependents; source identity; citations; proof limits; no-claim; and graph candidate versus reviewed live/closed consumer sets. Never infer closer from creator, assignee, or self-reported agent metadata. For every source, capture `br audit log ID --json` twice and bind the bounded allowlisted audit-event projection roots into closer provenance; absence remains LEGACY_UNAVAILABLE, disagreement is CONFLICTED, and unbounded audit bodies are referenced rather than copied. Legacy unavailable can complete immutable accounting with NoData closer authority; conflict in available evidence refuses.
3. Closed sources are byte- and relation-immutable. Relation identity is exactly (direction, dependency_type, endpoint_id, edge_metadata_root); endpoint title, status, priority, assignment, owner, and other mutable fields belong to a separately rooted neighbor_observation projection and are not themselves relation identity. No source field, comment, status, priority, assignment, ownership, parent, dependency, timestamp, reason, evidence, or no-claim changes. A new child references source ID, field roots, and consumed clauses only in its own payload/fingerprint; it is parented under .6 and blocks .5. No edge or comment is added to the source. Double-capture source projection before/after all work.
4. Classify each row as ADDITIVE_CLARIFICATION_CHILD_SAFE, LIVE_CONSUMER_CLARIFICATION_REQUIRED, SUPERSEDED_CITED, or HISTORICAL_IMMUTABLE_REVIEW with coordination owner, declared semantic owner state, rationale, user effect, clauses/citations, falsifier, closer-provenance state, and no-claim. No class fabricates implementation, test, evidence, authority, closer, or outcome.
5. Dependency/dependent edges create consumer candidates only. For every nonclosed candidate, review exact consumed clause/root and terminal owner, producing a clarification child or reviewed DOES_NOT_CONSUME disposition. Silent ambiguity refuses; sharing an edge, label, or parent is not consumption proof.
6. Assignee is coordination routing only. Resolve semantic review through an explicit live parent/program/domain owner receipt or governance-escalation child with named acceptance route. Empty owner, historical agent identity, lexical inference, or aggregate waiver cannot approve history. Self-reported br reviewer identity yields declared accounting only; externally verified authority remains separate/NoData unless configured.
7. Clarification/escalation children have exact parent .6, stable .1.2 key, complete source/consumer payload, default 10 and hard 25 target caps, 262,144-byte and 480-minute caps, and hard-block .5. Publish PUBLISHED work in quarantine/reconcile stages; activate only bounded waves. .6 may close on exact publication plus wave schedule, while every leaf continues to block .5 until resolved.
8. Unit/schema/boundary tests cover zero/one/9/10/11/24/25/26/max rows; every disposition and closer state; ownerless/conflicted ownership; no/one/many candidate and actual consumers; cited/uncited/superseded records; missing timestamps/reasons; status flips; exact roots; byte/work caps; order; and typed errors. They separately exercise relation identity drift, neighbor-observation drift with unchanged edge identity, coherent neighbor refresh, and mismatched relation versus neighbor roots.
9. Property/metamorphic/state tests prove exact history/consumer partition arithmetic, input/edge order invariance, source byte/relation identity, coordination-versus-authority separation, escalation determinism, candidate-to-actual review refinement, citation regrouping invariance, unrelated-live-Bead invariance, stable logical keys, idempotent publication, waves, and artifact replay.
10. Mutation/fault/resource/cancellation/restart tests reject reopening, any source or relation mutation, closer fabrication, assignment/priority change, proof widening, clause loss, copied boilerplate, hidden consumer/citation, stale closure metadata, fingerprint conflict, wrong/missing .5 edge, partial child, lint/lock/export/graph/replay fault, response ambiguity, queue flood, caps, and cancellation after every state. Recovery never deletes or overwrites history.
11. No-mock E2E uses released br and robot bv in a disjoint fixture with known/legacy-unavailable/conflicted closer cases, closed sources, candidate/actual live and closed consumers, ownerless escalation, safe child clarification, immutable residual, hostile source/edge mutation, interruption/reconcile/wave activation, lint/cycle/closeout, bounded deterministic redacted terminal-last logs, and artifact replay with live tracker denied. It proves byte- and relation-identical sources.
12. Close when every fresh closed warning row appears exactly once, every live consumer candidate is reviewed, every required child is PUBLISHED and blocks .5, a complete activation schedule exists, sources remain unchanged, no partial publication remains, replay agrees, and bottom-up fixed/per-row/per-consumer/per-child/fault/E2E/independent-review effort reconciles. This is immutable historical accounting; it never retroactively upgrades closure, evidence, closer authority, or product state.

## Plan-space refinement 2026-07-30 (controlling)

13. The only direct toolchain blocker is .1.2; .1.1 and .1.3 are transitive evidence through the proven chain. Consume the shared campaign_epoch_root but retain a distinct immutable_history_artifact_root over source, audit, relation-identity, neighbor-observation, schema, and no-claim evidence; this artifact root is not a membership set. Closed membership and source projections must be coherent within a run; classified unrelated live-Bead drift across runs may advance observation receipts without rewriting history or clarification keys.
14. Candidate adjudication covers both live and closed consumers. Each live candidate ends as LIVE_CLARIFICATION_CHILD, LIVE_GOVERNANCE_ESCALATION, or DOES_NOT_CONSUME with exact clause/root evidence. Each closed candidate ends as CLOSED_CITED, CLOSED_SUPERSEDED_CITED, CLOSED_CONFLICTED, or CLOSED_DOES_NOT_CONSUME. A closed consumer is never edited or linked; any missing owner, ambiguous clause, or conflict creates a new live governance child under .6 that blocks .5. Final .5 verifies the complete live plus closed partition.
15. Source immutability applies across transitions as well as bytes. If a source unexpectedly reopens, reactivates, changes status/priority/type/owner, gains or loses a relation, or changes close metadata during either capture, the run refuses with HISTORY_SOURCE_MOVED and performs no publication. A later coherent campaign emits MOVED_FROM_HISTORY for a reopened source or MOVED_TO_HISTORY for a newly closed live source, binds coherent before/after roots and one successor lineage, classifies it in the appropriate owner set, and proves it cannot remain in both history and live membership.
16. Clarification-child readiness and remediation_route are separate. REVIEW_ONLY publishes exact provenance, ownership, citation, or governance questions. DECLARED_READY may emit MANUAL_BR_REVIEW only for a live consumer or new clarification child, with exact argv/preconditions/postconditions/independent review and no-CAS warning; it never proposes mutation of a closed source. AUTOMATED_CONDITIONAL requires both .1.3 gates and still cannot target immutable history. Current br 0.2.19 provides no admitted atomic conditional-write primitive, so harness automation is AUTOMATION_NODATA; a separately authorized manual operator route remains possible only for live consumers or new clarification children under its explicit no-CAS boundary.
17. Publication uses .1.2. Live activation is forbidden until .7 closes and .8 is explicitly admitted from its deferred idle state. Every present-day activation route then acquires exact .8 with a unique campaign/run actor and holds through child/export/graph/replay; future fenced automation is separately admitted. Closed sources consume no activation capacity. Before every generated live child reobserve global 20, lane 10, owner 3 occupancy; active, assigned, reserved, or existing-workflow consumers remain deferred as ACTIVE_TARGET_CONFLICT until rooted coordination acknowledgement. Claim/coordination grants no history or semantic authority and current receipts make no fenced/exactly-once claim.
18. The separate v2 manifest executes HISTORY_ZERO, HISTORY_KNOWN_CLOSER, HISTORY_LEGACY_UNAVAILABLE, HISTORY_CONFLICTED_CLOSER, HISTORY_LIVE_CONSUMER, HISTORY_CLOSED_CITED, HISTORY_CLOSED_SUPERSEDED, HISTORY_CLOSED_CONFLICTED, HISTORY_DOES_NOT_CONSUME, HISTORY_OWNER_ESCALATION, HISTORY_REOPEN_DURING_RUN, HISTORY_CLOSE_DURING_RUN, HISTORY_MOVED_FROM_HISTORY, HISTORY_MOVED_TO_HISTORY, HISTORY_RELATION_DRIFT, HISTORY_NEIGHBOR_DRIFT_EDGE_STABLE, HISTORY_OVERSIZE, HISTORY_DEFERRED_REACTIVATION_REQUIRED, HISTORY_ACTIVE_CONFLICT, HISTORY_MANUAL_LIVE_HANDOFF, HISTORY_AUTOMATION_NODATA, HISTORY_STALE_EPOCH, HISTORY_CANCEL_EACH_STATE, HISTORY_LOG_REDACTION, HISTORY_OFFLINE_REPLAY, and all row/byte/minute boundaries. Each binds fixture, argv, exit, exact projections/dispositions, log assertions, artifacts, and replay. The v1 manifest remains byte-identical; prose-only cases fail.
19. Logs retain bounded deterministic campaign/history/case/assertion IDs, source/consumer IDs and field roots, closer state/source, live/closed disposition, owner/authority/route, immutable before/after projection verdicts, occupancy/conflict, exact argv arrays, allowlisted semantic result projections, first divergence, recovery, relative artifacts, unique terminal, next action, and no-claim. Raw stdout/stderr are retained only through content roots, byte counts, redaction verdicts, and safe relative artifact paths; never retain raw stream bodies. Exclude secrets, environment dumps, absolute paths, PIDs, timing noise, and bulk descriptions.
20. The 27,360-minute planning floor is explicit retained-snapshot arithmetic: 2,400 fixed history/schema/operator work + 727 x 24 minutes immutable row adjudication + 410 x 12 minutes candidate-consumer review + 2,592 clarification, transition/fault proof, replay, and independent review. Fresh rows, additional live or closed consumers, owner/citation conflicts, clarification children, recovery, or generated-leaf work must be re-estimated additively. This floor is not a cap; never sample, generalize, or drop historical functionality to fit time.
21. Set arithmetic is unit-typed. warning_rows are keyed by (issue_id, warning_kind, missing_section); deduplicated closed_source_issues are keyed by issue_id; candidate_consumer_edges are keyed by (direction, dependency_type, endpoint_id, edge_metadata_root); reviewed_dispositions are keyed by (source_issue_id, candidate_endpoint_id, consumed_clause_root). Every equation names one unit and uses an explicit projection before comparing sets; counts from different units are never equated.
22. Relation roots and neighbor-observation roots are separate schema fields, log keys, replay inputs, and test assertions. A neighbor field change can invalidate consumer adjudication and force refreshed observation without falsely reporting an edge mutation; an actual relation tuple change is HISTORY_RELATION_DRIFT and refuses the run.
23. Retain closed_warning_rows_root keyed by (issue_id, warning_kind, missing_section) and prove all_status_warning_rows_root = nonclosed_warning_rows_root disjoint-union closed_warning_rows_root under one coherent capture or explicit rebase lineage. Project and deduplicate P4 rows by issue_id into closed_p4_issue_ids_root and prove p4_all_status_issue_ids_root = nonclosed_p4_issue_ids_root disjoint-union closed_p4_issue_ids_root. Close/reopen/priority/status transitions use MOVED_TO_HISTORY, MOVED_FROM_HISTORY, or MOVED_TO_LANE lineage; immutable_history_artifact_root remains evidence identity and never appears in set arithmetic.
24. An individual source, audit projection, candidate-consumer set, or clarification payload exceeding a byte/work cap becomes HISTORY_OVERSIZE with exact full-content and bounded-projection roots, a referenced full artifact, deterministic reproduction, owner escalation, and no truncation, sampling, or false completion. Unit, mutation, cancellation, restart, E2E, redaction, and offline-replay tests cover the transition.
25. Keep source_semantic_status and publication_lifecycle_status separate. A live consumer with source_semantic_status=deferred is planning-only: manual and automated repair both refuse until owner-reviewed reactivation occurs outside the harness and a fresh capture, audit, consumer adjudication, occupancy check, and route decision completes; forged, stale, or aggregate reactivation receipts refuse. A newly published clarification child with publication_lifecycle_status=deferred is in ordinary quarantine/capacity scheduling and may proceed through .8 after .7 admission without semantic reactivation, provided its source target is not semantically deferred. Unit, state, mutation, cancellation, restart, and released-tool E2E cases prove the two fields cannot be conflated.

title: Implement hermetic template gate, proof traceability, and operator E2E
description:
Own implementation and evidence generation for the permanent semantic-template regression gate. This Bead exists to separate code/test authorship from the independent reviewer in .5.

Implement the hermetic xtask check-bead-templates route, check-all and configured DSR registration, the existing pre-commit warn/strict front-runner, the v2 acceptance-to-proof traceability and generated-leaf terminal validators, .8 atomic-claim wave/lifecycle protocol fixtures, operator-facing status/help output, and the complete unit/property/metamorphic/state/mutation/fault/resource/cancellation/restart/integration/no-mock E2E/logging/replay suite. Preserve the immutable v1 manifest and its 21-case historical proof; v2 uses a separately versioned manifest and additive harness dispatch.

The production gate reads tracked JSONL and checked-in rules without SQLite, ambient br, network, or host PATH and never mutates Beads. Separate public-path E2E may mutate only a disjoint released-br fixture to prove .8 and leaf lifecycle behavior. Every diagnostic is bounded, ranked, reproducible, and explicit about proof authority. .5 independently consumes this Bead evidence and must be owned/reviewed by someone who did not implement or generate it.

## Acceptance Criteria

The structured acceptance field is controlling and requires exact code ownership, complete test traceability, authentic E2E, detailed deterministic logs, artifact-only replay, DSR integration, operator usability, and strict role separation.

title: Operate the atomic-claim campaign activation sentinel and generated-leaf lifecycle
description:
Operate the current-tool campaign activation sentinel and generated-leaf lifecycle. This Bead turns released br 0.2.19 atomic --claim into cooperative single-writer serialization for template-review waves while preserving a fail-closed crash boundary.

The sentinel is deferred and unassigned between waves, intentionally absent from ordinary ready-work selection. A unique run-scoped actor atomically claims it, holds it through exact child activation, export, graph verification, and replay, then releases only after ownership and wave poststate are reobserved. A crash or ambiguous release leaves it held and blocks further activation until independently reviewed manual recovery. It never expires or auto-steals.

This is operational coordination, not a fenced distributed lease, target compare-and-swap, semantic review, external authority, or malicious-actor protection. The separately related deferred fenced-lease capability is the future automation horizon. .7 implements and tests the protocol; .5 independently adjudicates its complete lifecycle.

## Acceptance Criteria

The structured acceptance field requires exact atomic-claim protocol, fail-closed recovery, generated-leaf terminal validation, comprehensive concurrency/fault/E2E/log/replay evidence, and strict no-authority boundaries.
acceptance_criteria:
## Campaign activation sentinel and leaf-lifecycle acceptance

1. Be the exact root child .8, P0 task, with hard dependencies on .1.2 and .7 and a direct blocking edge into .5. .7 must close with retained terminal-Pass protocol, fixture, generated-leaf-validator, log, and replay evidence before .8 can be claimed for any live campaign wave. No lane hard-depends on .8 for publication; every lane uses it before any activation.
2. Between waves the exact sentinel state is deferred, unassigned, has no active run token, retains the last verified release receipt, and is intentionally absent from ordinary br ready output. Only .1.2 wave machinery, a DECLARED_MANUAL_WAVE_OPERATOR named by a root-bound .1.2 handoff, or an explicitly named recovery operator may claim it. Manual-wave and recovery roles remain distinct; robot rank, ordinary work selection, generic assignee, default actor, or stale run artifact grants no authority.
3. Each acquisition uses the argv array `br update frankensim-semantic-bead-template-hygiene-961yr.8 --claim --actor fs-template-wave:<campaign-epoch>:<run-id> --json --no-auto-import --no-auto-flush` with a never-reused run actor. The versioned claim-capability receipt binds br version.commit, claim.exclusive configuration, exact compare key, blocker/deferred behavior, argv grammar, and released-tool race proof. Different actors race: exactly one observes success. The assignee and audit actor must equal the run actor. Missing/default/reused actor, blind retry, or unverified lost response refuses; reobservation classifies ACQUIRED_BY_THIS_RUN, SENTINEL_HELD_BY_OTHER, AMBIGUOUS, or NODATA_SENTINEL.
4. br --claim atomically compares assignee vacancy only; it does not bind idle status, campaign epoch, lifecycle-open state, or last-release root. Capture those before acquisition, then after success reobserve assignee/status/audit events and validate the captured deferred status, exact campaign epoch, lifecycle-open flag, and last-release root before touching a child. Mismatch retains the claim and enters recovery/NoData. Hold the claim through per-child fresh campaign/lane/owner occupancy, exact expected child projection, deferred quarantine removal, dequarantine reobservation, final one-child status=open mutation, child post-observation, bounded batch export witness, graph/cycle check, and artifact replay. Never describe status plus label as atomic. Recompute occupancy before every child; drift, cap uncertainty, active-target conflict, wrong owner, or ambiguity stops the wave.
5. Release uses one exact br update to status=deferred and assignee empty only after reobserving the exact run token as current owner and a terminal verified wave projection. Retain pre-release owner projection, argv/result, post-release deferred/unassigned projection, export/graph/replay roots, and unique terminal. No unconditional retry after ambiguous release; any ambiguous result is reobserved and reconciled before another attempt.
6. Crash, cancellation, lost release, wrong-owner release, stale artifact, or ambiguous sentinel state leaves .8 in_progress/held and all later activation refused. There is no automatic expiry or steal. Manual recovery requires a reviewer distinct from both the failed run actor and the recovery operator, with a root-bound identity, scope, role-conflict, and verdict receipt. The reviewer authorizes release; the recovery operator executes it. Recovery also requires exact current sentinel/run and all affected child projections, completed or reconciled export/graph/replay, an additive recovery receipt/comment, and one exact release attempt. Force, direct DB edits, token reuse, or silent owner clearing is prohibited.
7. Current cooperative claiming serializes well-behaved program actors but does not fence malicious, out-of-protocol, or manual tracker mutations. The related deferred frankensim-template-hygiene-campaign-lease-wcivr is required before claiming AUTOMATED_FENCED_WAVE or race-free distributed recovery. This sentinel never enables target mutation or either .1.3 authority/capability gate.
8. Generated-leaf close validation uses the closed terminal schema owned by .1.2 and implemented/tested by .7. Verified close classes are REVIEW_RESOLVED_NO_TARGET_CHANGE, MANUAL_REPAIR_VERIFIED, AUTOMATED_REPAIR_VERIFIED, SUPERSEDED_COVERED, MOVED_TO_LANE_COVERED, MOVED_TO_HISTORY_COVERED, and MOVED_FROM_HISTORY_COVERED. Movement closure requires coherent before/after like-unit all-status roots, exact destination partition, one successor owner and leaf key, successor publication plus .5 blocker, immutable prior evidence, and no simultaneous live/history ownership. Canonical non-close classes are BLOCKED_MANUAL_AUTHORIZATION, ACTIVE_TARGET_CONFLICT, CONCURRENT_DRIFT, AMBIGUOUS_POSTSTATE, COMPENSATION_BLOCKED_BY_DRIFT, COMPENSATION_FAILED, BLOCKED_AUTOMATION_PREREQUISITE, BLOCKED_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW, PARTIAL_PUBLICATION, REPLAY_MISMATCH, and MANUAL_RECOVERY_REQUIRED. Legacy AMBIGUOUS_MANUAL_RESULT is accepted only as migration input and normalizes to AMBIGUOUS_POSTSTATE, never success. AUTOMATION_NODATA is nonblocking only when the leaf has a separately verified manual or no-change close class. Only a verified close class permits exact-ID ordinary br close with rooted reason/transition receipt.
9. Unit/schema/boundary/property/metamorphic/state tests and released-tool no-mock E2E use the canonical v2 registry IDs: NODATA_SENTINEL_NOT_ADMITTED, SENTINEL_NEVER_READY_BETWEEN_WAVES, SENTINEL_CLAIM_RACE, SENTINEL_SAME_HUMAN_DISTINCT_RUN, SENTINEL_MISSING_DEFAULT_REUSED_ACTOR_REFUSES, SENTINEL_ACTOR_AUDIT_MISMATCH_REFUSES, SENTINEL_LOST_CLAIM_RESPONSE, SENTINEL_PRECLAIM_STATE_MISMATCH, SENTINEL_PRECLAIM_CAPABILITY_MISMATCH, SENTINEL_CRASH_HELD, SENTINEL_WRONG_OWNER_RELEASE, SENTINEL_STALE_MANUAL_RECOVERY, SENTINEL_RELEASE_AMBIGUOUS, DECLARED_MANUAL_WAVE_OPERATOR, ACTIVATION_WITHOUT_SENTINEL_REFUSES, SENTINEL_DEQUARANTINE_BEFORE_STATUS, SENTINEL_DEQUARANTINE_CRASH_REFUSES_STATUS, SENTINEL_STATUS_BEFORE_DEQUARANTINE_REFUSES, CAP_REOBSERVE_EACH_CHILD, WAVE_MANUAL_HANDOFF, WAVE_MANUAL_PARTIAL_RECONCILE, WAVE_CANCEL_EACH_BOUNDARY, WAVE_LOG_REDACTION, and WAVE_OFFLINE_REPLAY, plus every verified close and canonical non-close leaf class including MOVED_TO_HISTORY_COVERED and MOVED_FROM_HISTORY_COVERED. Mutation/fault/resource/cancellation/restart injection covers every acquisition, validation, dequarantine, status, child, export, graph, replay, release, and recovery boundary.
10. Detailed deterministic redacted logs retain sentinel ID, campaign epoch, unique run actor, claim/release argv and allowlisted result projections, owner projection, occupancy before/after each child, selected/skipped IDs, leaf terminal evidence, first divergence, recovery, safe relative artifacts, reproduction, no-claim, and one unique last terminal. Raw stdout/stderr bodies are referenced only by content root, byte count, redaction verdict, and safe relative artifact path. Exclude secrets, environment dumps, absolute paths, PIDs, timing noise, bulk Bead bodies, and unbounded command output.
11. Close .8 only when .1.2 is closed, no claim is held, no PUBLISHED capacity-deferred or ACTIVATION_* work remains, every generated leaf is in a verified terminal close class and closed, all wave/recovery receipts replay, DB/export and graph converge, and .7 retained proof passes. Close by exact-ID ordinary br close. .5 independently consumes the closed sentinel lifecycle afterward.
12. This Bead proves cooperative activation serialization and complete generated-leaf lifecycle only. It mints no external human, semantic, target implementation, scientific, performance, product, promotion, or release authority and makes no fenced-distributed or exactly-once claim.

13. The 4,800-minute lifecycle planning floor is explicit: 960 sentinel acquisition/release and wave operation + 960 generated-leaf terminal validation + 1,440 concurrency/fault/cancellation/restart and released-tool E2E + 720 deterministic logs/offline replay/recovery + 720 independent lifecycle review. Generated target remediation keeps its own child estimate and is not hidden here. Fresh leaves, held-claim recovery, or additional waves add effort; this floor is not a cap.

14. Live campaign admission is graph-ordered: .1.2 may implement and exercise this protocol only in a disjoint released-br fixture; .7 must then close with retained terminal-Pass fixture evidence. Only after both .1.2 and .7 are closed, every hard blocker is clear, and a fresh admission receipt validates the still-deferred/unassigned sentinel may a live operator claim .8; ordinary br ready membership is neither expected nor used as authority. Before that point every live --advance-wave returns NODATA_SENTINEL_NOT_ADMITTED without changing .8 or any child.

title: Semantic identity coverage registry and replay-hash mutation battery
description:
Several audits found replay identities that omitted semantic fields or hashed display-oriented encodings: RNG stream counters invalidated a cross-crate golden; color algebra needed a schema/domain rotation; explanation fingerprints used rounded JSON; roofline rows needed dependency receipts, manifests, and exact build identity. Fixing each incident locally does not prove future receipt schemas remain complete.

Create a generated registry of every persisted/replayed identity schema (ledger nodes, packages, checker decisions, tune rows, planner/cache keys, explanation receipts, RNG goldens, CI snapshots). Each owner declares schema version, canonical encoder, semantic fields, explicitly non-semantic fields, domain string, and consumers. title: fs-session: in-memory submission terminals can never flush under the fs-ledger preclaim doctrine
description:
SIX fs-session conformance tests fail deterministically at HEAD (0fba65d): ss_003c, ss_003d, ss_003f, ss_003h, ss_006, ss_013 — all with 'submission authority <hash> requires a committed pre-execution claim and its positive terminalization permit' (fs-ledger session_registry.rs:4265-4272).

ROOT CAUSE (verified, not contention): fs-ledger 3a25a0d's registry doctrine refuses session_terminal groups with claim.kind=='submission' unless a durable PRE-EXECUTION claim exists (with positive permit). fs-session has the durable path (submit_once_durable files the Pending claim, durable_submission_permit threads the permit into BufferedTerminal), but the PLAIN submit_once -> flush_scope_to_ledger path emits KIND_SUBMISSION terminals with permit=None and no pre-committed claim -> the ledger refuses, and because the batch stays fully dirty, RETRY REFUSES FOREVER. The in-memory execute-then-flush contract that ss_003* pins ('open and self-contained terminal submission receipts') is structurally unsatisfiable.

DESIGN DECISION NEEDED (owner of 3a25a0d/68vo doctrine + RubyLotus who is active in session_registry): either (a) declare in-memory submissions unflushable and rewrite the 6 conformance pins onto submit_once_durable — accepting that plain submit_once receipts are ledger-orphaned; or (b) introduce an honestly-labeled self-contained submission kind (claim inserted at flush time like open/meter kinds, receipts carrying a weaker crash-integrity evidence class, NOT reusing kind 'submission' so the preclaim invariant stays intact for durable claims); (c) filing claim+permit inside the flush batch is LAUNDERING ('pre-execution' would be false) — refuse this option.

Attribution evidence: 728d631 (2pmb) touched only cost-model surfaces (estimate/sealed/admission) — reds reproduce orthogonally; fs-session/fs-ledger trees clean at time of run; failure is a typed ledger refusal, not contention.

title: Make fs-shapeprog simplification error certificates compositional and cancellation-safe
description:
ROOT CAUSE AND SEVERITY
fs-shapeprog simplification currently treats local rewrite error as a scalar combined with max. That is sound across independent min or max branches only under the right Lipschitz hypotheses, but not across sequential approximations on the same evaluation path. Two individually droppable offsets separated by a constructor can accumulate beyond the published max_error. Separately, consecutive Offset nodes are algebraically merged and labeled Exact even though the interpreter evaluates two rounded subtractions while the rewrite evaluates one subtraction from a rounded parameter sum. Catastrophic parameter cancellation can therefore change the SDF while publishing max_error zero. These are false geometry certificates and therefore P0.

MANDATORY WITNESSES
- Union(sphere(1).offset(0.006), sphere(1).translate([100,0,0])).offset(0.006) at tolerance 0.01 drops two sequential offsets on the active origin branch. Actual discrepancy is 0.012 while the current report says 0.006.
- sphere(1).offset(f64::MAX).offset(-f64::MAX) evaluates to a value one unit away at the origin after the current consecutive-offset merge, yet the rewrite is labeled Exact with max_error zero.
Preserve these as named G0 regressions and add order-reversed, sign, signed-zero, subnormal, overflow, branch-selection, and threshold neighbors.

MISSION
Replace ad hoc max-error bookkeeping with a compositional, outward-safe error algebra tied to the actual floating interpreter. Sequential rewrite errors must add outwardly; independent branch alternatives may use max only with executable 1-Lipschitz hypotheses; affine or scale operations must transform bounds by certified absolute Lipschitz factors; non-finite or unrepresentable propagation must refuse simplification rather than publish a finite claim. Never call a real-arithmetic identity Exact when f64 evaluation order changes observable semantics.

DESIGN AND ACCEPTANCE
- Define combination operators that distinguish sequential composition, alternatives, and scaling. Use exact or outward-rounded nonnegative bounds, validate every operand, and fail closed on overflow or missing hypotheses.
- Either preserve nested offsets exactly or prove a bit-level equivalence predicate for each merged instance. A heuristic near-equality check is insufficient.
- Track the deterministic first lossy rewrite and enough path or node context to replay the accumulated bound. Exact means bit-equivalent under the documented signed-zero and NaN policy.
- Ensure simplification is monotone in tolerance, idempotent at a true fixed point, deterministic, and cannot exceed its reported bound at any admitted finite sample.
- Add focused unit tests and G3 metamorphic tests for rewrite grouping, nesting under Union or Intersection or transforms, evaluation-order changes, permutation where mathematically admissible, power-of-two scaling, repeated simplification, and direct discrepancy verification. Include detailed deterministic diagnostics.
- Document the theorem hypotheses and no-claim boundary in CONTRACT. Do not weaken the system by disabling useful approximate rewrites globally; make the evidence calculus correct.
- Code-first landing may use rustfmt and diff checks only. Keep the Bead in progress until central cargo test -p fs-shapeprog --all-targets, union clippy, and DSR are green with recorded logs.

title: Move session event materialization off the governor-wide lock
description:
fs-session now bounds every retained collection, event page, flush row, and encoded byte, and releases the lock for ledger I/O. events_page still clones up to 1024 evidence-bearing events and flush preparation formats up to 4 MiB while holding the governor-wide mutex. Introduce per-scope sharding or immutable Arc snapshots so bounded cloning/JSON encoding occurs outside the global hot-path lock. Prove unrelated scope charge/submit latency under a barrier-controlled maximum-size page/flush.

## Steps to Reproduce

1. Populate one scope with a 1,024-event page or near-4 MiB flush and a second unrelated scope with a small charge/submit operation.
2. Pause clone/encode at a barrier immediately after the intended snapshot linearization point.
3. In the historical or seeded lock-held mutant, observe that the unrelated scope cannot complete until materialization resumes because clone/encode still holds the governor-wide mutex.
4. Exercise concurrent append/page/flush and inject encoder or ledger failure to expose torn cursors, partial publication, or lock leakage.
5. The repaired design must let the unrelated operation finish while materialization is paused and must replay identical counts, order, cursors, and roots.

## Acceptance Criteria

All existing bounds, event semantics, and flush functionality remain normative.

1. Canonical scope and semantics
- The governor-wide lock covers only the linearization needed to capture immutable handles, sequence/cursor state, and bounded metadata. Evidence cloning, JSON formatting/encoding, content-root work, allocation growth, ledger preparation, and I/O occur outside it.
- Preserve global/per-scope sequence semantics, page cursors, flush identities, idempotency, evidence payloads, redaction, content roots, the 1,024-event limit, and the 4 MiB limit.
- No event is lost, duplicated, reordered, observed from another scope, or published from a torn snapshot.

2. Boundary, concurrency, and mutation tests
- Cover zero/one scope/event; 1,023/1,024/1,025-event pages; zero/one byte and 4 MiB-1/exact/+1 flushes; empty/maximal payloads; Unicode and encoded expansion; many cold plus one hot scope; cursor start/end/stale/duplicate; concurrent append/page/flush/charge/submit; maximum collections and maximum+1 preallocation refusal; malformed event/schema/cursor/sink identity; and deterministic first error.
- A two-phase barrier pauses maximum-size clone/encode after snapshot linearization and proves an unrelated scope can charge and submit while materialization remains paused.
- Metamorphic tests compare a serial reference, page concatenation, flush reconstruction, per-scope order under legal interleavings, and clean-store replay.
- Mutants catch encoding under the global lock, early cursor advance, escaped borrows, stale publication, lost/duplicate/reordered events, scope contamination, cap bypass, and inconsistent roots.

3. Cancellation, faults, and atomicity
- Inject cancellation plus parser, allocator, encoder, worker, ledger, I/O, durable-seal, output-cap, deadline, and publication failures before/after snapshot, during clone/encode, before append, after durable append, and before in-memory cursor commit.
- Every path requests/drains/finalizes where applicable, releases locks/leases once, preserves retry/idempotency, avoids deadlock and partial authority, and returns one stable typed disposition.

4. E2E, independent checker, and logs
- Contribute SessionMaterializationIsolationReceiptV1 to existing helm.latency and helm.golden_replay cases in tests/e2e/conformance/helm.toml, consumed by scripts/ci/helm_conformance_profile.sh; create no competing runner.
- The release-built no-mock journey uses real governor charge/submit/page/flush and ledger paths with barrier-controlled happy and hostile twins.
- An independently opened ledger checker reconstructs counts, order, scope, cursors, flush rows, roots, idempotency, and clean-store replay without trusting producer summaries.
- Bounded deterministic redacted JSONL records source/build/tool/features, session/scope/event/page/flush/sink identity, ranges/counts, lock and outside-lock phases, budgets, concurrent operation, barrier state, cancellation/drain/finalize, fault, first divergence, stable exit, repairs, and relative artifacts; never raw payloads, secrets, or volatile process/host fields.

5. Verification and authority
- Run focused unit/property/concurrency/fault suites, release E2E, independent replay, strict affected-package Clippy, UBS when available, and dsr quality --tool frankensim.
- Barrier isolation proves lock independence only; a portable latency SLO requires a separately admitted fingerprinted host and retained capped distributions.

title: fs-adjoint: bind DWR acceptance to sealed estimate identity
description: ROOT CAUSE: accept consumes a caller-supplied dwr_abs scalar and can set accepted=true without retained DwrOutput evidence or binding the estimate to the problem, candidate, functional/window, and solver provenance. A caller can inject zero or replay an unrelated estimate. Deeper first-principles defect: dwr_integral_qoi admits any finite endpoint-zero P1 candidate but never proves it solves the primal discrete equilibrium. Because the enriched test z_f-I_h z_f vanishes at every coarse node, the constant candidate-slope contribution integrates to zero on each coarse cell; eta therefore measures only the fine-bubble/discretization residual and can remain unchanged under arbitrary interior candidate corruption, omitting coarse-space algebraic residual. Merely sealing the current payload would bind scientifically invalid data. SCOPE: introduce an unforgeable constructor-sealed DWR estimate binding exact problem/operator/mesh/forcing, candidate, functional/window and clipped partition, execution/budget policy, estimator payload, and a primal-solve/equilibrium receipt. Require acceptance to consume and verify that typed estimate; either prove the candidate is the canonical Galerkin solve to a retained residual tolerance or add a sound algebraic-error contribution/bound. Reject query/problem/candidate/solver-policy mismatch; retain Estimated color until a stronger theorem-backed proof exists. TESTS: naked/adversarial zero injection; cross-query/problem/candidate replay; arbitrary endpoint-zero interior corruption; random nonsolution candidates; perturbed solver residual at exact thresholds; stale mesh/forcing; tamper/reforge attempts; deterministic identity; valid solved-candidate acceptance; cancellation and budget boundaries. ACCEPTANCE: no public path accepts a naked estimate scalar; no accepted receipt can arise from an unproved primal candidate or omitted algebraic error; every acceptance is replay-verifiably linked to the exact solved state, functional, estimator partition, and execution policy.

comments.text: FRESH-EYES AUDIT ADDENDUM (2026-07-14): make the sealed estimate structurally immutable. DwrOutput and AcceptOutcome currently expose public mutable fields, so constructor sealing alone is not unforgeability unless all identity-bearing payload is private and access is read-only. The verifier must recompute identity from canonical source data, not trust stored digests. Bind the complete MmsProblem::canonical_bytes() payload; the current pattern of placing a BLAKE3 envelope around a weak 64-bit FNV-derived problem root cannot restore collision resistance. Replace the human label-only DwrQuery with a typed functional specification carrying domain/window, endpoint convention, units/dimension, QoI semantics, and schema version. Negative tests must mutate every private serialized field through supported decoding/tamper paths, attempt cross-functional replay with the same label, and demonstrate canonical-byte identity separation.

AUDIT AGAINST HEAD (CloudyFinch, 2026-07-25, tree 3625c3d9). NOT finished-but-unclosed — I checked before assuming, because IndigoElk's 24/24 green could easily have been read as closure. It is not: the 2026-07-18 fresh-eyes NO-GO list is still substantially open, and its headline item is a LIVE soundness defect that I have now reproduced by execution rather than inherited as an assertion.

REPRODUCED, NOT ASSUMED. The audit named a falsifier in prose: "absolute residual_max<=1e-9 is dimensionful/scale-dependent and admits concrete non-solutions (zero forcing, mesh [0,.5,1], candidate [0,2e-10,0] has residual -8e-10)". I built it and ran it against HEAD:

  problem   = admitted_problem("zero-forcing", vec![0.0], vec![0.0, 0.5, 1.0])
  candidate = [0.0, 2.0e-10, 0.0]
  -> equilibrium_residual_max = 8e-10   (exactly as predicted; K_11 = 2/h = 4, r_1 = -4*2e-10)
  -> accept(...) returned Ok, accepted=true, color=Estimated{estimator:"dwr-unbracketed", dispersion:1e-10}

With zero forcing the Galerkin solution is IDENTICALLY ZERO, so this candidate is provably not a solution, and acceptance minted a receipt for it. The gate at dwr_accept.rs:1771 compares an absolute, dimensionful residual against DWR_EQUILIBRIUM_RESIDUAL_TOLERANCE = 1e-9 (:49). It is wrong in both directions: rescale the problem down and any candidate passes; scale forcing up and a genuine binary64 solve is REFUSED. The probe was removed after the run; the file is byte-identical to HEAD (verified by diff). No test was left behind, because a failing test cannot be committed and a passing one would have to encode the defect.

WHY THE FIX IS NOT LANDING IN THIS SESSION — a hard blocker, established by the checker itself, not by my judgement. The repair is the one the audit specified: a retained componentwise backward error |r_i| / (|b_i| + sum_j |K_ij||u_j| + governed_small_scale_i) with raw argmax/scale/tolerance/policy retained, fail-closed zero-scale semantics. That adds bound preimage fields to DwrOutput, which forces a DWR_EVIDENCE_IDENTITY_VERSION v7 -> v8 rotation across three roots, three declarations, three classifiers, AND a same-commit regeneration of identity-schemas.json plus golden-couplings.json (docs/GOLDEN_POLICY.md, and the golden-bump protocol requires a committed tree and both build modes).

That last step is currently IMPOSSIBLE, and the tool says so:

  cargo run -p xtask -- check-identities   (5 violations at HEAD)
  "golden-coupling replacement-row advice suppressed: the authority manifest is
   inconsistent, so schema fingerprints computed now would be wrong"
  + "identity-authorities.json adds identity authority fs-exec:solver-resume
     without updating the independent REQUIRED_IDENTITY_IDS" (and the same for
     fs-exec:solver-snapshot-authority-subject)

So any v8 golden row minted today would be computed against an inconsistent authority pair. Applying it would be precisely the failure this program exists to refuse: a green that means "not evaluated". I am therefore NOT bumping the identity, and NOT hand-editing a generated registry to get around it. The unblocking bead is sj31i.52.5.8 (IndigoElk) — those are the same two fs-exec rows that are now 2 of the only 3 remaining check-goldens violations repo-wide. Recorded as a graph dependency rather than left in prose.

CORRECTED CONTEXT for whoever picks this up: IndigoElk's note that DWR golden re-pinning was blocked by "12 foreign check-identities violations" is now STALE in the helpful direction. The six DWR golden rows were discharged in my prior session (a64dc2e2, 3e95d50f, bead bf5xk); check-goldens is at 3 repo-wide and none of them are DWR. check-identities is at 5, not 12. The remaining DWR obstacle is not DWR's own rows — it is the fs-exec authority pair suppressing generated advice for everyone.

STILL OPEN from the 07-18 list, unchanged and not claimed by this audit: root recomputation in accept (the stored estimate root is trusted rather than replay-recomputed from retained preimage); the nodal residual Vec plus two O(n) sweeps remain unbudgeted, infallibly allocated and unpolled; full problem/candidate/solver-policy replay validation beyond the window/functional cross-check; indicators remain fine-remainder-only while eta includes the algebraic term; and the adversarial acceptance battery. Color correctly remains Estimated throughout.

Bead stays IN_PROGRESS. Do not cite the 24/24 dwr_accept battery as evidence for any of the above — it does not exercise them.

title: fs-ir: admit only lowered semantics to prevent capability bypass
description: ROOT CAUSE: admission evaluates raw Node syntax before shorthand lowering. simulate-pour and optimize-shape are unnamespaced at admission, then lower into capability-, cost-, and regime-sensitive operators, so raw shorthand can bypass grants or pricing that the equivalent explicit lowered form receives. SCOPE: make admission lower internally under a versioned policy or accept an opaque validated LoweredProgram that callers cannot forge; bind raw and lowered identities and reject lowering errors before authority checks. TESTS: raw shorthand versus explicit-lowered capability, cost, regime, denial, duplicate/unknown/dangling/trailing inputs, and deterministic receipts. ACCEPTANCE: semantically equivalent programs receive identical admission and budget verdicts, and no authority-relevant operator appears only after admission.

title: fs-qty: replace saturating dimension algebra with checked authority
description: ROOT CAUSE: dimension multiplication/division and const-generic support use saturating i8 arithmetic. Overflow aliases an invalid expression to a valid dimension vector, allowing dimensional checks and IR admission to accept false physics. SCOPE: introduce checked authoritative dimension operations and propagate a typed overflow/invalid-dimension state through quantity expressions and fs-ir admission; reserve saturation only for explicitly non-authoritative diagnostics if needed. TESTS: every +/-128 boundary, long multiply/divide/power trees, cancellation after overflow, const/runtime parity, query/admission refusal, and no alias to valid dimensions. ACCEPTANCE: dimension overflow is never silently clamped and cannot pass a semantic contract.
close_reason: Complete at 4599195 (pushed) with live green evidence. fs-qty: authoritative checked_plus/checked_minus/checked_times (Option<Dims>, None on any i8 overflow incl. -128*-1); saturating forms RENAMED saturating_* and demoted to explicitly non-authoritative diagnostics (old names removed — every consumer chose explicitly); QtyAny try_mul/try_div with DimensionOverflow carrying the rhs operand; operators panic-on-overflow as documented developer contract; const/runtime parity pinned by a compile_fail doctest (const-generic path refuses at compile time). Typed propagation delivered per SCOPE: fs-ir admission infer_dims REJECTS overflow with a dimensional finding (ad_016: 70 pressure factors refuse / 40 legal — the refusal is the overflow, not depth); Qoi::value_dims Option-checked with query-admission refusal; fs-opdsl PointwiseLaw::out_dims Option + TypeError::DimensionOverflow. fs-opt already checked at its sealed admission chokepoint (dims_add/sub_checked, DimSumOverflow) — no change; graph.rs/expr.rs confirmed dead files. TESTS per bead: every ±127/−128 boundary, long multiply/divide trees, the saturate-then-cancel aliasing kill ((100+50)−30 laundering 97 for 120 now refuses), const/runtime parity, query/admission refusal, and the G0 algebra properties restated over checked ops where they hold exactly. Evidence: fs-qty 84 green, fs-ir 51 green, fs-opdsl 14 green, all 14 dependents check Finished. ACCEPTANCE met: dimension overflow is never silently clamped and cannot pass a semantic contract. Unblocks sj31i.27 and sj31i.30.

title: fs-ir: make canonical AST and query grammar lossless and unambiguous
description: ROOT CAUSE: Query::to_node emits dimensioned quantities as bare numeric text, public AST variants can mint invalid symbols/keywords/nonfinite floats or Qty text inconsistent with value/dims, and query/lowering grammars silently resolve duplicate keys or ignore unknown/trailing operands. JSON also admits non-RFC number/control spellings. SCOPE: validated constructors plus recursive AST validation; one canonical quantity node encoder; exact versioned schemas with arity and unique-key enforcement; strict RFC 8259 scanning; canonicalization receipts or strict bytes where identities require it. TESTS: every Query/QoI target through sexpr and JSON round trips, adversarial AST construction, duplicate/unknown/dangling/trailing clauses, nonfinite values, leading plus/zero forms, raw controls, and byte identity. ACCEPTANCE: serialization is isomorphic and malformed/ambiguous programs fail closed with exact paths.

title: fs-scenario: certify time-varying incompressible flux over the full horizon
description: ROOT CAUSE: net mass-flow compatibility samples signals only at t=0. Ramps, tables, or Chebyshev signals can balance initially and diverge later yet pass the unqualified incompressible balance invariant. Sparse sampling is not a sound repair. SCOPE: define an explicit scenario horizon and prove the summed mass-flow signal identically balanced using exact piecewise breakpoints and certified Chebyshev/interval enclosures, or refuse unproven time-varying sets unless a pressure outlet exists; retain the proof/refusal evidence. TESTS: ramps/tables/Cheb profiles balanced only at t0, breakpoint cancellations, nearly balanced tolerances, full-horizon exact balance, horizon mismatch, and pressure-outlet escape. ACCEPTANCE: admitted no-outlet incompressible scenarios carry a replayable global-in-time balance argument.

comments.author: jemanuel
comments.text: FRESH-EYES SCOPE RATCHET: full-horizon flux certification must evaluate every supported signal over its declared time domain, not only t=0, and must validate each factored Combination after coefficients are applied. Balance of base-plus-each-case does not imply balance of arbitrary linear combinations. Replace contradictory always-positive inlet prose with typed signed port orientation/outlet semantics. Tests need ramp/spline/periodic extrema between endpoints, cancelling individual cases whose combination fails, coefficient overflow/cancellation, pressure-outlet/no-outlet variants, unit/frame transforms, bounded work/cancellation, and a no-mock scenario-to-solver admission receipt.

title: fs-scenario: preserve canonical source identity and precise parse diagnostics
description: ROOT CAUSE: v2 accepts alternate whitespace, numeric spellings, version spellings, and escapes but returns no migration/canonicalization receipt; semantic decoder errors usually report byte 0 because S-expression nodes discard spans. The canonical byte-stable claim therefore loses source identity and diagnostics are not actionable. SCOPE: retain spans and structural paths in the parse tree; require exact canonical bytes for current-version authority or emit a source-to-canonical hash receipt; state signed-zero/nonfinite policy explicitly. TESTS: whitespace, :version 02, numeric and escape aliases, signed zero, nested malformed fields with pinned nonzero offsets/paths, receipt tamper refusal, and canonical replay. ACCEPTANCE: every accepted noncanonical source is explicitly witnessed, and every refusal identifies the exact field and byte span.

title: fs-asbuilt: reject unidentifiable registration and carry spatial uncertainty
description: ROOT CAUSE: registration rank is checked only on centered design fiducials. Collapsed measured fiducials yield atan2(0,0), a plausible zero rotation, and can pass RMS/tolerance checks. Residual RMS is then treated as if it were SE(2) parameter and spatial uncertainty, making far-field binary classifications unjustified. SCOPE: require measured scatter/rank and normalized cross-covariance identifiability; carry SE(2) covariance/domain and pointwise leverage bounds; classify Pass/Fail/Indeterminate unless a bound decides. TESTS: coincident/near-collapsed measured sets, tiny design triangles, translation/scale perturbations, far-from-fiducial leverage, common-mode noise, and observed max near tolerance. ACCEPTANCE: no unidentifiable fit or observed-only residual can masquerade as a certified registration/tolerance decision.

comments.author: jemanuel
comments.text: FRESH-EYES REQUIREMENT: trustworthy registrations must be constructor-sealed outputs of a fit/identifiability receipt; imported transforms remain explicitly unverified. Bind fiducial and sample identities, measurement model, covariance, frame/basis/units, algorithm/version, residual and leverage diagnostics, execution budget, and source provenance. Registration RMS is a fit diagnostic, not SE(2) covariance or a portable observation variance.

comments.author: jemanuel
comments.text: FRESH-EYES PARTIAL ROOT FIX (2026-07-14): the live fs-asbuilt patch now refuses UnobservableRotation before atan2. It tracks raw measured spread so identical awkward-decimal measurements cannot evade the gate through centroid roundoff, and carries outward fs-ivl centroid/cross-covariance enclosures so at least one orientation-objective component must be proven nonzero without an epsilon heuristic. Regressions cover a collapsed (0.1,-0.3) scan and a noncollapsed isotropic reflection with flat rotation objective. This does not close the bead: measured rank/near-collapse policy, sealed fit receipts, SE(2) covariance, leverage/spatial uncertainty, Pass/Fail/Indeterminate classification, units/frames, and authentic downstream evidence remain required.

comments.author: jemanuel
comments.text: FRESH-EYES PARTIAL ROOT FIX (2026-07-15): registration rank and rotation sums now normalize design and measured centered coordinates by independently finite positive point-set scales before forming second- and fourth-order quantities. Metamorphic tests span 1e-300 through 1e300. Collapsed/no-spread data retain UnobservableRotation while interval-ambiguous nonzero-spread objectives return RotationCertificationUnresolved, and residual RMS is documented as a global fit diagnostic rather than transform uncertainty. This does not close the bead: retain a certified angle/translation enclosure or conditioning margin, SE(2) transform covariance or spatial uncertainty propagation, leverage-aware bounds, and typed length-versus-variance quantities before downstream assimilation can claim calibrated registration uncertainty.

comments.author: jemanuel
comments.text: FRESH-EYES NUMERIC AND REPLAY PARTIAL FIX (2026-07-15): hostile-coordinate registration now uses stable running centroids followed by an anchored normalized pass, literal 6n work accounting, finite scale gates, and scaled residual sum-of-squares. Rotation-plus-translation keeps the ordinary binary64 bits when finite; only an overflowing intermediate enters the scaled path, and an fs-ivl outward enclosure must prove the original real three-term affine sum remains within the finite range before recovery. Exact positive and negative MAX plus-or-minus 2^970 overflow-midpoint regressions prevent scaled rounding from minting a false finite result, while a cancelling extreme rotation remains representable. A direct MAX-residual G0 test exercises the non-squaring RMS path. Because these rules change replay semantics, the retained asbuilt diff domain, schema, and prefix move from v3 to v4. Central RCH batch on fmd passed fs-asbuilt 5 unit plus 23 integration tests. One final recovered-value-inside-enclosure consistency guard was added after that batch snapshot and is deliberately code-first pending the next union batch under the batch-verify strategy. This bead remains open and blocked as modeled: SE(2) covariance, leverage-aware spatial uncertainty, units/frames, typed Pass-Fail-Indeterminate evidence, and authentic fit receipts are not yet complete.

title: fs-assimilate: model shared calibration and registration covariance
description: ROOT CAUSE: observations carry only scalar variance and assimilate_all sequentially treats every reading as independent. Scan samples sharing one registration/calibration error fold that common variance into every scalar and spuriously gain N-fold information. SCOPE: support batch covariance or explicit latent nuisance/group-correlation identities; bind correlation structure into evidence and update algebra; reject duplicate-independent claims for shared sources. TESTS: N observations with one common-mode error, independent versus fully correlated limits, mixed groups, covariance PSD/symmetry checks, permutation invariance, and posterior oracle comparison. ACCEPTANCE: repeated observations cannot drive shared uncertainty below its common-mode floor.

comments.author: jemanuel
comments.text: FRESH-EYES REQUIREMENT: add ObservationId and dataset-row identity with idempotent replay, plus an explicit replicate identity/independence declaration. A repeated record must not be treated as a new experiment. Registration uncertainty must propagate through each observation operator Jacobian and remain correlated across observations sharing the fit; scalar RMS may not be copied into independent variances.

comments.text: SCOPE DELIVERED, closure gated by graph (QuietBear, 2026-08-08): fs-assimilate::groups module implements and verifies this bead's core scope — RowId per record with duplicate-row refusal (idempotent replay), SharedSource declarations, mechanically derived batch covariance (total-variance diagonal + shared off-diagonals), delegation to the checked whitening path, naive-posterior comparison, and the exact common-mode floor (1/v0 + S1/(1+sigma_c^2*S1))^-1 tested against joint-Gaussian conditioning. Acceptance holds numerically: grouped posterior == floor; naive claim dives below it. Full fs-assimilate suite green via RCH; clippy clean; committed to main; CONTRACT.md updated. NOTE: I began this bead from the open list without noticing the frankensim-sj31i.36 block edge; closure is left for the graph/owner since .36 (semantic identity binding) is still open. The delivered code stands and unblocks sj31i.64's update-algebra work.

title: fs-benchmark: bind every semantic field and resolve evidence before promotion
description: ROOT CAUSE: corpus hashing omits each query QoI, so changing temperature/K to pressure/Pa preserves the digest. Query records also self-assert Verified/Validated ranks without resolving evidence; audit misses finite/positive tolerances, unique IDs, count bounds, and rate/cost domains. SCOPE: schema-versioned length-framed hashing of every semantic field; replace ranks with evidence references and verifier policy; promote only after resolution; comprehensive structural/domain audit. TESTS: mutate every field one at a time, QoI/unit collision regression, missing/tampered evidence, duplicate IDs, count>total, NaN/negative costs/tolerances, rate bounds, deterministic digest. ACCEPTANCE: corpus identity changes for every semantic change and no authoritative rank exists without verified retained evidence.

comments.text: FRESH-EYES AUDIT ADDENDUM (2026-07-14): audit currently equates a nonempty named dataset with executable instrumentation. Several source schemas cannot reconstruct their advertised metrics at all: MmsCase lacks solver/workload/cost and warm-start observations; DesignTask lacks guard/random comparisons plus realized-cost/safety-factor fields; QueryCase lacks query-volume evidence. Require a typed metric evaluator to declare and validate schema compatibility, reconstruct every numerator/denominator from retained cases, and refuse name-only matches. Also replace generic rate(successes, 0)=0 for upper-bound metrics: conflict_rate < 0.25 currently passes with zero merge attempts. Zero-denominator upper-bound evidence must be Unavailable/Refused with a typed denominator receipt. Bind instrumented proposal definitions and evaluator versions into the corpus digest as semantic fields, using schema-versioned length framing and BLAKE3-class identity.

title: fs-flywheel-e2e: separate fixture conformance from activation statistics
description: ROOT CAUSE: the activation gate treats 20 correlated deterministic points from a deliberately linear family and nearby cache data as a six-month/customer-realistic checkpoint, without a sampling frame, holdout, uncertainty bound, or preregistration. Empty warm-start ratios become +infinity and can pass the savings gate. SCOPE: keep the fixture as conformance only; require a retained representative stratified corpus, independent holdout, exact denominators, minimum sample counts, and anytime-valid lower bounds/e-process thresholds for activation; distinguish accepted outright from measured savings. TESTS: empty/minimum samples, correlated duplicates, distribution shift, holdout leakage, adverse strata, stopping optionality, and retained sampling-frame identity. ACCEPTANCE: activation cannot pass from empty or nonrepresentative evidence and every threshold has a replayable statistical claim.
close_reason: Done at 9617df9: fs-flywheel-e2e activation module separates fixture conformance from activation statistics. Preregistered SamplingFrame (identity-retained strata/minimums/seed/thresholds via fs-ledger hash), holdout-only evidence with typed refusals (HoldoutLeakage, DuplicateSample, ZeroWarmDenominator, UnknownStratum, InsufficientSamples, NoWarmStartEvidence - the +INFINITY empty-ratio hole is unrepresentable), per-stratum anytime-valid betting e-processes at preregistered delta (optional stopping + favorable pooling cannot manufacture a pass), AcceptedOutright distinguished from measured savings. phase1 checkpoint reframed as conformance (p1_004) + p1_005 proves the linear-family fixture refuses at the adjudicator. Evidence: activation_stats 8/8, phase1_gate 5/5, e2e/phase2/phase3/cal/dbg all green on nightly-2026-07-06 under --features flywheel-e2e; CONTRACT.md updated. acceptance ac_003 red is the in-flight fs-verify receipt work (foreign, disjoint).

comments.author: jemanuel
comments.text: FRESH-EYES AUDIT ADDENDUM (2026-07-14): the compounding checkpoint ratio composed / best_isolated > 1.15 does not prove interaction or superadditivity; it proves only that four enabled mechanisms beat one. Replace it with a paired preregistered full 2^4 factorial or an equivalently identifying design, retained main/interaction contrasts, uncertainty bounds, and Shapley-style contribution accounting. Calibration and evaluation must be disjoint. Empty warm-start observations may not map to +infinity and pass; require typed availability and minimum denominators for every component gate. Preserve optional-stopping-safe lower bounds and adverse-stratum checks.

title: fs-diffreal-e2e: exercise production derivatives and state probabilistic claims honestly

title: fs-adjoint: integrate subcell QoI windows without quadrature blindness
description: ROOT CAUSE: primal QoI evaluation and dual-load assembly sample a discontinuous indicator at five Gauss nodes per cell. A narrow interval between nodes contributes exactly zero numerically even when its exact integral is positive, permitting eta=0 and false tolerance acceptance. SCOPE: split intersected cells at query-window endpoints or analytically integrate the clipped P1 basis and primal field over exact intersections; use identical endpoint semantics in primal QoI and adjoint RHS; treat empty and ULP-width windows explicitly. TESTS: a window [0.10,0.11] inside one [0,1] cell, windows around every Gauss gap, endpoints on cell boundaries, ULP-width windows, refinement convergence, manufactured exact integrals, and a regression proving the old false acceptance is refused. A world-class result should produce a replayable interval J(u) in [J(u_h)+Delta_h-E, J(u_h)+Delta_h+E] under explicit hypotheses, where Delta_h is a computable signed correction and E combines independently certified primal and dual approximation factors, algebraic-solve residuals, coefficient/data uncertainty, and quadrature/rounding enclosures. description: ROOT CAUSE: fs-flywheel-e2e run_loop executes nominally parallel agents against one mutable global RecomputeStore and advances the global headline/evidence during each branch before conflict resolution. A later branch can therefore observe same-iteration writes from an earlier branch, take cache skips, and receive parallel cost credit for work that was not independent. Conflicted or cancelled speculative branches also leave cache artifacts and accepted proposal evidence in the global headline. In the current literal-artifact fixture this already corrupts skips, per-branch costs, speedups, proposal/accept denominators, telemetry, trace hashes, and lineage; with real artifact inputs it becomes cache poisoning and output contamination. SCOPE: give every iteration one immutable start-of-iteration store/headline snapshot; execute branches in isolated overlays that collect cache writes, artifacts, evidence, costs, telemetry, and proposal state; resolve merge before publication; atomically validate and commit a deterministic union only for Resolved/Trivial outcomes or an explicitly serialized resolution. Quarantine conflict evidence outside the authoritative cache/headline, discard uncommitted overlays on cancellation while retaining honest charged work, and detect same-identity/different-artifact collisions before any partial commit. Bind snapshot revision, overlay roots, resolution, committed write set, and resulting revision into replay evidence. Preserve deterministic branch-order independence and request-drain-finalize semantics. TESTS: a cold one-iteration parallel run has no same-iteration cross-branch hits; swapped agent order and forced scheduler interleavings produce identical reports; accepted proposals followed by forced merge conflict leave authoritative cache revision/headline unchanged and the next iteration matches a no-commit control; cancellation after zero/one/all branch completions leaves no writes but charges completed work; identical overlay writes deduplicate, disjoint writes union, conflicting artifacts refuse atomically; inject failure at every validate/commit boundary; replay/tamper checks cover snapshot and commit receipts. ACCEPTANCE: no branch reads another branch's speculative writes; unresolved/cancelled work cannot affect authoritative skip decisions, headline evidence, or future outputs; every committed iteration is one atomic, deterministic, replay-verifiable state transition.

title: Sheaf numerics: convergence-certified decomposition, scale-aware spectra, and explicit Unknown
description:
ROOT CAUSE: Fixed iteration counts, absolute thresholds, partial eigenspectra, and nominal residuals can be mistaken for mathematical decomposition or cohomology authority. Build numerical reports whose claims are exactly scoped.

SCOPE: Define named normalized operators and return absolute plus scale-normalized primal, dual, orthogonality, and reconstruction residuals; stopping reason; iteration/work counts; conditioning and separation scope; nullspace dimension bounds; set-valued eigenvalue clusters; unresolved modes; and Converged, Indeterminate, or Refused state. Account for every admitted connected-component zero mode. A partial spectrum declares its covered range and never implies completeness. Retain witnesses sufficient for independent replay. New theorems may strengthen authority only under versioned admitted assumptions and proof/checker artifacts.

ACCEPTANCE AND TESTS: No spectral-gap, harmonic, exact, coexact, topology, or local-unrepairability claim arises from an unnormalized or unconverged computation. G0 tests exact complexes, repeated/clustered zero modes, scaling, sign/orientation, ill conditioning, empty components, extreme arithmetic, and tolerance boundaries. G1 manufactured decompositions verify residual and convergence order. G3 covers basis, relabeling, unit/weight scaling, subdivision, and equivalent normalization. G4 exhausts work/memory/deadline/cancellation with retained partial reports and no false success. G5 replays reductions across thread counts and ISAs. Independent spot checks and mutations target every residual, threshold, coverage, and completeness guard. Logs retain operator/normalization identity, spectrum coverage, residual bounds, budgets, state, and theorem/no-claim scope.

It can overflow, underflow, stagnate, or return a non-orthogonal remainder without an explicit Unknown state; downstream proposal ranking then treats those nominal values as actionable. title: Sheaf repair planning: typed proposal states and component-wise gauge feasibility
description:

SCOPE: Predictions use Available(value,witness), Unavailable(reason), Infeasible(witness), or OverBudget(required,available); costs carry units and a declared cost model; metrics name normalization, confidence or enclosure class, and source report. Ranking is deterministic and never converts a non-finite sentinel into a finite preference. Compute connected components including isolated vertices. Intersect every member's possibly asymmetric admitted shift interval per component, select a documented deterministic maximum-slack representative, return actual component offsets, and localize infeasibility. GaugeStepEligible authorizes only that representative choice and cannot erase coexact or harmonic obstruction.

ACCEPTANCE AND TESTS: Globally infeasible but component-wise feasible examples succeed with distinct offsets; one infeasible component is localized without laundering other components into complete repair.
