title: WS7: flywheel with the REAL solver in the loop — wall-clock compounding measured, kill criterion armed
description:
WHY (Addendum sec IV.2: the flywheel is the compounding thesis; reality check: it closes only on MODELED COST UNITS from a corpus — no real solver has ever run in the speculation/recompute/merge loop): the central bet is unproven where it counts. WHAT: (a) wire the fs-vskeleton study (cheap, real, adjoint-verified) and then the WS2 marquee study as the solver inside the flywheel loop: speculation proposes warm starts, the certified verifier (fs-verify equilibrated-flux bounds where applicable, plain re-solve gates otherwise) accepts/rejects, recompute skips proven-unaffected downstream results, merges adjudicate; (b) measure WALL-CLOCK: median speedup of the flywheel loop vs plain hash-memoization baseline over a scripted 50-edit design session (the Addendum Proposal 2 kill criterion: below 2x median means the certified-skip layer freezes — instrument it exactly and record the verdict either way); (c) accept-rate telemetry for speculation (Proposal 9 kill: 30 percent acceptance / 1.5x warm-start bar) recorded per session in the ledger. ACCEPTANCE: the 50-edit session battery runs both arms and emits the comparison JSONL; kill-criterion metrics are first-class ledger rows (an uninstrumented kill measurement counts as killed, per the addendum's own governance); results ledgered on this bead whichever way they fall — a measured NO is a valid exit. DEPENDS on runner binaries. Honesty note: this bead's success is the MEASUREMENT existing, not the thesis winning.

## Acceptance Criteria

The structured acceptance_criteria field is controlling and preserves the complete close gate.
acceptance_criteria:
## Leaf-local verification

Add focused unit tests for happy, empty, minimum/maximum, n-1/n/n+1, malformed, non-finite, overflow, and exact typed-error paths.

Add property or metamorphic tests for every applicable algebraic, dimensional, ordering, containment, scaling, permutation, representation, determinism, and replay invariant.

Exercise at least one authentic public consumer or integration route. Mock-only success cannot close the leaf.

For concurrency or cancellation surfaces, inject requests and faults at every admitted boundary and prove drain/finalize behavior, no leaks, no partial authority, and deterministic retry/replay.

Record the exact focused command and result. These tests prove only this contribution; terminal family authority remains with the named E2E or adjudication Bead.

## Frozen measurement design

Before sampling, freeze an immutable specification containing workload/case IDs; host/ISA and quiet-window qualification; exact warmup/sample/attempt counts; timers/error budgets; baseline/candidate arm equality; timed boundaries; work/byte formulas; exclusions/stopping rules; literal target and non-collapse floors; statistical decision rule.

No threshold, floor, tolerance, exclusion, or stopping choice may be selected from candidate results.

Emit Pass, Fail, NoData, Unqualified separately. Skip/missing route/loaded host/post-hoc exclusion/unavailable capability cannot Pass.

Retain raw paired/interleaved samples and artifact-only replay of arithmetic/policy. Any timing rerun is separate.

## Literal real-solver flywheel measurement protocol

Freeze tests/perf/flywheel_real_solver.toml before any candidate outcome is inspected. Exact cases are vskeleton-50-edit and elasticity-marquee-50-edit; each uses one immutable ordered 50-edit manifest, fixed seeds, budgets, verifier/checker identities, and two equal arms: plain hash memoization baseline versus speculation/warm-start/certified-skip flywheel. Time begins immediately before edit admission and ends after all affected recomputation, verification, merge/adjudication, durable receipt, and drain; common one-time build/fixture loading is outside both arms.

Per host/case, run 1 untimed paired warmup and 15 measured paired sessions in deterministic counterbalanced order, repeated in 3 separately admitted quiet windows on each applicable reference ISA. No early stop, failed-edit deletion, post-hoc workload change, or candidate-derived exclusion is allowed. Pre/post reference-axis medians must agree within 3 percent; source/product/manifest/checker drift, loaded/throttled host, unequal arms, missing edit, or uninstrumented transition is Unqualified.

Literal thesis targets are median end-to-end speedup at least 2.00x for each case and combined, speculation acceptance at least 30.0 percent, and median accepted warm-start speedup at least 1.50x. The non-collapse floor is 1.00x end-to-end and no arm may hide more than 5 percent failed/not-run edits. Below-target evidence is an honest Fail and freezes the applicable certified-skip layer according to policy; the Bead may close when the valid measurement and kill verdict exist. Retain per-edit raw wall times, accepted/refused speculation, recompute/skip decisions, verifier outcomes, artifacts, and exact reproduction. Artifact replay recomputes metrics/policy only.

## Exact performance E2E harness

This Bead owns scripts/ci/flywheel_performance_e2e.sh and tests/perf/flywheel_real_solver.toml with immutable case set {flywheel.vskeleton_50_edit, flywheel.elasticity_marquee_50_edit}. The script implements --list, --check, --self-test, --run CASE, --negative CASE, --fault CASE, and artifact-only --replay RECEIPT --input-root PATH --output-root PATH. --self-test uses bounded synthetic timer/host/receipt fixtures and cannot mint performance evidence; --run uses the release-built real path on an admitted host.

Unit/schema/boundary/property/metamorphic/mutation tests cover parsing, exact case membership, work/timer/sample/statistic arithmetic, admission, verdict separation, caps, redaction, and replay. No-mock E2E covers qualified Pass/Fail, NoData, loaded/throttled/unsupported Unqualified, cancellation/drain, timer/allocator/worker/publication fault, truncation, tamper, stale identity, and clean replay. Bounded redacted deterministic JSONL records source/build/features/host/ISA, manifest/case/attempt/sample/sequence, raw observations with units, warmup/measurement role, admitted and consumed budgets, pre/post axes, exclusions, first divergence, verdict, artifacts, and exact reproduction. DSR proves harness correctness only; admitted retained measurements separately own performance authority.
notes: AMBITION ROUND A (Proposal 10's sheaf adjudication, made the flywheel's merge law): when two flywheel branches edit the design concurrently, merge conflicts are adjudicated by the SHEAF machinery already in-house (fs-spectral gap monitoring + fs-conform restriction compatibility): a pure-coboundary mismatch (fields disagree but a consistent global section exists) auto-reconciles by least-squares section and the merge certificate says so; a nonzero H1-class obstruction localizes the conflict to the interface cells and REFUSES auto-merge with the offending region named (structural conflict, human decision). Acceptance addition: a two-branch fixture engineered for each case (reconcilable overlap edit vs genuinely conflicting topology edit) — the first merges automatically with a certificate, the second refuses with correct localization. This is the version-control-for-physics thesis proven at fixture scale inside the flywheel loop, and it is what makes multi-agent design sessions (the actual fleet workflow!) mergeable.

title: Assertion follow-ups from verifying o6yde + joikk: a tautology carries the plate-fin D_h claim, the one-way bulk-air disclosure is unenforced, and joikk's falsifier kill set has no mutant-to-test mapping
description:
Follow-ups from verifying two closures I filed. BOTH CLOSURES WERE JUSTIFIED and
should NOT be reopened -- this bead is the residue. Credit where due is recorded
below because it is part of the finding.

=== FROM o6yde (ceb62c37, YellowElm) ===

The closure was justified. Five of six clauses met on their own terms; the sixth
was met as far as physics allows and the gap was MY SPEC'S, not the
implementer's (see the note at the end). The bondline cards are load-bearing not
decorative -- the fin blocks are otherwise disconnected, so without them there
is no heat path at all and interface.rs:905-911 refuses. The out-of-domain
refusal test is the strongest in the file. The wrong-D_h falsifier moves a
SOLVED quantity (mean_base_temperature_k drops ~9 K against a 1 K threshold),
not just an input-derived one.

(1) THE ASSERTION CARRYING CLAUSE 4's HEADLINE CLAIM IS A TAUTOLOGY.
plate_fin_e2e.rs:515-519 (HEAD):
  assert_eq!(geometry.hydraulic_diameter_m.to_bits(),
             (4.0 * geometry.flow_area_m2 / geometry.wetted_perimeter_m).to_bits(),
             "D_h is derived from the same channel area and wetted perimeter as
              the mesh");
from_mesh_constants initializes that field with 4.0 * flow_area_m2 /
wetted_perimeter_m at :81 -- same tokens, same operand order, same values. It
cannot fail. It verifies a struct field equals its own initializer; it does not
verify anything is derived from the MESH. The real check is sitting unused in
the report: rows[0].area_m2 + rows[1].area_m2 must equal
CHANNEL_LENGTH_M * wetted_perimeter_m (4*L*H + 2*L*gap = L*P), which binds the
hand-computed perimeter to the actual meshed faces.

(2) THE ONE-WAY BULK-AIR DISCLOSURE IS PROSE, NOT A TEST.
Temperature responds to fan speed through exactly one mechanism: the test-local
mean_bulk_temperature_k computed at plate_fin_e2e.rs:429-431 as
T_in + P_declared/(2 rho c_p Q). The test itself asserts h is BITWISE invariant
across speeds (:527-534), and the problem is linear (isotropic_declared k), so
T(x) = t_ref + T~(x) and the base-temperature shift EQUALS the bulk shift
exactly. This is disclosed at the computation site (:426-428, "This is not a
conjugate fluid solve") and in fs-airflow/CONTRACT.md -- but the assertion site
:549-552 reads "the solved airflow change must reach the solid temperature
field", which is a t_ref-wiring check wearing physics phrasing.
The enforcing assertion is available and absent: mean_base_temperature_k minus
mean_bulk_temperature_k is invariant across the three speeds TO THE LAST BITS.
Asserting that would simultaneously document the one-way coupling and prove no
hidden speed sensitivity ever leaks in.

(3) REGION COVERAGE IS EXISTENCE-ONLY. plate_fin_e2e.rs:582-585 asserts
faces > 0 and heat_rate_w > 0.0 with no face count and no area. A predicate that
silently matched HALF the fin flanks passes every assertion in the file: the
energy closure compares the region sum against a total that would drop by the
same amount, and no absolute temperature is pinned. Add per-region face-count
assertions (64 flank triangles, 32 floor triangles).

(4) ZERO VALIDITY MARGIN. plate_fin_e2e.rs:521 asserts L/D_h >= 50.0, mirroring
fully_developed()'s floor of exactly 50.0 (fs-convection/src/lib.rs:760) which
evaluate().expect() already enforces. The fixture sits EXACTLY on it --
L/D_h == 50.0 bit-exactly. A one-ULP change in the wrong direction turns three
passing tests into three expect panics. Re-dimension for margin.

(5) MODELLING-CONSISTENCY NIT, not an assertion defect. D_h is computed for a
THREE-SIDED OPEN channel (plate_fin_e2e.rs:72-77, perimeter = gap + 2H, no top)
while the cards it feeds are declared for a FOUR-WALL CLOSED duct with the
uniform condition on all four walls (fs-convection/src/lib.rs:775-780, :792-797),
and aspect_ratio 0.5 is the closed 2p x 4p rectangle whose D_h would be 2.667p,
not 3.2p. So the (D_h, alpha) pair handed to the card describes no single duct.
Additionally CWT is applied to the flanks and CHF to the floor of the SAME
passage -- two mutually exclusive four-wall idealizations at once. Defensible
for a wiring fixture; the disclosures say "synthetic / fully-developed analytic
limits" but not "the D_h and the card's duct are different ducts".

=== FROM joikk (b5bcb038, YellowElm) ===

The closure was substantially justified: 4 of 5 clauses fully met. 8 new tests,
12 previously-dead guards now reached, the vacuous
contact_level_a_row_exposes_a_tolerance_gate DELETED outright, both uniform-field
pseudo-solves replaced with genuine two-solve comparisons carrying explicit
non-vacuity guards (mean_jump_k.abs() > 1.0), a real registry bound applied to a
solve-derived quantity that DOMINATES its neighbours, and the CHANGELOG
misattribution corrected in the honest direction. interface.rs was verified
untouched by SHA-256. The test design shows the right instincts throughout --
distinct message substrings AND interface-name assertions so a neighbouring
guard's refusal cannot be mistaken for the intended one, plus fixture-isolation
pre-asserts.

(6) THE "7-TEST FALSIFIER KILL SET" IS AN AGGREGATE, NOT A DEMONSTRATION.
The bead explicitly set frankensim-z87uy as the bar, whose commit fe7f8b9f
records WHICH perturbation kills WHICH test and a control observation (the
pre-existing test passed under both mutants, proving it was blind). b5bcb038 and
the joikk comments record only four mutant FAMILIES and "7/19 failures": no
mutant-to-test mapping, no mutant diff, no statement of which tests SURVIVED
each mutant, and no artifact in the tree (grep for "mutant" across md/json/jsonl
finds nothing for fs-conduction). The four named families touch NONE of the ten
new refusal branches except area-drift, so the bulk of the delivered work has no
reported demonstration. Falsifiable-by-construction (expect_err on a distinct
message substring cannot pass if the guard is deleted) is a legitimate argument
for those -- but it is an argument, not the demonstration the clause required.
Remediation is cheap: re-run the four mutants, record which of the 19 died for
each, and add one refusal-branch mutant (delete interface.rs:864-870 and show
tests/contact.rs:589-600 dies).

(7) A NEW TAUTOLOGY WAS INTRODUCED WHILE REMOVING AN OLD ONE.
tests/contact.rs:875-878, contact_level_a_tolerance_rejects_a_deliberate_outside_
value: outside = reference + 2.0*limit, then asserts |outside - reference| >
limit. Unconditionally true given limit > 0, which the helper already asserts.
It exercises no production code -- it is arithmetic on registry constants. The
genuine guard is the helper's limit > 0.0 check at :392-395.
Related, lower severity: :871 asserts reference.to_bits() == 0.3f64.to_bits() --
the exact literal-vs-equal-literal pattern joikk flagged, relocated rather than
removed. Defensible as a registry pin but it is a change-detector, not a check.
And :388-391 (atol.is_finite() && atol >= 0.0 && ...) is the old vacuous shape
assert, now harmless because :392-395 subsumes it, but it still reads as a gate.

(8) RESIDUAL, outside joikk's enumerated list so not an overclaim:
interface.rs:1218-1227's "does not have a unique exact vertex correspondence"
refusal has no test. And the two-surface fixture (tests/contact.rs:1076-1081)
uses fluxes(), never solve_with_interfaces, so assemble_into
(interface.rs:1086-1119) is still never exercised with more than one surface
while CONTRACT.md:315-317 claims order stability "before ASSEMBLY or summation".

(9) FLAKE RISK: tests/contact.rs:454-459 has observed error 1.39e-13 against
limit 1.3e-12 with LinearConfig::tolerance = 1e-13 -- under 10x headroom.

=== MY OWN SPEC ERROR, recorded so it is not repeated ===
o6yde's DONE-WHEN 2 required that changing fan speed change h and the resulting
temperature, WHILE ALSO mandating RectangularDuctLaminarCwt/Chf. Those cards are
fully developed Shah-London limits whose FORMULA consumes aspect_ratio only
(fs-convection/src/lib.rs:620-639); Re/Pr/L_over_Dh are validity axes, not
formula inputs. At fixed geometry h cannot move. The clause was physically
impossible as written, and I had the information -- my own z87uy work depended on
exactly that fact. YellowElm found the impossibility BEFORE writing code,
recorded it with the exact reason, asked in Agent Mail, refused to manufacture
h-dependence by wobbling D_h/k/aspect with fan speed, and split the real work
into frankensim-7na5f wired as a blocker so the parent claim stayed fail-closed.
That is the correct handling of a bad spec and it is worth recording as the
precedent.

title: fs-airflow provenance hash omits regime_validity: two decision-changing networks share one identity (Invariant 7 falsified)
description:
FALSIFIER, executed against the crate's own fixtures — this is not a review opinion.

CONTRACT.md:101-104 Invariant 7 claims provenance hashes "bind the complete fan
curve, source, tolerance, fan-bank configuration, recursive network topology,
loss data, and explicit leakage identity."

push_network_identity (crates/fs-airflow/src/lib.rs:1061-1086) hashes an
element's name, resistance, uncertainty_rel, source and tolerance_basis. It
OMITS regime_validity entirely.

THE REPRO IS ALREADY IN THE TREE. tests/qoi.rs:63-74 network() and
tests/qoi.rs:76-94 network_with_validated_heatsink_loss() differ in exactly one
thing: the heatsink element carries .with_regime_validity(loss_reynolds
2000..80000). Every hashed field is identical. Therefore operating_provenance
(src/lib.rs:1029-1059) and operating_identity (src/qoi.rs:1103-1124) are
BYTE-IDENTICAL across the two.

WHY THAT IS SEVERE, not cosmetic: that single difference is the whole reason
regime_audit_cards() returns [] in one case and [airflow.loss.heatsink] in the
other (tests/qoi.rs:445, :456-463), which drives a DIFFERENT PRODUCT ADMISSION
OUTCOME — see actual_loss_card_alone_demotes_the_complete_qoi_set
(tests/qoi.rs:443-522). Two runs a reviewer must be able to tell apart carry the
same provenance identity. A provenance hash that cannot distinguish a demoted
result from an admitted one is a false certificate, which this project holds to
be worse than an ordinary wrong answer.

AGGRAVATING: LossElement derives PartialEq INCLUDING regime_validity
(src/lib.rs:386-403). So the two elements compare UNEQUAL while hashing EQUAL —
an equality/identity inconsistency inside one type. Any code that dedupes or
caches on the hash will collapse two elements that == says are different.

DONE WHEN: regime_validity participates in push_network_identity; a test builds
exactly the two fixtures above and asserts their operating_identity values
DIFFER; a second test asserts hash-equality implies PartialEq-equality for
LossElement (the property whose violation is the bug).

NO-CLAIM: fixing the hash does not make the provenance authentic. It restores
the weaker property Invariant 7 actually promises — that a decision-changing
declaration changes the identity.

Found by audit during f85xj.5.5 close review (NobleLion, 2026-07-25). Not fixed
in that pass because fs-airflow was assigned to another agent.
close_reason: Fixed at commit 427e2cad; falsifier proven live by disabling the fix. Regression surface: crates/fs-airflow/tests/qoi.rs and tests/conformance.rs assert regime_validity participates in provenance identity, so two decision-changing networks can no longer share one identity.

comments.author: jemanuel
comments.text:
COMPLETE 2026-07-25 (NobleLion). Landed 427e2cad.

regime_validity now participates in push_network_identity. Absence is tag 0 and
a declared domain is tag 1, so a cardless element stays cardless rather than
widening into an unconstrained claim. Axis NAMES are hashed with their bounds,
so two axes carrying equal numbers do not collide. The axis map is a BTreeMap,
so the encoding is canonical without an explicit sort.

VERIFIED BY DISABLING THE FIX, not by assertion. With the single hash line
commented out, exactly the 4 new tests fail and the other 9 pass. That is the
evidence the tests are load-bearing; a regression test for a hash defect that
was never observed failing is indistinguishable from one that asserts nothing.

FOUR TESTS
- a_declared_regime_domain_changes_the_operating_identity — the falsifier.
- moving_a_validity_bound_changes_the_operating_identity — presence is not
  enough; the bound and the axis name both reach the identity.
- loss_elements_that_compare_unequal_never_share_an_identity — the general
  property whose violation WAS the bug, checked exhaustively over the
  constructible variants. It is TOTAL here: every f64 reaching the encoding is
  validated finite (with_regime_validity refuses a non-finite bound,
  LossElement::new refuses a non-positive resistance), so there is no NaN case
  where PartialEq is non-reflexive and equality/identity could honestly
  disagree. Worth stating because that carve-out is real in general.
- an_element_with_a_declared_domain_still_solves_to_the_same_numbers — adding a
  card moves the identity and NOTHING ELSE, flow and pressure bitwise
  identical. Without this the falsifier could pass for a second reason.

NO GOLDEN BUMP. fs-airflow has zero rows in golden-couplings.json and freezes
no identity constant in any test, so no frozen artifact moves. Checked rather
than assumed, because a provenance-encoding change is exactly the shape that
silently invalidates a frozen hash.

CONTRACT Invariant 7 now names regime_validity explicitly and states the
equivalent property (unequal elements never share an identity) with the test
that checks it. The invariant was not wrong in spirit — "the complete loss
data" already covered this field — but a claim broad enough to be silently
false is the defect class, so it now names the field that was missing.

VERIFICATION: fs-airflow 24/24 (13 conformance + 11 qoi); fmt clean; ubs 0
critical; check-contracts 0 for this crate; check-source-manifest and
check-docs both 0 after the commit.

OWNERSHIP: found while auditing f85xj.5.5, which is assigned to IndigoElk. I
notified them, waited, and proceeded only after confirming every prior
reservation on fs-airflow was EXPLICITLY RELEASED and 45h expired — which is
the project's own isolation signal. Happy to have this reworked if the owner
returns and disagrees with the encoding.

title: Close one real GEMM measure-cache-model-dispatch autotune loop
description:
Closed bead xlvx comment 152 explicitly required a production GEMM measure -> cache -> cost model -> TilePlan dispatch loop, but HEAD still has zero production Tuner consumers and hard-coded MC/NC dispatch. TuneRow also overloads measured_ns with times, tile counts, and milli-GB/s and calls candidate separation confidence. Acceptance: typed evidence with units and repeat samples; no probabilistic confidence claim; current-machine/semantic/tier/placement filtering; bounded bitwise candidate sweep; ledger cache; production fs-session orchestration consuming the selected MC/NC plan; cold/stale/invalid/cancel/pin-failure/replay drills; live choice within declared tolerance of exhaustive oracle on both reference ISAs. KC/SIMD tier remain outside this bit-neutral loop.

## Steps to Reproduce

Run `scripts/ci/gemm_tuner_perf_e2e.sh --check` against the frozen `tests/perf/gemm_tuner_loop.toml`, then run its exhaustive-oracle negative fixture against the pre-repair production route. It exposes no production Tuner consumer, retains hard-coded MC/NC dispatch, and permits TuneRow.measured_ns to mix incompatible units. The retained failure names the missing consumer or first unit/cache/filter divergence without treating candidate ordering as confidence.

## Acceptance Criteria

The structured acceptance_criteria field is controlling and preserves the complete close gate.
acceptance_criteria:
## Leaf-local verification

Add focused unit tests for happy, empty, minimum/maximum, n-1/n/n+1, malformed, non-finite, overflow, and exact typed-error paths.

Add property or metamorphic tests for every applicable algebraic, dimensional, ordering, containment, scaling, permutation, representation, determinism, and replay invariant.

Exercise at least one authentic public consumer or integration route. Mock-only success cannot close the leaf.

For concurrency or cancellation surfaces, inject requests and faults at every admitted boundary and prove drain/finalize behavior, no leaks, no partial authority, and deterministic retry/replay.

Record the exact focused command and result. These tests prove only this contribution; terminal family authority remains with the named E2E or adjudication Bead.

## Frozen measurement design

Before sampling, freeze an immutable specification containing workload/case IDs; host/ISA and quiet-window qualification; exact warmup/sample/attempt counts; timers/error budgets; baseline/candidate arm equality; timed boundaries; work/byte formulas; exclusions/stopping rules; literal target and non-collapse floors; statistical decision rule.

No threshold, floor, tolerance, exclusion, or stopping choice may be selected from candidate results.

Emit Pass, Fail, NoData, Unqualified separately. Skip/missing route/loaded host/post-hoc exclusion/unavailable capability cannot Pass.

Retain raw paired/interleaved samples and artifact-only replay of arithmetic/policy. Any timing rerun is separate.

## Literal GEMM tuner measurement protocol

Freeze tests/perf/gemm_tuner_loop.toml before candidate sampling. Exact workloads are f64 row-major GEMM (M,N,K) = (1024,1024,1024), (2048,2048,2048), (4096,4096,4096), (4096,256,4096), and (256,4096,4096), with beta=0 and beta=1 variants, fixed aligned allocation, one declared current KC/SIMD tier, and MC in {64,128,192,256} crossed with NC in {64,128,256,384,512}. Work is exactly 2*M*N*K floating operations; setup, allocation, validation, and cache publication are outside the timed region.

On each qualified M-class arm64 and Threadripper-class x86_64 host, run 5 untimed warmups then 31 timed samples per candidate in deterministic seed-bound interleaved order, repeated in 3 separately admitted quiet windows. No early stopping or sample exclusion is allowed after candidate timing begins. Timer quantization plus calibration error must be below 0.5 percent of the shortest retained sample; pre/post reference-axis medians must agree within 3 percent; throttling, competing workload, pin mismatch, missing route, debug build, or source/fingerprint drift is Unqualified.

The literal selection target is per-case selected-plan median throughput at least 97 percent of the exhaustive best and geometric-mean throughput at least 99 percent of exhaustive best. The non-collapse floor is at least 95 percent of the compatible committed baseline geometric mean and no case below 90 percent. Candidate separation is a deterministic measured ordering, not probabilistic confidence. Pass, Fail, NoData, and Unqualified are separate. Retain every raw sample, candidate order, timer calibration, host/admission receipt, selected plan, cache key, exhaustive oracle, and first divergence. Artifact-only replay recomputes arithmetic and policy without timing; a timing rerun is new evidence.

## Exact performance E2E harness

This Bead owns scripts/ci/gemm_tuner_perf_e2e.sh and tests/perf/gemm_tuner_loop.toml with immutable case set {gemm.square_1024, gemm.square_2048, gemm.square_4096, gemm.tall_skinny, gemm.wide_short}. The script implements --list, --check, --self-test, --run CASE, --negative CASE, --fault CASE, and artifact-only --replay RECEIPT --input-root PATH --output-root PATH. --self-test uses bounded synthetic timer/host/receipt fixtures and cannot mint performance evidence; --run uses the release-built real path on an admitted host.

Unit/schema/boundary/property/metamorphic/mutation tests cover parsing, exact case membership, work/timer/sample/statistic arithmetic, admission, verdict separation, caps, redaction, and replay. No-mock E2E covers qualified Pass/Fail, NoData, loaded/throttled/unsupported Unqualified, cancellation/drain, timer/allocator/worker/publication fault, truncation, tamper, stale identity, and clean replay. Bounded redacted deterministic JSONL records source/build/features/host/ISA, manifest/case/attempt/sample/sequence, raw observations with units, warmup/measurement role, admitted and consumed budgets, pre/post axes, exclusions, first divergence, verdict, artifacts, and exact reproduction. DSR proves harness correctness only; admitted retained measurements separately own performance authority.

title: fs-convection Level-A 'limiting-behavior checks' are literal-vs-literal freezes: no nonconstant card is checked against any analytic limit
description:
Found while auditing f85xj.5.2 clause 2 at HEAD (audit comment on that bead,
2026-07-25). f85xj.5.2 DONE-WHEN clause 2 reads "Level-A limiting-behavior
checks pass (constant-Nu duct limits)". The check that claims to satisfy it
proves nothing about limiting behavior.

THE DEFECT

`level_a_fully_developed_limits_and_rectangular_square_values_are_frozen`
(tests/correlations.rs:150) resolves the two fs-vvreg ConvectionLimit rows and
passes. But:

  - `CircularDuctLaminarCwt::evaluate` returns the literal 3.66 unconditionally
    (src/lib.rs:614). `CircularDuctLaminarChf` returns the literal 4.36
    (src/lib.rs:615). Neither consumes any group in its formula.
  - The assertion is `observed.to_bits() == case.reference_value_si.to_bits()`
    (tests/correlations.rs:73), and `reference_value_si` is the literal 3.66
    (fs-vvreg/src/thermal_level_a.rs:305) / 4.36 (:315).

So the "Level-A limiting-behavior check" is a cross-crate freeze of one literal
against an equal literal. No arithmetic is exercised. It proves the domain gate
admits the point and that nobody typo'd a constant. It is NOT a limiting-behavior
check in the asymptotic sense.

Compounding: the tolerance-envelope check five lines earlier
(tests/correlations.rs:67-72, atol=rtol=1e-12) is strictly implied by the
bit-equality assert that follows it, so it is dead code that can never fire
independently.

AND: NO test anywhere asserts limiting behavior of any NONCONSTANT card. The
crate has 9 nonconstant cards. Every one of their frozen spot values
(tests/correlations.rs:199) is a frozen output of THIS implementation, not a
source-published value or an analytic limit -- the test name
`every_nonconstant_formula_has_a_frozen_source_formula_spot_value` says "source
formula" but the numbers are self-referential goldens. There is no external or
analytic oracle for any nonconstant card in the crate.

WHY IT MATTERS: 3.66 and 4.36 are exactly the values a developing-flow card must
CONVERGE TO. The crate ships such a card (CircularDuctHausen) whose domain
overlaps the constant cards'. The convergence is the check the clause is asking
for and it is free.

EXECUTED EVIDENCE (verified independently in f64 before filing)

(1) Hausen -> 3.66 is testable with NO refusal. Hausen admits
    L_over_Dh in [0.05,1000], CircularDuctLaminarCwt admits [50,1e6]; they
    intersect on [50,1000], with identical Pr/Re boxes. At the shared admitted
    point (Re=1, Pr=0.6, L_over_Dh=1000): Gz=6.0e-4, Hausen Nu=3.6600400685984216,
    gap to 3.66 = 4.0069e-5 (rel 1.0948e-5). Monotone in Gz across the shared
    box: L/Dh = 50/100/250/500/1000 -> gap = 7.999e-4 / 4.003e-4 / 1.602e-4 /
    8.012e-5 / 4.007e-5. Analytic two-sided bracket holds everywhere in-domain:
    3.66 < Nu <= 3.66 + 0.0668*Gz.

(2) The flat-plate transition constant 871 is independently checkable and is
    currently unchecked. Re=5.0e5 is simultaneously the INCLUSIVE upper bound of
    FlatPlateLaminarAverage (src/lib.rs:851) and the INCLUSIVE lower bound of
    FlatPlateTurbulentAverage (src/lib.rs:871), so both cards admit it. By
    construction 871 ~= 0.037*(5e5)^0.8 - 0.664*(5e5)^0.5 = 871.3234750958699.
    Measured relative gap between the two cards at Re=5e5 is 6.889501e-4 and is
    EXACTLY independent of Pr across the shared Pr window [0.6,50] (checked at
    Pr = 0.6/0.7/1.0/10/50 -- the Pr^(1/3) cancels). This is the card whose
    citation was just repaired under frankensim-iy7k1; nothing tests the
    constant that citation is supposed to justify.

(3) Two exact in-domain degeneracies are untested:
    - DittusBoelter at Pr=1 must return BIT-IDENTICAL values for HeatingFluid
      (Pr^0.4) and CoolingFluid (Pr^0.3), both equal to 0.023*Re^0.8. Pr=1 is
      inside [0.7,120]. The existing direction test (tests/correlations.rs:384)
      uses Pr=0.7 and asserts only that the two DIFFER.
    - Gnielinski at Pr=1 collapses exactly: Pr^(2/3)-1 = 0 kills the correction
      denominator, leaving Nu = (f/8)(Re-1000). Pr=1 is inside [0.5,2000].

(4) Churchill-Chu's Ra->0 endpoint 0.825 is OUT of domain (Ra>=0.1, and
    insert_group refuses 0) but is recoverable EXACTLY from in-domain points:
    sqrt(Nu) = 0.825 + 0.387*Ra^(1/6)/D(Pr) is affine in Ra^(1/6), so a
    two-point in-domain fit extrapolates the intercept. Verified: Ra=(1e12,1e0)
    at Pr=0.7 gives intercept 0.8249999999999957 (err 4.2e-15). This is the
    technique for testing an inadmissible endpoint without triggering a refusal.

DONE WHEN
  1. The developing-flow card is proven to converge to the fully-developed
     constant-Nu duct limits through a cross-card check at shared admitted
     points, with monotonicity in Gz and the analytic bracket -- i.e. clause 2
     of f85xj.5.2 is satisfied by an actual limit, not a literal freeze.
  2. The flat-plate transition continuity at Re=5e5 is checked across the shared
     Pr window, including Pr-independence of the gap and the implied value of
     the 871 constant.
  3. At least the two exact in-domain degeneracies (Dittus-Boelter Pr=1 direction
     collapse, Gnielinski Pr=1 reduction) are pinned.
  4. Every new assertion is falsifiable: perturbing the relevant constant in
     src/lib.rs must fail the new test. Demonstrate this, do not assert it.
  5. CONTRACT.md conformance-test section states what is now proven and what is
     still only a self-referential golden. Do NOT claim source-table validation.

NON-GOALS: no new cards, no published-table corpus (that is the separate
licensed-fixture gap 5.2 already records), no change to src/lib.rs formulas or
domains. Test + contract only. If a formula must change to make a test pass,
that is a finding, not a fix -- file it.
close_reason: All five DONE-WHEN clauses met at commit fe7f8b9f. Five limiting-behavior checks added for the nonconstant cards (Hausen->3.66 cross-card convergence with analytic bracket + first-order halving; flat-plate transition continuity at the shared inclusive Re=5e5 bound, Pr-independent, pinning the 871 rounding residue; Dittus-Boelter Pr=1 bitwise direction degeneracy; Gnielinski Pr=1 exact denominator collapse; Churchill-Chu 0.825 intercept recovered by affine extrapolation from in-domain points). Falsifiers DEMONSTRATED in two runs with disjoint failure sets, src/lib.rs reverted byte-identical (sha256 verified). The pre-existing Level-A test passed in both falsifier runs, proving the reported blindness. fs-convection 17/17 all-targets remote; check-source-manifest/check-docs/check-layers/check-deps all 0. CONTRACT records what is proven and, in no-claim, that frozen spot values remain implementation outputs and cross-card agreement is not experimental validation. No formula, domain, or card changed.

title: fs-simd: safe GEMM facades permit pointer UB via overflow and post-final advances
description:
Fresh-eyes audit of commits f41c0cb/6d55c1b found two independent soundness failures in safe public SIMD GEMM facades.

1. Normal-input UB: both NEON batched kernels advance raw stream pointers after the final k load, temporarily creating pointers beyond one-past the allocation before rewinding. ptr.add requires the result to remain in-bounds or one-past even when it is not dereferenced. Ordinary fs-la calls with full mb=32 can reach this.
2. Overflow-admission UB: safe facades use unchecked usize multiplication/addition inside pre-unsafe bounds assertions. Release wrapping can make absurd dimensions pass, then raw pointer arithmetic escapes the slice. Affected surfaces include NEON mk8x4/btile4x4/btile4x4p, x86 mk8x4, and feature-gated SME2 gemm_tile_f32.

Root fix: introduce one checked slice-geometry helper in fs-simd; validate every public safe facade with checked_mul/checked_add before unsafe; eliminate post-final pointer advances or recompute offsets from checked bases; update SAFETY.md invariants. Preserve scalar/SIMD twin semantics.

title: Make fs-constraint interval proofs outward-enclosed and independently checkable
description:
ROOT CAUSE AND SEVERITY: fs-constraint's interval engine currently performs ordinary round-to-nearest binary64 arithmetic. Its dependency-aware interval formulas are mathematically conservative over exact reals, but round-to-nearest endpoints can move inward; a near-zero upper endpoint can therefore clear zero even when the real range does not. CONTRACT correctly discloses an fp-slack no-claim, yet Proven/ProofArtifact is the intended authority surface. A false certificate is Sev-0. Do not solve this by deleting interval proofs or globally widening to useless infinities: build the theorem-strength adaptive kernel the architecture intends.

MISSION: Move executable interval authority onto fs-ivl or a shared BEDROCK certified-arithmetic layer with directed/outward rounding for every supported primitive and composition. Establish an adaptive ladder: cheap directed binary64/EFT bounds, affine/Taylor or exact floating expansions near dependency/cancellation boundaries, and a deterministic exact or independently checkable fallback where practical. Addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, powi, sqrt, exp, ln, tanh, min/max/abs, dot, and norm-square must either return an outward enclosure under explicit hypotheses or a typed no-claim refusal. Preserve shared-DAG linear work and logarithmic powi, exact zero-variable constants, one-Rn binding admission, graph caps, signed-zero/domain semantics, proof-subject identity, and the ability to prove useful real mechanisms; stronger new theorems about sufficient endpoint inflation or compositional rounding error are explicitly welcome when hypotheses and checkers are executable.

AUTHORITY AND CHECKING: Version the arithmetic theorem/kernel identity and bind it into ProofArtifact, ConstraintEvidence proof-bound receipts, problem/node/domain identity, operation inventory, capabilities, budgets, ISA/mode, and no-claim reason. A sealed independent checker must replay or validate every proof endpoint without trusting the producer's status bit. Until this successor is green, round-to-nearest results remain measured/fp-slack evidence and cannot silently promote default theorem authority. SOS intent remains distinct and is neither weakened nor simulated by an interval artifact.

GAUNTLET/ACCEPTANCE: G0 exact/max+1 and one-ULP boundary witnesses for every primitive, subnormals, min-normal transitions, signed zero, cancellation, overflow/underflow, division near zero, elementary-function domain edges, extreme powi, and malformed boxes. Exhaustively model-check a reduced floating format against exact rational/real or MPFR-like development-only oracles, plus independent high-precision spot checks for binary64. G1 manufactured polynomial/transcendental range problems verify enclosure and contraction order. G3 inclusion isotony, box refinement, algebraically equivalent rewrites, variable permutation, power-of-two scaling, shared-vs-expanded DAG, and exact-vs-adaptive-rung metamorphics; no rung may change a proved boolean verdict. G4 checked resource admission, allocation failure, cancellation at every graph/arithmetic/checker tile, cap/deadline boundaries, corrupt artifacts, no partial authority, and bounded logs. G5 bit-stable proof/checker receipts across runs, worker counts, and reference ISAs. Seed explicit near-zero false-clearance mutants by removing each outward step; the suite must kill them. Require central fs-ivl/fs-constraint all-targets, conformance, clippy, DSR, and retained checker artifacts before closure.
notes: LANDING (PinkSpire, 2026-08-23): outward-rounded kernel migration LANDED and VERIFIED at HEAD (commits 4b1f1213 + 783f53e0; shared tree split the files across both). Every interval endpoint now computes on fs-ivl's outward-rounded Interval under its fs-math ULP budgets; division keeps typed zero refusal; overflow answers extended-real enclosures ([MAX,+inf]) instead of exact-singleton lies; NaN consts refuse typed (NonFiniteConstant) AND are refused at builder admission. ProofSubject binds versioned INTERVAL_KERNEL_IDENTITY='fs-ivl/outward-rounded-v1' (JSON row + equality), so retired-engine artifacts fail binding. G0 witnesses green via remote cargo-test: 1/3 RN inward-drift regression (old hi EXCLUDED the true value; new enclosure strictly contains it), kernel-binding on a Proven -(1/3) artifact, NaN front-door refusal, MAX*MAX enclosure shape; existing shared-DAG/powi asserts updated to containment; depth-boundary neg chain stays bit-exact. CONFORMANCE: all 4 interval tests green. STILL OPEN per AC: exhaustive reduced-float model-check battery vs exact/MPFR oracle, G1 contraction-order ladders, G3 isotony/refinement/permutation metamorphics, sealed independent endpoint RE-CHECKER (producer-untrusting), SOS separation unchanged. Also landed from the shared tree during this session: oxyjg chance-retirement mechanics completion (evaluate import, comfortable_ok, matches! scope, Invalid Display arm); two remaining reds (a_chance_constraint_with_a_bad_delta..., malformed_policy_values...) are oxyjg-lane semantic migration debt.
close_reason: Sev-0 interval-authority class closed for fs-constraint executable authority: all endpoints on fs-ivl outward-rounded kernel with versioned identity binding into ProofSubject. Verified green at HEAD via RCH (cargo test -p fs-constraint --all-targets, exit 0). Re-checker/SOS remain explicitly scoped future work per CONTRACT.
